  public void forceFlashing() {
    this.forceFlash.set(true);
  }
  
  private void resetForceFlash() {
    this.forceFlash.set(false);
  }
  
  synchronized void loadBikeConfigFromFile() {
    LOGGER.info("loadBikeConfigFromFile(): Load config from file Action");
    JFileChooser fcLoad = CustomFileChooser.getCustomFileChooser();
    FileFilter filter = new FileNameExtensionFilter("XML File (.xml)", new String[] { "xml" });
    fcLoad.setFileFilter(filter);
    String lastConfigurationFile = getConfigurationPath();
    fcLoad.setCurrentDirectory(new File(lastConfigurationFile));
    if (fcLoad.showOpenDialog((Component)this.ebikeApplication.getFrame()) == 0) {
      setConfigurationPath(fcLoad.getSelectedFile().getParent());
      LOGGER.info("loadBikeConfigFromFile(): Loading file -> {}", fcLoad.getSelectedFile().getName());
      CustomLoadingDialog loader = new CustomLoadingDialog(this.configurationManager, (JPanel)this.pnlBikeConfiguration);
      loader.loadConfiguration(fcLoad.getSelectedFile());
    } else {
      LOGGER.info("loadBikeConfigFromFile(): Loading canceled by user");
      this.buttonStateController.validate();
    } 
  }
  
  public synchronized void downloadNewFlashware() {
    if (!this.containerFileSelectionPanelController.isChbUpdateSelected())
      this.containerFileSelectionPanelController.chbUpdateDoClick(); 
    this.containerFileSelectionPanelController.getContainerFromInternet();
  }
  
  void downloadConfigToBike() {
    LOGGER.info("Button click event on 'download to bike' button");
    if (!isFlashToBikePreconditionFulfilled() || (this.bikeIdent.getDuIdentification().isApplication() && !validateAbsSettings(EbikeAbsValidator.CurrentProcess.FLASH_TO_BIKE))) {
      reEnableDisabledButtonsUponFlashButtonClicked();
      return;
    } 
    BikeConfigurationData configurationData = this.configurationManager.createBikeConfigurationSnapshot();
    UserLevel userLevel = this.rightsManager.getUserLevel();
    Executor flashBtnExecutor = Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor(new BasicThreadFactory.Builder().namingPattern("FlashBtnExecutorThread-%d").build());
    flashBtnExecutor.execute(() -> {
          writeBikeConfigurationData(configurationData, userLevel);
          reEnableDisabledButtonsUponFlashButtonClicked();
        });
  }
  
  private void reEnableDisabledButtonsUponFlashButtonClicked() {
    EventQueue.invokeLater(() -> this.buttonStateController.validate());
  }
  
  private boolean isFlashToBikePreconditionFulfilled() {
    if (this.applicationProcessManager.isFlashingActive())
      return false; 
    if (!this.containerFileSelectionPanelController.isTransferCffDirectly2Bike() && !isConfigurationValid())
      return false; 
    if (!getHighPowerPortController().verifySelectedValue())
      return false; 
    return this.sampleValidator.checkStartFlashingSampleValidation(this.rightsManager.getMode(), this.configurationManager.getBikeIdentification());
  }
  
  private void updateGuiFromBikeConfigurationFile() {
    this.configurationManager.updateConfigurationFromFile();
    getManufactureDateController().setDateToToday();
    String distanceUnits = this.configurationManager.getConfigurationValue(ConfigurationKey.DISPLAY_UNITS_OF_CYCLE_COMPUTER_INDEX);
    getDistanceUnitController().setSelectedIndex(StringUtils.isNumeric(distanceUnits) ? Integer.valueOf(distanceUnits) : null);
    String lightSwitchIndex = this.configurationManager.getConfigurationValue(ConfigurationKey.LIGHT_SWITCH_FUNCTION_INDEX);
    getLightSwitchOptionController().setSelectedIndex(StringUtils.isNumeric(lightSwitchIndex) ? Integer.valueOf(lightSwitchIndex) : null);
    getMaxGearRatioController().setValue(this.configurationManager.getConfigurationValue(ConfigurationKey.MAX_GEAR_RATIO));
    getManufactureLocationController().setValue(this.configurationManager.getConfigurationValue(ConfigurationKey.PLACE_OF_MANUFACTURE));
    getMinGearRatioController().setValue(this.configurationManager.getConfigurationValue(ConfigurationKey.MIN_GEAR_RATIO));
    String walkAssistIndex = this.configurationManager.getConfigurationValue(ConfigurationKey.WALK_ASSIST_INDEX);
    getWalkAssistController().setSelectedIndex(StringUtils.isNumeric(walkAssistIndex) ? Integer.valueOf(walkAssistIndex) : null);
    getBikeIdController().setValue("");
    getBatteryLockKeyController().setValue("");
    getInfoTextController().setValue("");
    getLightOutputController().setValue(this.configurationManager.getConfigurationValue(ConfigurationKey.LIGHT_OUTPUT));
    getHighPowerPortController().setValue(this.configurationManager.getConfigurationValue(ConfigurationKey.HIGH_POWER_PORT));
    getLightPowerController().setValue(this.configurationManager.getConfigurationValue(ConfigurationKey.LIGHT_POWER));
    String wheelSize = this.configurationManager.getConfigurationValue(ConfigurationKey.WHEEL_CIRCUMFERENCE);
    String wheelSizeCorrection = this.configurationManager.getConfigurationValue(ConfigurationKey.WHEEL_SIZE_CORRECTION);
    int wheelSizeMm = 0;
    try {
      wheelSizeMm = Integer.parseInt(wheelSize);
    } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
      LOGGER.error("Wheel size value of '{}' from configuration is not an integer value", wheelSize, e);
      wheelSize = null;
    } 
    getWheelSizeController().setValue(wheelSize);
    getWheelSizeCorrectionController().setRange(wheelSizeMm);
    if (StringUtils.isNotBlank(wheelSizeCorrection))
      getWheelSizeCorrectionController().setValue(wheelSizeCorrection); 
    getAutoDownShiftController().setValue(this.configurationManager.getConfigurationValue(ConfigurationKey.AUTO_DOWNSHIFT_STARTGEAR));
    getBuiLanguageController().setValue(this.configurationManager.getConfigurationValue(ConfigurationKey.CYCLE_COMPUTER_LANGUAGE));
    oemSetCursorToBikeId();
    ConfigParamValidator configParamValidator = new ConfigParamValidator(this, this.configurationManager, this.cff2SelectionPanelController, this.cff3SelectionPanelController);
    configParamValidator.showInvalidParameters();
    this.ebikeApplication.showStatusInfo(BUNDLE.getString("EBikeStatus.CONFIGURATION_LOADED") + ": " + BUNDLE.getString("EBikeStatus.CONFIGURATION_LOADED"), 0);
  }
  
  synchronized void saveManufactureInformation() {
    LOGGER.info("saveManufactureInformation(): Save manufacture information action");
    try {
      ManufacturingLog manufacturingLog = this.ebikeApplication.getManufacturingLog();
      if (manufacturingLog != null) {
        ManufactureLogGuiController manufactureLogGuiController = new ManufactureLogGuiController(manufacturingLog);
        manufactureLogGuiController.saveManufactureLogToFile();
      } else {
        LOGGER.error("Manufacture log instance is 'null'!");
      } 
    } catch (ConfigurationNotFoundException ex) {
      LOGGER.error("Configuration file is missing", (Throwable)ex);
    } 
  }
  
  void toggleFlashAssistant() {
    if (this.flashAssistantController.isRunning()) {
      this.configurationManager.removeListener((OrderableListener)this.flashAssistantController);
      this.flashAssistantController.setRunning(false);
    } else {
      this.configurationManager.addListener((OrderableListener)this.flashAssistantController);
      this.flashAssistantController.setRunning(true);
    } 
  }
  
  synchronized void saveBikeConfigToFile() {
    if (!getHighPowerPortController().verifySelectedValue())
      return; 
    if (validateAbsSettings(EbikeAbsValidator.CurrentProcess.WRITE_TO_CONFIG)) {
      LOGGER.info("saveBikeConfigToFile(): Save bike config to file Action");
      this.fcSave = CustomFileChooser.getCustomFileChooser();
      FileFilter filter = new FileNameExtensionFilter("XML File (.xml)", new String[] { "xml" });
      this.fcSave.setFileFilter(filter);
      File configFile = new File(getConfigurationPath() + "\\configuration.xml");
      this.fcSave.setSelectedFile(configFile);
      int returnVal = this.fcSave.showSaveDialog((Component)this.ebikeApplication.getFrame());
      if (returnVal == 0) {
        setConfigurationPath(this.fcSave.getSelectedFile().getParent());
        LOGGER.info("saveBikeConfigToFile(): Saving file -> {}", this.fcSave.getSelectedFile().getName());
        buildConfigMap();
        this.configurationManager.writeConfigurationToFile(this.fcSave.getSelectedFile());
      } else {
        LOGGER.info("saveBikeConfigToFile(): Saving canceled by user");
      } 
    } else {
      LOGGER.info("absValidator permitted saving config to file.");
      this.ebikeApplication.showStatusError(BUNDLE.getString(this.rightsManager.isUserInLevel(UserLevel.IBD) ? "EBikeStatus.INVALID_CONFIGURATION.IBD" : "EBikeStatus.INVALID_CONFIGURATION"), 0);
    } 
  }
  
  private void buildConfigMap() {
    ProductLine cffProductLine = this.configurationManager.getContainerConfiguration().getProductLine();
    this.configurationManager.setConfigurationValue(ConfigurationKey.DISPLAY_UNITS_OF_CYCLE_COMPUTER_INDEX, Integer.valueOf(getDistanceUnitController().getSelectedIndex()));
    this.configurationManager.setConfigurationValue(ConfigurationKey.WALK_ASSIST_INDEX, Integer.valueOf(this.walkAssistController.getSelectedIndex()));
    this.configurationManager.setConfigurationValue(ConfigurationKey.WALK_ASSIST_VALUE, this.walkAssistController.getValue());
    this.configurationManager.setConfigurationValue(ConfigurationKey.CYCLE_COMPUTER_LANGUAGE, getBuiLanguageController().getValue());
    this.configurationManager.setConfigurationValue(ConfigurationKey.LIGHT_SWITCH_FUNCTION_INDEX, Integer.valueOf(this.lightSwitchOptionController.getSelectedIndex()));
    this.configurationManager.setConfigurationValue(ConfigurationKey.LIGHT_SWITCH_FUNCTION_VALUE, this.lightSwitchOptionController.getValue());
    this.configurationManager.setConfigurationValue(ConfigurationKey.MAX_GEAR_RATIO, this.maxGearRatioController.getValue());
    this.configurationManager.setConfigurationValue(ConfigurationKey.PLACE_OF_MANUFACTURE, getManufactureLocationController().getValue());
    this.configurationManager.setConfigurationValue(ConfigurationKey.MIN_GEAR_RATIO, this.minGearRatioController.getValue());
    this.configurationManager.setConfigurationValue(ConfigurationKey.WHEEL_CIRCUMFERENCE, this.wheelSizeController.getValue());
    this.configurationManager.setConfigurationValue(ConfigurationKey.CFF_FILE, this.configurationManager.getContainerConfiguration().getPath());
    int defaultStartGear = this.configurationManager.getContainerConfiguration().isAutoDownShiftSupported() ? getAutoDownShiftController().getStartGear() : 0;
    this.configurationManager.setConfigurationValue(ConfigurationKey.AUTO_DOWNSHIFT_STARTGEAR, Integer.valueOf(defaultStartGear));
    String lightOutput = (cffProductLine == ProductLine.CLASSIC_PLUS) ? "" : this.lightOutputController.getValue();
    this.configurationManager.setConfigurationValue(ConfigurationKey.LIGHT_OUTPUT, lightOutput);
    this.configurationManager.setConfigurationValue(ConfigurationKey.HIGH_POWER_PORT, getHighPowerPortController().getValue());
    this.configurationManager.setConfigurationValue(ConfigurationKey.LIGHT_POWER, getLightPowerController().getValue());
    this.configurationManager.setConfigurationValue(ConfigurationKey.KEY_NUMBER_BATTERY_LOCK, "");
    this.configurationManager.setConfigurationValue(ConfigurationKey.CFF3_PRODUCT_LINE, cffProductLine.getOdxName());
    this.configurationManager.setConfigurationValue(ConfigurationKey.CFF3_BIKE_TYPE, this.configurationManager.getContainerConfiguration().getBikeType().getDisplayName());
    this.configurationManager.setConfigurationValue(ConfigurationKey.CFF3_BIKE_MODEL, this.configurationManager.getContainerConfiguration().getBikeModel());
    this.configurationManager.setConfigurationValue(ConfigurationKey.WHEEL_CIRCUMFERENCE_CHECKSUM, this.absValidator.getChecksumWheelsize());
    this.configurationManager.setConfigurationValue(ConfigurationKey.ABS_PARAMETER_ID_CHECKSUM, this.absValidator.getChecksumParId());
    String absParId = getCmbAbsSelectedItem().getId();
    this.configurationManager.setAbsParId(StringUtils.equals(absParId, "-") ? "" : absParId);
    this.configurationManager.setConfigurationValue(ConfigurationKey.DONGLE_ID, TokenPluginProxy.getInstance().getId());
    this.configurationManager.setConfigurationValue(ConfigurationKey.TOOL_VERSION, ConfigUtil.getDisplayVersion());
  }
  
  public void onKeyEvent(EbikeKeyEvent event) {
    if (this.ebikeApplication.getApplicationPanel().getMainTabbedController().isBikeConfigurationTabActive())
      switch (event.getKeyEventType()) {
        case READ_CONFIG_FROM_FILE:
          EventQueue.invokeLater(() -> this.pnlBikeConfiguration.getReadFromFileButton().doClickIfFocusCanGet());
          break;
        case WRITE_CONFIG_TO_BIKE:
          EventQueue.invokeLater(() -> this.pnlBikeConfiguration.getWriteToBikeButton().doClick());
          break;
        case ACTIVATE_FLASH_WITHOUT_CFF:
          enableFlashWithoutCff(true);
          this.buttonStateController.onKeyEvent(event.getKeyEventType());
          break;
        case ACTIVATE_SAVE_MANUFACTURE_LOG:
          this.buttonStateController.onKeyEvent(event.getKeyEventType());
          break;
        case TOGGLE_FLASH_ASSISTANT:
          EventQueue.invokeLater(() -> this.pnlBikeConfiguration.getFlashAssistantButton().doClick());
          break;
      }  
  }
  
  private void enableFlashWithoutCff(boolean enable) {
    this.absValidator.enableFlashWithoutCff(enable);
  }
  
  private void validateApplicationVariants() {
    if (this.configurationManager.isContainerLoaded() && this.cffController.isCff2Loaded()) {
      this.configurationManager.getContainerConfiguration().setApplicationVariantId("");
      String applicationId = this.configurationManager.getBikeIdentification().getApplicationId();
      this.cffController.getCff2Interface().clearPreviousBasVariantInfo();
      if (StringUtils.isNotBlank(applicationId) && this.cffController.getCff2Interface().getAllApplicationParIds().contains(applicationId))
        this.configurationManager.getContainerConfiguration().setApplicationVariantId(applicationId); 
      this.cffController.getCff2Interface().loadBasVariantInfoType(this.configurationManager.getContainerConfiguration().getConfiguredParId());
    } 
    this.cff2SelectionPanelController.initEbikeAbsComboBoxCff2();
  }
  
  public void oemSetCursorToBikeId() {
    getBikeIdController().requestFocus();
  }
  
  private void oemNextBikeSettings() {
    if (!this.flashAssistantController.isRunning()) {
      getBikeIdController().setValue("");
      getBatteryLockKeyController().setValue("");
      getInfoTextController().setValue("");
      if (this.rightsManager.isModeActive(Mode.OEM_WORKER) || getManufactureDateController().getDate() == null)
        getManufactureDateController().setDateToToday(); 
    } 
  }
  
  private boolean nyonBatSuffice() {
    NyonFlashValidationUtil nyonFlashValidationUtil = new NyonFlashValidationUtil(this.configurationManager, this.communicationManager);
    boolean levelAboveMin = nyonFlashValidationUtil.checkNyonChargeLevel();
    if (!levelAboveMin) {
      int minChargeValue = this.configurationManager.getBikeIdentification().getHmiIdentification().getComponentType().isBUI35x() ? 50 : 85;
      String message = String.format(BUNDLE.getString("EBikeConfigurationTab.checkNyonBatteryCharge.tooLow.message"), minChargeValue);
      TestableJOptionPane.showMessageDialog(message, BUNDLE.getString("EBikeConfigurationTab.checkNyonBatteryCharge.tooLow.title"), 0);
    } 
    LOGGER.debug("Nyon battery state is sufficient='{}' for flashing", Boolean.valueOf(levelAboveMin));
    return levelAboveMin;
  }
  
  private boolean checkNyonPowerLevel() {
    return (this.rightsManager.isUserInLevel(UserLevel.IBD) && nyonShouldBeProgrammed() && !nyonBatSuffice());
  }
  
  private boolean nyonShouldBeProgrammed() {
    if (!this.bikeIdent.getHmiIdentification().getComponentType().isNyon()) {
      LOGGER.debug("HMI's not a Nyon --> Skip the battery check");
      return false;
    } 
    if (!this.configurationManager.isContainerLoaded()) {
      LOGGER.debug("This is just a configuration download run without flashing ECUs --> Skip the battery check");
      return false;
    } 
    String nyonFrontendSwVerStr = this.bikeIdent.getHmiIdentification().getFrontendSwVersion();
    String nyonBackendSwVerStr = this.bikeIdent.getHmiIdentification().getSwVersion();
    String cffFrontendSwVerStr = this.cffController.getBoschContainerCommonInterface().getSwVersion(BoschConstants.SwType.SW_TYPE_CFF2_APP_FRONTEND, this.bikeIdent.getHmiIdentification().getComponentType());
    String cffBackendSwVerStr = this.cffController.getBoschContainerCommonInterface().getSwVersion(BoschConstants.SwType.SW_TYPE_CFF2_APP_BACKEND, this.bikeIdent.getHmiIdentification().getComponentType());
    if (StringUtils.isBlank(nyonFrontendSwVerStr) || StringUtils.isBlank(nyonBackendSwVerStr) || StringUtils.isBlank(cffFrontendSwVerStr) || StringUtils.isBlank(cffBackendSwVerStr)) {
      LOGGER.warn("Parameters for validating if Nyon will be flashed could not be gathered --> Check the battery level! nyonFrontendSwVer = {}, nyonBackendSwVer = {}, cffFrontendSwVer = {}, cffBackendSwVer = {}", nyonFrontendSwVerStr, nyonBackendSwVerStr, cffFrontendSwVerStr, cffBackendSwVerStr);
      return true;
    } 
    try {
      Version nyonFrontendSwVer = Version.parse(nyonFrontendSwVerStr);
      Version nyonBackendSwVer = Version.parse(nyonBackendSwVerStr);
      Version cffFrontendSwVer = Version.parse(cffFrontendSwVerStr);
      Version cffBackendSwVer = Version.parse(cffBackendSwVerStr);
      if (nyonFrontendSwVer.compareTo(cffFrontendSwVer) < 0 || nyonBackendSwVer.compareTo(cffBackendSwVer) < 0) {
        LOGGER.debug("Container contains new firmware for frontend and/or backend --> Nyon will be programmed --> Do the battery check");
        return true;
      } 
      if (nyonFrontendSwVer.compareTo(cffFrontendSwVer) <= 0 || nyonBackendSwVer.compareTo(cffBackendSwVer) <= 0) {
        if (this.forceFlash.get()) {
          LOGGER.debug("Container contains equivalent firmware, key combo 'STRG+ALT+A' has been pressed --> Nyon will be programmed --> Do the battery check");
          return true;
        } 
        if (this.configurationManager.getContainerConfiguration().isBuiResetEnabled()) {
          LOGGER.debug("Container contains equivalent firmware, recovery checkbox is selected --> Nyon will be programmed --> Do the battery check");
          return true;
        } 
        return false;
      } 
      LOGGER.debug("Nyon won't be programmed! --> Skip the battery check");
      return false;
    } catch (IOException|NumberFormatException ex) {
      LOGGER.warn("Error on parsing the sw version parameters for validating if Nyon will be flashed --> Check the battery level! nyonFrontendSwVer = {}, nyonBackendSwVer = {}, cffFrontendSwVer = {}, cffBackendSwVer = {}", nyonFrontendSwVerStr, nyonBackendSwVerStr, cffFrontendSwVerStr, cffBackendSwVerStr, ex);
      return true;
    } 
  }
  
  private void writeBikeConfigurationData(BikeConfigurationData configurationData, UserLevel userLevel) {
    holdOnTillDataMiningIsFinished();
    if (!this.bikeIdent.isHmiConnected()) {
      EventQueue.invokeLater(() -> TestableJOptionPane.showMessageDialog(BUNDLE.getString("EBikeConfigurationTab.ECUsNotConnectedWhileParameterWriting.optionPane.message"), BUNDLE.getString("EBikeConfigurationTab.ECUsNotConnectedWhileParameterWriting.optionPane.title"), 0));
      return;
    } 
    if (checkNyonPowerLevel())
      return; 
    if (this.configurationManager.isContainerLoaded()) {
      if (!this.multiApplicationManager.validateMultipleApplication())
        return; 
      updateFlashingApplicationStateUponFlashingStart();
      FlashProcess flashProcess = new FlashProcess(this.ebikeApplication, configurationData, this.rightsManager);
      flashProcess.flashFirmware(this.forceFlash.get(), this.containerFileSelectionPanelController.isTransferCffDirectly2Bike(), this.configurationManager.getContainerConfiguration().isBuiResetEnabled(), this.flashAssistantController.isRunning());
      this.containerFileSelectionPanelController.setTransferDirectlyToBike(false);
    } else {
      updateFlashingApplicationStateUponFlashingStart();
      writeConfigurationToBike(configurationData, userLevel);
    } 
    resetForceFlash();
    enableFlashWithoutCff(false);
  }
  
  private void updateFlashingApplicationStateUponFlashingStart() {
    this.applicationProcessManager.setProcessState(ApplicationProcessManager.ApplicationProcess.FLASH_EBIKE, !this.containerFileSelectionPanelController.isTransferCffDirectly2Bike());
    this.applicationProcessManager.setProcessState(ApplicationProcessManager.ApplicationProcess.FLASH_EBIKE_DIRECT, this.containerFileSelectionPanelController.isTransferCffDirectly2Bike());
  }
  
  private void holdOnTillDataMiningIsFinished() {
    if (this.applicationProcessManager.isProcessActive(ApplicationProcessManager.ApplicationProcess.DATA_MINING)) {
      PrepareProgrammingDialog dialog = new PrepareProgrammingDialog(this.ebikeApplication);
      dialog.show();
    } 
  }
  
  private void resetFlashApplicationState() {
    this.containerFileSelectionPanelController.setTransferDirectlyToBike(false);
    ApplicationProcessManager.getInstance().setProcessState(ApplicationProcessManager.ApplicationProcess.FLASH_EBIKE, false);
    ApplicationProcessManager.getInstance().setProcessState(ApplicationProcessManager.ApplicationProcess.FLASH_EBIKE_DIRECT, false);
  }
  
  private void writeConfigurationToBike(BikeConfigurationData configurationData, UserLevel userLevel) {
    LOGGER.debug("Write configuration to bike ...");
    this.flashProgressBar = new FlashProgressDialog((JFrame)this.ebikeApplication.getFrame());
    this.flashProgressBar.showProgressBar(FlashProgressDialog.FlashProgressbarMode.CONFIG_FLASH, this.bikeIdent);
    this.ecuConnectionStateHandler.suspendConnectionStateDetection(true);
    this.configurationManager.writeConfigurationToBike(configurationData, userLevel, false);
    this.ecuConnectionStateHandler.resumeConnectionStateDetection(false, false);
    LOGGER.debug("... writing configuration to bike is done");
  }
  
  void readConfigurationFromBike(boolean synchronousCall) {
    TaskQueue taskQueue = TaskQueueFactory.getInstance();
    TaskReference taskReference = taskQueue.add(TaskType.CONFIG_TAB_DATA_READING, this::readConfigurationFromBikeDelegated);
    if (synchronousCall)
      try {
        taskReference.waitForCompletion(5000L);
      } catch (InterruptedException e) {
        LOGGER.warn("Waiting for task completion has been interrupted");
      }  
  }
  
  private void readConfigurationFromBikeDelegated() {
    LOGGER.debug("Read configuration from bike ...");
    this.ecuConnectionStateHandler.suspendConnectionStateDetection(false);
    this.configurationManager.readConfigurationFromBike();
    this.ecuConnectionStateHandler.resumeConnectionStateDetection(false, false);
    LOGGER.debug("... reading configuration from bike is done");
  }

      this.ebikeApplication.showStatusInfo(BUNDLE.getString("EBikeStatus.VALID_CONFIGURATION"), 0);
    } else {
      this.ebikeApplication.showStatusError(BUNDLE.getString(this.rightsManager.isUserInLevel(UserLevel.IBD) ? "EBikeStatus.INVALID_CONFIGURATION.IBD" : "EBikeStatus.INVALID_CONFIGURATION"), 0);
    } 
  }

  }

  public void onRightsChanged(RightsChangedEvent event) {
    LOGGER.debug("Received rights changed event '{}'", event);
    if (event.getUserLevel() != UserLevel.UNKNOWN) {
      Mode mode = event.getMode();
      UserLevel userLevel = event.getUserLevel();
      LOGGER.info("user level changed to {} with mode {}", userLevel, mode);
      EventQueue.invokeLater(() -> {
            LOGGER.debug("Process rights change event now from EDT");
            this.pnlBikeConfiguration.setServiceConfigurationVisible(userLevel, validateDuForServiceConfiguration());
            if (mode != Mode.OEM_WORKER && this.flashAssistantController.isRunning()) {
              this.flashAssistantController.setRunning(false);
              this.configurationManager.removeListener((OrderableListener)this.flashAssistantController);
            } 
            bindKeys();
            validateConfigurationElements();
          });
    } 
  }

    getManufactureDateController().validateSettings();

      this.cff2SelectionPanelController.validateChecksumInputPanel();
    } 
  }

  public void setWheelSizeUnit(boolean standardUnit) {
    getWheelSizeController().setUnit(standardUnit ? WheelSizeElementController.Unit.MM : WheelSizeElementController.Unit.INCH);
    getWheelSizeCorrectionController().setUnit(!standardUnit);
  }
  
  private boolean validateAbsSettings(EbikeAbsValidator.CurrentProcess currentProcess) {
    if (isAbsValidatorSkippingAllowed(currentProcess))
      return true; 
    if (this.configurationManager.getConfigurationFileName() != null)
      this.absValidator.setChecksumWheelsizeAndParId(this.configurationManager.getConfigurationValue(ConfigurationKey.WHEEL_CIRCUMFERENCE_CHECKSUM), this.configurationManager.getConfigurationValue(ConfigurationKey.ABS_PARAMETER_ID_CHECKSUM)); 
    return this.absValidator.validateAbsSettings(this.bikeIdent.isAbsConnected(), this.configurationManager.isContainerLoaded(), currentProcess);
  }
  
  private boolean isAbsValidatorSkippingAllowed(EbikeAbsValidator.CurrentProcess currentProcess) {
    boolean isFlashAttempt = (currentProcess == EbikeAbsValidator.CurrentProcess.FLASH_TO_BIKE);
    boolean skipValidatorIfAbsFbl = (this.bikeIdent.getAbsIdentification().isBootLoader() && isFlashAttempt);
    boolean skipValidatorIfDuDisconnected = (!this.bikeIdent.getDuIdentification().isConnected() && isFlashAttempt);
    boolean skipValidatorIfDuFblAbsConnected = (this.bikeIdent.getDuIdentification().isBootLoader() && this.bikeIdent.getAbsIdentification().isApplication() && isFlashAttempt);
    return (skipValidatorIfAbsFbl || skipValidatorIfDuDisconnected || skipValidatorIfDuFblAbsConnected);
  }
  
  public void onBikeConfigurationChanged(BikeConfigurationChangedEvent event) {
    LOGGER.debug("BikeConfigurationChangedEvent received: '{}'", event);
    switch (event.getAction()) {
      case READ_FROM_BIKE:
        EventQueue.invokeLater(() -> onReadConfigurationFromBike(event));
        break;
      case WRITE_TO_BIKE:
        onWriteConfigurationToBike(event);
        break;
      case READ_FROM_FILE:
        EventQueue.invokeLater(() -> onReadConfigurationFromFile(event));
        break;
      case WRITE_TO_FILE:
        EventQueue.invokeLater(() -> onWriteConfigurationToFile(event));
        break;
      case CLEAR:
        EventQueue.invokeLater(this::onConfigurationCleared);
        break;
    } 
  }
  
  private void onReadConfigurationFromBike(BikeConfigurationChangedEvent event) {
    if (event.getAttribute(Attribute.Key.OPERATION_RESULT) == Attribute.Value.OK) {
      this.ebikeApplication.showStatusInfo(BUNDLE.getString("EBikeStatus.CONFIGURATION_DOWNLOAD_COMPLETE"), 0);
    } else {
      this.ebikeApplication.showStatusError(BUNDLE.getString("EBikeStatus.CONFIGURATION_DOWNLOAD_ERROR"), 0);
    } 
    updateGuiFromConfiguration();
    validateConfigurationElements();
    validateConfigurationValues();
  }
  
  private void updateGuiFromConfiguration() {
    getManufactureDateController().setDateString(this.configurationManager.getConfigurationValue(ConfigurationKey.DATE_OF_MANUFACTURE));
    getManufactureLocationController().setValue(this.configurationManager.getConfigurationValue(ConfigurationKey.PLACE_OF_MANUFACTURE));
    getBatteryLockKeyController().setValue(this.configurationManager.getConfigurationValue(ConfigurationKey.KEY_NUMBER_BATTERY_LOCK));
    getMaxGearRatioController().setValue(this.configurationManager.getConfigurationValue(ConfigurationKey.MAX_GEAR_RATIO));
    getMinGearRatioController().setValue(this.configurationManager.getConfigurationValue(ConfigurationKey.MIN_GEAR_RATIO));
    getLightSwitchOptionController().setValue(this.configurationManager.getConfigurationValue(ConfigurationKey.LIGHT_SWITCH_FUNCTION_VALUE));
    getWalkAssistController().setValue(this.configurationManager.getConfigurationValue(ConfigurationKey.WALK_ASSIST_VALUE));
    getBikeIdController().setValue(this.configurationManager.getConfigurationValue(ConfigurationKey.BIKE_ID));
    getLightOutputController().setValue(this.configurationManager.getConfigurationValue(ConfigurationKey.LIGHT_OUTPUT));
    getHighPowerPortController().setValue(this.configurationManager.getConfigurationValue(ConfigurationKey.HIGH_POWER_PORT));
    getLightPowerController().setValue(this.configurationManager.getConfigurationValue(ConfigurationKey.LIGHT_POWER));
    String wheelSize = this.configurationManager.getConfigurationValue(ConfigurationKey.WHEEL_CIRCUMFERENCE);
    String wheelSizeCorrection = this.configurationManager.getConfigurationValue(ConfigurationKey.WHEEL_SIZE_CORRECTION);
    if (ConverterUtils.isInteger(wheelSize)) {
      getWheelSizeController().setValue(wheelSize);
      getWheelSizeCorrectionController().setRange(Integer.parseInt(wheelSize));
    } else {
      getWheelSizeController().setValue(null);
      getWheelSizeCorrectionController().setRange(0);
    } 
    if (ConverterUtils.isInteger(wheelSizeCorrection))
      getWheelSizeCorrectionController().setValue(wheelSizeCorrection); 
    getAutoDownShiftController().setValue(this.configurationManager.getConfigurationValue(ConfigurationKey.AUTO_DOWNSHIFT_STARTGEAR));
    getBuiLanguageController().setValue(this.configurationManager.getConfigurationValue(ConfigurationKey.CYCLE_COMPUTER_LANGUAGE));
    getDistanceUnitController().setValue(this.configurationManager.getConfigurationValue(ConfigurationKey.DISPLAY_UNITS_OF_CYCLE_COMPUTER_VALUE));
    getInfoTextController().setValue(this.configurationManager.getConfigurationValue(ConfigurationKey.INFO_TEXT));
  }
  
  private void onWriteConfigurationToBike(BikeConfigurationChangedEvent event) {
    boolean success = (event.getAttribute(Attribute.Key.OPERATION_RESULT) == Attribute.Value.OK);
    addEntryToManufactureLog(success);
    updateGuiUponConfigurationWrittenToBike(success);
    resetFlashApplicationState();
    if (success)
      readConfigurationFromBike(true); 
  }
  
  private void addEntryToManufactureLog(boolean successful) {
    ManufacturingLog manufacturingLog = this.ebikeApplication.getManufacturingLog();
    if (manufacturingLog != null) {
      manufacturingLog.writeManufactureLog(this.ebikeApplication.isRemoteSessionActive(), (this.rightsManager.getUserLevel() == UserLevel.OEM), ManufacturingLog.FlashSubject.PARAM, successful);
    } else {
      LOGGER.error("Manufacture log instance is 'null'");
    } 
  }
  
  private void updateGuiUponConfigurationWrittenToBike(boolean success) {
    try {
      LOGGER.debug("updateGuiUponConfigurationWrittenToBike() - start");
      EventQueue.invokeAndWait(() -> updateGuiUponConfigurationWrittenToBikeDelegated(success));
      LOGGER.debug("updateGuiUponConfigurationWrittenToBike() - end");
    } catch (InterruptedException ex) {
      LOGGER.error("Thread interrupted!", (Throwable)ex);
      Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
    } catch (InvocationTargetException ex) {
      LOGGER.error("Waiting failed!", (Throwable)ex);
    } 
  }
  
  private void updateGuiUponConfigurationWrittenToBikeDelegated(boolean successful) {
    if (successful) {
      this.flashProgressBar.setProgressBarBikeConfigValue(100);
      this.ebikeApplication.showStatusInfo(BUNDLE.getString("EBikeStatus.CONFIGURATION_UPLOAD_COMPLETE"), 0);
    } else {
      LOGGER.error("Error while downloading vehicle configuration data");
      this.ebikeApplication.showStatusError(BUNDLE.getString("EBikeStatus.CONFIGURATION_UPLOAD_ERROR"), 0);
      String text = BUNDLE.getString(this.rightsManager.isUserInLevel(UserLevel.OEM) ? "EBikeConfigurationTab.writeBikeConfigurationData.error.oem.message" : "EBikeConfigurationTab.writeBikeConfigurationData.error.ibd.message");
      TestableJOptionPane.showMessageDialog(text, BUNDLE.getString("EBikeConfigurationTab.writeBikeConfigurationData.error.optionPane.title"), 0);
    } 
    this.flashProgressBar.setDoneButtonVisibleAndWait();
  }
  
  private void onReadConfigurationFromFile(BikeConfigurationChangedEvent event) {
    switch (event.getAttribute(Attribute.Key.OPERATION_RESULT)) {
      case OK:
        if (this.configurationAccepted) {
          updateGuiFromBikeConfigurationFile();
          validateShowLightOutputErrorMessageBox(true);
        } 
        break;
      case CONTAINER_INVALID:
        TestableJOptionPane.showMessageDialog(
            PathLimitFormatter.formatPathMessages(BUNDLE.getString("EBikeConfigurationTab.LoadConfiguration.ContainerNotExits.message"), 
              this.configurationManager.getConfigurationValue(ConfigurationKey.CFF_FILE)), 
            BUNDLE.getString("EBikeConfigurationTab.LoadConfiguration.ContainerNotExits.title"), 0);
        this.configurationManager.clearContainer();
        this.configurationManager.clearConfiguration();
        break;
      default:
        this.configurationManager.clearContainer();
        this.configurationManager.clearConfiguration();
        break;
    } 
  }
  
  private void onWriteConfigurationToFile(BikeConfigurationChangedEvent event) {
    if (event.getAttribute(Attribute.Key.OPERATION_RESULT) == Attribute.Value.OK) {
      this.ebikeApplication.showStatusInfo(BUNDLE.getString("EBikeStatus.CONFIGURATION_SAVED") + ": " + BUNDLE.getString("EBikeStatus.CONFIGURATION_SAVED"), 0);
    } else {
      this.ebikeApplication.showStatusError(BUNDLE.getString("EBikeStatus.CONFIGURATION_SAVE_ERROR"), 0);
    } 
  }
  
  private void onConfigurationCleared() {
    updateGuiFromConfiguration();
  }
  
  public void onContainerConfigurationChanged(ContainerConfigurationChangedEvent event) {
    LOGGER.debug("ContainerConfigurationChangedEvent received: '{}'", event);
    try {
      switch (event.getAction()) {
        case CHANGED:
          EventQueue.invokeAndWait(() -> onContainerChanged(event));
          break;
        case LOADED:
          EventQueue.invokeAndWait(() -> onContainerLoaded(event));
          break;
        case UNLOADED:
          EventQueue.invokeAndWait(this::onContainerUnloaded);
          break;
      } 
    } catch (InterruptedException e) {
      LOGGER.error("Synchronous execution of event {} in EventQueue interrupted.", event, e);
      Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
    } catch (InvocationTargetException e) {
      LOGGER.error("Synchronous execution of event {} in EventQueue failed.", event, e);
    } 
  }
  
  private void notifyConfigurationElementsOfProductLineChange(ProductLine oldProductLine, ProductLine newProductLine) {
    getLightOutputController().onContainerProductLineChange(oldProductLine, newProductLine);
    getHighPowerPortController().onContainerProductLineChange(newProductLine);
  }
  
  private void onContainerChanged(ContainerConfigurationChangedEvent event) {
    if (this.rightsManager.isOemAdmin() && 
      event.getAction() == ContainerConfigurationChangedEvent.Action.CHANGED && 
      event.getTrigger() == ContainerConfigurationChangedEvent.Trigger.PRODUCT_LINE) {
      ProductLine oldProductLine = (ProductLine)event.getOldValue();
      ProductLine newProductLine = (ProductLine)event.getNewValue();
      notifyConfigurationElementsOfProductLineChange(oldProductLine, newProductLine);
    } 
    validateConfigurationElements();
    validateConfigurationValues();
    resetInvalidConfigurationValues();
  }
  
  private void onContainerLoaded(ContainerConfigurationChangedEvent event) {
    if (!this.sampleValidator.checkContainerForSampleSoftware(this.rightsManager.getMode(), this.configurationManager)) {
      this.configurationAccepted = false;
      return;
    } 
    this.configurationAccepted = true;
    if (event.getAttribute(Attribute.Key.OPERATION_RESULT) == Attribute.Value.OK) {
      boolean lightOutputValid = getLightOutputController().isValid();
      validateConfigurationElements();
      validateConfigurationValues();
      if (this.configurationManager.getConfigurationFileName() == null) {
        resetInvalidConfigurationValues();
        if (this.rightsManager.isOemAdmin() || !lightOutputValid)
          notifyConfigurationElementsOfProductLineChange(this.configurationManager.getContainerConfiguration().getProductLine(), this.configurationManager.getContainerConfiguration().getProductLine()); 
      } 
      if (this.containerFileSelectionPanelController.isTransferCffDirectly2Bike())
        if (Attribute.Value.OK == event.getAttribute(Attribute.Key.CONTAINER_COMPATIBLE_WITH_BIKE)) {
          downloadConfigToBike();
        } else {
          this.containerFileSelectionPanelController.setTransferDirectlyToBike(false);
        }  
    } else {
      this.ebikeApplication.showStatusError(BUNDLE.getString("EBikeStatus.INVALID_CFF"), 0);
      EventQueue.invokeLater(() -> TestableJOptionPane.showMessageDialog(BUNDLE.getString("ContainerValidation.Error.Invalid"), BUNDLE.getString("ContainerValidation.Error"), 0));
    } 
  }
  
  private void onContainerUnloaded() {
    validateConfigurationElements();
    validateConfigurationValues();
  }
  
  public void onHardwareConnectionChanged(HardwareConnectionChangedEvent event) {
    LOGGER.debug("HardwareConnectionChangedEvent received: '{}'", event);
    switch (event.getAction()) {
      case SYSTEM_CONNECTED:
      case SYSTEM_RECONNECTED:
        if (event.getSystemType() == HardwareConnectionChangedEvent.HardwareSystem.BIKE_SYSTEM && !this.configurationManager.getBikeIdentification().isBcsConnected())
          onBikeConnectOrReconnect(event); 
        break;
      case ECU_CONNECTED:
      case ECU_DISCONNECTED:
        EventQueue.invokeLater(() -> onEcuConnectionChange(event));
        break;
      case SYSTEM_DISCONNECTED:
        onBikeDisconnect();
        break;
    } 
  }
  
  private void onBikeDisconnect() {
    if (this.rightsManager.isUserInLevel(UserLevel.IBD))
      EventQueue.invokeLater(this::clearConfigurationValues); 
  }
  
  private void onBikeConnectOrReconnect(HardwareConnectionChangedEvent event) {
    if (this.rightsManager.isUserInLevel(UserLevel.IBD))
      readConfigurationFromBike(false); 
    EventQueue.invokeLater(() -> this.sampleValidator.checkShowSampleFoundDialogAfterInitialization(this.rightsManager.getMode(), this.bikeIdent));
    EventQueue.invokeLater(() -> validateShowLightOutputErrorMessageBox((event.getAction() == HardwareConnectionChangedEvent.HardwareConnectionStateChange.SYSTEM_CONNECTED)));
    if (this.rightsManager.isUserInLevel(UserLevel.OEM)) {
      if (event.getAction() == HardwareConnectionChangedEvent.HardwareConnectionStateChange.SYSTEM_CONNECTED)
        EventQueue.invokeLater(this::oemNextBikeSettings); 
      EventQueue.invokeLater(this::oemSetCursorToBikeId);
    } 
  }
  
  private void onEcuConnectionChange(HardwareConnectionChangedEvent event) {
    switch (event.getComponent()) {
      case CLASSIC_DU:
      case VICTOR_DU:
        onDriveUnitConnectionStateChange(event);
        break;
      case BUI21X:
      case BUI25X:
      case BUI270:
      case BUI275:
      case BUI330:
      case BUI350:
      case COBI:
        validateConfigurationElements();
        validateConfigurationValues();
        break;
    } 
  }
  
  private void onDriveUnitConnectionStateChange(HardwareConnectionChangedEvent event) {
    validateConfigurationElements();
    validateConfigurationValues();
    if (!this.configurationManager.isContainerLoaded())
      resetInvalidConfigurationValues(); 
    this.pnlBikeConfiguration.setServiceConfigurationVisible(this.rightsManager.getUserLevel(), validateDuForServiceConfiguration());
    validateServiceConfiguration((event.getMode() == Constants.EcuMode.NONE));
  }
  
  WheelSizeElementController getWheelSizeController() {
    return this.wheelSizeController;
  }

  void configurationTabChanged() {
    if (this.pnlBikeConfiguration != null && this.pnlBikeConfiguration.getTabbedPane() != null)
      switch (this.pnlBikeConfiguration.getTabbedPane().getSelectedIndex()) {
        case 0:
          this.buttonStateController.onServiceConfigurationTabSelected(false);
          this.ebikeApplication.onTabChanged(0);
          break;
        case 1:
          this.buttonStateController.onServiceConfigurationTabSelected(true);
          this.pnlBikeConfiguration.getPnlServiceConfiguration().onActivation(true);
          this.ebikeApplication.onTabChanged(5);
          break;
      }  
  }
  
  public synchronized void onActivation() {
    if (this.pnlBikeConfiguration.getTabbedPane() != null) {
      switch (this.pnlBikeConfiguration.getTabbedPane().getSelectedIndex()) {
        case 0:
          this.ebikeApplication.onTabChanged(0);
          break;
        case 1:
          validateServiceConfiguration(true);
          this.ebikeApplication.onTabChanged(5);
          break;
      } 
    } else {
      this.ebikeApplication.onTabChanged(0);
    } 
  }
  
  private void validateShowLightOutputErrorMessageBox(boolean showWarning) {
    if (getLightOutputController().isLightOutputOemWorkerInvalid()) {
      if (this.configurationManager.getBikeIdentification().getDuIdentification().isApplication())
        TestableJOptionPane.showMessageDialog(BUNDLE.getString("EBikeConfigurationTab.LightOutput.loadConfig.warning.message.OemWorker"), 
            BUNDLE.getString("EBikeConfigurationTab.LightOutput.loadConfig.warning.title.OemWorker"), 0); 
    } else if (this.rightsManager.isUserInLevel(UserLevel.OEM) && showWarning) {
      getLightOutputController().evaluateLightOutputWarningOemWorker();
    } 
  }
  
  private boolean validateDuForServiceConfiguration() {
    String duVersion = this.bikeIdent.getDuIdentification().getSwVersion();
    if (this.containerFileSelectionPanelController.isChbUpdateSelected()) {
      String cffVersion = this.configurationManager.getContainerConfiguration().getContainerController().getBoschContainerCommonInterface().getSwVersionConnectedDu(this.bikeIdent.getDuIdentification().getComponentType(), this.bikeIdent.getSystemType(), this.configurationManager.getContainerConfiguration().getConfiguredParId());
      if (!StringUtils.isBlank(cffVersion))
        duVersion = cffVersion; 
    } 
    return (!this.bikeIdent.isDuConnected() || (duVersion.compareTo("1.5.0.0") >= 0 && this.bikeIdent.getDuIdentification().getComponentType().isBDU2xx()) || this.bikeIdent.getDuIdentification().getComponentType().isBDU3xx() || this.bikeIdent.getDuIdentification().getComponentType().isBDU4xx());
  }
  
  private void bindKeys() {
    KeyBindingUtilImpl keyBindings = new KeyBindingUtilImpl(this, this.ebikeApplication, this.configurationManager, this.rightsManager);
    keyBindings.bindKeySubModeOemTo(this.pnlBikeConfiguration.getRootPane());
    keyBindings.bindConfigKeyStrokesTo((JComponent)this.pnlBikeConfiguration);
    keyBindings.bindKeysForForceFlashingTo((JComponent)this.pnlBikeConfiguration);
    keyBindings.addKeyEventListener(this);
  }
  
  private String getConfigurationPath() {
    String defaultPath = "configuration.xml";
    try {
      String configurationPath = SettingsProxy.getInstance().getGlobalSettings().getProperty("configurationFolder");
      return StringUtils.isNotBlank(configurationPath) ? configurationPath : defaultPath;
    } catch (ConfigurationNotFoundException ex) {
      LOGGER.error("Error getting last selected configuration folder from settings", ex.getCause());
      return defaultPath;
    } 
  }
  
  private void setConfigurationPath(String path) {
    try {
      SettingsProxy.getInstance().getGlobalSettings().setProperty("configurationFolder", path);
    } catch (ConfigurationNotFoundException ex) {
      LOGGER.error("Error setting last selected configuration folder in settings", ex.getCause());
    } 
  }
  
  public void setPanel(BikeConfigurationPanel panel) {
    this.pnlBikeConfiguration = panel;
    initAbsValidator();
    initButtonController();
    addConfigurationEventListeners();
    setContainerDetailsControllers(this.pnlBikeConfiguration.getUpdatePanel());
  }
  
  private void setContainerDetailsControllers(UpdatePanel updatePanel) {
    initContainerDetailsControllers(updatePanel);
  }
  
  public BikeConfigurationPanel getBikeConfigurationPanel() {
    return this.pnlBikeConfiguration;
  }
  
  boolean isConfigurationValid() {
    return (isBuiConfigurationValid() && isDuConfigurationValid());
  }
  
  private boolean isDuConfigurationValid() {
    return (!this.configurationManager.getBikeIdentification().getDuIdentification().isApplication() || (
      getManufactureDateController().isValid() && 
      getManufactureLocationController().isValid() && 
      getBikeIdController().isValid() && 
      getInfoTextController().isValid() && 
      getBatteryLockKeyController().isValid() && 
      getMinGearRatioController().isValid() && 
      getMaxGearRatioController().isValid() && 
      getWheelSizeCorrectionController().isValid() && 
      getWheelSizeController().isValid() && 
      getLightOutputController().isValid() && 
      getLightSwitchOptionController().isValid() && 
      getWalkAssistController().isValid() && 
      getHighPowerPortController().isValid() && 
      getLightPowerController().isValid()));
  }
  
  private boolean isBuiConfigurationValid() {
    boolean valid = true;
    if (this.configurationManager.getBikeIdentification().getHmiIdentification().isApplication())
      if (this.configurationManager.getBikeIdentification().getHmiIdentification().getComponentType().isBUI21x()) {
        valid = getDistanceUnitController().isValid();
      } else if (this.configurationManager.getBikeIdentification().getHmiIdentification().getComponentType().isBUI25x()) {
        valid = (getBuiLanguageController().isValid() && getDistanceUnitController().isValid());
      }  
    return valid;
  }
  
  private BasVariantItem getCmbAbsSelectedItem() {
    if (this.cffController.isCff3Loaded())
      return this.cff3SelectionPanelController.getCmbAbsSelectedItem(); 
    if (this.cffController.isCff2Loaded())
      return this.cff2SelectionPanelController.getCmbAbsSelectedItem(); 
    LOGGER.error("selected item for ABS-combobox was requested, but no container loaded.");
    return new BasVariantItem("", "");
  }
  
  public String getOrderingName() {
    return "BikeConfigurationPanel";
  }
}

package com.gigatronik.beds.gui.configtab.bike;

import com.gigatronik.beds.gui.configtab.bike.container.Cff2ContentSelectionPanelController;
import com.gigatronik.beds.gui.configtab.bike.container.Cff3ContentSelectionPanelController;
import com.gigatronik.beds.gui.configtab.bike.elements.AbstractConfigurationElementController;
import com.gigatronik.beds.gui.configtab.bike.elements.LightOutputElementController;
import com.gigatronik.beds.gui.configtab.bike.elements.LightPowerElementController;
import com.gigatronik.beds.gui.configtab.bike.elements.WheelSizeElementController;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.configuration.ConfigurationKey;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.configuration.ConfigurationManager;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.flashcontainer.api.BoschContainerController;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.bosch.service.internationalization.ResourceBundleFactory;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.bosch.service.internationalization.Utf8ResourceBundleFormatted;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.common.util.ChecksumCalculator;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.gui.testinterface.TestableJOptionPane;
import org.apache.commons.lang3.StringUtils;

class ConfigParamValidator {
  private static final Utf8ResourceBundleFormatted BUNDLE = ResourceBundleFactory.newDefaultResourceBundle();
  
  private static final String SYSTEM_LINE_SEPARATOR = System.getProperty("line.separator");
  
  private final BikeConfigurationPanelController bikeConfigPanelController;
  
  private final ConfigurationManager configurationManager;
  
  private final Cff2ContentSelectionPanelController cff2SelectionPanelController;
  
  private final Cff3ContentSelectionPanelController cff3SelectionPanelController;
  
  private final BoschContainerController cffController;
  
  ConfigParamValidator(BikeConfigurationPanelController bikeConfPanelcontroller, ConfigurationManager configManager, Cff2ContentSelectionPanelController cff2SelPanelController, Cff3ContentSelectionPanelController cff3SelPanelController) {
    this.bikeConfigPanelController = bikeConfPanelcontroller;
    this.configurationManager = configManager;
    this.cff2SelectionPanelController = cff2SelPanelController;
    this.cff3SelectionPanelController = cff3SelPanelController;
    this.cffController = this.configurationManager.getContainerConfiguration().getContainerController();
  }
  
  private void validateParameter(StringBuilder sb, AbstractConfigurationElementController elementController, ConfigurationKey key) {
    if (!elementController.isValid()) {
      appendParameterToWarnMessage(sb, elementController, key);
      elementController.clearValue();
    } 
  }
  
  private void validateDisplayLanguage(StringBuilder sb) {
    if (StringUtils.isNotEmpty(this.configurationManager.getConfigurationFileValue(ConfigurationKey.CYCLE_COMPUTER_LANGUAGE)))
      validateParameter(sb, this.bikeConfigPanelController.getBuiLanguageController(), ConfigurationKey.CYCLE_COMPUTER_LANGUAGE); 
  }
  
  private void validateParameterDistanceUnits(StringBuilder sb, AbstractConfigurationElementController elementController) {
    if (!StringUtils.equals("-1", this.configurationManager.getConfigurationFileValue(ConfigurationKey.DISPLAY_UNITS_OF_CYCLE_COMPUTER_INDEX)))
      validateParameter(sb, elementController, ConfigurationKey.DISPLAY_UNITS_OF_CYCLE_COMPUTER_INDEX); 
  }
  
  private void validateAutoDownShift(StringBuilder sb) {
    validateParameter(sb, this.bikeConfigPanelController.getAutoDownShiftController(), ConfigurationKey.AUTO_DOWNSHIFT_STARTGEAR);
  }
  
  private void validateLightOutput(StringBuilder sb) {
    LightOutputElementController controller = this.bikeConfigPanelController.getLightOutputController();
    String fileValue = this.configurationManager.getConfigurationFileValue(ConfigurationKey.LIGHT_OUTPUT);
    if (!this.configurationManager.getContainerConfiguration().getProductLine().isGen1() && !controller.isValueAllowed(fileValue)) {
      appendParameterToWarnMessage(sb, controller, ConfigurationKey.LIGHT_OUTPUT);
      controller.clearValue();
    } 
  }
  
  private void validateParameterLightPower(StringBuilder sb, LightPowerElementController elementController) {
    if (!StringUtils.equals("0.0", this.configurationManager.getConfigurationFileValue(ConfigurationKey.LIGHT_POWER)) && !elementController.isValidValue() && StringUtils.equalsAny(this.configurationManager.getConfigurationFileValue(ConfigurationKey.LIGHT_SWITCH_FUNCTION_INDEX), "1", "2")) {
      appendParameterToWarnMessage(sb, elementController, ConfigurationKey.LIGHT_POWER);
      elementController.clearValue();
    } 
  }
  
  private void validateWheelSizeChecksum(StringBuilder sb, boolean checkSumMandatory) {
    WheelSizeElementController elementController = this.bikeConfigPanelController.getWheelSizeController();
    if (elementController.isValid()) {
      String fileValue = this.configurationManager.getConfigurationFileValue(ConfigurationKey.WHEEL_CIRCUMFERENCE);
      String calculatedChecksum = ChecksumCalculator.calculateWheelSizeChecksum(fileValue);
      String checksumFromFile = this.configurationManager.getConfigurationFileValue(ConfigurationKey.WHEEL_CIRCUMFERENCE_CHECKSUM);
      if ((checkSumMandatory || !StringUtils.isBlank(checksumFromFile)) && !StringUtils.equalsIgnoreCase(calculatedChecksum, checksumFromFile)) {
        appendParameterToWarnMessage(sb, elementController, ConfigurationKey.WHEEL_CIRCUMFERENCE);
        elementController.clearValue();
      } 
    } 
  }
  
  private void validateAbsParIdChecksum(StringBuilder sb, boolean checkSumMandatory) {
    String fileValue = this.configurationManager.getConfigurationFileValue(ConfigurationKey.ABS_PARAMETER_ID);
    String checksumFromFile = this.configurationManager.getConfigurationFileValue(ConfigurationKey.ABS_PARAMETER_ID_CHECKSUM);
    if (checkSumMandatory || fileValue != null || checksumFromFile != null) {
      String calculatedChecksum = ChecksumCalculator.calculateAbsVariantIdChecksum(fileValue);
      if (fileValue == null || checksumFromFile == null || !StringUtils.equalsIgnoreCase(calculatedChecksum, checksumFromFile)) {
        appendParameterToWarnMessage(sb, null, ConfigurationKey.ABS_PARAMETER_ID);
        this.cff2SelectionPanelController.clearAbsCmb();
        this.cff3SelectionPanelController.clearAbsCmb();
      } 
    } 
  }
  
  private void appendParameterToWarnMessage(StringBuilder sb, AbstractConfigurationElementController controller, ConfigurationKey key) {
    sb.append(SYSTEM_LINE_SEPARATOR);
    sb.append(getConfigurationParameterLabel(key));
    sb.append(getConfigurationParameterValue(controller, key));
  }
  
  private String getConfigurationParameterLabel(ConfigurationKey key) {
    return StringUtils.endsWith(key.getLabel(), ":") ? (key.getLabel() + " ") : (key.getLabel() + ": ");
  }
  
  private String getConfigurationParameterValue(AbstractConfigurationElementController controller, ConfigurationKey key) {
    String text = (controller != null) ? controller.getDisplayTextForValue(this.configurationManager.getConfigurationFileValue(key)) : 
      this.configurationManager.getConfigurationFileValue(key);
    return (text == null) ? "-" : text;
  }
  
  void showInvalidParameters() {
    StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
    validateParameterDistanceUnits(sb, this.bikeConfigPanelController.getDistanceUnitController());
    validateParameter(sb, this.bikeConfigPanelController.getLightSwitchOptionController(), ConfigurationKey.LIGHT_SWITCH_FUNCTION_INDEX);
    validateParameter(sb, this.bikeConfigPanelController.getMaxGearRatioController(), ConfigurationKey.MAX_GEAR_RATIO);
    validateParameter(sb, this.bikeConfigPanelController.getManufactureLocationController(), ConfigurationKey.PLACE_OF_MANUFACTURE);
    validateParameter(sb, this.bikeConfigPanelController.getMinGearRatioController(), ConfigurationKey.MIN_GEAR_RATIO);
    validateParameter(sb, this.bikeConfigPanelController.getWalkAssistController(), ConfigurationKey.WALK_ASSIST_INDEX);
    validateLightOutput(sb);
    validateParameter(sb, this.bikeConfigPanelController.getHighPowerPortController(), ConfigurationKey.HIGH_POWER_PORT);
    validateParameterLightPower(sb, this.bikeConfigPanelController.getLightPowerController());
    validateParameter(sb, this.bikeConfigPanelController.getWheelSizeController(), ConfigurationKey.WHEEL_CIRCUMFERENCE);
    boolean checkSumMandatory = this.cffController.getBas100Interface().isBas100DataForParIdAvailable();
    validateWheelSizeChecksum(sb, checkSumMandatory);
    validateAbsParIdChecksum(sb, checkSumMandatory);
    validateParameter(sb, this.bikeConfigPanelController.getWheelSizeCorrectionController(), ConfigurationKey.WHEEL_SIZE_CORRECTION);
    validateAutoDownShift(sb);
    validateDisplayLanguage(sb);
    if (StringUtils.isNotEmpty(sb)) {
      sb.insert(0, BUNDLE.getString("ConfigurationFile.invalidParameters"));
      TestableJOptionPane.showMessageDialog(sb.toString(), BUNDLE.getString("Bosch.diagnostic.tool"), 0);
    } 
  }
}

package com.gigatronik.beds.gui.configtab.bike.container;

import com.gigatronik.beds.common.order.OrderableListener;

public abstract class AbstractContentSelectionPanelController implements RightsChangedEventListener, BikeConfigurationChangesListener, ContainerConfigurationChangesListener {
  private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(AbstractContentSelectionPanelController.class);
  
  private final Border ioBorder = UIManager.getBorder("FormattedTextField.border");
  
  private final Border nioBorder = BorderFactory.createCompoundBorder(BorderFactory.createLineBorder(GuiColors.FRAME_INVALID, 2), this.ioBorder);
  
  private final ContentSelectionPanel pnlContentSelection;
  
  private final ChecksumInputPanel pnlAbsChecksumInput;
  
  protected final BikeIdentification bikeIdentification;
  
  final ContainerConfiguration containerConfig;
  
  protected final BoschContainerController cffController;
  
  protected final RightsManager rightsManager;
  
  protected final ConfigurationManager configurationManager;
  
  protected final CommunicationManager communicationManager;
  
  private static final String ABS_DEFAULT = "000";
  
  AbstractContentSelectionPanelController(ContentSelectionPanel selectionPanel, ChecksumInputPanel absChecksumPanel, ConfigurationManager configManager, RightsManager rightManager, CommunicationManager communicationManager) {
    this.pnlContentSelection = selectionPanel;
    this.pnlAbsChecksumInput = absChecksumPanel;
    this.configurationManager = configManager;
    this.bikeIdentification = this.configurationManager.getBikeIdentification();
    this.containerConfig = this.configurationManager.getContainerConfiguration();
    this.cffController = this.containerConfig.getContainerController();
    this.rightsManager = rightManager;
    this.communicationManager = communicationManager;
    configManager.addListener((OrderableListener)this);
    this.rightsManager.addListener(this);
  }
  
  void setPnlVisible(boolean visible) {
    this.pnlContentSelection.setVisible(visible);
  }
  
  public BasVariantItem getCmbAbsSelectedItem() {
    return (BasVariantItem)this.pnlContentSelection.getCmbAbs().getSelectedItem();
  }
  
  public void clearAbsCmb() {
    this.pnlContentSelection.getCmbAbs().setSelectedItem(null);
    handleAbsSelectionChanged();
  }
  
  void onCmbAbsSelectedItemChanged(ItemEvent evt) {
    if (evt.getStateChange() == 1)
      handleAbsSelectionChanged(); 
  }
  
  private void handleAbsSelectionChanged() {
    BasVariantItem item = getCmbAbsSelectedItem();
    String absParId = (item == null || StringUtils.equals(item.getId(), "-")) ? null : item.getId();
    this.configurationManager.setAbsParId(absParId);
    validateChecksumInputPanel();
    clearChecksumInputEntriesAndUncheck();
  }
  
  void cmbBasVariantEnableRequest(boolean enable) {
    TestableJComboBox<BasVariantItem> testableJComboBox = this.pnlContentSelection.getCmbAbs();
    if (testableJComboBox != null) {
      boolean cmbNotEmpty = ((testableJComboBox.getItemCount() != 1 || !StringUtils.equals(testableJComboBox.getItemAt(0).getName(), "-")) && testableJComboBox.getItemCount() != 0);
      testableJComboBox.setEnabled((enable && cmbNotEmpty && this.rightsManager.isModeActive(Mode.OEM_ADMIN)));
      setAbsTextFieldVisible(cmbNotEmpty);
    } 
  }
  
  void setAbsVarWithId(String absIdDu) {
    String id = StringUtils.isBlank(absIdDu) ? "-" : absIdDu;
    int index = indexOfAbsId(id);
    if (index >= 0) {
      this.pnlContentSelection.getCmbAbs().setSelectedIndex(index);
      return;
    } 
    this.configurationManager.setAbsParId("000");
  }
  
  private int indexOfAbsId(String absId) {
    TestableJComboBox<BasVariantItem> testableJComboBox = this.pnlContentSelection.getCmbAbs();
    for (int i = 0; i < testableJComboBox.getItemCount(); i++) {
      BasVariantItem item = testableJComboBox.getItemAt(i);
      if (StringUtils.equals(item.getId(), absId))
        return i; 
    } 
    return -1;
  }
  
  void updateEbikeAbsComboBox() {
    Set<BasVariantItem> absIds = new LinkedHashSet<>();
    if (this.cffController.getBas100Interface().isBas100DataForParIdAvailable()) {
      this.cffController.getBas100Interface().getAllBasParameterReplies().forEach(replyType -> absIds.add(new BasVariantItem(replyType.getParId(), this.cffController.getBas100Interface().getI18nNameForId(replyType.getParId()))));
    } else {
      absIds.add(new BasVariantItem("-", "-"));
    } 
    LOGGER.debug("Read in abs parameter ids from container: '{}'", absIds);
    this.pnlContentSelection.getCmbAbs().setModel(new DefaultComboBoxModel<>(absIds.<BasVariantItem>toArray(new BasVariantItem[absIds.size()])));
    cmbBasVariantEnableRequest((absIds.size() > 1));
    String selectedId = this.configurationManager.getContainerConfiguration().getAbsParId();
    LOGGER.debug("Preselected abs parameter id is: '{}'", selectedId);
    setAbsVarWithId(selectedId);
    validateChecksumInputPanel();
  }
  
  public void validateChecksumInputPanel() {
    validateChecksumInputPanelVisibility();
    validateChecksumInputPanelEnability();
  }
  
  void clearChecksumInputEntriesAndUncheck() {
    this.pnlAbsChecksumInput.resetPanelValuesToDefault();
  }
  
  void validateAbs(AbstractConfigurationEvent event) {
    Attribute.Value absValid = event.getAttribute(Attribute.Key.ABS_VALID);
    if (absValid != null)
      setAbsBorder((absValid == Attribute.Value.OK)); 
  }
  
  private void setAbsBorder(boolean valid) {
    setComboBoxValid(this.pnlContentSelection.getCmbAbs(), valid);
  }
  
  void setComboBoxValid(TestableJComboBox cmb, boolean valid) {
    if (cmb != null) {
      cmb.setValidWsdl(valid);
      cmb.setBorder(valid ? this.ioBorder : this.nioBorder);
      cmb.setForeground(valid ? GuiColors.TEXT_VALID : GuiColors.TEXT_INVALID);
    } 
  }
  
  private void validateChecksumInputPanelVisibility() {
    BoschContainerBas100VariantInfo bas100CffInterface = this.configurationManager.getContainerConfiguration().getContainerController().getBas100Interface();
    if (bas100CffInterface.isBas100DataForParIdAvailable() && this.rightsManager.isUserInLevel(UserLevel.OEM) && this.rightsManager.isModeActive(Mode.OEM_ADMIN)) {
      if (this.pnlContentSelection.getCmbAbs().getSelectedItem() == null || !NumberUtils.isParsable(((BasVariantItem)this.pnlContentSelection.getCmbAbs().getSelectedItem()).getId())) {
        this.pnlAbsChecksumInput.setVisible(false);
        return;
      } 
      int selectedParIdInt = Integer.parseInt(((BasVariantItem)this.pnlContentSelection.getCmbAbs().getSelectedItem()).getId());
      this.pnlAbsChecksumInput.setVisible((selectedParIdInt > 0));
    } else {
      this.pnlAbsChecksumInput.setVisible(false);
      clearChecksumInputEntriesAndUncheck();
    } 
  }
  
  private void validateChecksumInputPanelEnability() {
    boolean enabled;
    boolean buiConnected = this.configurationManager.getBikeIdentification().isHmiConnected();
    boolean duConnected = this.configurationManager.getBikeIdentification().getDuIdentification().isApplication();
    if (buiConnected) {
      enabled = (duConnected && this.configurationManager.isContainerCompatibleWithBike() && (this.configurationManager.isContainerConfiguredToBike() || !this.configurationManager.isContainerLoaded()));
    } else {
      enabled = this.configurationManager.isContainerConfiguredToBike();
    } 
    this.pnlAbsChecksumInput.getChbComponentSwitched().setEnabled(enabled);
  }
  
  abstract void setAbsTextFieldVisible(boolean paramBoolean);
}

package com.gigatronik.beds.gui.configtab.bike.container;

import com.gigatronik.beds.common.order.OrderableListener;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.configuration.ConfigurationManager;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.configuration.api.ContainerConfigurationChangesListener;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.configuration.impl.ContainerConfiguration;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.flashcontainer.api.BoschContainerCommon;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.flashcontainer.api.BoschContainerController;
import com.gigatronik.beds.settings.SettingsProxy;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.bosch.service.internationalization.ResourceBundleFactory;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.bosch.service.internationalization.Utf8ResourceBundleFormatted;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.framework.plugins.exceptions.ConfigurationNotFoundException;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.common.configuration.ComponentType;
import java.util.Map;
import javax.swing.table.DefaultTableModel;
import org.apache.commons.lang3.StringUtils;
import org.slf4j.Logger;
import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;

public abstract class AbstractDetailsPanelController implements ContainerConfigurationChangesListener {
  protected static final Utf8ResourceBundleFormatted BUNDLE = ResourceBundleFactory.newDefaultResourceBundle();
  
  protected static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(AbstractDetailsPanelController.class);
  
  protected static final String PRODUCTNAME_NYON_1GB_FRONTEND = BUNDLE.getString("ProductName.nyon1gbFrontend");
  
  protected static final String PRODUCTNAME_NYON_1GB_BACKEND = BUNDLE.getString("ProductName.nyon1gbBackend");
  
  protected static final String PRODUCTNAME_NYON_8GB_FRONTEND = BUNDLE.getString("ProductName.nyon8gbFrontend");
  
  protected static final String PRODUCTNAME_NYON_8GB_BACKEND = BUNDLE.getString("ProductName.nyon8gbBackend");
  
  private static final int ECU_COMPONENT_TYPE_NAME_LENGTH = 11;
  
  protected final DetailsPanel pnlDetails;
  
  protected final ContainerConfiguration containerConfig;
  
  protected final BoschContainerController cffController;
  
  protected final BoschContainerCommon cffInterface;
  
  protected final ConfigurationManager configurationManager;
  
  public AbstractDetailsPanelController(DetailsPanel detailsPanel, ConfigurationManager configManager) {
    this.pnlDetails = detailsPanel;
    this.configurationManager = configManager;
    this.containerConfig = this.configurationManager.getContainerConfiguration();
    this.cffController = this.containerConfig.getContainerController();
    this.cffInterface = this.cffController.getBoschContainerCommonInterface();
    configManager.addListener((OrderableListener)this);
  }
  
  protected void resetHmiTable() {
    this.pnlDetails.getTblHmiVersions().setModel(new DefaultTableModel(new String[][] { new String[] { "-", "-" },  }, new String[2]));
    this.pnlDetails.getTblHmiVersions().getColumnModel().getColumn(0).setPreferredWidth(80);
    this.pnlDetails.getTblHmiVersions().getColumnModel().getColumn(1).setPreferredWidth(20);
    this.pnlDetails.getTblHmiVersions().getColumnModel().getColumn(0).setResizable(false);
    this.pnlDetails.getTblHmiVersions().getColumnModel().getColumn(1).setResizable(false);
  }
  
  protected void fillBuiVersionTable() {
    Map<String, String> allBuiVersions = this.cffInterface.getAllBuiVersions(this.configurationManager.getContainerConfiguration().getConfiguredParId());
    if (allBuiVersions.isEmpty()) {
      resetHmiTable();
      return;
    } 
    DefaultTableModel model = new DefaultTableModel(0, 2);
    allBuiVersions.entrySet().stream().filter(entry -> (((String)entry.getKey()).startsWith("COMP_BUI21") || ((String)entry.getKey()).startsWith("COMP_BUI25"))).forEachOrdered(entry -> 
        model.insertRow(0, new Object[] { getBuiDisplayNameContainerDetails((String)entry.getKey()), entry.getValue() }));
    allBuiVersions.entrySet().stream().filter(entry -> ((String)entry.getKey()).startsWith("COMP_BUI27")).forEachOrdered(entry -> 
        model.addRow(new Object[] { getBuiDisplayNameContainerDetails((String)entry.getKey()), entry.getValue() }));
    allBuiVersions.entrySet().stream().filter(entry -> ((String)entry.getKey()).startsWith("COMP_BUI33")).forEachOrdered(entry -> 
        model.addRow(new Object[] { getBuiDisplayNameContainerDetails((String)entry.getKey()), entry.getValue() }));
    allBuiVersions.entrySet().stream().filter(entry -> ((String)entry.getKey()).startsWith("COMP_BUI35")).forEachOrdered(entry -> 
        model.addRow(new Object[] { getBuiDisplayNameContainerDetails((String)entry.getKey()), entry.getValue() }));
    if (isCobiFlashActivatedInSettings())
      allBuiVersions.entrySet().stream().filter(entry -> ((String)entry.getKey()).startsWith("COMP_CUI1")).forEachOrdered(entry -> 
          model.addRow(new Object[] { getBuiDisplayNameContainerDetails((String)entry.getKey()), entry.getValue() })); 
    this.pnlDetails.getTblHmiVersions().setModel(model);
    this.pnlDetails.getTblHmiVersions().getColumnModel().getColumn(0).setPreferredWidth(80);
    this.pnlDetails.getTblHmiVersions().getColumnModel().getColumn(1).setPreferredWidth(20);
    this.pnlDetails.getTblHmiVersions().getColumnModel().getColumn(0).setResizable(false);
    this.pnlDetails.getTblHmiVersions().getColumnModel().getColumn(1).setResizable(false);
  }
  
  protected String getBuiDisplayNameContainerDetails(String componentName) {
    String name = "";
    if (StringUtils.isNotEmpty(componentName) && componentName.length() >= 11) {
      ComponentType compType = ComponentType.parse(componentName.substring(0, 11));
      switch (compType) {
        case COMP_BUI270:
          name = componentName.contains("FRONTEND") ? PRODUCTNAME_NYON_1GB_FRONTEND : PRODUCTNAME_NYON_1GB_BACKEND;
          break;
        case COMP_BUI275:
          name = componentName.contains("FRONTEND") ? PRODUCTNAME_NYON_8GB_FRONTEND : PRODUCTNAME_NYON_8GB_BACKEND;
          break;
        case COMP_BUI350:
          name = "Nyon (BUI350)";
          break;
        default:
          name = compType.getProductName();
          break;
      } 
    } 
    return name;
  }
  
  protected boolean isCobiFlashActivatedInSettings() {
    try {
      return SettingsProxy.getInstance().getGlobalSettings().getBoolean("cobi_flash_active");
    } catch (ConfigurationNotFoundException ex) {
      LOGGER.warn("Flag for Cobi flash activation not found in settings ", ex.getMessage());
      return false;
    } 
  }
  
  protected void updateTxtAbsSwVersion() {
    this.pnlDetails.getTxtAbsSwVersion().setText(this.cffInterface.getSwVersion(ComponentType.COMP_BBA100));
  }
  
  protected abstract void fillContainerDetails();
}

package com.gigatronik.beds.gui.configtab.bike.container;

import com.gigatronik.beds.gui.panels.configtabs.components.checksum.ChecksumInputPanel;

import com.gigatronik.beds.service.configuration.event.ContainerConfigurationChangedEvent;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.flashcontainer.impl.ContainerBikeDataSet;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.rightsmanager.api.Mode;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.rightsmanager.api.RightsChangedEvent;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.rightsmanager.api.RightsManager;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.rightsmanager.api.UserLevel;
import java.awt.EventQueue;
import java.awt.event.ItemEvent;
import java.beans.PropertyChangeEvent;
import org.slf4j.Logger;
import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;

public class Cff2ContentSelectionPanelController extends AbstractContentSelectionPanelController {
  private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(Cff2ContentSelectionPanelController.class);
  
  private final Cff2ContentSelectionPanel pnlCff2Selection;
  
  private final Cff2DetailsPanelController cff2DetailsPanelController;
  
  public Cff2ContentSelectionPanelController(Cff2ContentSelectionPanel selectionPanel, Cff2DetailsPanelController detailsPanelController, ChecksumInputPanel absChecksumPanel, ConfigurationManager configManager, RightsManager rightsManager, CommunicationManager communicationManager) {
    super(selectionPanel, absChecksumPanel, configManager, rightsManager, communicationManager);
    this.pnlCff2Selection = selectionPanel;
    this.cff2DetailsPanelController = detailsPanelController;
    addListenersToPanel();
  }
  
  private void addListenersToPanel() {
    this.pnlCff2Selection.getBtnShowDetails().addPropertyChangeListener("enabled", this::btnShowDetailsPropertyChange);
    this.pnlCff2Selection.getBtnShowDetails().addItemListener(this::btnShowDetailsItemStateChanged);
    this.pnlCff2Selection.getCmbAbs().addItemListener(this::onCmbAbsSelectedItemChanged);
  }
  
  private void btnShowDetailsPropertyChange(PropertyChangeEvent evt) {
    if (Boolean.FALSE.equals(evt.getNewValue())) {
      this.cff2DetailsPanelController.setPnlVisible(false);
      this.pnlCff2Selection.getBtnShowDetails().setSelected(false);
    } 
  }
  
  private void btnShowDetailsItemStateChanged(ItemEvent evt) {
    this.cff2DetailsPanelController.setPnlVisible((evt.getStateChange() == 1));
  }
  
  public void initEbikeAbsComboBoxCff2() {
    if (!this.cffController.isCff3Loaded()) {
      this.pnlCff2Selection.getLblAbs().setVisible(this.rightsManager.isUserInLevel(UserLevel.OEM));
      this.pnlCff2Selection.getCmbAbs().setVisible(this.rightsManager.isUserInLevel(UserLevel.OEM));
      updateEbikeAbsComboBox();
      validateChecksumInputPanel();
    } 
  }
  
  private void onContainerLoaded() {
    if (this.cffController.isCff2Loaded()) {
      this.pnlCff2Selection.setVisible(true);
      this.pnlCff2Selection.getBtnShowDetails().setEnabled(true);
      this.pnlCff2Selection.getBtnShowDetails().setSelected(false);
    } else {
      this.pnlCff2Selection.setVisible(false);
      this.pnlCff2Selection.getBtnShowDetails().setEnabled(false);
    } 
  }
  
  private void onContainerUnloaded() {
    this.pnlCff2Selection.getBtnShowDetails().setEnabled(false);
    this.cffController.getBas100Interface().clearPreviousBasVariantInfo();
    updateEbikeAbsComboBox();
    setPnlVisible(false);
  }
  
  private void onReadConfigurationFromFile(BikeConfigurationChangedEvent event) {
    if (event.getAttribute(Attribute.Key.OPERATION_RESULT) == Attribute.Value.OK) {
      clearChecksumInputEntriesAndUncheck();
      String absId = this.configurationManager.getConfigurationValue(ConfigurationKey.ABS_PARAMETER_ID);
      setAbsVarWithId(absId);
    } 
  }
  
  private void onReadConfigurationFromBike() {
    if (this.configurationManager.getBikeIdentification().isDuConnected()) {
      ContainerBikeDataSet parameterSet = this.configurationManager.getContainerConfiguration().getParameterSet(this.configurationManager.getBikeIdentification().getApplicationId());
      if (parameterSet != null)
        updateEbikeAbsComboBox(); 
    } 
  }
  
  void setAbsTextFieldVisible(boolean visible) {
    this.cff2DetailsPanelController.setAbsTextFieldVisible(visible);
  }
  
  public void onBikeConfigurationChanged(BikeConfigurationChangedEvent event) {
    LOGGER.debug("BikeConfigurationChangedEvent received: '{}'", event);
    if (this.cffController.isCff2Loaded()) {
      LOGGER.debug("Process BikeConfigurationChangedEvent: '{}'", event);
      EventQueue.invokeLater(() -> {
            switch (event.getAction()) {
              case READ_FROM_BIKE:
                onReadConfigurationFromBike();
                break;
              case READ_FROM_FILE:
                onReadConfigurationFromFile(event);
                break;
            } 
          });
    } 
  }
  
  public void onContainerConfigurationChanged(ContainerConfigurationChangedEvent event) {
    LOGGER.debug("ContainerConfigurationChangedEvent received: '{}'", event);
    EventQueue.invokeLater(() -> {
          switch (event.getAction()) {
            case LOADED:
              onContainerLoaded();
              break;
            case UNLOADED:
              onContainerUnloaded();
              break;
          } 
          validateAbs((AbstractConfigurationEvent)event);
        });
  }
  
  public void onRightsChanged(RightsChangedEvent event) {
    LOGGER.debug("Received rights changed event '{}'", event);
    if (!this.cffController.isCff3Loaded())
      EventQueue.invokeLater(() -> {
            LOGGER.debug("Process rights change event now from EDT");
            if (event.getUserLevel() == UserLevel.OEM) {
              Mode mode = event.getMode();
              switch (mode) {
                case OEM_ADMIN:
                  cmbBasVariantEnableRequest(true);
                  break;
                case OEM_WORKER:
                  cmbBasVariantEnableRequest(false);
                  break;
              } 
            } 
          }); 
  }
}
