package com.gigatronik.beds.gui.configtab.bike.container;

import com.gigatronik.beds.service.configuration.Attribute;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.configuration.ConfigurationManager;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.configuration.api.HardwareConnectionChangesListener;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.configuration.event.ContainerConfigurationChangedEvent;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.configuration.event.HardwareConnectionChangedEvent;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.rightsmanager.api.RightsManager;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.rightsmanager.api.UserLevel;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.framework.util.Version;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.common.configuration.BikeIdentification;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.common.configuration.ComponentType;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.common.configuration.Constants;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.common.util.BoschConstants;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.common.util.BoschHelper;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.gui.testinterface.TestableJOptionPane;
import java.awt.EventQueue;
import java.awt.event.ActionEvent;
import java.io.IOException;
import org.apache.commons.lang3.StringUtils;
import org.slf4j.Logger;
import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;

public class Cff2DetailsPanelController extends AbstractDetailsPanelController implements HardwareConnectionChangesListener {
  private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(Cff2DetailsPanelController.class);
  
  private static final Version MIN_VERSION_BUI270_RESET = new Version(new Integer[] { 1, 5, 0, 0 });
  
  private static final Version MIN_VERSION_BUI275_RESET = new Version(new Integer[] { 2, 5, 0, 0 });
  
  private final Cff2DetailsPanel pnlCff2Details;
  
  private final RightsManager rightsManager;
  
  private final BikeIdentification bikeIdentification;
  
  public Cff2DetailsPanelController(Cff2DetailsPanel detailsPanel, ConfigurationManager configManager, RightsManager rightManager) {
    super(detailsPanel, configManager);
    this.pnlCff2Details = detailsPanel;
    addListenersToPanel();
    this.bikeIdentification = this.configurationManager.getBikeIdentification();
    this.rightsManager = rightManager;
  }
  
  void setPnlVisible(boolean visible) {
    this.pnlCff2Details.setVisible(visible);
  }
  
  void setAbsTextFieldVisible(boolean visible) {
    this.pnlCff2Details.getLblAbsSwVersion().setVisible(visible);
    this.pnlCff2Details.getTxtAbsSwVersion().setVisible(visible);
  }
  
  private void addListenersToPanel() {
    this.pnlCff2Details.getChbBuiReset().addActionListener(evt -> 
        chbBuiResetActionPerformed());
  }
  
  private void chbBuiResetActionPerformed() {
    if (this.pnlCff2Details.getChbBuiReset().isSelected()) {
      this.containerConfig.setBuiResetEnabled(true);
    } else {
      this.containerConfig.setBuiResetEnabled(false);
    } 
  }
  
  private void updateDetails() {
    this.pnlCff2Details.getTxtManufacturer().setText("-");
    this.pnlCff2Details.getTxtYear().setText("-");
    this.pnlCff2Details.getTxtBikeType().setText("-");
    this.pnlCff2Details.getTxtProductLine().setText("-");
    this.pnlCff2Details.getTxtBatterySwVersion().setText("-");
    this.pnlCff2Details.getTxtDuSwVersion().setText("-");
    this.pnlCff2Details.getTxtAbsSwVersion().setText("-");
    this.pnlCff2Details.getTxtApplParaVersion().setText("-");
    this.pnlCff2Details.getTxtToolVersion().setText("-");
    resetHmiTable();
    this.cffController.getBas100Interface().clearPreviousBasVariantInfo();
  }
  
  private void onContainerLoaded(ContainerConfigurationChangedEvent event) {
    if (event.getAttribute(Attribute.Key.OPERATION_RESULT) == Attribute.Value.OK)
      showContainerInfo(); 
  }
  
  private synchronized void showContainerInfo() {
    if (this.cffController.isCff2Loaded()) {
      fillBuiVersionTable();
      fillContainerDetails();
      validateBuiReset();
      updateTxtAbsSwVersion();
    } 
  }
  
  protected void fillContainerDetails() {
    this.pnlCff2Details.getTxtManufacturer().setText(this.containerConfig.getConfiguredParameterSet().getManufacturer());
    this.pnlCff2Details.getTxtYear().setText(this.configurationManager.getContainerConfiguration().getConfiguredParameterSet().getModelYear());
    this.pnlCff2Details.getTxtBikeType().setText(BoschHelper.customizeBikeType(this.containerConfig.getConfiguredParameterSet().getBikeType().getXmlAttribute()));
    this.pnlCff2Details.getTxtProductLine().setText(this.containerConfig.getConfiguredParameterSet().getProductLine().getDisplayNameWithGenCompType());
    this.pnlCff2Details.getTxtBatterySwVersion().setText(this.cffInterface.getBatSwVersionNotConnected());
    this.pnlCff2Details.getTxtDuSwVersion().setText(this.cffController.getBoschContainerCommonInterface().getSwVersionConnectedDu(ComponentType.NONE, Constants.SystemType.NONE, this.configurationManager.getContainerConfiguration().getConfiguredParId()));
    this.pnlCff2Details.getTxtApplParaVersion().setText(this.cffInterface.getParameterVersion(this.configurationManager.getContainerConfiguration().getConfiguredParId()));
    this.pnlCff2Details.getTxtToolVersion().setText(this.cffInterface.getRequiredVciVersion());
  }
  
  private void validateBuiReset() {
    if (this.pnlCff2Details.getChbBuiReset() != null) {
      boolean enabled = false;
      boolean visible = false;
      if (this.rightsManager.isUserInLevel(UserLevel.IBD)) {
        boolean bui270CffSupport = false;
        boolean bui275CffSupport = false;
        boolean bui330CffSupport = false;
        try {
          String bui270CffVersion = this.cffInterface.getSwVersion(BoschConstants.SwType.SW_TYPE_CFF2_APP_BACKEND, ComponentType.COMP_BUI270);
          String bui275CffVersion = this.cffInterface.getSwVersion(BoschConstants.SwType.SW_TYPE_CFF2_APP_BACKEND, ComponentType.COMP_BUI275);
          String bui330CffVersion = this.cffInterface.getSwVersion(ComponentType.COMP_BUI330);
          bui270CffSupport = (StringUtils.isNotBlank(bui270CffVersion) && Version.parse(bui270CffVersion).compareTo(MIN_VERSION_BUI270_RESET) > 0);
          bui275CffSupport = (StringUtils.isNotBlank(bui275CffVersion) && Version.parse(bui275CffVersion).compareTo(MIN_VERSION_BUI275_RESET) > 0);
          bui330CffSupport = StringUtils.isNotBlank(bui330CffVersion);
          visible = (bui270CffSupport || bui275CffSupport || bui330CffSupport);
        } catch (IOException|NumberFormatException ex) {
          LOGGER.error("Error parsing BUI software version from container", (Throwable)ex);
        } 
        enabled = validateEnabledStateBuiReset(bui270CffSupport, bui275CffSupport, bui330CffSupport);
      } 
      this.pnlCff2Details.getChbBuiReset().setVisible(visible);
      this.pnlCff2Details.getLblBuiReset().setVisible(visible);
      this.pnlCff2Details.getChbBuiReset().setEnabled(enabled);
      this.pnlCff2Details.getChbBuiReset().setSelected((this.pnlCff2Details.getChbBuiReset().isSelected() && enabled));
    } 
  }
  
  private boolean validateEnabledStateBuiReset(boolean bui270CffSupport, boolean bui275CffSupport, boolean bui330CffSupport) {
    boolean enabled = false;
    switch (this.bikeIdentification.getHmiIdentification().getComponentType()) {
      case COMP_BUI270:
        enabled = (bui270CffSupport && !this.bikeIdentification.getBms1Identification().isConnected() && !this.bikeIdentification.getBms2Identification().isConnected());
        break;
      case COMP_BUI275:
        enabled = (bui275CffSupport && !this.bikeIdentification.getBms1Identification().isConnected() && !this.bikeIdentification.getBms2Identification().isConnected());
        break;
      case COMP_BUI330:
        enabled = (bui330CffSupport && !this.bikeIdentification.getBms1Identification().isConnected() && !this.bikeIdentification.getBms2Identification().isConnected());
        break;
    } 
    return enabled;
  }
  
  public boolean confirmBuiReset() {
    String title, message;
    if (this.bikeIdentification.getHmiIdentification().getComponentType().isBUI33x()) {
      title = BUNDLE.getString("EBikeConfigurationTab.KioxReset.title");
      message = BUNDLE.getString("EBikeConfigurationTab.KioxReset.message");
    } else {
      title = BUNDLE.getString("EBikeConfigurationTab.BuiReset.text");
      message = BUNDLE.getString("EBikeConfigurationTab.NyonReset.message");
    } 
    int response = TestableJOptionPane.showConfirmDialog(message, title, 2, 2);
    if (response == 2)
      this.pnlCff2Details.getChbBuiReset().setSelected(false); 
    return (response == 0);
  }
  
  public Cff2VariantsPanel getVariantsPanel() {
    return this.pnlCff2Details.getVariantsPanel();
  }
  
  private void updateBuiReset(ContainerConfigurationChangedEvent event) {
    if (event.getTrigger() == ContainerConfigurationChangedEvent.Trigger.BUI_RESET)
      this.pnlCff2Details.getChbBuiReset().setSelected(this.containerConfig.isBuiResetEnabled()); 
  }
  
  public void onHardwareConnectionChanged(HardwareConnectionChangedEvent event) {
    LOGGER.debug("HardwareConnectionChangedEvent received: '{}'", event);
    EventQueue.invokeLater(() -> {
          LOGGER.debug("Process HardwareConnectionChangedEvent: '{}'", event);
          switch (event.getAction()) {
            case ECU_CONNECTED:
            case ECU_DISCONNECTED:
              validateBuiReset();
              break;
          } 
        });
  }
  
  public void onContainerConfigurationChanged(ContainerConfigurationChangedEvent event) {
    LOGGER.debug("ContainerConfigurationChangedEvent received: '{}'", event);
    EventQueue.invokeLater(() -> {
          LOGGER.debug("Process ContainerConfigurationChangedEvent: '{}'", event);
          switch (event.getAction()) {
            case CHANGED:
              updateBuiReset(event);
              break;
            case LOADED:
              onContainerLoaded(event);
              break;
            case UNLOADED:
              updateDetails();
              break;
          } 
        });
  }
}

package com.gigatronik.beds.gui.configtab.bike.container;

import com.gigatronik.beds.service.configuration.Attribute;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.configuration.api.ContainerConfigurationChangesListener;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.configuration.event.ContainerConfigurationChangedEvent;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.flashcontainer.api.BoschContainerController;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.flashcontainer.utils.BikeModelTranslationHelper;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.bosch.service.internationalization.ResourceBundleFactory;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.bosch.service.internationalization.Utf8ResourceBundleFormatted;
import java.awt.EventQueue;
import java.awt.GridBagConstraints;
import java.awt.Insets;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import javax.swing.JLabel;
import javax.swing.JTextField;
import org.slf4j.Logger;
import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;

public class Cff2VariantsPanelController implements ContainerConfigurationChangesListener {
  private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(Cff2DetailsPanelController.class);
  
  private static final Utf8ResourceBundleFormatted BUNDLE = ResourceBundleFactory.newDefaultResourceBundle();
  
  private static final int NUMBER_COLUMS = 10;
  
  private final Cff2VariantsPanel pnlCff2Variants;
  
  private final BoschContainerController cffController;
  
  public Cff2VariantsPanelController(Cff2VariantsPanel variantsPanel, BoschContainerController cffController) {
    this.pnlCff2Variants = variantsPanel;
    this.cffController = cffController;
  }
  
  private void onContainerLoaded(ContainerConfigurationChangedEvent event) {
    this.pnlCff2Variants.removeAll();
    if (event.getAttribute(Attribute.Key.OPERATION_RESULT) == Attribute.Value.OK && this.cffController.isCff2Loaded()) {
      ArrayList<String> allParIds = this.cffController.getCff2Interface().getAllApplicationParIds();
      String labelText = BUNDLE.getString("EBikeConfigurationTab.lblModel.text");
      boolean moreThanOneParId = (allParIds.size() > 1);
      int parIdCounter = 1;
      char parIdLabelAppendix = 'A';
      for (String parId : allParIds) {
        String parIdDescription = this.cffController.getCff2Interface().getDescriptionforParId(parId);
        String text = moreThanOneParId ? String.format("%s %c", labelText, parIdLabelAppendix) : labelText;
        JLabel lblModel = new JLabel(text);
        lblModel.setName(String.format("lblModel%d", parIdCounter));
        JTextField txtModel = new JTextField();
        txtModel.setName(String.format("txtModel%d", parIdCounter));
        txtModel.setEditable(false);
        txtModel.setColumns(10);
        txtModel.setText(BikeModelTranslationHelper.createTranslatedBikeModel(this.cffController.getCff2Interface().getEbikeModelCff2(parId)));
        txtModel.setToolTipText(parIdDescription);
        JLabel lblReferenceId = new JLabel(BUNDLE.getString("EBikeServiceTab.DU_DiagnosticTable.Data.APPLICATION_ID"));
        lblReferenceId.setName(String.format("lblReferenceId%d", parIdCounter));
        JTextField txtReferenceId = new JTextField();
        txtReferenceId.setName(String.format("txtReferenceId%d", parIdCounter));
        txtReferenceId.setEditable(false);
        txtReferenceId.setColumns(10);
        txtReferenceId.setText(parId);
        txtReferenceId.setToolTipText(parIdDescription);
        addToVariantsPanel(lblModel, txtModel);
        addToVariantsPanel(lblReferenceId, txtReferenceId);
        parIdCounter++;
        parIdLabelAppendix = (char)(parIdLabelAppendix + 1);
      } 
    } 
  }
  
  private void addToVariantsPanel(JLabel label, JTextField textField) {
    GridBagConstraints gridBagConstraints = new GridBagConstraints();
    gridBagConstraints.gridx = 0;
    gridBagConstraints.anchor = 13;
    gridBagConstraints.insets = new Insets(5, 0, 0, 0);
    this.pnlCff2Variants.add(label, gridBagConstraints);
    gridBagConstraints = new GridBagConstraints();
    gridBagConstraints.gridx = 1;
    gridBagConstraints.fill = 2;
    gridBagConstraints.weightx = 1.0D;
    gridBagConstraints.insets = new Insets(5, 5, 0, 0);
    this.pnlCff2Variants.add(textField, gridBagConstraints);
  }
  
  public void onContainerConfigurationChanged(ContainerConfigurationChangedEvent event) {
    LOGGER.debug("ContainerConfigurationChangedEvent received: '{}'", event);
    EventQueue.invokeLater(() -> {
          LOGGER.debug("Process ContainerConfigurationChangedEvent: '{}'", event);
          switch (event.getAction()) {
            case LOADED:
              onContainerLoaded(event);
              break;
            case UNLOADED:
              this.pnlCff2Variants.removeAll();
              break;
          } 
        });
  }
}

package com.gigatronik.beds.gui.configtab.bike.container;

import com.gigatronik.beds.gui.panels.configtabs.components.checksum.ChecksumInputPanel;
import com.gigatronik.beds.gui.utilities.BikeModelCellRenderer;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.communication.api.CommunicationManager;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.configuration.Attribute;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.configuration.ConfigurationManager;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.configuration.api.HardwareConnectionChangesListener;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.configuration.event.AbstractConfigurationEvent;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.configuration.event.BikeConfigurationChangedEvent;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.configuration.event.ContainerConfigurationChangedEvent;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.configuration.event.HardwareConnectionChangedEvent;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.flashcontainer.api.BoschContainerController;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.flashcontainer.impl.ContainerBikeDataSet;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.rightsmanager.api.Mode;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.rightsmanager.api.RightsChangedEvent;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.rightsmanager.api.RightsManager;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.rightsmanager.api.UserLevel;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.common.configuration.BikeType;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.common.configuration.ProductLine;
import java.awt.EventQueue;
import java.awt.event.ItemEvent;
import java.awt.event.ItemListener;
import java.beans.PropertyChangeEvent;
import java.util.LinkedHashSet;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Set;
import javax.swing.DefaultComboBoxModel;
import javax.swing.JComboBox;
import org.slf4j.Logger;
import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;

public class Cff3ContentSelectionPanelController extends AbstractContentSelectionPanelController implements HardwareConnectionChangesListener {
  private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(Cff3ContentSelectionPanelController.class);
  
  private final Cff3ContentSelectionPanel pnlCff3Selection;
  
  private final Cff3DetailsPanelController cff3DetailsPanelController;
  
  private final ItemListener productLineChangeListener;
  
  private final ItemListener bikeTypeChangeListener;
  
  private final ItemListener bikeModelChangeListener;
  
  public Cff3ContentSelectionPanelController(Cff3ContentSelectionPanel selectionPanel, Cff3DetailsPanelController detailsPanelController, ChecksumInputPanel absChecksumPanel, ConfigurationManager configManager, RightsManager rightManager, CommunicationManager comManager) {
    super(selectionPanel, absChecksumPanel, configManager, rightManager, comManager);
    this.productLineChangeListener = (e -> {
        if (e.getStateChange() == 1)
          this.configurationManager.setProductLine(getSelectedProductLine()); 
      });
    this.bikeTypeChangeListener = (e -> {
        if (e.getStateChange() == 1)
          this.configurationManager.setBikeType(getSelectedBikeType()); 
      });
    this.bikeModelChangeListener = (e -> {
        if (e.getStateChange() == 1)
          this.configurationManager.setBikeModel(getSelectedBikeModel()); 
      });
    this.pnlCff3Selection = selectionPanel;
    addListenersToPanel();
    this.cff3DetailsPanelController = detailsPanelController;
  }
  
  private void addListenersToPanel() {
    this.pnlCff3Selection.getBtnShowDetails().addPropertyChangeListener("enabled", this::btnShowDetailsPropertyChange);
    this.pnlCff3Selection.getBtnShowDetails().addItemListener(this::btnShowDetailsItemStateChanged);
    addComboBoxListeners();
  }
  
  private void addComboBoxListeners() {
    this.pnlCff3Selection.getCmbAbs().addItemListener(this::onCmbAbsSelectedItemChanged);
    this.pnlCff3Selection.getCmbProductLine().addItemListener(this.productLineChangeListener);
    this.pnlCff3Selection.getCmbBikeType().addItemListener(this.bikeTypeChangeListener);
    this.pnlCff3Selection.getCmbModel().addItemListener(this.bikeModelChangeListener);
  }
  
  private void removeComboBoxListeners() {
    this.pnlCff3Selection.getCmbAbs().removeItemListener(this::onCmbAbsSelectedItemChanged);
    this.pnlCff3Selection.getCmbProductLine().removeItemListener(this.productLineChangeListener);
    this.pnlCff3Selection.getCmbBikeType().removeItemListener(this.bikeTypeChangeListener);
    this.pnlCff3Selection.getCmbModel().removeItemListener(this.bikeModelChangeListener);
  }
  
  private void selectProductLine(ProductLine productLine) {
    if (setComboBoxItem((JComboBox)this.pnlCff3Selection.getCmbProductLine(), productLine.getDisplayNameWithGenCompType()) == null)
      this.configurationManager.setProductLine(null); 
  }
  
  private ProductLine getSelectedProductLine() {
    return ProductLine.fromDisplayNameWithCompType((String)this.pnlCff3Selection.getCmbProductLine().getSelectedItem());
  }
  
  private void onContainerLoaded(ContainerConfigurationChangedEvent event) {
    if (this.cffController.isCff3Loaded()) {
      this.pnlCff3Selection.setVisible(true);
      this.pnlCff3Selection.getBtnShowDetails().setEnabled(true);
      this.pnlCff3Selection.getBtnShowDetails().setSelected(false);
      if (event.getAttribute(Attribute.Key.OPERATION_RESULT) == Attribute.Value.OK) {
        updateContentFromConfiguration();
        setContainerCompatibility((AbstractConfigurationEvent)event);
      } 
    } else {
      this.pnlCff3Selection.setVisible(false);
      this.pnlCff3Selection.getBtnShowDetails().setEnabled(false);
    } 
  }
  
  private void onContainerUnloaded(ContainerConfigurationChangedEvent event) {
    this.pnlCff3Selection.getBtnShowDetails().setEnabled(false);
    clearCff3Selections();
    setContainerCompatibility((AbstractConfigurationEvent)event);
    setPnlVisible(false);
  }
  
  private void setContainerCompatibility(AbstractConfigurationEvent event) {
    Attribute.Value containerValidationResult = event.getAttribute(Attribute.Key.CONTAINER_COMPATIBLE_WITH_BIKE);
    if (containerValidationResult != null) {
      boolean containerCompatibleWithBike = (containerValidationResult == Attribute.Value.OK);
      setProductLineState(containerCompatibleWithBike);
      setBikeTypeState(containerCompatibleWithBike);
      setBikeModelState(containerCompatibleWithBike);
      setAbsVariantState(containerCompatibleWithBike);
    } 
    validateContainerConfiguration(event);
  }
  
  private void setProductLineState(boolean enabled) {
    if (this.pnlCff3Selection.getCmbProductLine() != null)
      this.pnlCff3Selection.getCmbProductLine().setEnabled((enabled && this.rightsManager.isOemAdmin())); 
  }
  
  private void setBikeTypeState(boolean enabled) {
    if (this.pnlCff3Selection.getCmbBikeType() != null)
      this.pnlCff3Selection.getCmbBikeType().setEnabled((enabled && this.rightsManager.isOemAdmin())); 
  }
  
  private void setBikeModelState(boolean enabled) {
    if (this.pnlCff3Selection.getCmbModel() != null)
      this.pnlCff3Selection.getCmbModel().setEnabled((enabled && this.rightsManager.isOemAdmin())); 
  }
  
  private void setAbsVariantState(boolean enabled) {
    if (this.pnlCff3Selection.getCmbAbs() != null)
      this.pnlCff3Selection.getCmbAbs().setEnabled((enabled && this.rightsManager.isOemAdmin())); 
  }
  
  private void updateContentFromConfiguration() {
    removeComboBoxListeners();
    updateVisibleProductLines();
    addComboBoxListeners();
  }
  
  private synchronized void updateVisibleProductLines() {
    if (this.cffController.isCff3Loaded()) {
      Set<String> productLines = new LinkedHashSet<>();
      List<ContainerBikeDataSet> dataSets = this.containerConfig.getContainerBikeDataSet();
      dataSets.forEach(dataSet -> productLines.add(dataSet.getProductLine().getDisplayNameWithGenCompType()));
      LOGGER.debug("Read in product lines from container: '{}'", productLines);
      this.pnlCff3Selection.getCmbProductLine().setModel(new DefaultComboBoxModel<>(productLines.<String>toArray(new String[0])));
      ProductLine selectedProductLine = this.configurationManager.getContainerConfiguration().getProductLine();
      LOGGER.debug("Preselected product line is: '{}'", selectedProductLine);
      selectProductLine(selectedProductLine);
      updateVisibleBikeTypes();
    } 
  }
  
  private void updateVisibleBikeTypes() {
    if (this.cffController.isCff3Loaded()) {
      ProductLine selectedProdLine = this.containerConfig.getProductLine();
      Set<String> bikeTypes = new LinkedHashSet<>();
      List<ContainerBikeDataSet> duParameterReplies = this.containerConfig.getContainerBikeDataSet();
      duParameterReplies.stream().filter(dataSet -> (selectedProdLine == dataSet.getProductLine())).forEachOrdered(dataSet -> bikeTypes.add(dataSet.getBikeType().getDisplayName()));
      LOGGER.debug("Read in bike types from container: '{}'", bikeTypes);
      this.pnlCff3Selection.getCmbBikeType().setModel(new DefaultComboBoxModel<>(bikeTypes.<String>toArray(new String[0])));
      BikeType selectedBikeType = this.configurationManager.getContainerConfiguration().getBikeType();
      LOGGER.debug("Preselected bike type is: '{}'", selectedBikeType);
      selectBikeType(selectedBikeType);
      updateVisibleModels();
    } 
  }
  
  private void selectBikeType(BikeType bikeType) {
    if (setComboBoxItem((JComboBox)this.pnlCff3Selection.getCmbBikeType(), bikeType.getDisplayName()) == null)
      this.configurationManager.setBikeType(null); 
  }
  
  private BikeType getSelectedBikeType() {
    return BikeType.fromDisplayName((String)this.pnlCff3Selection.getCmbBikeType().getSelectedItem());
  }
  
  private void updateVisibleModels() {
    if (this.cffController.getContainerType() == BoschContainerController.ContainerType.NONE)
      return; 
    ProductLine productLine = this.containerConfig.getProductLine();
    BikeType bikeType = this.containerConfig.getBikeType();
    Set<String> bikeModels = new LinkedHashSet<>();
    List<ContainerBikeDataSet> duParameterReplies = this.containerConfig.getContainerBikeDataSet();
    duParameterReplies.stream().filter(dataSet -> (productLine == dataSet.getProductLine() && bikeType == dataSet.getBikeType())).forEachOrdered(dataSet -> bikeModels.add(dataSet.getBikeModel()));
    LOGGER.debug("Read in bike models from container: '{}'", bikeModels);
    this.pnlCff3Selection.getCmbModel().setModel(new DefaultComboBoxModel<>(bikeModels.<String>toArray(new String[0])));
    this.pnlCff3Selection.getCmbModel().setRenderer(new BikeModelCellRenderer());
    String selectedBikeModel = this.configurationManager.getContainerConfiguration().getBikeModel();
    LOGGER.debug("Preselected bike model is: '{}'", selectedBikeModel);
    selectBikeModel(selectedBikeModel);
    updateEbikeAbsComboBox();
  }
  
  private synchronized void selectBikeModel(String bikeModel) {
    if (setComboBoxItem((JComboBox)this.pnlCff3Selection.getCmbModel(), bikeModel) == null)
      this.configurationManager.setBikeModel(null); 
  }
  
  private String getSelectedBikeModel() {
    return (String)this.pnlCff3Selection.getCmbModel().getSelectedItem();
  }
  
  private Object setComboBoxItem(JComboBox cmb, Object item) {
    int count = cmb.getItemCount();
    for (int n = 0; n < count; n++) {
      if (cmb.getItemAt(n).equals(item)) {
        cmb.setSelectedItem(item);
        return item;
      } 
    } 
    cmb.setSelectedItem(null);
    return null;
  }
  
  private synchronized void setComboBoxesEnabled(boolean enabled) {
    this.pnlCff3Selection.getCmbProductLine().setEnabled(enabled);
    this.pnlCff3Selection.getCmbBikeType().setEnabled(enabled);
    this.pnlCff3Selection.getCmbModel().setEnabled(enabled);
    cmbBasVariantEnableRequest(enabled);
  }
  
  private void onProductLineChanged(ContainerConfigurationChangedEvent event) {
    updateVisibleBikeTypes();
    validateProductLine((AbstractConfigurationEvent)event);
    validateBikeType((AbstractConfigurationEvent)event);
    validateBikeModel((AbstractConfigurationEvent)event);
    selectProductLine((ProductLine)event.getNewValue());
  }
  
  private void onBikeTypeChanged(ContainerConfigurationChangedEvent event) {
    updateVisibleModels();
    validateBikeType((AbstractConfigurationEvent)event);
    validateBikeModel((AbstractConfigurationEvent)event);
    selectBikeType((BikeType)event.getNewValue());
  }
  
  private void onBikeModelChanged(ContainerConfigurationChangedEvent event) {
    updateEbikeAbsComboBox();
    validateBikeModel((AbstractConfigurationEvent)event);
    selectBikeModel((String)event.getNewValue());
  }
  
  private void onAbsParameterIdChanged(ContainerConfigurationChangedEvent event) {
    setAbsVarWithId((String)event.getNewValue());
  }
  
  private void onContainerChanged(ContainerConfigurationChangedEvent event) {
    if (this.cffController.isCff3Loaded())
      switch (event.getTrigger()) {
        case PRODUCT_LINE:
          onProductLineChanged(event);
          break;
        case BIKE_TYPE:
          onBikeTypeChanged(event);
          break;
        case BIKE_MODEL:
          onBikeModelChanged(event);
          break;
        case ABS_PAR_ID:
          onAbsParameterIdChanged(event);
          break;
      }  
  }
  
  private void btnShowDetailsItemStateChanged(ItemEvent evt) {
    this.cff3DetailsPanelController.setPnlVisible((evt.getStateChange() == 1));
  }
  
  private void btnShowDetailsPropertyChange(PropertyChangeEvent evt) {
    if (Boolean.FALSE.equals(evt.getNewValue())) {
      this.cff3DetailsPanelController.setPnlVisible(false);
      this.pnlCff3Selection.getBtnShowDetails().setSelected(false);
    } 
  }
  
  private synchronized void clearCff3Selections() {
    if (this.pnlCff3Selection.getCmbProductLine() != null) {
      this.pnlCff3Selection.getCmbProductLine().removeAllItems();
      this.pnlCff3Selection.getCmbBikeType().removeAllItems();
      this.pnlCff3Selection.getCmbModel().removeAllItems();
      this.pnlCff3Selection.getCmbAbs().removeAllItems();
    } 
  }
  
  private void onBikeConnect(HardwareConnectionChangedEvent event) {
    if (this.containerConfig.getProductLine() == ProductLine.NONE && this.configurationManager.getBikeIdentification().isDuConnected() && this.rightsManager.isOemAdmin())
      updateContentFromConfiguration(); 
    validateContainerConfiguration((AbstractConfigurationEvent)event);
  }
  
  private void setProductLineBorder(boolean valid) {
    setComboBoxValid(this.pnlCff3Selection.getCmbProductLine(), valid);
  }
  
  private void setBikeTypeBorder(boolean valid) {
    setComboBoxValid(this.pnlCff3Selection.getCmbBikeType(), valid);
  }
  
  private void setBikeModelBorder(boolean valid) {
    setComboBoxValid(this.pnlCff3Selection.getCmbModel(), valid);
  }
  
  private void onBikeDisconnect() {
    if (this.configurationManager.isContainerLoaded()) {
      setProductLineBorder(true);
      setBikeTypeBorder(true);
      setBikeModelBorder(true);
    } 
  }
  
  private void validateProductLine(AbstractConfigurationEvent event) {
    Attribute.Value productLineValid = event.getAttribute(Attribute.Key.PRODUCT_LINE_VALID);
    if (productLineValid != null)
      setProductLineBorder((productLineValid == Attribute.Value.OK)); 
  }
  
  private void validateBikeType(AbstractConfigurationEvent event) {
    Attribute.Value bikeTypeValid = event.getAttribute(Attribute.Key.BIKE_TYPE_VALID);
    if (bikeTypeValid != null)
      setBikeTypeBorder((bikeTypeValid == Attribute.Value.OK)); 
  }
  
  private void validateBikeModel(AbstractConfigurationEvent event) {
    Attribute.Value bikeModelValid = event.getAttribute(Attribute.Key.BIKE_MODEL_VALID);
    if (bikeModelValid != null)
      setBikeModelBorder((bikeModelValid == Attribute.Value.OK)); 
  }
  
  private void validateContainerConfiguration(AbstractConfigurationEvent event) {
    validateProductLine(event);
    validateBikeType(event);
    validateBikeModel(event);
    validateAbs(event);
  }
  
  void setAbsTextFieldVisible(boolean visible) {
    this.cff3DetailsPanelController.setAbsTextFieldVisible(visible);
  }
  
  public void onRightsChanged(RightsChangedEvent event) {
    LOGGER.debug("RightsChangedEvent received '{}'", event);
    if (this.cffController.isCff3Loaded() && event.getUserLevel() == UserLevel.OEM)
      EventQueue.invokeLater(() -> {
            LOGGER.debug("Process rights change event now from EDT");
            setComboBoxesEnabled((event.getMode() == Mode.OEM_ADMIN));
          }); 
  }
  
  public void onBikeConfigurationChanged(BikeConfigurationChangedEvent event) {
    LOGGER.debug("BikeConfigurationChangedEvent received: '{}'", event);
    if (this.cffController.isCff3Loaded() && event.getAction() == BikeConfigurationChangedEvent.Action.READ_FROM_BIKE)
      EventQueue.invokeLater(() -> onReadFromBike(event)); 
  }
  
  private void onReadFromBike(BikeConfigurationChangedEvent event) {
    updateContentFromConfiguration();
    validateContainerConfiguration((AbstractConfigurationEvent)event);
  }
  
  public void onHardwareConnectionChanged(HardwareConnectionChangedEvent event) {
    LOGGER.debug("HardwareConnectionChangedEvent received: '{}'", event);
    if (this.cffController.isCff3Loaded())
      switch (event.getAction()) {
        case SYSTEM_CONNECTED:
        case SYSTEM_RECONNECTED:
          if (event.getSystemType() == HardwareConnectionChangedEvent.HardwareSystem.BIKE_SYSTEM)
            EventQueue.invokeLater(() -> onBikeConnect(event)); 
          break;
        case SYSTEM_DISCONNECTED:
          if (event.getSystemType() == HardwareConnectionChangedEvent.HardwareSystem.BIKE_SYSTEM)
            EventQueue.invokeLater(this::onBikeDisconnect); 
          break;
        case ECU_CONNECTED:
        case ECU_DISCONNECTED:
          EventQueue.invokeLater(() -> setContainerCompatibility((AbstractConfigurationEvent)event));
          break;
      }  
  }
  
  public void onContainerConfigurationChanged(ContainerConfigurationChangedEvent event) {
    LOGGER.debug("ContainerConfigurationChangedEvent received: '{}'", event);
    switch (event.getAction()) {
      case CHANGED:
        EventQueue.invokeLater(() -> onContainerChanged(event));
        break;
      case LOADED:
        EventQueue.invokeLater(() -> onContainerLoaded(event));
        break;
      case UNLOADED:
        EventQueue.invokeLater(() -> onContainerUnloaded(event));
        break;
    } 
    EventQueue.invokeLater(() -> validateAbs((AbstractConfigurationEvent)event));
  }
}

package com.gigatronik.beds.gui.configtab.bike.container;

import com.gigatronik.beds.service.configuration.Attribute;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.configuration.ConfigurationManager;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.configuration.api.BikeConfigurationChangesListener;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.configuration.event.BikeConfigurationChangedEvent;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.configuration.event.ContainerConfigurationChangedEvent;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.flashcontainer.impl.ContainerBikeDataSet;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.common.configuration.ComponentType;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.common.configuration.Constants;
import java.awt.EventQueue;
import java.io.File;
import org.apache.commons.lang3.StringUtils;
import org.slf4j.Logger;
import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;

public class Cff3DetailsPanelController extends AbstractDetailsPanelController implements BikeConfigurationChangesListener {
  private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(Cff3DetailsPanelController.class);
  
  private final Cff3DetailsPanel pnlCff3Details;
  
  public Cff3DetailsPanelController(Cff3DetailsPanel detailsPanel, ConfigurationManager configManager) {
    super(detailsPanel, configManager);
    this.pnlCff3Details = detailsPanel;
  }
  
  void setPnlVisible(boolean visible) {
    this.pnlCff3Details.setVisible(visible);
  }
  
  void setAbsTextFieldVisible(boolean visible) {
    this.pnlCff3Details.getLblAbsSwVersion().setVisible(visible);
    this.pnlCff3Details.getTxtAbsSwVersion().setVisible(visible);
  }
  
  private synchronized void clearContainerInfo() {
    this.pnlCff3Details.getTxtApplId().setText("");
    this.pnlCff3Details.getTxtYear().setText("");
    this.pnlCff3Details.getTxtManufacturer().setText("");
    this.pnlCff3Details.getTxtBatterySwVersion().setText("");
    this.pnlCff3Details.getTxtDuSwVersion().setText("");
    this.pnlCff3Details.getTxtAbsSwVersion().setText("");
    this.pnlCff3Details.getTxtApplParaVersion().setText("");
    this.pnlCff3Details.getTxtToolVersion().setText("");
    resetHmiTable();
    updateDetails();
  }
  
  private void updateDetails() {
    if (!this.configurationManager.getContainerConfiguration().isConfigured()) {
      this.pnlCff3Details.getTxtApplId().setText("-");
      this.pnlCff3Details.getTxtYear().setText("-");
      this.pnlCff3Details.getTxtManufacturer().setText("-");
      this.pnlCff3Details.getTxtBatterySwVersion().setText("-");
      this.pnlCff3Details.getTxtDuSwVersion().setText("-");
      this.pnlCff3Details.getTxtAbsSwVersion().setText("-");
      this.pnlCff3Details.getTxtApplParaVersion().setText("-");
      this.pnlCff3Details.getTxtToolVersion().setText("-");
      resetHmiTable();
      this.cffController.getBas100Interface().clearPreviousBasVariantInfo();
    } else {
      fillCff3GuiElements();
    } 
  }
  
  private void fillCff3GuiElements() {
    fillBuiVersionTable();
    updateTxtAbsSwVersion();
    fillContainerDetails();
  }
  
  protected void fillContainerDetails() {
    ContainerBikeDataSet cbds = this.containerConfig.getConfiguredParameterSet();
    if (cbds != null) {
      this.pnlCff3Details.getTxtManufacturer().setText(cbds.getManufacturer());
      this.pnlCff3Details.getTxtApplId().setText(this.configurationManager.getContainerConfiguration().getConfiguredParId());
      this.pnlCff3Details.getTxtYear().setText(cbds.getModelYear());
      this.pnlCff3Details.getTxtApplParaVersion().setText(this.cffInterface.getParameterVersion(this.configurationManager.getContainerConfiguration().getConfiguredParId()));
      this.pnlCff3Details.getTxtToolVersion().setText(this.cffInterface.getRequiredVciVersion());
      this.pnlCff3Details.getTxtBatterySwVersion().setText(this.cffInterface.getBatSwVersionNotConnected());
      this.pnlCff3Details.getTxtDuSwVersion().setText(this.cffInterface.getSwVersionConnectedDu(ComponentType.NONE, Constants.SystemType.NONE, this.configurationManager.getContainerConfiguration().getConfiguredParId()));
    } 
  }
  
  private void onContainerLoaded(ContainerConfigurationChangedEvent event) {
    if (this.cffController.isCff3Loaded() && event.getAttribute(Attribute.Key.OPERATION_RESULT) == Attribute.Value.OK) {
      String fileName = ((File)event.getNewValue()).getName();
      if (StringUtils.endsWith(fileName, ".cff3"))
        this.pnlCff3Details.setVisible(false); 
      updateDetails();
    } 
  }
  
  private void onContainerChanged(ContainerConfigurationChangedEvent event) {
    switch (event.getTrigger()) {
      case PRODUCT_LINE:
      case BIKE_TYPE:
      case BIKE_MODEL:
        updateDetails();
        break;
    } 
  }
  
  public void onBikeConfigurationChanged(BikeConfigurationChangedEvent event) {
    LOGGER.debug("BikeConfigurationChangedEvent received: '{}'", event);
    if (this.cffController.isCff3Loaded() && event.getAction() == BikeConfigurationChangedEvent.Action.READ_FROM_BIKE)
      EventQueue.invokeLater(this::updateDetails); 
  }
  
  public void onContainerConfigurationChanged(ContainerConfigurationChangedEvent event) {
    LOGGER.debug("ContainerConfigurationChangedEvent received: '{}'", event);
    EventQueue.invokeLater(() -> {
          LOGGER.debug("Process ContainerConfigurationChangedEvent: '{}'", event);
          switch (event.getAction()) {
            case CHANGED:
              onContainerChanged(event);
              break;
            case LOADED:
              onContainerLoaded(event);
              break;
            case UNLOADED:
              clearContainerInfo();
              break;
          } 
        });
  }
}

import com.gigatronik.beds.service.rightsmanager.api.UserLevel;
import com.gigatronik.beds.settings.SettingsProxy;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.bosch.service.internationalization.ResourceBundleFactory;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.bosch.service.internationalization.Utf8ResourceBundleFormatted;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.bosch.updateserver.UpdateServerConnection;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.framework.plugins.exceptions.ConfigurationNotFoundException;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.common.configuration.BikeIdentification;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.common.configuration.EcuIdentification;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.custom.CustomFileChooser;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.gui.EBikeApplication;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.gui.testinterface.TestableJOptionPane;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.utils.ConfigUtil;
import java.awt.Component;
import java.awt.EventQueue;
import java.awt.event.ActionEvent;
import java.io.File;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.text.SimpleDateFormat;
import java.util.Date;
import java.util.concurrent.CountDownLatch;
import java.util.concurrent.Executor;
import java.util.concurrent.Executors;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicBoolean;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicReference;
import javax.swing.BorderFactory;
import javax.swing.JDialog;
import javax.swing.JFileChooser;
import javax.swing.JPanel;
import javax.swing.UIManager;
import javax.swing.border.Border;
import javax.swing.filechooser.FileFilter;
import javax.swing.filechooser.FileNameExtensionFilter;
import org.apache.commons.io.FileUtils;
import org.apache.commons.lang3.StringUtils;
import org.apache.commons.lang3.concurrent.BasicThreadFactory;
import org.slf4j.Logger;
import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;

public class ContainerFileSelectionPanelController implements RightsChangedEventListener, ContainerConfigurationChangesListener, HardwareConnectionChangesListener {
  private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(BikeConfigurationPanelController.class);
  
  private static final Utf8ResourceBundleFormatted BUNDLE = ResourceBundleFactory.newDefaultResourceBundle();
  
  private static final String CFF2_FILENAME_PREFIX_REPLY = "reply";
  
  private static final String CFF2_FILENAME_PREFIX_REQUEST = "request";
  
  private static final String VIEW_TYPE_DETAILS = "viewTypeDetails";
  
  private final ContainerFileSelectionPanel pnlContainerFileSelection;
  
  private final Cff2ContentSelectionPanelController cff2ContentSelectionPanelController;
  
  private final Cff3ContentSelectionPanelController cff3ContentSelectionPanelController;
  
  private final SampleValidator sampleValidator;
  
  private final EBikeApplication ebikeApplication;
  
  private final BikeIdentification bikeIdent;
  
  private final ConfigurationManager configurationManager;
  
  private ContainerDownloadController containerDownloadController;
  
  private boolean transferCffDirectly2Bike = false;
  
  private final Border ioBorder = UIManager.getBorder("FormattedTextField.border");
  
  private final Border nioBorder = BorderFactory.createCompoundBorder(BorderFactory.createLineBorder(GuiColors.FRAME_INVALID, 2), this.ioBorder);
  
  private UserLevel userLevel = UserLevel.UNKNOWN;
  
  private Mode userMode = Mode.NONE;
  
  private final AtomicBoolean isSampleValidationSelectFromInternetEnabled = new AtomicBoolean(true);
  
  private File loadedCffFile;
  
  JDialog containerBikeCompatibilityMessageDialog;
  
  public ContainerFileSelectionPanelController(ContainerFileSelectionPanel cffSelectionPanel, Cff2ContentSelectionPanelController cff2SelectionPnlController, Cff3ContentSelectionPanelController cff3SelectionPnlController, ConfigurationManager cm, EBikeApplication eBikeApp, RightsManager rightsManager) {
    this.pnlContainerFileSelection = cffSelectionPanel;
    this.cff2ContentSelectionPanelController = cff2SelectionPnlController;
    this.cff3ContentSelectionPanelController = cff3SelectionPnlController;
    this.configurationManager = cm;
    this.ebikeApplication = eBikeApp;
    this.bikeIdent = this.configurationManager.getBikeIdentification();
    this.containerDownloadController = new ContainerDownloadController(this.ebikeApplication, this, this.configurationManager);
    addListenersToPanel();
    this.sampleValidator = SampleValidatorFactory.getSampleValidator();
    cm.addListener((OrderableListener)this);
    rightsManager.addListener(this);
  }
  
  private void addListenersToPanel() {
    this.pnlContainerFileSelection.getChbUpdate().addActionListener(evt -> 
        chbUpdateActionPerformed());
    this.pnlContainerFileSelection.getBtnContainerFromFile().addActionListener(evt -> 
        btnContainerFromFileActionPerformed());
    this.pnlContainerFileSelection.getBtnContainerFromInternet().addActionListener(evt -> getContainerFromInternet());
  }
  
  public boolean isChbUpdateSelected() {
    return this.pnlContainerFileSelection.getChbUpdate().isSelected();
  }
  
  public void chbUpdateDoClick() {
    this.pnlContainerFileSelection.getChbUpdate().doClick();
  }
  
  public boolean isChbUpdateEnabled() {
    return this.pnlContainerFileSelection.getChbUpdate().isEnabled();
  }
  
  public void setChbUpdateEnabled(boolean enabled) {
    this.pnlContainerFileSelection.getChbUpdate().setEnabled(enabled);
  }
  
  public void setTransferDirectlyToBike(boolean enabled) {
    this.transferCffDirectly2Bike = enabled;
  }
  
  public boolean isTransferCffDirectly2Bike() {
    return this.transferCffDirectly2Bike;
  }
  
  private void setComponentsVisible(boolean visible) {
    this.pnlContainerFileSelection.getLblUpdateHintIbd().setVisible((visible && this.userLevel == UserLevel.IBD));
    this.pnlContainerFileSelection.getBtnContainerFromInternet().setVisible(visible);
    this.pnlContainerFileSelection.getBtnContainerFromFile().setVisible(visible);
    this.pnlContainerFileSelection.getLblFile().setVisible(visible);
    this.pnlContainerFileSelection.getTxtContainerFile().setVisible(visible);
  }
  
  private void chbUpdateActionPerformed() {
    boolean updateSelected = this.pnlContainerFileSelection.getChbUpdate().isSelected();
    setComponentsVisible(updateSelected);
    boolean cff3Loaded = this.configurationManager.getContainerConfiguration().getContainerController().isCff3Loaded();
    this.cff3ContentSelectionPanelController.setPnlVisible((updateSelected && cff3Loaded));
    this.cff2ContentSelectionPanelController.setPnlVisible((updateSelected && !cff3Loaded));
    if (!updateSelected) {
      this.configurationManager.clearContainer();
      if (this.userLevel == UserLevel.OEM)
        this.configurationManager.clearConfiguration(); 
    } 
  }
  
  public void getContainerFromInternet() {
    this.pnlContainerFileSelection.getBtnContainerFromInternet().setEnabled(false);
    LOGGER.info("getContainerFromInternet(): Get cff file from bosch server");
    if (!new UpdateServerConnection().isServerAvailable(true)) {
      LOGGER.error("Update server not available on download container flash data");
      validateLoadContainerFromInternetButtonState();
      return;
    } 
    if (this.userLevel == UserLevel.IBD) {
      String[] dialogOptions = { BUNDLE.getString("FileChooser.saveButtonText"), 
          BUNDLE.getString("EBikeConfigurationTab.transferDirectly.optionPane.option") };
      String msg = BUNDLE.getString("EBikeConfigurationTab.transferDirectly.optionPane.message") + "\n" + BUNDLE.getString("EBikeConfigurationTab.transferDirectly.optionPane.message");
      String title = BUNDLE.getString("EBikeConfigurationTab.transferDirectly.optionPane.title");
      int response = TestableJOptionPane.showOptionDialog(msg, title, 0, 3, null, dialogOptions, dialogOptions[0]);
      if (response == -1) {
        validateLoadContainerFromInternetButtonState();
        return;
      } 
      this.transferCffDirectly2Bike = (response == 1);
    } 
    Executor btnCffDownloadExecutor = Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor(new BasicThreadFactory.Builder().namingPattern("BtnDownloadCffFromInternet-Thread-%d").build());
    btnCffDownloadExecutor.execute(this::downloadContainerAndSetDownloadButtonState);
  }
  
  private void downloadContainerAndSetDownloadButtonState() {
    this.containerDownloadController = new ContainerDownloadController(this.ebikeApplication, this, this.configurationManager);
    this.configurationManager.getContainerConfiguration().getContainerController().getCff2ContainerFromInternet(ConfigUtil.getDisplayVersion(), Cff2_DesiredReply.FULL, this.bikeIdent.getSystemType(), this.bikeIdent.getApplicationId(), this.bikeIdent.getBctIdentification(), this.bikeIdent.getDuIdentification(), (EcuIdentification)this.bikeIdent.getBms1Identification(), this.bikeIdent.getHmiIdentification(), this.bikeIdent.getAbsIdentification(), this.bikeIdent.getBcsIdentification(), true, this.containerDownloadController);
    validateLoadContainerFromInternetButtonState();
  }
  
  private void btnContainerFromFileActionPerformed() {
    JFileChooser fileChooser = CustomFileChooser.getCustomFileChooser();
    fileChooser.getActionMap().get("viewTypeDetails").actionPerformed(null);
    FileFilter cffFilter = getFileFilter();
    fileChooser.setFileFilter(cffFilter);
    fileChooser.setCurrentDirectory(new File(getContainerPath()));
    int returnVal = fileChooser.showOpenDialog((Component)this.ebikeApplication.getFrame());
    if (returnVal == 0) {
      setContainerPath(fileChooser.getSelectedFile().getParent());
      LOGGER.info("getContainerFromFile(): Selected file -> {}", fileChooser.getSelectedFile().getName());
      File selectedFile = fileChooser.getSelectedFile();
      loadContainerFile(selectedFile);
    } else {
      LOGGER.info("getContainerFromFile(): Open command cancelled by user.");
    } 
  }
  
  private FileFilter getFileFilter() {
    FileFilter filter;
    if (this.userLevel == UserLevel.OEM) {
      filter = new FileNameExtensionFilter("Container File Format (.cff2, .cff3)", new String[] { "cff2", "cff3" });
    } else {
      filter = new FileNameExtensionFilter("Container File Format (.cff2)", new String[] { "cff2" });
    } 
    return filter;
  }
  
  public File getLoadedCffFile() {
    return this.loadedCffFile;
  }
  
  private String getContainerPath() {
    try {
      String containerPath = SettingsProxy.getInstance().getGlobalSettings().getProperty("containerFolder");
      return (containerPath != null) ? containerPath : "";
    } catch (ConfigurationNotFoundException ex) {
      LOGGER.error("Error getting last selected container folder from settings", ex.getCause());
      return "";
    } 
  }
  
  private void setContainerPath(String path) {
    try {
      SettingsProxy.getInstance().getGlobalSettings().setProperty("containerFolder", path);
    } catch (ConfigurationNotFoundException ex) {
      LOGGER.error("Error setting last selected container folder in settings", (Throwable)ex);
    } 
  }
  
  public void loadContainerFile(File file) {
    this.configurationManager.clearContainer();
    CustomLoadingDialog loader = new CustomLoadingDialog(this.configurationManager, (JPanel)this.pnlContainerFileSelection);
    loader.loadContainer(file, this.transferCffDirectly2Bike);
  }
  
  private void validateLoadContainerFromFileButtonState() {
    this.pnlContainerFileSelection.getBtnContainerFromFile().setEnabled((this.userLevel == UserLevel.IBD || this.userMode == Mode.OEM_ADMIN));
  }
  
  private void validateLoadContainerFromInternetButtonState() {
    this.pnlContainerFileSelection.getBtnContainerFromInternet().setEnabled((this.bikeIdent.isHmiConnected() && this.isSampleValidationSelectFromInternetEnabled.get() && (this.userLevel == UserLevel.IBD || this.userMode == Mode.OEM_ADMIN)));
  }
  
  private void checkContainerCompatibility(AbstractConfigurationEvent event) {
    if (event == null)
      return; 
    Attribute.Value value = event.getAttribute(Attribute.Key.CONTAINER_COMPATIBLE_WITH_BIKE);
    if (value != null)
      if (value == Attribute.Value.OK) {
        this.pnlContainerFileSelection.getTxtContainerFile().setValidWsdl(true);
        this.pnlContainerFileSelection.getTxtContainerFile().setBorder(this.ioBorder);
        this.pnlContainerFileSelection.getTxtContainerFile().setForeground(GuiColors.TEXT_VALID);
        String text = this.pnlContainerFileSelection.getTxtContainerFile().getText();
        this.pnlContainerFileSelection.getTxtContainerFile().setToolTipText(StringUtils.isNotBlank(text) ? text : null);
      } else {
        this.pnlContainerFileSelection.getTxtContainerFile().setValidWsdl(false);
        this.pnlContainerFileSelection.getTxtContainerFile().setBorder(this.nioBorder);
        this.pnlContainerFileSelection.getTxtContainerFile().setForeground(GuiColors.TEXT_INVALID);
        this.pnlContainerFileSelection.getTxtContainerFile().setToolTipText(value.getInfo());
      }  
  }
  
  private void onContainerUnloaded(ContainerConfigurationChangedEvent event) {
    this.pnlContainerFileSelection.getTxtContainerFile().setText("");
    this.pnlContainerFileSelection.getChbUpdate().setSelected(false);
    this.loadedCffFile = null;
    setComponentsVisible(false);
    checkContainerCompatibility((AbstractConfigurationEvent)event);
  }
  
  private void onContainerLoaded(ContainerConfigurationChangedEvent event) {
    if (event.getAttribute(Attribute.Key.OPERATION_RESULT) == Attribute.Value.OK) {
      this.pnlContainerFileSelection.getChbUpdate().setSelected(true);
      setComponentsVisible(true);
      this.loadedCffFile = (File)event.getNewValue();
      this.pnlContainerFileSelection.getTxtContainerFile().setText(this.loadedCffFile.getName());
      checkContainerCompatibility((AbstractConfigurationEvent)event);
    } 
  }
  
  private void onBikeStateChanged(HardwareConnectionChangedEvent event) {
    if (event.getAction() == HardwareConnectionChangedEvent.HardwareConnectionStateChange.SYSTEM_DISCONNECTED && this.containerBikeCompatibilityMessageDialog != null)
      this.containerBikeCompatibilityMessageDialog.dispose(); 
    this.isSampleValidationSelectFromInternetEnabled.set((this.userMode == Mode.OEM_ADMIN || !this.sampleValidator.isAnySampleHwConnected(this.bikeIdent)));
    validateLoadContainerFromInternetButtonState();
    checkContainerCompatibility((AbstractConfigurationEvent)event);
  }
  
  public void saveRequestCffContainer(String cffPath) {
    try {
      saveContainerFile(cffPath, "request");
    } catch (IOException|RuntimeException ex) {
      LOGGER.error("Failed to save request cff container", (Throwable)ex);
    } 
  }
  
  public File saveReplyCffContainer(String cffPath) {
    try {
      return saveContainerFile(cffPath, "reply");
    } catch (IOException|RuntimeException ex) {
      LOGGER.error("Failed to save reply cff container", (Throwable)ex);
      return null;
    } 
  }
  
  public String getFormattedContainerFileDefaultName(String fileNamePrefix) {
    SimpleDateFormat dateFormat = new SimpleDateFormat("yyyyMMdd");
    String appId = this.bikeIdent.getApplicationId();
    if (StringUtils.isBlank(appId))
      appId = this.bikeIdent.isDuConnected() ? "000000" : "111111"; 
    return fileNamePrefix + "_" + fileNamePrefix + "_" + dateFormat.format(new Date()) + ".cff2";
  }
  
  private File saveContainerFile(String cffPath, String cffFileName) throws IOException {
    AtomicReference<File> selectedFile = new AtomicReference<>();
    CountDownLatch fileSelectionLatch = new CountDownLatch(1);
    String path = getContainerPath() + getContainerPath() + File.separator;
    EventQueue.invokeLater(() -> {
          JFileChooser fileChooser = CustomFileChooser.getCustomFileChooser();
          fileChooser.getActionMap().get("viewTypeDetails").actionPerformed(null);
          FileFilter filter = new FileNameExtensionFilter("Container File Format (.cff2)", new String[] { "cff2" });
          fileChooser.setFileFilter(filter);
          fileChooser.setSelectedFile(new File(path));
          int returnValue = fileChooser.showSaveDialog((Component)this.ebikeApplication.getFrame());
          if (returnValue == 0)
            selectedFile.set(fileChooser.getSelectedFile()); 
          fileSelectionLatch.countDown();
        });
    try {
      fileSelectionLatch.await();
    } catch (InterruptedException e) {
      LOGGER.error("btnContainerFromFileActionPerformed interrupted");
      Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
    } 
    File file = new File(cffPath);
    if (selectedFile.get() != null) {
      setContainerPath(selectedFile.get().getParent());
      FileUtils.copyFile(file, selectedFile.get());
      return selectedFile.get();
    } 
    return null;
  }
  
  public void onRightsChanged(RightsChangedEvent event) {
    LOGGER.debug("Received rights changed event '{}'", event);
    if (event.getUserLevel() != UserLevel.UNKNOWN) {
      this.userLevel = event.getUserLevel();
      this.userMode = event.getMode();
      EventQueue.invokeLater(() -> {
            LOGGER.debug("Process rights change event now from EDT");
            this.pnlContainerFileSelection.getChbUpdate().setEnabled((this.userLevel == UserLevel.IBD || this.userMode == Mode.OEM_ADMIN));
            this.isSampleValidationSelectFromInternetEnabled.set((this.userMode == Mode.OEM_ADMIN || !this.sampleValidator.isAnySampleHwConnected(this.bikeIdent)));
            validateLoadContainerFromFileButtonState();
            validateLoadContainerFromInternetButtonState();
          });
    } 
  }
  
  public void onHardwareConnectionChanged(HardwareConnectionChangedEvent event) {
    LOGGER.debug("HardwareConnectionChangedEvent received: '{}'", event);
    switch (event.getAction()) {
      case SYSTEM_CONNECTED:
      case SYSTEM_RECONNECTED:
      case SYSTEM_DISCONNECTED:
        if (event.getSystemType() == HardwareConnectionChangedEvent.HardwareSystem.BIKE_SYSTEM)
          EventQueue.invokeLater(() -> onBikeStateChanged(event)); 
        break;
      case ECU_CONNECTED:
      case ECU_DISCONNECTED:
        EventQueue.invokeLater(() -> onBikeStateChanged(event));
        break;
    } 
  }
  
  public void onContainerConfigurationChanged(ContainerConfigurationChangedEvent event) {
    LOGGER.debug("ContainerConfigurationChangedEvent received: '{}'", event);
    switch (event.getAction()) {
      case LOADED:
        EventQueue.invokeLater(() -> onContainerLoaded(event));
        break;
      case UNLOADED:
        EventQueue.invokeLater(() -> onContainerUnloaded(event));
        break;
    } 
  }
}

package com.gigatronik.beds.gui.configtab.bike;

import com.gigatronik.beds.gui.configtab.bike.container.ContainerFileSelectionPanelController;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.configuration.ConfigurationManager;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.flashcontainer.download.AbstractContainerDownloadStateHandler;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.flashcontainer.impl.ContainerDownloadDataset;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.bosch.service.internationalization.ResourceBundleFactory;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.bosch.service.internationalization.Utf8ResourceBundleFormatted;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.gui.EBikeApplication;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.gui.EBikeESLosErrorDialog;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.gui.testinterface.TestableJOptionPane;
import java.io.File;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.util.List;
import javax.swing.JFrame;
import org.apache.commons.io.FileUtils;
import org.slf4j.Logger;
import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;

public class ContainerDownloadController extends AbstractContainerDownloadStateHandler {
  protected static final Utf8ResourceBundleFormatted BUNDLE = ResourceBundleFactory.newDefaultResourceBundle();
  
  private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(ContainerDownloadController.class);
  
  private final ContainerFileSelectionPanelController containerSelectionPanelController;
  
  private static final String CFF_DOWNLOAD_FAILED = "EBikeStatus.CFF_DOWNLOAD_FAILED";
  
  private final EBikeApplication ebikeApplication;
  
  public ContainerDownloadController(EBikeApplication ebikeApplication, ContainerFileSelectionPanelController cffSelectioPnlController, ConfigurationManager configurationManager) {
    super(configurationManager.getContainerConfiguration().getContainerController());
    this.containerSelectionPanelController = cffSelectioPnlController;
    this.ebikeApplication = ebikeApplication;
  }
  
  public void onRequestError() {
    LOGGER.error("getContainerFromInternet(): Returned 0 -> Could not generate request CFF.");
    TestableJOptionPane.showMessageDialog(BUNDLE.getString("EBikeConfigurationTab.ContainerFromInternet.return0.optionPane.message"), 
        BUNDLE.getString("EBikeConfigurationTab.ContainerFromInternet.return0.optionPane.title"), 0);
    this.ebikeApplication.showStatusError(BUNDLE.getString("EBikeStatus.CFF_DOWNLOAD_FAILED"), 0);
    this.containerSelectionPanelController.setTransferDirectlyToBike(false);
  }
  
  public void onDownloadError(ContainerDownloadDataset resultData) {
    LOGGER.error("getContainerFromInternet(): Returned 4 -> Reply container is corrupt");
    TestableJOptionPane.showMessageDialog(BUNDLE.getString("EBikeConfigurationTab.ContainerFromInternet.return4.optionPane.message"), 
        BUNDLE.getString("EBikeConfigurationTab.ContainerFromInternet.return4.optionPane.title"), 0);
    this.containerSelectionPanelController.saveRequestCffContainer(resultData.getRequestCffPath());
    this.ebikeApplication.showStatusError(BUNDLE.getString("EBikeStatus.CFF_DOWNLOAD_FAILED"), 0);
    this.containerSelectionPanelController.setTransferDirectlyToBike(false);
    this.ebikeApplication.getConfigurationManager().clearContainer();
  }
  
  public void onCffError(List<String[]> errorMessages) {
    LOGGER.error("getContainerFromInternet(): Returned 2 -> Error message CFF obtained.");
    int numberOfMessages = errorMessages.size();
    int numberOfErrorDialogs = (int)Math.ceil((double)numberOfMessages / 10.0D);
    EBikeESLosErrorDialog.showESLosError(errorMessages, numberOfErrorDialogs, new EBikeESLosErrorDialog((JFrame)this.ebikeApplication.getFrame()));
    this.ebikeApplication.showStatusError(BUNDLE.getString("EBikeStatus.CFF_DOWNLOAD_FAILED"), 0);
    this.containerSelectionPanelController.setTransferDirectlyToBike(false);
  }
  
  public void onDownloadSuccessful(ContainerDownloadDataset resultData) {
    LOGGER.info("getContainerFromInternet(): Returned 3 -> Response CFF obtained.");
    this.ebikeApplication.showStatusInfo(BUNDLE.getString("EBikeStatus.CFF_DOWNLOAD_SUCCESSFUL"), 0);
    File cffFile = renameDownloadedCffFile(resultData.getReplyCffPath());
    resultData.setReplyCff(cffFile.getAbsolutePath());
    if (this.containerSelectionPanelController.isTransferCffDirectly2Bike()) {
      this.containerSelectionPanelController.loadContainerFile(cffFile);
    } else {
      File savedFile = this.containerSelectionPanelController.saveReplyCffContainer(cffFile.getAbsolutePath());
      this.containerSelectionPanelController.loadContainerFile((savedFile != null) ? savedFile : cffFile);
    } 
  }
  
  private File renameDownloadedCffFile(String replyCffPath) {
    File tmpFile = new File(replyCffPath);
    try {
      File newFile = new File(tmpFile.getParent(), this.containerSelectionPanelController.getFormattedContainerFileDefaultName("reply"));
      Files.deleteIfExists(newFile.toPath());
      FileUtils.moveFile(tmpFile, newFile);
      return newFile;
    } catch (IOException ex) {
      LOGGER.error("Failed to rename downloaded cff container file", (Throwable)ex);
      return tmpFile;
    } 
  }
  
  public void onInvalidUrl() {
    LOGGER.warn("getContainerFromInternet(): Error during service call. Urls might be all wrong");
    TestableJOptionPane.showMessageDialog(BUNDLE.getString("AbstractEBikeConfigTab.download.noconnection.text"), 
        BUNDLE.getString("AbstractEBikeConfigTab.download.noconnection.title"), 0);
    this.ebikeApplication.showStatusError(BUNDLE.getString("EBikeStatus.CFF_DOWNLOAD_FAILED"), 0);
    this.containerSelectionPanelController.setTransferDirectlyToBike(false);
  }
  
  public void onConnectionProblem() {
    LOGGER.warn("getContainerFromInternet(): Returned 1 -> Unable to connect to internet.");
    TestableJOptionPane.showMessageDialog(BUNDLE.getString("AbstractEBikeConfigTab.download.noconnection.text"), 
        BUNDLE.getString("AbstractEBikeConfigTab.download.noconnection.title"), 0);
    this.ebikeApplication.showStatusError(BUNDLE.getString("EBikeStatus.CFF_DOWNLOAD_FAILED"), 0);
    this.containerSelectionPanelController.setTransferDirectlyToBike(false);
  }
}

package com.gigatronik.beds.gui.configtab.bike;

import com.gigatronik.beds.gui.customcomponents.CustomProgressDialog;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.configuration.ConfigurationManager;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.bosch.service.internationalization.ResourceBundleFactory;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.bosch.service.internationalization.Utf8ResourceBundleFormatted;
import java.awt.Dialog;
import java.awt.EventQueue;
import java.io.File;
import javax.swing.JPanel;
import javax.swing.SwingUtilities;
import javax.swing.SwingWorker;
import org.slf4j.Logger;
import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;

public class CustomLoadingDialog {
  private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(CustomLoadingDialog.class);
  
  private static final Utf8ResourceBundleFormatted BUNDLE = ResourceBundleFactory.newDefaultResourceBundle();
  
  private final ConfigurationManager configManager;
  
  private final JPanel pnlParent;
  
  private CustomProgressDialog dlgProgress;
  
  private SwingWorker<Void, Void> worker;
  
  public CustomLoadingDialog(ConfigurationManager configurationManager, JPanel parentPanel) {
    this.configManager = configurationManager;
    this.pnlParent = parentPanel;
    createDialog();
  }
  
  public void loadContainer(File containerFile, boolean transferDirectToBike) {
    createContainerLoader(containerFile, transferDirectToBike);
    this.worker.execute();
    EventQueue.invokeLater(() -> showDialog(BUNDLE.getString("ProgressMonitor.progressText"), BUNDLE.getString("CustomProgress.Container.label")));
  }
  
  public void loadConfiguration(File configurationFile) {
    createConfigurationLoader(configurationFile);
    this.worker.execute();
    EventQueue.invokeLater(() -> showDialog(BUNDLE.getString("ProgressMonitor.progressText"), BUNDLE.getString("CustomProgress.Configuration.label")));
  }
  
  private void createContainerLoader(final File file, final boolean transferDirectToBike) {
    this.worker = new SwingWorker<>() {
        public Void doInBackground() {
          try {
            Thread.currentThread().setName("ContainerLoader-" + Thread.currentThread().getId());
            CustomLoadingDialog.this.configManager.loadContainer(file, transferDirectToBike);
          } catch (Exception e) {
            CustomLoadingDialog.LOGGER.error("Error loading container from file {}:", file.getAbsolutePath(), e);
          } 
          return null;
        }
        
        protected void done() {
          CustomLoadingDialog.this.closeDialog();
          if (isCancelled()) {
            CustomLoadingDialog.LOGGER.debug("Loading Container was cancelled");
            CustomLoadingDialog.this.configManager.clearContainer();
          } 
        }
      };
  }
  
  private void createConfigurationLoader(final File file) {
    this.worker = new SwingWorker<>() {
        public Void doInBackground() {
          try {
            Thread.currentThread().setName("ConfigurationLoader-" + Thread.currentThread().getId());
            CustomLoadingDialog.this.configManager.readConfigurationFromFile(file);
          } catch (Exception e) {
            CustomLoadingDialog.LOGGER.error("Error loading configuration from file {}:", file.getAbsolutePath(), e);
          } 
          return null;
        }
        
        protected void done() {
          CustomLoadingDialog.this.closeDialog();
          if (isCancelled()) {
            CustomLoadingDialog.LOGGER.debug("Reading configuration from file was cancelled");
            CustomLoadingDialog.this.configManager.clearConfiguration();
          } 
        }
      };
  }
  
  private void createDialog() {
    this.dlgProgress = new CustomProgressDialog();
    this.dlgProgress.getButton().setVisible(false);
    this.dlgProgress.setResizable(false);
    this.dlgProgress.setModal(true);
    this.dlgProgress.setModalityType(Dialog.ModalityType.APPLICATION_MODAL);
    this.dlgProgress.setDefaultCloseOperation(0);
    this.dlgProgress.setLocationRelativeTo(SwingUtilities.getRoot(this.pnlParent));
    this.dlgProgress.getProgressBar().setIndeterminate(true);
  }
  
  private void showDialog(String title, String message) {
    this.dlgProgress.setTitle(title);
    this.dlgProgress.getlabel().setText(message);
    this.dlgProgress.pack();
    this.dlgProgress.setVisible(true);
  }
  
  private void closeDialog() {
    this.dlgProgress.setVisible(false);
    this.dlgProgress.dispose();
  }
}

package com.gigatronik.beds.gui.configtab.bike;

import com.gigatronik.beds.common.order.OrderableListener;
import com.gigatronik.beds.gui.color.GuiColors;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.configuration.ConfigurationManager;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.configuration.api.BikeConfigurationChangesListener;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.configuration.api.ContainerConfigurationChangesListener;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.configuration.api.HardwareConnectionChangesListener;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.configuration.event.BikeConfigurationChangedEvent;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.configuration.event.ContainerConfigurationChangedEvent;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.configuration.event.HardwareConnectionChangedEvent;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.bosch.service.internationalization.ResourceBundleFactory;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.bosch.service.internationalization.Utf8ResourceBundleFormatted;
import java.awt.EventQueue;
import org.slf4j.Logger;
import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;

public class DataSourcePanelController implements BikeConfigurationChangesListener, ContainerConfigurationChangesListener, HardwareConnectionChangesListener {
  private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(DataSourcePanelController.class);
  
  private static final Utf8ResourceBundleFormatted BUNDLE = ResourceBundleFactory.newDefaultResourceBundle();
  
  private final ConfigurationManager configurationManager;
  
  private final DataSourcePanel panel;
  
  public DataSourcePanelController(DataSourcePanel dataSourcePanel, ConfigurationManager configurationManager) {
    this.panel = dataSourcePanel;
    this.configurationManager = configurationManager;
    configurationManager.addListener((OrderableListener)this);
  }
  
  private void updateConfigurationName() {
    String configFileName = this.configurationManager.getConfigurationFileName();
    if (configFileName != null) {
      if (this.configurationManager.isConfigurationFileChanged()) {
        LOGGER.info("Configuration in file mismatches current GUI settings!");
        this.panel.setConfigurationNameColor(GuiColors.DARK_RED);
        this.panel.setConfigurationName(configFileName + configFileName);
      } else {
        LOGGER.debug("Configuration in file matches current GUI settings");
        this.panel.setConfigurationNameColor(GuiColors.DARK_BLUISH);
        this.panel.setConfigurationName(configFileName);
      } 
    } else {
      this.panel.setConfigurationNameColor(GuiColors.DARK_BLUISH);
      this.panel.setConfigurationName("");
    } 
  }
  
  public void onBikeConfigurationChanged(BikeConfigurationChangedEvent event) {
    LOGGER.debug("BikeConfigurationChangedEvent received: '{}'", event);
    EventQueue.invokeLater(() -> updateConfigurationName());
  }
  
  public void onHardwareConnectionChanged(HardwareConnectionChangedEvent event) {
    LOGGER.debug("HardwareConnectionChangedEvent received: '{}'", event);
    EventQueue.invokeLater(() -> updateConfigurationName());
  }
  
  public void onContainerConfigurationChanged(ContainerConfigurationChangedEvent event) {
    LOGGER.debug("ContainerConfigurationChangedEvent received: '{}'", event);
    switch (event.getAction()) {
      case LOADED:
        EventQueue.invokeLater(() -> this.panel.setConfigurationSource(this.configurationManager.getContainerConfiguration().getName()));
        break;
      case UNLOADED:
        EventQueue.invokeLater(() -> this.panel.setConfigurationSource(""));
        break;
    } 
    EventQueue.invokeLater(() -> updateConfigurationName());
  }
}

  public enum ComboBoxItem {
    LIGHT_SWITCH_OPTION_DISABLED("No light switching over DU", AbstractConfigurationElementController.BUNDLE.getString("EBikeConfigurationTab.DISABLED")),
    LIGHT_SWITCH_OPTION_ENABLED("Light over DU", AbstractConfigurationElementController.BUNDLE.getString("EBikeConfigurationTab.ENABLED")),

    LIGHT_OUTPUT_12V("LIGHT_SUPPLY_VOLTAGE_12V", AbstractConfigurationElementController.BUNDLE.getString("EBikeConfigurationTab.LightOutput.12V")),
    UNIT_KILOMETER("km", AbstractConfigurationElementController.BUNDLE.getString("EBikeConfigurationTab.KILOMETER")),
    UNIT_MILES("mi", AbstractConfigurationElementController.BUNDLE.getString("EBikeConfigurationTab.MILES")),
    AUTO_DOWN_SHIFT_ENABLED("TRUE", AbstractConfigurationElementController.BUNDLE.getString("EBikeConfigurationTab.ENABLED")),
    AUTO_DOWN_SHIFT_DISABLED("FALSE", AbstractConfigurationElementController.BUNDLE.getString("EBikeConfigurationTab.DISABLED")),
    HIGH_POWER_PORT_ENABLED("TRUE", AbstractConfigurationElementController.BUNDLE.getString("EBikeConfigurationTab.ENABLED")),
    HIGH_POWER_PORT_DISABLED("FALSE", AbstractConfigurationElementController.BUNDLE.getString("EBikeConfigurationTab.DISABLED"));
    
    private final String value;
    
    private final String text;
    
    ComboBoxItem(String value, String text) {
      this.value = value;
      this.text = text;
    }
    
    public String getValue() {
      return this.value;
    }
    
    public String toString() {
      return this.text;
    }
  }
  
  AbstractComboBoxElementController(ComboBoxElement configurationElement, ConfigurationManager configurationManager, RightsManager rightsManager, ConfigurationKey configurationKey) {
    super(configurationElement, configurationManager, rightsManager);
    this.key = configurationKey;
    this.comboBox = (JComboBox)configurationElement.getControlledComponent();
  }
  
  public void validateValue() {
    setValid((this.comboBox.getSelectedIndex() >= 0));
  }
  
  public void validateSettings() {
    validateContent();
    validateVisibility();
    validateState();
  }
  
  public void setSelectedIndex(Integer value) {
    if (value != null && value >= 0) {
      try {
        this.comboBox.setSelectedIndex(value.intValue());
      } catch (IllegalArgumentException e) {
        LOGGER.error("Setting combo box '{}' to index '{}' failed - {}", this.comboBox.getName(), value, e.getMessage());
        clearValue();
      } 
    } else {
      clearValue();
    } 
    validateValue();
  }
  
  public int getSelectedIndex() {
    return this.comboBox.getSelectedIndex();
  }
  
  public void setValue(String value) {
    if (value == null || !setComboBoxByValue(value))
      clearValue(); 
    validateValue();
  }
  
  private boolean setComboBoxByValue(String value) {
    int index = this.comboBox.getItemCount();
    while (--index >= 0) {
      ComboBoxItem item = this.comboBox.getItemAt(index);
      if (StringUtils.equals(item.getValue(), value)) {
        this.comboBox.setSelectedIndex(index);
        return true;
      } 
    } 
    return false;
  }
  
  public String getDisplayTextForValue(String value) {
    if (value != null) {
      int index = this.comboBox.getItemCount();
      while (--index >= 0) {
        ComboBoxItem item = this.comboBox.getItemAt(index);
        if (StringUtils.equalsAny(value, item.getValue(), item.toString()))
          return item.toString(); 
      } 
    } 
    return value;
  }
  
  public String getValue() {
    ComboBoxItem item = (ComboBoxItem)this.comboBox.getSelectedItem();
    if (item != null)
      return item.getValue(); 
    return null;
  }
  
  public void clearValue() {
    this.comboBox.setSelectedItem(null);
    validateValue();
    this.configurationManager.setConfigurationValue(this.key, null);
  }
  
  void validateContent() {}
  
  void validateState() {
    setEnabled(true);
  }
  
  void validateVisibility() {
    setVisible(true);
  }
}

      component.setMaximumSize(this.controlledComponent.getMaximumSize());
      component.setMinimumSize(this.controlledComponent.getMinimumSize());
      component.setPreferredSize(this.controlledComponent.getPreferredSize());

    GridBagConstraints gridBagConstraints = new GridBagConstraints();
    gridBagConstraints.gridx = 1;
    gridBagConstraints.gridy = 0;
    gridBagConstraints.insets = new Insets(0, 0, 4, 0);
