import com.gigatronik.ebike.common.configuration.Constants;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.common.configuration.ProductLine;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.common.util.ConverterUtils;
import org.apache.commons.lang3.StringUtils;
import org.slf4j.Logger;
import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;

public abstract class AbstractConfigurationElementController {
  public static final Utf8ResourceBundleFormatted BUNDLE = ResourceBundleFactory.newDefaultResourceBundle();
  
  private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(AbstractConfigurationElementController.class);
  
  final AbstractConfigurationElement controlledElement;
  
  final ConfigurationManager configurationManager;
  
  final RightsManager rightsManager;
  
  boolean valid = true;
  
  private boolean enabled = false;
  
  public AbstractConfigurationElementController(AbstractConfigurationElement controlledElement, ConfigurationManager configurationManager, RightsManager rightsManager) {
    this.controlledElement = controlledElement;
    this.configurationManager = configurationManager;
    this.rightsManager = rightsManager;
  }
  
  public abstract void validateValue();
  
  public abstract void validateSettings();
  
  public abstract void clearValue();
  
  public boolean isValid() {
    return (!isVisible() || this.valid);
  }
  
  public void setValid(boolean valid) {
    this.valid = valid;
    getConfigurationElement().paintBorder((valid || !this.enabled));
  }
  
  public boolean isEnabled() {
    return this.enabled;
  }
  
  public void setEnabled(boolean enabled) {
    this.enabled = enabled;
    getConfigurationElement().getControlledComponent().setEnabled(enabled);
    getConfigurationElement().paintBorder((this.valid || !enabled));
  }
  
  public boolean isVisible() {
    return getConfigurationElement().isVisible();
  }
  
  public void setVisible(boolean visible) {
    getConfigurationElement().setVisible(visible);
  }
  
  public void requestFocus() {
    if (this.enabled)
      this.controlledElement.getControlledComponent().requestFocusInWindow(); 
  }
  
  public AbstractConfigurationElement getConfigurationElement() {
    return this.controlledElement;
  }
  
  boolean isAdminWithContainerOrBike() {
    return (this.rightsManager.getMode() == Mode.OEM_ADMIN && isContainerLoadedOrBikeConnected());
  }
  
  boolean isAdminWithContainerOrBuiConnected() {
    return (this.rightsManager.getMode() == Mode.OEM_ADMIN && isContainerLoadedOrBuiConnected());
  }
  
  boolean isOemWithContainerOrBike() {
    return (this.rightsManager.getUserLevel() == UserLevel.OEM && isContainerLoadedOrBikeConnected());
  }
  
  private boolean isContainerLoadedOrBuiConnected() {
    boolean buiConnected = this.configurationManager.getBikeIdentification().isHmiConnected();
    boolean buiAppMode = this.configurationManager.getBikeIdentification().getHmiIdentification().isApplication();
    if (buiConnected)
      return (buiAppMode && this.configurationManager.isContainerCompatibleWithBike() && (this.configurationManager.isContainerConfiguredToBike() || !this.configurationManager.isContainerLoaded())); 
    return this.configurationManager.isContainerConfiguredToBike();
  }
  
  public abstract String getDisplayTextForValue(String paramString);
  
  boolean isContainerLoadedOrBikeConnected() {
    boolean buiConnected = this.configurationManager.getBikeIdentification().isHmiConnected();
    boolean duConnected = isConfigurableBikeConnected();
    if (buiConnected)
      return (duConnected && this.configurationManager.isContainerCompatibleWithBike() && (this.configurationManager.isContainerConfiguredToBike() || !this.configurationManager.isContainerLoaded())); 
    return this.configurationManager.isContainerConfiguredToBike();
  }
  
  boolean isConfigurableBikeConnected() {
    return this.configurationManager.getBikeIdentification().getDuIdentification().isApplication();
  }
  
  boolean isIbdWithBuiConnected() {
    return (this.rightsManager.getUserLevel() == UserLevel.IBD && 
      this.configurationManager.getBikeIdentification().getHmiIdentification().isApplication() && 
      this.configurationManager.isContainerCompatibleWithBike());
  }
  
  boolean isIbdWithBikeConnected() {
    return (this.rightsManager.getUserLevel() == UserLevel.IBD && 
      isConfigurableBikeConnected() && 
      this.configurationManager.isContainerCompatibleWithBike());
  }
  
  Version getDuUpdateVersion() {
    if (this.configurationManager.isContainerLoaded()) {
      String cffVersion = this.configurationManager.getContainerConfiguration().getContainerController().getBoschContainerCommonInterface().getSwVersionConnectedDu(ComponentType.NONE, Constants.SystemType.NONE, this.configurationManager.getContainerConfiguration().getConfiguredParId());
      if (!StringUtils.isBlank(cffVersion))
        return versionFromStringOrZeroVersion(cffVersion); 
    } 
    return versionFromStringOrZeroVersion(this.configurationManager.getBikeIdentification().getDuIdentification().getSwVersion());
  }
  
  Version hmiUpdateVersion(ComponentType type) {
    if (this.configurationManager.isContainerLoaded())
      return getContainerVersionForComponent(type); 
    return getVersionForConnectedHmi(type);
  }
  
  Version getVersionForConnectedHmi(ComponentType component) {
    String version = "";
    if (this.configurationManager.getBikeIdentification().getHmiIdentification().getComponentType() == component)
      version = this.configurationManager.getBikeIdentification().getHmiIdentification().getSwVersion(); 
    return versionFromStringOrZeroVersion(version);
  }
  
  Version getContainerVersionForComponent(ComponentType component) {
    String version = "";
    if (this.configurationManager.isContainerLoaded())
      version = this.configurationManager.getContainerConfiguration().getContainerController().getBoschContainerCommonInterface().getSwVersionConnectedHmi(component); 
    return versionFromStringOrZeroVersion(version);
  }
  
  Version getFirmwareVersionFromContainer(ComponentType type) {
    String cffVersion = "";
    if (this.configurationManager.isContainerLoaded())
      cffVersion = this.configurationManager.getContainerConfiguration().getContainerController().getBoschContainerCommonInterface().getSwVersion(type); 
    return versionFromStringOrZeroVersion(cffVersion);
  }
  
  boolean containerHasFirmwareForComponent(ComponentType type) {
    if (this.configurationManager.isContainerLoaded()) {
      String version = this.configurationManager.getContainerConfiguration().getContainerController().getBoschContainerCommonInterface().getSwVersionConnectedHmi(type);
      return StringUtils.isNotBlank(version);
    } 
    return false;
  }
  
  Version getDuBikeVersion() {
    String duVersionString = this.configurationManager.getBikeIdentification().getDuIdentification().getSwVersion();
    return versionFromStringOrZeroVersion(duVersionString);
  }
  
  Version versionFromStringOrZeroVersion(String version) {
    if (StringUtils.isNotBlank(version))
      try {
        return Version.parse(version);
      } catch (NumberFormatException|java.io.IOException ex) {
        LOGGER.warn("Failed to parse the DU software version: {}", version, ex);
      }  
    return new Version(new Integer[] { 0, 0, 0, 0 });
  }
  
  String convertFromMmToInch(String valueMM) {
    if (ConverterUtils.isInteger(valueMM)) {
      Integer tempValue = new Integer(valueMM);
      double inchValue = ConverterUtil.millimeterToInch(tempValue.doubleValue());
      return String.format("%.2f", inchValue);
    } 
    return "";
  }
  
  String convertFromInchToMM(String valueInch) {
    if (ConverterUtils.isDouble(valueInch)) {
      Double tempValue = new Double(valueInch);
      double mmValue = ConverterUtil.inchToMillimeter(tempValue.doubleValue());
      return String.format("%.0f", mmValue);
    } 
    return "";
  }
  
  ProductLine getSelectedProductLine() {
    if (this.configurationManager.isContainerLoaded())
      return this.configurationManager.getContainerConfiguration().getProductLine(); 
    return this.configurationManager.getBikeIdentification().getProductLine();
  }
}

package com.gigatronik.beds.gui.configtab.bike.elements;

import com.gigatronik.beds.gui.color.GuiColors;
import com.gigatronik.beds.gui.customcomponents.api.NumericTextField;
import com.gigatronik.beds.gui.customcomponents.impl.CustomComponentsFactory;
import java.awt.GridBagConstraints;
import java.awt.GridBagLayout;
import java.awt.Insets;
import javax.swing.BorderFactory;
import javax.swing.DefaultComboBoxModel;
import javax.swing.JComboBox;
import javax.swing.JLabel;
import javax.swing.JPanel;
import javax.swing.JTextField;
import javax.swing.border.Border;

public class AutoDownShiftElement extends AbstractConfigurationElement {
  private JComboBox cmbAutoDownShift;
  
  private NumericTextField txtAutoDownShift;
  
  private Border validBorder;
  
  private Border invalidBorder;
  
  private static final String PANEL_AUTO_DOWN_SHIFT = "pnlAutoDownShift";
  
  static final int MIN_START_GEAR = 1;
  
  static final int MAX_START_GEAR = 7;
  
  static final int DEFAULT_START_GEAR = 2;
  
  static final int DISABLED_START_GEAR = 0;
  
  public AutoDownShiftElement() {
    init();
  }
  
  private void init() {
    setName("pnlAutoDownShift");
    JPanel pnlAutoDownShift = new JPanel();
    pnlAutoDownShift.setName("pnlAutoDownShift");
    GridBagLayout gblPanel = new GridBagLayout();
    gblPanel.columnWidths = new int[] { 96, 120, 40 };
    gblPanel.rowHeights = new int[] { 0 };
    gblPanel.columnWeights = new double[] { 1.0D, 1.0D, 0.0D };
    gblPanel.rowWeights = new double[] { 0.0D };
    pnlAutoDownShift.setLayout(gblPanel);
    this.cmbAutoDownShift = new JComboBox();
    this.cmbAutoDownShift.setName("cmbAutoDownShift");
    this.cmbAutoDownShift.setToolTipText(BUNDLE.getString("EBikeConfigurationTab.AutoDownShift.tooltip"));
    this.cmbAutoDownShift.setModel(new DefaultComboBoxModel<>(new AbstractComboBoxElementController.ComboBoxItem[] { AbstractComboBoxElementController.ComboBoxItem.AUTO_DOWN_SHIFT_ENABLED, AbstractComboBoxElementController.ComboBoxItem.AUTO_DOWN_SHIFT_DISABLED }));
    this.validBorder = this.cmbAutoDownShift.getBorder();
    this.invalidBorder = BorderFactory.createCompoundBorder(BorderFactory.createLineBorder(GuiColors.FRAME_INVALID, 2), this.validBorder);
    GridBagConstraints gbcComboBox = new GridBagConstraints();
    gbcComboBox.fill = 1;
    gbcComboBox.anchor = 17;
    gbcComboBox.insets = new Insets(0, 0, 5, 5);
    gbcComboBox.gridx = 0;
    gbcComboBox.gridy = 0;
    pnlAutoDownShift.add(this.cmbAutoDownShift, gbcComboBox);
    JLabel lblAutoDownShiftDefault = new JLabel(BUNDLE.getString("EBikeConfigurationTab.AutoDownShiftDefault.label"));
    lblAutoDownShiftDefault.setName("lblAutoDownShiftDefault");
    GridBagConstraints gbcLabel = new GridBagConstraints();
    gbcLabel.anchor = 13;
    gbcLabel.insets = new Insets(0, 0, 0, 5);
    gbcLabel.gridx = 1;
    gbcLabel.gridy = 0;
    pnlAutoDownShift.add(lblAutoDownShiftDefault, gbcLabel);
    this.txtAutoDownShift = CustomComponentsFactory.createNumericTextField("txtAutoDownShift", null, false, true, true);
    this.txtAutoDownShift.setToolTipText(BUNDLE.getString("EBikeConfigurationTab.AutoDownShiftDefault.tooltip"));
    this.txtAutoDownShift.setRange(1.0D, 7.0D);
    this.txtAutoDownShift.setDecimal(0);
    this.txtAutoDownShift.setText(String.valueOf(2));
    GridBagConstraints gbcSpinner = new GridBagConstraints();
    gbcSpinner.fill = 2;
    gbcSpinner.insets = new Insets(0, 0, 5, 0);
    gbcSpinner.gridx = 2;
    gbcSpinner.gridy = 0;
    pnlAutoDownShift.add((JTextField)this.txtAutoDownShift, gbcSpinner);
    setControlledComponent(pnlAutoDownShift, "pnlAutoDownShift");
    setLabel(BUNDLE.getString("EBikeConfigurationTab.AutoDownShift.label"));
    setUnit("");
  }
  
  public JComboBox getComboBox() {
    return this.cmbAutoDownShift;
  }
  
  public NumericTextField getSpinner() {
    return this.txtAutoDownShift;
  }
  
  public void setEnabled(boolean enabled) {
    this.cmbAutoDownShift.setEnabled(enabled);
    this.txtAutoDownShift.setEnabled(enabled);
  }
  
  public void paintBorder(boolean valid) {
    this.cmbAutoDownShift.setBorder((!this.cmbAutoDownShift.isEnabled() || this.cmbAutoDownShift.getSelectedIndex() >= 0) ? getValidBorder() : getInvalidBorder());
  }
}

package com.gigatronik.beds.gui.configtab.bike.elements;

import com.gigatronik.beds.gui.customcomponents.api.NumericTextField;
import com.gigatronik.beds.gui.customcomponents.api.TextField;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.configuration.ConfigurationKey;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.configuration.ConfigurationManager;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.rightsmanager.api.Mode;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.rightsmanager.api.RightsManager;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.rightsmanager.api.UserLevel;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.common.configuration.Constants;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.common.util.ConverterUtils;
import java.awt.event.ItemEvent;
import javax.swing.JComboBox;
import javax.swing.JTextField;
import org.slf4j.Logger;
import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;

public class AutoDownShiftElementController extends AbstractConfigurationElementController {
  private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(AutoDownShiftElementController.class);
  
  private final AutoDownShiftElement element;
  
  public AutoDownShiftElementController(AutoDownShiftElement configurationElement, ConfigurationManager configurationManager, RightsManager rightsManager) {
    super(configurationElement, configurationManager, rightsManager);
    this.element = configurationElement;
    init();
  }
  
  private void init() {
    this.element.getComboBox().addItemListener(e -> {
          if (e.getStateChange() == 1) {
            JComboBox comboBox = (JComboBox)e.getSource();
            NumericTextField field = this.element.getSpinner();
            if (comboBox.getSelectedItem() == AbstractComboBoxElementController.ComboBoxItem.AUTO_DOWN_SHIFT_DISABLED) {
              field.setEnabled(false);
              field.setAdditionalAllowedValues(new double[0]);
              field.setText(String.valueOf(0));
            } else {
              field.setEnabled(!this.rightsManager.isModeActive(Mode.OEM_WORKER));
              field.setAdditionalAllowedValues(null);
              field.setText(String.valueOf(2));
            } 
            validateValue();
          } 
        });
    this.element.getSpinner().setListener(new TextField.TextFieldListener() {
          public void onValidationStateChanged(String componentName, boolean isValid, String value) {
            AutoDownShiftElementController.this.validateValue();
            onValueChanged(componentName, value);
          }
          
          public void onValueChanged(String componentName, String newText) {
            AutoDownShiftElementController.LOGGER.debug("Auto down shift changed to '{}'", newText);
            AutoDownShiftElementController.this.configurationManager.setConfigurationValue(ConfigurationKey.AUTO_DOWNSHIFT_STARTGEAR, newText);
          }
        });
  }
  
  public void validateValue() {
    boolean valid = false;
    String gearValue = ((JTextField)this.element.getSpinner()).getText();
    if (ConverterUtils.isInteger(gearValue)) {
      int gear = Integer.parseInt(gearValue);
      if (this.element.getComboBox().getSelectedItem() == AbstractComboBoxElementController.ComboBoxItem.AUTO_DOWN_SHIFT_ENABLED) {
        valid = (gear >= 1 && gear <= 7);
      } else if (this.element.getComboBox().getSelectedItem() == AbstractComboBoxElementController.ComboBoxItem.AUTO_DOWN_SHIFT_DISABLED) {
        valid = (gear == 0);
      } 
    } 
    setValid(valid);
  }
  
  public void validateSettings() {
    validateState();
    validateVisibility();
  }
  
  private void validateState() {
    boolean ibdWithBike = (this.rightsManager.isUserInLevel(UserLevel.IBD) && isConfigurableBikeConnected());
    boolean oemAdminWithBikeOrContainer = (this.rightsManager.isOemAdmin() && isContainerLoadedOrBikeConnected());
    boolean enabled = ((ibdWithBike || oemAdminWithBikeOrContainer) && 
      this.configurationManager.getBikeIdentification().getSystemType() != Constants.SystemType.CLASSIC_PLUS);
    this.element.getComboBox().setEnabled(enabled);
    this.element.getSpinner().setEnabled((enabled && this.element.getComboBox().getSelectedItem() == AbstractComboBoxElementController.ComboBoxItem.AUTO_DOWN_SHIFT_ENABLED));
    setEnabled(enabled);
  }
  
  private void validateVisibility() {
    setVisible(isSupportedByContainerOrBike());
  }
  
  private boolean isSupportedByContainerOrBike() {
    if (this.configurationManager.isContainerLoaded())
      return this.configurationManager.getContainerConfiguration().isAutoDownShiftSupported(); 
    return this.configurationManager.getBikeIdentification().isAutoDownShiftSupported();
  }
  
  public void setValue(String startGear) {
    if (ConverterUtils.isInteger(startGear) && this.configurationManager.getBikeIdentification().getSystemType() != Constants.SystemType.CLASSIC_PLUS) {
      int gear = Integer.parseInt(startGear);
      this.element.getComboBox().setSelectedItem((gear == 0) ? AbstractComboBoxElementController.ComboBoxItem.AUTO_DOWN_SHIFT_DISABLED : AbstractComboBoxElementController.ComboBoxItem.AUTO_DOWN_SHIFT_ENABLED);
      this.element.getSpinner().setText(startGear);
    } else {
      this.element.getComboBox().setSelectedItem(null);
      this.element.getSpinner().setText(null);
    } 
    validateValue();
  }
  
  public Integer getStartGear() {
    if (this.configurationManager.getBikeIdentification().getSystemType() != Constants.SystemType.CLASSIC_PLUS) {
      String gearValue = ((JTextField)this.element.getSpinner()).getText();
      if (ConverterUtils.isInteger(gearValue))
        return Integer.valueOf(gearValue); 
    } 
    return null;
  }
  
  public void clearValue() {
    setValue(null);
  }
  
  public boolean isValid() {
    return (!isSupportedByContainerOrBike() || this.valid);
  }
  
  public String getDisplayTextForValue(String value) {
    return value;
  }
}

package com.gigatronik.beds.gui.configtab.bike.elements;

import com.gigatronik.beds.gui.customcomponents.AbstractCustomComponentListener;
import com.gigatronik.beds.gui.customcomponents.CustomTextField;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.configuration.ConfigurationKey;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.configuration.ConfigurationManager;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.rightsmanager.api.RightsManager;
import com.gigatronik.beds.settings.SettingsProxy;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.framework.plugins.exceptions.ConfigurationNotFoundException;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.framework.util.Version;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.common.configuration.Constants;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.common.configuration.ProductLine;
import org.apache.commons.lang3.StringUtils;
import org.slf4j.Logger;
import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;

public class BatteryLockKeyElementController extends AbstractConfigurationElementController {
  private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(BatteryLockKeyElementController.class);
  
  private static final int MAX_CHAR = 30;
  
  private static final Version DU_MIN_SW_BATTERYLOCKKEY = new Version(new Integer[] { 1, 4, 1, 0 });
  
  private final TextFieldElement element;
  
  private final CustomTextField txtKey;
  
  public BatteryLockKeyElementController(TextFieldElement configurationElement, ConfigurationManager configurationManager, RightsManager rightsManager) {
    super(configurationElement, configurationManager, rightsManager);
    this.element = configurationElement;
    this.txtKey = (CustomTextField)this.element.getControlledComponent();
    init();
  }
  
  private void init() {
    this.txtKey.setMaxInputLength(30);
    this.txtKey.setEmptyAllowed(true);
    this.txtKey.setListener(new AbstractCustomComponentListener() {
          public boolean onFocusLost() {
            return true;
          }
          
          public void onVerificationChanged(boolean textValid) {
            BatteryLockKeyElementController.this.setValid(textValid);
          }
          
          public void onValueChanged(Object value) {
            BatteryLockKeyElementController.LOGGER.debug("Battery lock key value changed to '{}'", BatteryLockKeyElementController.this.getValue());
            BatteryLockKeyElementController.this.configurationManager.setConfigurationValue(ConfigurationKey.KEY_NUMBER_BATTERY_LOCK, BatteryLockKeyElementController.this.getValue());
          }
        });
  }
  
  public void setValue(String value) {
    if (!StringUtils.equals(value, getValue())) {
      this.txtKey.setText((value == null) ? "" : value);
      validateValue();
    } 
  }
  
  public String getValue() {
    if (this.configurationManager.getBikeIdentification().getSystemType() == Constants.SystemType.CLASSIC_PLUS)
      return null; 
    return this.txtKey.getText();
  }
  
  public void validateValue() {
    setValid(this.txtKey.verifyTextInput(false));
  }
  
  public void validateSettings() {
    validateState();
    validateVisibility();
  }
  
  private void validateVisibility() {
    Version duSwVersion = getDuUpdateVersion();
    ProductLine cffProductLine = getSelectedProductLine();
    boolean visible = true;
    if (cffProductLine.isGen1() || (cffProductLine.isGen2() && duSwVersion.compareTo(DU_MIN_SW_BATTERYLOCKKEY) < 0))
      visible = false; 
    setVisible(visible);
  }
  
  private void validateState() {
    setEnabled(((isOemWithContainerOrBike() && enabledInSettings()) || isIbdWithBikeConnected()));
  }
  
  private boolean enabledInSettings() {
    try {
      return SettingsProxy.getInstance().getGlobalSettings().getBoolean("flashassistant_battery_key_visible");
    } catch (ConfigurationNotFoundException ex) {
      LOGGER.warn("Failed to read battery lock key setting from configuration.", ex.getMessage());
      return false;
    } 
  }
  
  public void clearValue() {
    setValue(null);
  }
  
  public String getDisplayTextForValue(String value) {
    return value;
  }
}

package com.gigatronik.beds.gui.configtab.bike.elements;

import com.gigatronik.beds.gui.customcomponents.AbstractCustomComponentListener;
import com.gigatronik.beds.gui.customcomponents.CustomTextField;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.configuration.ConfigurationKey;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.configuration.ConfigurationManager;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.rightsmanager.api.RightsManager;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.rightsmanager.api.UserLevel;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.common.configuration.Constants;
import org.apache.commons.lang3.StringUtils;
import org.slf4j.Logger;
import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;

public class BikeIdElementController extends AbstractConfigurationElementController {
  private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(BikeIdElementController.class);
  
  private static final int MAX_CHAR_BIKE_ID_VICTOR = 30;
  
  private static final int MAX_CHAR_BIKE_ID_CLASSIC = 20;
  
  private final TextFieldElement element;
  
  private final CustomTextField txtBikeId;
  
  private int maxTextLength = 0;
  
  public BikeIdElementController(TextFieldElement configurationElement, ConfigurationManager configurationManager, RightsManager rightsManager) {
    super(configurationElement, configurationManager, rightsManager);
    this.element = configurationElement;
    this.txtBikeId = (CustomTextField)this.element.getControlledComponent();
    init();
  }
  
  private void init() {
    this.txtBikeId.setEmptyText(BUNDLE.getString("EBikeConfigurationTab.TEXT_PROMPT"));
    setMaxTextSize(30);
    this.txtBikeId.setListener(new AbstractCustomComponentListener() {
          public boolean onFocusLost() {
            return true;
          }
          
          public void onVerificationChanged(boolean textValid) {
            BikeIdElementController.this.setValid(textValid);
          }
          
          public void onValueChanged(Object value) {
            BikeIdElementController.LOGGER.debug("Bike id value changed to '{}'", BikeIdElementController.this.getValue());
            BikeIdElementController.this.configurationManager.setConfigurationValue(ConfigurationKey.BIKE_ID, BikeIdElementController.this.getValue());
          }
        });
  }
  
  public void setValue(String value) {
    this.txtBikeId.setText((value == null) ? "" : value);
    validateValue();
  }
  
  public String getValue() {
    return StringUtils.isBlank(this.txtBikeId.getText()) ? null : this.txtBikeId.getText();
  }
  
  public void validateValue() {
    setValid(this.txtBikeId.verifyTextInput(false));
  }
  
  public boolean isValid() {
    return (super.isValid() || this.rightsManager.getUserLevel() == UserLevel.IBD);
  }
  
  public void validateSettings() {
    boolean classic;
    setEnabled(isOemWithContainerOrBike());
    if (this.configurationManager.isContainerLoaded()) {
      classic = this.configurationManager.getContainerConfiguration().getProductLine().isGen1();
    } else {
      classic = (this.configurationManager.getBikeIdentification().getSystemType() == Constants.SystemType.CLASSIC_PLUS);
    } 
    setMaxTextSize(classic ? 20 : 30);
  }
  
  private void setMaxTextSize(int length) {
    if (this.maxTextLength != length) {
      this.maxTextLength = length;
      if (length == 20) {
        this.element.setUnit(BUNDLE.getString("EBikeConfigurationTab.lblBikeIDNumberFormat.text"));
        this.element.setToolTip(BUNDLE.getString("EBikeConfigurationTab.fmtTxtBikeIDNumber.toolTipText"));
      } else {
        this.element.setUnit(BUNDLE.getString("EBikeConfigurationTab.lblBikeIDNumberFormatVictor.text"));
        this.element.setToolTip(BUNDLE.getString("EBikeConfigurationTab.fmtTxtBikeIDNumberVictor.toolTipText"));
      } 
      this.txtBikeId.setMaxInputLength(length);
    } 
  }
  
  public void clearValue() {
    setValue(null);
  }
  
  public String getDisplayTextForValue(String value) {
    return value;
  }
}

ITEM 49: com/gigatronik/beds/gui/configtab/bike/elements/BuiLanguageElementController.java
========================================================================================================================
package com.gigatronik.beds.gui.configtab.bike.elements;

import com.gigatronik.beds.gui.customcomponents.DisabledComboBoxModel;
import com.gigatronik.beds.gui.customcomponents.DisabledItemsComboBox;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.configuration.ConfigurationKey;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.configuration.ConfigurationManager;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.rightsmanager.api.RightsManager;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.rightsmanager.api.UserLevel;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.bosch.service.internationalization.I18NUtil;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.framework.util.Version;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.common.configuration.ComponentType;
import java.awt.event.ItemEvent;
import java.awt.event.ItemListener;
import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.List;
import org.apache.commons.lang3.StringUtils;
import org.slf4j.Logger;
import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;

public class BuiLanguageElementController extends AbstractConfigurationElementController {
  private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(BuiLanguageElementController.class);
  
  private static final Version INTUVIA_MIN_SW_DANISH_LANGUAGE = new Version(new Integer[] { 5, 3, 0, 0 });
  
  private static final Version INTUVIA_MIN_SW_SWEDISH_LANGUAGE = new Version(new Integer[] { 5, 4, 0, 0 });
  
  private static final Version INTUVIA_MIN_SW_JAPANESE_LANGUAGE = new Version(new Integer[] { 5, 6, 0, 0 });
  
  private static final Version KIOX_SUPPORT_MIN_VERSION = new Version(new Integer[] { 1, 2, 0, 1 });
  
  private final List<String> supportedlanguages = I18NUtil.getBuiLanguages();
  
  private final DisabledItemsComboBox comboBox;
  
  private ItemListener itemListener;
  
  public BuiLanguageElementController(BuiLanguageElement configurationElement, ConfigurationManager configurationManager, RightsManager rightsManager) {
    super(configurationElement, configurationManager, rightsManager);
    this.comboBox = (DisabledItemsComboBox)configurationElement.getControlledComponent();
    init();
  }
  
  private void init() {
    this.itemListener = (event -> {
        if (event.getStateChange() == 1) {
          LOGGER.debug("Bui language changed to '{}'", event.getItem());
          validateValue();
          this.configurationManager.setConfigurationValue(ConfigurationKey.CYCLE_COMPUTER_LANGUAGE, getValue());
        } 
      });
    this.comboBox.addItemListener(this.itemListener);
  }
  
  public void validateValue() {
    setValid((this.comboBox.getSelectedIndex() >= 0));
  }
  
  public void validateSettings() {
    validateContent();
    validateVisibility();
    validateState();
  }
  
  public void setValue(String value) {
    if (value != null) {
      String selectedLanguage = I18NUtil.convIso2DisplayName(value);
      if (StringUtils.isNotBlank(selectedLanguage)) {
        int index = this.supportedlanguages.indexOf(selectedLanguage);
        if (index >= 0 && this.comboBox.getItemCount() > index && !this.comboBox.isItemDisabled(index)) {
          this.comboBox.setSelectedIndex(index);
          validateValue();
          return;
        } 
      } 
    } 
    clearValue();
  }
  
  public String getValue() {
    int selectedIndex = this.comboBox.getSelectedIndex();
    if (selectedIndex >= 0 && selectedIndex < this.supportedlanguages.size())
      return I18NUtil.convDisplay2IsoName(this.supportedlanguages.get(selectedIndex)); 
    return null;
  }
  
  public void clearValue() {
    this.comboBox.setSelectedItem(null);
    validateValue();
    this.configurationManager.setConfigurationValue(ConfigurationKey.CYCLE_COMPUTER_LANGUAGE, null);
  }
  
  private void validateContent() {
    if (this.rightsManager.isUserInLevel(UserLevel.IBD)) {
      validateContentForIbd();
    } else {
      validateContentForOem();
    } 
  }
  
  private void validateContentForIbd() {
    if (this.configurationManager.getBikeIdentification().getHmiIdentification().isApplication()) {
      validateBikeContent();
    } else {
      validateContainerContent();
    } 
  }
  
  private void validateContentForOem() {
    if (this.configurationManager.isContainerLoaded()) {
      validateContainerContent();
    } else {
      validateBikeContent();
    } 
  }
  
  private void validateBikeContent() {
    ComponentType hmiType = this.configurationManager.getBikeIdentification().getHmiIdentification().getComponentType();
    if (hmiType.isBUI33x() || hmiType.isBUI35x()) {
      validateBui3xxContent();
    } else if (hmiType.isBUI25x()) {
      validateBui25xContent(getVersionForConnectedHmi(hmiType));
    } 
  }
  
  private void validateContainerContent() {
    if (containerHasFirmwareForComponent(ComponentType.COMP_BUI250)) {
      Version version = getContainerVersionForComponent(ComponentType.COMP_BUI250);
      validateBui25xContent(version);
      return;
    } 
    if (containerHasFirmwareForComponent(ComponentType.COMP_BUI350)) {
      validateBui3xxContent();
      return;
    } 
    Version hmiVersion = getContainerVersionForComponent(ComponentType.COMP_BUI330);
    if (hmiVersion.compareTo(KIOX_SUPPORT_MIN_VERSION) >= 0) {
      validateBui3xxContent();
      return;
    } 
    this.comboBox.removeAllItems();
    clearValue();
  }
  
  private void validateBui25xContent(Version hmiVersion) {
    this.comboBox.removeItemListener(this.itemListener);
    String[] entries = this.supportedlanguages.<String>toArray(new String[0]);
    boolean[] states = new boolean[entries.length];
    Arrays.fill(states, true);
    String updateMessage = BUNDLE.getString("EBikeConfigurationTab.displayLanguage.updateMessage");
    if (hmiVersion.compareTo(INTUVIA_MIN_SW_DANISH_LANGUAGE) > 0) {
      if (hmiVersion.compareTo(INTUVIA_MIN_SW_SWEDISH_LANGUAGE) <= 0) {
        entries[7] = entries[7] + entries[7];
        states[7] = false;
        entries[8] = entries[8] + entries[8];
        states[8] = false;
      } 
    } else {
      entries[6] = entries[6] + entries[6];
      states[6] = false;
      entries[7] = entries[7] + entries[7];
      states[7] = false;
      entries[8] = entries[8] + entries[8];
      states[8] = false;
    } 
    if (hmiVersion.compareTo(INTUVIA_MIN_SW_JAPANESE_LANGUAGE) <= 0) {
      entries[9] = entries[9] + entries[9];
      states[9] = false;
    } 
    setDisplayLanguageEntries(entries, states);
    this.comboBox.addItemListener(this.itemListener);
  }
  
  private void validateBui3xxContent() {
    this.comboBox.removeItemListener(this.itemListener);
    String[] entries = new String[this.supportedlanguages.size() - 1];
    boolean[] states = new boolean[entries.length];
    for (int i = 0; i < entries.length; i++) {
      entries[i] = this.supportedlanguages.get(i);
      states[i] = true;
    } 
    setDisplayLanguageEntries(entries, states);
    this.comboBox.addItemListener(this.itemListener);
  }
  
  private void setDisplayLanguageEntries(String[] entries, boolean[] states) {
    int selectedIndex = this.comboBox.getSelectedIndex();
    this.comboBox.setModel(new DisabledComboBoxModel(entries, states));
    if (selectedIndex >= 0 && entries[selectedIndex].contains(BUNDLE.getString("EBikeConfigurationTab.displayLanguage.updateMessage")))
      selectedIndex = 0; 
    this.comboBox.setSelectedIndex(selectedIndex);
  }
  
  private void validateState() {
    setEnabled((isIbdWithBuiConnected() || isAdminWithContainerOrBuiConnected()));
  }
  
  private void validateVisibility() {
    boolean visible = false;
    ComponentType hmiType = this.configurationManager.getBikeIdentification().getHmiIdentification().getComponentType();
    if (hmiType == ComponentType.NONE) {
      visible = (!this.configurationManager.isContainerLoaded() || isBuiLanguageSettingSupportedByContainer());
    } else if (hmiType.isBUI25x() || hmiType.isBUI35x()) {
      visible = true;
    } else if (hmiType.isBUI33x()) {
      visible = validateVisibilityForBui33x();
    } 
    setVisible(visible);
    LOGGER.debug("Set visibility of the Language Element in the Configuration Tab to '{}'", Boolean.valueOf(visible));
  }
  
  private boolean validateVisibilityForBui33x() {
    Version swVersion = this.rightsManager.isUserInLevel(UserLevel.OEM) ? hmiUpdateVersion(ComponentType.COMP_BUI330) : 
      versionFromStringOrZeroVersion(this.configurationManager.getBikeIdentification().getHmiIdentification().getSwVersion());
    return (swVersion.compareTo(KIOX_SUPPORT_MIN_VERSION) >= 0);
  }
  
  private boolean isBuiLanguageSettingSupportedByContainer() {
    return (containerHasFirmwareForComponent(ComponentType.COMP_BUI250) || 
      containerHasFirmwareForComponent(ComponentType.COMP_BUI350) || 
      getFirmwareVersionFromContainer(ComponentType.COMP_BUI330).compareTo(KIOX_SUPPORT_MIN_VERSION) >= 0);
  }
  
  public boolean isValid() {
    ComponentType hmiType = this.configurationManager.getBikeIdentification().getHmiIdentification().getComponentType();
    if (hmiType == ComponentType.NONE)
      return (this.valid || !isBuiLanguageSettingSupportedByContainer()); 
    if (hmiType.isBUI25x() || 
      hmiType.isBUI35x() || (
      hmiType.isBUI33x() && validateVisibilityForBui33x()))
      return this.valid; 
    return true;
  }
  
  public String getDisplayTextForValue(String value) {
    return value;
  }
}

package com.gigatronik.beds.gui.configtab.bike.elements;

import com.gigatronik.beds.service.configuration.ConfigurationKey;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.configuration.ConfigurationManager;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.rightsmanager.api.RightsManager;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.rightsmanager.api.UserLevel;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.framework.util.Version;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.common.configuration.ComponentType;
import java.awt.event.ItemEvent;
import javax.swing.DefaultComboBoxModel;
import javax.swing.JComboBox;
import org.slf4j.Logger;
import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;

public class DistanceUnitElementController extends AbstractComboBoxElementController {
  private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(DistanceUnitElementController.class);
  
  private static final Version KIOX_SUPPORT_MIN_VERSION = new Version(new Integer[] { 1, 2, 0, 1 });
  
  private static final DefaultComboBoxModel<AbstractComboBoxElementController.ComboBoxItem> MODEL = new DefaultComboBoxModel<>(new AbstractComboBoxElementController.ComboBoxItem[] { AbstractComboBoxElementController.ComboBoxItem.UNIT_KILOMETER, AbstractComboBoxElementController.ComboBoxItem.UNIT_MILES });
  
  private final JComboBox<AbstractComboBoxElementController.ComboBoxItem> comboBox;
  
  public DistanceUnitElementController(ComboBoxElement configurationElement, ConfigurationManager configurationManager, RightsManager rightsManager) {
    super(configurationElement, configurationManager, rightsManager, ConfigurationKey.DISPLAY_UNITS_OF_CYCLE_COMPUTER_INDEX);
    this.comboBox = (JComboBox<AbstractComboBoxElementController.ComboBoxItem>)configurationElement.getControlledComponent();
    init();
  }
  
  private void init() {
    this.comboBox.setModel(MODEL);
    this.comboBox.addItemListener(event -> {
          if (event.getStateChange() == 1) {
            LOGGER.debug("Distance unit changed to '{}'", event.getItem());
            validateValue();
            this.configurationManager.setConfigurationValue(ConfigurationKey.DISPLAY_UNITS_OF_CYCLE_COMPUTER_INDEX, Integer.valueOf(getSelectedIndex()));
            this.configurationManager.setConfigurationValue(ConfigurationKey.DISPLAY_UNITS_OF_CYCLE_COMPUTER_VALUE, getValue());
          } 
        });
  }
  
  public void setSelectedIndex(Integer index) {
    super.setSelectedIndex(index);
    this.configurationManager.setConfigurationValue(ConfigurationKey.DISPLAY_UNITS_OF_CYCLE_COMPUTER_INDEX, Integer.valueOf(getSelectedIndex()));
    this.configurationManager.setConfigurationValue(ConfigurationKey.DISPLAY_UNITS_OF_CYCLE_COMPUTER_VALUE, getValue());
  }
  
  void validateState() {
    setEnabled((isIbdWithBuiConnected() || isAdminWithContainerOrBuiConnected()));
  }
  
  void validateVisibility() {
    ComponentType hmiType = this.configurationManager.getBikeIdentification().getHmiIdentification().getComponentType();
    if (hmiType == ComponentType.NONE) {
      setVisible((!this.configurationManager.isContainerLoaded() || isDistanceUnitSupportedByContainer()));
    } else if (hmiType.isBUI21x() || hmiType.isBUI25x() || hmiType.isBUI35x()) {
      setVisible(true);
    } else if (hmiType.isBUI33x()) {
      setVisible(validateVisibilityForBui33x());
    } else {
      setVisible(false);
    } 
  }
  
  private boolean validateVisibilityForBui33x() {
    Version swVersion = this.rightsManager.isUserInLevel(UserLevel.OEM) ? hmiUpdateVersion(ComponentType.COMP_BUI330) : 
      versionFromStringOrZeroVersion(this.configurationManager.getBikeIdentification().getHmiIdentification().getSwVersion());
    return (swVersion.compareTo(KIOX_SUPPORT_MIN_VERSION) >= 0);
  }
  
  private boolean isDistanceUnitSupportedByContainer() {
    return (containerHasFirmwareForComponent(ComponentType.COMP_BUI210) || 
      containerHasFirmwareForComponent(ComponentType.COMP_BUI215) || 
      containerHasFirmwareForComponent(ComponentType.COMP_BUI250) || 
      containerHasFirmwareForComponent(ComponentType.COMP_BUI350) || 
      getFirmwareVersionFromContainer(ComponentType.COMP_BUI330).compareTo(KIOX_SUPPORT_MIN_VERSION) >= 0);
  }
  
  public void setValue(String value) {
    super.setValue(value);
    this.configurationManager.setConfigurationValue(ConfigurationKey.DISPLAY_UNITS_OF_CYCLE_COMPUTER_INDEX, Integer.valueOf(getSelectedIndex()));
    this.configurationManager.setConfigurationValue(ConfigurationKey.DISPLAY_UNITS_OF_CYCLE_COMPUTER_VALUE, getValue());
  }
  
  public boolean isValid() {
    ComponentType hmiType = this.configurationManager.getBikeIdentification().getHmiIdentification().getComponentType();
    if (hmiType == ComponentType.NONE)
      return (this.valid || !isDistanceUnitSupportedByContainer()); 
    if (hmiType.isBUI21x() || 
      hmiType.isBUI25x() || 
      hmiType.isBUI35x() || (
      hmiType.isBUI33x() && validateVisibilityForBui33x()))
      return this.valid; 
    return true;
  }
}

package com.gigatronik.beds.gui.configtab.bike.elements;

import com.gigatronik.beds.gui.customcomponents.api.NumericTextField;
import com.gigatronik.beds.gui.customcomponents.impl.CustomComponentsFactory;
import javax.swing.JTextField;

public class GearRatioElement extends AbstractConfigurationElement {
  private static final long serialVersionUID = 1L;
  
  public enum Type {
    MIN, MAX;
  }
  
  public enum Range {
    GEN1, GEN2, GEN3_GEN4;
  }
  
  private double[] rangeGen1 = new double[2];
  
  private double[] rangeGen2 = new double[2];
  
  private double[] rangeGen3 = new double[2];
  
  private final Type type;
  
  private Range range;
  
  public GearRatioElement(Type type) {
    this.type = type;
    init();
  }
  
  private void init() {
    switch (this.type) {
      case MIN:
        initializeMinGearRatioElement();
        break;
      case MAX:
        initializeMaxGearRatioElement();
        break;
    } 
  }
  
  private void initializeMinGearRatioElement() {
    setLabel(BUNDLE.getString("EBikeConfigurationTab.lblLowestGearRatio.text"));
    setName("pnlMinGearRatio");
    NumericTextField numericTextField = CustomComponentsFactory.createNumericTextField("txtMinGearRatio", null, false, true, true);
    numericTextField.setDecimal(2);
    setControlledComponent((JTextField)numericTextField, "txtMinGearRatio");
    this.rangeGen1 = new double[] { 0.1D, 3.0D };
    this.rangeGen2 = new double[] { 0.1D, 1.5D };
    this.rangeGen3 = new double[] { 0.1D, 3.5D };
  }
  
  private void initializeMaxGearRatioElement() {
    setLabel(BUNDLE.getString("EBikeConfigurationTab.lblHighestGearRatio.text"));
    setName("pnlMaxGearRatio");
    NumericTextField numericTextField = CustomComponentsFactory.createNumericTextField("txtMaxGearRatio", null, false, true, true);
    numericTextField.setDecimal(2);
    setControlledComponent((JTextField)numericTextField, "txtMaxGearRatio");
    this.rangeGen1 = new double[] { 2.0D, 6.0D };
    this.rangeGen2 = new double[] { 0.8D, 4.0D };
    this.rangeGen3 = new double[] { 1.5D, 10.0D };
  }
  
  public Type getType() {
    return this.type;
  }
  
  public void setRange(Range range) {
    if (this.range != range) {
      this.range = range;
      switch (range) {
        case GEN1:
          setRange(this.rangeGen1[0], this.rangeGen1[1]);
          break;
        case GEN2:
          setRange(this.rangeGen2[0], this.rangeGen2[1]);
          break;
        case GEN3_GEN4:
          setRange(this.rangeGen3[0], this.rangeGen3[1]);
          break;
      } 
    } 
  }
  
  private void setRange(double min, double max) {
    NumericTextField numericTextField = (NumericTextField)getControlledComponent();
    numericTextField.setRange(min, max);
    setUnit(String.format("(%.2f - %.2f)", min, max));
  }
  
  public void paintBorder(boolean valid) {}
}

ITEM 53: com/gigatronik/beds/gui/configtab/bike/elements/GearRatioElementController.java

package com.gigatronik.beds.gui.configtab.bike.elements;

import com.gigatronik.beds.gui.customcomponents.api.NumericTextField;
import com.gigatronik.beds.gui.customcomponents.api.TextField;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.configuration.ConfigurationKey;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.configuration.ConfigurationManager;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.rightsmanager.api.RightsManager;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.common.configuration.ComponentType;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.common.configuration.ProductLine;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.common.util.ConverterUtils;
import org.apache.commons.lang3.StringUtils;
import org.slf4j.Logger;
import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;

public class GearRatioElementController extends AbstractConfigurationElementController implements TextField.TextFieldListener {
  private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(GearRatioElementController.class);
  
  private final GearRatioElement element;
  
  private final NumericTextField numericTextField;
  
  private String value;
  
  private boolean validStateFromTextfield;
  
  public GearRatioElementController(GearRatioElement configurationElement, ConfigurationManager configurationManager, RightsManager rightsManager) {
    super(configurationElement, configurationManager, rightsManager);
    this.element = configurationElement;
    this.numericTextField = (NumericTextField)this.element.getControlledComponent();
    init();
  }
  
  private void init() {
    setVisible(true);
    this.numericTextField.setListener(this);
    this.element.setRange(GearRatioElement.Range.GEN3_GEN4);
    setValue(null);
  }
  
  public void validateValue() {
    setValid(this.validStateFromTextfield);
  }
  
  public void validateSettings() {
    setEnabled(isAdminWithContainerOrBike());
    adjustRange();
  }
  
  private void adjustRange() {
    if (this.configurationManager.isContainerLoaded()) {
      adjustRangeByContainer();
    } else {
      adjustRangeByBike();
    } 
  }
  
  private void adjustRangeByBike() {
    ComponentType componentType = this.configurationManager.getBikeIdentification().getDuIdentification().getComponentType();
    if (componentType.isBDU3xx() || componentType.isBDU4xx()) {
      this.element.setRange(GearRatioElement.Range.GEN3_GEN4);
    } else if (componentType.isBDU2xx()) {
      this.element.setRange(GearRatioElement.Range.GEN2);
    } else if (componentType.isBDU1xx()) {
      this.element.setRange(GearRatioElement.Range.GEN1);
    } else {
      this.element.setRange(GearRatioElement.Range.GEN3_GEN4);
    } 
  }
  
  private void adjustRangeByContainer() {
    ProductLine productLine = this.configurationManager.getContainerConfiguration().getProductLine();
    if (productLine.isGen3() || productLine.isGen4()) {
      this.element.setRange(GearRatioElement.Range.GEN3_GEN4);
    } else if (productLine.isGen2()) {
      this.element.setRange(GearRatioElement.Range.GEN2);
    } else if (productLine.isGen1()) {
      this.element.setRange(GearRatioElement.Range.GEN1);
    } 
  }
  
  public void setValue(String value) {
    if (ConverterUtils.isDouble(value)) {
      this.numericTextField.setText(value);
    } else {
      this.numericTextField.setText("");
    } 
  }
  
  public String getValue() {
    return this.value;
  }
  
  public void onValidationStateChanged(String componentName, boolean isValid, String value) {
    if (StringUtils.equals(componentName, "txtMinGearRatio") || StringUtils.equals(componentName, "txtMaxGearRatio")) {
      this.validStateFromTextfield = isValid;
      setValid(this.validStateFromTextfield);
      onValueChanged(componentName, value);
    } 
  }
  
  public void onValueChanged(String componentName, String newText) {
    if (StringUtils.isEmpty(newText)) {
      this.value = null;
    } else {
      this.value = String.format("%.2f", Double.parseDouble(newText));
    } 
    switch (componentName) {
      case "txtMinGearRatio":
        LOGGER.debug("Gear ratio '{}' changed to '{}'", ConfigurationKey.MIN_GEAR_RATIO, this.value);
        this.configurationManager.setConfigurationValue(ConfigurationKey.MIN_GEAR_RATIO, this.value);
        break;
      case "txtMaxGearRatio":
        LOGGER.debug("Gear ratio '{}' changed to '{}'", ConfigurationKey.MAX_GEAR_RATIO, this.value);
        this.configurationManager.setConfigurationValue(ConfigurationKey.MAX_GEAR_RATIO, this.value);
        break;
    } 
  }
  
  public void clearValue() {
    setValue(null);
  }
  
  public String getDisplayTextForValue(String value) {
    return value;
  }
}

package com.gigatronik.beds.gui.configtab.bike.elements;

import com.gigatronik.beds.service.configuration.ConfigurationKey;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.configuration.ConfigurationManager;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.ecu.api.Du;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.rightsmanager.api.RightsManager;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.common.configuration.ComplexResponse;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.common.configuration.ProductLine;

import java.awt.event.ItemEvent;
import javax.swing.DefaultComboBoxModel;

import org.apache.commons.lang3.StringUtils;
import org.slf4j.Logger;

public class HighPowerPortElementController extends AbstractComboBoxElementController {
  private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(HighPowerPortElementController.class);
  
  private static final DefaultComboBoxModel MODEL = new DefaultComboBoxModel<>(new AbstractComboBoxElementController.ComboBoxItem[] { AbstractComboBoxElementController.ComboBoxItem.HIGH_POWER_PORT_ENABLED, AbstractComboBoxElementController.ComboBoxItem.HIGH_POWER_PORT_DISABLED });
  
  private final ComboBoxElement element;
  
  private final JComboBox comboBox;
  
  private final Du du;
  
  public HighPowerPortElementController(ComboBoxElement configurationElement, ConfigurationManager configurationManager, RightsManager rightsManager, CommunicationManager communicationManager) {
    super(configurationElement, configurationManager, rightsManager, ConfigurationKey.HIGH_POWER_PORT);
    this.element = configurationElement;
    this.comboBox = (JComboBox)this.element.getControlledComponent();
    this.du = communicationManager.getDuCom();
    init();
  }
  
  private void init() {
    this.comboBox.setModel(MODEL);
    this.comboBox.addItemListener(event -> {
          if (event.getStateChange() == 1) {
            LOGGER.debug("High power port mode changed to '{}'", event.getItem());
            validateValue();
            this.configurationManager.setConfigurationValue(ConfigurationKey.HIGH_POWER_PORT, getValue());
          } 
        });
  }
  
  public void setSelectedIndex(Integer index) {
    super.setSelectedIndex(index);
    this.configurationManager.setConfigurationValue(ConfigurationKey.HIGH_POWER_PORT, getValue());
  }
  
  void validateState() {
    setEnabled((isIbdWithBikeConnected() || isAdminWithContainerOrBike()));
  }
  
  void validateVisibility() {
    setVisible(isSupportedByBikeOrContainer());
  }
  
  public void onContainerProductLineChange(ProductLine productLine) {
    if (getValue() != null && !productLine.isGen4())
      setValue(null); 
  }
  
  public boolean verifySelectedValue() {
    if (isSupportedByBikeOrContainer() && StringUtils.equals(getValue(), "FALSE")) {
      if (this.configurationManager.isContainerLoaded())
        return verifySelectedValueByContainer(); 
      if (this.configurationManager.getBikeIdentification().getDuIdentification().isApplication())
        return verifySelectedValueByBike(); 
    } 
    return true;
  }
  
  private boolean isSupportedByBikeOrContainer() {
    return (this.configurationManager.getContainerConfiguration().getProductLine().isGen4() || 
      this.configurationManager.getBikeIdentification().getDuIdentification().getComponentType().isBDU4xx());
  }
  
  private boolean verifySelectedValueByContainer() {
    String absId = this.configurationManager.getConfigurationValue(ConfigurationKey.ABS_PARAMETER_ID);
    return showMismatchConfirmationDialogByAbsConfiguration(absId);
  }
  
  private boolean verifySelectedValueByBike() {
    ComplexResponse response = this.du.readAbsVariantCodeWithChecksum();
    try {
      String absId = response.getParameterByName("AbsVariantCode").getValue();
      return showMismatchConfirmationDialogByAbsConfiguration(absId);
    } catch (ComplexResponse.DataAccessException ex) {
      LOGGER.error("Failed to read and parse abs configuration from drive unit", (Throwable)ex);
      return showMismatchConfirmationDialogByAbsConfiguration("0x01");
    } 
  }
  
  private boolean showMismatchConfirmationDialogByAbsConfiguration(String absId) {
    int id;
    try {
      id = integerIdFromStringId(absId);
    } catch (NumberFormatException ex) {
      LOGGER.error("Error parsing string ID {} to integer ID.", absId, ex);
      id = 0;
    } 
    if (id != 0) {
      String title = BUNDLE.getString("Bosch.diagnostic.tool");
      String message = BUNDLE.getString("EBikeConfigurationTab.HighPowerPort.warning");
      return (TestableJOptionPane.showConfirmDialog(message, title, 2, 2) == 0);
    } 
    return true;
  }
  
  private int integerIdFromStringId(String id) {
    if (StringUtils.startsWithIgnoreCase(id, "0x"))
      return Integer.parseInt(id.replace("0x", ""), 16); 
    return Integer.parseInt(id);
  }
}

package com.gigatronik.beds.gui.configtab.bike.elements;

import com.gigatronik.beds.gui.customcomponents.AbstractCustomComponentListener;
import com.gigatronik.beds.gui.customcomponents.CustomTextField;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.configuration.ConfigurationKey;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.configuration.ConfigurationManager;

import org.apache.commons.lang3.StringUtils;
import org.slf4j.Logger;
import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;

public class InfoTextElementController extends AbstractConfigurationElementController {
  private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(InfoTextElementController.class);
  
  private static final int MAX_CHAR = 30;
  
  private final TextFieldElement element;
  
  private final CustomTextField txtKey;
  
  public InfoTextElementController(TextFieldElement configurationElement, ConfigurationManager configurationManager, RightsManager rightsManager) {
    super(configurationElement, configurationManager, rightsManager);
    this.element = configurationElement;
    this.txtKey = (CustomTextField)this.element.getControlledComponent();
    init();
  }
  
  private void init() {
    this.txtKey.setMaxInputLength(30);
    this.txtKey.setInvalidChars(new char[] { ',', ';' });
    this.txtKey.setNonPrintablesRegex("\\p{C}");
    this.txtKey.setEmptyAllowed(true);
    this.txtKey.setListener(new AbstractCustomComponentListener() {
          public boolean onFocusLost() {
            return true;
          }
          
          public void onValueChanged(Object value) {
            InfoTextElementController.LOGGER.debug("Info text value changed to '{}'", InfoTextElementController.this.getValue());
            InfoTextElementController.this.configurationManager.setConfigurationValue(ConfigurationKey.INFO_TEXT, InfoTextElementController.this.getValue());
          }
          
          public void onVerificationChanged(boolean textValid) {
            InfoTextElementController.this.setValid(textValid);
          }
        });
  }
  
  public void setValue(String value) {
    if (!StringUtils.equals(value, getValue())) {
      this.txtKey.setText((value == null) ? "" : value);
      validateValue();
    } 
  }
  
  public String getValue() {
    return this.txtKey.getText();
  }
  
  public void validateValue() {
    setValid(this.txtKey.verifyTextInput(false));
  }
  
  public void validateSettings() {
    validateState();
    validateVisibility();
  }
  
  private void validateVisibility() {
    setVisible((this.rightsManager.getUserLevel() == UserLevel.OEM));
  }
  
  private void validateState() {
    setEnabled((isOemWithContainerOrBike() && enabledInSettings()));
  }
  
  private boolean enabledInSettings() {
    try {
      return SettingsProxy.getInstance().getGlobalSettings().getBoolean("configurationtab_configuration_comment_visible");
    } catch (ConfigurationNotFoundException ex) {
      LOGGER.warn("Failed to read configuration comment setting from configuration.", ex.getMessage());
      return false;
    } 
  }
  
  public void clearValue() {
    setValue(null);
  }
  
  public String getDisplayTextForValue(String value) {
    return value;
  }
}

package com.gigatronik.beds.gui.configtab.bike.elements;

import com.gigatronik.beds.service.configuration.ConfigurationKey;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.configuration.ConfigurationManager;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.rightsmanager.api.Mode;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.rightsmanager.api.RightsManager;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.rightsmanager.api.UserLevel;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.framework.util.Version;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.common.configuration.ComponentType;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.common.configuration.DuIdentification;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.common.configuration.ProductLine;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.gui.EBikeApplication;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.gui.testinterface.TestableJOptionPane;
import java.awt.EventQueue;
import java.awt.event.ItemEvent;
import javax.swing.DefaultComboBoxModel;
import javax.swing.JComboBox;
import org.apache.commons.lang3.StringUtils;
import org.slf4j.Logger;
import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;

public class LightOutputElementController extends AbstractComboBoxElementController {
  private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(LightOutputElementController.class);
  
  private static final String DU_MIN_HW_LIGHTOUTPUT = "0.0.6.0";
  
  private static final Version DU_MIN_SW_LIGHTOUTPUT = new Version(new Integer[] { 1, 5, 1, 0 });
  
  private static final DefaultComboBoxModel<AbstractComboBoxElementController.ComboBoxItem> MODEL = new DefaultComboBoxModel<>(new AbstractComboBoxElementController.ComboBoxItem[] { AbstractComboBoxElementController.ComboBoxItem.LIGHT_OUTPUT_6V, AbstractComboBoxElementController.ComboBoxItem.LIGHT_OUTPUT_12V });
  
  private final EBikeApplication eBikeApplication;
  
  private final JComboBox<AbstractComboBoxElementController.ComboBoxItem> comboBox;
  
  private boolean evaluateWarning = true;
  
  private static final String TOOLTIP_DEFAULT = BUNDLE.getString("EBikeConfigurationTab.LightOutput.tooltip");
  
  private static final String TOOLTIP_NOT_SUPPORTED = BUNDLE.getString("EBikeConfigurationTab.LightOutput.notSupported");
  
  public LightOutputElementController(ComboBoxElement configurationElement, ConfigurationManager configurationManager, RightsManager rightsManager, EBikeApplication ebikeApp) {
    super(configurationElement, configurationManager, rightsManager, ConfigurationKey.LIGHT_OUTPUT);
    this.comboBox = (JComboBox<AbstractComboBoxElementController.ComboBoxItem>)configurationElement.getControlledComponent();
    this.eBikeApplication = ebikeApp;
    init();
  }
  
  private void init() {
    this.comboBox.setModel(MODEL);
    this.comboBox.addItemListener(event -> {
          if (event.getStateChange() == 1) {
            LOGGER.debug("Light output value changed to '{}'", event.getItem());
            validateValue();
            this.configurationManager.setConfigurationValue(ConfigurationKey.LIGHT_OUTPUT, getValue());
            if (this.evaluateWarning) {
              evaluateLightOutputChangeWarning();
            } else if (this.rightsManager.isModeActive(Mode.OEM_WORKER)) {
              evaluateLightOutputWarningOemWorker();
            } 
          } 
        });
  }
  
  public void setValue(String value) {
    if (!is12vByContainer()) {
      this.evaluateWarning = false;
      super.setValue(value);
      if (value == null)
        validateContent(); 
      this.evaluateWarning = true;
    } 
  }
  
  public void validateSettings() {
    super.validateSettings();
    validateValue();
  }
  
  public void validateValue() {
    boolean valid = (this.comboBox.getSelectedIndex() >= 0);
    if (valid) {
      ProductLine productLine = getSelectedProductLine();
      if (productLine.isGen2()) {
        valid = validateValueAgainstSwVersion();
        if (valid && this.configurationManager.getBikeIdentification().isDuConnected())
          valid = validateValueAgainstHwVersion(); 
      } 
    } 
    setValid(valid);
  }
  
  private boolean validateValueAgainstSwVersion() {
    Version duSwVersion = getDuUpdateVersion();
    if (duSwVersion.compareTo(DU_MIN_SW_LIGHTOUTPUT) <= 0 && this.comboBox.getSelectedItem() == AbstractComboBoxElementController.ComboBoxItem.LIGHT_OUTPUT_12V) {
      this.comboBox.setToolTipText(TOOLTIP_NOT_SUPPORTED);
      return false;
    } 
    this.comboBox.setToolTipText(TOOLTIP_DEFAULT);
    return true;
  }
  
  private boolean validateValueAgainstHwVersion() {
    String duHwVersion = this.configurationManager.getBikeIdentification().getDuIdentification().getHwVersion();
    if (duHwVersion.compareTo("0.0.6.0") < 0 && this.comboBox.getSelectedItem() == AbstractComboBoxElementController.ComboBoxItem.LIGHT_OUTPUT_12V) {
      this.comboBox.setToolTipText(TOOLTIP_NOT_SUPPORTED);
      return false;
    } 
    this.comboBox.setToolTipText(TOOLTIP_DEFAULT);
    return true;
  }
  
  void validateContent() {
    ProductLine productLine = getSelectedProductLine();
    if (is12VByProductLine(productLine))
      this.comboBox.setSelectedItem(AbstractComboBoxElementController.ComboBoxItem.LIGHT_OUTPUT_12V); 
    if (this.rightsManager.isUserInLevel(UserLevel.IBD) && productLine.isGen2() && this.comboBox.getSelectedIndex() < 0 && this.configurationManager.isBikeConnected()) {
      String duHwVersion = this.configurationManager.getBikeIdentification().getDuIdentification().getHwVersion();
      Version duSwVersion = getDuUpdateVersion();
      if (duHwVersion.compareTo("0.0.6.0") < 0 || duSwVersion.compareTo(DU_MIN_SW_LIGHTOUTPUT) <= 0)
        this.comboBox.setSelectedItem(AbstractComboBoxElementController.ComboBoxItem.LIGHT_OUTPUT_6V); 
    } 
  }
  
  void validateVisibility() {
    setVisible(!getSelectedProductLine().isGen1());
  }
  
  void validateState() {
    if (this.rightsManager.isModeActive(Mode.OEM_WORKER)) {
      setEnabled(false);
    } else if (is12vByContainer() || is12vByBike()) {
      setEnabled(false);
    } else if (this.rightsManager.isUserInLevel(UserLevel.IBD)) {
      setEnabled(isIbdWithBikeGen2EditableLightOutput());
    } else {
      setEnabled(isAdminWithContainerOrBike());
    } 
  }
  
  private boolean isIbdWithBikeGen2EditableLightOutput() {
    DuIdentification duIdentification = this.configurationManager.getBikeIdentification().getDuIdentification();
    Version duSwVersion = getDuUpdateVersion();
    if (this.configurationManager.isContainerCompatibleWithBike() && duIdentification.isApplication() && duIdentification.getComponentType().isBDU2xx()) {
      String duHwVersion = duIdentification.getHwVersion();
      return (duHwVersion.compareTo("0.0.6.0") >= 0 && duSwVersion.compareTo(DU_MIN_SW_LIGHTOUTPUT) > 0);
    } 
    return false;
  }
  
  private void evaluateLightOutputChangeWarning() {
    if (this.configurationManager.getConfigurationFileName() == null && is12vByContainer())
      return; 
    if (this.rightsManager.isUserInLevel(UserLevel.IBD)) {
      evaluateLightOutputWarningIbd();
    } else if (this.rightsManager.isUserInLevel(UserLevel.OEM)) {
      if (this.rightsManager.isModeActive(Mode.OEM_ADMIN)) {
        evaluateLightOutputWarningOemAdmin();
      } else {
        evaluateLightOutputWarningOemWorker();
      } 
    } 
  }
  
  private void evaluateLightOutputWarningIbd() {
    if (!is12vByBike() && this.comboBox.getSelectedItem() == AbstractComboBoxElementController.ComboBoxItem.LIGHT_OUTPUT_12V)
      EventQueue.invokeLater(() -> TestableJOptionPane.showMessageDialog(BUNDLE.getString("EBikeConfigurationTab.LightOutput.warning.message"), 
            BUNDLE.getString("EBikeConfigurationTab.LightOutput.warning.title"), 2)); 
  }
  
  private void evaluateLightOutputWarningOemAdmin() {
    if (this.comboBox.getSelectedItem() != null && getSelectedProductLine().isGen2())
      EventQueue.invokeLater(() -> TestableJOptionPane.showMessageDialog(String.format(BUNDLE.getString("EBikeConfigurationTab.LightOutput.warning.message.OEM"), String.valueOf(this.comboBox.getSelectedItem())), 
            BUNDLE.getString("EBikeConfigurationTab.LightOutput.warning.title.OEM"), 2)); 
  }
  
  public void evaluateLightOutputWarningOemWorker() {
    if (this.configurationManager.getConfigurationFileName() != null && this.comboBox.getSelectedItem() == AbstractComboBoxElementController.ComboBoxItem.LIGHT_OUTPUT_12V)
      this.eBikeApplication.showStatusWarning(BUNDLE.getString("EBikeConfigurationTab.LightOutput.warning.message"), 10); 
  }
  
  public boolean isLightOutputOemWorkerInvalid() {
    String duHwVersion = this.configurationManager.getBikeIdentification().getDuIdentification().getHwVersion();
    ComponentType duType = this.configurationManager.getBikeIdentification().getDuIdentification().getComponentType();
    boolean hwConstraint = (duType.isBDU1xx() || (duType.isBDU2xx() && duHwVersion.compareTo("0.0.6.0") < 0));
    String lightOutPutFromConfig = this.configurationManager.getConfigurationValue(ConfigurationKey.LIGHT_OUTPUT);
    boolean output12V = StringUtils.equals(lightOutPutFromConfig, AbstractComboBoxElementController.ComboBoxItem.LIGHT_OUTPUT_12V.getValue());
    return (hwConstraint && output12V && this.rightsManager.isModeActive(Mode.OEM_WORKER));
  }
  
  public void setValid(boolean valid) {
    super.setValid(valid);
    if (!valid && this.configurationManager.getBikeIdentification().getDuIdentification().isApplication() && this.comboBox.getSelectedItem() != null)
      getConfigurationElement().paintBorder(false); 
  }
  
  public boolean isValid() {
    validateValue();
    return super.isValid();
  }
  
  public void onContainerProductLineChange(ProductLine oldProductLine, ProductLine newProductLine) {
    if (newProductLine.isGen2() && !oldProductLine.isGen2()) {
      setValue(null);
    } else if (is12VByProductLine(newProductLine)) {
      setValue("LIGHT_SUPPLY_VOLTAGE_12V");
    } else if (newProductLine.isGen1()) {
      clearValue();
    } 
  }
  
  public boolean isValueAllowed(String value) {
    return StringUtils.equalsAny(value, AbstractComboBoxElementController.ComboBoxItem.LIGHT_OUTPUT_6V.getValue(), AbstractComboBoxElementController.ComboBoxItem.LIGHT_OUTPUT_12V.getValue());
  }
  
  private boolean is12vByBike() {
    return is12VByProductLine(this.configurationManager.getBikeIdentification().getProductLine());
  }
  
  private boolean is12vByContainer() {
    return is12VByProductLine(this.configurationManager.getContainerConfiguration().getProductLine());
  }
  
  private boolean is12VByProductLine(ProductLine productLine) {
    return (productLine.isGen3() || productLine.isGen4());
  }
}

public class LightPowerElementController extends AbstractConfigurationElementController implements BikeConfigurationChangesListener, ContainerConfigurationChangesListener, HardwareConnectionChangesListener {
  private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(LightPowerElementController.class);
  
  private static final String FORMAT = "(%.1f - %.1f) W";
  
  private static final Version DU_GEN3_LOWERLIMIT_SW_LIGHTPOWER = new Version(new Integer[] { 1, 1, 0, 0 });
  
  private static final double MAX_LIGHT_POWER = 18.0D;
  
  private static final double MIN_LIGHT_POWER = 3.0D;
  
  private static final double DEACTIVATED_LIGHT_POWER = 0.0D;
  
  private static final String[] ACTIVE_LIGHT_SWITCH_OPTIONS = new String[] { "Bike light permanently on", "Bike light switchable" };
  
  private final LightPowerElement element;
  
  private final NumericTextField txt;
  
  private CustomPopup hintPopup;
  
  private Double value;
  
  private boolean lightSwitchingEnabled = true;
  
  private AWTEventListener popupMouseListener;
  
  public LightPowerElementController(LightPowerElement configurationElement, ConfigurationManager configurationManager, RightsManager rightsManager) {
    super(configurationElement, configurationManager, rightsManager);
    this.element = configurationElement;
    this.txt = (NumericTextField)this.element.getControlledComponent();
    init();
    configurationManager.addListener((OrderableListener)this);
  }
  
  private void init() {
    this.element.setUnit(String.format("(%.1f - %.1f) W", 3.0D, 18.0D));
    setVisible(false);
    this.txt.setRange(3.0D, 18.0D);
    this.txt.setDecimal(1);
    this.txt.setListener(new TextField.TextFieldListener() {
          public void onValidationStateChanged(String componentName, boolean valid, String text) {
            LightPowerElementController.this.setValid(valid);
            onValueChanged(componentName, text);
          }
          
          public void onValueChanged(String componentName, String text) {
            LightPowerElementController.this.value = ConverterUtils.isDouble(text) ? Double.parseDouble(text) : null;
            LightPowerElementController.LOGGER.debug("Light power changed to '{}'", text);
            LightPowerElementController.this.configurationManager.setConfigurationValue(ConfigurationKey.LIGHT_POWER, text);
          }
        });
    ((JComponent)this.txt).addFocusListener(new FocusListener() {
          public void focusGained(FocusEvent e) {
            LightPowerElementController.this.showHintPopup();
          }
          
          public void focusLost(FocusEvent e) {
            LightPowerElementController.this.closeHintPopup();
          }
        });
    clearValue();
  }
  
  public boolean isValid() {
    return (super.isValid() || !this.lightSwitchingEnabled);
  }
  
  public boolean isValidValue() {
    return super.isValid();
  }
  
  public void validateValue() {
    if (this.value != null) {
      setValid((this.value >= 3.0D && this.value <= 18.0D));
    } else {
      setValid(false);
    } 
  }
  
  public void validateSettings() {
    setEnabled(((isAdminWithContainerOrBike() || isIbdWithBikeConnected()) && this.lightSwitchingEnabled));
  }
  
  private void validateVisibility() {
    ProductLine productLine = getSelectedProductLine();
    Version duSwVersion = (this.rightsManager.getUserLevel() == UserLevel.OEM) ? getDuUpdateVersion() : getDuBikeVersion();
    setVisible(((productLine.isGen3() && DU_GEN3_LOWERLIMIT_SW_LIGHTPOWER.compareTo(duSwVersion) < 0) || productLine.isGen4()));
  }
  
  public void setValue(String v) {
    if (ConverterUtils.isDouble(v)) {
      setValue(Double.parseDouble(v));
    } else {
      clearValue();
    } 
  }
  
  public void clearValue() {
    this.value = null;
    this.txt.setText("");
    validateValue();
  }
  
  private void setValue(double d) {
    this.value = (double)Math.round(d * 10.0D) / 10.0D;
    this.txt.setText(String.format("%.1f", this.value));
    validateValue();
  }
  
  public String getValue() {
    return (this.value != null) ? String.format("%.1f", this.value) : null;
  }
  
  private void showHintPopup() {
    if (this.hintPopup == null) {
      this

        
        .hintPopup = new CustomPopup(this.controlledElement.getControlledComponent(), new Dimension(300, 70), new Point(this.controlledElement.getControlledComponent().getWidth() - 50, 0), BUNDLE.getString("LightPower.tooltip"), CustomPopup.Style.BUBBLE);
      this.hintPopup.setVisible(true);
      addHintPopupMouseListener();
    } 
  }
  
  private void closeHintPopup() {
    if (this.hintPopup != null) {
      this.hintPopup.dispose();
      this.hintPopup = null;
    } 
  }
  
  private void addHintPopupMouseListener() {
    if (this.popupMouseListener == null) {
      this.popupMouseListener = (event -> {
          if (event instanceof MouseEvent && event.getID() == 500)
            if (((MouseEvent)event).getComponent() == this.txt) {
              showHintPopup();
            } else {
              closeHintPopup();
            }  
        });
      Toolkit.getDefaultToolkit().addAWTEventListener(this.popupMouseListener, 16L);
    } 
  }
  
  private void onLightSwitchOptionChanged(BikeConfigurationChangedEvent.Action eventAction, String option) {
    this.lightSwitchingEnabled = StringUtils.startsWithAny(option, ACTIVE_LIGHT_SWITCH_OPTIONS);
    validateSettings();
    if (isVisible() && (eventAction == BikeConfigurationChangedEvent.Action.READ_FROM_FILE || eventAction == BikeConfigurationChangedEvent.Action.VALUE_CHANGED) && !this.lightSwitchingEnabled)
      setValue(0.0D); 
  }
  
  public void onBikeConfigurationChanged(BikeConfigurationChangedEvent event) {
    LOGGER.debug("BikeConfigurationChangedEvent received: '{}'", event);
    switch (event.getAction()) {
      case READ_FROM_BIKE:
      case READ_FROM_FILE:
        EventQueue.invokeLater(() -> onLightSwitchOptionChanged(event.getAction(), this.configurationManager.getConfigurationValue(ConfigurationKey.LIGHT_SWITCH_FUNCTION_VALUE)));
        EventQueue.invokeLater(this::validateVisibility);
        break;
      case VALUE_CHANGED:
        if (event.getKey() == ConfigurationKey.LIGHT_SWITCH_FUNCTION_VALUE)
          EventQueue.invokeLater(() -> onLightSwitchOptionChanged(event.getAction(), (String)event.getNewValue())); 
        break;
      case CLEAR:
        EventQueue.invokeLater(this::validateVisibility);
        break;
    } 
  }
  
  public void onHardwareConnectionChanged(HardwareConnectionChangedEvent event) {
    LOGGER.debug("HardwareConnectionChangedEvent received: '{}'", event);
    switch (event.getAction()) {
      case ECU_CONNECTED:
      case ECU_DISCONNECTED:
        if (event.getComponent().isDriveUnit())
          EventQueue.invokeLater(this::validateVisibility); 
        break;
    } 
  }
  
  public void onContainerConfigurationChanged(ContainerConfigurationChangedEvent event) {
    LOGGER.debug("ContainerConfigurationChangedEvent received: '{}'", event);
    switch (event.getAction()) {
      case LOADED:
      case UNLOADED:
      case CHANGED:
        EventQueue.invokeLater(this::validateVisibility);
        break;
    } 
  }
  
  public String getDisplayTextForValue(String value) {
    return value;
  }
}

ITEM 59: com/gigatronik/beds/gui/configtab/bike/elements/LightSwitchOptionElementController.java
