package com.gigatronik.beds.gui.configtab.bike.elements;

import com.gigatronik.beds.service.configuration.ConfigurationKey;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.configuration.ConfigurationManager;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.rightsmanager.api.RightsManager;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.framework.util.Version;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.common.configuration.ComponentType;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.common.configuration.ProductLine;
import java.awt.event.ItemEvent;
import java.awt.event.ItemListener;
import java.io.IOException;
import javax.swing.DefaultComboBoxModel;
import javax.swing.JComboBox;
import org.apache.commons.lang3.StringUtils;
import org.slf4j.Logger;
import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;

public class LightSwitchOptionElementController extends AbstractComboBoxElementController {
  private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(LightSwitchOptionElementController.class);
  
  private static final Version DU_MIN_SW_LIGHTSWITCH_ENABLED_CLASSIC_PLUS = new Version(new Integer[] { 2, 7, 0, 0 });
  
  private static final Version DU_MIN_SW_LIGHTSWITCH_PERMANENTLY_ON_BDU2 = new Version(new Integer[] { 1, 3, 0, 0 });
  
  private static final DefaultComboBoxModel MODEL_CLASSIC = new DefaultComboBoxModel<>(new AbstractComboBoxElementController.ComboBoxItem[] { AbstractComboBoxElementController.ComboBoxItem.LIGHT_SWITCH_OPTION_DISABLED, AbstractComboBoxElementController.ComboBoxItem.LIGHT_SWITCH_OPTION_ENABLED });
  
  private static final DefaultComboBoxModel MODEL_VICTOR = new DefaultComboBoxModel<>(new AbstractComboBoxElementController.ComboBoxItem[] { AbstractComboBoxElementController.ComboBoxItem.LIGHT_SWITCH_OPTION_DEACTIVATED, AbstractComboBoxElementController.ComboBoxItem.LIGHT_SWITCH_OPTION_SWITCHABLE, AbstractComboBoxElementController.ComboBoxItem.LIGHT_SWITCH_OPTION_PERMANENT_ON });
  
  private final JComboBox comboBox;
  
  private ItemListener itemListener;
  
  public LightSwitchOptionElementController(ComboBoxElement configurationElement, ConfigurationManager configurationManager, RightsManager rightsManager) {
    super(configurationElement, configurationManager, rightsManager, ConfigurationKey.LIGHT_SWITCH_FUNCTION_INDEX);
    this.comboBox = (JComboBox)configurationElement.getControlledComponent();
    init();
  }
  
  private void init() {
    this.itemListener = (event -> {
        if (event.getStateChange() == 1) {
          LOGGER.debug("Light switch option changed to '{}'", event.getItem());
          validateValue();
          this.configurationManager.setConfigurationValue(ConfigurationKey.LIGHT_SWITCH_FUNCTION_INDEX, Integer.valueOf(getSelectedIndex()));
          this.configurationManager.setConfigurationValue(ConfigurationKey.LIGHT_SWITCH_FUNCTION_VALUE, getValue());
        } 
      });
    this.comboBox.addItemListener(this.itemListener);
  }
  
  public void setValue(String value) {
    validateContent();
    super.setValue(value);
    this.configurationManager.setConfigurationValue(ConfigurationKey.LIGHT_SWITCH_FUNCTION_INDEX, Integer.valueOf(getSelectedIndex()));
    this.configurationManager.setConfigurationValue(ConfigurationKey.LIGHT_SWITCH_FUNCTION_VALUE, getValue());
  }
  
  public void setSelectedIndex(Integer index) {
    validateContent();
    super.setSelectedIndex(index);
    this.configurationManager.setConfigurationValue(ConfigurationKey.LIGHT_SWITCH_FUNCTION_INDEX, Integer.valueOf(getSelectedIndex()));
    this.configurationManager.setConfigurationValue(ConfigurationKey.LIGHT_SWITCH_FUNCTION_VALUE, getValue());
  }
  
  void validateContent() {
    ProductLine pl = getSelectedProductLine();
    if (pl == ProductLine.NONE)
      return; 
    this.comboBox.removeItemListener(this.itemListener);
    boolean gen2VersionMatch = (DU_MIN_SW_LIGHTSWITCH_PERMANENTLY_ON_BDU2.compareTo(getDuUpdateVersion()) < 0);
    boolean extendedSettings = (pl.isGen4() || pl.isGen3() || (pl.isGen2() && gen2VersionMatch));
    DefaultComboBoxModel model = extendedSettings ? MODEL_VICTOR : MODEL_CLASSIC;
    if (model.getSize() != this.comboBox.getItemCount()) {
      int newIndex = this.comboBox.getSelectedIndex();
      this.comboBox.setModel(model);
      if (newIndex < model.getSize()) {
        this.comboBox.setSelectedIndex(newIndex);
      } else {
        this.comboBox.setSelectedIndex(-1);
      } 
    } 
    this.comboBox.addItemListener(this.itemListener);
  }
  
  void validateState() {
    if (isIbdWithBikeConnected()) {
      ComponentType duType = this.configurationManager.getBikeIdentification().getDuIdentification().getComponentType();
      Version duSwVersion = getSwVersion(this.configurationManager.getBikeIdentification().getDuIdentification().getSwVersion());
      boolean isMinRequiredBDU1xxSwVersion = (DU_MIN_SW_LIGHTSWITCH_ENABLED_CLASSIC_PLUS.compareTo(duSwVersion) <= 0);
      if (duType.isBDU1xx() && isMinRequiredBDU1xxSwVersion) {
        setEnabled(true);
      } else {
        setEnabled(checkConfigurationRights(duSwVersion));
      } 
    } else {
      setEnabled(isAdminWithContainerOrBike());
    } 
  }
  
  private boolean checkConfigurationRights(Version duSwVersion) {
    boolean userRightsConstraints = false;
    boolean swVersionConstraints = (this.configurationManager.getBikeIdentification().getDuIdentification().getComponentType().isBDU2xx() && 
      DU_MIN_SW_LIGHTSWITCH_PERMANENTLY_ON_BDU2.compareTo(duSwVersion) > 0);
    String confRights = this.configurationManager.getBikeIdentification().getDuIdentification().getIbdConfigurationRights();
    if (!StringUtils.isBlank(confRights)) {
      int hexConfRights = Integer.parseInt(confRights, 16);
      String binaryString = Integer.toBinaryString(hexConfRights);
      userRightsConstraints = binaryString.endsWith("1");
    } 
    return (userRightsConstraints || swVersionConstraints);
  }
  
  private Version getSwVersion(String duVersionString) {
    Version duSwVersion = null;
    try {
      if (StringUtils.isNotBlank(duVersionString))
        duSwVersion = Version.parse(duVersionString); 
    } catch (IOException|NumberFormatException e) {
      LOGGER.error("Error parsing du version: {}", duVersionString);
    } 
    return duSwVersion;
  }
}

import com.github.lgooddatepicker.components.DatePicker;
import com.github.lgooddatepicker.zinternaltools.DateChangeEvent;
import java.awt.Color;
import java.time.LocalDate;
import java.time.ZoneId;
import java.time.format.DateTimeParseException;
import org.slf4j.Logger;
import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;

public class ManufactureDateElementController extends AbstractConfigurationElementController {
  private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(ManufactureDateElementController.class);
  
  private final ManufactureDateElement element;
  
  private final DatePicker txtDate;
  
  public ManufactureDateElementController(ManufactureDateElement configurationElement, ConfigurationManager configurationManager, RightsManager rightsManager) {
    super(configurationElement, configurationManager, rightsManager);
    this.element = configurationElement;
    this.txtDate = (DatePicker)this.element.getControlledComponent();
    init();
  }
  
  private void init() {
    TextPrompt prompt = new TextPrompt(BUNDLE.getString("EBikeConfigurationTab.TEXT_PROMPT"), this.txtDate.getComponentDateTextField(), TextPrompt.Show.FOCUS_LOST);
    prompt.setName("txtPrompt");
    prompt.setForeground(Color.GRAY);
    prompt.changeStyle(2);
    this.txtDate.addDateChangeListener(event -> {
          validateValue();
          String dateString = isValid() ? getDateString() : null;
          LOGGER.debug("Manufacture date changed to '{}'", dateString);
          this.configurationManager.setConfigurationValue(ConfigurationKey.DATE_OF_MANUFACTURE, dateString);
        });
  }
  
  public void setDate(LocalDate date) {
    this.txtDate.setDate(date);
    validateValue();
  }
  
  public LocalDate getDate() {
    return this.txtDate.getDate();
  }
  
  public String getDateString() {
    return (getDate() != null) ? I18NDateTimesFormats.formatDateToInternalToolFormat(getDate()) : null;
  }
  
  public void setDateString(String date) {
    try {
      setDate((date != null) ? I18NDateTimesFormats.getInternalDateFormat().parse(date).toInstant().atZone(ZoneId.systemDefault()).toLocalDate() : null);
    } catch (DateTimeParseException|java.text.ParseException e) {
      LOGGER.error("Invalid date string", (Throwable)e);
      setDate(null);
    } 
  }
  
  public void setDateToToday() {
    this.txtDate.setDateToToday();
    this.configurationManager.setConfigurationValue(ConfigurationKey.DATE_OF_MANUFACTURE, getDateString());
  }
  
  public void validateValue() {
    LocalDate date = getDate();
    int minYear = getSelectedProductLine().isGen1() ? 2000 : 2013;
    setValid((this.rightsManager.isUserInLevel(UserLevel.IBD) || (date != null && date.getYear() >= minYear && date.getYear() < 2100)));
  }
  
  public void validateSettings() {
    setEnabled(isAdminWithContainerOrBike());
  }
  
  public void clearValue() {
    setDate(null);
  }
  
  public String getDisplayTextForValue(String value) {
    return value;
  }
}

package com.gigatronik.beds.gui.configtab.bike.elements;

import com.gigatronik.beds.gui.customcomponents.AbstractCustomComponentListener;
import com.gigatronik.beds.gui.customcomponents.CustomTextField;
import com.gigatronik.beds.gui.customcomponents.api.NumericTextField;
import com.gigatronik.beds.gui.customcomponents.api.TextField;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.configuration.ConfigurationKey;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.configuration.ConfigurationManager;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.rightsmanager.api.RightsManager;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.framework.util.Version;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.common.configuration.ComponentType;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.common.configuration.ProductLine;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.common.util.ConverterUtils;
import javax.swing.JTextField;
import org.apache.commons.lang3.StringUtils;
import org.slf4j.Logger;
import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;

public class ManufactureLocationElementController extends AbstractConfigurationElementController {
  private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(ManufactureLocationElementController.class);
  
  private static final Version DU_MIN_SW_MANUFACTURELOCATION_TEXT = new Version(new Integer[] { 1, 4, 1, 0 });
  
  private static final int MAX_CHAR = 20;
  
  private final ManufactureLocationElement element;
  
  private final CustomTextField txtLocation;
  
  private final NumericTextField txtNumericLocation;
  
  public ManufactureLocationElementController(ManufactureLocationElement configurationElement, ConfigurationManager configurationManager, RightsManager rightsManager) {
    super(configurationElement, configurationManager, rightsManager);
    this.element = configurationElement;
    this.txtLocation = this.element.getTextField();
    this.txtNumericLocation = this.element.getNumericTextField();
    init();
  }
  
  private void init() {
    this.txtLocation.setMaxInputLength(20);
    this.txtLocation.setEmptyText(BUNDLE.getString("EBikeConfigurationTab.TEXT_PROMPT"));
    this.txtLocation.setListener(new AbstractCustomComponentListener() {
          public boolean onFocusLost() {
            return true;
          }
          
          public void onVerificationChanged(boolean textValid) {
            ManufactureLocationElementController.this.setValid(textValid);
          }
          
          public void onValueChanged(Object value) {
            ManufactureLocationElementController.LOGGER.debug("Manufacture location value changed to '{}'", ManufactureLocationElementController.this.getValue());
            ManufactureLocationElementController.this.configurationManager.setConfigurationValue(ConfigurationKey.PLACE_OF_MANUFACTURE, ManufactureLocationElementController.this.getValue());
          }
        });
    this.txtNumericLocation.setListener(new TextField.TextFieldListener() {
          public void onValidationStateChanged(String componentName, boolean isValid, String value) {
            ManufactureLocationElementController.this.setValid(isValid);
            onValueChanged(componentName, value);
          }
          
          public void onValueChanged(String componentName, String newText) {
            ManufactureLocationElementController.LOGGER.debug("Manufacture location value changed to '{}'", newText);
            ManufactureLocationElementController.this.configurationManager.setConfigurationValue(ConfigurationKey.PLACE_OF_MANUFACTURE, newText);
          }
        });
  }
  
  public void setValue(String value) {
    if (getConfigurationElement().getControlledComponent().equals(this.txtNumericLocation)) {
      this.txtNumericLocation.setText(ConverterUtils.isInteger(value) ? value : null);
    } else {
      this.txtLocation.setText((value != null) ? value : "");
    } 
    validateValue();
  }
  
  public String getValue() {
    String text;
    if (getConfigurationElement().getControlledComponent().equals(this.txtNumericLocation)) {
      text = ((JTextField)this.txtNumericLocation).getText();
    } else {
      text = this.txtLocation.getText();
    } 
    return StringUtils.isBlank(text) ? null : text;
  }
  
  public void validateValue() {
    boolean valid = false;
    if (getConfigurationElement().getControlledComponent().equals(this.txtNumericLocation)) {
      String text = ((JTextField)this.txtNumericLocation).getText();
      if (ConverterUtils.isInteger(text)) {
        int i = Integer.parseInt(text);
        valid = (i >= 0 && i <= 256);
      } 
    } else {
      valid = this.txtLocation.verifyTextInput(false);
    } 
    setValid(valid);
  }
  
  public void validateSettings() {
    validateType();
    validateState();
  }
  
  private void validateState() {
    setEnabled(isAdminWithContainerOrBike());
  }
  
  private void validateType() {
    boolean newTextFormat;
    Version duSwVersion = getDuUpdateVersion();
    ComponentType compType = this.configurationManager.getBikeIdentification().getDuIdentification().getComponentType();
    ProductLine productLine = this.configurationManager.getContainerConfiguration().getProductLine();
    if (duSwVersion.compareTo(new Version(new Integer[] { 0, 0, 0, 0 })) == 0) {
      newTextFormat = true;
    } else if (productLine != ProductLine.NONE) {
      newTextFormat = (productLine.isGen4() || productLine.isGen3() || (productLine.isGen2() && duSwVersion.compareTo(DU_MIN_SW_MANUFACTURELOCATION_TEXT) > 0));
      if (!newTextFormat)
        newTextFormat = (this.configurationManager.getContainerConfiguration().getContainerController().isCff3Loaded() && StringUtils.isBlank(this.configurationManager.getContainerConfiguration().getBikeModel())); 
    } else {
      newTextFormat = (compType == ComponentType.NONE || compType.isBDU4xx() || compType.isBDU3xx() || (compType.isBDU2xx() && duSwVersion.compareTo(DU_MIN_SW_MANUFACTURELOCATION_TEXT) > 0));
    } 
    if (newTextFormat) {
      if (getConfigurationElement().getControlledComponent().equals(this.txtNumericLocation)) {
        this.element.showTextField();
        setValue(this.configurationManager.getConfigurationValue(ConfigurationKey.PLACE_OF_MANUFACTURE));
      } 
    } else if (getConfigurationElement().getControlledComponent().equals(this.txtLocation)) {
      this.element.showSpinner();
      setValue(this.configurationManager.getConfigurationValue(ConfigurationKey.PLACE_OF_MANUFACTURE));
    } 
  }
  
  public void clearValue() {
    setValue(null);
  }
  
  public String getDisplayTextForValue(String value) {
    return value;
  }
}

import com.gigatronik.beds.service.configuration.ConfigurationKey;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.configuration.ConfigurationManager;

import com.gigatronik.ebike.common.configuration.ComplexResponse;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.common.util.ConverterUtils;
import java.awt.event.ItemEvent;
import java.awt.event.ItemListener;
import javax.swing.DefaultComboBoxModel;
import javax.swing.JComboBox;
import org.apache.commons.lang3.StringUtils;
import org.slf4j.Logger;
import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;

public class WalkAssistElementController extends AbstractComboBoxElementController {
  private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(WalkAssistElementController.class);
  
  private static final DefaultComboBoxModel<AbstractComboBoxElementController.ComboBoxItem> MODEL_CLASSIC = new DefaultComboBoxModel<>(new AbstractComboBoxElementController.ComboBoxItem[] { AbstractComboBoxElementController.ComboBoxItem.WALKASSIST_CLASSIC_DISABLED, AbstractComboBoxElementController.ComboBoxItem.WALKASSIST_CLASSIC_ENABLED });
  
  private static final DefaultComboBoxModel<AbstractComboBoxElementController.ComboBoxItem> MODEL_VICTOR = new DefaultComboBoxModel<>(new AbstractComboBoxElementController.ComboBoxItem[] { AbstractComboBoxElementController.ComboBoxItem.WALKASSIST_VICTOR_DISABLED, AbstractComboBoxElementController.ComboBoxItem.WALKASSIST_VICTOR_ENABLED });
  
  private final ComboBoxElement element;
  
  private final JComboBox<AbstractComboBoxElementController.ComboBoxItem> comboBox;
  
  private ItemListener itemListener;
  
  public WalkAssistElementController(ComboBoxElement configurationElement, ConfigurationManager configurationManager, RightsManager rightsManager) {
    super(configurationElement, configurationManager, rightsManager, ConfigurationKey.WALK_ASSIST_INDEX);
    this.element = configurationElement;
    this.comboBox = (JComboBox<AbstractComboBoxElementController.ComboBoxItem>)this.element.getControlledComponent();
    init();
  }
  
  private void init() {
    this.comboBox.setModel(MODEL_VICTOR);
    this.itemListener = (event -> {
        if (event.getStateChange() == 1) {
          LOGGER.debug("Walk assist option changed to '{}'", event.getItem());
          validateValue();
          writeToConfiguration();
        } 
      });
    this.comboBox.addItemListener(this.itemListener);
  }
  
  public void setValue(String value) {
    super.setValue(value);
    writeToConfiguration();
  }
  
  public void setSelectedIndex(Integer index) {
    super.setSelectedIndex(index);
    writeToConfiguration();
  }
  
  private void writeToConfiguration() {
    int index = getSelectedIndex();
    this.configurationManager.setConfigurationValue(ConfigurationKey.WALK_ASSIST_INDEX, (index >= 0) ? index : null);
    this.configurationManager.setConfigurationValue(ConfigurationKey.WALK_ASSIST_VALUE, getValue());
  }
  
  void validateContent() {
    this.comboBox.removeItemListener(this.itemListener);
    this.comboBox.setModel(getSelectedProductLine().isGen1() ? MODEL_CLASSIC : MODEL_VICTOR);
    this.comboBox.addItemListener(this.itemListener);
    String value = this.configurationManager.getConfigurationValue(ConfigurationKey.WALK_ASSIST_VALUE);
    if (!StringUtils.isBlank(value)) {
      setValue(value);
    } else {
      String index = this.configurationManager.getConfigurationValue(ConfigurationKey.WALK_ASSIST_INDEX);
      if (ConverterUtils.isInteger(index)) {
        setSelectedIndex(Integer.valueOf(Integer.parseInt(index)));
      } else {
        setSelectedIndex(Integer.valueOf(-1));
      } 
    } 
  }
  
  private boolean isDriveOffSupported() {
    if (this.configurationManager.isContainerLoaded())
      return this.configurationManager.getContainerConfiguration().isDriveOffSupported(); 
    return this.configurationManager.getBikeIdentification().isDriveOffSupported();
  }
  
  void validateState() {
    if (isDriveOffSupported()) {
      validateDriveOffState();
    } else {
      validateWalkAssistState();
    } 
  }
  
  private void validateWalkAssistState() {
    showWalkAssistField();
    boolean enabled = false;
    if (isAdminWithContainerOrBike() || isIbdWithBikeConnected())
      if (this.configurationManager.getBikeIdentification().isDuConnected() && getSelectedProductLine().isGen1()) {
        ComplexResponse gkType = this.configurationManager.getBikeIdentification().getDuIdentification().getGkType();
        ComplexResponse waState = this.configurationManager.getBikeIdentification().getDuIdentification().getWalkAssistState();
        enabled = ("Glockenkern gehaertet".equals(gkType.toString()) && waState.isPositive());
        if (!enabled)
          setValue(waState.isPositive() ? waState.toString() : AbstractComboBoxElementController.ComboBoxItem.WALKASSIST_CLASSIC_DISABLED.getValue()); 
      } else {
        enabled = true;
      }  
    setEnabled(enabled);
  }
  
  private void validateDriveOffState() {
    showDriveOffField();
    setEnabled(false);
    if (isAdminWithContainerOrBike() || isIbdWithBikeConnected())
      setSelectedIndex(Integer.valueOf(1)); 
  }
  
  private void showWalkAssistField() {
    this.element.setLabel(BUNDLE.getString("EBikeConfigurationTab.lblWalkAssistance.text"));
    this.comboBox.setToolTipText(BUNDLE.getString("EBikeConfigurationTab.comboBox_WalkAssistance.toolTipText"));
  }
  
  private void showDriveOffField() {
    this.element.setLabel(BUNDLE.getString("EBikeConfigurationTab.lblWalkAssistance.text2"));
    this.comboBox.setToolTipText(BUNDLE.getString("EBikeConfigurationTab.comboBox_DriveOff.toolTipText"));
  }
}

package com.gigatronik.beds.gui.configtab.bike.elements;

import com.gigatronik.beds.gui.customcomponents.api.NumericTextField;
import com.gigatronik.beds.gui.customcomponents.api.TextField;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.configuration.ConfigurationKey;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.configuration.ConfigurationManager;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.rightsmanager.api.RightsManager;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.rightsmanager.api.UserLevel;
import com.gigatronik.bosch.utils.ConverterUtil;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.common.configuration.Constants;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.common.util.ConverterUtils;
import javax.swing.JComponent;
import javax.swing.JTextField;
import javax.swing.event.ChangeEvent;
import org.apache.commons.lang3.StringUtils;
import org.slf4j.Logger;
import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;

public class WheelSizeCorrectionElementController extends AbstractConfigurationElementController {
  private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(WheelSizeCorrectionElementController.class);
  
  private final WheelSizeCorrectionElement element;
  
  private boolean imperialUnit = false;
  
  private boolean initializedWheelSize = false;
  
  private int wheelSize = 750;
  
  private int lowerLimit = 750;
  
  private int upperLimit = 750;
  
  private final TextField.TextFieldListener textListener = new TextField.TextFieldListener() {
      public void onValidationStateChanged(String componentName, boolean isValid, String value) {
        WheelSizeCorrectionElementController.this.element.getSlider().setEnabled(isValid);
        WheelSizeCorrectionElementController.this.setValid(isValid);
        onTextChanged(null);
        onTextChanged(value);
      }
      
      public void onValueChanged(String componentName, String newText) {
        onTextChanged(newText);
      }
      
      private void onTextChanged(String text) {
        String mm = null;
        if (ConverterUtils.isDouble(text)) {
          mm = WheelSizeCorrectionElementController.this.imperialUnit ? WheelSizeCorrectionElementController.this.convertFromInchToMM(text) : text;
          if (!WheelSizeCorrectionElementController.this.element.getSlider().hasFocus())
            try {
              WheelSizeCorrectionElementController.this.element.getSlider().setValue(Integer.parseInt(mm));
            } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
              WheelSizeCorrectionElementController.this.element.getSlider().setValue(WheelSizeCorrectionElementController.this.upperLimit);
              WheelSizeCorrectionElementController.LOGGER.info("Slider value too high to be parsed as Integer.");
            }  
        } 
        WheelSizeCorrectionElementController.LOGGER.debug("Wheel size correction changed to '{}'", mm);
        WheelSizeCorrectionElementController.this.configurationManager.setConfigurationValue(ConfigurationKey.WHEEL_SIZE_CORRECTION, mm);
      }
    };
  
  public WheelSizeCorrectionElementController(WheelSizeCorrectionElement configurationElement, ConfigurationManager configurationManager, RightsManager rightsManager) {
    super(configurationElement, configurationManager, rightsManager);
    this.element = configurationElement;
    init();
  }
  
  private void init() {
    this.element.getSlider().addChangeListener(e -> {
          if (((JComponent)e.getSource()).hasFocus())
            setValue(String.format("%d", this.element.getSlider().getValue())); 
        });
    NumericTextField textField = this.element.getTextField();
    textField.setClearOnInputOutOfRange(false);
    textField.setDecimal(0);
    textField.setListener(this.textListener);
  }
  
  public void validateValue() {
    String text = getValue();
    if (ConverterUtils.isInteger(text)) {
      int mm = Integer.parseInt(text);
      setValid((mm >= this.lowerLimit && mm <= this.upperLimit));
    } else {
      setValid(false);
    } 
  }
  
  public void validateSettings() {
    validateContent();
    validateVisibility();
    validateState();
  }
  
  public void setValue(String value) {
    if (ConverterUtils.isInteger(value)) {
      this.element.getTextField().setText(this.imperialUnit ? convertFromMmToInch(value) : value);
    } else {
      this.element.getTextField().setText("");
    } 
  }
  
  public String getValue() {
    String text = ((JTextField)this.element.getTextField()).getText();
    if (this.imperialUnit && StringUtils.isNotBlank(text))
      return convertFromInchToMM(text); 
    return text;
  }
  
  public void setUnit(boolean imperial) {
    if (this.imperialUnit != imperial) {
      this.element.getTextField().setListener(null);
      String value = getValue();
      this.imperialUnit = imperial;
      updateGui();
      setValue(value);
      this.element.getTextField().setListener(this.textListener);
    } 
  }
  
  private void updateGui() {
    double correction = (double)this.wheelSize * 0.05D;
    this.upperLimit = (int)((double)this.wheelSize + correction);
    if (this.upperLimit > 3000)
      this.upperLimit = 3000; 
    this.lowerLimit = (int)((double)this.wheelSize - correction);
    if (this.lowerLimit < 750)
      this.lowerLimit = 750; 
    this.element.getSlider().setMaximum(this.upperLimit);
    this.element.getSlider().setMinimum(this.lowerLimit);
    if (this.imperialUnit) {
      double minimum = ConverterUtil.millimeterToInch((double)this.lowerLimit);
      double maximum = ConverterUtil.millimeterToInch((double)this.upperLimit);
      this.element.getTextField().setRange(minimum, maximum);
      this.element.setUnit(String.format("(%.2f - %.2f) %s", minimum, maximum, BUNDLE.getString("EBikeConfigurationTab.inch")));
      this.element.getTextField().setDecimal(2);
    } else {
      this.element.getTextField().setRange((double)this.lowerLimit, (double)this.upperLimit);
      this.element.setUnit(String.format("(%d - %d) mm", this.lowerLimit, this.upperLimit));
      this.element.getTextField().setDecimal(0);
    } 
  }
  
  public void setRange(int circumference) {
    if (this.wheelSize != circumference || !this.initializedWheelSize) {
      this.wheelSize = circumference;
      this.initializedWheelSize = true;
      String value = getValue();
      updateGui();
      setValue(value);
    } 
  }
  
  private void validateContent() {
    String circumference = this.configurationManager.getConfigurationValue(ConfigurationKey.WHEEL_CIRCUMFERENCE);
    if (ConverterUtils.isDouble(circumference))
      try {
        setRange(Integer.parseInt(circumference));
      } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
        LOGGER.error("Error setting wheel size correction range from configuration value '{}'", circumference, e);
      }  
  }
  
  private void validateState() {
    boolean enabled = isIbdWithBikeConnected();
    this.element.getSlider().setEnabled(enabled);
    this.element.getTextField().setEnabled(enabled);
  }
  
  private void validateVisibility() {
    setVisible((this.configurationManager.getBikeIdentification().getSystemType() != Constants.SystemType.CLASSIC_PLUS && this.rightsManager.isUserInLevel(UserLevel.IBD)));
  }
  
  public void clearValue() {
    setValue(null);
  }
  
  public String getDisplayTextForValue(String value) {
    return value;
  }
}

ITEM 69: com/gigatronik/beds/gui/configtab/bike/elements/WheelSizeElementController.java

package com.gigatronik.beds.gui.configtab.bike.elements;

import com.gigatronik.beds.gui.customcomponents.api.NumericTextField;
import com.gigatronik.beds.gui.customcomponents.api.TextField;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.configuration.ConfigurationKey;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.configuration.ConfigurationManager;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.rightsmanager.api.RightsManager;
import com.gigatronik.bosch.utils.ConverterUtil;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.common.util.ConverterUtils;
import javax.swing.JTextField;
import org.slf4j.Logger;
import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;

public class WheelSizeElementController extends AbstractConfigurationElementController {
  private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(WheelSizeElementController.class);
  
  private static final String FORMAT_MM = "(%d - %d) mm";
  
  private static final String FORMAT_IN = "(%.2f - %.2f) " + BUNDLE.getString("EBikeConfigurationTab.inch");
  
  static final int MAX_WHEELSIZE_MM = 3000;
  
  static final int MIN_WHEELSIZE_MM = 750;
  
  private final WheelSizeElement element;
  
  private final NumericTextField numericTextField;
  
  private Unit unit;
  
  public void clearValue() {
    setValue(null);
    this.configurationManager.setConfigurationValue(ConfigurationKey.WHEEL_CIRCUMFERENCE, null);
    this.configurationManager.setConfigurationValue(ConfigurationKey.WHEEL_CIRCUMFERENCE_CHECKSUM, null);
  }
  
  public enum Unit {
    MM, INCH;
  }
  
  public WheelSizeElementController(WheelSizeElement configurationElement, ConfigurationManager configurationManager, RightsManager rightsManager) {
    super(configurationElement, configurationManager, rightsManager);
    this.element = configurationElement;
    this.numericTextField = (NumericTextField)this.element.getControlledComponent();
    init();
  }
  
  private void init() {
    setVisible(true);
    this.unit = null;
    this.numericTextField.setRange(750.0D, 3000.0D);
    this.numericTextField.setDecimal(0);
    this.numericTextField.setListener(new TextField.TextFieldListener() {
          public void onValidationStateChanged(String componentName, boolean isValid, String value) {
            WheelSizeElementController.this.setValid(isValid);
            onValueChanged(componentName, value);
          }
          
          public void onValueChanged(String componentName, String newText) {
            String mmValue = null;
            if (ConverterUtils.isDouble(newText))
              mmValue = (WheelSizeElementController.this.unit == WheelSizeElementController.Unit.INCH) ? WheelSizeElementController.this.convertFromInchToMM(newText) : newText; 
            WheelSizeElementController.LOGGER.debug("Wheel size changed to '{}'", mmValue);
            WheelSizeElementController.this.configurationManager.setConfigurationValue(ConfigurationKey.WHEEL_CIRCUMFERENCE, mmValue);
          }
        });
    setValue(null);
  }
  
  public void validateValue() {
    String value = getValue();
    if (value != null) {
      int mm = Integer.parseInt(value);
      setValid((mm >= 750 && mm <= 3000));
    } else {
      setValid(false);
    } 
  }
  
  public void validateSettings() {
    setEnabled(isAdminWithContainerOrBike());
  }
  
  public void setValue(String wheelSize) {
    if (ConverterUtils.isInteger(wheelSize)) {
      this.numericTextField.setText((this.unit == Unit.INCH) ? convertFromMmToInch(wheelSize) : wheelSize);
    } else {
      this.numericTextField.setText("");
    } 
  }
  
  public String getValue() {
    String value = ((JTextField)this.numericTextField).getText();
    if (ConverterUtils.isDouble(value))
      return (this.unit == Unit.INCH) ? convertFromInchToMM(value) : value; 
    return null;
  }
  
  public void setUnit(Unit unit) {
    if (unit != this.unit) {
      double minWheelSize, maxWheelSize;
      String actualValueMM = getValue();
      switch (unit) {
        case MM:
          this.element.setUnit(String.format("(%d - %d) mm", 750, 3000));
          this.numericTextField.setRange(750.0D, 3000.0D);
          this.numericTextField.setDecimal(0);
          break;
        case INCH:
          minWheelSize = ConverterUtil.millimeterToInch(750.0D);
          maxWheelSize = ConverterUtil.millimeterToInch(3000.0D);
          this.element.setUnit(String.format(FORMAT_IN, minWheelSize, maxWheelSize));
          this.numericTextField.setRange(minWheelSize, maxWheelSize);
          this.numericTextField.setDecimal(2);
          break;
        default:
          this.element.setUnit(String.format("(%s - %s)", 750, 3000));
          break;
      } 
      Unit oldUnit = this.unit;
      this.unit = unit;
      if (oldUnit != null && actualValueMM != null)
        this.numericTextField.setText((unit == Unit.MM) ? actualValueMM : convertFromMmToInch(actualValueMM)); 
    } 
  }
  
  public String getDisplayTextForValue(String value) {
    return value;
  }
}

package com.gigatronik.beds.gui.configtab.bike;

import com.gigatronik.dart2.bosch.applicationprocess.ApplicationProcessManager;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.bosch.applicationprocess.ApplicationProcessStateChangedEvent;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.bosch.applicationprocess.ApplicationProcessStateChangesListener;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.bosch.service.internationalization.ResourceBundleFactory;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.bosch.service.internationalization.Utf8ResourceBundleFormatted;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.gui.EBikeApplication;
import java.awt.BorderLayout;
import java.awt.Component;
import java.awt.Dialog;
import java.awt.Dimension;
import java.awt.EventQueue;
import java.awt.Frame;
import javax.swing.JDialog;
import javax.swing.JLabel;
import javax.swing.JPanel;
import javax.swing.JProgressBar;
import javax.swing.border.EmptyBorder;
import org.slf4j.Logger;
import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;

public class PrepareProgrammingDialog implements ApplicationProcessStateChangesListener {
  private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(PrepareProgrammingDialog.class);
  
  private static final transient Utf8ResourceBundleFormatted BUNDLE = ResourceBundleFactory.newDefaultResourceBundle();
  
  public static final int TIMEOUT = 20000;
  
  private final EBikeApplication eBikeApplication;
  
  private final ApplicationProcessManager applicationProcessManager;
  
  private JDialog dialog;
  
  public PrepareProgrammingDialog(EBikeApplication eBikeApplication) {
    this.eBikeApplication = eBikeApplication;
    this.applicationProcessManager = ApplicationProcessManager.getInstance();
    this.dialog = createGui();
  }
  
  public void show() {
    openDialog();
    waitTillDataMiningIsDone();
    closeDialog();
  }
  
  private void openDialog() {
    LOGGER.info("Open prepare programming dialog");
    EventQueue.invokeLater(() -> this.dialog.setVisible(true));
  }
  
  private void waitTillDataMiningIsDone() {
    this.applicationProcessManager.addListener(this);
    waitAction();
    this.applicationProcessManager.removeListener(this);
  }
  
  private synchronized void waitAction() {
    try {
      while (this.applicationProcessManager.isProcessActive(ApplicationProcessManager.ApplicationProcess.DATA_MINING)) {
        LOGGER.debug("Wait for data mining procedure termination for max = '{}' ms", Integer.valueOf(20000));
        wait(20000L);
      } 
    } catch (InterruptedException ex) {
      LOGGER.error("Waiting interrupted", (Throwable)ex);
    } 
  }
  
  private void closeDialog() {
    LOGGER.info("Close prepare programming dialog");
    EventQueue.invokeLater(() -> this.dialog.dispose());
  }
  
  public synchronized void onApplicationProcessStateChanged(ApplicationProcessStateChangedEvent event) {
    LOGGER.debug("ApplicationProcessStateChangedEvent received: '{}'", event);
    if (!event.getApplicationProcessManager().isProcessActive(ApplicationProcessManager.ApplicationProcess.DATA_MINING)) {
      LOGGER.debug("Data mining's done, notify waiting thread");
      notifyAll();
    } 
  }
  
  private JDialog createGui() {
    JDialog loadingDialog = new JDialog((Frame)this.eBikeApplication.getFrame());
    JPanel panel = new JPanel(new BorderLayout());
    JLabel txt = new JLabel(BUNDLE.getString("WaitDialog.PreparingProgramming.text"));
    txt.setHorizontalAlignment(0);
    txt.setBorder(new EmptyBorder(5, 5, 10, 5));
    panel.setBorder(new EmptyBorder(10, 10, 10, 10));
    panel.add(txt, "Center");
    JProgressBar prgAction = new JProgressBar();
    prgAction.setFocusable(false);
    prgAction.setMinimumSize(new Dimension(150, 20));
    prgAction.setName("prgAction");
    prgAction.setOpaque(true);
    prgAction.setVerifyInputWhenFocusTarget(false);
    prgAction.setIndeterminate(true);
    panel.add(prgAction, "South");
    loadingDialog.setMinimumSize(new Dimension(250, 50));
    loadingDialog.setTitle(BUNDLE.getString("ProgressMonitor.progressText"));
    loadingDialog.setResizable(false);
    loadingDialog.getContentPane().add(panel);
    loadingDialog.pack();
    loadingDialog.setLocationRelativeTo((Component)this.eBikeApplication.getFrame());
    loadingDialog.setDefaultCloseOperation(0);
    loadingDialog.setModal(true);
    loadingDialog.setModalityType(Dialog.ModalityType.APPLICATION_MODAL);
    return loadingDialog;
  }
}

package com.gigatronik.beds.gui.configtab.multipleapplication;

import com.gigatronik.dart2.bosch.service.internationalization.ResourceBundleFactory;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.bosch.service.internationalization.Utf8ResourceBundleFormatted;
import java.awt.Component;
import java.awt.Dimension;
import java.awt.GridBagConstraints;
import java.awt.Insets;
import java.awt.event.ActionEvent;
import java.awt.event.WindowAdapter;
import java.awt.event.WindowEvent;
import java.awt.image.BufferedImage;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.function.Consumer;
import javax.swing.ButtonGroup;
import org.apache.commons.lang3.StringUtils;

public class MultipleApplicationDialogController {
  private static final Utf8ResourceBundleFormatted BUNDLE = ResourceBundleFactory.newDefaultResourceBundle();
  
  private ButtonGroup radioButtonGroup;
  
  private int yIndex = 0;
  
  private int result = 2;
  
  private MultipleApplicationDialog applicationDialog;
  
  ArrayList<ApplicationEntryPanel> appEntries = new ArrayList<>();
  
  public MultipleApplicationDialogController(MultipleApplicationDialog appDialog, String productLineDisplayName) {
    this.applicationDialog = appDialog;
    setProductLineHeader(productLineDisplayName);
    setButtonText();
    clearAllEntries();
    this.applicationDialog.getBtnOk().addActionListener(e -> {
          this.result = 0;
          this.applicationDialog.setVisible(false);
        });
    this.applicationDialog.getBtnCancel().addActionListener(e -> {
          this.result = 2;
          this.applicationDialog.setVisible(false);
        });
    this.applicationDialog.addWindowListener(new WindowAdapter() {
          public void windowClosing(WindowEvent e) {
            MultipleApplicationDialogController.this.result = 2;
            MultipleApplicationDialogController.this.applicationDialog.setVisible(false);
          }
        });
  }
  
  private void clearAllEntries() {
    this.yIndex = 0;
    this.appEntries.clear();
    this.radioButtonGroup = new ButtonGroup();
    this.applicationDialog.getPnlApplicationEntries().removeAll();
  }
  
  public void addEntry(String title, BufferedImage icon, String parId, String description, boolean preSelected) {
    ApplicationEntryPanel pnlAppEntry = new ApplicationEntryPanel();
    ApplicationEntryPanelController entryController = new ApplicationEntryPanelController(pnlAppEntry, parId, icon, title, description);
    pnlAppEntry.setController(entryController);
    entryController.getRadioButton().setSelected(preSelected);
    this.radioButtonGroup.add(entryController.getRadioButton());
    GridBagConstraints gbc = new GridBagConstraints();
    gbc.gridx = 0;
    gbc.gridy = this.yIndex;
    gbc.insets = new Insets(10, 0, 10, 0);
    gbc.fill = 2;
    gbc.anchor = 17;
    this.appEntries.add(pnlAppEntry);
    this.applicationDialog.getPnlApplicationEntries().add((Component)pnlAppEntry, gbc);
    this.yIndex++;
    if (this.yIndex == 3) {
      this.applicationDialog.getScrollPaneApplicationEntries().setPreferredSize(new Dimension(100, 400));
      this.applicationDialog.getScrollPaneApplicationEntries().setMinimumSize(new Dimension(100, 400));
      this.applicationDialog.pack();
      this.applicationDialog.setLocationRelativeTo(this.applicationDialog.getOwner());
    } 
  }
  
  public void setEntrySelected(String parId, boolean selected) {
    this.appEntries.forEach((Consumer<? super ApplicationEntryPanel>)(pnlEntry -> {
          if (StringUtils.equals(parId, pnlEntry.getController().getParId()))
            pnlEntry.getController().getRadioButton().setSelected(selected); 
        }));
  }
  
  public void setEntrySelected(int index, boolean selected) {
    this.appEntries.get(index).getController().getRadioButton().setSelected(selected);
  }
  
  public int setVisible(boolean visible) {
    this.applicationDialog.setVisible(visible);
    return this.result;
  }
  
  private void setProductLineHeader(String productLineDisplayName) {
    this.applicationDialog.getLblTitle().setText(String.format("%s %s", BUNDLE.getString("EBikeApplication.multipleApplication.dialogTitle"), productLineDisplayName));
  }
  
  private void setButtonText() {
    this.applicationDialog.getBtnOk().setText(BUNDLE.getString("JOptionPane.Ok"));
    this.applicationDialog.getBtnCancel().setText(BUNDLE.getString("JOptionPane.Cancel"));
  }
  
  public String getSelectedParId() {
    for (ApplicationEntryPanel entry : this.appEntries) {
      ApplicationEntryPanelController entryController = entry.getController();
      if (entryController.getRadioButton().isSelected())
        return entryController.getParId(); 
    } 
    return null;
  }
}

ITEM 76: com/gigatronik/beds/gui/configtab/multipleapplication/MultipleApplicationManagerImpl.java
========================================================================================================================
package com.gigatronik.beds.gui.configtab.multipleapplication;

import com.gigatronik.beds.service.configuration.impl.ContainerConfiguration;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.flashcontainer.api.BoschContainerController;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.flashcontainer.api.BoschContainerGen2;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.flashcontainer.cff2.Cff2_DuParameterReply;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.common.configuration.BikeIdentification;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.gui.testinterface.TestableJOptionPane;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.Comparator;
import java.util.function.Consumer;
import java.util.regex.Matcher;
import java.util.regex.Pattern;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;
import org.apache.commons.lang3.StringUtils;
import org.apache.commons.lang3.math.NumberUtils;

public class MultipleApplicationManagerImpl implements MultipleApplicationManager {
  private final BoschContainerController cffController;
  
  private final BoschContainerGen2 cff2Interface;
  
  private final BikeIdentification bikeIdent;
  
  private MultipleApplicationDialog multiAppDialog;
  
  private MultipleApplicationDialogController multiAppDialogController;
  
  private final String positionInTitleExtractRegex = "(#)(\\d+)(#)";
  
  private final Pattern positionInTitleExtractPattern = Pattern.compile("(#)(\\d+)(#)");
  
  private final ContainerConfiguration containerConfig;
  
  public MultipleApplicationManagerImpl(BoschContainerController containerController, BikeIdentification bikeIdent, ContainerConfiguration containerConfig) {
    this.cffController = containerController;
    this.bikeIdent = bikeIdent;
    this.cff2Interface = containerController.getCff2Interface();
    this.containerConfig = containerConfig;
  }
  
  public boolean validateMultipleApplication() {
    if (this.cffController.isCff3Loaded() || !this.bikeIdent.getDuIdentification().isApplication())
      return true; 
    ArrayList<Cff2_DuParameterReply> duParaReplies = new ArrayList<>(this.cff2Interface.getDuParameterReplies());
    if (duParaReplies.size() == 1)
      return true; 
    this.multiAppDialog = new MultipleApplicationDialog();
    this.multiAppDialog.setLocationRelativeTo(TestableJOptionPane.getDefaultParentFrame());
    this.multiAppDialogController = new MultipleApplicationDialogController(this.multiAppDialog, this.bikeIdent.getProductLineDisplayName());
    this.multiAppDialog.setController(this.multiAppDialogController);
    Collections.sort(duParaReplies, new Comparator<>() {
          public int compare(Cff2_DuParameterReply duParamReply1, Cff2_DuParameterReply duParamReply2) {
            Integer int1 = extractPosition(duParamReply1.getParId());
            Integer int2 = extractPosition(duParamReply2.getParId());
            return int1.compareTo(int2);
          }
          
          private int extractPosition(String parId) {
            if (StringUtils.isBlank(parId))
              return Integer.MAX_VALUE; 
            String title = MultipleApplicationManagerImpl.this.cff2Interface.getTitleForParId(parId);
            if (StringUtils.isNotBlank(title)) {
              Matcher m = MultipleApplicationManagerImpl.this.positionInTitleExtractPattern.matcher(title);
              return (m.find() && NumberUtils.isParsable(m.group(2))) ? Integer.parseInt(m.group(2)) : Integer.MAX_VALUE;
            } 
            return Integer.MAX_VALUE;
          }
        });
    duParaReplies.forEach((Consumer<? super Cff2_DuParameterReply>)(reply -> this.multiAppDialogController.addEntry(parseTitle(this.cff2Interface.getTitleForParId(reply.getParId())), this.cff2Interface.getIconForParId(reply.getParId()), reply.getParId(), this.cff2Interface.getDescriptionforParId(reply.getParId()), StringUtils.equals(reply.getParId(), this.bikeIdent.getApplicationId()))));
    if (!duParaReplies.stream().map(id -> id.getParId()).collect(Collectors.toList()).contains(this.bikeIdent.getApplicationId()))
      this.multiAppDialogController.setEntrySelected(0, true); 
    return showDialog(this.multiAppDialog);
  }
  
  private String parseTitle(String rawTitle) {
    if (StringUtils.isBlank(rawTitle))
      return ""; 
    return StringUtils.replaceAll(rawTitle, "(#)(\\d+)(#)", "");
  }
  
  public boolean showDialog(MultipleApplicationDialog multiAppDialog) {
    int result = multiAppDialog.getController().setVisible(true);
    if (result == 0) {
      this.containerConfig.setApplicationVariantId(multiAppDialog.getController().getSelectedParId());
      return true;
    } 
    return false;
  }
  
  public MultipleApplicationDialog getMultiAppDialog() {
    return this.multiAppDialog;
  }
}

package com.gigatronik.beds.gui.crm;

import com.gigatronik.beds.service.moviecompression.api.Compression;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.moviecompression.api.MovieCompressor;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.bosch.service.internationalization.ResourceBundleFactory;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.bosch.service.internationalization.Utf8ResourceBundleFormatted;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.gui.testinterface.TestableJOptionPane;
import java.io.File;
import java.text.DecimalFormat;
import java.text.NumberFormat;
import java.text.SimpleDateFormat;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.Date;
import javax.swing.ImageIcon;
import org.apache.commons.io.FilenameUtils;
import org.apache.commons.lang3.StringUtils;
import org.slf4j.Logger;
import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;

class CrmAttachmentPanelController {
  static final String COMPRESSED_VIDEO_DIR = System.getenv("DART2_HOME") + System.getenv("DART2_HOME") + "video";
  
  private static final String FILENAME_SUFFIX_COMPRESSED = "(compressed)";
  
  enum COMPRESSION_STATE {
    UNCOMPRESSED, COMPRESSION_RUNNING, COMPRESSION_DONE;
  }
  
  private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(CrmAttachmentPanelController.class);
  
  private static final Utf8ResourceBundleFormatted BUNDLE = ResourceBundleFactory.newDefaultResourceBundle();
  
  private static final ArrayList<String> MOVIE_FILES = new ArrayList<>(Arrays.asList("mov", "mp4", "mpeg", "avi", "3gp", "mkv"));
  
  private static final long ONE_KB_TO_BYTE = 1024L;
  
  private static final long ONE_MB_TO_BYTE = 1048576L;
  
  private static final long ONE_GB_TO_BYTE = 1073741824L;
  
  private final ImageIcon compressIconPopup = new ImageIcon(getClass().getResource("/com/gigatronik/beds/gui/crm/crm_compress.png"));
  
  private final ImageIcon compressIconButton = new ImageIcon(getClass().getResource("/com/gigatronik/beds/gui/crm/crm_compress_enabled.png"));
  
  private final ImageIcon compressCancelIconButton = new ImageIcon(getClass().getResource("/com/gigatronik/beds/gui/crm/crm_compress_cancel_enabled.png"));
  
  private static final String TOOLTIP_ABORT_COMPRESS = BUNDLE.getString("Crm.ButtonToolTip.AbortCompressMovie");
  
  private static final String TOOLTIP_DO_COMPRESS = BUNDLE.getString("Crm.ButtonToolTip.CompressMovie");
  
  private static final String COMPRESSION_FAILED_TITLE = BUNDLE.getString("Crm.Compression.failedTitle");
  
  private static final String COMPRESSION_FAILED_COMMON = BUNDLE.getString("Crm.Compression.failedCommonText");
  
  private static final String DEFAULT_PROGRESSBAR_TEXT = String.format(BUNDLE.getString("Crm.CompressionIsRunning"), "...");
  
  private File selectedFile = null;
  
  private final CrmAttachmentPanel panel;
  
  private CrmMainMaskPanelController crmMainMaskPanelController;
  
  private boolean isReadOnly = false;
  
  private final MovieCompressor movieCompressor;
  
  private boolean compressionAvailable = false;
  
  private COMPRESSION_STATE compressionState = COMPRESSION_STATE.UNCOMPRESSED;
  
  private CrmFileChooser fileChooser;
  
  private Compression compression;
  
  CrmAttachmentPanelController(CrmAttachmentPanel panel, MovieCompressor movieCompressor) {
    this.panel = panel;
    this.movieCompressor = movieCompressor;
    updateTexts();
    updateComponentStates();
  }
  
  void setCrmMainMaskPanelController(CrmMainMaskPanelController crmMainMaskPanelController) {
    this.crmMainMaskPanelController = crmMainMaskPanelController;
  }
  
  File getSelectedFile() {
    return this.selectedFile;
  }
  
  void setReadOnly(boolean isReadOnly) {
    if (this.isReadOnly != isReadOnly) {
      this.isReadOnly = isReadOnly;
      updateComponentStates();
    } 
  }
  
  boolean isCompressionRunning() {
    return (this.compressionState == COMPRESSION_STATE.COMPRESSION_RUNNING);
  }
  
  private void cancelCompressing() {
    if (isCompressionRunning()) {
      if (this.compression != null)
        this.compression.cancel(); 
      setCompressionState(COMPRESSION_STATE.UNCOMPRESSED);
      updateComponentStates();
      if (this.crmMainMaskPanelController != null)
        this.crmMainMaskPanelController.validateBtnSend(); 
    } 
  }
  
  boolean isReadOnly() {
    return this.isReadOnly;
  }
  
  void setSelectedFile(File file, COMPRESSION_STATE compressState) {
    this.selectedFile = file;
    setCompressionState(compressState);
    if (compressState == COMPRESSION_STATE.UNCOMPRESSED && isMovieFile()) {
      this.movieCompressor.checkForCompressionAvailable(this.selectedFile, compressionCheckResults -> 
          CrmHelper.delegateToEventQueue(() -> {
              this.compressionAvailable = (compressionCheckResults == MovieCompressor.CompressionCheckResults.COMPRESSION_CAN_BE_DONE);
              checkShowCompressionHintPopup();
              updateAll();
            }, true));
    } else {
      this.compressionAvailable = false;
      updateAll();
    } 
  }
  
  private void updateAll() {
    String filePath = (this.selectedFile != null) ? this.selectedFile.getAbsolutePath() : "";
    LOGGER.info("{} set File to '{}'", this.panel.getName(), filePath);
    updateTexts();
    updateComponentStates();
  }
  
  void openFileChooser() {
    CrmFileChooser crmFileChooser = getFileChooser();
    int status = crmFileChooser.showOpenDialog();
    if (status == 0)
      setSelectedFile(crmFileChooser.getSelectedFile(), COMPRESSION_STATE.UNCOMPRESSED); 
  }
  
  void toggleCompressFile() {
    if (this.compressionState == COMPRESSION_STATE.COMPRESSION_RUNNING) {
      cancelCompressing();
    } else if (this.compressionState == COMPRESSION_STATE.UNCOMPRESSED) {
      startCompressing();
    } 
  }
  
  private void startCompressing() {
    setCompressionState(COMPRESSION_STATE.COMPRESSION_RUNNING);
    updateComponentStates();
    this


      
      .compression = this.movieCompressor.compress(this.selectedFile, createCompressedFile(this.selectedFile)).onStart(this::compressionStart).onProgress(this::compressionProcess).onSuccess(this::compressionDone).onFailure(this::compressionFailed);
  }
  
  private File createCompressedFile(File selectedFile) {
    SimpleDateFormat dateFormat = new SimpleDateFormat("ddMMyyyyHHmmss");
    String subPath = dateFormat.format(new Date());
    File dir = new File(COMPRESSED_VIDEO_DIR + COMPRESSED_VIDEO_DIR + File.separator);
    if (!dir.mkdirs())
      LOGGER.warn("Failed to create a folder for compressed video: {}", dir); 
    dir.deleteOnExit();
    File file = new File(dir, FilenameUtils.getBaseName(selectedFile.getName()) + "(compressed)." + FilenameUtils.getBaseName(selectedFile.getName()));
    file.deleteOnExit();
    return file;
  }
  
  void deleteButtonAction() {
    setSelectedFile(null, COMPRESSION_STATE.UNCOMPRESSED);
  }
  
  private void updateTexts() {
    if (isValidFile(this.selectedFile)) {
      this.panel.txtSelectedFileName.setText(this.selectedFile.getName());
      this.panel.lblFileSize.setText(formatFileSizeForLabel(this.selectedFile.length()));
    } else {
      this.panel.txtSelectedFileName.setText("");
      this.panel.lblFileSize.setText("");
    } 
  }
  
  private String formatFileSizeForLabel(long fileSize) {
    String fileSizeText;
    if (fileSize < 1048576L) {
      double roundedValue = (double)Math.round((double)fileSize / 1024.0D);
      fileSizeText = String.format("%.0f KB", roundedValue);
    } else if (fileSize >= 10737418240L) {
      double roundedValue = (double)Math.round((double)fileSize / 1.073741824E9D * 10.0D) / 10.0D;
      fileSizeText = String.format("%.1f GB", roundedValue);
    } else {
      double roundedValue = (double)Math.round((double)fileSize / 1048576.0D * 10.0D) / 10.0D;
      fileSizeText = String.format("%.1f MB", roundedValue);
    } 
    return fileSizeText;
  }
  
  private void updateComponentStates() {
    if (this.isReadOnly) {
      this.panel.btnSelectFile.setEnabled(false);
      this.panel.btnCompress.setEnabled(false);
      this.panel.btnCompress.setIcon(this.compressIconButton);
      this.panel.btnCompress.setToolTipText(TOOLTIP_DO_COMPRESS);
      this.panel.btnRemoveAttachment.setEnabled(false);
      this.panel.prgCompression.setVisible(false);
      this.panel.txtSelectedFileName.setVisible(true);
      return;
    } 
    if (isCompressionRunning()) {
      this.panel.btnSelectFile.setEnabled(false);
      this.panel.btnCompress.setEnabled(true);
      this.panel.btnCompress.setIcon(this.compressCancelIconButton);
      this.panel.btnCompress.setToolTipText(TOOLTIP_ABORT_COMPRESS);
      this.panel.btnRemoveAttachment.setEnabled(false);
      this.panel.prgCompression.setIndeterminate(true);
      this.panel.prgCompression.setString(DEFAULT_PROGRESSBAR_TEXT);
      this.panel.prgCompression.setVisible(true);
      this.panel.txtSelectedFileName.setVisible(false);
      return;
    } 
    this.panel.btnSelectFile.setEnabled(true);
    this.panel.prgCompression.setIndeterminate(false);
    this.panel.prgCompression.setVisible(false);
    this.panel.txtSelectedFileName.setVisible(true);
    this.panel.btnCompress.setIcon(this.compressIconButton);
    this.panel.btnCompress.setToolTipText(TOOLTIP_DO_COMPRESS);
    if (isValidFile(this.selectedFile)) {
      this.panel.btnCompress.setEnabled((this.compressionAvailable && this.compressionState == COMPRESSION_STATE.UNCOMPRESSED));
      this.panel.btnRemoveAttachment.setEnabled(true);
    } else {
      this.panel.btnCompress.setEnabled(false);
      this.panel.btnRemoveAttachment.setEnabled(StringUtils.isNotEmpty(this.panel.txtSelectedFileName.getText()));
    } 
  }
  
  private static boolean isValidFile(File file) {
    return (file != null && file.exists() && file.isFile());
  }
  
  private boolean isMovieFile() {
    if (isValidFile(this.selectedFile)) {
      String fileSuffix = StringUtils.lowerCase(StringUtils.substringAfterLast(this.selectedFile.getName(), "."));
      return MOVIE_FILES.contains(fileSuffix);
    } 
    return false;
  }
  
  private void checkShowCompressionHintPopup() {
    if (!this.compressionAvailable) {
      TestableJOptionPane.showMessageDialog(BUNDLE.getString("Crm.Compression.notPossibleToCompressFile"), CrmMainTabPanelController.CRM_POPUP_TITLE, 1, this.compressIconPopup);
    } else if (this.selectedFile.length() >= 209715200L) {
      TestableJOptionPane.showMessageDialog(BUNDLE.getString("Crm.hintBigMovieFileUseCompression"), CrmMainTabPanelController.CRM_POPUP_TITLE, 1, this.compressIconPopup);
    } 
  }
  
  private void setCompressionState(COMPRESSION_STATE compressionState) {
    if (this.compressionState == compressionState)
      return; 
    this.compressionState = compressionState;
    if (this.crmMainMaskPanelController != null)
      CrmHelper.delegateToEventQueue(() -> this.crmMainMaskPanelController.validateBtnSend(), true); 
  }
  
  private void compressionStart() {}
  
  void compressionProcess(int process, long estimatedTimeMs) {
    String estimatedTime = formatEstimatedTime(estimatedTimeMs);
    CrmHelper.delegateToEventQueue(() -> {
          if (this.compressionState == COMPRESSION_STATE.COMPRESSION_RUNNING && process >= 0 && process <= 100) {
            String message;
            LOGGER.trace("Set compression progress={}, estimatedTimeMs={}, estimatedTime={}", process, estimatedTimeMs, estimatedTime);
            if (estimatedTimeMs > 0L) {
              message = String.format(BUNDLE.getString("Crm.Compression.progress"), estimatedTime);
            } else {
              message = String.format(BUNDLE.getString("Crm.CompressionIsRunning"), "...");
            } 
            this.panel.prgCompression.setString(message);
            this.panel.prgCompression.setValue(process);
            this.panel.prgCompression.setIndeterminate(false);
          } 
        }, true);
  }
  
  void compressionDone(File file) {
    CrmHelper.delegateToEventQueue(() -> setSelectedFile(file, COMPRESSION_STATE.COMPRESSION_DONE), true);
  }
  
  void compressionFailed(Compression.FailureCode failureCode, String errorMessage) {
    if (failureCode != Compression.FailureCode.CANCELED)
      CrmHelper.delegateToEventQueue(() -> {
            TestableJOptionPane.showMessageDialog(COMPRESSION_FAILED_COMMON, COMPRESSION_FAILED_TITLE, 0);
            setCompressionState(COMPRESSION_STATE.UNCOMPRESSED);
            updateComponentStates();
          }, true); 
  }
  
  private String formatEstimatedTime(long estimatedTime) {
    if (estimatedTime == 0L)
      return null; 
    long secondBasis = Math.round((double)estimatedTime / 1000.0D);
    long minuteBasis = secondBasis / 60L;
    long hours = minuteBasis / 60L;
    long minutes = minuteBasis - hours * 60L;
    long seconds = secondBasis - minuteBasis * 60L;
    NumberFormat format = new DecimalFormat("00");
    return format.format(hours) + ":" + format.format(hours) + ":" + format.format(minutes);
  }
  
  private CrmFileChooser getFileChooser() {
    if (this.fileChooser == null)
      this.fileChooser = new CrmFileChooser(); 
    return this.fileChooser;
  }
}

package com.gigatronik.beds.gui.crm;

import com.gigatronik.beds.common.bct.BctState;
import com.gigatronik.beds.diagnosticdatapool.api.serviceparameter.BmsServiceParameter;
import com.gigatronik.beds.diagnosticdatapool.api.serviceparameter.ServiceParameter;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.communication.api.CommunicationManager;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.configuration.ConfigurationManager;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.common.configuration.ComplexResponse;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.gui.BatterySelectionChecker;
import java.awt.EventQueue;
import java.util.LinkedList;
import java.util.List;

class CrmBctCheckInitialized {
  private final BatterySelectionChecker batterySelectionChecker;
  
  private final CrmInternalFactory crmInternalFactory;
  
  private final CommunicationManager communicationManager;
  
  private final ConfigurationManager configManager;
  
  CrmBctCheckInitialized(CrmInternalFactory crmInternalFactory) {
    this.crmInternalFactory = crmInternalFactory;
    this.batterySelectionChecker = crmInternalFactory.createBatterySelectionChecker();
    this.communicationManager = crmInternalFactory.getEBikeApplication().getCommunicationManager();
    this.configManager = crmInternalFactory.getEBikeApplication().getConfigurationManager();
  }
  
  boolean doInitializationCheck() {
    if (!this.crmInternalFactory.getConfigurationManager().getBikeIdentification().isBctConnected())
      return true; 
    return checkBctState();
  }
  
  private boolean checkBctState() {
    BctState currentState = this.communicationManager.getBctCom().readOperatingState();
    if (currentState == BctState.TEST_RUNNING || currentState == BctState.DISCHARGE_RUNNING)
      return false; 
    handleBatterySelection(currentState);
    return true;
  }
  
  private boolean handleBatterySelection(BctState currentState) {
    if (!this.batterySelectionChecker.isBctBatteryTypeSet()) {
      hideProgressDialog();
      return selectBattery(currentState);
    } 
    getBatteryData(currentState);
    return true;
  }
  
  private boolean selectBattery(BctState currentState) {
    if (this.batterySelectionChecker.ensureBatteryIsSelected()) {
      showProgressDialog();
      getBatteryData(currentState);
      return true;
    } 
    showProgressDialog();
    return false;
  }
  
  private void getBatteryData(BctState currentState) {
    if (currentState != BctState.DISCHARGE_FINISHED && currentState != BctState.TEST_FINISHED) {
      ComplexResponse response = this.communicationManager.getBms1Com().executeExtendedSessionAndSecurityAccess(this.crmInternalFactory.getRightsManager().getUserLevel());
      if (response.isPositive()) {
        List<ServiceParameter> parametersToRead = buildCrmBat1Request();
        this.crmInternalFactory.getServiceParameterDatapool().getCleanServiceParameterBundle(parametersToRead);
        this.communicationManager.getBms1Com().startDefaultSession(false);
      } 
    } 
  }
  
  private void showProgressDialog() {
    EventQueue.invokeLater(() -> this.crmInternalFactory.getReadingBikeDataProgressDialog().setVisible(true));
  }
  
  private void hideProgressDialog() {
    EventQueue.invokeLater(() -> this.crmInternalFactory.getReadingBikeDataProgressDialog().setVisible(false));
  }
  
  private List<ServiceParameter> buildCrmBat1Request() {
    List<ServiceParameter> parametersToRequest = new LinkedList<>();
    parametersToRequest.add(BmsServiceParameter.HW_VERSION);
    parametersToRequest.add(BmsServiceParameter.SW_VERSION);
    if (this.configManager.getBikeIdentification().getBms1Identification().isApplication()) {
      parametersToRequest.add(BmsServiceParameter.PART_NUMBER);
      parametersToRequest.add(BmsServiceParameter.SERIAL_NUMBER);
      parametersToRequest.add(BmsServiceParameter.BATTERY_VOLTAGE);
      parametersToRequest.add(BmsServiceParameter.BATTERY_TEMPERATURE);
      parametersToRequest.add(BmsServiceParameter.BATTERY_CHARGE_STATE);
      parametersToRequest.add(BmsServiceParameter.BATTERY_DEACTIVATION);
      parametersToRequest.add(BmsServiceParameter.LOAD_CYCLES);
      parametersToRequest.add(BmsServiceParameter.MAX_TEMP_LIFETIME);
      parametersToRequest.add(BmsServiceParameter.DURATION_THERMAL_PROTECTION);
      parametersToRequest.add(BmsServiceParameter.PROV_AH_OVER_LIFETIME);
      if (!this.configManager.getBikeIdentification().getBms1Identification().getComponentType().isBBP1xx()) {
        parametersToRequest.add(BmsServiceParameter.LOWEST_BATTERY_CELL_VOLTAGE);
        parametersToRequest.add(BmsServiceParameter.PRODUCT_CODE);
        parametersToRequest.add(BmsServiceParameter.MIN_PACK_TEMPERATURE);
        parametersToRequest.add(BmsServiceParameter.BATTERY_CODE);
      } 
    } 
    return parametersToRequest;
  }
}

package com.gigatronik.beds.gui.crm;

import com.gigatronik.beds.gui.customcomponents.DocumentSizeFilter;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.gui.SpecialCharacterFilter;
import java.awt.Component;
import javax.swing.BorderFactory;
import javax.swing.ComboBoxEditor;
import javax.swing.JTextField;
import javax.swing.text.AbstractDocument;

class CrmComboBoxEditor extends JTextField implements ComboBoxEditor {
  public CrmComboBoxEditor(int maxChars, String regEx, CrmMainMaskPanelController crmMainMaskPanelController) {
    initTextField(maxChars, regEx, crmMainMaskPanelController);
  }
  
  private void initTextField(int maxChars, String regEx, CrmMainMaskPanelController crmMainMaskPanelController) {
    setName("txtComboBoxEditor");
    ((AbstractDocument)getDocument()).setDocumentFilter(new SpecialCharacterFilter(new DocumentSizeFilter(maxChars)));
    getDocument().addDocumentListener(new CrmDocumentListener(crmMainMaskPanelController, this, true, regEx));
    setOpaque(false);
    setBorder(BorderFactory.createEmptyBorder(0, 5, 0, 5));
  }
  
  public Component getEditorComponent() {
    return this;
  }
  
  public void setItem(Object anObject) {
    if (anObject != null)
      setText(anObject.toString()); 
  }
  
  public Object getItem() {
    return getText();
  }
}

  private final String value;
  
  private final String bundleKey;
  
  private final String crmXmlText;
  
  CrmComboBoxItem(String bundleKey) {
    this.value = name();
    this.bundleKey = bundleKey;
    this.crmXmlText = null;
  }
  
  CrmComboBoxItem(String value, String text) {
    this.value = value;
    this.bundleKey = text;
    this.crmXmlText = value;
  }
  
  CrmComboBoxItem(String value, String text, String crmXmlText) {
    this.value = value;
    this.bundleKey = text;
    this.crmXmlText = crmXmlText;
  }
  
  public String getValue() {
    return this.value;
  }
  
  public String toString() {
    if (this.bundleKey == null)
      return this.crmXmlText; 
    String result = BUNDLE.getString(this.bundleKey);
    if (this == PRODUCT_FAMILY_BBP) {
      result = result + " 1 (Single/DualBatt)";
    } else if (this == PRODUCT_FAMILY_BBP2) {
      result = result + " 2 (DualBatt)";
    } 
    return result;
  }
  
  public String getTextForXml() {
    if (this.crmXmlText == null)
      return BUNDLE_EN.getString(this.bundleKey); 
    return this.crmXmlText;
  }
  
  public static CrmComboBoxItem getElementFromXmlText(String value, String namePrefix) {
    for (CrmComboBoxItem item : values()) {
      if (StringUtils.startsWith(item.name(), namePrefix) && StringUtils.equals(item.getTextForXml(), value))
        return item; 
    } 
    return null;
  }
}

package com.gigatronik.beds.gui.crm;

import com.github.lgooddatepicker.optionalusertools.DateChangeListener;
import com.github.lgooddatepicker.zinternaltools.DateChangeEvent;
import java.time.LocalDate;
import javax.swing.UIManager;

class CrmDateChangeListener implements DateChangeListener {
  private static final LocalDate PURCHASE_DATE_MIN = LocalDate.of(2009, 1, 1);
  
  private final CrmMainMaskPanel crmMainMaskPanel;
  
  private final CrmMainMaskPanelController crmMainMaskPanelController;
  
  public CrmDateChangeListener(CrmMainMaskPanel crmMainMaskPanel, CrmMainMaskPanelController crmMainMaskPanelController) {
    this.crmMainMaskPanel = crmMainMaskPanel;
    this.crmMainMaskPanelController = crmMainMaskPanelController;
  }
  
  public void dateChanged(DateChangeEvent dce) {
    validateDate(dce);
    this.crmMainMaskPanelController.validateBtnSend();
  }
  
  private void validateDate(DateChangeEvent dce) {
    if (dce.getNewDate() == null || dce.getNewDate().isAfter(LocalDate.now()) || dce.getNewDate().isBefore(PURCHASE_DATE_MIN)) {
      this.crmMainMaskPanel.getTxtPurchaseDate().getComponentDateTextField().setBorder(CrmMainMaskPanelController.BORDER_INVALID);
      this.crmMainMaskPanel.getTxtPurchaseDate().getComponentDateTextField().setForeground(CrmMainMaskPanelController.FOREGROUND_INVALID);
    } else {
      this.crmMainMaskPanel.getTxtPurchaseDate().getComponentDateTextField().setBorder(UIManager.getBorder("TextField.border"));
      this.crmMainMaskPanel.getTxtPurchaseDate().getComponentDateTextField().setForeground(UIManager.getColor("TextField.foreground"));
    } 
  }
}

ITEM 83: com/gigatronik/beds/gui/crm/CrmDocumentListener.java
========================================================================================================================
package com.gigatronik.beds.gui.crm;

import javax.swing.JComboBox;
import javax.swing.UIManager;
import javax.swing.event.DocumentEvent;
import javax.swing.event.DocumentListener;
import javax.swing.text.JTextComponent;
import org.apache.commons.lang3.StringUtils;

class CrmDocumentListener implements DocumentListener {
  private final CrmMainMaskPanelController crmMainMaskPanelController;
  
  private final String regEx;
  
  private final JTextComponent textField;
  
  private boolean emptyAllowed;
  
  public CrmDocumentListener(CrmMainMaskPanelController crmMainMaskPanelController, JTextComponent textField, boolean emptyAllowed, String regEx) {
    this.crmMainMaskPanelController = crmMainMaskPanelController;
    this.textField = textField;
    this.emptyAllowed = emptyAllowed;
    this.regEx = regEx;
  }
  
  public void setEmptyAllowed(boolean emptyAllowed) {
    this.emptyAllowed = emptyAllowed;
    insertUpdate(null);
  }
  
  public void insertUpdate(DocumentEvent e) {
    validateText();
    if (this.crmMainMaskPanelController != null)
      this.crmMainMaskPanelController.validateBtnSend(); 
  }
  
  public void removeUpdate(DocumentEvent e) {
    insertUpdate(e);
  }
  
  public void changedUpdate(DocumentEvent e) {}
  
  private void validateText() {
    if (this.textField == null)
      return; 
    boolean isValid = false;
    boolean withRegexCheck = StringUtils.isNotBlank(this.regEx);
    String text = this.textField.getText();
    boolean textIsEmpty = StringUtils.isEmpty(text);
    if (this.emptyAllowed && textIsEmpty) {
      isValid = true;
    } else if (withRegexCheck && !textIsEmpty && text.matches(this.regEx)) {
      isValid = true;
    } else if (!withRegexCheck && !textIsEmpty) {
      isValid = true;
    } 
    if (this.textField instanceof CrmComboBoxEditor) {
      setCrmComboBoxEditorState(isValid);
      return;
    } 
    if (isValid) {
      this.textField.setBorder(UIManager.getBorder("TextField.border"));
      this.textField.setForeground(UIManager.getColor("TextField.foreground"));
    } else {
      this.textField.setBorder(CrmMainMaskPanelController.BORDER_INVALID);
      this.textField.setForeground(CrmMainMaskPanelController.FOREGROUND_INVALID);
    } 
  }
  
  private void setCrmComboBoxEditorState(boolean valid) {
    JComboBox parent = (JComboBox)this.textField.getParent();
    if (valid) {
      parent.setBorder(UIManager.getBorder("Combobox.border"));
    } else {
      parent.setBorder(CrmMainMaskPanelController.BORDER_INVALID);
    } 
  }
}

ITEM 84: com/gigatronik/beds/gui/crm/CrmFileChooser.java

package com.gigatronik.beds.gui.crm;

import com.gigatronik.beds.settings.SettingsProxy;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.framework.plugins.exceptions.ConfigurationNotFoundException;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.gui.testinterface.TestableJOptionPane;
import java.io.File;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.InputStream;
import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;
import javax.swing.JFileChooser;
import javax.swing.filechooser.FileNameExtensionFilter;
import org.slf4j.Logger;
import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;

class CrmFileChooser {
  private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(CrmFileChooser.class);
  
  private static final String LAST_OPENED_CRM_FILE = "last_opened_crm_file";
  
  private JFileChooser fileChooser;
  
  private static final String[] FILE_NAME_EXTENSIONS = new String[] { 
      "JPG", "JPEG", "PNG", "MOV", "MP4", "MPEG", "AVI", "3GP", "PDF", "RTF", 
      "DOC", "DOCX", "XLS", "XLSX", "EML" };
  
  CrmFileChooser() {
    this.fileChooser = new JFileChooser() {
        public void approveSelection() {
          CrmFileChooser.this.setLastOpenedFileToCurrentLocation();
          super.approveSelection();
        }
      };
    this.fileChooser.removeChoosableFileFilter(this.fileChooser.getFileFilter());
    this.fileChooser.setFileFilter(new FileNameExtensionFilter((String)Arrays.<String>stream(FILE_NAME_EXTENSIONS).map(String::toLowerCase).collect(Collectors.joining(", ")), FILE_NAME_EXTENSIONS));
  }
  
  int showOpenDialog() {
    setCurrentDirectoryToLastOpenedFile();
    return this.fileChooser.showOpenDialog(TestableJOptionPane.getDefaultParentFrame());
  }
  
  File getSelectedFile() {
    return this.fileChooser.getSelectedFile();
  }
  
  private void setCurrentDirectoryToLastOpenedFile() {
    try {
      File lastSelectedFile = new File(SettingsProxy.getInstance().getGlobalSettings().getProperty("last_opened_crm_file"));
      File directoryOfLastSelectedFile = lastSelectedFile.getParentFile();
      if (directoryOfLastSelectedFile != null && directoryOfLastSelectedFile.isDirectory())
        this.fileChooser.setCurrentDirectory(directoryOfLastSelectedFile); 
    } catch (ConfigurationNotFoundException|NullPointerException e) {
      LOGGER.info("There was no previous directory, setting to MyDocuments");
      this.fileChooser.setCurrentDirectory(new File(returnMyDocumentsLocationFolder()));
    } 
  }
  
  private void setLastOpenedFileToCurrentLocation() {
    File currentSelectedFile = this.fileChooser.getSelectedFile();
    try {
      SettingsProxy.getInstance().getGlobalSettings().setProperty("last_opened_crm_file", currentSelectedFile.getCanonicalPath());
    } catch (ConfigurationNotFoundException e) {
      LOGGER.error("The configuration file cannot be located, the last visited folder won't be saved.");
    } catch (IOException e) {
      LOGGER.error("The canonical path of the current selected file cannot be obtained, the last visited folder won't be saved.");
    } 
  }
  
  String returnMyDocumentsLocationFolder() {
    String myDocuments = null;
    try {
      Process p = Runtime.getRuntime().exec("reg query \"HKCU\\Software\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Explorer\\Shell Folders\" /v personal");
      p.waitFor();
      InputStream in = p.getInputStream();
      byte[] b = new byte[in.available()];
      if (in.read(b) > 0) {
        myDocuments = new String(b);
        myDocuments = myDocuments.split("\\s\\s+")[4];
      } 
      in.close();
    } catch (Exception e) {
      LOGGER.error("Cannot find the MyDocuments location, setting to C:");
    } 
    return (myDocuments != null) ? myDocuments : "C:";
  }
}

ITEM 85: com/gigatronik/beds/gui/crm/CrmHelper.java
