package com.gigatronik.beds.gui.crm;

import java.awt.EventQueue;
import java.io.File;
import java.lang.reflect.InvocationTargetException;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.function.Consumer;
import javax.swing.JDialog;
import javax.swing.border.Border;
import javax.swing.border.CompoundBorder;
import javax.swing.border.LineBorder;
import org.slf4j.Logger;
import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;

class CrmHelper {
  private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(CrmHelper.class);
  
  static void delegateToEventQueue(Runnable runnable, boolean useInvokeLaterIfNotEventQueue) {
    if (EventQueue.isDispatchThread()) {
      runnable.run();
    } else if (useInvokeLaterIfNotEventQueue) {
      EventQueue.invokeLater(runnable);
    } else {
      try {
        EventQueue.invokeAndWait(runnable);
      } catch (InvocationTargetException ex) {
        LOGGER.error("Something went wrong on EventQueue.invokeAndWait: {}", (Throwable)ex);
      } catch (InterruptedException ex) {
        LOGGER.error("Thread Interrupted: Something went wrong on EventQueue.invokeAndWait", (Throwable)ex);
        Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
      } 
    } 
  }
  
  static CrmUploadResultPanel createUploadResultPanelWithAttachments(ArrayList<File> uploadedAttachments, ArrayList<File> allNotReadOnlyAttachments) {
    CrmUploadResultPanel panel = new CrmUploadResultPanel();
    uploadedAttachments.forEach((Consumer<? super File>)(successFile -> panel.addFileLabel(successFile.getName(), true)));
    allNotReadOnlyAttachments.forEach((Consumer<? super File>)(failedFile -> {
          if (!uploadedAttachments.contains(failedFile))
            panel.addFileLabel(failedFile.getName(), false); 
        }));
    return panel;
  }
  
  static void closePopup(JDialog dialog) {
    if (dialog != null && dialog.isVisible())
      dialog.setVisible(false); 
  }
  
  static boolean isBorderValid(Border border) {
    if (border == null)
      return true; 
    if (border instanceof CompoundBorder) {
      CompoundBorder compoundBorder = (CompoundBorder)border;
      if (compoundBorder.getOutsideBorder() instanceof LineBorder)
        border = compoundBorder.getOutsideBorder(); 
    } 
    if (border instanceof LineBorder)
      return (CrmMainMaskPanelController.BORDER_INVALID.getLineColor().getRGB() != ((LineBorder)border).getLineColor().getRGB()); 
    return true;
  }
}

    if (this.crmMovieCompressor == null) {
      FFmpegCompressor fFmpegCompressor = new FFmpegCompressor(new ProcessUtil(), this.crmExecutorService);
      this.crmMovieCompressor = new MovieCompressorImpl(this.crmExecutorService, fFmpegCompressor);
    } 
    return this.crmMovieCompressor;
  }
}

package com.gigatronik.beds.gui.crm;

import java.awt.event.ItemEvent;
import java.awt.event.ItemListener;
import java.util.Optional;
import javax.swing.UIManager;
import org.apache.commons.lang3.StringUtils;

class CrmItemListenerProductFamily implements ItemListener {
  private final CrmMainMaskPanel crmMainMaskPanel;
  
  private final CrmMainMaskPanelController crmMainMaskPanelController;
  
  private final CrmDocumentListener txtSerialNumberListener;
  
  private final CrmMainTabPanelController crmMainTabPanelController;
  
  CrmItemListenerProductFamily(CrmMainMaskPanel crmMainMaskPanel, CrmMainMaskPanelController crmMainMaskPanelController, CrmDocumentListener txtSerialNumberListener, CrmMainTabPanelController crmMainTabPanelController) {
    this.crmMainMaskPanel = crmMainMaskPanel;
    this.crmMainMaskPanelController = crmMainMaskPanelController;
    this.txtSerialNumberListener = txtSerialNumberListener;
    this.crmMainTabPanelController = crmMainTabPanelController;
  }
  
  public void itemStateChanged(ItemEvent event) {
    if (this.crmMainMaskPanel.getCmbProductfamily().getSelectedIndex() >= 0) {
      this.crmMainMaskPanel.getCmbProductfamily().setBorder(UIManager.getBorder("Combobox.border"));
    } else {
      this.crmMainMaskPanel.getCmbProductfamily().setBorder(CrmMainMaskPanelController.BORDER_INVALID);
    } 
    if (event.getItem() == CrmComboBoxItem.PRODUCT_FAMILY_BDU && event.getStateChange() == 2)
      this.crmMainMaskPanelController.setOptionalCrmManualConfigurationDialogModel(Optional.ofNullable(null)); 
    this.crmMainMaskPanel.getTxtSerialNumber().setText("");
    resetSerialNumberToInit();
    this.crmMainMaskPanel.getTxtPartNumber().setText("");
    resetPartNumberToInit();
    checkManualConfigurationVisibility();
    this.crmMainMaskPanelController.validateBtnSend();
  }
  
  private void resetSerialNumberToInit() {
    if (this.crmMainMaskPanel.getCmbProductfamily().getSelectedIndex() < 0) {
      this.crmMainMaskPanel.getTxtSerialNumber().setEnabled(false);
      this.txtSerialNumberListener.setEmptyAllowed(false);
      return;
    } 
    boolean emptyAllowed = false;
    String value = "";
    CrmXmlData xmlForSending = this.crmMainTabPanelController.getXmlForSending();
    switch ((CrmComboBoxItem)this.crmMainMaskPanel.getCmbProductfamily().getSelectedItem()) {
      case PRODUCT_FAMILY_ABS:
        value = xmlForSending.getAbsSerialnumber();
        break;
      case PRODUCT_FAMILY_BBP:
        value = xmlForSending.getBms1Serialnumber();
        break;
      case PRODUCT_FAMILY_BBP2:
        value = xmlForSending.getBms2Serialnumber();
        break;
      case PRODUCT_FAMILY_BCS:
        value = xmlForSending.getBcsSerialnumber();
        break;
      case PRODUCT_FAMILY_BCT:
        value = xmlForSending.getBctSerialnumber();
        break;
      case PRODUCT_FAMILY_BDU:
        value = xmlForSending.getDuSerialnumber();
        break;
      case PRODUCT_FAMILY_BUI:
        value = xmlForSending.getHmiSerialnumber();
        break;
      case PRODUCT_FAMILY_BRC:
      case PRODUCT_FAMILY_OTHERS:
        emptyAllowed = true;
        break;
    } 
    boolean enabled = true;
    if (StringUtils.isNotEmpty(value)) {
      this.crmMainMaskPanel.getTxtSerialNumber().setText(value);
      enabled = false;
    } 
    this.crmMainMaskPanel.getTxtSerialNumber().setEnabled((enabled && this.crmMainMaskPanel.getCmbProductfamily().isEnabled()));
    this.txtSerialNumberListener.setEmptyAllowed(emptyAllowed);
  }
  
  private void resetPartNumberToInit() {
    if (this.crmMainMaskPanel.getCmbProductfamily().getSelectedIndex() < 0) {
      this.crmMainMaskPanel.getTxtPartNumber().setEnabled(false);
      return;
    } 
    String value = "";
    CrmXmlData xmlForSending = this.crmMainTabPanelController.getXmlForSending();
    switch ((CrmComboBoxItem)this.crmMainMaskPanel.getCmbProductfamily().getSelectedItem()) {
      case PRODUCT_FAMILY_ABS:
        value = xmlForSending.getAbsPartnumber();
        break;
      case PRODUCT_FAMILY_BBP:
        value = xmlForSending.getBms1Partnumber();
        break;
      case PRODUCT_FAMILY_BBP2:
        value = xmlForSending.getBms2Partnumber();
        break;
      case PRODUCT_FAMILY_BCS:
        value = xmlForSending.getBcsPartnumber();
        break;
      case PRODUCT_FAMILY_BCT:
        value = xmlForSending.getBctPartnumber();
        break;
      case PRODUCT_FAMILY_BDU:
        value = xmlForSending.getDuPartnumber();
        break;
      case PRODUCT_FAMILY_BUI:
        value = xmlForSending.getHmiPartnumber();
        break;
    } 
    boolean enabled = true;
    if (StringUtils.isNotEmpty(value)) {
      this.crmMainMaskPanel.getTxtPartNumber().setText(value);
      enabled = false;
    } 
    this.crmMainMaskPanel.getTxtPartNumber().setEnabled((enabled && this.crmMainMaskPanel.getCmbProductfamily().isEnabled()));
  }
  
  private void checkManualConfigurationVisibility() {
    boolean visible = ((CrmComboBoxItem)this.crmMainMaskPanel.getCmbProductfamily().getSelectedItem() == CrmComboBoxItem.PRODUCT_FAMILY_BDU && 
      !this.crmMainTabPanelController.getXmlForSending().isDuConnected());
    this.crmMainMaskPanel.getBtnManualConfiguration().setVisible(visible);
    this.crmMainMaskPanelController.validateBtnManualConfiguration();
  }
}

ITEM 88: com/gigatronik/beds/gui/crm/CrmLatestsServiceCases.java
========================================================================================================================
package com.gigatronik.beds.gui.crm;

import com.gigatronik.beds.settings.global.GlobalSettingsProxy;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Arrays;
import org.apache.commons.lang3.StringUtils;
import org.slf4j.Logger;
import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;

class CrmLatestsServiceCases {
  private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(CrmLatestsServiceCases.class);
  
  private static final String SETTINGS_KEY_LATEST_SERVICE_CASES = "crm.latestServiceCases";
  
  private static final String SETTINGS_KEY_MAX_LATEST_SERVICE_CASES = "crm.maxCountLatestServiceCases";
  
  private static final String SEPARATOR_LATEST_SERVICE_CASES = ";";
  
  private final ArrayList<String> latestServiceCases;
  
  private int maxNumberOfLatestServiceCases = 10;
  
  private final GlobalSettingsProxy globalSettings;
  
  CrmLatestsServiceCases(GlobalSettingsProxy globalSettings) {
    this.globalSettings = globalSettings;
    this.latestServiceCases = new ArrayList<>();
    readMaxNumberOfLatestServiceCases();
  }
  
  void addServiceCaseNumber(String crmServiceCaseNumber) {
    this.latestServiceCases.remove(crmServiceCaseNumber);
    this.latestServiceCases.add(0, crmServiceCaseNumber);
    while (this.latestServiceCases.size() > this.maxNumberOfLatestServiceCases)
      this.latestServiceCases.remove(this.maxNumberOfLatestServiceCases); 
    saveCasesToProperties();
  }
  
  ArrayList<String> getLatestServiceCases() {
    readCasesFromProperties();
    return (ArrayList<String>)this.latestServiceCases.clone();
  }
  
  private void readCasesFromProperties() {
    this.latestServiceCases.clear();
    if (this.globalSettings != null) {
      String latestCases = this.globalSettings.getProperty("crm.latestServiceCases");
      String[] arrayLatestCases = StringUtils.split(latestCases, ";");
      if (arrayLatestCases == null)
        return; 
      this.latestServiceCases.addAll(Arrays.asList(arrayLatestCases));
      LOGGER.debug("latest crm service cases readed from settings properties");
    } 
  }
  
  private void saveCasesToProperties() {
    if (this.globalSettings != null) {
      String latestCases = String.join(";", this.latestServiceCases);
      this.globalSettings.setProperty("crm.latestServiceCases", latestCases);
      LOGGER.debug("latest crm service cases written to settings properties");
    } 
  }
  
  private void readMaxNumberOfLatestServiceCases() {
    if (this.globalSettings != null)
      this.maxNumberOfLatestServiceCases = this.globalSettings.getInteger("crm.maxCountLatestServiceCases", 10); 
  }
}

package com.gigatronik.beds.gui.crm;

import com.gigatronik.beds.gui.customcomponents.DocumentSizeFilter;
import com.gigatronik.beds.gui.customcomponents.api.TextField;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.crmclient.report.api.RetrievedReportData;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.crmclient.xml.DUxxxManualType;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.crmclient.xml.EBikeCRMType;
import com.gigatronik.beds.settings.SettingsProxy;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.framework.plugins.exceptions.ConfigurationNotFoundException;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.gui.SpecialCharacterFilter;
import com.github.lgooddatepicker.components.DatePicker;
import java.awt.Color;
import java.awt.event.ActionEvent;
import java.awt.event.ItemEvent;
import java.awt.event.ItemListener;
import java.io.File;
import java.text.Collator;
import java.time.LocalDate;
import java.util.ArrayList;

import javax.swing.DefaultComboBoxModel;
import javax.swing.JCheckBox;
import javax.swing.JComboBox;
import javax.swing.JComponent;
import javax.swing.JPanel;
import javax.swing.UIManager;
import javax.swing.border.CompoundBorder;
import javax.swing.border.LineBorder;
import javax.swing.event.ChangeEvent;
import javax.swing.text.AbstractDocument;

import org.apache.commons.lang3.StringUtils;
import org.slf4j.Logger;
import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;

class CrmMainMaskPanelController implements TextField.TextFieldListener {
  private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(CrmMainMaskPanelController.class);
  
  private static final int MAX_CHAR_CASE_NUMBER = 30;
  
  private static final int MAX_CHAR_ERROR_DESCRIPTION = 1500;
  
  private static final String CONFIG_COUNTRY = "crm_country";
  
  private static final String CONFIG_CUSTOMER_NAME = "crm_customer_name";
  
  static final LineBorder BORDER_INVALID = new LineBorder(Color.red, 2, false);
  
  static final Color FOREGROUND_INVALID = BORDER_INVALID.getLineColor();
  
  static final String TEXT_FIELDBORDER = "TextField.border";
  
  static final String TEXT_FIELDFOREGROUND = "TextField.foreground";
  
  private boolean contactMailValid = false;
  
  private String contactMailText;
  
  private final CrmMainTabPanelController crmMainTabPanelController;
  
  private final CrmInternalFactory crmFactory;
  
  private final CrmMainMaskPanel panel;
  
  private Optional<CrmManualConfigurationDialogModel> optionalCrmManualConfigurationDialogModel;
  
  private final CrmManualConfigurationDialogController crmManualConfigurationDialogController;
  
  private CrmLatestsServiceCases crmLatestsServiceCases;
  
  private ItemListener cmbServiceCaseNumberItemListener;
  
  private RetrievedReportData retrievedReportData;
  
  private CrmDocumentListener txtSerialNumberListener;
  
  CrmMainMaskPanelController(CrmMainTabPanelController crmMainTabPanelController, CrmInternalFactory crmFactory) {
    this.optionalCrmManualConfigurationDialogModel = Optional.ofNullable(null);
    this.crmMainTabPanelController = crmMainTabPanelController;
    this.crmFactory = crmFactory;
    this.crmManualConfigurationDialogController = crmFactory.createCrmManualConfigurationDialogController(this);
    this.panel = crmFactory.createCrmMainMaskPanel(this);
    initCrmLatestServiceCases();
    initDialog();
    resetFormularToInitValues();
  }
  
  private void initCrmLatestServiceCases() {
    try {
      this.crmLatestsServiceCases = this.crmFactory.createCrmLatestsServiceCases(SettingsProxy.getInstance().getGlobalSettings());
    } catch (ConfigurationNotFoundException ex) {
      LOGGER.debug("Global settings configuration was not found. Continue without the latest service cases");
      this.crmLatestsServiceCases = null;
    } 
  }
  
  private void initDialog() {
    this.txtSerialNumberListener = new CrmDocumentListener(this, this.panel.getTxtSerialNumber(), false, null);
    initCmbCountry();
    initGeneralJTextField(this.panel.getTxtCustomnumber());
    initCmbCasenumber();
    initCmbProductfamily();
    this.panel.getTxtSerialNumber().getDocument().addDocumentListener(this.txtSerialNumberListener);
    initGeneralJTextField(this.panel.getTxtPartNumber());
    initTxtPurchaseDate();
    initGeneralJTextField(this.panel.getTxtContactName());
    initAttachments();
    initTxtErrorDescription();
    initChbInformedCustomer();
    initBtnSend();
    initBtnManualConfiguration();
  }
  
  private void initCmbCountry() {
    List<CrmComboBoxItem> elements = new ArrayList<>();
    for (CrmComboBoxItem item : CrmComboBoxItem.values()) {
      if (StringUtils.startsWith(item.name(), "COUNTRY_"))
        elements.add(item); 
    } 
    Collections.sort(elements, (o1, o2) -> Collator.getInstance(Locale.getDefault()).compare(o1.toString(), o2.toString()));
    this.panel.getCmbCountry().setModel(new DefaultComboBoxModel(elements.toArray()));
    this.panel.getCmbCountry().addItemListener(event -> {
          if (this.panel.getCmbCountry().getSelectedIndex() >= 0) {
            this.panel.getCmbCountry().setBorder(UIManager.getBorder("Combobox.border"));
          } else {
            this.panel.getCmbCountry().setBorder(BORDER_INVALID);
          } 
          validateBtnSend();
        });
  }
  
  private void initGeneralJTextField(JTextComponent generalTextField) {
    generalTextField.getDocument().addDocumentListener(new CrmDocumentListener(this, generalTextField, false, null));
  }
  
  private void initCmbCasenumber() {
    updateCmbCasenumberEntries();
    CrmComboBoxEditor crmComboBoxEditor = new CrmComboBoxEditor(30, null, this);
    this.cmbServiceCaseNumberItemListener = (event -> {
        if (event.getStateChange() != 1 || !this.crmMainTabPanelController.isCrmTabActive())
          return; 
        String caseNumber = event.getItem().toString();
        if (StringUtils.isEmpty(caseNumber) && this.retrievedReportData != null) {
          resetFormularToInitValues();
          return;
        } 
        if (CrmHelper.isBorderValid(this.panel.getCmbCasenumber().getBorder()) && !StringUtils.isEmpty(caseNumber))
          loadServiceCase(event.getItem().toString()); 
      });
    this.panel.getCmbCasenumber().setEditor(crmComboBoxEditor);
    this.panel.getCmbCasenumber().addItemListener(this.cmbServiceCaseNumberItemListener);
  }
  
  private void updateCmbCasenumberEntries() {
    JComboBox<String> cmbCasenumber = this.panel.getCmbCasenumber();
    cmbCasenumber.removeItemListener(this.cmbServiceCaseNumberItemListener);
    Object selectedItem = cmbCasenumber.getSelectedItem();
    cmbCasenumber.setModel(new DefaultComboBoxModel(this.crmLatestsServiceCases.getLatestServiceCases().toArray()));
    cmbCasenumber.setSelectedItem(selectedItem);
    cmbCasenumber.addItemListener(this.cmbServiceCaseNumberItemListener);
  }
  
  private void initCmbProductfamily() {
    List<CrmComboBoxItem> elements = new ArrayList<>();
    for (CrmComboBoxItem item : CrmComboBoxItem.values()) {
      if (StringUtils.startsWith(item.name(), "PRODUCT_FAMILY_"))
        elements.add(item); 
    } 
    this.panel.getCmbProductfamily().setModel(new DefaultComboBoxModel(elements.toArray()));
    this.panel.getCmbProductfamily().addItemListener(new CrmItemListenerProductFamily(this.panel, this, this.txtSerialNumberListener, this.crmMainTabPanelController));
  }
  
  private void initTxtPurchaseDate() {
    DatePicker picker = this.panel.getTxtPurchaseDate();
    picker.addDateChangeListener(new CrmDateChangeListener(this.panel, this));
  }
  
  private void initAttachments() {
    ArrayList<CrmAttachmentPanelController> attachmentControllerList = this.panel.getAttachmentControllerList();
    attachmentControllerList.forEach((Consumer<? super CrmAttachmentPanelController>)(crmAttachmentPanelController -> crmAttachmentPanelController.setCrmMainMaskPanelController(this)));
  }
  
  private void initTxtErrorDescription() {
    ((AbstractDocument)this.panel.getTxtErrorDescription().getDocument()).setDocumentFilter(new SpecialCharacterFilter(new DocumentSizeFilter(1500)));
    initGeneralJTextField(this.panel.getTxtErrorDescription());
  }
  
  private void initChbInformedCustomer() {
    this.panel.getChbInformedCustomer().addChangeListener(e -> {
          if (this.panel.getChbInformedCustomer().isSelected()) {
            this.panel.getChbInformedCustomer().setForeground(this.panel.getForeground());
          } else {
            this.panel.getChbInformedCustomer().setForeground(FOREGROUND_INVALID);
          } 
          validateBtnSend();
        });
  }
  
  private void initBtnSend() {
    this.panel.getBtnSend().addActionListener(e -> {
          this.panel.getBtnSend().setEnabled(false);
          writeGlobalSettings();
          this.crmMainTabPanelController.buttonSendPress(this.panel, this.optionalCrmManualConfigurationDialogModel, this.contactMailText, 
              this.crmFactory.createCrmReportController());
        });
  }
  
  private void initBtnManualConfiguration() {
    this.panel.getBtnManualConfiguration().addActionListener(e -> this.crmManualConfigurationDialogController.showDialogWithData(this.optionalCrmManualConfigurationDialogModel));
  }
  
  void validateBtnManualConfiguration() {
    if (this.optionalCrmManualConfigurationDialogModel.isPresent() || !this.panel.getBtnManualConfiguration().isVisible()) {
      this.panel.getBtnManualConfiguration().setBorder(UIManager.getBorder("Button.border"));
    } else {
      this.panel.getBtnManualConfiguration().setBorder(new CompoundBorder(BORDER_INVALID, UIManager.getBorder("Button.border")));
    } 
  }
  
  private void writeGlobalSettings() {
    try {
      SettingsProxy.getInstance().getGlobalSettings().setProperty("crm_country", ((CrmComboBoxItem)this.panel.getCmbCountry().getSelectedItem()).getValue());
      SettingsProxy.getInstance().getGlobalSettings().setProperty("crm_customer_name", this.panel.getTxtContactName().getText());
    } catch (ConfigurationNotFoundException ex) {
      java.util.logging.Logger.getLogger(CrmMainMaskPanelController.class.getName()).log(Level.SEVERE, null, (Throwable)ex);
    } 
  }
  
  String getCustomerNumber() {
    return this.panel.getTxtCustomnumber().getText();
  }
  
  void validateBtnSend() {
    boolean hasInvalidFields = (this.panel.getCmbCountry().getSelectedIndex() < 0 || 
      !CrmHelper.isBorderValid(this.panel.getTxtCustomnumber().getBorder()) || 
      !CrmHelper.isBorderValid(this.panel.getCmbCasenumber().getBorder()) || 
      this.panel.getCmbProductfamily().getSelectedIndex() < 0 || 
      !CrmHelper.isBorderValid(this.panel.getTxtSerialNumber().getBorder()) || 
      !CrmHelper.isBorderValid(this.panel.getTxtPartNumber().getBorder()) || 
      !CrmHelper.isBorderValid(this.panel.getTxtPurchaseDate().getComponentDateTextField().getBorder()) || 
      !CrmHelper.isBorderValid(this.panel.getTxtContactName().getBorder()) || !this.contactMailValid || 
      
      !CrmHelper.isBorderValid(this.panel.getTxtErrorDescription().getBorder()) || 
      !this.panel.getChbInformedCustomer().isSelected() || 
      !CrmHelper.isBorderValid(this.panel.getBtnManualConfiguration().getBorder()) || 
      isAtLeastOneCompressionRunning());
    this.panel.getBtnSend().setEnabled(!hasInvalidFields);
  }
  
  private boolean isAtLeastOneCompressionRunning() {
    return this.panel.getAttachmentControllerList().stream().anyMatch(crmAttachmentPanelController -> crmAttachmentPanelController.isCompressionRunning());
  }
  
  final void resetFormularToInitValues() {
    this.retrievedReportData = null;
    try {
      String country = SettingsProxy.getInstance().getGlobalSettings().getProperty("crm_country", "");
      if (StringUtils.isNotBlank(country)) {
        CrmComboBoxItem countryItem = CrmComboBoxItem.valueOf("COUNTRY_" + country);
        this.panel.getCmbCountry().setSelectedItem(countryItem);
      } else {
        this.panel.getCmbCountry().setSelectedIndex(-1);
      } 
    } catch (ConfigurationNotFoundException|IllegalArgumentException ex) {
      LOGGER.error("Failed to read {} settings from global settings configuration. Default settings used.", "crm_country", ex);
      this.panel.getCmbCountry().setSelectedIndex(-1);
    } 
    String customerNumber = "";
    try {
      customerNumber = SettingsProxy.getInstance().getGlobalSettings().getProperty("settings_userdata_customerNumber", customerNumber);
    } catch (ConfigurationNotFoundException ex) {
      LOGGER.error("Failed to read customer number settings from global settings configuration. Default settings used.", (Throwable)ex);
    } 
    this.panel.getTxtCustomnumber().setText(customerNumber);
    updateCmbCasenumberEntries();
    this.panel.getCmbCasenumber().setSelectedIndex(-1);
    this.panel.getCmbCasenumber().getEditor().setItem("");
    this.panel.getCmbProductfamily().setSelectedIndex(-1);
    this.panel.getTxtSerialNumber().setText("");
    this.panel.getTxtPartNumber().setText("");
    this.panel.getTxtPurchaseDate().clear();
    this.panel.getTxtPurchaseDate().getComponentDateTextField().setBorder(BORDER_INVALID);
    this.panel.getChbCrossExchange().setSelected(false);
    try {
      this.panel.getTxtContactName().setText(SettingsProxy.getInstance().getGlobalSettings().getProperty("crm_customer_name", ""));
    } catch (ConfigurationNotFoundException|IllegalArgumentException ex) {
      LOGGER.error("Failed to read {} settings from global settings configuration. Default settings used.", "crm_customer_name", ex);
    } 
    String customerMail = "";
    try {
      customerMail = SettingsProxy.getInstance().getGlobalSettings().getProperty("settings_userdata_customerEMail", customerMail);
    } catch (ConfigurationNotFoundException ex) {
      LOGGER.error("Failed to read flash assistant settings from global settings configuration. Default settings used.", (Throwable)ex);
    } 
    this.panel.getTxtContactMail().setText(customerMail);
    this.panel.getTxtErrorDescription().setText("");
    this.panel.getTxtErrorDescription().setBorder(BORDER_INVALID);
    this.panel.getChbInformedCustomer().setSelected(false);
    this.panel.getChbInformedCustomer().setForeground(BORDER_INVALID.getLineColor());
    this.panel.getAttachmentControllerList().forEach((Consumer<? super CrmAttachmentPanelController>)(attachmentController -> {
          attachmentController.setSelectedFile(null, CrmAttachmentPanelController.COMPRESSION_STATE.UNCOMPRESSED);
          attachmentController.setReadOnly(false);
        }));
    setNotAttachmentFieldsToEnabled(true);
    setOptionalCrmManualConfigurationDialogModel(Optional.ofNullable(null));
    this.crmManualConfigurationDialogController.closeDialog(true, new CrmManualConfigurationDialogModel());
  }
  
  ArrayList<File> getAllNotReadOnlyAttachments() {
    ArrayList<File> fileList = new ArrayList<>();
    this.panel.getAttachmentControllerList().forEach((Consumer<? super CrmAttachmentPanelController>)(attachmentController -> {
          File attachment = attachmentController.getSelectedFile();
          if (!attachmentController.isReadOnly() && attachment != null && !fileList.contains(attachment))
            fileList.add(attachment); 
        }));
    return fileList;
  }
  
  ArrayList<File> getAllReadOnlyAttachments() {
    ArrayList<File> fileList = new ArrayList<>();
    this.panel.getAttachmentControllerList().forEach((Consumer<? super CrmAttachmentPanelController>)(attachmentController -> {
          File attachment = attachmentController.getSelectedFile();
          if (attachmentController.isReadOnly() && attachment != null && !fileList.contains(attachment))
            fileList.add(attachment); 
        }));
    return fileList;
  }
  
  void setAttachmentReadOnly(File file) {
    if (file != null)
      this.panel.getAttachmentControllerList().forEach((Consumer<? super CrmAttachmentPanelController>)(attachmentController -> {
            File attachment = attachmentController.getSelectedFile();
            if (attachment != null && attachment == file)
              attachmentController.setReadOnly(true); 
          })); 
  }
  
  void setNotAttachmentFieldsToEnabled(boolean enabled) {
    this.panel.getChbCrossExchange().setEnabled(enabled);
    this.panel.getChbInformedCustomer().setEnabled(enabled);
    this.panel.getCmbCountry().setEnabled(enabled);
    this.panel.getCmbProductfamily().setEnabled(enabled);
    this.panel.getCmbCasenumber().setEnabled(enabled);
    this.panel.getTxtContactMail().setEnabled(enabled);
    this.panel.getTxtContactName().setEnabled(enabled);
    this.panel.getTxtCustomnumber().setEnabled(enabled);
    this.panel.getTxtErrorDescription().setEnabled(enabled);
    this.panel.getTxtPurchaseDate().setEnabled(enabled);
    this.panel.getTxtSerialNumber().setEnabled((enabled && this.panel.getCmbProductfamily().getSelectedIndex() > 0));
    this.panel.getTxtPartNumber().setEnabled((enabled && this.panel.getCmbProductfamily().getSelectedIndex() > 0));
    this.crmManualConfigurationDialogController.setAllDialogFieldsEnabled(enabled);
  }
  
  boolean isAllFieldsDisabledIgnoreAttachments() {
    return (!this.panel.getChbCrossExchange().isEnabled() && 
      !this.panel.getChbInformedCustomer().isEnabled() && 
      !this.panel.getCmbCountry().isEnabled() && 
      !this.panel.getCmbProductfamily().isEnabled() && 
      !this.panel.getCmbCasenumber().isEnabled() && 
      !this.panel.getTxtContactMail().isEnabled() && 
      !this.panel.getTxtContactName().isEnabled() && 
      !this.panel.getTxtCustomnumber().isEnabled() && 
      !this.panel.getTxtErrorDescription().isEnabled() && 
      !this.panel.getTxtSerialNumber().isEnabled() && 
      !this.panel.getTxtPartNumber().isEnabled() && 
      !this.panel.getTxtPurchaseDate().isEnabled());
  }
  
  void setCaseNumberAndAddToHistory(String caseNumber, boolean shouldCaseNumberBeAddedToHistory) {
    if (caseNumber != null) {
      if (shouldCaseNumberBeAddedToHistory) {
        this.crmLatestsServiceCases.addServiceCaseNumber(caseNumber);
        updateCmbCasenumberEntries();
      } 
      this.panel.getCmbCasenumber().removeItemListener(this.cmbServiceCaseNumberItemListener);
      this.panel.getCmbCasenumber().getEditor().setItem(caseNumber);
      this.panel.getCmbCasenumber().addItemListener(this.cmbServiceCaseNumberItemListener);
    } 
  }
  
  String getCaseNumber() {
    return (String)this.panel.getCmbCasenumber().getEditor().getItem();
  }
  
  void setFocusToCaseNumber() {
    this.panel.getCmbCasenumber().requestFocus();
  }
  
  JPanel getCrmMainMaskPanel() {
    return (JPanel)this.panel;
  }
  
  public void onValidationStateChanged(String componentName, boolean isValid, String value) {
    if (StringUtils.equals(componentName, "txtContactMail")) {
      this.contactMailValid = isValid;
      validateBtnSend();
    } 
  }
  
  public void onValueChanged(String componentName, String newText) {
    if (StringUtils.equals(componentName, "txtContactMail"))
      this.contactMailText = newText; 
  }
  
  void setOptionalCrmManualConfigurationDialogModel(Optional<CrmManualConfigurationDialogModel> optionalModel) {
    this.optionalCrmManualConfigurationDialogModel = optionalModel;
    validateBtnManualConfiguration();
    validateBtnSend();
  }
  
  private void loadServiceCase(String crmServiceCaseNumber) {
    LOGGER.debug("load crm service case {}", crmServiceCaseNumber);
    CrmReportLoading crmRetrieveReportListener = this.crmFactory.createCrmRetrieveReportListener(this.crmMainTabPanelController, this);
    crmRetrieveReportListener.getReport(this.panel.getTxtCustomnumber().getText(), crmServiceCaseNumber);
  }
  
  void onLoadingServiceCase(RetrievedReportData data) {
    CrmHelper.delegateToEventQueue(() -> showLoadedServiceCase(data), true);
  }
  
  private void showLoadedServiceCase(RetrievedReportData data) {
    this.retrievedReportData = data;
    EBikeCRMType loadedCrm = data.getReport();
    setLoadedServiceCaseComponent(this.panel.getCmbCountry(), CrmComboBoxItem.getElementFromXmlText(loadedCrm.getIbd().getCountry(), "COUNTRY_"), false);
    setLoadedServiceCaseComponent(this.panel.getTxtCustomnumber(), loadedCrm.getIbd().getCustomerNumber(), false);
    setLoadedServiceCaseComponent((JComponent)this.panel.getTxtContactMail(), loadedCrm.getIbd().getContactEmail(), false);
    setLoadedServiceCaseComponent(this.panel.getTxtContactName(), loadedCrm.getIbd().getContactName(), false);
    setLoadedServiceCaseComponent(this.panel.getTxtErrorDescription(), loadedCrm.getCaseInfo().getErrorDescription(), true);
    setLoadedServiceCaseComponent(this.panel.getCmbProductfamily(), CrmComboBoxItem.getElementFromXmlText(loadedCrm.getCaseInfo().getProductFamily(), "PRODUCT_FAMILY_"), false);
    setLoadedServiceCaseComponent(this.panel.getChbCrossExchange(), Boolean.valueOf(loadedCrm.getCaseInfo().isCrossExchange()), true);
    setLoadedServiceCaseComponent((JComponent)this.panel.getTxtPurchaseDate(), loadedCrm.getCaseInfo().getDateOfPurchase(), true);
    setLoadedServiceCaseComponent(this.panel.getTxtSerialNumber(), loadedCrm.getCaseInfo().getSerialNumberManual(), false);
    setLoadedServiceCaseComponent(this.panel.getTxtPartNumber(), loadedCrm.getCaseInfo().getPartNumberManual(), false);
    this.panel.getChbInformedCustomer().setSelected(false);
    DUxxxManualType duManual = loadedCrm.getDuxxxmanual();
    if (duManual != null) {
      CrmManualConfigurationDialogModel model = new CrmManualConfigurationDialogModel();
      model.setAbsVariant(CrmComboBoxItem.getElementFromXmlText(Boolean.toString(duManual.isEBikeAbsVariant()), "ABS_"));
      model.setApplicationId(CrmComboBoxItem.getElementFromXmlText(duManual.getApplicationId(), "APPLICATION_"));
      model.setBikeId(duManual.getBikeId());
      model.setBrand(duManual.getBrand());
      model.setExternalReference(duManual.getExternalReference());
      model.setGearratio(duManual.getGearRatio());
      model.setGeartype1(CrmComboBoxItem.getElementFromXmlText(duManual.getGearType1(), "GEARTYPE_1_"));
      model.setGeartype2(duManual.getGearType2());
      model.setHighPowerPort(CrmComboBoxItem.getElementFromXmlText(Boolean.toString(duManual.isHighPowerPort()), "HIGHPOWERPORT_"));
      model.setHighestGearratio(duManual.getHighestGearRatio());
      model.setLightOutput(CrmComboBoxItem.getElementFromXmlText(duManual.getLightOutput(), "LIGHT_OUTPUT_"));
      model.setLightPower(duManual.getLightPower());
      model.setLightSwitchStatus(CrmComboBoxItem.getElementFromXmlText(duManual.getLightSwitchStatus(), "LIGHT_SWITCH_STATUS_"));
      model.setLowestGearratio(duManual.getLowestGearRatio());
      model.setProductLine(CrmComboBoxItem.getElementFromXmlText(duManual.getProductLine(), "PRODUCT_LINE_"));
      model.setWalkassistant(CrmComboBoxItem.getElementFromXmlText(Boolean.toString(duManual.isWalkAssist()), "WALKASSISTANT_"));
      model.setWheelcircumference(duManual.getWheelCircumferenceValue());
      model.setWheelcircumferenceUnit(duManual.getWheelCircumferenceUnit());
      setOptionalCrmManualConfigurationDialogModel(Optional.ofNullable(model));
      this.crmManualConfigurationDialogController.setAllDialogFieldsEnabled(false);
    } 
    this.crmFactory.getReceiveXmlDataProgressDialog().setVisible(false);
  }
  
  private void setLoadedServiceCaseComponent(JComponent component, Object newValue, boolean enabled) {
    if (component == null)
      return; 
    if (component instanceof JTextComponent) {
      JTextComponent textComponent = (JTextComponent)component;
      textComponent.setText((String)newValue);
    } else if (component instanceof JComboBox) {
      JComboBox comboBox = (JComboBox)component;
      comboBox.setSelectedItem(newValue);
    } else if (component instanceof JCheckBox) {
      JCheckBox checkBox = (JCheckBox)component;
      checkBox.setSelected(((Boolean)newValue).booleanValue());
    } else if (component instanceof DatePicker) {
      DatePicker datepicker = (DatePicker)component;
      datepicker.setDate((LocalDate)newValue);
    } 
    component.setEnabled(enabled);
  }
}

package com.gigatronik.beds.gui.crm;

import com.gigatronik.beds.gui.color.GuiColors;

public class CrmMainTabPanel extends TestableJPanel {
  private static final Utf8ResourceBundleFormatted BUNDLE = ResourceBundleFactory.newDefaultResourceBundle();
  
  private final CrmMainTabPanelController crmMainTabPanelController;
  
  private CardLayout centerPanelCardLayout;
  
  private JPanel pnlCenterCards;
  
  private JTextArea lblServerNotAvailable;
  
  private JTextArea lblBctHasWrongState;
  
  private static final Color COLOR_LIGHT_GRAY = new Color(172, 186, 199);
  
  enum Cards {
    CARD_BCT_HAS_WRONG_STATE("BctHasWrongState"),
    CARD_MAINMASK("MainMask"),
    CARD_SERVER_UNAVAILABLE("ServerUnavailable");
    
    private final String value;
    
    Cards(String value) {
      this.value = value;
    }
    
    public String toString() {
      return this.value;
    }
  }
  
  private CrmMainTabPanel() {
    this.crmMainTabPanelController = null;
  }
  
  public CrmMainTabPanel(CrmInternalFactory crmFactory) {
    this.crmMainTabPanelController = crmFactory.createCrmMainTabPanelController(this);
    CrmMainMaskPanelController crmMainMaskPanelController = crmFactory.createCrmMainMaskPanelController(this.crmMainTabPanelController);
    this.crmMainTabPanelController.setCrmMainMaskPanelController(crmMainMaskPanelController);
    createGui(crmMainMaskPanelController);
  }
  
  private void createGui(CrmMainMaskPanelController crmMainMaskPanelController) {
    setName("pnlCrmMainTab");
    setLayout(new BorderLayout(5, 0));
    setBorder(BorderFactory.createEmptyBorder(5, 5, 5, 5));
    JPanel pnlTop = new JPanel();
    pnlTop.setName("pnlTop");
    add(pnlTop, "North");
    pnlTop.setLayout(new BorderLayout(5, 5));
    JLabel lblTitle = new JLabel(BUNDLE.getString("EBikeMainTabbed.crmservice.text"));
    lblTitle.setName("lblTitle");
    lblTitle.setOpaque(true);
    lblTitle.setBackground(GuiColors.BLUE);
    lblTitle.setForeground(Color.WHITE);
    lblTitle.setFont(EBikeApplicationPanel.DEFAULT_FONT.deriveFont(1, 15.0F));
    lblTitle.setHorizontalAlignment(0);
    lblTitle.setBorder(new EmptyBorder(10, 0, 10, 0));
    pnlTop.add(lblTitle, "Center");
    this.pnlCenterCards = new JPanel();
    this.pnlCenterCards.setName("pnlCenter");
    add(this.pnlCenterCards, "Center");
    this.centerPanelCardLayout = new CardLayout();
    this.pnlCenterCards.setLayout(this.centerPanelCardLayout);
    this.pnlCenterCards.add(crmMainMaskPanelController.getCrmMainMaskPanel(), Cards.CARD_MAINMASK.toString());
    this.pnlCenterCards.add(createServerNotAvailablePanel(), Cards.CARD_SERVER_UNAVAILABLE.toString());
    this.pnlCenterCards.add(createBctHasWrongStatePanel(), Cards.CARD_BCT_HAS_WRONG_STATE.toString());
  }
  
  private JPanel createServerNotAvailablePanel() {
    JPanel pnlServerNotAvailable = createEmptyBorderLayoutPanel("pnlServerNotAvailable");
    this.lblServerNotAvailable = createMultilineLabel("lblServerNotAvailable");
    pnlServerNotAvailable.add(this.lblServerNotAvailable, "North");
    return pnlServerNotAvailable;
  }
  
  private JPanel createBctHasWrongStatePanel() {
    JPanel pnlBctHasWrongState = createEmptyBorderLayoutPanel("pnlBctHasWrongState");
    this.lblBctHasWrongState = createMultilineLabel("lblBctHasWrongState");
    pnlBctHasWrongState.add(this.lblBctHasWrongState, "North");
    return pnlBctHasWrongState;
  }
  
  private JPanel createEmptyBorderLayoutPanel(String name) {
    JPanel pnlEmpty = new JPanel(new BorderLayout(5, 5));
    pnlEmpty.setName(name);
    pnlEmpty.setBorder(BorderFactory.createEmptyBorder(20, 0, 0, 0));
    return pnlEmpty;
  }
  
  private JTextArea createMultilineLabel(String name) {
    JTextArea lblMultiline = new JTextArea();
    lblMultiline.setText("");
    lblMultiline.setName(name);
    lblMultiline.setBackground(COLOR_LIGHT_GRAY);
    lblMultiline.setLineWrap(true);
    lblMultiline.setBorder(BorderFactory.createEmptyBorder(5, 5, 5, 5));
    lblMultiline.setEditable(false);
    lblMultiline.setForeground(UIManager.getColor("Label.foreground"));
    Font defaultLabelFont = UIManager.getFont("Label.font");
    lblMultiline.setFont(defaultLabelFont.deriveFont((float)defaultLabelFont.getSize() + 2.0F));
    return lblMultiline;
  }
  
  void switchToCard(Cards card) {
    this.centerPanelCardLayout.show(this.pnlCenterCards, card.toString());
  }
  
  void setServerNotAvailableText(String text) {
    this.lblServerNotAvailable.setOpaque(StringUtils.isNotEmpty(text));
    this.lblServerNotAvailable.setText(text);
  }
  
  void setBctHasWrongStateText(String text) {
    this.lblBctHasWrongState.setOpaque(StringUtils.isNotEmpty(text));
    this.lblBctHasWrongState.setText(text);
  }
  
  public void onTabGetActive() {
    this.crmMainTabPanelController.onTabGetActive();
  }
  
  public void onTabGetInactive() {
    this.crmMainTabPanelController.onTabGetInactive();
  }
}

package com.gigatronik.beds.gui.crm;

import com.gigatronik.beds.common.order.OrderableListener;

class CrmMainTabPanelController implements HardwareConnectionChangesListener, ApplicationProcessStateChangesListener {
  private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(CrmMainTabPanelController.class);
  
  private static final Utf8ResourceBundleFormatted BUNDLE = ResourceBundleFactory.newDefaultResourceBundle();
  
  static final String CRM_POPUP_TITLE = BUNDLE.getString("Crm.ProvideReport");
  
  private final CrmMainTabPanel crmMainTabPanel;
  
  private final ApplicationProcessManager applicationProcessManager;
  
  private CrmMainMaskPanelController crmMainMaskPanelController;
  
  private final CrmInternalFactory crmFactory;
  
  private CrmXmlData xmlForSending = null;
  
  private final AtomicBoolean isTabActive = new AtomicBoolean(false);
  
  private final AtomicBoolean restartGuiOnNewHardware = new AtomicBoolean(false);
  
  private boolean errorDialogOnScreen = false;
  
  public CrmMainTabPanelController(CrmInternalFactory crmFactory, CrmMainTabPanel crmMainTabPanel, ApplicationProcessManager applicationProcessManager) {
    this.crmFactory = crmFactory;
    this.crmMainTabPanel = crmMainTabPanel;
    this.applicationProcessManager = applicationProcessManager;
    deleteVideoCompressionFilesOnExit();
  }
  
  boolean isCrmTabActive() {
    return this.isTabActive.get();
  }
  
  void setCrmMainMaskPanelController(CrmMainMaskPanelController crmMainMaskPanelController) {
    this.crmMainMaskPanelController = crmMainMaskPanelController;
  }
  
  private void addListeners() {
    this.crmFactory.getConfigurationManager().addListener((OrderableListener)this);
    this.applicationProcessManager.addListener(this);
  }
  
  private void removeListeners() {
    this.crmFactory.getConfigurationManager().removeListener((OrderableListener)this);
    this.applicationProcessManager.removeListener(this);
  }
  
  void onTabGetActive() {
    LOGGER.info("Crm Tab got active");
    this.isTabActive.set(true);
    resetGuiToStart();
    addListeners();
    checkCrmServerAliveAndCreateXml();
  }
  
  void onTabGetInactive() {
    if (this.isTabActive.get()) {
      LOGGER.info("CRM Tab got inactive");
      this.isTabActive.set(false);
      removeListeners();
    } 
  }
  
  private void checkCrmServerAliveAndCreateXml() {
    final CrmReportController crmSendingController = this.crmFactory.createCrmReportController();
    final CrmReportAliveServerListenerOnStartImpl crmAliveServerListenerOnStart = this.crmFactory.createCrmReportAliveServerListenerOnActivation(this);
    crmAliveServerListenerOnStart.prepareStart();
    SwingWorker<Void, Void> worker = new SwingWorker<>() {
        protected Void doInBackground() {
          crmSendingController.isCrmServerAvailable(crmAliveServerListenerOnStart);
          return null;
        }
      };
    worker.execute();
  }
  
  private void resetGuiToStart() {
    switchGuiToCard(CrmMainTabPanel.Cards.CARD_SERVER_UNAVAILABLE, "", null);
    this.crmFactory.getCrmMovieCompressor().cancelAllCompressions();
    this.crmMainMaskPanelController.resetFormularToInitValues();
  }
  
  void buttonSendPress(CrmMainMaskPanel dialog, Optional<CrmManualConfigurationDialogModel> optionalCrmManualConfigurationDialogModel, String contactEmail, CrmReportController crmReportController) {
    setupCrmProgressDialog();
    this.xmlForSending.finalizeXmlForSending(dialog, contactEmail, optionalCrmManualConfigurationDialogModel);
    CrmReportAliveServerListenerOnReportSendingImpl crmReportAliveServerListenerOnReportSending = this.crmFactory.createCrmReportAliveServerListenerOnReportSending(this);
    CrmReportSendListener crmReportSendListener = this.crmFactory.createCrmReportSendListener(this.crmMainMaskPanelController, this);
    String serviceCase = this.crmMainMaskPanelController.getCaseNumber();
    crmReportController.sendReport(this.xmlForSending.getEbikeCrmType(), this.crmMainMaskPanelController.getCustomerNumber(), I18NUtil.getLocale().getLanguage(), serviceCase, 
        this.crmMainMaskPanelController.getAllNotReadOnlyAttachments(), crmReportAliveServerListenerOnReportSending, crmReportSendListener);
    CrmHelper.delegateToEventQueue(() -> this.crmFactory.getCrmProgressDialog().setVisible(true), true);
  }
  
  public void onHardwareConnectionChanged(HardwareConnectionChangedEvent event) {
    LOGGER.debug("HardwareChanged event received {}", event.toString());
    switch (event.getAction()) {
      case ECU_CONNECTED:
        if (event.getComponent() != Constants.EcuType.BCT)
          return; 
        break;
      case SYSTEM_CONNECTED:
      case SYSTEM_RECONNECTED:
        break;
      default:
        return;
    } 
    this.restartGuiOnNewHardware.set(true);
    CrmHelper.delegateToEventQueue(() -> resetGuiToStart(), true);
  }
  
  public void onApplicationProcessStateChanged(ApplicationProcessStateChangedEvent event) {
    LOGGER.debug("ApplicationProcessStateChanged event received (restart? {}): {}", Boolean.valueOf(this.restartGuiOnNewHardware.get()), 
        event.toString());
    if (!event.getApplicationProcessManager().isReadingServiceDataActive() && 
      this.restartGuiOnNewHardware.compareAndSet(true, false))
      CrmHelper.delegateToEventQueue(() -> checkCrmServerAliveAndCreateXml(), true); 
  }
  
  private void deleteVideoCompressionFilesOnExit() {
    try {
      FileUtils.forceDeleteOnExit(new File(CrmAttachmentPanelController.COMPRESSED_VIDEO_DIR));
    } catch (IOException e) {
      LOGGER.warn("Error scheduling videos directory for cleaning: {}.", CrmAttachmentPanelController.COMPRESSED_VIDEO_DIR);
    } 
  }
  
  void setXmlForSending(CrmXmlData xmlForSending) {
    this.xmlForSending = xmlForSending;
  }
  
  CrmXmlData getXmlForSending() {
    return this.xmlForSending;
  }
  
  void serverNotReachable(String timeAvailableAgain, boolean aliveServiceResponsed, boolean showAsPopup) {
    CrmHelper.closePopup((JDialog)this.crmFactory.getCrmProgressDialog());
    String message = BUNDLE.getString("Crm.ServerNotReachable");
    if (!aliveServiceResponsed) {
      message = message + "\n" + message;
    } else {
      if (StringUtils.isNotBlank(timeAvailableAgain))
        message = message + "\n" + message; 
      message = message + "\n" + message;
    } 
    if (showAsPopup) {
      TestableJOptionPane.showMessageDialog(message, CRM_POPUP_TITLE, 0);
    } else {
      switchGuiToCard(CrmMainTabPanel.Cards.CARD_SERVER_UNAVAILABLE, message, null);
    } 
  }
  
  void switchGuiToCard(CrmMainTabPanel.Cards card, String message, JPanel successPanel) {
    if (null != card)
      switch (card) {
        case CARD_SERVER_UNAVAILABLE:
          this.crmMainTabPanel.setServerNotAvailableText(message);
          break;
        case CARD_BCT_HAS_WRONG_STATE:
          this.crmMainTabPanel.setBctHasWrongStateText(message);
          break;
      }  
    this.crmMainTabPanel.switchToCard(card);
  }
  
  private void setupCrmProgressDialog() {
    CrmProgressDialog crmProgressDialog = this.crmFactory.getCrmProgressDialog();
    for (ActionListener listener : crmProgressDialog.getCancelButton().getActionListeners())
      crmProgressDialog.getCancelButton().removeActionListener(listener); 
    crmProgressDialog.getCancelButton().addActionListener(e -> buttonXmlSendingCancelPress());
    crmProgressDialog.getCancelButton().setVisible(true);
    crmProgressDialog.setUploadProgress(-1);
    crmProgressDialog.setUploadText(BUNDLE.getString("Crm.SendingReport"));
    crmProgressDialog.setFileText("");
    crmProgressDialog.setFileProgress(0);
    crmProgressDialog.setFileMaxProgress(1);
    crmProgressDialog.setFileElementsVisible(false);
  }
  
  private void buttonXmlSendingCancelPress() {
    LOGGER.debug("user pressed the cancel upload button");
    this.crmFactory.getLatestCreatedCrmReportController().ifPresent(CrmReportController::cancelUpload);
    CrmProgressDialog crmProgressDialog = this.crmFactory.getCrmProgressDialog();
    crmProgressDialog.getCancelButton().setVisible(false);
    crmProgressDialog.setUploadText(BUNDLE.getString("Crm.uploadWillBeAborted"));
    crmProgressDialog.setUploadProgress(-1);
    this.crmFactory.getLatestCreatedCrmReportController()
      .ifPresentOrElse(CrmReportController::cancelUpload, () -> CrmHelper.closePopup((JDialog)crmProgressDialog));
  }
  
  void uploadFailed(int errorCode, String title) {
    String message = BUNDLE.getString("Crm.servererror") + BUNDLE.getString("Crm.servererror") + "\n";
    if (errorCode == 404) {
      message = message + message;
    } else if (errorCode >= 300 && errorCode < 500) {
      message = message + message;
    } else if (errorCode >= 500 && errorCode < 600) {
      message = message + message;
    } else if (errorCode == 0) {
      message = BUNDLE.getString("RDC.ConnectToClient.NoConnection.error.dialog.text");
    } else if (errorCode == -1) {
      message = BUNDLE.getString("Crm.uploadAbort.title");
    } 
    uploadFailed(message, title);
  }
  
  void uploadFailed(String message, String title) {
    CrmHelper.delegateToEventQueue(() -> {
          hideProgressShowErrorPopupAndThenTheInputMaskAgain(message, title);
          this.crmMainMaskPanelController.validateBtnSend();
        }, true);
  }
  
  void uploadSuccess(Object message) {
    CrmHelper.delegateToEventQueue(() -> showSuccessPopupAndChangeToTabDiagnostic(message), true);
  }
  
  boolean isErrorDialogOnScreen() {
    return this.errorDialogOnScreen;
  }
  
  private void hideProgressShowErrorPopupAndThenTheInputMaskAgain(final Object message, final String title) {
    CrmHelper.closePopup((JDialog)this.crmFactory.getCrmProgressDialog());
    CrmHelper.closePopup((JDialog)this.crmFactory.getReceiveXmlDataProgressDialog());
    SwingWorker<Void, Void> errorWorker = new SwingWorker<>() {
        protected Void doInBackground() {
          synchronized (this) {
            if (Boolean.FALSE.equals(Boolean.valueOf(CrmMainTabPanelController.this.errorDialogOnScreen))) {
              CrmMainTabPanelController.this.errorDialogOnScreen = true;
              TestableJOptionPane.showMessageDialog(message, title, 0);
            } 
          } 
          return null;
        }
        
        protected void done() {
          synchronized (this) {
            CrmMainTabPanelController.this.errorDialogOnScreen = false;
          } 
        }
      };
    errorWorker.execute();
  }
  
  private void showSuccessPopupAndChangeToTabDiagnostic(Object message) {
    CrmHelper.closePopup((JDialog)this.crmFactory.getCrmProgressDialog());
    TestableJOptionPane.showMessageDialog(message, CRM_POPUP_TITLE, -1);
    this.crmFactory.getMainTabbedController().switchToDiagnosticTab();
  }
}

  private GridBagConstraints getDefaultTextFieldConstraints(int gridY, int insetTop) {
    GridBagConstraints gridBagConstraints = new GridBagConstraints();
    gridBagConstraints.gridx = 1;
    gridBagConstraints.gridy = gridY;
    gridBagConstraints.gridwidth = 3;
    gridBagConstraints.gridheight = 1;
    gridBagConstraints.fill = 1;
    gridBagConstraints.insets = new Insets(insetTop, 0, 5, 0);
    return gridBagConstraints;
  }
  
  private TextField.TextFieldListener createDefaultTextFieldListener() {
    return new TextField.TextFieldListener() {
        public void onValidationStateChanged(String componentName, boolean isValid, String value) {
          CrmManualConfigurationDialog.this.validateBtnOk();
        }
        
        public void onValueChanged(String componentName, String newText) {
          if (CrmManualConfigurationDialog.this.model == null)
            return; 
          if (StringUtils.equals("txtBrand", componentName)) {
            CrmManualConfigurationDialog.this.model.setBrand(newText);
          } else if (StringUtils.equals("txtExternalReference", componentName)) {
            CrmManualConfigurationDialog.this.model.setExternalReference(newText);
          } else if (StringUtils.equals("txtBikeId", componentName)) {
            CrmManualConfigurationDialog.this.model.setBikeId(newText);
          } else if (StringUtils.equals("txtGeartype2", componentName)) {
            CrmManualConfigurationDialog.this.model.setGeartype2(newText);
          } else if (StringUtils.equals("txtGearratio", componentName)) {
            CrmManualConfigurationDialog.this.model.setGearratio(newText);
          } else if (StringUtils.equals("txtHighestGearratio", componentName)) {
            CrmManualConfigurationDialog.this.model.setHighestGearratio(newText);
          } else if (StringUtils.equals("txtLowestGearratio", componentName)) {
            CrmManualConfigurationDialog.this.model.setLowestGearratio(newText);
          } else if (StringUtils.equals("txtWheelCircumference", componentName)) {
            CrmManualConfigurationDialog.this.model.setWheelcircumference(newText);
          } else if (StringUtils.equals("txtLightPower", componentName)) {
            CrmManualConfigurationDialog.this.model.setLightPower(newText);
          } 
        }
      };
  }
  
  private ItemListener createDefaultComboBoxItemListener() {
    return e -> {
        if (this.model == null)
          return; 
        if (this.cmbProductline == e.getSource()) {
          this.model.setProductLine((CrmComboBoxItem)this.cmbProductline.getSelectedItem());
        } else if (this.cmbGeartype1 == e.getSource()) {
          this.model.setGeartype1((CrmComboBoxItem)this.cmbGeartype1.getSelectedItem());
        } else if (this.cmbLightSwitchStatus == e.getSource()) {
          this.model.setLightSwitchStatus((CrmComboBoxItem)this.cmbLightSwitchStatus.getSelectedItem());
        } else if (this.cmbWalkAssistant == e.getSource()) {
          this.model.setWalkassistant((CrmComboBoxItem)this.cmbWalkAssistant.getSelectedItem());
        } else if (this.cmbLightOutput == e.getSource()) {
          this.model.setLightOutput((CrmComboBoxItem)this.cmbLightOutput.getSelectedItem());
        } else if (this.cmbHighPowerPort == e.getSource()) {
          this.model.setHighPowerPort((CrmComboBoxItem)this.cmbHighPowerPort.getSelectedItem());
        } else if (this.cmbApplicationId == e.getSource()) {
          this.model.setApplicationId((CrmComboBoxItem)this.cmbApplicationId.getSelectedItem());
        } else if (this.cmbAbsVariant == e.getSource()) {
          this.model.setAbsVariant((CrmComboBoxItem)this.cmbAbsVariant.getSelectedItem());
        } 
        JComboBox cmb = (JComboBox)e.getSource();
        if (cmb.getSelectedIndex() >= 0) {
          cmb.setBorder(UIManager.getBorder("Combobox.border"));
        } else {
          cmb.setBorder(CrmMainMaskPanelController.BORDER_INVALID);
        } 
        validateBtnOk();
      };
  }
  
  private void initComboBox(JComboBox comboBox, ItemListener itemListener, String prefixCrmComboBoxItem) {
    List<CrmComboBoxItem> elements = new ArrayList<>();
    for (CrmComboBoxItem item : CrmComboBoxItem.values()) {
      if (StringUtils.startsWith(item.name(), prefixCrmComboBoxItem))
        elements.add(item); 
    } 
    comboBox.setModel(new DefaultComboBoxModel(elements.toArray()));
    comboBox.addItemListener(itemListener);
  }
  
  private void initCustomization() {
    boolean emptyTextFieldAllowed = false;
    TextField.TextFieldListener defaultTextFieldListener = createDefaultTextFieldListener();
    ItemListener itemListener = createDefaultComboBoxItemListener();
    this.txtBrand = CustomComponentsFactory.createTextFieldNoRegex("txtBrand", defaultTextFieldListener, emptyTextFieldAllowed);
    this.pnlDevice.add((Component)this.txtBrand, getDefaultTextFieldConstraints(0, 5));
    this.txtExternalReference = CustomComponentsFactory.createTextFieldNoRegex("txtExternalReference", defaultTextFieldListener, emptyTextFieldAllowed);
    this.pnlDevice.add((Component)this.txtExternalReference, getDefaultTextFieldConstraints(1, 0));
    this.txtBikeId = CustomComponentsFactory.createTextFieldNoRegex("txtBikeId", defaultTextFieldListener, emptyTextFieldAllowed);
    this.pnlDevice.add((Component)this.txtBikeId, getDefaultTextFieldConstraints(2, 0));
    initComboBox(this.cmbProductline, itemListener, "PRODUCT_LINE_");
    initComboBox(this.cmbGeartype1, itemListener, "GEARTYPE_1_");
    this.txtGeartype2 = CustomComponentsFactory.createTextFieldNoRegex("txtGeartype2", defaultTextFieldListener, emptyTextFieldAllowed);
    this.pnlDevice.add((Component)this.txtGeartype2, getDefaultTextFieldConstraints(5, 0));
    this.txtGearratio = CustomComponentsFactory.createNumericTextField("txtGearratio", defaultTextFieldListener, false, false, false);
    this.txtGearratio.setDecimal(0);
    this.txtGearratio.setClearOnInputOutOfRange(false);
    this.pnlDevice.add((Component)this.txtGearratio, getDefaultTextFieldConstraints(6, 0));
    this.txtHighestGearratio = CustomComponentsFactory.createNumericTextField("txtHighestGearratio", defaultTextFieldListener, false, false, false);
    this.txtHighestGearratio.setDecimal(0);
    this.txtHighestGearratio.setClearOnInputOutOfRange(false);
    this.pnlDevice.add((Component)this.txtHighestGearratio, getDefaultTextFieldConstraints(7, 0));
    this.txtLowestGearratio = CustomComponentsFactory.createNumericTextField("txtLowestGearratio", defaultTextFieldListener, false, false, false);
    this.txtLowestGearratio.setDecimal(0);
    this.txtLowestGearratio.setClearOnInputOutOfRange(false);
    this.pnlDevice.add((Component)this.txtLowestGearratio, getDefaultTextFieldConstraints(8, 0));
    this.txtWheelCircumference = CustomComponentsFactory.createTextFieldNoRegex("txtWheelCircumference", defaultTextFieldListener, emptyTextFieldAllowed);
    GridBagConstraints defaultTextFieldConstraints = getDefaultTextFieldConstraints(9, 0);
    defaultTextFieldConstraints.gridwidth = 1;
    this.pnlDevice.add((Component)this.txtWheelCircumference, defaultTextFieldConstraints);
    initComboBox(this.cmbLightSwitchStatus, itemListener, "LIGHT_SWITCH_STATUS_");
    initComboBox(this.cmbWalkAssistant, itemListener, "WALKASSISTANT_");
    initComboBox(this.cmbLightOutput, itemListener, "LIGHT_OUTPUT_");
    this.txtLightPower = CustomComponentsFactory.createNumericTextField("txtLightPower", defaultTextFieldListener, false, false, false);
    this.txtLightPower.setRange(0.0D, 18.0D);
    this.txtLightPower.setDecimal(1);
    this.txtLightPower.setClearOnInputOutOfRange(false);
    this.pnlDevice.add((Component)this.txtLightPower, getDefaultTextFieldConstraints(13, 0));
    initComboBox(this.cmbHighPowerPort, itemListener, "HIGHPOWERPORT_");
    initComboBox(this.cmbApplicationId, itemListener, "APPLICATION_");
    initComboBox(this.cmbAbsVariant, itemListener, "ABS_");
    this.chbLiability.addChangeListener(e -> {
          if (this.chbLiability.isSelected()) {
            this.chbLiability.setForeground(getForeground());
          } else {
            this.chbLiability.setForeground(CrmMainMaskPanelController.FOREGROUND_INVALID);
          } 
          validateBtnOk();
        });
    if (this.controller != null) {
      this.btnOk.addActionListener(e -> this.controller.closeDialog(false, this.model));
      this.btnAbort.addActionListener(e -> this.controller.closeDialog(true, null));
      addWindowListener(new WindowAdapter() {
            public void windowClosing(WindowEvent e) {
              if (CrmManualConfigurationDialog.this.btnAbort.isEnabled()) {
                CrmManualConfigurationDialog.this.btnAbort.doClick();
              } else {
                CrmManualConfigurationDialog.this.btnOk.doClick();
              } 
            }
          });
    } 
  }
  
  private void validateBtnOk() {
    boolean valid = (isBorderValid(this.txtBrand) && 
      isBorderValid(this.txtExternalReference) && 
      isBorderValid(this.txtBikeId) && 
      this.cmbProductline.getSelectedIndex() >= 0 && 
      this.cmbGeartype1.getSelectedIndex() >= 0 && 
      isBorderValid(this.txtGeartype2) && 
      isBorderValid(this.txtGearratio) && 
      isBorderValid(this.txtHighestGearratio) && 
      isBorderValid(this.txtLowestGearratio) && 
      isBorderValid(this.txtWheelCircumference) && 
      this.cmbLightSwitchStatus.getSelectedIndex() >= 0 && 
      this.cmbWalkAssistant.getSelectedIndex() >= 0 && 
      this.cmbLightOutput.getSelectedIndex() >= 0 && 
      isBorderValid(this.txtLightPower) && 
      this.cmbHighPowerPort.getSelectedIndex() >= 0 && 
      this.cmbApplicationId.getSelectedIndex() >= 0 && 
      this.cmbAbsVariant.getSelectedIndex() >= 0 && 
      this.chbLiability.isSelected());
    this.btnOk.setEnabled(valid);
  }
  
  void resetValuesFromModel(CrmManualConfigurationDialogModel model) {
    this.model = model;
    if (this.txtBrand.isEnabled() && this.txtBrand.isVisible())
      ((JTextField)this.txtBrand).requestFocus(); 
    this.txtBrand.setText(model.getBrand());
    this.txtExternalReference.setText(model.getExternalReference());
    this.txtBikeId.setText(model.getBikeId());
    this.cmbProductline.setSelectedItem(model.getProductLine());
    this.cmbGeartype1.setSelectedItem(model.getGeartype1());
    this.txtGeartype2.setText(model.getGeartype2());
    this.txtGearratio.setText(model.getGearratio());
    this.txtHighestGearratio.setText(model.getHighestGearratio());
    this.txtLowestGearratio.setText(model.getLowestGearratio());
    this.txtWheelCircumference.setText(model.getWheelcircumference());
    this.groupWheelCircumference.setSelected(this.rbtnMM.getModel(), StringUtils.equals(this.rbtnMM.getText(), model.getWheelcircumferenceUnit()));
    this.cmbLightSwitchStatus.setSelectedItem(model.getLightSwitchStatus());
    this.cmbWalkAssistant.setSelectedItem(model.getWalkassistant());
    this.cmbLightOutput.setSelectedItem(model.getLightOutput());
    this.txtLightPower.setText(model.getLightPower());
    this.cmbHighPowerPort.setSelectedItem(model.getHighPowerPort());
    this.cmbApplicationId.setSelectedItem(model.getApplicationId());
    this.cmbAbsVariant.setSelectedItem(model.getAbsVariant());
    this.chbLiability.setSelected((!this.chbLiability.isEnabled() && model.getGeartype1() != null));
  }
  
  private boolean isBorderValid(TextField textField) {
    return CrmHelper.isBorderValid(((JTextField)textField).getBorder());
  }
  
  void setAllFieldsEnabled(boolean enabled) {
    this.btnAbort.setEnabled(enabled);
    this.chbLiability.setEnabled(enabled);
    this.cmbAbsVariant.setEnabled(enabled);
    this.cmbApplicationId.setEnabled(enabled);
    this.cmbGeartype1.setEnabled(enabled);
    this.cmbHighPowerPort.setEnabled(enabled);
    this.cmbLightOutput.setEnabled(enabled);
    this.cmbLightSwitchStatus.setEnabled(enabled);
    this.cmbProductline.setEnabled(enabled);
    this.cmbWalkAssistant.setEnabled(enabled);
    this.txtBrand.setEnabled(enabled);
    this.txtExternalReference.setEnabled(enabled);
    this.txtBikeId.setEnabled(enabled);
    this.txtGeartype2.setEnabled(enabled);
    this.txtGearratio.setEnabled(enabled);
    this.txtHighestGearratio.setEnabled(enabled);
    this.txtLowestGearratio.setEnabled(enabled);
    this.txtWheelCircumference.setEnabled(enabled);
    this.txtLightPower.setEnabled(enabled);
    adaptButtonGroupWheelCircumference(enabled);
  }
  
  private void adaptButtonGroupWheelCircumference(boolean enabled) {
    Enumeration<AbstractButton> elements = this.groupWheelCircumference.getElements();
    while (elements.hasMoreElements()) {
      AbstractButton button = elements.nextElement();
      button.setEnabled(enabled);
    } 
  }
  
  void updateWheelCircumferenceUnitInModel() {
    if (this.model == null)
      return; 
    this.model.setWheelcircumferenceUnit(this.rbtnMM.isSelected() ? this.rbtnMM.getText() : this.rbtnEtrto.getText());
  }
}

package com.gigatronik.beds.gui.crm;

import com.gigatronik.ebike.gui.testinterface.TestableJOptionPane;
import java.util.Optional;

class CrmManualConfigurationDialogController {
  private CrmManualConfigurationDialog dialog;
  
  private final CrmInternalFactory crmInternalFactory;
  
  private final CrmMainMaskPanelController crmMainMaskPanelController;
  
  public CrmManualConfigurationDialogController(CrmInternalFactory crmInternalFactory, CrmMainMaskPanelController crmMainMaskPanelController) {
    this.crmInternalFactory = crmInternalFactory;
    this.crmMainMaskPanelController = crmMainMaskPanelController;
  }
  
  void showDialogWithData(Optional<CrmManualConfigurationDialogModel> optionalModel) {
    CrmManualConfigurationDialogModel model = optionalModel.isPresent() ? optionalModel.get() : this.crmInternalFactory.createCrmManualConfigurationModel();
    createDialogIfNeccessary();
    this.dialog.resetValuesFromModel(model);
    this.dialog.pack();
    this.dialog.setLocationRelativeTo(TestableJOptionPane.getDefaultParentFrame());
    this.dialog.setVisible(true);
  }
  
  void closeDialog(boolean canceled, CrmManualConfigurationDialogModel model) {
    if (canceled) {
      model = null;
    } else {
      this.dialog.updateWheelCircumferenceUnitInModel();
    } 
    this.crmMainMaskPanelController.setOptionalCrmManualConfigurationDialogModel(Optional.ofNullable(model));
    this.dialog.setVisible(false);
  }
  
  void setAllDialogFieldsEnabled(boolean enabled) {
    createDialogIfNeccessary();
    this.dialog.setAllFieldsEnabled(enabled);
  }
  
  void createDialogIfNeccessary() {
    if (this.dialog == null)
      this.dialog = this.crmInternalFactory.createCrmManualConfigurationDialog(this); 
  }
}

  }
  
  public CrmProgressDialog(JFrame mainFrame) {
    super(mainFrame);
    setLocationRelativeTo(mainFrame);
    initComponents();
  }
  
  void setUploadProgress(int progress) {
    setProgress(progress, this.prgUpload);
  }

    this.prgUpload.setMaximum(maxProgress);
  }

    return this.btnCancel;
  }

    if (text != null && !StringUtils.equals(text, this.lblUploadText.getText()))
      this.lblUploadText.setText(text); 
  }

    this.lblFileText.setVisible(visible);
    this.prgFile.setVisible(visible);
  }

    if (text != null && !StringUtils.equals(text, this.lblFileText.getText()))
      this.lblFileText.setText(text); 
  }
  
  void setFileProgress(int progress) {
    setProgress(progress, this.prgFile);
  }
  
  void setFileMaxProgress(int maxProgress) {
    this.prgFile.setMaximum(maxProgress);
  }
  
  private void setProgress(int progress, JProgressBar progressBar) {
    if (progress < 1 || progress > progressBar.getMaximum()) {
      progressBar.setIndeterminate(true);
      progressBar.setValue(0);
    } else {
      progressBar.setValue(progress);
      progressBar.setIndeterminate(false);
    } 
  }

ITEM 98: com/gigatronik/beds/gui/crm/CrmReportAliveServerListenerOnStartImpl.java

package com.gigatronik.beds.gui.crm;

import com.gigatronik.beds.gui.customcomponents.CustomProgressDialog;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.crmclient.report.api.CrmReportAliveServerListener;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.bosch.service.internationalization.ResourceBundleFactory;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.bosch.service.internationalization.Utf8ResourceBundleFormatted;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.common.configuration.ComponentType;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.gui.testinterface.TestableJOptionPane;
import java.awt.EventQueue;
import java.util.List;
import javax.swing.SwingWorker;
import org.slf4j.Logger;
import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;

class CrmReportAliveServerListenerOnStartImpl implements CrmReportAliveServerListener {
  private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(CrmReportAliveServerListenerOnStartImpl.class);
  
  private static final Utf8ResourceBundleFormatted BUNDLE = ResourceBundleFactory.newDefaultResourceBundle();
  
  private final CrmInternalFactory crmFactory;
  
  private List<ComponentType> connectedComponentsPre;
  
  private final CustomProgressDialog readingDataProgressDlg;
  
  private final CrmMainTabPanelController crmMainTabPanelController;
  
  CrmReportAliveServerListenerOnStartImpl(CrmMainTabPanelController crmMainTabPanelController, CrmInternalFactory crmFactory) {
    this.crmFactory = crmFactory;
    this.crmMainTabPanelController = crmMainTabPanelController;
    this.readingDataProgressDlg = crmFactory.getReadingBikeDataProgressDialog();
  }
  
  void prepareStart() {
    EventQueue.invokeLater(() -> this.readingDataProgressDlg.setVisible(true));
  }
  
  private void closeReadingDataProgressDialog() {
    LOGGER.debug("Close crm service reading data progress dialog");
    this.readingDataProgressDlg.setVisible(false);
  }
  
  private void serverReady() {
    SwingWorker<Boolean, Void> worker = new SwingWorker<>() {
        protected Boolean doInBackground() {
          boolean result = CrmReportAliveServerListenerOnStartImpl.this.crmFactory.createBctChecker().doInitializationCheck();
          CrmReportAliveServerListenerOnStartImpl.this.connectedComponentsPre = CrmReportAliveServerListenerOnStartImpl.this.crmFactory.getConfigurationManager().getBikeIdentification().getAllConnectedComponentTypes();
          return result;
        }
        
        protected void done() {
          CrmReportAliveServerListenerOnStartImpl.this.closeReadingDataProgressDialog();
          boolean result = false;
          try {
            result = get();
          } catch (InterruptedException|java.util.concurrent.ExecutionException e) {
            CrmReportAliveServerListenerOnStartImpl.LOGGER.error("Error getting result from btc initialization check", (Throwable)e);
            Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
          } 
          if (!result) {
            CrmReportAliveServerListenerOnStartImpl.this.crmMainTabPanelController.switchGuiToCard(CrmMainTabPanel.Cards.CARD_BCT_HAS_WRONG_STATE, CrmReportAliveServerListenerOnStartImpl.BUNDLE.getString("Crm.StartCheckBct.InvalidBctState"), null);
          } else {
            CrmReportAliveServerListenerOnStartImpl.this.fillCrmXml();
          } 
        }
      };
    worker.execute();
  }
  
  private void fillCrmXml() {
    CrmXmlData xmlForSending = new CrmXmlData(this.crmFactory);
    List<ComponentType> connectedComponentsPost = this.crmFactory.getConfigurationManager().getBikeIdentification().getAllConnectedComponentTypes();
    if (this.connectedComponentsPre.size() == connectedComponentsPost.size()) {
      if (xmlForSending.hasNegativResponses()) {
        String title = BUNDLE.getString("EBikeReport.incompleteData.title");
        String message = BUNDLE.getString("Message.IncompleteComponentDiagnosisData") + "\n" + BUNDLE.getString("Message.IncompleteComponentDiagnosisData");
        TestableJOptionPane.showMessageDialog(message, title, 1);
      } 
    } else {
      String message = BUNDLE.getString("Crm.generatingProblem") + "\n" + BUNDLE.getString("Crm.generatingProblem");
      String title = BUNDLE.getString("EBikeReport.incompleteData.title");
      TestableJOptionPane.showMessageDialog(message, title, 2);
    } 
    this.crmMainTabPanelController.switchGuiToCard(CrmMainTabPanel.Cards.CARD_MAINMASK, "", null);
    this.crmMainTabPanelController.setXmlForSending(xmlForSending);
  }
  
  private void serverNotReady(String timeAvailableAgain, boolean aliveServiceReached) {
    closeReadingDataProgressDialog();
    this.crmMainTabPanelController.serverNotReachable(timeAvailableAgain, aliveServiceReached, false);
  }
  
  public void onServerReachable() {
    serverReady();
  }
  
  public void onServerNotReachable(String errorMessage, String timeAvailableAgain, boolean aliveServiceReached) {
    EventQueue.invokeLater(() -> serverNotReady(timeAvailableAgain, aliveServiceReached));
  }
}

package com.gigatronik.beds.gui.crm;

import com.gigatronik.beds.gui.customcomponents.CustomProgressDialog;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.crmclient.report.api.CrmRetrieveReportController;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.crmclient.report.api.CrmRetrieveReportListener;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.crmclient.report.api.RetrievedReportData;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.bosch.service.internationalization.I18NUtil;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.bosch.service.internationalization.ResourceBundleFactory;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.bosch.service.internationalization.Utf8ResourceBundleFormatted;
import java.awt.EventQueue;
import java.awt.event.ActionEvent;
import java.awt.event.ActionListener;
import org.slf4j.Logger;
import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;

class CrmReportLoading implements CrmRetrieveReportListener {
  private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(CrmReportLoading.class);
  
  private static final Utf8ResourceBundleFormatted BUNDLE = ResourceBundleFactory.newDefaultResourceBundle();
  
  private final CrmInternalFactory crmInternalFactory;
  
  private final CrmMainTabPanelController crmMainTabPanelController;
  
  private final CrmMainMaskPanelController crmMainMaskPanelController;
  
  CrmReportLoading(CrmInternalFactory crmInternalFactory, CrmMainTabPanelController crmMainTabPanelController, CrmMainMaskPanelController crmMainMaskPanelController) {
    this.crmInternalFactory = crmInternalFactory;
    this.crmMainTabPanelController = crmMainTabPanelController;
    this.crmMainMaskPanelController = crmMainMaskPanelController;
  }
  
  void getReport(String customerNumber, String serviceCaseNumber) {
    CrmRetrieveReportController crmRetrieveReportController = this.crmInternalFactory.createCrmRetrieveReportController();
    CustomProgressDialog receiveXmlDataProgressDialog = this.crmInternalFactory.getReceiveXmlDataProgressDialog();
    initDialog(receiveXmlDataProgressDialog, crmRetrieveReportController, serviceCaseNumber);
    EventQueue.invokeLater(() -> receiveXmlDataProgressDialog.setVisible(true));
    crmRetrieveReportController.retrieveReportAsync(customerNumber, serviceCaseNumber, I18NUtil.getLocale().getLanguage(), this);
  }
  
  private void initDialog(CustomProgressDialog receiveXmlDataProgressDialog, CrmRetrieveReportController crmRetrieveReportController, String serviceCaseNumber) {
    receiveXmlDataProgressDialog.getlabel().setText(String.format(BUNDLE.getString("Crm.LoadingServiceCase"), serviceCaseNumber));
    receiveXmlDataProgressDialog.setDefaultCloseOperation(0);
    for (ActionListener listener : receiveXmlDataProgressDialog.getButton().getActionListeners())
      receiveXmlDataProgressDialog.getButton().removeActionListener(listener); 
    receiveXmlDataProgressDialog.getButton().addActionListener(e -> cancelLoading(crmRetrieveReportController));
  }
  
  private void cancelLoading(CrmRetrieveReportController crmRetrieveReportController) {
    LOGGER.debug("user pressed the cancel loading service case button");
    crmRetrieveReportController.cancelReceiveRequest();
    this.crmMainTabPanelController.uploadFailed(BUNDLE.getString("Crm.uploadAbort"), BUNDLE.getString("Crm.ProvideReport"));
  }
  
  public void onRetrieveSuccess(RetrievedReportData data) {
    this.crmMainMaskPanelController.onLoadingServiceCase(data);
  }
  
  public void onRetrieveError(int errorCode) {
    this.crmMainTabPanelController.uploadFailed(errorCode, BUNDLE.getString("Crm.ProvideReport"));
    resetGui();
  }
  
  public void onRetrieveError(String errorMessage) {
    this.crmMainTabPanelController.uploadFailed(errorMessage, BUNDLE.getString("Crm.ProvideReport"));
    resetGui();
  }
  
  public void onRetrieveError() {
    onRetrieveError(BUNDLE.getString("Crm.LoadingServiceCase.Error"));
  }
  
  private void resetGui() {
    CrmHelper.delegateToEventQueue(() -> {
          String caseNumber = this.crmMainMaskPanelController.getCaseNumber();
          this.crmMainMaskPanelController.resetFormularToInitValues();
          this.crmMainMaskPanelController.setCaseNumberAndAddToHistory(caseNumber, false);
          this.crmMainMaskPanelController.setFocusToCaseNumber();
        }, true);
  }
}
