package com.gigatronik.beds.gui.crm;

import com.gigatronik.beds.service.crmclient.report.api.CrmReportSendListener;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.bosch.service.internationalization.ResourceBundleFactory;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.bosch.service.internationalization.Utf8ResourceBundleFormatted;
import java.awt.EventQueue;
import java.io.File;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Objects;
import org.slf4j.Logger;
import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;

public class CrmReportSendListenerImpl implements CrmReportSendListener {
  private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(CrmReportSendListenerImpl.class);
  
  private static final Utf8ResourceBundleFormatted BUNDLE = ResourceBundleFactory.newDefaultResourceBundle();
  
  private static final String TEXT_UPLOAD_ABORTED = BUNDLE.getString("Crm.uploadAbort");
  
  private static final String TEXT_UPLOAD_ABORTED_TITLE = BUNDLE.getString("Crm.uploadAbort.title");
  
  private static final String TEXT_UPLOAD_FILES = BUNDLE.getString("Crm.FileUpload");
  
  private final CrmMainMaskPanelController crmMainMaskPanelController;
  
  private final CrmMainTabPanelController crmMainTabPanelController;
  
  private final CrmProgressDialog crmProgressDialog;
  
  private final ArrayList<File> uploadedAttachments;
  
  private final ArrayList<File> allNotReadOnlyAttachments;
  
  private final int maxUploadFiles;
  
  CrmReportSendListenerImpl(CrmMainMaskPanelController crmMainMaskPanelController, CrmMainTabPanelController crmMainTabPanelController, CrmProgressDialog crmProgressDialog) {
    this.crmMainMaskPanelController = crmMainMaskPanelController;
    this.crmMainTabPanelController = crmMainTabPanelController;
    this.crmProgressDialog = crmProgressDialog;
    this.uploadedAttachments = crmMainMaskPanelController.getAllReadOnlyAttachments();
    this.allNotReadOnlyAttachments = crmMainMaskPanelController.getAllNotReadOnlyAttachments();
    this.maxUploadFiles = this.uploadedAttachments.size() + this.allNotReadOnlyAttachments.size();
  }
  
  public void onUploadSuccess(String caseNumber, boolean existingCase) {
    LOGGER.debug("Got an Upload success with caseNumber: {} and existingCase: {}", caseNumber, Boolean.valueOf(existingCase));
    CrmHelper.delegateToEventQueue(() -> {
          this.crmMainMaskPanelController.setCaseNumberAndAddToHistory(caseNumber, true);
          if (this.uploadedAttachments.size() == this.maxUploadFiles) {
            String message = String.format(BUNDLE.getString("Crm.ReportSuccessfulTransferedAndAssignedToServicecase"), 
                this.crmMainMaskPanelController.getCaseNumber());
            CrmUploadResultPanel uploadResultPanelWithAttachments = CrmHelper.createUploadResultPanelWithAttachments(this.uploadedAttachments, this.allNotReadOnlyAttachments);
            uploadResultPanelWithAttachments.setResultText(message);
            this.crmMainTabPanelController.uploadSuccess(uploadResultPanelWithAttachments);
          } 
          this.crmMainMaskPanelController.validateBtnSend();
        }, true);
  }
  
  public void onUploadProgress(long bytesWritten, long contentLength, boolean done) {
    LOGGER.debug("Got upload progress with bytesWritten: {}; contentLength: {} and done:{} ", bytesWritten, contentLength, 
        done);
    if (this.crmProgressDialog != null && this.crmProgressDialog.isVisible() && contentLength > 0L) {
      int value = done ? 100 : (int)((double)(bytesWritten * 100L) / (double)contentLength);
      CrmHelper.delegateToEventQueue(() -> updateProgressDialogForReport(value), false);
    } 
  }
  
  public void onError(int errorCode) {
    LOGGER.debug("Got Error with errorCode: {} ", Integer.valueOf(errorCode));
    this.crmMainTabPanelController.uploadFailed(errorCode, CrmMainTabPanelController.CRM_POPUP_TITLE);
  }
  
  public void onCancelSuccess() {
    LOGGER.info("onCancelSuccess not implemented");
    this.crmMainTabPanelController.uploadFailed(TEXT_UPLOAD_ABORTED, TEXT_UPLOAD_ABORTED_TITLE);
  }
  
  public void onUploadAttachmentSuccess(File file) {
    LOGGER.debug("success upload of file '{}', switch to eventQueue to handle it.", file.getName());
    CrmHelper.delegateToEventQueue(() -> handleAttachmentSuccess(file), true);
  }
  
  public void onUploadAttachmentProgress(long bytesUploaded, long contentLength, File file) {
    LOGGER.debug("Progress upload of Attachment. bytesUploaded: {}, contentLength: {}, file: {}", bytesUploaded, contentLength, 
        file.getName());
    CrmHelper.delegateToEventQueue(() -> updateProgressDialogForAttachments(bytesUploaded, contentLength, file), true);
  }
  
  private void updateProgressDialogForReport(int value) {
    if (this.crmProgressDialog != null) {
      this.crmProgressDialog.setUploadMaxProgress(100);
      this.crmProgressDialog.setUploadProgress(value);
      this.crmProgressDialog.getCancelButton().setEnabled((value < 100));
      this.crmProgressDialog.setUploadText(BUNDLE.getString("Crm.SendingReport"));
      this.crmProgressDialog.setFileText("");
      this.crmProgressDialog.setFileProgress(0);
      this.crmProgressDialog.setFileMaxProgress(1);
      this.crmProgressDialog.setFileElementsVisible(false);
    } 
  }
  
  private void updateProgressDialogForAttachments(long bytesUploaded, long contentLength, File file) {
    if (this.crmProgressDialog != null) {
      updateProgressDialogForAttachments();
      this.crmProgressDialog.setFileElementsVisible((this.maxUploadFiles > 0));
      this.crmProgressDialog.setFileText(Objects.nonNull(file) ? file.getName() : "");
      this.crmProgressDialog.setFileMaxProgress((int)contentLength);
      this.crmProgressDialog.setFileProgress((int)bytesUploaded);
      if (!this.crmProgressDialog.isVisible())
        EventQueue.invokeLater(() -> this.crmProgressDialog.setVisible(true)); 
    } 
  }
  
  private void updateProgressDialogForAttachments() {
    int actualFile = this.uploadedAttachments.size();
    this.crmProgressDialog.setUploadText(String.format(TEXT_UPLOAD_FILES, actualFile, this.maxUploadFiles));
    this.crmProgressDialog.setUploadProgress(actualFile);
    this.crmProgressDialog.setUploadMaxProgress(this.maxUploadFiles);
  }
  
  private void handleAttachmentSuccess(File file) {
    this.uploadedAttachments.add(file);
    this.crmProgressDialog.getCancelButton().setEnabled((this.uploadedAttachments.size() < this.maxUploadFiles));
    updateProgressDialogForAttachments();
  }
}

package com.gigatronik.beds.gui.crm;

import com.gigatronik.ebike.gui.testinterface.TestableJPanel;
import java.awt.GridBagConstraints;
import java.awt.GridBagLayout;
import java.awt.Insets;
import javax.swing.BorderFactory;
import javax.swing.ImageIcon;
import javax.swing.JLabel;

public class CrmUploadResultPanel extends TestableJPanel {
  private static final long serialVersionUID = 736248782718541131L;
  
  private int fileLabelCounter = 0;
  
  private final ImageIcon iconSuccess = new ImageIcon(getClass().getResource("/com/gigatronik/beds/gui/crm/crm_cloud_ok.png"));
  
  private final ImageIcon iconFailed = new ImageIcon(getClass().getResource("/com/gigatronik/beds/gui/crm/crm_cloud_nok.png"));
  
  private JLabel lblResultText;
  
  public CrmUploadResultPanel() {
    initComponents();
  }
  
  void addFileLabel(String text, boolean uploadSuccess) {
    if (this.fileLabelCounter == 0)
      addSpaceAfterLabel(); 
    this.fileLabelCounter++;
    JLabel label = new JLabel(text, uploadSuccess ? this.iconSuccess : this.iconFailed, 2);
    label.setName(String.format("lblFileName%d", this.fileLabelCounter));
    GridBagConstraints gridBagConstraints = new GridBagConstraints();
    gridBagConstraints.gridx = 0;
    gridBagConstraints.gridy = this.fileLabelCounter;
    gridBagConstraints.fill = 2;
    gridBagConstraints.insets = new Insets(0, 0, 5, 0);
    add(label, gridBagConstraints);
  }
  
  void setResultText(String resultMessage) {
    this.lblResultText.setText(resultMessage);
  }
  
  private void addSpaceAfterLabel() {
    GridBagLayout layout = (GridBagLayout)getLayout();
    GridBagConstraints constraints = layout.getConstraints(this.lblResultText);
    constraints.insets = new Insets(0, 0, 10, 0);
    layout.setConstraints(this.lblResultText, constraints);
  }
  
  private void initComponents() {
    this.lblResultText = new JLabel();
    setBorder(BorderFactory.createEmptyBorder(5, 5, 5, 5));
    setName("pnlUploadError");
    GridBagLayout layout = new GridBagLayout();
    layout.columnWidths = new int[] { 300 };
    layout.columnWeights = new double[] { 1.0D };
    setLayout(layout);
    this.lblResultText.setText("Upload Result");
    this.lblResultText.setName("lblResultText");
    GridBagConstraints gridBagConstraints = new GridBagConstraints();
    gridBagConstraints.gridx = 0;
    gridBagConstraints.gridy = 0;
    gridBagConstraints.fill = 2;
    add(this.lblResultText, gridBagConstraints);
  }
}

class CrmXmlData {
  private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(CrmXmlData.class);

  public CrmXmlData(CrmInternalFactory crmFactory) {
    this.crmFactory = crmFactory;
    this.foundNegativResponse = false;
    this.xmlReport = new EBikeCRMType();
    createXML();
  }
  
  private void createXML() {
    ZonedDateTime reportTimeDate = ZonedDateTime.now(ZoneId.systemDefault());
    this.xmlReport.setReportDate(reportTimeDate.toLocalDate());
    this.xmlReport.setReportTime(reportTimeDate.toOffsetDateTime().toOffsetTime());
    this.xmlReport.setPcToolVersion(ConfigUtil.getDisplayVersion());
    this.xmlReport.setIbd(new IBDType());
    this.xmlReport.getIbd().setDongleId(this.crmFactory.getTokenPluginProxy().getId());
    if (this.crmFactory.getConfigurationManager().getBikeIdentification().isBctConnected()) {
      this.xmlReport.setBct100(setBctXmlData());
      if (this.crmFactory.getConfigurationManager().getBikeIdentification().isBms1Connected())
        this.xmlReport.setBbp2XxBct(setBbpXmlData(this.crmFactory.getConfigurationManager().getBikeIdentification().getBms1Identification())); 
      return;
    } 
    if (this.crmFactory.getConfigurationManager().getBikeIdentification().isBms1Connected())
      this.xmlReport.getBbp2Xx().add(setBbpXmlData(this.crmFactory.getConfigurationManager().getBikeIdentification().getBms1Identification())); 
    if (this.crmFactory.getConfigurationManager().getBikeIdentification().isHmiConnected())
      setBuiXmlData(); 
    if (this.crmFactory.getConfigurationManager().getBikeIdentification().isDuConnected())
      this.bduType = setDuXmlData(); 
    if (this.crmFactory.getConfigurationManager().getBikeIdentification().isBms2Connected())
      this.xmlReport.getBbp2Xx().add(setBbpXmlData(this.crmFactory.getConfigurationManager().getBikeIdentification().getBms2Identification())); 
    if (this.crmFactory.getConfigurationManager().getBikeIdentification().isAbsConnected())
      this.xmlReport.setBas100(setBasXmlData()); 
    if (this.crmFactory.getConfigurationManager().getBikeIdentification().isEshiftConnected())
      this.xmlReport.setEShift(setEshiftXmlData()); 
    if (this.crmFactory.getConfigurationManager().getBikeIdentification().isBcsConnected())
      this.xmlReport.setBcs250(setBcsData()); 
  }
  
  protected boolean hasNegativResponses() {
    return this.foundNegativResponse;
  }
  
  protected EBikeCRMType getEbikeCrmType() {
    return this.xmlReport;
  }
  
  protected void finalizeXmlForSending(CrmMainMaskPanel crmMainMaskPanel, String contactEmail, Optional<CrmManualConfigurationDialogModel> optionalCrmManualConfigurationDialogModel) {
    this.xmlReport.getIbd().setContactEmail(contactEmail);
    this.xmlReport.getIbd().setContactName(crmMainMaskPanel.getTxtContactName().getText());
    this.xmlReport.getIbd().setCountry(((CrmComboBoxItem)crmMainMaskPanel.getCmbCountry().getSelectedItem()).getTextForXml());
    this.xmlReport.getIbd().setCustomerNumber(crmMainMaskPanel.getTxtCustomnumber().getText());
    this.xmlReport.setCaseInfo(new CaseInfoType());
    this.xmlReport.getCaseInfo().setCrossExchange(crmMainMaskPanel.getChbCrossExchange().isSelected());
    this.xmlReport.getCaseInfo().setDateOfPurchase(crmMainMaskPanel.getTxtPurchaseDate().getDate());
    this.xmlReport.getCaseInfo().setErrorDescription(crmMainMaskPanel.getTxtErrorDescription().getText());
    this.xmlReport.getCaseInfo().setProductFamily(((CrmComboBoxItem)crmMainMaskPanel.getCmbProductfamily().getSelectedItem()).getTextForXml());
    this.xmlReport.getCaseInfo().setSerialNumberManual(crmMainMaskPanel.getTxtSerialNumber().getText());
    this.xmlReport.getCaseInfo().setPartNumberManual(crmMainMaskPanel.getTxtPartNumber().getText());
    setDuData(optionalCrmManualConfigurationDialogModel);
  }
  
  private void setDuData(Optional<CrmManualConfigurationDialogModel> optionalCrmManualConfigurationDialogModel) {
    if (this.bduType != null) {
      this.xmlReport.setDuxxxmanual(null);
      this.xmlReport.setBduxxx(this.bduType);
    } else if (optionalCrmManualConfigurationDialogModel.isPresent()) {
      this.xmlReport.setBduxxx(null);
      this.xmlReport.setDuxxxmanual(createDuxxxmanual(optionalCrmManualConfigurationDialogModel.get()));
    } else {
      LOGGER.error("There is no connected bdu data and no manual bdu configuration. This should never happen.");
    } 
  }
  
  private EBikeCRMType setBuiXmlData() {
    BUI21XType bUI21XType;
    BUI25XType bUI25XType;
    BUI27XType bUI27XType;
    BUI33XType bUI33XType;
    BUI35XType bUI35XType;
    CUI1XxType cUI1XxType;
    HmiIdentification hmi = this.crmFactory.getConfigurationManager().getBikeIdentification().getHmiIdentification();
    String hwVersion = getComplexResponseValueEnglish(this.crmFactory.getServiceParameterDatapool().getServiceParameter((ServiceParameter)HmiServiceParameter.HW_VERSION), true);
    String partNo = getComplexResponseValueEnglish(this.crmFactory.getServiceParameterDatapool().getServiceParameter((ServiceParameter)HmiServiceParameter.PART_NUMBER), true);
    String productCode = getComplexResponseValueEnglish(this.crmFactory.getServiceParameterDatapool().getServiceParameter((ServiceParameter)HmiServiceParameter.PRODUCT_CODE), true);
    ComplexResponse serialNumber = this.crmFactory.getServiceParameterDatapool().getServiceParameter((ServiceParameter)HmiServiceParameter.SERIAL_NUMBER);
    String swVersion = getComplexResponseValueEnglish(this.crmFactory.getServiceParameterDatapool().getServiceParameter((ServiceParameter)HmiServiceParameter.SW_VERSION), true);
    DtcResponse dtcResponse = this.crmFactory.getServiceParameterDatapool().getErrorMemoryContent(ServiceParameter.Ecu.HMI);
    ECUType ecuType = null;
    switch (hmi.getComponentType()) {
      case COMP_BUI210:
      case COMP_BUI215:
        this.xmlReport.setBui21X(new BUI21XType());
        this.xmlReport.getBui21X().setHwVersion(hwVersion);
        this.xmlReport.getBui21X().setPartNumber(partNo);
        this.xmlReport.getBui21X().setProductCode(productCode);
        this.xmlReport.getBui21X().setSerialNumber(getComplexResponseValueEnglish(SerialNumberHelper.getSerialnumberBui21x(serialNumber), true));
        this.xmlReport.getBui21X().setSwVersion(swVersion);
        this.xmlReport.getBui21X().setFblMode(hmi.isBootLoader());
        this.xmlReport.getBui21X().setHwSample(hmi.isHwSample());
        this.xmlReport.getBui21X().setSwSample(hmi.isSwSample());
        this.xmlReport.getBui21X().setDistanceUnit(getComplexResponseValueEnglish(this.crmFactory.getServiceParameterDatapool().getServiceParameter((ServiceParameter)HmiServiceParameter.DISTANCE_UNIT), true));
        this.xmlReport.getBui21X().setStatusBattery(getComplexResponseValueEnglish(this.crmFactory.getServiceParameterDatapool().getServiceParameter((ServiceParameter)HmiServiceParameter.BATTERY_STATE), true));
        bUI21XType = this.xmlReport.getBui21X();
        break;
      case COMP_BUI250:
      case COMP_BUI251:
      case COMP_BUI255:
        this.xmlReport.setBui25X(new BUI25XType());
        this.xmlReport.getBui25X().setHwVersion(hwVersion);
        this.xmlReport.getBui25X().setPartNumber(partNo);
        this.xmlReport.getBui25X().setProductCode(productCode);
        this.xmlReport.getBui25X().setSerialNumber(getComplexResponseValueEnglish(SerialNumberHelper.getSerialnumberBui25x(serialNumber), true));
        this.xmlReport.getBui25X().setSwVersion(swVersion);
        this.xmlReport.getBui25X().setFblMode(hmi.isBootLoader());
        this.xmlReport.getBui25X().setHwSample(hmi.isHwSample());
        this.xmlReport.getBui25X().setSwSample(hmi.isSwSample());
        this.xmlReport.getBui25X().setDistanceUnit(getComplexResponseValueEnglish(this.crmFactory.getServiceParameterDatapool().getServiceParameter((ServiceParameter)HmiServiceParameter.DISTANCE_UNIT), true));
        bUI25XType = this.xmlReport.getBui25X();
        break;
      case COMP_BUI270:
      case COMP_BUI275:
        this.xmlReport.setBui27X(new BUI27XType());
        this.xmlReport.getBui27X().setHwVersion(hwVersion);
        this.xmlReport.getBui27X().setPartNumber(partNo);
        this.xmlReport.getBui27X().setProductCode(productCode);
        this.xmlReport.getBui27X().setSerialNumber(getComplexResponseValueEnglish(SerialNumberHelper.getSerialnumberBui27x(serialNumber), true));
        this.xmlReport.getBui27X().setSwVersion(swVersion);
        this.xmlReport.getBui27X().setFblMode(hmi.isBootLoader());
        this.xmlReport.getBui27X().setHwSample(hmi.isHwSample());
        this.xmlReport.getBui27X().setSwSample(hmi.isSwSample());
        this.xmlReport.getBui27X().setSwVersionFrontEnd(getComplexResponseValueEnglish(this.crmFactory.getServiceParameterDatapool().getServiceParameter((ServiceParameter)HmiServiceParameter.SW_VERSION_FRONTEND), true));
        this.xmlReport.getBui27X().setSwVersionMap(getComplexResponseValueEnglish(this.crmFactory.getServiceParameterDatapool().getServiceParameter((ServiceParameter)HmiServiceParameter.MAP_VERSION_REQUIRED), true));
        this.xmlReport.getBui27X().setBatteryChargeState(getComplexResponseValueEnglish(this.crmFactory.getServiceParameterDatapool().getServiceParameter((ServiceParameter)HmiServiceParameter.BATTERY_CHARGE_VALUE), true));
        this.xmlReport.getBui27X().setUdam1(getComplexResponseListValueEnglish(this.crmFactory.getServiceParameterDatapool().getServiceParameter((ServiceParameter)HmiServiceParameter.UDAM_DATA), "UserDefinedAssistanceMode1", true));
        this.xmlReport.getBui27X().setUdam2(getComplexResponseListValueEnglish(this.crmFactory.getServiceParameterDatapool().getServiceParameter((ServiceParameter)HmiServiceParameter.UDAM_DATA), "UserDefinedAssistanceMode2", true));
        this.xmlReport.getBui27X().setUdam3(getComplexResponseListValueEnglish(this.crmFactory.getServiceParameterDatapool().getServiceParameter((ServiceParameter)HmiServiceParameter.UDAM_DATA), "UserDefinedAssistanceMode3", true));
        this.xmlReport.getBui27X().setUdam4(getComplexResponseListValueEnglish(this.crmFactory.getServiceParameterDatapool().getServiceParameter((ServiceParameter)HmiServiceParameter.UDAM_DATA), "UserDefinedAssistanceMode4", true));
        bUI27XType = this.xmlReport.getBui27X();
        break;
      case COMP_BUI330:
        this.xmlReport.setBui330(new BUI33XType());
        this.xmlReport.getBui330().setHwVersion(hwVersion);
        this.xmlReport.getBui330().setPartNumber(partNo);
        this.xmlReport.getBui330().setProductCode(productCode);
        this.xmlReport.getBui330().setSerialNumber(getComplexResponseValueEnglish(SerialNumberHelper.getSerialnumberBui33x(serialNumber), true));
        this.xmlReport.getBui330().setSwVersion(swVersion);
        this.xmlReport.getBui330().setFblMode(hmi.isBootLoader());
        this.xmlReport.getBui330().setHwSample(hmi.isHwSample());
        this.xmlReport.getBui330().setSwSample(hmi.isSwSample());
        this.xmlReport.getBui330().setBatteryChargeState(getComplexResponseValueEnglish(this.crmFactory.getServiceParameterDatapool().getServiceParameter((ServiceParameter)HmiServiceParameter.BATTERY_CHARGE_VALUE), true));
        bUI33XType = this.xmlReport.getBui330();
        break;
      case COMP_BUI350:
        this.xmlReport.setBui350(new BUI35XType());
        this.xmlReport.getBui350().setHwVersion(hwVersion);
        this.xmlReport.getBui350().setPartNumber(partNo);
        this.xmlReport.getBui350().setProductCode(productCode);
        this.xmlReport.getBui350().setSerialNumber(getComplexResponseValueEnglish(serialNumber, true));
        this.xmlReport.getBui350().setSwVersion(swVersion);
        this.xmlReport.getBui350().setFblMode(hmi.isBootLoader());
        this.xmlReport.getBui350().setHwSample(hmi.isHwSample());
        this.xmlReport.getBui350().setSwSample(hmi.isSwSample());
        this.xmlReport.getBui350().setSwVersionFrontEnd(getComplexResponseValueEnglish(this.crmFactory.getServiceParameterDatapool().getServiceParameter((ServiceParameter)HmiServiceParameter.SW_VERSION_FRONTEND), true));
        this.xmlReport.getBui350().setSwVersionMap(getComplexResponseValueEnglish(this.crmFactory.getServiceParameterDatapool().getServiceParameter((ServiceParameter)HmiServiceParameter.MAP_VERSION_REQUIRED), true));
        this.xmlReport.getBui350().setBatteryChargeState(getComplexResponseValueEnglish(this.crmFactory.getServiceParameterDatapool().getServiceParameter((ServiceParameter)HmiServiceParameter.BATTERY_CHARGE_VALUE), true));
        this.xmlReport.getBui350().setUdam1(getComplexResponseListValueEnglish(this.crmFactory.getServiceParameterDatapool().getServiceParameter((ServiceParameter)HmiServiceParameter.UDAM_DATA), "UserDefinedAssistanceMode1", true));
        this.xmlReport.getBui350().setUdam2(getComplexResponseListValueEnglish(this.crmFactory.getServiceParameterDatapool().getServiceParameter((ServiceParameter)HmiServiceParameter.UDAM_DATA), "UserDefinedAssistanceMode2", true));
        this.xmlReport.getBui350().setUdam3(getComplexResponseListValueEnglish(this.crmFactory.getServiceParameterDatapool().getServiceParameter((ServiceParameter)HmiServiceParameter.UDAM_DATA), "UserDefinedAssistanceMode3", true));
        this.xmlReport.getBui350().setUdam4(getComplexResponseListValueEnglish(this.crmFactory.getServiceParameterDatapool().getServiceParameter((ServiceParameter)HmiServiceParameter.UDAM_DATA), "UserDefinedAssistanceMode4", true));
        bUI35XType = this.xmlReport.getBui350();
        break;
      case COMP_CUI100:
        this.xmlReport.setCui1Xx(new CUI1XxType());
        this.xmlReport.getCui1Xx().setHwVersion(hwVersion);
        this.xmlReport.getCui1Xx().setPartNumber(partNo);
        this.xmlReport.getCui1Xx().setProductCode(productCode);
        this.xmlReport.getCui1Xx().setSerialNumber(getComplexResponseValueEnglish(serialNumber, true));
        this.xmlReport.getCui1Xx().setSwVersion(swVersion);
        this.xmlReport.getCui1Xx().setFblMode(hmi.isBootLoader());

  private BDUxxxType setDuXmlData() {
    DuIdentification du = this.crmFactory.getConfigurationManager().getBikeIdentification().getDuIdentification();
    ComponentType componentType = du.getComponentType();
    BDUxxxType bduXml = new BDUxxxType();
    bduXml.setHwVersion(getComplexResponseValueEnglish(this.crmFactory.getServiceParameterDatapool().getServiceParameter((ServiceParameter)DuServiceParameter.HW_VERSION)));
    bduXml.setSwVersion(getComplexResponseValueEnglish(this.crmFactory.getServiceParameterDatapool().getServiceParameter((ServiceParameter)DuServiceParameter.SW_VERSION)));
    bduXml.setFblMode(du.isBootLoader());
    bduXml.setHwSample(du.isHwSample());
    bduXml.setSwSample(du.isSwSample());
    bduXml.setApplicationId(getComplexResponseValueEnglish(this.crmFactory.getServiceParameterDatapool().getServiceParameter((ServiceParameter)DuServiceParameter.APPLICATION_ID)));
    bduXml.setProductLine(getComplexResponseValueEnglish(this.crmFactory.getServiceParameterDatapool().getServiceParameter((ServiceParameter)DuServiceParameter.PRODUCT_LINE)));
    bduXml.setBikeType(getComplexResponseValueEnglish(this.crmFactory.getServiceParameterDatapool().getServiceParameter((ServiceParameter)DuServiceParameter.BIKE_TYPE)));
    bduXml.setDateOfManufacture(getComplexResponseValueEnglish(this.crmFactory.getServiceParameterDatapool().getServiceParameter((ServiceParameter)DuServiceParameter.BIKE_DATE_OF_MANUFACTURE)));
    bduXml.setPartNumber(getComplexResponseValueEnglish(this.crmFactory.getServiceParameterDatapool().getServiceParameter((ServiceParameter)DuServiceParameter.PART_NUMBER)));
    bduXml.setSerialNumber(getComplexResponseValueEnglish(this.crmFactory.getServiceParameterDatapool().getServiceParameter((ServiceParameter)DuServiceParameter.SERIAL_NUMBER)));
    bduXml.setBikeId(getComplexResponseValueEnglish(this.crmFactory.getServiceParameterDatapool().getServiceParameter((ServiceParameter)DuServiceParameter.BIKE_ID)));
    bduXml.setHighestGearRatio(getComplexResponseValueEnglish(this.crmFactory.getServiceParameterDatapool().getServiceParameter((ServiceParameter)DuServiceParameter.HIGHEST_WHEEL_RATIO)));
    bduXml.setLowestGearRatio(getComplexResponseValueEnglish(this.crmFactory.getServiceParameterDatapool().getServiceParameter((ServiceParameter)DuServiceParameter.LOWEST_WHEEL_RATIO)));
    bduXml.setWheelCircumference(getComplexResponseValueEnglish(this.crmFactory.getServiceParameterDatapool().getServiceParameter((ServiceParameter)DuServiceParameter.WHEELSIZE_CIRCUMFERENCE)));
    bduXml.setLightSwitchStatus(getComplexResponseValueEnglish(CustomizeResponsesForDisplaying.customizeLightSwitchingMode(this.crmFactory.getServiceParameterDatapool().getServiceParameter((ServiceParameter)DuServiceParameter.LIGHT_SWITCH_STATUS), BUNDLE_EN)));
    bduXml.setWalkAssist(getComplexResponseValueEnglish(this.crmFactory.getServiceParameterDatapool().getServiceParameter((ServiceParameter)DuServiceParameter.WALK_ASSIST_STATE)));
    bduXml.setTotalActiveOperatingTime(getComplexResponseValueEnglish(this.crmFactory.getServiceParameterDatapool().getServiceParameter((ServiceParameter)DuServiceParameter.TOT_ACTIVE_OPERATINGTIME_WITH_ASSIST)));
    bduXml.setTotalOperatingTime(getComplexResponseValueEnglish(this.crmFactory.getServiceParameterDatapool().getServiceParameter((ServiceParameter)DuServiceParameter.TOT_PASSIVE_OPERATINGTIME_WITHOUT_ASSIST)));
    bduXml.setMaxSpeedAssistance(getComplexResponseValueEnglish(this.crmFactory.getServiceParameterDatapool().getServiceParameter((ServiceParameter)DuServiceParameter.MAX_SPEED_FOR_ASSISTANCE)));
    bduXml.setProductCode(getComplexResponseValueEnglish(this.crmFactory.getServiceParameterDatapool().getServiceParameter((ServiceParameter)DuServiceParameter.PRODUCT_CODE)));
    bduXml.setWheelSizeCorrection(getComplexResponseValueEnglish(this.crmFactory.getServiceParameterDatapool().getServiceParameter((ServiceParameter)DuServiceParameter.WHEELSIZE_CORRECTION)));
    bduXml.setLightOutput(getComplexResponseValueEnglish(CustomizeResponsesForDisplaying.customizeLightPowerSupplyLevel(this.crmFactory.getServiceParameterDatapool().getServiceParameter((ServiceParameter)DuServiceParameter.LIGHT_OUTPUT), (!componentType.isBDU1xx() && !componentType.isBDU2xx()))));
    bduXml.setDriveOff(getComplexResponseValueEnglish(this.crmFactory.getServiceParameterDatapool().getServiceParameter((ServiceParameter)DuServiceParameter.DRIVE_OFF_STATE)));
    bduXml.setEBikeAbsVariant(getComplexResponseValueEnglish(this.crmFactory.getServiceParameterDatapool().getServiceParameter((ServiceParameter)DuServiceParameter.ABS_VARIANT_ID)));
    bduXml.setHmiLess(getComplexResponseValueEnglish(this.crmFactory.getServiceParameterDatapool().getServiceParameter((ServiceParameter)DuServiceParameter.HMI_LESS_SYSTEM)));
    bduXml.setOdometer(getComplexResponseValueEnglish(this.crmFactory.getServiceParameterDatapool().getServiceParameter((ServiceParameter)DuServiceParameter.ODOMETER)));
    bduXml.setManipulation(getComplexResponseValueEnglish(CustomizeResponsesForDisplaying.customizeManipulationDetected(this.crmFactory.getServiceParameterDatapool().getServiceParameter((ServiceParameter)DuServiceParameter.MANIPULATION), BUNDLE_EN)));
    bduXml.setNumberDetectedManipulations(getComplexResponseValueEnglish(this.crmFactory.getServiceParameterDatapool().getServiceParameter((ServiceParameter)DuServiceParameter.MANIPULATIONS_NUMBER)));
    bduXml.setEshiftAutoGear(getComplexResponseValueEnglish(this.crmFactory.getConfigurationManager().getBikeIdentification().getEShiftIdentification().getAutoGearStateResponse()));
    bduXml.setEshiftAutoDownShift(getComplexResponseValueEnglish(this.crmFactory.getServiceParameterDatapool().getServiceParameter((ServiceParameter)DuServiceParameter.AUTO_DOWN_SHIFT)));
    bduXml.setEshiftDefaultGear(getComplexResponseValueEnglish(this.crmFactory.getServiceParameterDatapool().getServiceParameter((ServiceParameter)DuServiceParameter.DEFAULT_GEAR)));
    ServiceParameter[] dataDuStatistic = { 
        (ServiceParameter)DuServiceParameter.ASSISTANCE_MODE_DISTANCE_OFF, (ServiceParameter)DuServiceParameter.ASSISTANCE_MODE_DISTANCE_SPORT, (ServiceParameter)DuServiceParameter.ASSISTANCE_MODE_DISTANCE_TURBO, (ServiceParameter)DuServiceParameter.ASSISTANCE_MODE_DISTANCE_ECO, (ServiceParameter)DuServiceParameter.ASSISTANCE_MODE_DISTANCE_TOUR, (ServiceParameter)DuServiceParameter.ASSISTANCE_MODE_DISTANCE_USER1, (ServiceParameter)DuServiceParameter.ASSISTANCE_MODE_DISTANCE_USER2, (ServiceParameter)DuServiceParameter.ASSISTANCE_MODE_DISTANCE_USER3, (ServiceParameter)DuServiceParameter.ASSISTANCE_MODE_DISTANCE_USER4, (ServiceParameter)DuServiceParameter.ASSISTANCE_MODE_ENERGY_SPORT,

  private void setDtcXmlData(ECUType ecuType, String ecu, DtcResponse dtcResponse) {
    if (dtcResponse.isPositive()) {
      if (dtcResponse.getDtcs().isEmpty())
        return; 
      dtcResponse.getDtcs().forEach(dtc -> {
            StringBuilder keyDescription = new StringBuilder();
            keyDescription.append("ErrorManagerConfiguration.");
            keyDescription.append(ecu.toUpperCase());
            keyDescription.append(".");
            keyDescription.append(dtc.getHexCode());
            keyDescription.append(".description");
            String description = BUNDLE_EN.getString(keyDescription.toString());
            if (description.equals(keyDescription.toString()))
              description = dtc.getText(); 
            DTCType dtcXml = new DTCType();
            dtcXml.setErrorCode(dtc.getHexCode());
            dtcXml.setDescription(description);
            ecuType.getDtcs().add(dtcXml);
          });
    } else if (dtcResponse.isNegative()) {
      DTCType dtcXml = new DTCType();
      dtcXml.setErrorCode("");
      dtcXml.setDescription(BUNDLE_EN.getString("EBikeServiceTab.NEGATIVE_RESPONSE"));
      ecuType.getDtcs().add(dtcXml);
    } 
  }
  
  private String getComplexResponseListValueEnglish(ComplexResponse response, String udam, boolean ignoreNegativeResponse) {
    if (response == null)
      return ""; 
    try {
      response = new ComplexResponse(response.getParameterByName(udam).getValue());
    } catch (ComplexResponse.DataAccessException ex) {
      LOGGER.error("error parsing list response", (Throwable)ex);
    } 
    return getComplexResponseValueEnglish(response, ignoreNegativeResponse);
  }
  
  private String getComplexResponseValueEnglish(ComplexResponse response) {
    return getComplexResponseValueEnglish(response, false);
  }
  
  private String getComplexResponseValueEnglish(ComplexResponse response, boolean ignoreNegativeResponse) {
    if (response == null)
      return ""; 
    if (response.isPositive())
      return removeNonPrintableChars(response.toString()); 
    try {
      NegativeResponse negativ = response.getNegativeResponse();
      if (!ignoreNegativeResponse && negativ != NegativeResponse.REQUEST_OUT_OF_RANGE)
        this.foundNegativResponse = true; 
      return BUNDLE_EN.getString(negativ.getErrorTextKey());
    } catch (ComplexResponse.DataAccessException ex) {
      LOGGER.error("Error parsing negative response", (Throwable)ex);
      return "";
    } 
  }
  
  private String getPositiveComplexResponseValue(ComplexResponse response) {
    if (response != null && response.isPositive())
      return getComplexResponseValueEnglish(response, false); 
    return "";
  }
  
  private String calcEnergyComnsumption(Map<String, ComplexResponse> dataDuStatistic) {
    if (this.crmFactory.getConfigurationManager().getBikeIdentification().isHmiConnected()) {
      HmiIdentification hmi = this.crmFactory.getConfigurationManager().getBikeIdentification().getHmiIdentification();
      double sumDistance = 0.0D;
      double sumEnergy = 0.0D;
      if (hmi.getComponentType().isBUI25x()) {
        sumDistance = getSummary(false, false, dataDuStatistic);
        sumEnergy = getSummary(true, false, dataDuStatistic);
      } else if (hmi.getComponentType().isNyon()) {
        sumDistance = getSummary(false, true, dataDuStatistic);
        sumEnergy = getSummary(true, true, dataDuStatistic);
      } 
      if (sumDistance != 0.0D)
        return String.format("%.1f", sumEnergy * 100.0D / 3600.0D / sumDistance); 
    } 
    return "0.0";
  }
  
  private double getSummary(boolean forEnergy, boolean hasUserModes, Map<String, ComplexResponse> dataDuStatistic) {
    if (dataDuStatistic.isEmpty())
      return 0.0D; 
    String keyStart = "ASSIST_MODE_DISTANCE_";
    if (forEnergy)
      keyStart = "ASSIST_MODE_ENERGY_"; 
    List<AssistanceMode> modes = new LinkedList<>();
    modes.addAll(Arrays.asList(AssistanceMode.getBasicModes()));
    if (hasUserModes)
      modes.addAll(Arrays.asList(AssistanceMode.getUserModes())); 
    double summary = 0.0D;
    for (int i = 0; i < modes.size(); i++) {
      ComplexResponse response = dataDuStatistic.getOrDefault(keyStart + keyStart, DEFAULT_RESPONSE);
      if (response.isPositive() && StringUtils.isNotBlank(response.toString()))
        try {
          summary += Double.parseDouble(response.toString());
        } catch (NumberFormatException ex) {
          LOGGER.warn("Value '{}' is not double. Ignore it.", response);
        }  
    } 
    return summary;
  }
  
  private String removeNonPrintableChars(String value) {
    if (StringUtils.isEmpty(value))
      return ""; 
    return value.replaceAll("[^\\p{Print}]", "");
  }
  
  private DUxxxManualType createDuxxxmanual(CrmManualConfigurationDialogModel manualDuConfig) {
    DUxxxManualType duxxxManualType = new DUxxxManualType();

    duxxxManualType.setGearType1(manualDuConfig.getGeartype1().getTextForXml());
    duxxxManualType.setGearType2(manualDuConfig.getGeartype2());
    duxxxManualType.setHighPowerPort(Boolean.parseBoolean(manualDuConfig.getHighPowerPort().getTextForXml()));
    duxxxManualType.setHighestGearRatio(manualDuConfig.getHighestGearratio());
    duxxxManualType.setLightOutput(manualDuConfig.getLightOutput().getTextForXml());
    duxxxManualType.setLightPower(manualDuConfig.getLightPower());
    duxxxManualType.setLightSwitchStatus(manualDuConfig.getLightSwitchStatus().getTextForXml());
    duxxxManualType.setLowestGearRatio(manualDuConfig.getLowestGearratio());
    duxxxManualType.setProductLine(manualDuConfig.getProductLine().getTextForXml());
    duxxxManualType.setWalkAssist(Boolean.parseBoolean(manualDuConfig.getWalkassistant().getTextForXml()));
    duxxxManualType.setWheelCircumferenceUnit(manualDuConfig.getWheelcircumferenceUnit());
    duxxxManualType.setWheelCircumferenceValue(manualDuConfig.getWheelcircumference());
    return duxxxManualType;
  }

package com.gigatronik.beds.gui.customcomponents;

import com.gigatronik.ebike.gui.testinterface.TestableJPanel;
import java.awt.Container;
import java.awt.event.ActionListener;

import java.util.List;
import javax.swing.BorderFactory;
import javax.swing.GroupLayout;
import javax.swing.border.Border;
import org.slf4j.Logger;
import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;

public class ButtonPanel extends TestableJPanel {
  private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(ButtonPanel.class);
  
  private static final long serialVersionUID = -4773552395319935810L;
  
  private static final int KEYBOARD_BUTTON_TRIGGER_KEY = 10;
  
  private static final int MOUSE_BUTTON_TRIGGER_BUTTON = 1;
  
  private final transient Border raisedetched = BorderFactory.createEtchedBorder(0);
  
  private final transient Border loweredetched = BorderFactory.createEtchedBorder(1);
  
  private final transient Border noBorder = BorderFactory.createEmptyBorder();
  
  private final transient List<ActionListener> listeners = new LinkedList<>();
  
  private boolean paintDefaultBorder = true;
  
  public ButtonPanel() {
    initComponents();
  }
  
  public void addActionListener(ActionListener l) {
    this.listeners.add(l);
  }
  
  public void removeActionListener(ActionListener l) {
    this.listeners.remove(l);
  }
  
  private void press() {
    if (this.paintDefaultBorder) {
      setBorder(this.loweredetched);
    } else {
      setBorder(this.noBorder);
    } 
  }
  
  private void release() {
    if (this.paintDefaultBorder) {
      setBorder(this.raisedetched);
    } else {
      setBorder(this.noBorder);
    } 
  }
  
  private void fireActionPerformed() {
    for (ActionListener listener : this.listeners)
      listener.actionPerformed(null); 
  }
  
  public void setPaintDefaultBorder(boolean paintDefaultBorder) {
    this.paintDefaultBorder = paintDefaultBorder;
  }
  
  private void initComponents() {
    addMouseListener(new MouseAdapter() {
          public void mousePressed(MouseEvent evt) {
            ButtonPanel.this.formMousePressed(evt);
          }
          
          public void mouseReleased(MouseEvent evt) {
            ButtonPanel.this.formMouseReleased(evt);
          }
          
          public void mouseClicked(MouseEvent evt) {
            ButtonPanel.this.formMouseClicked(evt);
          }
        });
    addKeyListener(new KeyAdapter() {
          public void keyTyped(KeyEvent evt) {
            ButtonPanel.this.formKeyTyped(evt);
          }
          
          public void keyPressed(KeyEvent evt) {
            ButtonPanel.this.formKeyPressed(evt);
          }
          
          public void keyReleased(KeyEvent evt) {
            ButtonPanel.this.formKeyReleased(evt);
          }
        });
    GroupLayout layout = new GroupLayout((Container)this);
    setLayout(layout);
    layout.setHorizontalGroup(
        layout.createParallelGroup(GroupLayout.Alignment.LEADING)
        .addGap(0, 400, 32767));
    layout.setVerticalGroup(
        layout.createParallelGroup(GroupLayout.Alignment.LEADING)
        .addGap(0, 300, 32767));
  }
  
  private void formKeyPressed(KeyEvent evt) {
    if (evt.getKeyChar() == '\n') {
      LOGGER.trace("Key pressed", evt);
      press();
    } 
  }
  
  private void formKeyReleased(KeyEvent evt) {
    if (evt.getKeyChar() == '\n') {
      LOGGER.trace("Key released", evt);
      release();
    } 
  }
  
  private void formKeyTyped(KeyEvent evt) {
    if (evt.getKeyChar() == '\n') {
      LOGGER.trace("Key typed", evt);
      fireActionPerformed();
    } 
  }
  
  private void formMouseClicked(MouseEvent evt) {
    if (evt.getButton() == 1)
      fireActionPerformed(); 
  }
  
  private void formMousePressed(MouseEvent evt) {
    if (evt.getButton() == 1) {
      LOGGER.trace("Mouse pressed", evt);
      press();
    } 
  }
  
  private void formMouseReleased(MouseEvent evt) {
    if (evt.getButton() == 1) {
      LOGGER.trace("Mouse released", evt);
      release();
    } 
  }
  
  public void onClickComponentWsdl() {
    fireActionPerformed();
  }
}

ITEM 108: com/gigatronik/beds/gui/customcomponents/CustomPopup.java
========================================================================================================================
package com.gigatronik.beds.gui.customcomponents;

import java.awt.BasicStroke;
import java.awt.Color;
import java.awt.Component;
import java.awt.Dimension;
import java.awt.Graphics;
import java.awt.Graphics2D;
import java.awt.Point;
import java.awt.Polygon;
import java.awt.Shape;
import java.awt.event.AdjustmentEvent;
import java.awt.event.AdjustmentListener;
import java.awt.event.ComponentAdapter;
import java.awt.event.ComponentEvent;
import java.awt.geom.GeneralPath;
import java.awt.geom.Rectangle2D;
import java.awt.geom.RoundRectangle2D;
import javax.swing.JDialog;
import javax.swing.JPanel;
import javax.swing.JScrollPane;
import javax.swing.JTextArea;
import javax.swing.SwingUtilities;

public class CustomPopup {
  private JDialog dialog;
  
  private JTextArea txtArea;
  
  private final Component parentComponent;
  
  private ComponentAdapter frameAdapter;
  
  private AdjustmentListener scrollPaneAdapter;
  
  private final Style popupStyle;
  
  private int borderSize = 0;
  
  private Color borderColor = Color.black;
  
  private Point scrollOffset = new Point(0, 0);
  
  public enum Style {
    RECTANGLE, ROUNDED_RECTANGLE, BUBBLE;
  }
  
  public CustomPopup(Component component, Dimension size, Point offset, String text, Style style) {
    this.parentComponent = component;
    Point position = this.parentComponent.getLocationOnScreen();
    position.x += offset.x;
    position.y += offset.y;
    this.popupStyle = style;
    createPopup(position, size, text, style);
    addParentFrameAdapter(position, size);
    addScrollPaneAdapter();
  }
  
  public void setText(String text) {
    this.txtArea.setText(text);
  }
  
  public void setBorder(int size, Color color) {
    this.borderSize = size;
    this.borderColor = color;
  }
  
  public void setVisible(boolean b) {
    this.dialog.setVisible(b);
  }
  
  public boolean isVisible() {
    return this.dialog.isVisible();
  }
  
  public void dispose() {
    removeParentFrameAdapter();
    removeScrollPaneAdapter();
    this.dialog.dispose();
  }
  
  private void addParentFrameAdapter(Point position, Dimension size) {
    Component parentFrame = SwingUtilities.getRoot(this.parentComponent);
    if (parentFrame != null) {
      final Point frameOffset = new Point(position.x - parentFrame.getX(), position.y - parentFrame.getY() - size.height);
      this.frameAdapter = new ComponentAdapter() {
          public void componentMoved(ComponentEvent evt) {
            Point xy = evt.getComponent().getLocationOnScreen();
            xy.translate(frameOffset.x - CustomPopup.this.scrollOffset.x, frameOffset.y - CustomPopup.this.scrollOffset.y);
            CustomPopup.this.dialog.setLocation(xy);
          }
        };
      parentFrame.addComponentListener(this.frameAdapter);
    } 
  }
  
  private void removeParentFrameAdapter() {
    if (this.frameAdapter != null) {
      Component parentFrame = SwingUtilities.getRoot(this.parentComponent);
      if (parentFrame != null)
        parentFrame.removeComponentListener(this.frameAdapter); 
    } 
  }
  
  private void addScrollPaneAdapter() {
    final JScrollPane scrollPane = getScrollPane();
    if (scrollPane != null) {
      this.scrollPaneAdapter = new AdjustmentListener() {
          int xOld;
          
          int yOld;
          
          {
            this.xOld = scrollPane.getHorizontalScrollBar().getValue();
            this.yOld = scrollPane.getVerticalScrollBar().getValue();
          }
          
          public void adjustmentValueChanged(AdjustmentEvent e) {
            Point xy = CustomPopup.this.dialog.getLocation();
            if (e.getSource() == scrollPane.getVerticalScrollBar()) {
              CustomPopup.this.scrollOffset.y = scrollPane.getVerticalScrollBar().getValue();
              xy.y = xy.y - CustomPopup.this.scrollOffset.y + this.yOld;
              this.yOld = CustomPopup.this.scrollOffset.y;
            } else if (e.getSource() == scrollPane.getHorizontalScrollBar()) {
              CustomPopup.this.scrollOffset.x = scrollPane.getHorizontalScrollBar().getValue();
              xy.x = xy.x - CustomPopup.this.scrollOffset.x + this.xOld;
              this.xOld = CustomPopup.this.scrollOffset.x;
            } 
            CustomPopup.this.dialog.setLocation(xy);
          }
        };
      scrollPane.getVerticalScrollBar().addAdjustmentListener(this.scrollPaneAdapter);
      scrollPane.getHorizontalScrollBar().addAdjustmentListener(this.scrollPaneAdapter);
    } 
  }
  
  private void removeScrollPaneAdapter() {
    if (this.scrollPaneAdapter != null) {
      JScrollPane scrollPane = getScrollPane();
      if (scrollPane != null) {
        scrollPane.getVerticalScrollBar().removeAdjustmentListener(this.scrollPaneAdapter);
        scrollPane.getHorizontalScrollBar().removeAdjustmentListener(this.scrollPaneAdapter);
      } 
    } 
  }
  
  private JScrollPane getScrollPane() {
    for (Component p = this.parentComponent; p != null; p = p.getParent()) {
      if (p instanceof JScrollPane)
        return (JScrollPane)p; 
    } 
    return null;
  }
  
  private void createPopup(Point xy, Dimension size, String text, Style style) {
    switch (style) {
      case BUBBLE:
        createBubblePopup(xy, size, text);
        break;
      case ROUNDED_RECTANGLE:
        createRoundedRectanglePopup(xy, size, text);
        break;
      default:
        createRectanglePopup(xy, size, text);
        break;
    } 
  }
  
  private void createRectanglePopup(Point xy, Dimension size, String text) {
    Shape shape = new Rectangle2D.Double(0.0D, 0.0D, (double)size.width, (double)size.height);
    createPopup(xy, size, text, shape);
  }
  
  private void createRoundedRectanglePopup(Point xy, Dimension size, String text) {
    Shape shape = new RoundRectangle2D.Double(0.0D, 0.0D, (double)size.width, (double)size.height, 15.0D, 15.0D);
    createPopup(xy, size, text, shape);
  }
  
  private void createBubblePopup(Point xy, Dimension size, String text) {
    Shape shape = createBubbleShape(size);
    createPopup(xy, size, text, shape);
  }
  
  private void createPopup(Point xy, Dimension size, String text, Shape shape) {
    Color color = new Color(16777184);
    this.dialog = createDialog(xy, size, color);
    this.dialog.setShape(shape);
    this.txtArea = createTextArea(size, color, text);
    this.txtArea.setEnabled(false);
    this.txtArea.setDisabledTextColor(Color.BLACK);
    this.dialog.add(this.txtArea);
    this.dialog.pack();
  }
  
  private JDialog createDialog(Point xy, Dimension size, Color color) {
    JDialog dlg = new JDialog();
    dlg.setSize(size);
    dlg.setPreferredSize(size);
    dlg.setMinimumSize(size);
    dlg.setContentPane(new ContentPanel(color));
    dlg.setAlwaysOnTop(true);
    dlg.setUndecorated(true);
    dlg.setFocusableWindowState(false);
    dlg.setLocation(xy.x, xy.y - size.height);
    return dlg;
  }
  
  private JTextArea createTextArea(Dimension size, Color color, String text) {
    JTextArea txt = new JTextArea(text);
    txt.setLineWrap(true);
    txt.setWrapStyleWord(true);
    txt.setLocation(10, 10);
    txt.setSize(size.width - 10, size.height - 10);
    txt.setBackground(color);
    return txt;
  }
  
  private Shape createBubbleShape(Dimension size) {
    GeneralPath shape = new GeneralPath();
    Polygon arrow = new Polygon(new int[] { 20, 30, 40 }, new int[] { size.height - 25, size.height, size.height - 25 }, 3);
    Shape roundedRectangle = new RoundRectangle2D.Double(0.0D, 0.0D, (double)size.width, (double)(size.height - 25), 15.0D, 15.0D);
    shape.append(roundedRectangle, true);
    shape.append(arrow, true);
    return shape;
  }
  
  private class ContentPanel extends JPanel {
    private static final long serialVersionUID = 1L;
    
    ContentPanel(Color color) {
      init(color);
    }
    
    private void init(Color color) {
      setBackground(color);
    }
    
    public void paintComponent(Graphics g) {
      super.paintComponent(g);
      if (CustomPopup.this.borderSize > 0)
        switch (CustomPopup.this.popupStyle) {
          case BUBBLE:
            paintBubbleBorder((Graphics2D)g, CustomPopup.this.borderColor, CustomPopup.this.borderSize);
            break;
          case RECTANGLE:
            paintRectBorder((Graphics2D)g, CustomPopup.this.borderColor, CustomPopup.this.borderSize);
            break;
          case ROUNDED_RECTANGLE:
            paintRoundedRectBorder((Graphics2D)g, CustomPopup.this.borderColor, CustomPopup.this.borderSize);
            break;
        }  
    }
    
    private void paintRoundedRectBorder(Graphics2D g, Color color, int thickness) {
      g.setColor(color);
      g.setStroke(new BasicStroke((float)thickness));
      g.drawRoundRect(thickness / 2, thickness / 2, getWidth() - thickness, getHeight() - thickness, 15, 15);
    }
    
    private void paintRectBorder(Graphics2D g, Color color, int thickness) {
      g.setColor(color);
      g.setStroke(new BasicStroke((float)thickness));
      g.drawRect(thickness / 2, thickness / 2, getWidth() - thickness, getHeight() - thickness);
    }
    
    private void paintBubbleBorder(Graphics2D g, Color color, int thickness) {
      g.setColor(color);
      g.setStroke(new BasicStroke((float)thickness));
      g.drawRoundRect(thickness / 2, thickness / 2, getWidth() - thickness, getHeight() - 25 - thickness, 15, 15);
      g.drawPolygon(new int[] { 20, 30, 40 }, new int[] { getHeight() - 25 - thickness / 2, getHeight() - thickness / 2, getHeight() - 25 - thickness / 2 }, 3);
      g.setColor(getBackground());
      g.drawLine(20 + thickness, getHeight() - 25 - thickness / 2, 40 - thickness, getHeight() - 25 - thickness / 2);
    }
  }
}

ITEM 110: com/gigatronik/beds/gui/customcomponents/CustomTextField.java

package com.gigatronik.beds.gui.customcomponents;

import com.gigatronik.beds.gui.configtab.bike.elements.AbstractConfigurationElementController;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.custom.TextPrompt;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.gui.SpecialCharacterFilter;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.gui.testinterface.TestableJOptionPane;
import java.awt.Color;
import javax.swing.InputVerifier;
import javax.swing.JComponent;
import javax.swing.JTextField;
import javax.swing.event.DocumentEvent;
import javax.swing.event.DocumentListener;
import javax.swing.text.AbstractDocument;
import org.apache.commons.lang3.StringUtils;

public class CustomTextField extends JTextField {
  private boolean textValid;
  
  private boolean emptyAllowed;
  
  private int maxInputLength = 100;
  
  private String nonPrintablesRegex = "[^\\p{Print}]";
  
  private char[] invalidChars = new char[] { 
      ';', ':', '|', '\\', '?', '*', '<', '"', ':', '>', 
      '+', '[', ']', '/', ',', '.', '„', '€', '°', '§', 
      '´', 'µ', '²', '³', 'ß', '\000', '\001', '\002', '\003', '\004', 
      '\005', '\006', '\007', '\b', '\t', '\n', '\013', '\f', '\r', '\016', 
      '\017', '\020', '\021', '\022', '\023', '\024', '\025', '\026', '\027', '\030', 
      '\031', '\032', '\033', '\034', '\035', '\036', '\037', '\u007F' };
  
  private transient AbstractCustomComponentListener listener;
  
  private final transient DocumentListener documentListener = new DocumentListener() {
      public void insertUpdate(DocumentEvent e) {
        CustomTextField.this.onTextChange();
      }
      
      public void removeUpdate(DocumentEvent e) {
        CustomTextField.this.onTextChange();
      }
      
      public void changedUpdate(DocumentEvent e) {}
    };
  
  public CustomTextField() {
    init();
  }
  
  private void init() {
    getDocument().addDocumentListener(this.documentListener);
    setInputVerifier(new InputVerifier() {
          public boolean verify(JComponent input) {
            CustomTextField.this.verifyTextInput(false);
            return CustomTextField.this.textValid;
          }
          
          public boolean shouldYieldFocus(JComponent input) {
            CustomTextField.this.verifyTextInput(true);
            return (CustomTextField.this.textValid || StringUtils.isBlank(CustomTextField.this.getText()));
          }
        });
  }
  
  public void setEmptyAllowed(boolean allowed) {
    this.emptyAllowed = allowed;
    this.textValid = verifyTextInput(false);
  }
  
  public void setEmptyText(String text) {
    TextPrompt prompt = new TextPrompt(text, this, TextPrompt.Show.FOCUS_LOST);
    prompt.setName("txtPrompt");
    prompt.setForeground(Color.GRAY);
    prompt.changeStyle(2);
  }
  
  public void setMaxInputLength(int length) {
    if (length != this.maxInputLength) {
      this.maxInputLength = length;
      ((AbstractDocument)getDocument()).setDocumentFilter(new SpecialCharacterFilter(new DocumentSizeFilter(length)));
      this.textValid = verifyTextInput(false);
    } 
  }
  
  public void setInvalidChars(char[] chars) {
    this.invalidChars = chars;
    this.textValid = verifyTextInput(false);
  }
  
  public void setNonPrintablesRegex(String nonPrintablesRegex) {
    if (nonPrintablesRegex != null) {
      this.nonPrintablesRegex = nonPrintablesRegex;
      this.textValid = verifyTextInput(false);
    } 
  }
  
  public void setListener(AbstractCustomComponentListener listener) {
    this.listener = listener;
  }
  
  public boolean verifyTextInput(boolean showWarning) {
    String message = "";
    String text = getText();
    boolean valid = (this.emptyAllowed || !StringUtils.isBlank(text));
    if (valid) {
      if (!checkInvalidChars(text)) {
        message = message + message;
        valid = false;
      } else if (text.length() > this.maxInputLength) {
        message = message + message + AbstractConfigurationElementController.BUNDLE.getString("EBikeConfigurationTab.CustomInputVerifier.LIMITED_VALUE_BATTERY_LOCK_KEY") + ". ";
        valid = false;
      } 
      if (!valid && showWarning) {
        message = message + "\n" + message;
        String title = AbstractConfigurationElementController.BUNDLE.getString("EBikeConfigurationTab.CustomInputVerifier.optionPane.title");
        TestableJOptionPane.showMessageDialog(message, title, 2);
        selectAll();
      } 
    } 
    return valid;
  }
  
  boolean checkInvalidChars(String testString) {
    if (StringUtils.containsAny(testString, this.invalidChars))
      return false; 
    String noNonPrintable = testString.replaceAll(this.nonPrintablesRegex, "");
    return testString.equals(noNonPrintable);
  }
  
  private void onTextChange() {
    boolean valid = verifyTextInput(false);
    notifyListenerOnValidationChange(valid);
    if (this.listener != null)
      this.listener.onValueChanged(getText()); 
  }
  
  private void notifyListenerOnValidationChange(boolean valid) {
    if (this.textValid != valid) {
      this.textValid = valid;
      if (this.listener != null)
        this.listener.onVerificationChanged(this.textValid); 
    } 
  }
  
  public void setText(String text) {
    getDocument().removeDocumentListener(this.documentListener);
    super.setText(text);
    onTextChange();
    getDocument().addDocumentListener(this.documentListener);
  }
}

package com.gigatronik.beds.gui.customcomponents;

import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Set;
import java.util.Vector;
import javax.swing.DefaultComboBoxModel;

public class DisabledComboBoxModel extends DefaultComboBoxModel<Object> {
  private static final long serialVersionUID = 1L;
  
  private transient Set<Object> disabledItemsIndex = new HashSet();
  
  public DisabledComboBoxModel() {}
  
  public DisabledComboBoxModel(Object[] items, boolean[] disabledItems) {
    super(items);
    for (int i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
      if (!disabledItems[i])
        this.disabledItemsIndex.add(Integer.valueOf(i)); 
    } 
  }
  
  public DisabledComboBoxModel(List<String> items, boolean[] disabledItems) {
    this(items.toArray(new Object[items.size()]), disabledItems);
  }
  
  public DisabledComboBoxModel(Vector<?> v, boolean[] disabledItems) {
    for (int i = 0; i < v.size(); i++) {
      if (disabledItems[i])
        this.disabledItemsIndex.add(Integer.valueOf(i)); 
    } 
  }
  
  public Set<Object> getDisabledItems() {
    return this.disabledItemsIndex;
  }
}

package com.gigatronik.beds.gui.customcomponents;

import java.awt.Component;
import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.Set;
import javax.swing.Icon;
import javax.swing.JComboBox;
import javax.swing.JLabel;
import javax.swing.JList;
import javax.swing.ListCellRenderer;
import javax.swing.SwingUtilities;
import javax.swing.UIManager;

public class DisabledItemsComboBox extends JComboBox<Object> {
  private static final long serialVersionUID = 1L;
  
  private transient Set<Object> disabled_items_index = new HashSet();
  
  public DisabledItemsComboBox() {
    setRenderer(new DisabledComboBoxListRenderer(getRenderer()));
    setOpaque(UIManager.getBoolean("ComboBox.opaque"));
  }
  
  public DisabledItemsComboBox(DisabledComboBoxModel aModel) {
    this();
    setModel(aModel);
  }
  
  public void addItem(Object anObject, boolean disabled) {
    addItem(anObject);
    if (disabled)
      this.disabled_items_index.add(Integer.valueOf(getItemCount() - 1)); 
  }
  
  public void setModel(DisabledComboBoxModel aModel) {
    this.disabled_items_index = aModel.getDisabledItems();
    setModel(aModel);
  }
  
  public void setInitialSelection(int index) {
    super.setSelectedIndex(index);
  }
  
  public boolean isItemDisabled(int index) {
    return this.disabled_items_index.contains(Integer.valueOf(index));
  }
  
  public void removeAllItems() {
    super.removeAllItems();
    this.disabled_items_index = new HashSet();
  }
  
  public void removeItemAt(int anIndex) {
    super.removeItemAt(anIndex);
    this.disabled_items_index.remove(Integer.valueOf(anIndex));
  }
  
  public void removeItem(Object anObject) {
    for (int i = 0; i < getItemCount(); i++) {
      if (getItemAt(i) == anObject)
        this.disabled_items_index.remove(Integer.valueOf(i)); 
    } 
    super.removeItem(anObject);
  }
  
  public void setSelectedIndex(int index) {
    if (!this.disabled_items_index.contains(Integer.valueOf(index))) {
      super.setSelectedIndex(index);
    } else {
      SwingUtilities.invokeLater(new Runnable() {
            public void run() {
              DisabledItemsComboBox.this.setPopupVisible(true);
            }
          });
    } 
  }
  
  private class DisabledComboBoxListRenderer implements ListCellRenderer {
    private final ListCellRenderer delegate;
    
    public DisabledComboBoxListRenderer(ListCellRenderer delegate) {
      this.delegate = delegate;
    }
    
    public Component getListCellRendererComponent(JList list, Object value, int index, boolean isSelected, boolean cellHasFocus) {
      Component component = this.delegate.getListCellRendererComponent(list, value, index, isSelected, cellHasFocus);
      if (isSelected) {
        component.setBackground(list.getSelectionBackground());
        component.setForeground(list.getSelectionForeground());
      } else {
        component.setBackground(list.getBackground());
        component.setForeground(list.getForeground());
      } 
      if (DisabledItemsComboBox.this.disabled_items_index.contains(Integer.valueOf(index))) {
        component.setBackground(list.getBackground());
        component.setForeground(UIManager.getColor("Label.disabledForeground"));
      } 
      DisabledItemsComboBox.this.setFont(list.getFont());
      if (value instanceof Icon) {
        ((JLabel)component).setIcon((Icon)value);
      } else {
        ((JLabel)component).setText((value == null) ? "" : value.toString());
      } 
      return component;
    }
  }
}

ITEM 113: com/gigatronik/beds/gui/customcomponents/DocumentNumberFilter.java
========================================================================================================================
package com.gigatronik.beds.gui.customcomponents;

import javax.swing.text.AttributeSet;
import javax.swing.text.BadLocationException;
import javax.swing.text.Document;
import javax.swing.text.DocumentFilter;

public class DocumentNumberFilter extends DocumentFilter {
  private String regEx = "(-|\\+)?[0-9]+(\\.([0-9]+)?)?";
  
  public void insertString(DocumentFilter.FilterBypass fb, int offset, String string, AttributeSet attr) throws BadLocationException {
    Document doc = fb.getDocument();
    StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
    sb.append(doc.getText(0, doc.getLength()));
    sb.insert(offset, string);
    if (sb.toString().isEmpty() || sb.toString().matches(this.regEx))
      super.insertString(fb, offset, string, attr); 
  }
  
  public void replace(DocumentFilter.FilterBypass fb, int offset, int length, String text, AttributeSet attrs) throws BadLocationException {
    Document doc = fb.getDocument();
    StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
    sb.append(doc.getText(0, doc.getLength()));
    sb.replace(offset, offset + length, text);
    if (sb.toString().isEmpty() || sb.toString().matches(this.regEx))
      super.replace(fb, offset, length, text, attrs); 
  }
  
  public void allowNegativeNumbers(boolean allowed) {
    this.regEx = this.regEx.replace("(-|\\+)?", "");
    if (allowed)
      this.regEx = "(-|\\+)?" + this.regEx; 
  }
  
  public void allowFloatNumbers(boolean allowed) {
    this.regEx = this.regEx.replace("(\\.([0-9]+)?)?", "");
    if (allowed)
      this.regEx += "(\\.([0-9]+)?)?"; 
  }
  
  public void allowFloatNumbers(int precision) {
    int end = this.regEx.indexOf("(\\.([0-9]");
    if (end > 0)
      this.regEx = this.regEx.substring(0, end); 
    if (precision > 0)
      this.regEx += this.regEx; 
  }
}

ITEM 114: com/gigatronik/beds/gui/customcomponents/DocumentSizeFilter.java
========================================================================================================================
package com.gigatronik.beds.gui.customcomponents;

import javax.swing.text.AttributeSet;
import javax.swing.text.BadLocationException;
import javax.swing.text.DocumentFilter;

public class DocumentSizeFilter extends DocumentFilter {
  private final int maxChars;
  
  public DocumentSizeFilter(int maxChars) {
    this.maxChars = maxChars;
  }
  
  public void insertString(DocumentFilter.FilterBypass fb, int offs, String str, AttributeSet a) throws BadLocationException {
    if (fb.getDocument().getLength() + str.length() <= this.maxChars)
      super.insertString(fb, offs, str, a); 
  }
  
  public void replace(DocumentFilter.FilterBypass fb, int offs, int length, String str, AttributeSet a) throws BadLocationException {
    if (fb.getDocument().getLength() + str.length() - length <= this.maxChars)
      super.replace(fb, offs, length, str, a); 
  }
}

ITEM 116: com/gigatronik/beds/gui/customcomponents/impl/NumericTextFieldImpl.java
========================================================================================================================
package com.gigatronik.beds.gui.customcomponents.impl;

import com.gigatronik.beds.gui.customcomponents.DocumentNumberFilter;
import com.gigatronik.beds.gui.customcomponents.api.NumericTextField;
import com.gigatronik.beds.gui.customcomponents.api.TextField;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.common.util.ConverterUtils;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.gui.SpecialCharacterFilter;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.gui.testinterface.TestableJOptionPane;
import java.awt.EventQueue;
import javax.swing.text.AbstractDocument;
import org.apache.commons.lang3.StringUtils;

class NumericTextFieldImpl extends TextFieldImpl implements NumericTextField {
  private static final long serialVersionUID = 4646577959237659767L;
  
  private static final String VALUE_OUT_OF_RANGE = BUNDLE.getString("EBikeConfigurationTab.CustomInputVerifier.RANGE_VALUE");
  
  private static final String VALUE_NOT_NUMERIC = BUNDLE.getString("EBikeConfigurationTab.CustomInputVerifier.VALID_VALUE");
  
  private double minValue;
  
  private double maxValue;
  
  private int decimal;
  
  private transient DocumentNumberFilter documentNumberFilter;
  
  private double[] allowedAdditionalValues = new double[0];
  
  private boolean clearOnInputOutOfRange = true;
  
  private String formatter;
  
  public NumericTextFieldImpl(String componentName, TextField.TextFieldListener listener, boolean isEmptyAllowed, String validationRegEx, boolean yieldFocusOnInvalid, boolean showErrorPopupOnInvalidText, boolean isInformAboutEveryTextChange) {
    super(componentName, listener, isEmptyAllowed, validationRegEx, yieldFocusOnInvalid, showErrorPopupOnInvalidText, 0, isInformAboutEveryTextChange);
    this.minValue = 0.0D;
    this.maxValue = 0.0D;
    this.decimal = 0;
    updateFormatter();
    initDocumentFilterNumeric();
  }
  
  public void setDecimal(int decimal) {
    if (decimal < 0 || this.decimal == decimal)
      return; 
    this.decimal = decimal;
    updateFormatter();
    this.documentNumberFilter.allowFloatNumbers(decimal);
    setIsValid(validateText());
  }
  
  public void setRange(double minValue, double maxValue) {
    boolean changes = false;
    if (this.minValue != minValue) {
      this.minValue = minValue;
      this.documentNumberFilter.allowNegativeNumbers((minValue < 0.0D));
      changes = true;
    } 
    if (this.maxValue != maxValue) {
      this.maxValue = maxValue;
      changes = true;
    } 
    if (changes)
      setIsValid(validateText()); 
  }
  
  public void setListener(TextField.TextFieldListener listener) {
    this.listener = listener;
    if (listener != null) {
      listener.onValidationStateChanged(getName(), this.isValid, getText());
      listener.onValueChanged(getName(), getText());
    } 
  }
  
  private void initDocumentFilterNumeric() {
    this.documentNumberFilter = new DocumentNumberFilter();
    this.documentNumberFilter.allowFloatNumbers(this.decimal);
    this.documentNumberFilter.allowNegativeNumbers((this.minValue < 0.0D));
    ((AbstractDocument)getDocument()).setDocumentFilter(new SpecialCharacterFilter(this.documentNumberFilter));
  }
  
  synchronized boolean validateText() {
    boolean valid = false;
    boolean withRegexCheck = StringUtils.isNotBlank(this.validationRegEx);
    String text = getText();
    boolean textIsEmpty = StringUtils.isEmpty(text);
    if (this.isEmptyAllowed && textIsEmpty) {
      valid = true;
    } else if (withRegexCheck && !textIsEmpty && text.matches(this.validationRegEx)) {
      valid = validateNumeric(text);
    } else if (!withRegexCheck && !textIsEmpty) {
      valid = true;
    } 
    return valid;
  }
  
  private boolean validateNumeric(String text) {
    if (StringUtils.isNotEmpty(text)) {
      double value = Double.parseDouble(text);
      for (int i = 0; this.allowedAdditionalValues.length > i; i++) {
        if (this.allowedAdditionalValues[i] == value)
          return true; 
      } 
      if (this.maxValue > this.minValue && value > this.maxValue)
        return false; 
      if (this.minValue != this.maxValue && value >= this.minValue)
        return true; 
      if (this.minValue == this.maxValue)
        return true; 
    } 
    return false;
  }
  
  void showWarningPopup() {
    if (!this.isValid && this.showErrorPopupOnInvalidText && StringUtils.isNotEmpty(getText())) {
      String message;
      String title = BUNDLE.getString("EBikeConfigurationTab.CustomInputVerifier.optionPane.title");
      if (!this.isEmptyAllowed && StringUtils.isEmpty(getText())) {
        message = VALUE_NOT_NUMERIC;
      } else {
        message = String.format(VALUE_OUT_OF_RANGE, String.format(this.formatter, this.minValue), String.format(this.formatter, this.maxValue));
      } 
      TestableJOptionPane.showMessageDialog(message, title, 2);
      if (this.clearOnInputOutOfRange)
        EventQueue.invokeLater(() -> setText("")); 
    } 
  }
  
  private void updateFormatter() {
    this.formatter = "%." + this.decimal + "f";
  }
  
  void doFormatingsBeforeInformListeners(String textValue) {
    String correctedValue = removeLeadingZeros(textValue);
    if (this.decimal > 0 && ConverterUtils.isDouble(correctedValue)) {
      Double myValue = new Double(textValue);
      correctedValue = String.format(this.formatter, myValue);
    } 
    if (!StringUtils.equals(textValue, correctedValue))
      super.setText(correctedValue); 
  }
  
  private String removeLeadingZeros(String textValue) {
    while (textValue != null && textValue.length() > 1 && textValue.matches("(0+)([1-9]+).*"))
      textValue = StringUtils.removeStart(textValue, "0"); 
    return textValue;
  }
  
  public void setText(String value) {
    super.setText((value == null) ? "" : value);
  }
  
  public void setAdditionalAllowedValues(double[] allowedValues) {
    if (allowedValues == null)
      allowedValues = new double[0]; 
    this.allowedAdditionalValues = allowedValues;
    setIsValid(validateText());
  }
  
  public void setClearOnInputOutOfRange(boolean clearOnInputOutOfRange) {
    this.clearOnInputOutOfRange = clearOnInputOutOfRange;
  }
}

package com.gigatronik.beds.gui.customcomponents.impl;

import com.gigatronik.beds.gui.customcomponents.DocumentSizeFilter;
import com.gigatronik.beds.gui.customcomponents.api.TextField;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.bosch.service.internationalization.ResourceBundleFactory;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.bosch.service.internationalization.Utf8ResourceBundleFormatted;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.gui.SpecialCharacterFilter;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.gui.testinterface.TestableJOptionPane;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.gui.testinterface.TestableJTextField;
import java.awt.Color;
import java.awt.Insets;
import java.awt.event.ActionEvent;
import javax.swing.BorderFactory;
import javax.swing.InputVerifier;
import javax.swing.JComponent;
import javax.swing.JTextField;
import javax.swing.UIManager;
import javax.swing.border.LineBorder;
import javax.swing.event.DocumentEvent;
import javax.swing.event.DocumentListener;
import javax.swing.text.AbstractDocument;
import org.apache.commons.lang3.StringUtils;
import org.slf4j.Logger;
import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;

class TextFieldImpl extends TestableJTextField implements TextField {
  private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(TextFieldImpl.class);
  
  private static final long serialVersionUID = -7793186103080916627L;
  
  public static final Utf8ResourceBundleFormatted BUNDLE = ResourceBundleFactory.newDefaultResourceBundle();
  
  private static final String TEXT_FIELDBORDER = "TextField.border";
  
  private static final String TEXT_FIELDFOREGROUND = "TextField.foreground";
  
  private static final LineBorder BORDER_INVALID = new LineBorder(Color.red, 2, false);
  
  private static final Color FOREGROUND_INVALID = BORDER_INVALID.getLineColor();
  
  boolean isValid = false;
  
  transient TextField.TextFieldListener listener;
  
  final boolean isEmptyAllowed;
  
  private final boolean yieldFocusOnInvalid;
  
  final boolean showErrorPopupOnInvalidText;
  
  private final boolean isInformAboutEveryTextChange;
  
  final String validationRegEx;
  
  private final boolean withRegexCheck;
  
  private final int maxChars;
  
  private final DocumentListener documentListener = new DocumentListener() {
      public void insertUpdate(DocumentEvent e) {
        onValueChange();
      }
      
      public void removeUpdate(DocumentEvent e) {
        onValueChange();
      }
      
      public void changedUpdate(DocumentEvent e) {}
      
      private void onValueChange() {
        TextFieldImpl.this.setIsValid(TextFieldImpl.this.validateText());
        if (TextFieldImpl.this.isInformAboutEveryTextChange)
          TextFieldImpl.this.informListenerAndShowPopup(false); 
      }
    };
  
  TextFieldImpl(String componentName, TextField.TextFieldListener listener, boolean isEmptyAllowed, String validationRegEx, boolean yieldFocusOnInvalid, boolean showErrorPopupOnInvalidText, int maxChars, boolean isInformAboutEveryTextChange) {
    if (StringUtils.isEmpty(componentName))
      throw new NullPointerException("componentName must not be null or empty"); 
    setName(componentName);
    this.listener = listener;
    this.isEmptyAllowed = isEmptyAllowed;
    this.validationRegEx = validationRegEx;
    this.withRegexCheck = StringUtils.isNotBlank(validationRegEx);
    this.yieldFocusOnInvalid = yieldFocusOnInvalid;
    this.showErrorPopupOnInvalidText = showErrorPopupOnInvalidText;
    this.maxChars = maxChars;
    this.isInformAboutEveryTextChange = isInformAboutEveryTextChange;
    Insets insets = getMargin();
    insets.set(insets.top, 5, insets.bottom, 5);
    setMargin(insets);
    init();
  }
  
  public void setText(String value) {
    getDocument().removeDocumentListener(this.documentListener);
    super.setText(value);
    if (!StringUtils.equals(value, getText())) {
      LOGGER.error("value '{}' could not be set to Field '{}'. Empty Text is set.", value, getName());
      super.setText("");
    } 
    setIsValid(validateText());
    informListenerAndShowPopup(false);
    getDocument().addDocumentListener(this.documentListener);
  }
  
  public void setEnabled(boolean enabled) {
    super.setEnabled(enabled);
    setIsValid(validateText());
    paintJob();
  }
  
  public void setVisible(boolean visible) {
    super.setVisible(visible);
    setIsValid(validateText());
    paintJob();
  }
  
  private void init() {
    getDocument().addDocumentListener(this.documentListener);
    initInputVerifier();
    addActionListener(e -> informListenerAndShowPopup(true));
    if (this.maxChars > 0)
      ((AbstractDocument)getDocument()).setDocumentFilter(new SpecialCharacterFilter(new DocumentSizeFilter(this.maxChars))); 
    paintJob();
  }
  
  public boolean isValidWsdl() {
    return this.isValid;
  }
  
  void setIsValid(boolean isValid) {
    if (this.isValid != isValid) {
      this.isValid = isValid;
      paintJob();
      if (this.listener != null)
        this.listener.onValidationStateChanged(getName(), this.isValid, getText()); 
    } 
  }
  
  private void initInputVerifier() {
    setInputVerifier(new InputVerifier() {
          public boolean verify(JComponent input) {
            TextFieldImpl.this.setIsValid(TextFieldImpl.this.validateText());
            TextFieldImpl.this.informListenerAndShowPopup(true);
            return TextFieldImpl.this.isValid;
          }
          
          public boolean shouldYieldFocus(JComponent input) {
            verify(input);
            return (!TextFieldImpl.this.yieldFocusOnInvalid || TextFieldImpl.this.isValid || !StringUtils.isNotEmpty(((JTextField)input).getText()));
          }
        });
  }
  
  synchronized boolean validateText() {
    boolean valid = false;
    String text = getText();
    boolean textIsEmpty = StringUtils.isEmpty(text);
    if (this.isEmptyAllowed && textIsEmpty) {
      valid = true;
    } else if (this.withRegexCheck && !textIsEmpty && text.matches(this.validationRegEx)) {
      valid = true;
    } else if (!this.withRegexCheck && !textIsEmpty) {
      valid = true;
    } 
    return valid;
  }
  
  private void paintJob() {
    if (this.isValid || !isEnabled() || !isVisible()) {
      setBorder(UIManager.getBorder("TextField.border"));
      setForeground(UIManager.getColor("TextField.foreground"));
    } else {
      setBorder(BorderFactory.createCompoundBorder(BORDER_INVALID, UIManager.getBorder("TextField.border")));
      setForeground(FOREGROUND_INVALID);
    } 
  }
  
  private synchronized void informListenerAndShowPopup(boolean showPopup) {
    if (this.listener != null) {
      doFormatingsBeforeInformListeners(getText());
      this.listener.onValueChanged(getName(), getText());
    } 
    if (showPopup)
      showWarningPopup(); 
  }
  
  void showWarningPopup() {
    if (!this.isValid && this.showErrorPopupOnInvalidText) {
      String message = BUNDLE.getString("EBikeConfigurationTab.CustomInputVerifier.INVALID_CHARACTERS");
      message = message + "\n" + message;
      String title = BUNDLE.getString("EBikeConfigurationTab.CustomInputVerifier.optionPane.title");
      TestableJOptionPane.showMessageDialog(message, title, 2);
    } 
  }
  
  void doFormatingsBeforeInformListeners(String text) {}
}
