package com.gigatronik.beds.gui.customcomponents;

import com.gigatronik.dart2.bosch.service.internationalization.I18NUtil;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.bosch.service.internationalization.ResourceBundleFactory;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.bosch.service.internationalization.Utf8ResourceBundleFormatted;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.custom.ImageButton;
import java.awt.Color;
import java.awt.Font;
import java.awt.FontMetrics;
import java.awt.Graphics;
import java.awt.Graphics2D;
import java.awt.RenderingHints;
import java.util.Locale;
import org.apache.commons.lang3.StringUtils;

public class LabeledImageButton extends ImageButton {
  private static final long serialVersionUID = 7851450612889116348L;
  
  private static final Utf8ResourceBundleFormatted BUNDLE_DEFAULT = ResourceBundleFactory.newResourceBundle("com.gigatronik.dart2.plugin.ui.Messages_Bundle", Locale.ENGLISH);
  
  private static final Utf8ResourceBundleFormatted BUNDLE = ResourceBundleFactory.newDefaultResourceBundle();
  
  private static final Font TEXT_FONT_DEFAULT = new Font("BoschSansGlobal-Regular", 0, 11);
  
  private String text;
  
  private String textDefault;
  
  private Locale currentLocal;
  
  public LabeledImageButton(String generatereportimage, String key) {
    super(generatereportimage);
    setFont(TEXT_FONT_DEFAULT);
    setText(key);
  }
  
  public LabeledImageButton() {
    setFont(TEXT_FONT_DEFAULT);
  }
  
  public void paint(Graphics g) {
    super.paint(g);
    String labelText = getLabelText();
    if (labelText != null) {
      this.currentLocal = I18NUtil.getLocale();
      if (this.currentLocal != Locale.CHINESE && this.currentLocal != Locale.JAPANESE && g instanceof Graphics2D) {
        Graphics2D g2d = (Graphics2D)g;
        g2d.setRenderingHint(RenderingHints.KEY_TEXT_ANTIALIASING, RenderingHints.VALUE_TEXT_ANTIALIAS_ON);
      } 
      FontMetrics metrics = g.getFontMetrics(getFont());
      int x = (getWidth() - metrics.stringWidth(labelText)) / 2;
      int y = getHeight() - 10;
      g.setFont(getFont());
      g.setColor(getTextColor());
      g.drawString(labelText, x, y);
    } 
  }
  
  public void setText(String key) {
    if (!StringUtils.isBlank(key)) {
      this.textDefault = BUNDLE_DEFAULT.getString(key);
      this.text = BUNDLE.getString(key);
    } 
  }
  
  private boolean isTextTooLong(String txt) {
    Graphics g = getGraphics();
    if (g != null) {
      FontMetrics metrics = g.getFontMetrics(getFont());
      if (getWidth() - metrics.stringWidth(txt) < 0)
        return true; 
    } 
    return false;
  }
  
  public String getLabelText() {
    return isTextTooLong(this.text) ? this.textDefault : this.text;
  }
  
  private Color getTextColor() {

========================================================================================================================
ITEM 120: com/gigatronik/beds/gui/customcomponents/RoundedBorderWithInnerShadow.java
========================================================================================================================
package com.gigatronik.beds.gui.customcomponents;

import java.awt.BasicStroke;
import java.awt.Color;
import java.awt.Component;
import java.awt.Graphics;
import java.awt.Graphics2D;
import java.awt.RenderingHints;
import java.awt.Shape;
import java.awt.Stroke;
import java.awt.geom.Area;
import java.awt.geom.Rectangle2D;
import java.awt.geom.RoundRectangle2D;
import javax.swing.border.AbstractBorder;

public class RoundedBorderWithInnerShadow extends AbstractBorder {
  private final float shadowWidth;
  
  private final int edgesRad;
  
  private final Color startShadowColor;
  
  public RoundedBorderWithInnerShadow(float shadowWidth, int radiusEdges, Color shadowColor) {
    if (shadowWidth > 0.0F) {
      this.shadowWidth = shadowWidth;
    } else {
      this.shadowWidth = 0.0F;
    } 
    if (radiusEdges > 0) {
      this.edgesRad = radiusEdges;
    } else {
      this.edgesRad = 0;
    } 
    if (shadowColor != null) {
      this.startShadowColor = shadowColor;
    } else {
      this.startShadowColor = new Color(100, 100, 100);
    } 
  }
  
  public RoundedBorderWithInnerShadow() {
    this.shadowWidth = 5.0F;
    this.edgesRad = 10;
    this.startShadowColor = new Color(100, 100, 100);
  }
  
  public void paintBorder(Component c, Graphics g, int x, int y, int width, int height) {
    super.paintBorder(c, g, x, y, width, height);
    Graphics2D g2d = (Graphics2D)g;
    g2d.setRenderingHint(RenderingHints.KEY_INTERPOLATION, RenderingHints.VALUE_INTERPOLATION_BILINEAR);
    g2d.setRenderingHint(RenderingHints.KEY_ALPHA_INTERPOLATION, RenderingHints.VALUE_ALPHA_INTERPOLATION_QUALITY);
    g2d.setRenderingHint(RenderingHints.KEY_ANTIALIASING, RenderingHints.VALUE_ANTIALIAS_ON);
    if (this.shadowWidth > 0.0F) {
      g2d.setStroke(new BasicStroke(1.0F));
      int alpha = 0;
      int alphaDistance = 255 / (int)this.shadowWidth;
      for (int i = 0; (float)i < this.shadowWidth; i++) {
        alpha = 255 - (i + 1) * alphaDistance;
        g2d.setColor(new Color(this.startShadowColor.getRed(), this.startShadowColor.getGreen(), this.startShadowColor.getBlue(), alpha));
        if (this.edgesRad - 2 * i <= 0) {
          g2d.drawRect(x + i, y + i, width - 1, height - 1);
        } else {
          g2d.drawRoundRect(x + i, y + i, width - 1, height - 1, this.edgesRad - i * 2, this.edgesRad - i * 2);
        } 
      } 
    } 
    Shape myShapeInner = new RoundRectangle2D.Double(0.0D, 0.0D, (double)(width - 2), (double)(height - 2), (double)this.edgesRad, (double)this.edgesRad);
    Shape myShapeOuter = new Rectangle2D.Double(0.0D, 0.0D, (double)width, (double)height);
    Stroke myStroke = new BasicStroke(1.0F);
    g2d.setStroke(myStroke);
    Area myArea = new Area(myShapeOuter);
    myArea.subtract(new Area(myShapeInner));
    g2d.setColor(c.getParent().getBackground());
    g2d.fill(myArea);
  }
}

ITEM 121: com/gigatronik/beds/gui/customcomponents/StopButtonUI.java
========================================================================================================================
package com.gigatronik.beds.gui.customcomponents;

import com.gigatronik.beds.gui.flashassistant.panel.FlashAssistantDialogController;
import java.awt.FontMetrics;
import java.awt.Graphics;
import java.awt.Graphics2D;
import java.awt.Insets;
import java.awt.Rectangle;
import java.awt.RenderingHints;
import javax.swing.AbstractButton;
import javax.swing.ButtonModel;
import javax.swing.ImageIcon;
import javax.swing.JComponent;
import javax.swing.SwingUtilities;
import javax.swing.plaf.basic.BasicButtonUI;
import org.apache.commons.lang3.StringUtils;

public class StopButtonUI extends BasicButtonUI {
  private static final ImageIcon IMAGE_NORMAL_LEFT = new ImageIcon(FlashAssistantDialogController.class.getResource("btn_stop/btn_stop_normal_left-part.png"));
  
  private static final ImageIcon IMAGE_NORMAL_MIDDLE = new ImageIcon(FlashAssistantDialogController.class.getResource("btn_stop/btn_stop_normal_middle-part.png"));
  
  private static final ImageIcon IMAGE_NORMAL_RIGHT = new ImageIcon(FlashAssistantDialogController.class.getResource("btn_stop/btn_stop_normal_F6_right-part.png"));
  
  private static final ImageIcon IMAGE_ENTERED_LEFT = new ImageIcon(FlashAssistantDialogController.class.getResource("btn_stop/btn_stop_entered_left-part.png"));
  
  private static final ImageIcon IMAGE_ENTERED_MIDDLE = new ImageIcon(FlashAssistantDialogController.class.getResource("btn_stop/btn_stop_entered_middle-part.png"));
  
  private static final ImageIcon IMAGE_ENTERED_RIGHT = new ImageIcon(FlashAssistantDialogController.class.getResource("btn_stop/btn_stop_entered_F6_right-part.png"));
  
  private static final ImageIcon IMAGE_PRESSED_LEFT = new ImageIcon(FlashAssistantDialogController.class.getResource("btn_stop/btn_stop_pressed_left-part.png"));
  
  private static final ImageIcon IMAGE_PRESSED_MIDDLE = new ImageIcon(FlashAssistantDialogController.class.getResource("btn_stop/btn_stop_pressed_middle-part.png"));
  
  private static final ImageIcon IMAGE_PRESSED_RIGHT = new ImageIcon(FlashAssistantDialogController.class.getResource("btn_stop/btn_stop_pressed_F6_right-part.png"));
  
  public void paint(Graphics g, JComponent c) {
    super.paint(g, c);
    AbstractButton button = (AbstractButton)c;
    ButtonModel buttonModel = button.getModel();
    Graphics2D g2d = (Graphics2D)g;
    g2d.setRenderingHint(RenderingHints.KEY_INTERPOLATION, RenderingHints.VALUE_INTERPOLATION_BILINEAR);
    g2d.setRenderingHint(RenderingHints.KEY_ALPHA_INTERPOLATION, RenderingHints.VALUE_ALPHA_INTERPOLATION_QUALITY);
    g2d.setRenderingHint(RenderingHints.KEY_ANTIALIASING, RenderingHints.VALUE_ANTIALIAS_ON);
    int middleStart = IMAGE_NORMAL_LEFT.getIconWidth();
    int middleWidth = button.getWidth() - (IMAGE_ENTERED_LEFT.getIconWidth() + IMAGE_ENTERED_RIGHT.getIconWidth());
    int rightStart = button.getWidth() - IMAGE_ENTERED_RIGHT.getIconWidth();
    int iconHeight = IMAGE_ENTERED_MIDDLE.getIconHeight();
    if (buttonModel.isPressed() || buttonModel.isSelected()) {
      g2d.drawImage(IMAGE_PRESSED_LEFT.getImage(), 0, 0, null);
      g2d.drawImage(IMAGE_PRESSED_MIDDLE.getImage(), middleStart, 0, middleWidth, iconHeight, null);
      g2d.drawImage(IMAGE_PRESSED_RIGHT.getImage(), rightStart, 0, null);
    } else if (buttonModel.isRollover()) {
      g2d.drawImage(IMAGE_ENTERED_LEFT.getImage(), 0, 0, null);
      g2d.drawImage(IMAGE_ENTERED_MIDDLE.getImage(), middleStart, 0, middleWidth, iconHeight, null);
      g2d.drawImage(IMAGE_ENTERED_RIGHT.getImage(), rightStart, 0, null);
    } else {
      g2d.drawImage(IMAGE_NORMAL_LEFT.getImage(), 0, 0, null);
      g2d.drawImage(IMAGE_NORMAL_MIDDLE.getImage(), middleStart, 0, middleWidth, iconHeight, null);
      g2d.drawImage(IMAGE_NORMAL_RIGHT.getImage(), rightStart, 0, null);
    } 
    if (StringUtils.isNotEmpty(button.getText())) {
      Rectangle viewRect = new Rectangle();
      Rectangle textRect = new Rectangle();
      Rectangle iconRect = new Rectangle();
      Insets i = button.getInsets();
      viewRect.x = i.left;
      viewRect.y = i.top;
      viewRect.width = button.getWidth() - (i.right + viewRect.x);
      viewRect.height = button.getHeight() - (i.bottom + viewRect.y);
      textRect.x = textRect.y = textRect.width = textRect.height = 0;
      iconRect.x = iconRect.y = iconRect.width = iconRect.height = 0;
      FontMetrics fm = button.getFontMetrics(button.getFont());
      String text = SwingUtilities.layoutCompoundLabel(button, fm, button.getText(), button.getIcon(), button.getVerticalAlignment(), button.getHorizontalAlignment(), button.getVerticalTextPosition(), button.getHorizontalTextPosition(), viewRect, iconRect, textRect, button.getIconTextGap());
      paintText(g, c, textRect, text);
    } 
  }
}

package com.gigatronik.beds.gui.diagnostic;

import javax.swing.table.DefaultTableModel;

public class DiagnosticDefaultTableModel extends DefaultTableModel {
  Class[] columnTypes = new Class<?>[] { String.class, String.class };
  
  boolean[] columnEditables = new boolean[] { false, false };
  
  public DiagnosticDefaultTableModel(Object[][] data, Object[] columnNames) {
    super(data, columnNames);
  }
  
  public Class getColumnClass(int columnIndex) {
    return this.columnTypes[columnIndex];
  }
  
  public boolean isCellEditable(int row, int column) {
    return this.columnEditables[column];
  }
}

package com.gigatronik.beds.gui.ebikedisabler;

import com.gigatronik.beds.gui.color.GuiColors;
import com.gigatronik.beds.gui.customcomponents.DocumentSizeFilter;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.communication.api.CommunicationManager;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.rightsmanager.api.RightsManager;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.rightsmanager.api.UserLevel;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.bosch.service.internationalization.ResourceBundleFactory;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.bosch.service.internationalization.Utf8ResourceBundleFormatted;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.common.configuration.ComplexResponse;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.common.util.BoschHelper;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.common.util.ConverterUtils;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.gui.testinterface.TestableJOptionPane;
import java.awt.Dialog;
import java.awt.event.ActionEvent;
import java.awt.event.WindowAdapter;
import java.awt.event.WindowEvent;
import java.util.regex.Matcher;
import java.util.regex.Pattern;
import javax.swing.BorderFactory;
import javax.swing.JButton;
import javax.swing.JLabel;
import javax.swing.JTextField;
import javax.swing.UIManager;
import javax.swing.border.Border;
import javax.swing.event.DocumentEvent;
import javax.swing.event.DocumentListener;
import javax.swing.text.AbstractDocument;
import org.slf4j.Logger;
import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;

public class EbikeDisablerDialogController {
  private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(EbikeDisablerDialogController.class);
  
  private static final Utf8ResourceBundleFormatted BUNDLE = ResourceBundleFactory.newDefaultResourceBundle();
  
  private EbikeDisablerDialog ebikeDisablerDialog;
  
  private JButton btnCloseAndEnterLater;
  
  private JButton btnEnterResetCode;
  
  private JTextField txtRecoveryPin;
  
  private static final String REGEX_EIGHT_NUMERIC_SIGNS = "\\d{8}";
  
  private final Pattern eightNumericSignPattern = Pattern.compile("\\d{8}");
  
  private static final int MAX_CHAR_RECOVERY_PIN = 8;
  
  private final CommunicationManager comMgr;
  
  private final RightsManager rightsManager;
  
  private final Border ioBorder = UIManager.getBorder("TextField.border");
  
  private final Border nioBorder = BorderFactory.createCompoundBorder(BorderFactory.createLineBorder(GuiColors.FRAME_INVALID, 2), this.ioBorder);
  
  private boolean disablerResetted = false;
  
  public EbikeDisablerDialogController(CommunicationManager comManager, RightsManager rights) {
    this.comMgr = comManager;
    this.rightsManager = rights;
  }
  
  public boolean showDialog(ComplexResponse disablerIdentifier) {
    initDialog(disablerIdentifier);
    this.ebikeDisablerDialog.setLocationRelativeTo(TestableJOptionPane.getDefaultParentFrame());
    this.ebikeDisablerDialog.setModalityType(Dialog.ModalityType.DOCUMENT_MODAL);
    this.ebikeDisablerDialog.pack();
    this.ebikeDisablerDialog.setVisible(true);
    return this.disablerResetted;
  }
  
  private boolean validateRecoveryPin() {
    String text = this.txtRecoveryPin.getText();
    Matcher m = this.eightNumericSignPattern.matcher(text);
    if (m.find()) {
      this.txtRecoveryPin.setBorder(this.ioBorder);
      return true;
    } 
    this.txtRecoveryPin.setBorder(this.nioBorder);
    return false;
  }
  
  private void initListeners() {
    this.ebikeDisablerDialog.addWindowListener(new WindowAdapter() {
          public void windowClosing(WindowEvent e) {
            EbikeDisablerDialogController.this.ebikeDisablerDialog.setVisible(false);
          }
        });
    this.btnCloseAndEnterLater.addActionListener(e -> this.ebikeDisablerDialog.setVisible(false));
    ((AbstractDocument)this.txtRecoveryPin.getDocument()).setDocumentFilter(new DocumentSizeFilter(8));
    this.txtRecoveryPin.getDocument().addDocumentListener(new DocumentListener() {
          public void insertUpdate(DocumentEvent e) {
            EbikeDisablerDialogController.this.btnEnterResetCode.setEnabled(EbikeDisablerDialogController.this.validateRecoveryPin());
          }
          
          public void removeUpdate(DocumentEvent e) {
            EbikeDisablerDialogController.this.btnEnterResetCode.setEnabled(EbikeDisablerDialogController.this.validateRecoveryPin());
          }
          
          public void changedUpdate(DocumentEvent e) {
            EbikeDisablerDialogController.this.btnEnterResetCode.setEnabled(EbikeDisablerDialogController.this.validateRecoveryPin());
          }
        });
    this.btnEnterResetCode.addActionListener(e -> {
          if (ConverterUtils.isInteger(this.txtRecoveryPin.getText())) {
            Integer recoveryPin = Integer.parseInt(this.txtRecoveryPin.getText());
            ComplexResponse response = this.comMgr.getDuCom().writeResetRecoveryPin(Integer.toHexString(recoveryPin.intValue()));
            if (response != null && response.isPositive()) {
              LOGGER.info("The eBike Disabler Function was resetted.");
              this.ebikeDisablerDialog.setVisible(false);
              TestableJOptionPane.showMessageDialog(BUNDLE.getString("EbikeDisabler.Dialog.DisablerResetSuccessful"), BUNDLE.getString("Bosch.diagnostic.tool"), 1);
              this.disablerResetted = true;
            } else {
              LOGGER.info("The eBike Disabler Function could not be resetted.");
              this.ebikeDisablerDialog.setVisible(false);
              TestableJOptionPane.showMessageDialog(BUNDLE.getString("EbikeDisabler.Dialog.DisablerResetNotSuccessful"), BUNDLE.getString("Bosch.diagnostic.tool"), 0);
              this.ebikeDisablerDialog.setVisible(true);
            } 
          } else {
            LOGGER.error("Entered recovery pin is not parsable as INT");
          } 
        });
  }
  
  private void initDialog(ComplexResponse disablerIdentifier) {
    this.ebikeDisablerDialog = new EbikeDisablerDialog();
    this.btnCloseAndEnterLater = this.ebikeDisablerDialog.getBtnResetLater();
    this.btnEnterResetCode = this.ebikeDisablerDialog.getBtnEnterResetCode();
    JLabel lblDisablerIdent = this.ebikeDisablerDialog.getTxtDisablerIdentNr();
    this.txtRecoveryPin = this.ebikeDisablerDialog.getTxtDisablerRecoveryPin();
    initListeners();
    this.disablerResetted = false;
    lblDisablerIdent.setText((disablerIdentifier != null && disablerIdentifier.isPositive()) ? Integer.toString(BoschHelper.hex2int(disablerIdentifier.toString())) : "");
    this.btnEnterResetCode.setEnabled(validateRecoveryPin());
    if (this.rightsManager.getUserLevel() == UserLevel.IBD) {
      this.ebikeDisablerDialog.getPnlInfo().setText(BUNDLE.getString("EbikeDisabler.Dialog.ibd.information"));
    } else if (this.rightsManager.getUserLevel() == UserLevel.OEM) {
      this.ebikeDisablerDialog.getPnlInfo().setText(BUNDLE.getString("EbikeDisabler.Dialog.oem.information"));
    } 
  }
}

ITEM 127: com/gigatronik/beds/gui/ebikedisabler/EbikeDisablerPopupController.java
========================================================================================================================
package com.gigatronik.beds.gui.ebikedisabler;

import com.gigatronik.beds.common.order.OrderableListener;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.communication.api.CommunicationManager;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.configuration.ConfigurationManager;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.configuration.api.HardwareConnectionChangesListener;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.configuration.event.HardwareConnectionChangedEvent;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.ecu.api.Hmi;
import com.gigatronik.beds.settings.SettingsProxy;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.bosch.service.internationalization.ResourceBundleFactory;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.bosch.service.internationalization.Utf8ResourceBundleFormatted;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.framework.plugins.exceptions.ConfigurationNotFoundException;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.framework.util.Version;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.common.configuration.BikeIdentification;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.common.configuration.ComplexResponse;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.common.configuration.DuIdentification;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.gui.testinterface.TestableJOptionPane;
import java.io.IOException;
import org.apache.commons.lang3.StringUtils;
import org.slf4j.Logger;
import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;

public class EbikeDisablerPopupController implements HardwareConnectionChangesListener {
  private static final Version MIN_DU_SW_VER_GEN3 = new Version(new Integer[] { 1, 1, 0, 0 });
  
  private static final String LOCK_SERVICE_FEEDBACK_DISABLED = "lockServicePopupDisabled";
  
  private final BikeIdentification bikeIdent;
  
  private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(EbikeDisablerPopupController.class);
  
  public static final Utf8ResourceBundleFormatted BUNDLE = ResourceBundleFactory.newDefaultResourceBundle();
  
  private final String dlgTitle = BUNDLE.getString("Bosch.diagnostic.tool");
  
  private final String dlgMessage = BUNDLE.getString("EbikeDisabler.ebikeLocked.dialog.message");
  
  private final String dlgUnlockedMessage = BUNDLE.getString("EbikeDisabler.ebikeUnlocked.dialog.message");
  
  private final CommunicationManager comManager;
  
  public EbikeDisablerPopupController(BikeIdentification bikeIdent, CommunicationManager comManager, ConfigurationManager configurationManager) {
    this.bikeIdent = bikeIdent;
    this.comManager = comManager;
    configurationManager.addListener((OrderableListener)this);
  }
  
  public boolean isDuDisablerCandidate() {
    DuIdentification duIdent = this.bikeIdent.getDuIdentification();
    if (duIdent.getComponentType().isBDU4xx())
      return true; 
    if (duIdent.getComponentType().isBDU3xx())
      try {
        Version duSw = Version.parse(duIdent.getSwVersion());
        return (duSw != null && MIN_DU_SW_VER_GEN3.compareTo(duSw) < 0);
      } catch (IOException ex) {
        LOGGER.warn("DU sw version {} could not be parsed", duIdent.getSwVersion(), ex);
      }  
    return false;
  }
  
  boolean isLockServicePopupDisabled() {
    try {
      String lockServiceProperty = SettingsProxy.getInstance().getGlobalSettings().getProperty("lockServicePopupDisabled");
      return StringUtils.equalsIgnoreCase(lockServiceProperty, Boolean.TRUE.toString());
    } catch (ConfigurationNotFoundException e) {
      LOGGER.error("Configuration File didn't find, LOCK Service Feedback fallback as enabled: ", (Throwable)e);
      return false;
    } 
  }
  
  private void onBikeSystemConnected() {
    if (isDuDisablerCandidate() && !isLockServicePopupDisabled() && 
      this.comManager.getHmiCom().readSystemChargeState().equals(Hmi.SystemChargingState.NOT_CHARGING)) {
      ComplexResponse cr = this.comManager.getDuCom().readDisablerStatusLocked();
      ComplexResponse lockServiceEnabled = this.comManager.getDuCom().readDisablerFunctionEnable();
      if (cr.isPositive() && Boolean.parseBoolean(cr.toString())) {
        TestableJOptionPane.showMessageDialog(this.dlgMessage, this.dlgTitle, 1);
      } else if (lockServiceEnabled.isPositive() && Boolean.parseBoolean(lockServiceEnabled.toString())) {
        TestableJOptionPane.showMessageDialog(this.dlgUnlockedMessage, this.dlgTitle, 1);
      } 
    } 
  }
  
  public void onHardwareConnectionChanged(HardwareConnectionChangedEvent event) {
    LOGGER.debug("HardwareConnectionChangedEvent received: '{}'", event);
    switch (event.getAction()) {
      case SYSTEM_CONNECTED:
      case SYSTEM_RECONNECTED:
        if (event.getSystemType() == HardwareConnectionChangedEvent.HardwareSystem.BIKE_SYSTEM)
          onBikeSystemConnected(); 
        break;
    } 
  }
}

  private void setEditingState(EditState state, JLabel iconLabel, String iconText, JTextField textfield) {
    switch (state) {
      case EDITING:
        iconLabel.setIcon(this.iconEditing);
        iconLabel.setText("");
        textfield.setEnabled(true);
        textfield.setForeground(this.textFieldNormalColor);
        textfield.requestFocus();
        break;
      case VALID:
        iconLabel.setIcon(this.iconCheck);
        iconLabel.setText("");
        textfield.setEnabled(true);
        textfield.setForeground(this.textFieldNormalColor);
        break;
      case DISABLED:
        iconLabel.setIcon(this.iconForText);
        iconLabel.setText(iconText);
        textfield.setEnabled(false);
        textfield.setForeground(this.textFieldNormalColor);
        break;
      case INVALID:
        iconLabel.setIcon(this.iconEditing);
        iconLabel.setText("");
        textfield.setEnabled(true);
        textfield.setForeground(this.textFieldInvalidColor);
        break;
    } 
  }

package com.gigatronik.beds.gui.flashassistant.panel;

public class FlashAssistantDialogController implements BikeConfigurationChangesListener, ContainerConfigurationChangesListener, HardwareConnectionChangesListener {
  private enum ActiveEntry {
    ARTICLE_NO, BIKE_ID, BATTERY_KEY, COMMENT;
  }
  
  private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(FlashAssistantDialogController.class);
  
  private static final Utf8ResourceBundleFormatted BUNDLE = ResourceBundleFactory.newDefaultResourceBundle();
  
  private static final String FLASHASSISTANT_PROPERTY_BATTERYKEY_VISIBLE = "flashassistant_battery_key_visible";
  
  private static final String FLASHASSISTANT_PROPERTY_FLASH_AUTOMATICALLY = "flashassistant_flash_automatically_activated";
  
  private static final String CONFIGURATIONTAB_PROPERTY_CONFIGURATION_COMMENT_VISIBLE = "configurationtab_configuration_comment_visible";
  
  private static final String ENTRY_NAME_ARTICLENO = BUNDLE.getString("PART_NUMBER");
  
  private static final String ENTRY_NAME_BIKEID = BUNDLE.getString("EBikeReport.eBike.bikeid");
  
  private static final String ENTRY_NAME_BATTERYKEY = BUNDLE.getString("EBikeServiceTab.DU_DiagnosticTable.Data.KEY_NUMBER_BATTERY_LOCK");
  
  private static final String ENTRY_NAME_COMMENT = StringUtils.substringBefore(BUNDLE.getString("EBikeConfigurationTab.InfoText.label"), ":").trim();
  
  private static final String FLASH_ASSISTANT_DIALOGTITLE = "FlashAssistant.Dialog.title";
  
  private FlashAssistantDialog dialog = null;
  
  private volatile boolean isRunning;
  
  private final BikeConfigurationPanelController bikeConfigurationPanelController;
  
  private final ConfigurationManager configurationManager;
  
  private String valueArticleNo;
  
  private String valueBikeId;
  
  private String valueComment;
  
  private String valueBatteryKey;
  
  private final SampleValidator sampleValidator;
  
  public static final KeyStroke STOP_FLASH_ASSISTANT_KEY_STROKE = KeyStroke.getKeyStroke(117, 0);
  
  public FlashAssistantDialogController(BikeConfigurationPanelController bikeConfigurationPanelController, ConfigurationManager configurationManager) {
    this.bikeConfigurationPanelController = bikeConfigurationPanelController;
    this.configurationManager = configurationManager;
    this.sampleValidator = SampleValidatorFactory.getSampleValidator();
  }
  
  private void onArticleNoEntered(ActionEvent e) {
    LOGGER.info("ArticleNoEntered Action by event ID: {}", Integer.valueOf(e.getID()));
    validateArticleNo();
  }
  
  private void onBikeIdEntered(ActionEvent e) {
    LOGGER.info("BikeIdEntered Action by event ID: {}", Integer.valueOf(e.getID()));
    int checkBikeIdValue = validateBikeId();
    if (shouldNextElementGetActivated(checkBikeIdValue, e)) {
      activateNextElement(ActiveEntry.BIKE_ID);
    } else if (checkBikeIdValue == 0 && e.getID() != 1005) {
      this.dialog.setEditingStateBikeId(FlashAssistantDialog.EditState.EDITING);
    } 
  }
  
  private void onBatteryKeyEntered(ActionEvent e) {
    LOGGER.info("BatteryKeyEntered Action by event ID: {}", Integer.valueOf(e.getID()));
    int checkBatteryKeyEntered = validateBatteryKey();
    if (shouldNextElementGetActivated(checkBatteryKeyEntered, e)) {
      activateNextElement(ActiveEntry.BATTERY_KEY);
    } else if (checkBatteryKeyEntered == 0 && e.getID() != 1005) {
      this.dialog.setEditingStateBatLock(FlashAssistantDialog.EditState.EDITING);
    } 
  }
  
  private void onCommentEntered(ActionEvent e) {
    LOGGER.info("InfoTextEntered Action by event ID: {}", Integer.valueOf(e.getID()));
    int checkComment = validateComment();
    if (shouldNextElementGetActivated(checkComment, e)) {
      activateNextElement(ActiveEntry.COMMENT);
    } else if (checkComment == 0 && e.getID() != 1005) {
      this.dialog.setEditingStateComment(FlashAssistantDialog.EditState.EDITING);
    } 
  }
  
  private boolean shouldNextElementGetActivated(int validationResult, ActionEvent e) {
    boolean activateNextField = (validationResult == 1 || validationResult == -2 || validationResult == -3);
    activateNextField = (activateNextField && e.getID() != 1005);
    return activateNextField;
  }
  
  private void activateNextElement(ActiveEntry activeEntry) {
    String loggerText = "Activate next field. From " + activeEntry + " to {}";
    if (activeEntry == ActiveEntry.ARTICLE_NO) {
      LOGGER.info(loggerText, ActiveEntry.BIKE_ID);
      this.dialog.setEditingStateBikeId(FlashAssistantDialog.EditState.EDITING);
    } else if (isCommentEnabled() && activeEntry == ActiveEntry.BIKE_ID) {
      LOGGER.info(loggerText, ActiveEntry.COMMENT);
      this.dialog.setEditingStateComment(FlashAssistantDialog.EditState.EDITING);
    } else if (isShowBatteryLockEnabled() && activeEntry != ActiveEntry.BATTERY_KEY) {
      LOGGER.info(loggerText, ActiveEntry.BATTERY_KEY);
      this.dialog.setEditingStateBatLock(FlashAssistantDialog.EditState.EDITING);
    } 
  }
  
  private void onCancelAssistant(ActionEvent e) {
    LOGGER.info("Cancel the FlashAssistant was called");
    this.bikeConfigurationPanelController.onKeyEvent(new EbikeKeyEvent(EbikeKeyEvent.KeyEventType.TOGGLE_FLASH_ASSISTANT));
  }
  
  private boolean allValuesAcceptable() {
    int checkArticleNo = validateArticleNo();
    int checkBikeId = validateBikeId();
    int checkBatKey = isShowBatteryLockEnabled() ? validateBatteryKey() : 1;
    int checkComment = isCommentEnabled() ? validateComment() : 1;
    boolean allValuesAcceptable = (checkArticleNo == 1 && (checkBikeId == 1 || checkBikeId == -2));
    allValuesAcceptable = (allValuesAcceptable && (checkBatKey == 1 || checkBatKey == -2));
    allValuesAcceptable = (allValuesAcceptable && (checkComment == 1 || checkComment == -2));
    LOGGER.info("Checked all values acceptable. Article: {}; BikeId: {}; BatteryKey: {}; Comment: {} => allAcceptable: {}", checkArticleNo, checkBikeId, checkBatKey, checkComment, allValuesAcceptable);
    return allValuesAcceptable;
  }
  
  private boolean syncDialogWithConfigPanelBeforeFlash() {
    LOGGER.info("Start synchronize the Dialog with the Config-Tab");
    if (this.dialog != null && this.dialog.isVisible()) {
      if (validateArticleNo() != 1)
        return false; 
      if (!syncBikeIdWithConfigPanelAndValidate())
        return false; 
      if (!syncBatLockWithConfigPanelAndValidate())
        return false; 
      if (!syncCommentWithConfigPanelAndValidate())
        return false; 
    } 
    LOGGER.info("Synchronize was successful");
    return true;
  }
  
  private boolean syncBikeIdWithConfigPanelAndValidate() {
    if (!StringUtils.equals(this.dialog.getBikeIdValue(), this.bikeConfigurationPanelController.getBikeIdController().getValue())) {
      LOGGER.info("Synchronize the BikeId with the Config-Tab");
      int retVal = validateBikeId();
      if (retVal == -1)
        return false; 
    } 
    return true;
  }
  
  private boolean syncBatLockWithConfigPanelAndValidate() {
    if (isShowBatteryLockEnabled() && !StringUtils.equals(this.dialog.getBatteryLockKeyValue(), this.bikeConfigurationPanelController.getBatteryLockKeyController().getValue())) {
      LOGGER.info("Synchronize the BatteryLock with the Config-Tab");
      int retVal = validateBatteryKey();
      if (retVal == -1)
        return false; 
    } 
    return true;
  }
  
  private boolean syncCommentWithConfigPanelAndValidate() {
    if (isCommentEnabled() && !StringUtils.equals(this.dialog.getCommentValue(), this.bikeConfigurationPanelController.getInfoTextController().getValue())) {
      LOGGER.info("Synchronize the InfoText with the Config-Tab");
      int retVal = validateComment();
      if (retVal == -1)
        return false; 
    } 
    return true;
  }
  
  private void checkForFlashStep() {
    LOGGER.info("Check if flash the bike is possible. bike connected: {}; flashbutton enabled: {}; container configured to bike: {}", this.configurationManager.isBikeConnected(), this.bikeConfigurationPanelController.getBikeConfigurationPanel().getWriteToBikeButton().isEnabled(), this.configurationManager.isContainerConfiguredToBike());
    if (StringUtils.isEmpty(this.dialog.getArticleNoValue()))
      return; 
    if (!syncDialogWithConfigPanelBeforeFlash())
      return; 
    if (allValuesAcceptable() && this.configurationManager.isBikeConnected() && this.bikeConfigurationPanelController.getBikeConfigurationPanel().getWriteToBikeButton().isEnabled() && this.configurationManager.isContainerConfiguredToBike()) {
      if (isFlashAutomaticallyActivated()) {
        LOGGER.info("Start the flashprocess via automated button press");
        this.bikeConfigurationPanelController.onKeyEvent(new EbikeKeyEvent(EbikeKeyEvent.KeyEventType.WRITE_CONFIG_TO_BIKE));
      } 
      this.dialog.setVisible(false);
    } 
  }
  
  public boolean isRunning() {
    return this.isRunning;
  }
  
  public void setRunning(boolean isRunning) {
    LOGGER.info("set Running was called. wan't to set the running from {} to {}", Boolean.valueOf(this.isRunning), Boolean.valueOf(isRunning));
    if (this.isRunning != isRunning)
      if (isRunning) {
        startFlashAssistant();
      } else {
        stopFlashAssistant();
      }  
  }
  
  private void startFlashAssistant() {
    LOGGER.info("try to start the FlashAssistant. SpecificationFile state is: {}", SpecificationTable.getLastFileState());
    switch (SpecificationTable.getLastFileState()) {
      case FILE_COULDNT_BE_READ:
      case NO_FILE_IS_SELECTED:
        showOkMessage(BUNDLE.getString("FlashAssistant.ErrorMessage.AkvNotFound"));
        break;
      case MISSING_ARTICLE_COLUMN:
      case MISSING_CONFIGURATION_COLUMN:
        showOkMessage(BUNDLE.getString("FlashAssistant.ErrorMessage.AkvIncorrect"));
        break;
      case FILE_IS_INVALID:
        showOkMessage(BUNDLE.getString("FlashAssistant.ErrorMessage.AkvIncorrect") + "\n" + BUNDLE.getString("FlashAssistant.ErrorMessage.AkvIncorrect"));
        break;
      case VALID:
        setupDialog();
        clearDialogForNewInput();
        this.isRunning = true;
        this.bikeConfigurationPanelController.getBikeConfigurationPanel().getFlashAssistantButton().setSelected(isRunning());
        this.dialog.setVisible(true);
        break;
    } 
  }
  
  private void showOkMessage(String message) {
    LOGGER.info("show OK-Message with info text: {}", message);
    TestableJOptionPane.showMessageDialog(message, BUNDLE.getString("FlashAssistant.Dialog.title"), 2);
  }
  
  private int showSameValuesEnteredMessage(String valueName1, String valueName2) {
    String[] options = { BUNDLE.getString("JOptionPane.Next"), BUNDLE.getString("JOptionPane.Correction") };
    String message = String.format(BUNDLE.getString("FlashAssistant.ErrorMessage.SameValuesEntered"), valueName1, valueName2);
    int retVal = TestableJOptionPane.showOptionDialog(message, BUNDLE.getString("FlashAssistant.Dialog.title"), -1, -1, null, options, options[1]);
    LOGGER.info("show same-values-popup for {} and {}. User selected: {}", valueName1, valueName2, retVal);
    return retVal;
  }
  
  private void stopFlashAssistant() {
    LOGGER.info("stop the FlashAssistant");
    if (this.dialog != null) {
      if (this.dialog.isVisible())
        this.dialog.setVisible(false); 
      this.dialog.dispose();
    } 
    this.dialog = null;
    this.isRunning = false;
    this.bikeConfigurationPanelController.getBikeConfigurationPanel().getFlashAssistantButton().setSelected(isRunning());
    this.configurationManager.setConfigurationValue(ConfigurationKey.OEM_PARTNUMBER, null);
  }
  
  void setupDialog() {
    LOGGER.info("Create and initialize the FlashAssistantDialog");
    this.dialog = new FlashAssistantDialog((JFrame)SwingUtilities.getRoot((Component)this.bikeConfigurationPanelController.getBikeConfigurationPanel()));
    this.dialog.setLocationRelativeTo(SwingUtilities.getRoot((Component)this.bikeConfigurationPanelController.getBikeConfigurationPanel()));
    setupArticleNo();
    setupBikeId();
    setupInfoText();
    setupBatteryKey();
    setupStopButton();
    this.dialog.addWindowListener(new WindowAdapter() {
          public void windowClosing(WindowEvent e) {
            FlashAssistantDialogController.this.onCancelAssistant(null);
          }
        });
    this.configurationManager.setConfigurationValue(ConfigurationKey.OEM_PARTNUMBER, null);
  }
  
  private void setupArticleNo() {
    this.dialog.getArticleNoTextField().setAction(new AbstractAction() {
          private static final long serialVersionUID = -5644390861803492118L;
          
          public void actionPerformed(ActionEvent e) {
            FlashAssistantDialogController.this.onArticleNoEntered(e);
          }
        });
    this.dialog.getArticleNoTextField().setInputVerifier(new InputVerifier() {
          public boolean verify(JComponent input) {
            return true;
          }
          
          public boolean shouldYieldFocus(JComponent input) {
            if (FlashAssistantDialogController.this.validateArticleNo() != 1)
              return false; 
            return true;
          }
        });
  }
  
  private void setupBikeId() {
    this.dialog.getBikeIdTextField().setAction(new AbstractAction() {
          private static final long serialVersionUID = -2644390861803492172L;
          
          public void actionPerformed(ActionEvent e) {
            FlashAssistantDialogController.this.onBikeIdEntered(e);
          }
        });
    this.dialog.getBikeIdTextField().setInputVerifier(new InputVerifier() {
          public boolean verify(JComponent input) {
            return true;
          }
          
          public boolean shouldYieldFocus(JComponent input) {
            if (FlashAssistantDialogController.this.validateBikeId() == -1)
              return false; 
            return true;
          }
        });
  }
  
  private void setupInfoText() {
    this.dialog.setCommentVisible(isCommentEnabled());
    this.dialog.getInfoTextField().setAction(new AbstractAction() {
          private static final long serialVersionUID = -5644390861803492172L;
          
          public void actionPerformed(ActionEvent e) {
            FlashAssistantDialogController.this.onCommentEntered(e);
          }
        });
    this.dialog.getInfoTextField().setInputVerifier(new InputVerifier() {
          public boolean verify(JComponent input) {
            return true;
          }
          
          public boolean shouldYieldFocus(JComponent input) {
            if (FlashAssistantDialogController.this.validateComment() == -1)
              return false; 
            return true;
          }
        });
  }
  
  private void setupBatteryKey() {
    this.dialog.setBatteryLockKeyVisible(isShowBatteryLockEnabled());
    this.dialog.getBatteryLockTextField().setAction(new AbstractAction() {
          private static final long serialVersionUID = -5649390861803492172L;
          
          public void actionPerformed(ActionEvent e) {
            FlashAssistantDialogController.this.onBatteryKeyEntered(e);
          }
        });
    this.dialog.getBatteryLockTextField().setInputVerifier(new InputVerifier() {
          public boolean verify(JComponent input) {
            return true;
          }
          
          public boolean shouldYieldFocus(JComponent input) {
            if (FlashAssistantDialogController.this.validateBatteryKey() == -1)
              return false; 
            return true;
          }
        });
  }
  
  private void setupStopButton() {
    AbstractAction stopAction = new AbstractAction() {
        private static final long serialVersionUID = -5644390861603492172L;
        
        public void actionPerformed(ActionEvent e) {
          FlashAssistantDialogController.this.onCancelAssistant(e);
        }
      };
    this.dialog.getStopButton().addActionListener(stopAction);
    this.dialog.getStopButton().getInputMap(2).put(STOP_FLASH_ASSISTANT_KEY_STROKE, "abort");
    this.dialog.getStopButton().getActionMap().put("abort", stopAction);
  }
  
  private void clearDialogForNewInput() {
    LOGGER.info("clear/reset all the values on the dialog.");
    this.valueArticleNo = "";
    this.valueBikeId = "";
    this.valueBatteryKey = "";
    this.valueComment = "";
    this.configurationManager.setConfigurationValue(ConfigurationKey.OEM_PARTNUMBER, null);
    this.dialog.clearAllValues();
    this.configurationManager.clearConfiguration();
    this.configurationManager.clearContainer();
    this.dialog.setEditingStateArticlNo(FlashAssistantDialog.EditState.EDITING);
    this.dialog.setEditingStateBikeId(FlashAssistantDialog.EditState.DISABLED);
    this.dialog.setEditingStateBatLock(FlashAssistantDialog.EditState.DISABLED);
    this.dialog.setEditingStateComment(FlashAssistantDialog.EditState.DISABLED);
  }
  
  public void onHardwareConnectionChanged(HardwareConnectionChangedEvent event) {
    LOGGER.debug("HardwareConnectionChangedEvent received: '{}'", event);
    if (event.getSystemType() == HardwareConnectionChangedEvent.HardwareSystem.BIKE_SYSTEM)
      switch (event.getAction()) {
        case SYSTEM_CONNECTED:
          EventQueue.invokeLater(() -> onBikeConnection());
          break;
        case SYSTEM_RECONNECTED:
          EventQueue.invokeLater(() -> onBikeReconnection());
          break;
      }  
  }
  
  private synchronized void onBikeConnection() {
    LOGGER.info("Bike connected event received");
    if (this.dialog != null && this.dialog.isVisible()) {
      validateBikeAndContainer();
      checkForFlashStep();
    } else if (this.dialog != null && !this.dialog.isVisible()) {
      checkShowDialogAgain();
    } 
  }
  
  private synchronized void onBikeReconnection() {
    LOGGER.info("Bike reconnected event received");
    if (this.dialog != null && this.dialog.isVisible()) {
      validateBikeAndContainer();
      checkForFlashStep();
    } 
  }
  
  public void onContainerConfigurationChanged(ContainerConfigurationChangedEvent event) {
    LOGGER.debug("ContainerConfigurationChangedEvent received: '{}'", event);
    EventQueue.invokeLater(() -> onContainerConfigurationChangedActions(event));
  }
  
  private synchronized void onContainerConfigurationChangedActions(ContainerConfigurationChangedEvent event) {
    if (this.dialog != null && this.dialog.isVisible())
      switch (event.getAction()) {
        case LOADED:
        case CHANGED:
          LOGGER.info("Process ContainerConfigurationChangedEvent: Action: {}; Trigger: {}", event.getAction(), event.getTrigger());
          if (event.getTrigger() == ContainerConfigurationChangedEvent.Trigger.FILE)
            validateBikeAndContainer(); 
          break;
      }  
  }
  
  private void checkShowDialogAgain() {
    LOGGER.info("Show dialog again. Is the dialog already visible: ", Boolean.valueOf(this.dialog.isVisible()));
    if (!this.dialog.isVisible()) {
      clearDialogForNewInput();
      this.dialog.setVisible(true);
    } 
  }
  
  public void onBikeConfigurationChanged(BikeConfigurationChangedEvent event) {
    LOGGER.debug("BikeConfigurationChangedEvent received: '{}'", event);
    switch (event.getAction()) {
      case READ_FROM_FILE:
        EventQueue.invokeLater(() -> onConfigurationFileChanged());
        break;
      case VALUE_CHANGED:
        EventQueue.invokeLater(() -> onConfigurationValueChanged(event));
        break;
    } 
  }
  
  private synchronized void onConfigurationFileChanged() {
    if (this.dialog != null && this.dialog.isVisible()) {
      LOGGER.info("Configuration file changed");
      this.dialog.setConfigFileNameText(this.configurationManager.getConfigurationFileName());
      this.configurationManager.setConfigurationValue(ConfigurationKey.OEM_PARTNUMBER, this.valueArticleNo);
      activateNextElement(ActiveEntry.ARTICLE_NO);
      checkForFlashStep();
    } 
  }
  
  private synchronized void onConfigurationValueChanged(BikeConfigurationChangedEvent event) {
    ConfigurationKey key = event.getKey();
    if (key == null || this.dialog == null || !this.dialog.isVisible())
      return; 
    switch (key) {
      case OEM_PARTNUMBER:
        LOGGER.info("configuration changed for {} received", key);
        if (valueChanged(event, this.valueArticleNo))
          validateArticleNo(); 
        checkForFlashStep();
        break;
      case BIKE_ID:
        LOGGER.info("configuration changed for {} received", key);
        if (valueChanged(event, this.valueBikeId))
          validateBikeId(); 
        checkForFlashStep();
        break;
      case INFO_TEXT:
        LOGGER.info("configuration changed for {} received", key);
        if (valueChanged(event, this.valueComment))
          validateComment(); 
        checkForFlashStep();
        break;
      case KEY_NUMBER_BATTERY_LOCK:
        LOGGER.info("configuration changed for {} received", key);
        if (valueChanged(event, this.dialog.getBatteryLockKeyValue()))
          validateBatteryKey(); 
        checkForFlashStep();
        break;
    } 
  }
  
  private boolean valueChanged(BikeConfigurationChangedEvent event, String oldValue) {
    String newValue = (event.getNewValue() != null) ? event.getNewValue().toString() : null;
    return !StringUtils.equals(oldValue, newValue);
  }
  
  private int validateArticleNo() {
    if (this.dialog == null || !this.dialog.isVisible())
      return -3; 
    boolean changed = true;
    if (StringUtils.equals(this.valueArticleNo, this.dialog.getArticleNoValue())) {
      changed = false;
    } else {
      this.valueArticleNo = this.dialog.getArticleNoValue();
    } 
    String configurationFile = SpecificationTable.getConfiguration(this.valueArticleNo);
    if (StringUtils.isBlank(configurationFile)) {
      this.dialog.setEditingStateArticlNo(FlashAssistantDialog.EditState.INVALID);
      if (changed)
        showOkMessage(BUNDLE.getString("FlashAssistant.ErrorMessage.ArticleNotFoundInAkv")); 
      return 0;
    } 
    File file = new File(configurationFile);
    if (!file.exists() || !file.isFile() || !file.canRead()) {
      this.dialog.setEditingStateArticlNo(FlashAssistantDialog.EditState.INVALID);
      if (changed)
        showOkMessage(BUNDLE.getString("FlashAssistant.ErrorMessage.ConfigurationFileNotFound")); 
      return -1;
    } 
    if (!StringUtils.equals(this.valueArticleNo, this.configurationManager.getConfigurationValue(ConfigurationKey.OEM_PARTNUMBER)))
      this.configurationManager.setConfigurationValue(ConfigurationKey.OEM_PARTNUMBER, this.valueArticleNo); 
    if (changed)
      this.configurationManager.readConfigurationFromFile(file); 
    return 1;
  }
  
  private int validateBikeAndContainer() {
    if (this.dialog == null || !this.dialog.isVisible())
      return -3; 
    if (this.configurationManager.isBikeConnected() && this.configurationManager.isContainerLoaded() && !this.sampleValidator.isSampleSoftwareInContainer(this.configurationManager.getContainerConfiguration())) {
      if (!this.configurationManager.isContainerConfiguredToBike() || !this.configurationManager.isContainerCompatibleWithBike()) {
        String[] options = { BUNDLE.getString("JOptionPane.Next"), BUNDLE.getString("JOptionPane.Correction") };
        if (TestableJOptionPane.showOptionDialog(BUNDLE.getString("FlashAssistant.ErrorMessage.ConfigNotValidForConnectedBike"), BUNDLE.getString("FlashAssistant.Dialog.title"), -1, -1, null, options, options[1]) == 1) {
          this.valueArticleNo = "";
          this.configurationManager.setConfigurationValue(ConfigurationKey.OEM_PARTNUMBER, "");
          this.dialog.reenterArticleNo();
          return 0;
        } 
        this.dialog.setEditingStateArticlNo(FlashAssistantDialog.EditState.INVALID);
        return -2;
      } 
      this.dialog.setEditingStateArticlNo(FlashAssistantDialog.EditState.VALID);
      return 1;
    } 
    this.dialog.setEditingStateArticlNo(FlashAssistantDialog.EditState.VALID);
    return -1;
  }
  
  private int validateBikeId() {
    if (this.dialog == null || !this.dialog.isVisible())
      return -4; 
    boolean changed = true;
    if (StringUtils.equals(this.valueBikeId, this.dialog.getBikeIdValue())) {
      changed = false;
    } else {
      this.valueBikeId = this.dialog.getBikeIdValue();
    } 
    if (StringUtils.isBlank(this.valueBikeId))
      return 0; 
    boolean ignoreSameValue = false;
    int retValCheckEqual = checkForEqualValues(this.valueBikeId, this.valueArticleNo, ENTRY_NAME_BIKEID, ENTRY_NAME_ARTICLENO, changed);
    if (retValCheckEqual == -1) {
      this.valueBikeId = "";
      this.dialog.reenterBikeId();
      return -1;
    } 
    if (retValCheckEqual == 0)
      ignoreSameValue = true; 
    if (!writeAndValidateBikeId()) {
      this.dialog.setEditingStateBikeId(FlashAssistantDialog.EditState.INVALID);
      return -3;
    } 
    if (ignoreSameValue) {
      this.dialog.setEditingStateBikeId(FlashAssistantDialog.EditState.INVALID);
      return -2;
    } 
    this.dialog.setEditingStateBikeId(FlashAssistantDialog.EditState.VALID);
    return 1;
  }
  
  private boolean writeAndValidateBikeId() {
    boolean validValue = this.bikeConfigurationPanelController.getBikeIdController().isValid();
    if (!StringUtils.equals(this.valueBikeId, this.bikeConfigurationPanelController.getBikeIdController().getValue())) {
      this.bikeConfigurationPanelController.getBikeIdController().setValue(this.valueBikeId);
      if (!StringUtils.equals(this.valueBikeId, this.bikeConfigurationPanelController.getBikeIdController().getValue()) || !this.bikeConfigurationPanelController.getBikeIdController().isValid()) {
        validValue = false;
      } else {
        validValue = true;
      } 
    } 
    return validValue;
  }
  
  private int validateComment() {
    if (this.dialog == null || !this.dialog.isVisible())
      return -3; 
    boolean changed = true;
    if (StringUtils.equals(this.valueComment, this.dialog.getCommentValue())) {
      changed = false;
    } else {
      this.valueComment = this.dialog.getCommentValue();
    } 
    if (StringUtils.isEmpty(this.valueComment))
      return 0; 
    boolean ignoreSameValue = false;
    int retValCheckEqual = checkForEqualValues(this.valueComment, this.valueArticleNo, ENTRY_NAME_COMMENT, ENTRY_NAME_ARTICLENO, changed);
    if (retValCheckEqual == -1) {
      this.dialog.reenterComment();
      this.valueComment = "";
      return -1;
    } 
    if (retValCheckEqual == 0)
      ignoreSameValue = true; 
    retValCheckEqual = checkForEqualValues(this.valueComment, this.valueBikeId, ENTRY_NAME_COMMENT, ENTRY_NAME_BIKEID, changed);
    if (retValCheckEqual == -1) {
      this.dialog.reenterComment();
      this.valueComment = "";
      return -1;
    } 
    if (retValCheckEqual == 0)
      ignoreSameValue = true; 
    if (!writeAndValidateComment()) {
      this.dialog.setEditingStateComment(FlashAssistantDialog.EditState.INVALID);
      return -3;
    } 
    if (ignoreSameValue) {
      this.dialog.setEditingStateComment(FlashAssistantDialog.EditState.INVALID);
      return -2;
    } 
    this.dialog.setEditingStateComment(FlashAssistantDialog.EditState.VALID);
    return 1;
  }
  
  private boolean writeAndValidateComment() {
    boolean validValue = this.bikeConfigurationPanelController.getInfoTextController().isValid();
    if (!StringUtils.equals(this.valueComment, this.bikeConfigurationPanelController.getInfoTextController().getValue())) {
      this.bikeConfigurationPanelController.getInfoTextController().setValue(this.valueComment);
      if (!StringUtils.equals(this.valueComment, this.bikeConfigurationPanelController.getInfoTextController().getValue()) || !this.bikeConfigurationPanelController.getInfoTextController().isValid()) {
        validValue = false;
      } else {
        validValue = true;
      } 
    } 
    return validValue;
  }
  
  private int validateBatteryKey() {
    if (this.dialog == null || !this.dialog.isVisible())
      return -3; 
    boolean changed = true;
    if (StringUtils.equals(this.valueBatteryKey, this.dialog.getBatteryLockKeyValue())) {
      changed = false;
    } else {
      this.valueBatteryKey = this.dialog.getBatteryLockKeyValue();
    } 
    if (StringUtils.isBlank(this.valueBatteryKey))
      return 0; 
    boolean ignoreSameValue = false;
    int retValCheckEqual = checkForEqualValues(this.valueBatteryKey, this.valueArticleNo, ENTRY_NAME_BATTERYKEY, ENTRY_NAME_ARTICLENO, changed);
    if (retValCheckEqual == -1) {
      this.dialog.reenterBatLock();
      this.valueBatteryKey = "";
      return -1;
    } 
    if (retValCheckEqual == 0)
      ignoreSameValue = true; 
    retValCheckEqual = checkForEqualValues(this.valueBatteryKey, this.valueBikeId, ENTRY_NAME_BATTERYKEY, ENTRY_NAME_BIKEID, changed);
    if (retValCheckEqual == -1) {
      this.dialog.reenterBatLock();
      this.valueBatteryKey = "";
      return -1;
    } 
    if (retValCheckEqual == 0)
      ignoreSameValue = true; 
    retValCheckEqual = checkForEqualValues(this.valueBatteryKey, this.valueComment, ENTRY_NAME_BATTERYKEY, ENTRY_NAME_COMMENT, changed);
    if (retValCheckEqual == -1) {
      this.dialog.reenterBatLock();
      this.valueBatteryKey = "";
      return -1;
    } 
    if (retValCheckEqual == 0)
      ignoreSameValue = true; 
    if (!writeAndValidateBatLock()) {
      this.dialog.setEditingStateBatLock(FlashAssistantDialog.EditState.INVALID);
      return -3;
    } 
    if (ignoreSameValue) {
      this.dialog.setEditingStateBatLock(FlashAssistantDialog.EditState.INVALID);
      return -2;
    } 
    this.dialog.setEditingStateBatLock(FlashAssistantDialog.EditState.VALID);
    return 1;
  }
  
  private boolean writeAndValidateBatLock() {
    boolean validValue = this.bikeConfigurationPanelController.getBatteryLockKeyController().isValid();
    if (!StringUtils.equals(this.valueBatteryKey, this.bikeConfigurationPanelController.getBatteryLockKeyController().getValue())) {
      this.bikeConfigurationPanelController.getBatteryLockKeyController().setValue(this.valueBatteryKey);
      if (!StringUtils.equals(this.valueBatteryKey, this.bikeConfigurationPanelController.getBatteryLockKeyController().getValue()) || !this.bikeConfigurationPanelController.getBatteryLockKeyController().isValid()) {
        validValue = false;
      } else {
        validValue = true;
      } 
    } 
    return validValue;
  }
  
  private int checkForEqualValues(String value1, String value2, String value1Name, String value2Name, boolean valuesAreChanged) {
    if (StringUtils.equals(value1, value2)) {
      if (valuesAreChanged) {
        int same = showSameValuesEnteredMessage(value1Name, value2Name);
        if (same == 1)
          return -1; 
      } 
      return 0;
    } 
    return 1;
  }
  
  private boolean isShowBatteryLockEnabled() {
    boolean result = false;
    try {
      result = SettingsProxy.getInstance().getGlobalSettings().getBoolean("flashassistant_battery_key_visible");
    } catch (ConfigurationNotFoundException ex) {
      LOGGER.error("Failed to read flash assistant setting from global settings configuration. Default setting used.", (Throwable)ex);
    } 
    return result;
  }
  
  private boolean isCommentEnabled() {
    boolean result = false;
    try {
      result = SettingsProxy.getInstance().getGlobalSettings().getBoolean("configurationtab_configuration_comment_visible");
    } catch (ConfigurationNotFoundException ex) {
      LOGGER.error("Failed to read configuration comment setting from global setting {} configuration. Default setting used.", "configurationtab_configuration_comment_visible", ex);
    } 
    return result;
  }
  
  private boolean isFlashAutomaticallyActivated() {
    boolean result = false;
    try {
      result = SettingsProxy.getInstance().getGlobalSettings().getBoolean("flashassistant_flash_automatically_activated");
    } catch (ConfigurationNotFoundException ex) {
      LOGGER.error("Failed to read flash assistant setting from global settings configuration. Default setting used.", (Throwable)ex);
    } 
    return result;
  }

ITEM 130: com/gigatronik/beds/gui/flashassistant/specificationtable/SpecificationTable.java
========================================================================================================================
package com.gigatronik.beds.gui.flashassistant.specificationtable;

import com.gigatronik.beds.settings.SettingsProxy;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.framework.plugins.exceptions.ConfigurationNotFoundException;
import java.io.File;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.Iterator;
import java.util.regex.Matcher;
import java.util.regex.Pattern;
import org.apache.commons.csv.CSVFormat;
import org.apache.commons.csv.CSVParser;
import org.apache.commons.csv.CSVRecord;
import org.apache.commons.lang3.StringUtils;
import org.slf4j.Logger;
import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;

public class SpecificationTable {
  public enum SpecificationTableFileStatus {
    VALID, FILE_COULDNT_BE_READ, NO_FILE_IS_SELECTED, MISSING_ARTICLE_COLUMN, MISSING_CONFIGURATION_COLUMN, FILE_IS_INVALID;
  }
  
  private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(SpecificationTable.class);
  
  private static final String FLASHASSISTANT_PROPERTY_SPECIFICATIONTABLE_FILE_LOCATION = "flashassistant_specificationtable_location";
  
  private static final String TITLE_ARTICLENO = "OEMArticleNo";
  
  private static final String TITLE_CONFIGURATIONFILE = "OEMConfigurationFile";
  
  private static final Pattern VALID_ARTICLE_PATTERN = Pattern.compile("(.){1,}");
  
  private static final Pattern VALID_CONFIGURATION_PATTERN = Pattern.compile("(.){1,}");
  
  private static SpecificationTable instance;
  
  private static SpecificationTableFileStatus lastFileState = SpecificationTableFileStatus.NO_FILE_IS_SELECTED;
  
  private static final HashMap<String, String> mappingValues = new HashMap<>();
  
  private static String lastValidReadOEMArticleNo;
  
  public static SpecificationTable getInstance() {
    if (instance == null) {
      instance = new SpecificationTable();
      lastFileState = parseSpecificationTable();
    } 
    return instance;
  }
  
  public static SpecificationTableFileStatus readSpecificationTable() {
    if (instance == null) {
      getInstance();
    } else {
      lastFileState = parseSpecificationTable();
    } 
    return lastFileState;
  }
  
  public static SpecificationTableFileStatus getLastFileState() {
    if (instance == null)
      getInstance(); 
    return lastFileState;
  }
  
  public static String getConfiguration(String articleNo) {
    if (instance == null)
      getInstance(); 
    String result = mappingValues.get(articleNo);
    return (result == null) ? "" : result;
  }
  
  private static SpecificationTableFileStatus parseSpecificationTable() {
    Iterable<CSVRecord> records;
    mappingValues.clear();
    lastValidReadOEMArticleNo = "";
    String filePath = getSpecificationtableLocation();
    if (StringUtils.isBlank(filePath)) {
      LOGGER.error("SpecificationTable file isn't selected.");
      return SpecificationTableFileStatus.NO_FILE_IS_SELECTED;
    } 
    try {
      CSVParser parser = CSVParser.parse(new File(filePath), StandardCharsets.UTF_8, CSVFormat.EXCEL.withDelimiter(';'));
      records = parser.getRecords();
    } catch (IOException ex) {
      LOGGER.error("SpecificationTable file could not be loaded.", (Throwable)ex);
      return SpecificationTableFileStatus.FILE_COULDNT_BE_READ;
    } 
    return parseSpecificationFileContent(records);
  }
  
  private static SpecificationTableFileStatus parseSpecificationFileContent(Iterable<CSVRecord> records) {
    Iterator<CSVRecord> iterator = records.iterator();
    if (!iterator.hasNext())
      return SpecificationTableFileStatus.MISSING_ARTICLE_COLUMN; 
    CSVRecord record = iterator.next();
    int columnArticleNo = getIndexForText("OEMArticleNo", record);
    if (columnArticleNo < 0) {
      LOGGER.error("Specification table file misses the title for ArticleNo.");
      return SpecificationTableFileStatus.MISSING_ARTICLE_COLUMN;
    } 
    int columnConfiguration = getIndexForText("OEMConfigurationFile", record);
    if (columnConfiguration < 0) {
      LOGGER.error("Specification table file misses the title for ConfigurationFile.");
      return SpecificationTableFileStatus.MISSING_CONFIGURATION_COLUMN;
    } 
    int columnCountFirstRow = record.size();
    while (iterator.hasNext()) {
      CSVRecord recordElement = iterator.next();
      String key = (recordElement.size() > columnArticleNo) ? recordElement.get(columnArticleNo) : "";
      String value = (recordElement.size() > columnConfiguration) ? recordElement.get(columnConfiguration) : "";
      if (recordElement.size() != columnCountFirstRow) {
        LOGGER.error("In the specification table the row after key '{}' has the wrong count of columns.", lastValidReadOEMArticleNo);
        return SpecificationTableFileStatus.FILE_IS_INVALID;
      } 
      lastValidReadOEMArticleNo = key;
      Matcher keyMatcher = VALID_ARTICLE_PATTERN.matcher(key);
      Matcher valueMatcher = VALID_CONFIGURATION_PATTERN.matcher(value);
      if (!keyMatcher.matches() || !valueMatcher.matches()) {
        LOGGER.info("In the specification table was an illegal entry found. The key '{}' with value '{}' will not be added.", key, value);
        continue;
      } 
      mappingValues.put(key, value);
    } 
    return SpecificationTableFileStatus.VALID;
  }
  
  public static String getLastValidReadOEMArticleNo() {
    if (instance == null)
      throw new NullPointerException("Specificationtable was never read. Call first 'readSpecificationTable' or 'getInstance'"); 
    return lastValidReadOEMArticleNo;
  }
  
  private static int getIndexForText(String searchText, CSVRecord record) {
    for (int i = 0; i < record.size(); i++) {
      if (StringUtils.equals(searchText, record.get(i)))
        return i; 
    } 
    return -1;
  }
  
  private static String getSpecificationtableLocation() {
    String result = "";
    try {
      result = SettingsProxy.getInstance().getGlobalSettings().getProperty("flashassistant_specificationtable_location", result);
    } catch (ConfigurationNotFoundException ex) {
      LOGGER.error("Failed to read flash assistant settings from global settings configuration. Default settings used.", (Throwable)ex);
    } 
    return result;
  }
}

    this.rightsManager = rightsManager;

    addComponentListener();
    rightsManager.addListener(this);
    repaintFrameUponWindowStateAction();
  }
  
  private void repaintFrameUponWindowStateAction() {
    addWindowStateListener(e -> {
          LOGGER.debug("Received '{}', repaint '{}'", e.getClass(), getClass());
          repaint();
        });
  }
  
  private void createGui() {
    setDefaultCloseOperation(0);
    this.rootPane.setName("applicationRootPane");
    setTitle(GUI_TITLE_DEFAULT);
    setMinimumSize(new Dimension(1024, 768));
    setPreferredSize(new Dimension(1366, 768));
    setResizable(true);
    setIconImage(new ImageIcon(getClass().getResource("/com/gigatronik/ebike/gui/resources/Bosch-logo-square.png")).getImage());
    setName("frmMain");
    this.applicationPanel = new EBikeApplicationPanel(this.ebikeApplication, this.rightsManager);
    this.applicationPanel.setOpaque(true);
    this.applicationPanel.setName("pnlContent");
    setContentPane((Container)this.applicationPanel);
    setLocationRelativeTo(null);
    pack();
    addWindowListener();
    loadFramePositionAndSize();
  }
  
  private void addComponentListener() {
    addComponentListener(new ComponentAdapter() {
          public void componentShown(ComponentEvent e) {
            ApplicationFrame.LOGGER.info("GUI displayed");
            SplashScreenLauncher.getInstance().closeSplashScreen();
          }
        });
  }
  
  private void loadFramePositionAndSize() {
    try {
      String x = SettingsProxy.getInstance().getGlobalSettings().getProperty("window.position.x");
      String y = SettingsProxy.getInstance().getGlobalSettings().getProperty("window.position.y");
      String h = SettingsProxy.getInstance().getGlobalSettings().getProperty("window.height");
      String w = SettingsProxy.getInstance().getGlobalSettings().getProperty("window.width");
      if (x != null && ConverterUtils.isInteger(x) && y != null && 
        ConverterUtils.isInteger(y) && h != null && 
        ConverterUtils.isInteger(h) && w != null && 
        ConverterUtils.isInteger(w)) {
        setBounds(Integer.parseInt(x), Integer.parseInt(y), Integer.parseInt(w), Integer.parseInt(h));
      } else {
        setLocationRelativeTo(null);
      } 
      String max = SettingsProxy.getInstance().getGlobalSettings().getProperty("window.maximized");
      if (StringUtils.equals(max, "true") || (h == null && w == null))
        setExtendedState(getExtendedState() | 0x6); 
    } catch (ConfigurationNotFoundException e) {
      LOGGER.error("Failed to load window position and size from configuration", (Throwable)e);
    } 
  }
  
  public void saveWindowPositionAndSize() {
    String value = String.valueOf((getExtendedState() == 6));
    try {
      SettingsProxy.getInstance().getGlobalSettings().setProperty("window.maximized", value);
      SettingsProxy.getInstance().getGlobalSettings().setProperty("window.position.x", String.valueOf(getX()));
      SettingsProxy.getInstance().getGlobalSettings().setProperty("window.position.y", String.valueOf(getY()));
      SettingsProxy.getInstance().getGlobalSettings().setProperty("window.height", String.valueOf(getHeight()));
      SettingsProxy.getInstance().getGlobalSettings().setProperty("window.width", String.valueOf(getWidth()));
    } catch (ConfigurationNotFoundException e) {
      LOGGER.error("Unable to save window preferences", (Throwable)e);
    } 
  }
  
  private void addWindowListener() {
    addWindowListener(new WindowAdapter() {
          public void windowClosing(WindowEvent e) {
            ApplicationFrame.LOGGER.debug("WindowListener method called: windowClosing.");
            ApplicationFrame.this.ebikeApplication.quit(0, true);
          }
        });
  }
  
  public EBikeApplicationPanel getApplicationPanel() {
    return this.applicationPanel;
  }
  
  public void onRightsChanged(RightsChangedEvent event) {
    LOGGER.debug("Received rights changed event '{}'", event);
    if (event.getUserLevel() != UserLevel.UNKNOWN)
      EventQueue.invokeLater(() -> {
            LOGGER.debug("Process rights change event now from EDT");
            setTitle(GUI_TITLE_DEFAULT + " - " + GUI_TITLE_DEFAULT);
          }); 
  }
}

  }
  
  private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(AbstractNonEcuConfigurationTabController.class);
  
  private static final Utf8ResourceBundleFormatted BUNDLE = ResourceBundleFactory.newDefaultResourceBundle();
  
  private static final String ENVIRONMENT_SHOW_NEGATIVE_RESPONSE = "showNegativeResponse";
  
  private static final String[] DIAGNOSTIC_COLUMNS = new String[] { BUNDLE.getString("EBikeServiceTab.DiagnosticTable.Column.DIAGNOSTIC_PARAMETER"), 
      BUNDLE.getString("EBikeServiceTab.DiagnosticTable.Column.VALUES") };
  
  private final BCT_BCS_CONFIGURATION bctOrBcsConfiguration;
  
  private final AbstractNonEcuConfigurationTab bctAndBcsConfigurationTab;
  
  private final TableEvaluator bctAndBcsTableEvaluator;
  
  private final String propertyNameFlashFile;
  
  private final ConfigurationManager configurationManager;
  
  private final EBikeApplication eBikeApplication;
  
  private final ApplicationProcessManager applicationProcessManager;
  
  private final RightsManager rightsManager;
  
  private TableModel tableModel;
  
  private final Executor flashExecutor = Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor(new BasicThreadFactory.Builder().namingPattern("FlashThread-%d").build());
  
  AbstractNonEcuConfigurationTabController(BCT_BCS_CONFIGURATION config, AbstractNonEcuConfigurationTab configTab, ConfigurationManager configurationManager, EBikeApplication eBikeApplication, RightsManager rightsManager) {
    this.bctOrBcsConfiguration = config;
    this.bctAndBcsConfigurationTab = configTab;
    if (this.bctOrBcsConfiguration == BCT_BCS_CONFIGURATION.BCT) {
      this.bctAndBcsTableEvaluator = new TableEvaluatorImpl(getClass().getClassLoader().getResourceAsStream("com/gigatronik/beds/gui/panels/bct/bcs/configuration/BctServiceTable.xml"), BUNDLE);
      this.propertyNameFlashFile = "bctFlashFile";
    } else {
      this.bctAndBcsTableEvaluator = new TableEvaluatorImpl(getClass().getClassLoader().getResourceAsStream("com/gigatronik/beds/gui/panels/bct/bcs/configuration/BcsServiceTable.xml"), BUNDLE);
      this.propertyNameFlashFile = "bcsFlashFile";
    } 
    this.configurationManager = configurationManager;
    this.eBikeApplication = eBikeApplication;
    this.applicationProcessManager = ApplicationProcessManager.getInstance();
    this.rightsManager = rightsManager;
    init();
  }
  
  TableModel getTableModel() {
    return this.tableModel;
  }
  
  private void init() {
    setTextsInTab();
    this.bctAndBcsConfigurationTab.getFlashButton().addActionListener(e -> {
          if (this.bctAndBcsConfigurationTab.getFlashButton().isEnabled()) {
            this.bctAndBcsConfigurationTab.getFlashButton().setEnabled(false);
            LOGGER.info("Clicked {} flash button", this.bctOrBcsConfiguration.getName());
            this.flashExecutor.execute(this::onFlashAction);
          } 
        });
    populateDefaultTable(this.bctAndBcsTableEvaluator);
  }
  
  private void setTextsInTab() {
    if (this.bctOrBcsConfiguration == BCT_BCS_CONFIGURATION.BCT) {
      this.bctAndBcsConfigurationTab.setTitle(BUNDLE.getString("BctConfigurationTab.lblTabTitle.text"));
      this.bctAndBcsConfigurationTab.getFlashButton().setToolTipText(BUNDLE.getString("BctConfigurationTab.imgbtnFlashBct.toolTipText"));
    } else {
      this.bctAndBcsConfigurationTab.setTitle(BUNDLE.getString("BcsConfigurationTab.lblTabTitle.text"));
      this.bctAndBcsConfigurationTab.getFlashButton().setToolTipText(BUNDLE.getString("BcsConfigurationTab.imgbtnFlashBcs.toolTipText"));
      this.bctAndBcsConfigurationTab.setInfoText(null);
    } 
  }
  
  private void onFlashAction() {
    try {
      String flashFile = SettingsProxy.getInstance().getGlobalSettings().getProperty(this.propertyNameFlashFile);
      if (StringUtils.isNotEmpty(flashFile)) {
        File container = new File(flashFile);
        if (container.exists() && !container.isDirectory()) {
          if (this.configurationManager.getContainerConfiguration().getContainerController().getContainerFromFileSystem(container, false)) {
            LOGGER.debug("Using local container for {} flashing {}", this.bctOrBcsConfiguration.getName(), flashFile);
            flashFirmware(true);
            return;
          } 
          LOGGER.warn("Loading container {} from {} FlashFile property failed", flashFile, this.bctOrBcsConfiguration.getName());
        } else {
          LOGGER.warn("{} FlashFile property points to unvalid file: {}", this.bctOrBcsConfiguration.getName(), flashFile);
        } 
      } else {
        LOGGER.debug("{} FlashFile property not set", this.bctOrBcsConfiguration.getName());
      } 
    } catch (ConfigurationNotFoundException ex) {
      LOGGER.warn("Global settings not available", (Throwable)ex);
    } 
    if (!new UpdateServerConnection().isServerAvailable(true)) {
      LOGGER.error("Update server not available on download bct flash data");
      setImgBtnFlashEnabled(true);
      return;
    } 
    LOGGER.debug("Download a container from the update server for {} flashing", this.bctOrBcsConfiguration.getName());
    NonEcuContainerDownloadController containerDownloadController = new NonEcuContainerDownloadController(this.eBikeApplication, this, this.configurationManager.getContainerConfiguration().getContainerController());
    if (this.configurationManager.getContainerConfiguration().getContainerController().getCff2ContainerFromInternet(ConfigUtil.getDisplayVersion(), Cff2_DesiredReply.FULL, this.configurationManager.getBikeIdentification().getSystemType(), this.configurationManager.getBikeIdentification().getApplicationId(), this.configurationManager.getBikeIdentification().getBctIdentification(), this.configurationManager.getBikeIdentification().getDuIdentification(), (EcuIdentification)this.configurationManager.getBikeIdentification().getBms1Identification(), this.configurationManager.getBikeIdentification().getHmiIdentification(), this.configurationManager.getBikeIdentification().getAbsIdentification(), this.configurationManager.getBikeIdentification().getBcsIdentification(), true, containerDownloadController)) {
      flashFirmware(false);
    } else {
      LOGGER.error("Downloading Container for {}-Flashing failed.", this.bctOrBcsConfiguration.getName());
    } 
  }
  
  private void flashFirmware(boolean useLocalContainer) {
    ApplicationProcessManager.getInstance().setProcessState(useLocalContainer ? ApplicationProcessManager.ApplicationProcess.FLASH_EBIKE : ApplicationProcessManager.ApplicationProcess.FLASH_EBIKE_DIRECT, true);
    holdOnTillDataMiningIsFinished();
    FlashProcess flashProcess = new FlashProcess(this.eBikeApplication, this.configurationManager.createBikeConfigurationSnapshot(), this.rightsManager);
    flashProcess.flashFirmware(false, false, false, false);
  }
  
  private void holdOnTillDataMiningIsFinished() {
    if (this.applicationProcessManager.isProcessActive(ApplicationProcessManager.ApplicationProcess.DATA_MINING)) {
      PrepareProgrammingDialog dialog = new PrepareProgrammingDialog(this.eBikeApplication);
      dialog.show();
    } 
  }
  
  void onConnect() {
    LOGGER.debug("Fill {} config tab table", this.bctOrBcsConfiguration.getName());
    Map<String, ComplexResponse> data = new HashMap<>();
    getData(data);
    populateTable(data);
  }
  
  private void getData(Map<String, ComplexResponse> data) {
    if (this.bctOrBcsConfiguration == BCT_BCS_CONFIGURATION.BCT) {
      getBctData(data);
    } else {
      getBcsData(data);
    } 
  }
  
  private void getBctData(Map<String, ComplexResponse> data) {
    EcuIdentification bctIdentification = this.configurationManager.getBikeIdentification().getBctIdentification();
    data.put(BctServiceParameter.PART_NUMBER.getText(), bctIdentification.getPartNumberResponse());
    data.put(BctServiceParameter.SERIAL_NUMBER.getText(), SerialNumberHelper.getSerialnumberBct(bctIdentification.getSerialNumberResponse()));
    data.put(BctServiceParameter.HW_VERSION.getText(), bctIdentification.getHwVersionResponse());
    data.put(BctServiceParameter.SW_VERSION.getText(), bctIdentification.getSwVersionResponse());
  }
  
  private void getBcsData(Map<String, ComplexResponse> data) {
    EcuIdentification bcsIdentification = this.configurationManager.getBikeIdentification().getBcsIdentification();
    data.put(BcsServiceParameter.PART_NUMBER.getText(), bcsIdentification.getPartNumberResponse());
    data.put(BcsServiceParameter.SERIAL_NUMBER.getText(), bcsIdentification.getSerialNumberResponse());
    data.put(BcsServiceParameter.HW_VERSION.getText(), bcsIdentification.getHwVersionResponse());
    data.put(BcsServiceParameter.SW_VERSION.getText(), bcsIdentification.getSwVersionResponse());
  }
  
  void onDisconnect() {
    EventQueue.invokeLater(() -> {
          populateDefaultTable(this.bctAndBcsTableEvaluator);
          setImgBtnFlashEnabled(false);
        });
  }
  
  private void populateDefaultTable(TableEvaluator tableEvaluator) {
    Map<String, Object> environment = new HashMap<>();
    List<TableEvaluatorImpl.TableEntry> result = tableEvaluator.evaluateTable(environment, null, false, null);
    this.tableModel = getDiagnosticTableModel(result);
    this.bctAndBcsConfigurationTab.getTable().setModel(this.tableModel);
  }
  
  private TableModel getDiagnosticTableModel(List<TableEvaluatorImpl.TableEntry> data) {
    TableEvaluatorImpl.TableEntry[] resultArray = data.<TableEvaluatorImpl.TableEntry>toArray(new TableEvaluatorImpl.TableEntry[0]);
    List<Object[]> dataList = new LinkedList<>();
    for (int i = 0; i < data.size(); i++) {
      dataList.add(new Object[] { resultArray[i].getCaption(), resultArray[i].getValue() });
    } 
    return new DiagnosticDefaultTableModel(dataList.toArray(new Object[0][]), DIAGNOSTIC_COLUMNS);
  }
  
  private void populateTable(Map<String, ComplexResponse> parameterValues) {
    Map<String, Object> environment = new HashMap<>();
    environment.put("showNegativeResponse", "");
    List<TableEvaluatorImpl.TableEntry> result = this.bctAndBcsTableEvaluator.evaluateTable(environment, parameterValues, false, null);
    this.tableModel = getDiagnosticTableModel(result);
    this.bctAndBcsConfigurationTab.getTable().setModel(this.tableModel);
  }
  
  abstract void setImgBtnFlashEnabled(boolean paramBoolean);
}

package com.gigatronik.beds.gui.panels.bct.bcs.configuration;

import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;

public class BcsConfigurationTabController extends AbstractNonEcuConfigurationTabController {

  private final BcsConfigurationTab bcsConfigurationTab;
  
  public BcsConfigurationTabController(BcsConfigurationTab configTab, EBikeApplication eBikeApplication, ConfigurationManager configurationManager, RightsManager rightsManager) {

    switch (event.getAction()) {

      case ECU_DISCONNECTED:

      setImgBtnFlashEnabled(true);
      onConnect();

    if (type == Constants.EcuType.BCS250)
      onDisconnect(); 
  }

    this.bcsConfigurationTab.getFlashButton().setEnabled(enabled);
  }
