package com.gigatronik.beds.gui.panels.bct.bcs.configuration;

import com.gigatronik.beds.common.bct.BctState;
import com.gigatronik.beds.common.order.OrderableListener;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.configuration.ConfigurationManager;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.configuration.event.HardwareConnectionChangedEvent;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.ecuconnectionstate.api.BctEventHandler;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.ecuconnectionstate.impl.event.BctOperationStateChangeEvent;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.rightsmanager.api.RightsManager;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.bosch.service.internationalization.ResourceBundleFactory;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.bosch.service.internationalization.Utf8ResourceBundleFormatted;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.gui.EBikeApplication;
import org.slf4j.Logger;
import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;

public class BctConfigurationTabController extends AbstractNonEcuConfigurationTabController implements BctEventHandler.BctOperationStateListener {
  private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(BctConfigurationTabController.class);
  
  private static final Utf8ResourceBundleFormatted BUNDLE = ResourceBundleFactory.newDefaultResourceBundle();
  
  private final BctConfigurationTab pnlBctConfigurationTab;
  
  private boolean firmwareUpdateAllowed = true;
  
  public BctConfigurationTabController(BctConfigurationTab bctConfigurationTab, EBikeApplication eBikeApplication, ConfigurationManager configurationManager, RightsManager rightsManager) {
    super(AbstractNonEcuConfigurationTabController.BCT_BCS_CONFIGURATION.BCT, bctConfigurationTab, configurationManager, eBikeApplication, rightsManager);
    this.pnlBctConfigurationTab = bctConfigurationTab;
    configurationManager.addListener((OrderableListener)this);
  }
  
  public void onBctOperationStateChanged(BctOperationStateChangeEvent event) {
    LOGGER.debug("Received BctOperationStateChangeEvent: '{}'", event);
    switch (event.getOperatingState()) {
      case NOT_CONNECTED:
      case TEST_FINISHED:
      case TEST_ERROR:
      case DISCHARGE_ERROR:
      case DISCHARGE_FINISHED:
        this.firmwareUpdateAllowed = false;
        this.pnlBctConfigurationTab.setInfoText(null);
        this.pnlBctConfigurationTab.getFlashButton().setEnabled(false);
        break;
      case TEST_RUNNING:
        this.firmwareUpdateAllowed = false;
        this.pnlBctConfigurationTab.setInfoText(BUNDLE.getString("BctConfigurationTab.lbInfo.text"));
        this.pnlBctConfigurationTab.getFlashButton().setEnabled(false);
        break;
      case DISCHARGE_RUNNING:
        this.firmwareUpdateAllowed = false;
        this.pnlBctConfigurationTab.setInfoText(BUNDLE.getString("BctConfigurationTab.dischargeInfo.text"));
        this.pnlBctConfigurationTab.getFlashButton().setEnabled(false);
        break;
      case CONNECTED_FBL:
      case IDLE:
      case IDLE_BATTERY_SET:
        this.firmwareUpdateAllowed = true;
        this.pnlBctConfigurationTab.setInfoText(null);
        this.pnlBctConfigurationTab.getFlashButton().setEnabled(true);
        break;
    } 
  }
  
  public void onHardwareConnectionChanged(HardwareConnectionChangedEvent event) {
    LOGGER.debug("HardwareConnectionChangedEvent received: '{}'", event);
    if (event.getSystemType() == HardwareConnectionChangedEvent.HardwareSystem.BCT_SYSTEM)
      switch (event.getAction()) {
        case SYSTEM_CONNECTED:
        case SYSTEM_RECONNECTED:
          onConnect();
          break;
        case SYSTEM_DISCONNECTED:
          onDisconnect();
          break;
      }  
  }
  
  void setImgBtnFlashEnabled(boolean enabled) {
    LOGGER.debug("Set BCT flash button to {}", Boolean.valueOf(enabled));
    if (enabled && !this.firmwareUpdateAllowed)
      LOGGER.debug("Activation of BCT flash button prevented, because the BCT is not in the correct operation mode for firmware update"); 
    this.pnlBctConfigurationTab.getFlashButton().setEnabled((enabled && this.firmwareUpdateAllowed));
  }
}

package com.gigatronik.beds.gui.panels.bct.bcs.configuration;

import com.gigatronik.beds.service.flashcontainer.api.BoschContainerController;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.flashcontainer.download.AbstractContainerDownloadStateHandler;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.flashcontainer.impl.ContainerDownloadDataset;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.bosch.service.internationalization.ResourceBundleFactory;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.bosch.service.internationalization.Utf8ResourceBundleFormatted;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.gui.EBikeApplication;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.gui.EBikeESLosErrorDialog;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.gui.testinterface.TestableJOptionPane;
import java.text.SimpleDateFormat;
import java.util.Date;
import java.util.List;
import org.slf4j.Logger;
import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;

public class NonEcuContainerDownloadController extends AbstractContainerDownloadStateHandler {
  private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(NonEcuContainerDownloadController.class);
  
  private static final Utf8ResourceBundleFormatted BUNDLE = ResourceBundleFactory.newDefaultResourceBundle();
  
  private static final String STATUS_DOWNLOAD_FAILED = "EBikeStatus.CFF_DOWNLOAD_FAILED";
  
  private final EBikeApplication eBikeApplication;
  
  private final AbstractNonEcuConfigurationTabController bctAndBcsConfiguration;
  
  public NonEcuContainerDownloadController(EBikeApplication eBikeApplication, AbstractNonEcuConfigurationTabController config, BoschContainerController cffController) {
    super(cffController);
    this.eBikeApplication = eBikeApplication;
    this.bctAndBcsConfiguration = config;
  }
  
  public void onInvalidUrl() {
    LOGGER.warn("getContainerFromInternet(): Error during service call. Urls might be all wrong");
    TestableJOptionPane.showMessageDialog(BUNDLE.getString("AbstractEBikeConfigTab.download.noconnection.text"), 
        BUNDLE.getString("AbstractEBikeConfigTab.download.noconnection.title"), 0);
    this.eBikeApplication.showStatusError(BUNDLE.getString("EBikeStatus.CFF_DOWNLOAD_FAILED"), 0);
    this.bctAndBcsConfiguration.setImgBtnFlashEnabled(true);
  }
  
  public void onCffError(List<String[]> errors) {
    LOGGER.error("getContainerFromInternet(): Returned 2 -> Error message CFF obtained.");
    int numberOfMessages = errors.size();
    int numberOfErrorDialogs = (int)Math.ceil((double)numberOfMessages / 10.0D);
    EBikeESLosErrorDialog.showESLosError(errors, numberOfErrorDialogs, new EBikeESLosErrorDialog(TestableJOptionPane.getDefaultParentFrame()));
    this.eBikeApplication.showStatusError(BUNDLE.getString("EBikeStatus.CFF_DOWNLOAD_FAILED"), 0);
    this.bctAndBcsConfiguration.setImgBtnFlashEnabled(true);
  }
  
  public void onConnectionProblem() {
    LOGGER.warn("Unable to connect to internet.");
    TestableJOptionPane.showMessageDialog(BUNDLE.getString("AbstractEBikeConfigTab.download.noconnection.text"), 
        BUNDLE.getString("AbstractEBikeConfigTab.download.noconnection.title"), 0);
    this.eBikeApplication.showStatusError(BUNDLE.getString("EBikeStatus.CFF_DOWNLOAD_FAILED"), 0);
    this.bctAndBcsConfiguration.setImgBtnFlashEnabled(true);
  }
  
  public void onDownloadError(ContainerDownloadDataset resultData) {
    LOGGER.error("Reply container is corrupt");
    TestableJOptionPane.showMessageDialog(BUNDLE.getString("EBikeConfigurationTab.ContainerFromInternet.return4.optionPane.message"), 
        BUNDLE.getString("EBikeConfigurationTab.ContainerFromInternet.return4.optionPane.title"), 0);
    this.eBikeApplication.showStatusError(BUNDLE.getString("EBikeStatus.CFF_DOWNLOAD_FAILED"), 0);
    this.bctAndBcsConfiguration.setImgBtnFlashEnabled(true);
  }
  
  public void onRequestError() {
    LOGGER.error("getContainerFromInternet(): Returned 0 -> Could not generate request CFF.");
    TestableJOptionPane.showMessageDialog(BUNDLE.getString("EBikeConfigurationTab.ContainerFromInternet.return0.optionPane.message"), 
        BUNDLE.getString("EBikeConfigurationTab.ContainerFromInternet.return0.optionPane.title"), 0);
    this.eBikeApplication.showStatusError(BUNDLE.getString("EBikeStatus.CFF_DOWNLOAD_FAILED"), 0);
    this.bctAndBcsConfiguration.setImgBtnFlashEnabled(true);
  }
  
  public void onDownloadSuccessful(ContainerDownloadDataset resultData) {
    LOGGER.info("Response CFF obtained.");
    this.cffController.setCff2Container(resultData);
    SimpleDateFormat dateFormat = new SimpleDateFormat("yyyyMMdd");
    String fileName = "reply_" + dateFormat.format(new Date()) + ".cff2";
    String filePath = System.getProperty("java.io.tmpdir");
    String fileNameWithPath = filePath + filePath;
    this.cffController.copyContainerFile(resultData.getReplyCffPath(), fileNameWithPath);
    this.eBikeApplication.showStatusInfo(BUNDLE.getString("EBikeStatus.CFF_DOWNLOAD_SUCCESSFUL"), 0);
  }
}

package com.gigatronik.beds.gui.panels.bct.choosebatterytype;

import com.gigatronik.beds.common.bct.BctBatteryType;
import com.gigatronik.beds.common.bct.BctResponse;
import com.gigatronik.beds.gui.panels.bct.tab.controller.BctErrorEvent;
import com.gigatronik.beds.gui.panels.bct.tab.controller.BctErrorEventListener;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.communication.api.CommunicationManager;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.ecuconnectionstate.api.EcuConnectionStateHandler;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.bosch.applicationprocess.ApplicationProcessManager;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.concurrent.Executor;
import java.util.concurrent.Executors;
import org.apache.commons.lang3.concurrent.BasicThreadFactory;
import org.slf4j.Logger;
import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;

public class ChooseBatteryTypeController {
  private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(ChooseBatteryTypeController.class);
  
  private final CommunicationManager communicationManager;
  
  private final EcuConnectionStateHandler ecuConnectionStateHandler;
  
  private final Executor executor = Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor(new BasicThreadFactory.Builder().namingPattern("EventPublisher-%d").build());
  
  private final List<BctErrorEventListener> bctErrorCallbacks = new ArrayList<>();
  
  public ChooseBatteryTypeController(CommunicationManager communicationManager, EcuConnectionStateHandler ecuConnectionStateHandler) {
    this.communicationManager = communicationManager;
    this.ecuConnectionStateHandler = ecuConnectionStateHandler;
  }
  
  public void selectBattery(BctBatteryType batteryType) {
    LOGGER.info("Selected battery type {}", batteryType);
    ApplicationProcessManager.getInstance().setProcessState(ApplicationProcessManager.ApplicationProcess.SET_BMS_TYPE_IN_BCT, true);
    this.ecuConnectionStateHandler.suspendConnectionStateDetection(true);
    selectBatteryAction(batteryType);
    this.ecuConnectionStateHandler.resumeConnectionStateDetection(false, false);
    ApplicationProcessManager.getInstance().setProcessState(ApplicationProcessManager.ApplicationProcess.SET_BMS_TYPE_IN_BCT, false);
  }
  
  private void selectBatteryAction(BctBatteryType batteryType) {
    BctResponse response = this.communicationManager.getBctCom().selectBattery(batteryType);
    LOGGER.info("BCT response for battery select {} ", response);
    if (response == BctResponse.REJECTED) {
      LOGGER.warn("Configuration of BCT failed --> start a single retry!");
      response = this.communicationManager.getBctCom().selectBattery(batteryType);
    } 
    if (response == BctResponse.REJECTED)
      publishEvent(new BctErrorEvent().setTextKey("BctCapacityMeasurementTab.ChooseBatteryTypePanel.lblOrderInfo.errortext").setTitleKey("BctCapacityMeasurementTab.ChooseBatteryTypePanel.lblOrderInfo.errortitle")); 
  }
  
  public synchronized void addBctErrorListener(BctErrorEventListener listener) {
    if (!this.bctErrorCallbacks.contains(listener))
      this.bctErrorCallbacks.add(listener); 
  }
  
  private synchronized void publishEvent(BctErrorEvent event) {
    this.bctErrorCallbacks.forEach(listener -> this.executor.execute(() -> listener.onBctError(event)));
  }
}

    this.btnChooseBatteryActive.setEnabled(enabled);
    this.btnChooseBatteryClassic.setEnabled(enabled);
  }
  
  private void selectBattery(final BctBatteryType batteryType) {
    SwingWorker<Void, Void> worker = new SwingWorker<>() {
        protected Void doInBackground() {
          ChooseBatteryTypePanel.this.chooseBatteryTypeController.selectBattery(batteryType);
          return null;
        }
      };
    setButtonsEnabled(false);
    getParent().setCursor(Cursor.getPredefinedCursor(3));
    worker.execute();
  }

    initLabelColors();

    this.pnlInfo1.getLabel().setForeground(Color.BLACK);
    this.pnlInfo2.getLabel().setForeground(Color.BLACK);
  }
  
  public void onBctOperationStateChanged(BctOperationStateChangeEvent event) {
    setButtonsEnabled((event.getOperatingState() == BctState.IDLE));
  }
  
  public void onBctError(BctErrorEvent event) {
    setButtonsEnabled(true);
  }
}

ITEM 145: com/gigatronik/beds/gui/panels/bct/components/PropagatingMouseAdapter.java
========================================================================================================================
package com.gigatronik.beds.gui.panels.bct.components;

import java.awt.Component;
import java.awt.Container;
import java.awt.event.MouseAdapter;
import java.awt.event.MouseEvent;

public class PropagatingMouseAdapter extends MouseAdapter {
  public void mouseClicked(MouseEvent e) {
    Component clickedComponent = e.getComponent();
    Container parent = clickedComponent.getParent();
    int relativeX = clickedComponent.getX() + e.getX();
    int relativeY = clickedComponent.getY() + e.getY();
    MouseEvent propagationEvent = new MouseEvent(parent, 500, e.getWhen(), e.getModifiers(), relativeX, relativeY, e.getClickCount(), false);
    parent.dispatchEvent(propagationEvent);
  }
}

package com.gigatronik.beds.gui.panels.bct.components;

import java.awt.BasicStroke;
import java.awt.Color;
import java.awt.Dimension;
import java.awt.Graphics;
import java.awt.Graphics2D;
import java.awt.GridBagConstraints;
import java.awt.GridBagLayout;
import java.awt.Insets;
import java.awt.RenderingHints;
import javax.swing.ImageIcon;
import javax.swing.JLabel;
import javax.swing.JPanel;
import org.apache.commons.lang3.StringUtils;

public class RoundedInfo extends JPanel {
  private static final int DEFAULT_RADIUS = 16;
  
  private int radius = 16;
  
  private JLabel lblInfo;
  
  public RoundedInfo() {
    initComponents();
    setOpaque(false);
  }
  
  protected void paintComponent(Graphics g) {
    super.paintComponent(g);
    int width = getWidth();
    int height = getHeight();
    Graphics2D g2d = (Graphics2D)g;
    g2d.setRenderingHint(RenderingHints.KEY_ANTIALIASING, RenderingHints.VALUE_ANTIALIAS_ON);
    g2d.setColor(getBackground());
    g2d.fillRoundRect(0, 0, width, height, this.radius, this.radius);
    g2d.setStroke(new BasicStroke());
  }
  
  public void setText(String text) {
    this.lblInfo.setText(text);
  }
  
  public void setIcon(String resource) {
    if (StringUtils.isNotEmpty(resource))
      this.lblInfo.setIcon(new ImageIcon(getClass().getResource(resource))); 
  }
  
  public void setRadius(int radius) {
    this.radius = radius;
  }
  
  public JLabel getLabel() {
    return this.lblInfo;
  }
  
  private void initComponents() {
    this.lblInfo = new JLabel();
    setBackground(new Color(181, 195, 205));
    setMinimumSize(new Dimension(400, 40));
    setName("lblInfotxt");
    setPreferredSize(new Dimension(400, 40));
    setLayout(new GridBagLayout());
    this.lblInfo.setFont(this.lblInfo.getFont().deriveFont(this.lblInfo.getFont().getStyle() | 0x1));
    this.lblInfo.setIcon(new ImageIcon(getClass().getResource("/com/gigatronik/beds/gui/panels/bct/ic_info_33.png")));
    this.lblInfo.setText("Infotext here");
    this.lblInfo.setName("lblInfo");
    GridBagConstraints gridBagConstraints = new GridBagConstraints();
    gridBagConstraints.gridx = 0;
    gridBagConstraints.gridy = 0;
    gridBagConstraints.fill = 1;

package com.gigatronik.beds.gui.panels.bct.dischargefinished;

import com.gigatronik.beds.common.bct.BctBatteryType;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.communication.api.CommunicationManager;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.bosch.service.internationalization.ResourceBundleFactory;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.bosch.service.internationalization.Utf8ResourceBundleFormatted;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.gui.EBikeApplication;
import java.awt.Cursor;
import java.awt.event.ActionEvent;

public class DischargeFinishedPanelController {
  private static final Utf8ResourceBundleFormatted BUNDLE = ResourceBundleFactory.newDefaultResourceBundle();
  
  private final DischargeFinishedPanel pnlDischargeFinished;
  
  private final CommunicationManager communicationManager;
  
  private static final String VICTOR_LABEL = "CapacityTestTab.bctBatteryType.Victor";
  
  private static final String CLASSIC_PLUS_LABEL = "CapacityTestTab.bctBatteryType.ClassicPlus";
  
  public DischargeFinishedPanelController(DischargeFinishedPanel dischargeFinishedPanel, EBikeApplication eBikeApp) {
    this.pnlDischargeFinished = dischargeFinishedPanel;
    this.communicationManager = eBikeApp.getCommunicationManager();
    init();
  }
  
  private void init() {
    this.pnlDischargeFinished.getBatterySelectionButton().addActionListener(e -> finishMeasurement());
  }
  
  private void finishMeasurement() {
    this.pnlDischargeFinished.getBatterySelectionButton().setCursor(Cursor.getPredefinedCursor(3));
    this.pnlDischargeFinished.getParent().setCursor(Cursor.getPredefinedCursor(3));
    this.communicationManager.getBctCom().confirmMeasurementFinished();
    this.pnlDischargeFinished.getBatterySelectionButton().setCursor(Cursor.getPredefinedCursor(12));
  }
  
  public void detectSelectedBatteryType() {
    if (this.communicationManager.getBctCom().getSelectedBattery() == BctBatteryType.VICTOR) {
      this.pnlDischargeFinished.getLabelBatteryLine().setText(BUNDLE.getString("CapacityTestTab.bctBatteryType.Victor"));
    } else if (this.communicationManager.getBctCom().getSelectedBattery() == BctBatteryType.CLASSIC) {
      this.pnlDischargeFinished.getLabelBatteryLine().setText(BUNDLE.getString("CapacityTestTab.bctBatteryType.ClassicPlus"));
    } 
  }
}

  public MeasurementFinishedPanelController(MeasurementFinishedPanel panel, EBikeApplication eBikeApplication, WarrantyPanelController warrantyPanelController, RightsManager rightsManager) {
    this.measurementFinishedPanel = panel;
    this.eBikeApplication = eBikeApplication;
    this.warrantyPanelController = warrantyPanelController;
    this.communicationManager = eBikeApplication.getCommunicationManager();
    this.configurationManager = eBikeApplication.getConfigurationManager();
    this.rightsManager = rightsManager;
    this.bctTableModel = populateTable(null);
    rightsManager.addListener(this);
  }
  
  public synchronized void disableSaveReportFeatureAndCloseDialog() {
    closeBctReportDialog();
    this.warrantyFeatureEnabled.set(false);
  }
  
  private synchronized void forceBctReportSave() {
    if (this.warrantyFeatureEnabled.get() && this.savingBctReport.compareAndSet(false, true)) {
      File selectedFolder = showWarrantyFileDialog();
      while (!validSelectedFolder(selectedFolder) && !this.bctDisconnected)
        selectedFolder = showWarrantyFileDialog(); 
      saveReportWithDialog(selectedFolder);
    } 
    this.savingBctReport.set(false);
  }
  
  private boolean validSelectedFolder(File selectedFolder) {
    return (selectedFolder != null && selectedFolder.exists());
  }
  
  private File showWarrantyFileDialog() {
    this.bctMeasurementResultSaveDialog = new BctMeasurementResultSaveDialog(TestableJOptionPane.getDefaultParentFrame(), this.warrantyPanelController.getWarrantyCase());
    this.warrantyPanelController.registerWarrantyCaseChangedListener(this.bctMeasurementResultSaveDialog.getController());
    this.warrantyPanelController.getWarrantyPanel().getDatePicker().clear();
    this.bctMeasurementResultSaveDialog.setVisible(true);
    File selectedFolder = null;
    if (this.configurationManager.getBikeIdentification().isBctConnected()) {
      selectedFolder = this.bctMeasurementResultSaveDialog.getSelectedPath();
      this.warrantyPanelController.getWarrantyPanel().getDatePicker().getComponentDateTextField().setText(this.bctMeasurementResultSaveDialog.getTextFieldDate().getText());
      this.warrantyPanelController.getWarrantyPanel().getCheckBoxCommercialUse().setSelected(this.bctMeasurementResultSaveDialog.getCheckBoxCommercialUse().isSelected());
      this.warrantyPanelController.onCommercialUsageChanged(this.bctMeasurementResultSaveDialog.getCheckBoxCommercialUse().isSelected());
    } 
    this.bctMeasurementResultSaveDialog.dispose();
    this.bctMeasurementResultSaveDialog = null;
    return selectedFolder;
  }
  
  private void bctReportPrepareForceSave(File selectedFolder) {
    try {
      if (new File(selectedFolder.getCanonicalPath()).isDirectory()) {
        this.eBikeApplication.getFrame().setCursor(Cursor.getPredefinedCursor(3));
        if (this.rightsManager.getUserLevel() == UserLevel.OEM)
          prepareGenerateReport(ReportType.DEALER_SERVICE, new File(selectedFolder.getCanonicalPath(), getBctReportName(ReportType.DEALER_SERVICE))); 
        if (this.rightsManager.getUserLevel() == UserLevel.IBD)
          prepareGenerateReport(ReportType.SERVICE, new File(selectedFolder.getCanonicalPath(), getBctReportName(ReportType.SERVICE))); 
        prepareGenerateReport(ReportType.CUSTOMER, new File(selectedFolder.getCanonicalPath(), getBctReportName(ReportType.CUSTOMER)));
      } 
    } catch (IOException ex) {
      LOGGER.error("Error in forceReportSave: ", (Throwable)ex);
      this.eBikeApplication.showStatusError(BUNDLE_SAVE_REPORT_ERROR);
    } finally {
      this.eBikeApplication.getFrame().setCursor(Cursor.getDefaultCursor());
    } 
  }
  
  private void closeBctReportDialog() {
    if (this.bctMeasurementResultSaveDialog != null) {
      this.bctMeasurementResultSaveDialog.close();
      this.savingBctReport.set(false);
    } 
  }

  private TableModel populateTable(Map<String, ComplexResponse> parameterValues) {
    Map<String, Object> environment = new HashMap<>();
    environment.put("showNegativeResponse", "");
    switch (this.rightsManager.getUserLevel()) {
      case OEM:
        environment.put("userGroup", "OEM");
        break;
      case IBD:
        environment.put("userGroup", "IBD");
        break;
    } 
    List<TableEvaluatorImpl.TableEntry> result = this.bctEvaluator.evaluateTable(environment, parameterValues, false, null);
    this.bctTableModel = getDiagnosticTableModel(result);
    return this.bctTableModel;
  }
  
  private TableModel getDiagnosticTableModel(List<TableEvaluatorImpl.TableEntry> data) {
    TableEvaluatorImpl.TableEntry[] resultArray = data.<TableEvaluatorImpl.TableEntry>toArray(new TableEvaluatorImpl.TableEntry[0]);
    List<Object[]> dataList = new LinkedList<>();
    for (int i = 0; i < data.size(); i++) {
      dataList.add(new Object[] { resultArray[i].getCaption(), resultArray[i].getValue() });
    } 
    return new DiagnosticDefaultTableModel(dataList.toArray(new Object[0][]), DIAGNOSTIC_COLUMNS);
  }
  
  public void onBctOperationStateChanged(BctOperationStateChangeEvent event) {
    this.bctState = event.getOperatingState();
    switch (this.bctState) {
      case TEST_FINISHED:
        this.bctDisconnected = false;
        handleMeasurementFinished();
        break;
      case TEST_ERROR:
        this.bctDisconnected = false;
        handleMeasurementError();
        break;
      default:
        this.bctDisconnected = true;
        EventQueue.invokeLater(this::closeBctReportDialog);
        break;
    } 
  }
  
  private void handleMeasurementFinished() {
    this.bctBatteryData = this.communicationManager.getBctOperationAssistent().readBatteryDataFromCapacityTester();
    EventQueue.invokeLater(() -> {
          this.warrantyPanelController.setBatteryParameters(this.bctBatteryData);
          adjustProgressBars(this.bctBatteryData);
          fillTable(this.bctBatteryData);
          adjustBctTypeLabel();
          forceBctReportSave();
        });
  }
  
  private void handleMeasurementError() {
    this.bctError = this.communicationManager.getBctCom().getLastError();
    switch (this.bctError) {
      case EMON_LOST_CAN_COMMUNICATION:
      case EMON_BAT_DISCONNECTED_DURING_MEASUREMENT:
        handleMeasurementFinished();
        break;
    } 
  }
  
  private void fillTable(BctBatteryData batteryData) {
    LOGGER.info("Fill BCT table");
    EcuIdentification bctIdent = this.configurationManager.getBikeIdentification().getBctIdentification();
    Map<String, ComplexResponse> map = new HashMap<>();
    map.put("bctPartNumber", bctIdent.getPartNumberResponse());
    map.put("bctSerialNumber", SerialNumberHelper.getSerialnumberBct(bctIdent.getSerialNumberResponse()));
    map.put("bctHwVersion", bctIdent.getHwVersionResponse());
    map.put("bctSwVersion", bctIdent.getSwVersionResponse());
    map.put("bctErrorCode", new ComplexResponse(this.bctError.getText()));
    ComponentType compType = ComponentType.parse(batteryData.getComponentType());
    map.put("dateOfMeasurement", new ComplexResponse(batteryData.getDateOfMeasurementForDisplay()));
    map.put("componentType", new ComplexResponse((compType != ComponentType.NONE) ? compType.getDisplayName() : batteryData.getComponentType()));
    map.put("partNumber", new ComplexResponse(batteryData.getPartNumber()));
    map.put("serialNumber", new ComplexResponse(batteryData.getSerialNumberForDisplay()));
    map.put("softwareVersion", new ComplexResponse(batteryData.getSoftwareVersion()));
    map.put("hardwareVersion", new ComplexResponse(batteryData.getHardwareVersion()));
    map.put("numberOfFullChargeCycles", new ComplexResponse(batteryData.getNumberOfFullChargeCycles()));
    map.put("nominalEnergy", new ComplexResponse(batteryData.getNominalEnergy()));
    map.put("measuredEnergy", new ComplexResponse(batteryData.getMeasuredEnergy()));
    map.put("manufactureDate", new ComplexResponse(batteryData.getManufactureDateForDisplay(false)));
    map.put("errorCodes", new ComplexResponse(batteryData.getErrorCodesForDisplay()));
    this.measurementFinishedPanel.setBctTableModel(populateTable(map));
  }
  
  private void adjustProgressBars(BctBatteryData batteryData) {
    BigDecimal actualValue = BigDecimal.ZERO;
    try {
      actualValue = new BigDecimal(batteryData.getMeasuredEnergy());
    } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
      LOGGER.error("Could not parse measured value", (Throwable)e);
    } 
    BigDecimal nominalValue = BigDecimal.ZERO;
    try {
      nominalValue = new BigDecimal(batteryData.getNominalEnergy());
    } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
      LOGGER.error("Could not parse nominal value", (Throwable)e);
    } 
    this.actualValuePercent = 0;
    this.measurementFinishedPanel.getPrgActualValue().setValue(this.actualValuePercent);
    BigDecimal actualValueRounded = BigDecimal.ZERO;
    if (nominalValue.intValue() != 0) {
      actualValueRounded = actualValue.multiply(BigDecimal.valueOf(100.0D)).divide(nominalValue, 2, RoundingMode.HALF_UP);
      this.actualValuePercent = actualValueRounded.intValue();
      this.measurementFinishedPanel.getPrgActualValue().setValue(this.actualValuePercent);
    } 
    this.nominalValueString = batteryData.getNominalEnergy() + " Wh";
    this.measurementFinishedPanel.getPrgValueAsNew().setString(this.nominalValueString);
    this.actualValueString = "" + actualValue + " Wh (" + actualValue + " %)";
    this.measurementFinishedPanel.getPrgActualValue().setString(this.actualValueString);
    if (this.bctError == BctError.EMON_NO_FAULT) {
      this.measurementFinishedPanel.setInfoText(BUNDLE.getString("MeasurementFinishedPanel.lbInfo.text"));
      this.measurementFinishedPanel.setInfoIcon("/com/gigatronik/beds/gui/panels/bct/measurefinished/warranty/infoBlueIcon_transparent.png");
    } else {
      this.measurementFinishedPanel.setInfoText(BUNDLE.getString("MeasurementFinishedPanel.info.canceled"));
      this.measurementFinishedPanel.setInfoIcon("/com/gigatronik/beds/gui/panels/bct/measurefinished/warranty/exclamationMarkOrangeIcon_transparent.png");
    } 
  }
  
  void onBatteryTypeSelectionClicked(ActionEvent evt) {
    this.measurementFinishedPanel.getBatterySelectionButton().setCursor(Cursor.getPredefinedCursor(3));
    this.measurementFinishedPanel.getParent().setCursor(Cursor.getPredefinedCursor(3));
    if (this.batteryTypeSelectionEnabled && confirmMeasurement() == BctResponse.REJECTED)
      publishEvent(new BctErrorEvent()
          .setTextKey("BctCapacityMeasurementTab.Error.confirm.text")
          .setTitleKey("BctCapacityMeasurementTab.Error.confirm.title")); 
    this.measurementFinishedPanel.getBatterySelectionButton().setCursor(Cursor.getPredefinedCursor(12));
  }
  
  private BctResponse confirmMeasurement() {
    if (this.bctState == BctState.TEST_FINISHED)
      return this.communicationManager.getBctCom().confirmMeasurementFinished(); 
    return this.communicationManager.getBctCom().confirmMeasurementError();
  }

  private void adjustBctTypeLabel() {
    BctBatteryType selectedBattery = this.communicationManager.getBctCom().getSelectedBattery();
    switch (selectedBattery) {
      case CLASSIC:
        setLblBctBatteryTypeText(BUNDLE.getString("BctCapacityMeasurementTab.ChooseBatteryTypePanel.btnBaPa1.text"));
        break;
      case VICTOR:
        setLblBctBatteryTypeText(BUNDLE.getString("BctCapacityMeasurementTab.ChooseBatteryTypePanel.btnBaba2.text"));
        break;
      default:
        LOGGER.warn("UNKNOWN battery state appeared in finished panel");
        break;
    } 
  }
  
  private void prepareGenerateReport(ReportType reportType, File file) {
    ReportData<File> reportFile = ReportFactory.builder().data();
    reportFile.setValue(file);
    prepareGenerateReport(reportType, reportFile, future -> {
        
        });
  }
  
  private void prepareGenerateReport(ReportType reportType, ReportData<File> file, Consumer<Future> reportTaskFutureConsumer) {
    LOGGER.info("generateReport(): Generate BCT report for {}, {}", this.rightsManager.getUserLevel(), reportType.getTypeName());
    File tmpReport = null;
    try {
      tmpReport = File.createTempFile("tmpReport_", ".data");
      Stopwatch watch = new Stopwatch();
      watch.start();
      generateReport(reportType, tmpReport, reportTaskFutureConsumer);
      watch.stop();
      LOGGER.trace("PDF Report from call to select a destination took {}ms", Long.valueOf(watch.getMillisecondsElapsed()));
      if (file.getValue() != null) {
        FileUtils.moveFile(tmpReport, (File)file.getValue());
      } else {
        LOGGER.info("saveGeneratedReport(): Save BCT report cancelled by user.");
      } 
    } catch (Exception e) {
      LOGGER.error("Failed to create a report of type {}", reportType, e);
      this.eBikeApplication.showStatusError(BUNDLE_SAVE_REPORT_ERROR);
    } finally {
      FileUtils.deleteQuietly(tmpReport);
    } 
  }
  
  private boolean showReportFileChooseDialog(ReportData<File> file, String defaultReportFileName) {
    LOGGER.trace("Open report file choose dialog");
    try {
      JFileChooser fc = CustomFileChooser.getCustomFileChooser();
      fc.setCurrentDirectory(new File(SettingsProxy.getInstance().getGlobalSettings().getProperty("last_opened_folder")));
      File defaultFile = new File(defaultReportFileName);
      fc.setSelectedFile(defaultFile);
      FileNameExtensionFilter pdfFilter = new FileNameExtensionFilter("Portable Document Format (.pdf)", new String[] { "pdf" });
      fc.setFileFilter(pdfFilter);
      int returnVal = fc.showSaveDialog(TestableJOptionPane.getDefaultParentFrame());
      SettingsProxy.getInstance().getGlobalSettings()
        .setProperty("last_opened_folder", fc.getCurrentDirectory().getCanonicalPath());
      this.eBikeApplication.getApplicationPanel().getMainTabbedController().getSettingsTab().onBctPathLocationChanged();
      if (returnVal == 0) {
        file.setValue(fc.getSelectedFile());
        return true;
      } 
    } catch (ConfigurationNotFoundException|IOException e) {
      LOGGER.error("Error in prepareGenerateReport: ", (Throwable)e);
    } 
    file.setValue(null);
    return false;
  }
  
  private void generateReport(ReportType reportType, File file, Consumer<Future> reportTaskFutureConsumer) {
    BctReportGeneratorDataImpl bctReportGeneratorDataImpl = new BctReportGeneratorDataImpl();
    BctReportGenerator pdfGenerator = ReportFactory.builder().bctReportGenerator();
    ((BctReportGenerator)pdfGenerator.createDocument(reportType))
      .writeGeneralTable()
      .writeMeasuringResultTable()
      .writeAccuComponentTable();
    if (reportType != ReportType.CUSTOMER)
      pdfGenerator.writeTestDeviceComponentTable()
        .writeEvaluationTable(); 
    Future reportFuture = pdfGenerator.generateAndSave((ReportGeneratorData)bctReportGeneratorDataImpl, file);
    reportTaskFutureConsumer.accept(reportFuture);
    setUpReportDto((BctReportGeneratorData)bctReportGeneratorDataImpl, reportType);
    pdfGenerator.waitForComplete();
  }
  
  private String getBctReportName(ReportType reportType) {
    SimpleDateFormat fmt = new SimpleDateFormat("yyyyMMddhhmmss");
    Date myDate = new Date();
    String dateString = fmt.format(myDate);
    String serial = StringUtils.isBlank(this.bctBatteryData.getSerialNumberForDisplay()) ? "" : this.bctBatteryData.getSerialNumberForDisplay();
    String reportName = "CapacityTest_" + reportType.getTypeName() + "_" + serial + "_" + dateString + ".pdf";
    LOGGER.info("getBctReportName(): Create report file name -> {}", reportName);
    return reportName;
  }
  
  private void setUpReportDto(BctReportGeneratorData data, ReportType reportType) {
    BctReportDto dto = new BctReportDto(new JTableToDtoConverterImpl());
    try {
      ((BctReportDto)((BctReportDto)((BctReportDto)((BctReportDto)((BctReportDto)((BctReportDto)((BctReportDto)((BctReportDto)((BctReportDto)((BctReportDto)
        
        dto.setLocale(I18NUtil.getLocale()))
        .setDisplayVersion(ConfigUtil.getDisplayVersion()))
        .setReportType(reportType))
        .setDataPath(SettingsProxy.getInstance().getDataPath()))
        
        .setCompanyName(SettingsProxy.getInstance().getGlobalSettings().getProperty("settings_userdata_companyName")))
        .setCustomerAddress(SettingsProxy.getInstance().getGlobalSettings().getProperty("settings_userdata_customerAddress")))
        .setCustomerPhoneNumber(SettingsProxy.getInstance().getGlobalSettings().getProperty("settings_userdata_customerPhoneNumber")))
        .setCustomerEmail(SettingsProxy.getInstance().getGlobalSettings().getProperty("settings_userdata_customerEMail")))
        .setCustomerWebSite(SettingsProxy.getInstance().getGlobalSettings().getProperty("settings_userdata_customerWebsite")))
        .setCustomerNumber(SettingsProxy.getInstance().getGlobalSettings().getProperty("settings_userdata_customerNumber")))
        
        .setBctBatteryData(this.bctBatteryData)
        .setBctIdentification(this.configurationManager.getBikeIdentification().getBctIdentification())
        .setBctError(this.bctError)
        
        .setMeasuredBatteryEnergy((this.bctError == BctError.EMON_LOST_CAN_COMMUNICATION) ? readMeasuredBatteryEnergy() : "")
        
        .setPurchaseDate(this.warrantyPanelController.getPurchaseDate())
        .setCommercialUse(this.warrantyPanelController.getIsCommercialUse())
        .setEvaluationText(BUNDLE.getString("MeasurementFinishedPanel.Warranty.Info." + this.warrantyPanelController.getWarrantyCase()));
    } catch (ConfigurationNotFoundException ex) {
      LOGGER.error("Could not create ServiceReportDto", (Throwable)ex);
    } 
    ReportFactory.setBctValuesFromDto(data, dto);
  }
  
  private String readMeasuredBatteryEnergy() {
    try {
      return this.communicationManager.getBctCom().readMeasuredBatteryEnergy().getString();
    } catch (ComplexResponse.DataAccessException ex) {
      LOGGER.error("Parsing measured enenergy response failed", (Throwable)ex);
      return "";
    } 
  }
  
  public void onRightsChanged(RightsChangedEvent event) {
    LOGGER.debug("Received rights changed event '{}'", event);
    if (event.getUserLevel() != UserLevel.UNKNOWN) {
      this.warrantyPanelController.startWarrantyFileProcessing();
      this.btnOemReportVisible = (event.getUserLevel() == UserLevel.OEM);
      this.btnIbdReportVisible = (event.getUserLevel() == UserLevel.IBD);
      EventQueue.invokeLater(() -> {
            LOGGER.debug("Process rights change event now from EDT");
            this.measurementFinishedPanel.getImgBtnOemReport().setVisible((event.getUserLevel() == UserLevel.OEM));
            this.measurementFinishedPanel.getImgBtnIbdReport().setVisible((event.getUserLevel() == UserLevel.IBD));
          });
    } 
  }
  
  public void performIbdReportAction() {
    saveReportWithDialog(ReportType.SERVICE);
    setBatteryTypeSelectionEnabled(true);
  }
  
  public void performCustomerReportAction() {
    saveReportWithDialog(ReportType.CUSTOMER);
    setBatteryTypeSelectionEnabled(true);
  }
  
  public void performOemReportAction() {
    saveReportWithDialog(ReportType.DEALER_SERVICE);
    setBatteryTypeSelectionEnabled(true);
  }
  
  public WarrantyPanelController getWarrantyPanelController() {
    return this.warrantyPanelController;
  }
  
  public synchronized void addBctErrorListener(BctErrorEventListener listener) {
    if (!this.bctErrorCallbacks.contains(listener))
      this.bctErrorCallbacks.add(listener); 
  }
  
  public synchronized void removeBctErrorListener(BctErrorEventListener listener) {
    this.bctErrorCallbacks.remove(listener);
  }
  
  private synchronized void publishEvent(BctErrorEvent event) {
    this.bctErrorCallbacks.forEach(listener -> this.executor.execute(() -> listener.onBctError(event)));
  }
  
  private void saveReportWithDialog(final File file) {
    SwingWorker<Void, Void> worker = new SwingWorker<>() {
        protected Void doInBackground() {
          MeasurementFinishedPanelController.this.bctReportPrepareForceSave(file);
          return null;
        }
        
        protected void done() {
          MeasurementFinishedPanelController.this.measurementFinishedPanel.closeReportProgressDialog();
        }
      };
    worker.execute();
    this.measurementFinishedPanel.showReportProgressDialog();
  }
  
  private void saveReportWithDialog(final ReportType reportType) {
    final ReportData<File> reportFile = ReportFactory.builder().data();
    final FutureHolder reportTaskFuture = new FutureHolder();
    SwingWorker<Void, Void> worker = new SwingWorker<>() {
        protected Void doInBackground() {
          MeasurementFinishedPanelController.this.prepareGenerateReport(reportType, reportFile, reportTaskFuture);
          return null;
        }
        
        protected void done() {
          MeasurementFinishedPanelController.this.measurementFinishedPanel.closeReportProgressDialog();
        }
      };
    worker.execute();
    String defaultReportFileName = getBctReportName(reportType);
    if (showReportFileChooseDialog(reportFile, defaultReportFileName)) {
      this.measurementFinishedPanel.showReportProgressDialog();
      return;
    } 
    worker.cancel(true);
    reportTaskFuture.cancel();
  }
  
  public MeasurementFinishedPanelController() {}
}

package com.gigatronik.beds.gui.panels.bct.measurefinished.warranty;

import com.gigatronik.beds.gui.color.GuiColors;
import com.gigatronik.beds.settings.SettingsProxy;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.bosch.service.internationalization.I18NDateTimesFormats;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.bosch.service.internationalization.I18NUtil;

import com.gigatronik.dart2.bosch.service.internationalization.Utf8ResourceBundleFormatted;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.framework.plugins.exceptions.ConfigurationNotFoundException;
import java.awt.Component;
import java.awt.event.ActionEvent;
import java.io.File;

import java.time.format.DateTimeFormatter;

public class BctMeasurementResultSaveDialogController implements WarrantyCaseChangedListener {
  private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(BctMeasurementResultSaveDialogController.class);
  
  private static final Utf8ResourceBundleFormatted BUNDLE = ResourceBundleFactory.newDefaultResourceBundle();
  
  private static final String PROPERTY_LAST_OPENED_FOLDER = "last_opened_folder";
  
  private static final String PATH_DOCUMENT_TITLE = "Path";
  
  private static final String DATE_DOCUMENT_TITLE = "Date";
  
  private final BctMeasurementResultSaveDialog bctMeasurementResultSaveDialog;
  
  private final ButtonEnablement buttonEnablement;
  
  private final transient Border validBorder;
  
  private final transient Border invalidBorder;
  
  private JFileChooser folderChooser;
  
  private boolean batteryIsNoWarrantyCase;
  
  public BctMeasurementResultSaveDialogController(BctMeasurementResultSaveDialog bctMeasurementResultSaveDialog, WarrantyCase currentWarrantyCase) {
    LOGGER.debug("Create BctMeasurementResultSaveDialogController");
    this.bctMeasurementResultSaveDialog = bctMeasurementResultSaveDialog;
    this.validBorder = this.bctMeasurementResultSaveDialog.getTextFieldDate().getComponentDateTextField().getBorder();
    this.invalidBorder = BorderFactory.createCompoundBorder(BorderFactory.createLineBorder(GuiColors.FRAME_INVALID, 2), this.validBorder);
    ButtonModel buttonModel = this.bctMeasurementResultSaveDialog.getOKButton().getModel();
    Document filePath = this.bctMeasurementResultSaveDialog.getTextFieldFile().getDocument();
    filePath.putProperty("title", "Path");
    Document manufactureDate = this.bctMeasurementResultSaveDialog.getTextFieldDate().getComponentDateTextField().getDocument();
    manufactureDate.putProperty("title", "Date");
    updateBatteryIsNoWarrantyFlag(currentWarrantyCase);
    this.buttonEnablement = new ButtonEnablement(buttonModel);
    this.buttonEnablement.addDocument(filePath);
    this.buttonEnablement.addDocument(manufactureDate);
    this.bctMeasurementResultSaveDialog.getTextFieldFile().setText(getPathForFile().getPath());
    this.bctMeasurementResultSaveDialog.getOKButton().addActionListener(l -> onOKClicked());
    this.bctMeasurementResultSaveDialog.getShowFileChooserDialogButton().addActionListener(l -> onFileDirectoryClicked());
  }
  
  private void onOKClicked() {
    this.bctMeasurementResultSaveDialog.setSelectedPath(new File(this.bctMeasurementResultSaveDialog.getTextFieldFile().getText()));
    this.bctMeasurementResultSaveDialog.setVisible(false);
  }
  
  private void onFileDirectoryClicked() {
    if (this.folderChooser == null) {
      prepareFolderChooser();
      this.folderChooser.setFileFilter(new FileNameExtensionFilter("Portable Document Format (.pdf)", new String[] { "pdf" }));
      this.folderChooser.setCurrentDirectory(getPathForFile());
      int returnValue = this.folderChooser.showOpenDialog((Component)this.bctMeasurementResultSaveDialog);
      if (returnValue == 0) {
        File selectedFolder = this.folderChooser.getSelectedFile();
        this.bctMeasurementResultSaveDialog.getTextFieldFile().setText(selectedFolder.getPath());
        try {
          SettingsProxy.getInstance().getGlobalSettings().setProperty("last_opened_folder", selectedFolder.getCanonicalPath());
        } catch (ConfigurationNotFoundException|java.io.IOException ex) {
          LOGGER.error("Error in forceReportSave: ", (Throwable)ex);
        } 
        LOGGER.info("Seletected folder from user: {}", selectedFolder);
      } 
      this.folderChooser = null;
    } 
  }
  
  public void closeFileChooser() {
    if (this.folderChooser != null)
      this.folderChooser.cancelSelection(); 
  }
  
  private void prepareFolderChooser() {
    this.folderChooser = new JFileChooser() {
        public void approveSelection() {
          File f = getSelectedFile();
          if (f.exists() && f.isDirectory())
            super.approveSelection(); 
        }
      };
    this.folderChooser.setFileSelectionMode(1);
    this.folderChooser.setName("dlgChooseFolderReport");
    this.folderChooser.setDialogTitle(BUNDLE.getString("MeasurementFinishedPanel.BCT_Report.FolderChooser"));
    this.folderChooser.setAcceptAllFileFilterUsed(false);
    this.folderChooser.setApproveButtonText(BUNDLE.getString("EBikeSettingsTab.btnManufactureLogLocation.text"));
    this.folderChooser.setApproveButtonToolTipText(BUNDLE.getString("MeasurementFinishedPanel.BCT_Report.FolderChooser"));
  }
  
  private File getPathForFile() {
    File lastSelectedFolder;
    try {
      lastSelectedFolder = new File(SettingsProxy.getInstance().getGlobalSettings().getProperty("last_opened_folder"));
      if (!lastSelectedFolder.isDirectory())
        lastSelectedFolder = new File(FileSystemView.getFileSystemView().getDefaultDirectory().getPath()); 
    } catch (ConfigurationNotFoundException ex) {
      LOGGER.error("Could not read last selected folder. Using default path. ", (Throwable)ex);
      lastSelectedFolder = new File(FileSystemView.getFileSystemView().getDefaultDirectory().getPath());
    } 
    return lastSelectedFolder;
  }
  
  private void paintPurchaseDateBorder(boolean valid) {
    JTextField txtField = this.bctMeasurementResultSaveDialog.getTextFieldDate().getComponentDateTextField();
    txtField.setBorder(valid ? this.validBorder : this.invalidBorder);
  }
  
  public void onWarrantyCaseChanged(WarrantyCase warrantyCase) {
    updateBatteryIsNoWarrantyFlag(warrantyCase);
    this.buttonEnablement.documentChanged();
  }
  
  private synchronized void updateBatteryIsNoWarrantyFlag(WarrantyCase newWarrantyCase) {
    this.batteryIsNoWarrantyCase = (newWarrantyCase == WarrantyCase.ENERGY_WITHIN_RANGE);
    LOGGER.debug("Flag 'batteryIsNoWarrantyCase' has been updated to '{}'", Boolean.valueOf(this.batteryIsNoWarrantyCase));
  }
  
  public void onWarrantyConditionsMissing() {
    LOGGER.info("Close window 'cause of missing warranty condition parameters.");
    this.bctMeasurementResultSaveDialog.close();
  }
  
  private class ButtonEnablement implements DocumentListener {
    private final ButtonModel buttonModel;
    
    private final List<Document> documents = new ArrayList<>();
    
    public ButtonEnablement(ButtonModel buttonModel) {
      this.buttonModel = buttonModel;
    }
    
    public void addDocument(Document document) {
      document.addDocumentListener(this);
      this.documents.add(document);
      documentChanged();
    }
    
    public void documentChanged() {
      boolean valid = true;
      for (Document document : this.documents) {
        if (!isElementValid(document))
          valid = false; 
      } 
      this.buttonModel.setEnabled(valid);
    }
    
    private boolean isElementValid(Document document) {
      if (isManufactureDateTextField(document))
        return isManufactureDateTextFieldValid(document); 
      if (isSaveReportPathTextField(document))
        return isSaveReportPathTextFieldValid(document); 
      return true;
    }
    
    private boolean isManufactureDateTextFieldValid(Document document) {
      boolean valid = isDateValid(document);
      BctMeasurementResultSaveDialogController.this.paintPurchaseDateBorder(valid);
      return valid;
    }
    
    private boolean isDateValid(Document dateDocument) {
      String date = getDateString(dateDocument);
      if (StringUtils.isNotBlank(date))
        try {
          return !isDateInTheFuture(date);
        } catch (DateTimeParseException e) {
          BctMeasurementResultSaveDialogController.LOGGER.debug("Error parsing purchase date from BctMeasurementResultSaveDialog%n{}", e.getMessage());
          return false;
        }  
      return BctMeasurementResultSaveDialogController.this.batteryIsNoWarrantyCase;
    }
    
    private String getDateString(Document dateDocument) {
      String date = null;
      try {
        date = dateDocument.getText(0, dateDocument.getLength());
      } catch (BadLocationException|DateTimeParseException ex) {
        BctMeasurementResultSaveDialogController.LOGGER.warn("Error parsing purchase date from BctMeasurementResultSaveDialog", (Throwable)ex);
      } 
      return date;
    }
    
    private boolean isDateInTheFuture(String dateString) {
      DateTimeFormatter formatter = DateTimeFormatter.ofPattern(I18NDateTimesFormats.getDateFormatterByCurrentLocale(), I18NUtil.getLocale());
      LocalDate purchaseDate = LocalDate.parse(dateString, formatter);
      LocalDate today = LocalDate.now();
      return purchaseDate.isAfter(today);
    }
    
    private boolean isManufactureDateTextField(Document document) {
      return StringUtils.equals("Date", (String)document.getProperty("title"));
    }
    
    private boolean isSaveReportPathTextField(Document document) {
      return StringUtils.equals("Path", (String)document.getProperty("title"));
    }
    
    private boolean isSaveReportPathTextFieldValid(Document document) {
      try {
        return (document.getLength() > 0 && new File(document.getText(0, document.getLength())).exists());
      } catch (BadLocationException e) {
        BctMeasurementResultSaveDialogController.LOGGER.error("Failed to get text from textfield of save path", (Throwable)e);
        return false;
      } 
    }
    
    public void insertUpdate(DocumentEvent e) {
      documentChanged();
    }
    
    public void removeUpdate(DocumentEvent e) {
      documentChanged();
    }
    
    public void changedUpdate(DocumentEvent e) {
      documentChanged();
    }
  }
}

ITEM 156: com/gigatronik/beds/gui/panels/bct/measurefinished/warranty/WarrantyConfigurationDecryptor.java
========================================================================================================================
package com.gigatronik.beds.gui.panels.bct.measurefinished.warranty;

import com.gigatronik.beds.service.dongleblacklist.impl.BlacklistCryptor;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.dongleblacklist.impl.BlacklistKeyDecryptor;
import com.gigatronik.bosch.plugin.tokenproxy.TokenPluginProxy;
import com.gigatronik.bosch.plugin.unitoken.TokenException;
import java.io.ByteArrayInputStream;
import java.io.File;
import java.io.InputStream;
import java.nio.charset.Charset;
import org.apache.commons.io.FileUtils;
import org.slf4j.Logger;
import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;

class WarrantyConfigurationDecryptor {
  private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(WarrantyConfigurationDecryptor.class);
  
  private static final Charset UTF8_CHARSET = Charset.forName("UTF-8");
  
  private final BlacklistKeyDecryptor warrantyKeyDecryptor = new BlacklistKeyDecryptor(TokenPluginProxy.getInstance().getToken(TokenPluginProxy.TokenType.LOCAL));
  
  public InputStream decryptWarrantyFile(String fileName) throws TokenException {
    String warrantyDecryptionKeyPlain = this.warrantyKeyDecryptor.getBlacklistEncryptionKey();
    BlacklistCryptor warrantyFileDecryptor = new BlacklistCryptor(warrantyDecryptionKeyPlain);
    try {
      String encryptedWarrantyFileStr = FileUtils.readFileToString(new File(WarrantyPanelController.WARRANTY_FILE_DIRECTORY + WarrantyPanelController.WARRANTY_FILE_DIRECTORY), UTF8_CHARSET);
      LOGGER.debug("Decrypt warranty file via key");
      String decryptedWarrantyFileStr = warrantyFileDecryptor.decrypt(encryptedWarrantyFileStr);
      LOGGER.debug("Decryption of warranty file worked");
      return new ByteArrayInputStream(decryptedWarrantyFileStr.getBytes(UTF8_CHARSET));
    } catch (Exception ex) {
      LOGGER.error("Failed to process encrypted warranty file '{}'", WarrantyPanelController.WARRANTY_FILE_DIRECTORY + WarrantyPanelController.WARRANTY_FILE_DIRECTORY, ex);
      return null;
    } 
  }
}

package com.gigatronik.beds.gui.panels.bct.measurefinished.warranty;

import com.gigatronik.dart2.bosch.updateserver.UPDATE_SERVER_URL;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.bosch.updateserver.UpdateServerConnection;
import java.io.File;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Paths;
import org.apache.commons.io.FileUtils;
import org.apache.commons.lang3.StringUtils;
import org.slf4j.Logger;
import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;

class WarrantyConfigurationDownloader {
  private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(WarrantyConfigurationDownloader.class);
  
  private final UpdateServerConnection updateServerConnection;
  
  public WarrantyConfigurationDownloader(UpdateServerConnection connection) {
    this.updateServerConnection = connection;
  }
  
  public boolean downloadWarrantyFile() {
    String serverUrl = "" + UPDATE_SERVER_URL.get(UPDATE_SERVER_URL.BCT_WARRANTY_DOWNLOAD) + "bat.wd";
    String fileSystemPath = WarrantyPanelController.WARRANTY_FILE_DIRECTORY + "new_bat.wd";
    return downloadWarrantyFile(serverUrl, fileSystemPath);
  }
  
  public void replaceLocalWithDownloadedFile() {
    try {
      Files.deleteIfExists(Paths.get(WarrantyPanelController.WARRANTY_FILE_DIRECTORY + "bat.wd"));
      LOGGER.debug("Deleted local warranty file");
    } catch (IOException ex) {
      LOGGER.warn("Deletion of local file failed", (Throwable)ex);
      return;
    } 
    File downloadedFile = new File(WarrantyPanelController.WARRANTY_FILE_DIRECTORY + "new_bat.wd");
    if (downloadedFile.exists() && downloadedFile.renameTo(new File(WarrantyPanelController.WARRANTY_FILE_DIRECTORY + "bat.wd"))) {
      LOGGER.debug("Renamed downloaded warranty file");
    } else {
      LOGGER.warn("Renaming of downloaded warranty file failed");
    } 
  }
  
  private boolean downloadWarrantyFile(String source, String target) {
    LOGGER.debug("Download encrypted warranty file at '{}' and save it at '{}'", source, target);
    String downloadPath = this.updateServerConnection.downloadFileSync(source);
    if (StringUtils.isNotBlank(downloadPath) && new File(downloadPath).exists()) {
      LOGGER.info("Downloading warranty file succeeded");
      try {
        FileUtils.copyFile(new File(downloadPath), new File(target));
        return true;
      } catch (IOException e) {
        LOGGER.warn("Failed to copy warranty file!", (Throwable)e);
        return false;
      } 
    } 
    LOGGER.error("Downloading warranty file failed");
    return false;
  }
}

package com.gigatronik.beds.gui.panels.bct.measurefinished.warranty;

class WarrantyConfigurationParser {
  private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(WarrantyConfigurationParser.class);
  
  public static final String WPK_PERCENTAGE_REMAINING_ENERGY_THRESHOLD_288WH = "warranty-parameter.percentage-remaining-energy-threshold.nominal-energy.288";

  public static final String WPK_PERCENTAGE_REMAINING_ENERGY_THRESHOLD_500WH = "warranty-parameter.percentage-remaining-energy-threshold.nominal-energy.500";
  
  public static final String WPK_PERCENTAGE_REMAINING_ENERGY_THRESHOLD_625WH = "warranty-parameter.percentage-remaining-energy-threshold.nominal-energy.625";
  
  public static final String WPK_DATE_OF_PURCHASE_NON_COMMERCIAL = "warranty-parameter.max-values.commercial-usage.false.date-of-purchase";
  
  public static final String WPK_DATE_OF_PRODUCTION_NON_COMMERCIAL = "warranty-parameter.max-values.commercial-usage.false.date-of-production";
  
  public static final String WPK_CHARGE_CYCLES_NON_COMMERCIAL = "warranty-parameter.max-values.commercial-usage.false.charge-cycles";
  
  public static final String WPK_DATE_OF_PURCHASE_COMMERCIAL = "warranty-parameter.max-values.commercial-usage.true.date-of-purchase";
  
  public static final String WPK_DATE_OF_PRODUCTION_COMMERCIAL = "warranty-parameter.max-values.commercial-usage.true.date-of-production";
  
  public static final String WPK_CHARGE_CYCLES_COMMERCIAL = "warranty-parameter.max-values.commercial-usage.true.charge-cycles";
  
  public static final String WTK_CAPTION = "warranty-text.caption";
  
  public static final String WTK_MAIN = "warranty-text.main";
  
  public static final String WTK_NON_COMMERCIAL_INTRODUCATION = "warranty-text.non-commercial-introduction";
  
  public static final String WTK_COMMERCIAL_INTRODUCATION = "warranty-text.commercial-introduction";
  
  public static final String WTK_NON_COMMERCIAL_BULLET_DATE_OF_PURCHASE = "warranty-text.bullets.commercial.false.date-of-purchase";
  
  public static final String WTK_NON_COMMERCIAL_BULLET_DATE_OF_PRODUCTION = "warranty-text.bullets.commercial.false.date-of-production";
  
  public static final String WTK_NON_COMMERCIAL_BULLET_CHARGE_CYCLES = "warranty-text.bullets.commercial.false.charge-cycles";
  
  public static final String WTK_COMMERCIAL_BULLET_DATE_OF_PURCHASE = "warranty-text.bullets.commercial.true.date-of-purchase";
  
  public static final String WTK_COMMERCIAL_BULLET_DATE_OF_PRODUCTION = "warranty-text.bullets.commercial.true.date-of-production";
  
  public static final String WTK_COMMERCIAL_BULLET_CHARGE_CYCLES = "warranty-text.bullets.commercial.true.charge-cycles";
  
  private static final String WARRANTY_PARAMETERS = "warranty-parameter";
  
  private static final String PERCENTAGE_REMAINING_ENERGY_THRESHOLD = "percentage-remaining-energy-threshold";
  
  private static final String NOMINAL_ENERGY = "nominal-energy";
  
  private static final String MAX_VALUES = "max-values";
  
  private static final String COMMERCIAL_USAGE = "commercial-usage";
  
  private static final String DATE_OF_PURCHASE = "date-of-purchase";
  
  private static final String DATE_OF_PRODUCTION = "date-of-production";
  
  private static final String CHARGE_CYCLES = "charge-cycles";
  
  private static final String WARRANTY_TEXT = "warranty-text";
  
  private static final String LANGUAGE = "language";
  
  private static final String CAPTION = "caption";
  
  private static final String MAIN = "main";
  
  private static final String NON_COMMERCIAL_INTRODUCATION = "non-commercial-introduction";
  
  private static final String COMMERCIAL_INTRODUCTION = "commercial-introduction";
  
  private static final String BULLETS = "bullets";
  
  private static final String COMMERCIAL = "commercial";
  
  private static final int NUMBER_OF_NOMINAL_CAPACITY_TAGS = 5;
  
  private static final int NUMBER_OF_CUSTOMER_TYPE_TAGS = 2;
  
  private static final String PLACEHOLDER_PATTERN = "\\{[^}]+\\}";
  
  private final WarrantyConfigurationDecryptor decryptor = new WarrantyConfigurationDecryptor();
  
  private final Map<String, String> warrantyFileContent = new HashMap<>();
  
  public boolean initWarrantyConditions() throws TokenException {
    return updateWarrantyConditions("bat.wd");
  }
  
  public boolean updateWarrantyConditions() throws TokenException {
    return updateWarrantyConditions("new_bat.wd");
  }
  
  private boolean updateWarrantyConditions(String file) throws TokenException {
    return (parseWarrantyFile(this.decryptor.decryptWarrantyFile(file)) && replacePlaceholders());
  }
  
  public Map<String, String> getWarrantyParameters() {
    if (this.warrantyFileContent.isEmpty())
      return null; 
    return createSubMap("warranty-parameter");
  }
  
  public Map<String, String> getWarrantyTexts() {
    if (this.warrantyFileContent.isEmpty())
      return null; 
    return createSubMap("warranty-text");
  }
  
  private Map<String, String> createSubMap(String filter) {
    Map<String, String> subMap = new HashMap<>();
    for (Map.Entry<String, String> entry : this.warrantyFileContent.entrySet()) {
      String currentKey = entry.getKey().toString();
      if (currentKey.startsWith(filter))
        subMap.put(currentKey, entry.getValue().toString()); 
    } 
    if (subMap.isEmpty())
      LOGGER.warn("Returning emtpy map! Used filter was '{}'", filter); 
    return subMap;
  }
  
  private boolean replacePlaceholders() {
    LOGGER.debug("Start replacing placeholders in warranty texts");
    Pattern pattern = Pattern.compile("\\{[^}]+\\}");
    Map<String, String> parameters = createSubMap("warranty-parameter");
    Map<String, String> texts = createSubMap("warranty-text");
    for (String currentKey : texts.keySet()) {
      String currentText = texts.get(currentKey);
      Matcher matcher = pattern.matcher(currentText);
      int numberOfPlaceholders = 0;
      while (matcher.find()) {
        String currentPlaceholderWithBrackets = matcher.group();
        String currentPlaceholderWithoutBrackets = currentPlaceholderWithBrackets.substring(1, currentPlaceholderWithBrackets.length() - 1);
        boolean replacementSuccessful = false;
        for (String currentParameter : parameters.keySet()) {
          if (currentParameter.equals(currentPlaceholderWithoutBrackets)) {
            currentText = currentText.replaceFirst("\\{" + currentPlaceholderWithoutBrackets + "\\}", parameters.get(currentPlaceholderWithoutBrackets));
            replacementSuccessful = true;
            break;
          } 
        } 
        if (!replacementSuccessful) {
          LOGGER.warn("Placeholder could not be replaced, parameter {} is undefined!", currentPlaceholderWithBrackets);
          return false;
        } 
        numberOfPlaceholders++;
      } 
      if (numberOfPlaceholders > 0)
        this.warrantyFileContent.put(currentKey, currentText); 
    } 
    return true;
  }
  
  private boolean parseWarrantyFile(InputStream xmlContent) {
    LOGGER.debug("Start parsing of decrypted warranty file");
    if (xmlContent == null) {
      LOGGER.warn("Input's null, parsing prevented");
      return false;
    } 
    try {
      DocumentBuilderFactory factory = DocumentBuilderFactory.newInstance();
      DocumentBuilder builder = factory.newDocumentBuilder();
      Document document = builder.parse(xmlContent);
      return parseWarrantyFile(document);
    } catch (ParserConfigurationException|org.xml.sax.SAXException|java.io.IOException ex) {
      LOGGER.warn("Processing decrypted warranty file failed!");
      return false;
    } 
  }
  
  private boolean parseWarrantyFile(Document xml) {
    this.warrantyFileContent.keySet().removeAll(this.warrantyFileContent.keySet());
    try {
      return parseWarrantyFileTry(xml);
    } catch (WarrantyFileParsingErrorException ex) {
      LOGGER.warn("Parsing error warranty file content! {}", (Throwable)ex);
      return false;
    } 
  }
  
  private boolean parseWarrantyFileTry(Document xml) throws WarrantyFileParsingErrorException {
    extractPercentThresholds(xml);
    extractWarrantyConditionParameters(xml);
    extractWarrantyText(xml);
    LOGGER.debug("Read in content: {}", this.warrantyFileContent);
    return true;
  }
  
  private void extractPercentThresholds(Document xml) throws WarrantyFileParsingErrorException {
    try {
      NodeList percentageRemainingEnergyThresholdNodes = xml.getElementsByTagName("percentage-remaining-energy-threshold");
      for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
        Element percentageRemainingEnergyThresholdElement = (Element)percentageRemainingEnergyThresholdNodes.item(i);
        String nominalEnergy = percentageRemainingEnergyThresholdElement.getAttribute("nominal-energy");
        String percentageRemainingEnergyThreshold = percentageRemainingEnergyThresholdElement.getTextContent();
        this.warrantyFileContent.put("warranty-parameter.percentage-remaining-energy-threshold.nominal-energy." + nominalEnergy, percentageRemainingEnergyThreshold);
      } 
    } catch (Exception ex) {
      throw new WarrantyFileParsingErrorException("Extracting percent thresholds from warranty file not possible!", ex);
    } 
  }
  
  private void extractWarrantyConditionParameters(Document xml) throws WarrantyFileParsingErrorException {
    try {
      NodeList maxValueNodes = xml.getElementsByTagName("max-values");
      for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
        Element maxValueElement = (Element)maxValueNodes.item(i);
        String commercialUsage = maxValueElement.getAttribute("commercial-usage");
        String dateOfPurchase = maxValueElement.getElementsByTagName("date-of-purchase").item(0).getTextContent();
        String dateOfProduction = maxValueElement.getElementsByTagName("date-of-production").item(0).getTextContent();
        String chargeCycles = maxValueElement.getElementsByTagName("charge-cycles").item(0).getTextContent();
        this.warrantyFileContent.put("warranty-parameter.max-values.commercial-usage." + commercialUsage + ".date-of-production", dateOfProduction);
        this.warrantyFileContent.put("warranty-parameter.max-values.commercial-usage." + commercialUsage + ".date-of-purchase", dateOfPurchase);
        this.warrantyFileContent.put("warranty-parameter.max-values.commercial-usage." + commercialUsage + ".charge-cycles", chargeCycles);
      } 
    } catch (Exception ex) {
      throw new WarrantyFileParsingErrorException("Extracting condition parameters from warranty file not possible!", ex);
    } 
  }
  
  private void extractWarrantyText(Document xml) throws WarrantyFileParsingErrorException {
    try {
      NodeList warrantyTextNodes = xml.getElementsByTagName("warranty-text");
      for (int i = 0; i < warrantyTextNodes.getLength(); i++) {
        Element warrantyTextElement = (Element)warrantyTextNodes.item(i);
        String language = warrantyTextElement.getAttribute("language");
        if (I18NUtil.getLocale().getISO3Language().equals(language))
          extractWarrantyText(warrantyTextElement); 
      } 
    } catch (Exception ex) {
      throw new WarrantyFileParsingErrorException("Extracting the warranty text from warranty file not possible!", ex);
    } 
  }
  
  private void extractWarrantyText(Element warrantyTextElement) throws WarrantyFileParsingErrorException {
    extractWarrantyTextNotBullets(warrantyTextElement);
    extractWarrantyTextBullets(warrantyTextElement);
  }
  
  private void extractWarrantyTextNotBullets(Element warrantyTextElement) throws WarrantyFileParsingErrorException {
    try {
      String caption = warrantyTextElement.getElementsByTagName("caption").item(0).getTextContent();
      String main = warrantyTextElement.getElementsByTagName("main").item(0).getTextContent();
      String nonCommercialIntroduction = warrantyTextElement.getElementsByTagName("non-commercial-introduction").item(0).getTextContent();
      String commercialIntroduction = warrantyTextElement.getElementsByTagName("commercial-introduction").item(0).getTextContent();
      this.warrantyFileContent.put("warranty-text.caption", caption);
      this.warrantyFileContent.put("warranty-text.main", main);
      this.warrantyFileContent.put("warranty-text.non-commercial-introduction", nonCommercialIntroduction);
      this.warrantyFileContent.put("warranty-text.commercial-introduction", commercialIntroduction);
    } catch (Exception ex) {
      throw new WarrantyFileParsingErrorException("Extracting the warranty text in the current language from warranty file not possible!", ex);
    } 
  }
  
  private void extractWarrantyTextBullets(Element warrantyTextElement) throws WarrantyFileParsingErrorException {
    try {
      NodeList bulletNodes = warrantyTextElement.getElementsByTagName("bullets");
      for (int j = 0; j < 2; j++) {
        Element bulletElement = (Element)bulletNodes.item(j);
        String commercial = bulletElement.getAttribute("commercial");
        String dateOfPurchase = bulletElement.getElementsByTagName("date-of-purchase").item(0).getTextContent();
        String dateOfProduction = bulletElement.getElementsByTagName("date-of-production").item(0).getTextContent();
        String chargeCycles = bulletElement.getElementsByTagName("charge-cycles").item(0).getTextContent();
        this.warrantyFileContent.put("warranty-text.bullets.commercial." + commercial + ".date-of-purchase", dateOfPurchase);
        this.warrantyFileContent.put("warranty-text.bullets.commercial." + commercial + ".date-of-production", dateOfProduction);
        this.warrantyFileContent.put("warranty-text.bullets.commercial." + commercial + ".charge-cycles", chargeCycles);
      } 
    } catch (Exception ex) {
      throw new WarrantyFileParsingErrorException("Extracting the warranty text bullets in the current language from warranty file not possible!", ex);
    } 
  }
}

ITEM 159: com/gigatronik/beds/gui/panels/bct/measurefinished/warranty/WarrantyEventPublisher.java
========================================================================================================================
package com.gigatronik.beds.gui.panels.bct.measurefinished.warranty;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.concurrent.Executor;
import java.util.concurrent.Executors;
import org.apache.commons.lang3.concurrent.BasicThreadFactory;
import org.slf4j.Logger;
import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;

public class WarrantyEventPublisher {
  private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(WarrantyEventPublisher.class);
  
  private final Executor executor = Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor(new BasicThreadFactory.Builder().namingPattern("WarrantyEventPublisher-%d").build());
  
  private final List<WarrantyCaseChangedListener> warrantyConditionCallbacks = new ArrayList<>();
  
  void publishWarrantyConditionUpdatedInfo(WarrantyCase warrantyCase) {
    if (warrantyCase != null) {
      LOGGER.info("Publish warranty condition updated info: '{}'", warrantyCase);
      this.executor.execute(() -> this.warrantyConditionCallbacks.forEach(listener -> listener.onWarrantyCaseChanged(warrantyCase)));
    } 
  }
  
  void publishWarrantyConditionsMissingInfo() {
    LOGGER.warn("Publish warranty conditions missing info!");
    this.executor.execute(() -> this.warrantyConditionCallbacks.forEach(listener -> listener.onWarrantyConditionsMissing()));
  }
  
  synchronized void registerWarrantyCaseChangedListener(WarrantyCaseChangedListener listener) {
    if (!this.warrantyConditionCallbacks.contains(listener))
      this.warrantyConditionCallbacks.add(listener); 
  }
  
  synchronized void deregisterWarrantyCaseChangedListener(WarrantyCaseChangedListener listener) {
    this.warrantyConditionCallbacks.remove(listener);
  }
}

package com.gigatronik.beds.gui.panels.bct.measurefinished.warranty;

import com.gigatronik.ebike.gui.EBikeApplicationPanel;
import java.util.Map;
import javax.swing.text.html.StyleSheet;
import org.slf4j.Logger;
import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;

class WarrantyInfoWindowBuilder {
  private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(WarrantyInfoWindowBuilder.class);
  
  public String createDialogContent(Map<String, String> texts) {
    LOGGER.debug("Create warranty info dialog content using: '{}'", texts);
    if (texts == null || texts.keySet().size() < 10) {
      LOGGER.warn("Texts missing, displaying dummy on click 'Garantiefall Informationen'");
      return "<HTML><BODY><P class=\"first\">Sorry, warranty informations are not available.</P></BODY></HTML>";
    } 
    return "<HTML><BODY><P class=\"first\">" + (String)
      
      texts.get("warranty-text.main") + "</P><P>" + (String)
      texts.get("warranty-text.non-commercial-introduction") + "</P><UL><LI>" + (String)
      
      texts.get("warranty-text.bullets.commercial.false.date-of-purchase") + "</LI><LI>" + (String)
      texts.get("warranty-text.bullets.commercial.false.date-of-production") + "</LI><LI>" + (String)
      texts.get("warranty-text.bullets.commercial.false.charge-cycles") + "</LI></UL><P>" + (String)
      
      texts.get("warranty-text.commercial-introduction") + "</P><UL><LI>" + (String)
      
      texts.get("warranty-text.bullets.commercial.true.date-of-purchase") + "</LI><LI>" + (String)
      texts.get("warranty-text.bullets.commercial.true.date-of-production") + "</LI><LI>" + (String)
      texts.get("warranty-text.bullets.commercial.true.charge-cycles") + "</LI></UL></BODY></HTML>";
  }
  
  public StyleSheet getStyleSheet() {
    StyleSheet styleSheet = new StyleSheet();
    styleSheet.addRule("html {font-family: \"" + EBikeApplicationPanel.DEFAULT_FONT.getFontName() + "\";font-weight: normal;font-size: 11px;");
    styleSheet.addRule("ul {list-style-type: disc;list-style-position: inside;margin-left: 10px;padding-left: 10px;}");
    styleSheet.addRule("p.first {margin: 0px 0px 0px 0px;}");
    styleSheet.addRule("p {margin: 10px 0px 0px 0px;}");
    styleSheet.addRule("li {margin-top: 10px;}");
    return styleSheet;
  }
}

ITEM 164: com/gigatronik/beds/gui/panels/bct/measurefinished/warranty/WarrantyPanelController.java
