package com.gigatronik.beds.gui.panels.bct.measurefinished.warranty;

import com.gigatronik.beds.service.communication.impl.bct.BctBatteryData;
import com.gigatronik.bosch.plugin.unitoken.TokenException;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.bosch.service.internationalization.I18NDateTimesFormats;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.bosch.service.internationalization.ResourceBundleFactory;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.bosch.service.internationalization.Utf8ResourceBundleFormatted;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.bosch.updateserver.UpdateServerConnection;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.gui.DefaultDongleStateListener;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.gui.testinterface.TestableJOptionPane;
import java.awt.EventQueue;
import java.text.ParseException;
import java.time.LocalDate;
import java.util.Date;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicBoolean;
import org.slf4j.Logger;
import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;

public class WarrantyPanelController {
  static final String WARRANTY_FILE_DIRECTORY = System.getenv("DART2_HOME") + "/conf/";
  
  static final String ENCRYPTED_WARRANTY_FILE_NAME = "bat.wd";
  
  static final String DOWNLOADED_ENCRYPTED_WARRANTY_FILE_PREFIX = "new_";
  
  private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(WarrantyPanelController.class);
  
  private static final Utf8ResourceBundleFormatted BUNDLE = ResourceBundleFactory.newDefaultResourceBundle();
  
  static final String ICON_BMS_OK = "/com/gigatronik/beds/gui/panels/bct/measurefinished/warranty/infoBlueIcon_transparent.png";
  
  private static final String ICON_BMS_NOK_WARRANTY = "/com/gigatronik/beds/gui/panels/bct/measurefinished/warranty/exclamationMarkOrangeIcon_transparent.png";
  
  private static final String ICON_BMS_NOK_NO_WARRANTY = "/com/gigatronik/beds/gui/panels/bct/measurefinished/warranty/exclamationMarkGreyIcon_transparent.png";
  
  public static final int NOMINAL_CAPACITY_288WH = 288;
  
  public static final int NOMINAL_CAPACITY_300WH = 300;
  
  public static final int NOMINAL_CAPACITY_400WH = 400;
  
  public static final int NOMINAL_CAPACITY_500WH = 500;
  
  public static final int NOMINAL_CAPACITY_600WH = 600;
  
  public static final int NOMINAL_CAPACITY_625WH = 625;
  
  private final AtomicBoolean warrantyFileProcessingStarted = new AtomicBoolean(false);
  
  private final AtomicBoolean preconditionWarrantyFileProcessingSucceeded = new AtomicBoolean(false);
  
  private final AtomicBoolean preconditionBmsParametersFromBctObtained = new AtomicBoolean(false);
  
  private final AtomicBoolean preconditionBmsParametersFromUserObtained = new AtomicBoolean(false);
  
  private int bmsNominalCapacity;
  
  private int bmsActualCapacity;
  
  private int bmsChargingCycles;
  
  private Date bmsProductionDate;
  
  private LocalDate bmsPurchaseDate;
  
  private boolean bmsCommercialUsage = false;
  
  private final WarrantyEventPublisher eventPublisher;
  
  private final WarrantyConfigurationParser parser;
  
  private final WarrantyConfigurationDownloader downloader;
  
  private final WarrantyInfoWindowBuilder windowBuilder;
  
  private WarrantyInfoPanel warrantyInfoPanel;
  
  private WarrantyPanel warrantyPanel;
  
  private WarrantyCase actualWarrantyCase = WarrantyCase.UNKNOWN;
  
  private final DefaultDongleStateListener defaultDongleStateListener;
  
  public WarrantyPanelController(DefaultDongleStateListener defaultDongleStateListener) {
    this.parser = new WarrantyConfigurationParser();
    this.downloader = new WarrantyConfigurationDownloader(new UpdateServerConnection());
    this.windowBuilder = new WarrantyInfoWindowBuilder();
    this.eventPublisher = new WarrantyEventPublisher();
    this.defaultDongleStateListener = defaultDongleStateListener;
  }
  
  public void setPanel(WarrantyPanel panel) {
    this.warrantyPanel = panel;
  }
  
  public void onDateChanged(LocalDate newPurchaseDate) {
    LOGGER.debug("Warranty parameter purchase date changed from '{}' to '{}'", this.bmsPurchaseDate, newPurchaseDate);
    this.bmsPurchaseDate = newPurchaseDate;
    if (this.bmsPurchaseDate != null && this.bmsPurchaseDate.isAfter(LocalDate.now()))
      this.bmsPurchaseDate = null; 
    proveCompletenessOfUserInputParameters();
    updateWarrantyInfoPanel();
  }
  
  public void onCommercialUsageChanged(boolean isChecked) {
    LOGGER.debug("Warranty parameter commercial usage changed from '{}' to '{}'", Boolean.valueOf(this.bmsCommercialUsage), Boolean.valueOf(isChecked));
    this.bmsCommercialUsage = isChecked;
    proveCompletenessOfUserInputParameters();
    updateWarrantyInfoPanel();
  }
  
  private void proveCompletenessOfUserInputParameters() {
    if (this.bmsPurchaseDate != null) {
      this.preconditionBmsParametersFromUserObtained.compareAndSet(false, true);
    } else {
      this.preconditionBmsParametersFromUserObtained.compareAndSet(true, false);
    } 
  }
  
  public void setBatteryParameters(BctBatteryData data) {
    try {
      this.bmsChargingCycles = Integer.parseInt(data.getNumberOfFullChargeCycles());
      this.bmsNominalCapacity = Integer.parseInt(data.getNominalEnergy());
      this.bmsActualCapacity = Integer.parseInt(data.getMeasuredEnergy());
      this.bmsProductionDate = I18NDateTimesFormats.getInternalDateFormat().parse(data.getManufactureDate());
      this.preconditionBmsParametersFromBctObtained.compareAndSet(false, true);
    } catch (ParseException|NumberFormatException ex) {
      LOGGER.warn("One of the bms parameters could not be parsed: bmsChargingCycles='{}' bmsNominalCapacity='{}' bmsActualCapacity='{}' bmsProductionDate='{}'", data.getNumberOfFullChargeCycles(), data.getNominalEnergy(), data.getMeasuredEnergy(), data.getManufactureDate(), ex);
      this.preconditionBmsParametersFromBctObtained.compareAndSet(true, false);
    } 
    LOGGER.debug("Received bms parameters from BCT: bmsChargingCycles = '{}', bmsNominalCapacity = '{}', bmsActualCapacity = '{}', bmsProductionDate = '{}'", this.bmsChargingCycles, this.bmsNominalCapacity, this.bmsActualCapacity, this.bmsProductionDate);
    updateWarrantyInfoPanel();
  }
  
  public WarrantyCase getWarrantyCase() {
    return this.actualWarrantyCase;
  }
  
  private synchronized void updateWarrantyInfoPanel() {
    if (batteryOkPreconditionsFulfilled() && isBatteryOk()) {
      this.actualWarrantyCase = WarrantyCase.ENERGY_WITHIN_RANGE;
      refreshWarrantyInfoPanelContent(this.actualWarrantyCase);
      this.eventPublisher.publishWarrantyConditionUpdatedInfo(this.actualWarrantyCase);
      return;
    } 
    if (warrantyCasePreconditionsFulfilled()) {
      this.actualWarrantyCase = predictWarrantyCase();
      LOGGER.debug("Warranty prediction terminated with '{}'", this.actualWarrantyCase);
      if (warrantyCasePreconditionsFulfilled() && this.actualWarrantyCase != null) {
        refreshWarrantyInfoPanelContent(this.actualWarrantyCase);
      } else {
        clearWarrantyInfoPanelContent();
      } 
      this.eventPublisher.publishWarrantyConditionUpdatedInfo(this.actualWarrantyCase);
    } else {
      LOGGER.debug("Not all necessary parameters are gathered to predict the actual warranty case: bmsParametersFromBctObtained={}, bmsParametersFromUserObtained={}, warrantyFileProcessingSucceeded={}", this.preconditionBmsParametersFromBctObtained.get(), this.preconditionBmsParametersFromUserObtained.get(), this.preconditionWarrantyFileProcessingSucceeded.get());
      clearWarrantyInfoPanelContent();
    } 
  }
  
  private boolean isBatteryOk() {
    Map<String, String> warrantyParameters = this.parser.getWarrantyParameters();
    int capacityThreshold = 0;
    try {
      switch (this.bmsNominalCapacity) {
        case 288:
          capacityThreshold = Integer.parseInt(warrantyParameters.get("warranty-parameter.percentage-remaining-energy-threshold.nominal-energy.288"));
          break;
        case 300:
          capacityThreshold = Integer.parseInt(warrantyParameters.get("warranty-parameter.percentage-remaining-energy-threshold.nominal-energy.300"));
          break;
        case 400:
          capacityThreshold = Integer.parseInt(warrantyParameters.get("warranty-parameter.percentage-remaining-energy-threshold.nominal-energy.400"));
          break;
        case 500:
          capacityThreshold = Integer.parseInt(warrantyParameters.get("warranty-parameter.percentage-remaining-energy-threshold.nominal-energy.500"));
          break;
        case 600:
        case 625:
          capacityThreshold = Integer.parseInt(warrantyParameters.get("warranty-parameter.percentage-remaining-energy-threshold.nominal-energy.625"));
          break;
        default:
          LOGGER.warn("Measured battery has unknown nominal capcity '{}'", Integer.valueOf(this.bmsNominalCapacity));
          this.preconditionBmsParametersFromBctObtained.compareAndSet(true, false);
          return false;
      } 
    } catch (NumberFormatException ex) {
      LOGGER.warn("Parsing of any of capacity thresholds not possible: 288Wh='{}', 300Wh='{}', 400Wh='{}', 500Wh='{}', 625Wh='{}'", warrantyParameters.get("warranty-parameter.percentage-remaining-energy-threshold.nominal-energy.288"), warrantyParameters.get("warranty-parameter.percentage-remaining-energy-threshold.nominal-energy.300"), warrantyParameters.get("warranty-parameter.percentage-remaining-energy-threshold.nominal-energy.400"), warrantyParameters.get("warranty-parameter.percentage-remaining-energy-threshold.nominal-energy.500"), warrantyParameters.get("warranty-parameter.percentage-remaining-energy-threshold.nominal-energy.625"), ex);
      this.preconditionWarrantyFileProcessingSucceeded.compareAndSet(true, false);
      return false;
    } 
    return (this.bmsActualCapacity * 100 / this.bmsNominalCapacity >= capacityThreshold);
  }
  
  private WarrantyCase predictWarrantyCase() {
    LOGGER.debug("Start determining the current warranty case ...");
    Map<String, String> warrantyParameters = this.parser.getWarrantyParameters();
    try {
      int thresholdPassedPurchaseMonths = Integer.parseInt(warrantyParameters.get(this.bmsCommercialUsage ? "warranty-parameter.max-values.commercial-usage.true.date-of-purchase" : "warranty-parameter.max-values.commercial-usage.false.date-of-purchase"));
      int thresholdPassedProducationMonths = Integer.parseInt(warrantyParameters.get(this.bmsCommercialUsage ? "warranty-parameter.max-values.commercial-usage.true.date-of-production" : "warranty-parameter.max-values.commercial-usage.false.date-of-production"));
      int thresholdChargeCycles = Integer.parseInt(warrantyParameters.get(this.bmsCommercialUsage ? "warranty-parameter.max-values.commercial-usage.true.charge-cycles" : "warranty-parameter.max-values.commercial-usage.false.charge-cycles"));
      LOGGER.debug("Used thresholds: passedPurchaseMonths='{}' passedProducationMonths='{}' chargeCycles='{}'", thresholdPassedPurchaseMonths, thresholdPassedProducationMonths, thresholdChargeCycles);
      Date yesterday = new Date(System.currentTimeMillis() - 86400000L);
      boolean purchaseExpired = this.bmsPurchaseDate.plusMonths((long)thresholdPassedPurchaseMonths).isBefore(LocalDate.now());
      this.bmsProductionDate.setMonth(this.bmsProductionDate.getMonth() + thresholdPassedProducationMonths);
      boolean productionExpired = this.bmsProductionDate.before(yesterday);
      this.bmsProductionDate.setMonth(this.bmsProductionDate.getMonth() - thresholdPassedProducationMonths);
      boolean chargCyclesExpired = (this.bmsChargingCycles > thresholdChargeCycles);
      LOGGER.debug("Condition check result: purchaseExpired='{}' productionExpired='{}' chargCyclesExpired='{}'", purchaseExpired, productionExpired, chargCyclesExpired);
      if (!purchaseExpired && !productionExpired && !chargCyclesExpired)
        return WarrantyCase.ENERGY_BEYOND_RANGE_WARRANTY; 
      if (chargCyclesExpired && (purchaseExpired || productionExpired))
        return WarrantyCase.ENERGY_BEYOND_RANGE_NO_WARRANTY_DATE_AND_CYCLES; 
      if (chargCyclesExpired && !purchaseExpired && !productionExpired)
        return WarrantyCase.ENERGY_BEYOND_RANGE_NO_WARRANTY_TOO_MANY_CYCLES; 
      if (!chargCyclesExpired && (purchaseExpired || productionExpired))
        return WarrantyCase.ENERGY_BEYOND_RANGE_NO_WARRANTY_DATE_EXCEEDED; 
      return null;
    } catch (NumberFormatException ex) {
      LOGGER.warn("Parsing warranty thresholds failed: {}", warrantyParameters, ex);
      this.preconditionWarrantyFileProcessingSucceeded.compareAndSet(true, false);
      return null;
    } 
  }
  
  private void refreshWarrantyInfoPanelContent(WarrantyCase warrantyCase) {
    String icon;
    LOGGER.debug("Update displayed warranty case to '{}'", warrantyCase);
    String text = "<html>" + BUNDLE.getString("MeasurementFinishedPanel.Warranty.Info." + warrantyCase) + "</html>";
    switch (warrantyCase) {
      case ENERGY_BEYOND_RANGE_NO_WARRANTY_TOO_MANY_CYCLES:
      case ENERGY_BEYOND_RANGE_NO_WARRANTY_DATE_EXCEEDED:
      case ENERGY_BEYOND_RANGE_NO_WARRANTY_DATE_AND_CYCLES:
        icon = "/com/gigatronik/beds/gui/panels/bct/measurefinished/warranty/exclamationMarkGreyIcon_transparent.png";
        break;
      case ENERGY_BEYOND_RANGE_WARRANTY:
        icon = "/com/gigatronik/beds/gui/panels/bct/measurefinished/warranty/exclamationMarkOrangeIcon_transparent.png";
        break;
      default:
        icon = "/com/gigatronik/beds/gui/panels/bct/measurefinished/warranty/infoBlueIcon_transparent.png";
        break;
    } 
    this.warrantyPanel.updateWarrantyInfoPanelContent(icon, text);
    this.warrantyPanel.paintBorder(true);
  }
  
  private void clearWarrantyInfoPanelContent() {
    String clearText;
    boolean drawInvalidBorder;
    if (this.bmsPurchaseDate == null) {
      clearText = BUNDLE.getString("MeasurementFinishedPanel.Warranty.Info.PurchaseDateMissing");
      drawInvalidBorder = false;
    } else {
      clearText = "n/a";
      drawInvalidBorder = true;
    } 
    this.warrantyPanel.paintBorder(drawInvalidBorder);
    LOGGER.debug("Warranty info panel content is cleared. Displayed text is '{}' with valid border '{}'", clearText, Boolean.valueOf(drawInvalidBorder));
    this.warrantyPanel.updateWarrantyInfoPanelContent("/com/gigatronik/beds/gui/panels/bct/measurefinished/warranty/infoBlueIcon_transparent.png", clearText);
  }
  
  private void setVolunteerWarrantyPanelContent() {
    this.warrantyPanel.updateVolunteerWarrantyPanelContent("/com/gigatronik/beds/gui/panels/bct/measurefinished/warranty/infoBlueIcon_transparent.png", BUNDLE.getString("MeasurementFinishedPanel.Warranty.Info.VOLUNTEER_WARRANTY"));
  }
  
  public void startWarrantyFileProcessing() {
    if (this.warrantyFileProcessingStarted.compareAndSet(false, true)) {
      Thread warrantyThread = new Thread(() -> {
            try {
              executeWarrantyFileProcessingProcedure();
            } catch (TokenException ex) {
              LOGGER.warn("Processing of warranty file could not terminate successfully, because of dongle failure. Try again on next dongle connection!", (Throwable)ex);
              this.warrantyFileProcessingStarted.set(false);
              this.defaultDongleStateListener.displayDongleIsMissingDialog();
            } 
          });
      warrantyThread.setName("Warranty-Thread");
      warrantyThread.start();
    } 
  }
  
  private void executeWarrantyFileProcessingProcedure() throws TokenException {
    LOGGER.debug("Started executing warranty file processing procedure ...");
    if (this.downloader.downloadWarrantyFile() && this.parser.updateWarrantyConditions()) {
      LOGGER.debug("Updating and processing of new warranty file worked");
      this.downloader.replaceLocalWithDownloadedFile();
      this.preconditionWarrantyFileProcessingSucceeded.compareAndSet(false, true);
    } else if (this.parser.initWarrantyConditions()) {
      LOGGER.debug("Downloading or processing of new warranty file from update server failed, using local warranty file as a fallback");
      this.preconditionWarrantyFileProcessingSucceeded.compareAndSet(false, true);
    } else {
      LOGGER.warn("Neither the local nor the remote file from the update server works --> disable feature");
    } 
    if (!this.preconditionWarrantyFileProcessingSucceeded.get())
      this.eventPublisher.publishWarrantyConditionsMissingInfo(); 
    EventQueue.invokeLater(() -> {
          setVolunteerWarrantyPanelContent();
          prepareVolunteerWarrantyInfoWindow();
          updateWarrantyInfoPanel();
        });
  }
  
  private void prepareVolunteerWarrantyInfoWindow() {
    this.warrantyInfoPanel = new WarrantyInfoPanel(TestableJOptionPane.getDefaultParentFrame());
    Map<String, String> warrantyTexts = this.parser.getWarrantyTexts();
    this.warrantyInfoPanel.setDialogContent(this.windowBuilder.createDialogContent(warrantyTexts), this.windowBuilder.getStyleSheet());
    this.warrantyInfoPanel.setCaptionText((warrantyTexts == null) ? "Caption" : warrantyTexts.get("warranty-text.caption"));
  }
  
  public void displayVolunteerWarrantyWindow() {
    LOGGER.debug("Display warranty info panel");
    this.warrantyInfoPanel.setVisible(true);
  }
  
  public LocalDate getPurchaseDate() {
    return this.warrantyPanel.getDatePicker().getDate();
  }
  
  public boolean getIsCommercialUse() {
    return this.warrantyPanel.getCheckBoxCommercialUse().isSelected();
  }
  
  private boolean batteryOkPreconditionsFulfilled() {
    return (this.preconditionWarrantyFileProcessingSucceeded.get() && this.preconditionBmsParametersFromBctObtained.get());
  }
  
  private boolean warrantyCasePreconditionsFulfilled() {
    return (this.preconditionWarrantyFileProcessingSucceeded.get() && this.preconditionBmsParametersFromBctObtained.get() && this.preconditionBmsParametersFromUserObtained.get());
  }
  
  public WarrantyPanel getWarrantyPanel() {
    return this.warrantyPanel;
  }
  
  public void registerWarrantyCaseChangedListener(WarrantyCaseChangedListener listener) {
    this.eventPublisher.registerWarrantyCaseChangedListener(listener);
  }
  
  public void deregisterWarrantyCaseChangedListener(WarrantyCaseChangedListener listener) {
    this.eventPublisher.deregisterWarrantyCaseChangedListener(listener);
  }
}

package com.gigatronik.beds.gui.panels.bct.measureinprogress.controller;

import com.gigatronik.beds.common.bct.BctBatteryType;

public class MeasurementInProgressController implements BctEventHandler.BctOperationStateListener, BctEventHandler.BctMeasurementProgressListener {
  private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(MeasurementInProgressController.class);
  
  private static final Utf8ResourceBundleFormatted BUNDLE = ResourceBundleFactory.newDefaultResourceBundle();
  
  private String remainingTimeLabel = BUNDLE.getString("StopMeasurementButtonPanel.lblRemainingTime.text");
  
  private static final int MINUTES_MAX = 60;
  
  private static final String VICTOR_LABEL = BUNDLE.getString("CapacityTestTab.bctBatteryType.Victor");
  
  private static final String CLASSIC_PLUS_LABEL = BUNDLE.getString("CapacityTestTab.bctBatteryType.ClassicPlus");
  
  private static final String INFO_RUNNING_MEASUREMENT = BUNDLE.getString("MeasurementInProgressPanel.lblMeasRunning.text");
  
  private static final String INFO_ERROR_MEASUREMENT = BUNDLE.getString("MeasurementInProgressPanel.lblMeasError.text");
  
  private static final String INFO_RUNNING_DISCHARGE = BUNDLE.getString("MeasurementInProgressPanel.lblMeasRunning.dischargeRunning.text");
  
  private static final String INFO_ERROR_DISCHARGE = BUNDLE.getString("MeasurementInProgressPanel.lblMeasError.dischargeError.text");
  
  private static final String INFO_DO_NOT_DISCONNECT_MEASUREMENT = BUNDLE.getString("BCT.doNotDisconnectDuringMeassurement");
  
  private static final String INFO_DO_NOT_DISCONNECT_DISCHARGE = BUNDLE.getString("BCT.doNotDisconnectDuringDischarge");
  
  private static final String REMAINING_TIME_MEASUREMENT = BUNDLE.getString("StopMeasurementButtonPanel.lblRemainingTime.text");
  
  private static final String REMAINING_TIME_DISCHARGE = BUNDLE.getString("StopMeasurementButtonPanel.lblRemainingTime.dischargeTime.text");
  
  private static final String STOP_TEXT_MEASUREMENT = BUNDLE.getString("StopMeasurementButtonPanel.stopMeasurement.text");
  
  private static final String STOP_TEXT_DISCHARGE = BUNDLE.getString("StopMeasurementButtonPanel.stopMeasurement.stopDischarge.text");
  
  private static final String TOOLTIP_STOP_TEXT_MEASUREMENT = BUNDLE.getString("StopMeasurementButtonPanel.stopMeasurement.tooltip");
  
  private static final String TOOLTIP_STOP_TEXT_DISCHARGE = BUNDLE.getString("StopMeasurementButtonPanel.stopMeasurement.stopDischarge.tooltip");
  
  private static final String TITLE_MAIN_FRAME_MEASUREMENT = BUNDLE.getString("CapacityTestTab.lblTabTitle.text");
  
  private static final String TITLE_MAIN_FRAME_DISCHARGE = BUNDLE.getString("CapacityTestTab.lblTabTitle.discharge.text");
  
  private static final String DIALOG_MEASUREMENT_TITLE = BUNDLE.getString("BCT.stopMeasurement.confirmationDialog.title");
  
  private static final String DIALOG_MEASUREMENT_TEXT = BUNDLE.getString("BCT.stopMeasurement.confirmationDialog.text");
  
  private static final String DIALOG_DISCHARGE_TITLE = BUNDLE.getString("BCT.stopDischarge.confirmationDialog.title");
  
  private static final String DIALOG_DISCHARGE_TEXT = BUNDLE.getString("BCT.stopDischarge.confirmationDialog.text");
  
  private static final String ICON_INFO = "/com/gigatronik/beds/gui/panels/bct/ic_info_33.png";
  
  private static final String ICON_WARN = "/com/gigatronik/beds/gui/panels/bct/ic_warning_33.png";
  
  private final CommunicationManager communicationManager;
  
  private final BctEventHandler bctEventHandler;
  
  private final MeasurementInProgressPanel pnlMeasurementInProgress;
  
  private BctState bctState = BctState.NOT_CONNECTED;
  
  private final Executor executor = Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor(new BasicThreadFactory.Builder().namingPattern("EventPublisher-%d").build());
  
  private final List<BctErrorEventListener> bctErrorCallbacks = new ArrayList<>();
  
  public MeasurementInProgressController(MeasurementInProgressPanel panel, EBikeApplication eBikeApp) {
    this.pnlMeasurementInProgress = panel;
    this.communicationManager = eBikeApp.getCommunicationManager();
    this.bctEventHandler = eBikeApp.getBctEventHandler();
    this.pnlMeasurementInProgress.setInfoIcon("/com/gigatronik/beds/gui/panels/bct/ic_info_33.png");
    this.pnlMeasurementInProgress.setInfoText("Info");
    this.pnlMeasurementInProgress.getStopMeasurementButtonPanel().addActionListener(e -> onStopButtonClicked());
    init();
  }
  
  private void init() {
    this.bctEventHandler.subscribeBctMeasurementProgressChanges(this);
    this.bctEventHandler.subscribeBctOperationStateChanges(this);
  }
  
  public void onStopButtonClicked() {
    String[] objButtons = { BUNDLE.getString("JOptionPane.Ok"), BUNDLE.getString("JOptionPane.Cancel") };
    switch (this.bctState) {
      case TEST_RUNNING:
        if (TestableJOptionPane.showOptionDialog((Component)this.pnlMeasurementInProgress, DIALOG_MEASUREMENT_TEXT, DIALOG_MEASUREMENT_TITLE, -1, 3, null, objButtons, objButtons[1]) == 0) {
          this.pnlMeasurementInProgress.getParent().setCursor(Cursor.getPredefinedCursor(3));
          stopMeasurement();
        } 
        break;
      case DISCHARGE_RUNNING:
        if (TestableJOptionPane.showOptionDialog((Component)this.pnlMeasurementInProgress, DIALOG_DISCHARGE_TEXT, DIALOG_DISCHARGE_TITLE, -1, 3, null, objButtons, objButtons[1]) == 0) {
          this.pnlMeasurementInProgress.getParent().setCursor(Cursor.getPredefinedCursor(3));
          stopDischarge();
        } 
        break;
    } 
  }
  
  private void stopMeasurement() {
    if (this.communicationManager.getBctCom().stopMeasurement() == BctResponse.REJECTED)
      publishEvent(new BctErrorEvent()
          .setTextKey("MeasurementInProgressPanel.stopped.error.text")
          .setTitleKey("MeasurementInProgressPanel.stopped.error.title")); 
  }
  
  private void stopDischarge() {
    if (this.communicationManager.getBctCom().stopDischarge() == BctResponse.REJECTED)
      publishEvent(new BctErrorEvent()
          .setTextKey("MeasurementInProgressPanel.stopped.discharge.error.text")
          .setTitleKey("MeasurementInProgressPanel.stopped.discharge.error.title")
          .setDischargeMode(true)); 
  }
  
  public void onBctMeasurementProgress(BctMeasurementProgressEvent event) {
    BctTestProgress testProgress = event.getMeasurementProgress();
    if (testProgress != null) {
      int minutes = testProgress.getRemainingMinutes();
      this.pnlMeasurementInProgress.setRemainingTime(String.format("%s %02dh %02dm", this.remainingTimeLabel, minutes / 60, minutes % 60));
    } 
  }
  
  public void onBctOperationStateChanged(BctOperationStateChangeEvent event) {
    LOGGER.debug("Received BctOperationStateChangeEvent: '{}'", event);
    this.bctState = event.getOperatingState();
    if (null != this.bctState)
      switch (this.bctState) {
        case TEST_ERROR:
          setLabelTexts(TITLE_MAIN_FRAME_MEASUREMENT, INFO_ERROR_MEASUREMENT, INFO_DO_NOT_DISCONNECT_MEASUREMENT, STOP_TEXT_MEASUREMENT, REMAINING_TIME_MEASUREMENT, "/com/gigatronik/beds/gui/panels/bct/ic_warning_33.png");
          setTooltipTexts(TOOLTIP_STOP_TEXT_MEASUREMENT);
          break;
        case TEST_RUNNING:
          setLabelTexts(TITLE_MAIN_FRAME_MEASUREMENT, INFO_RUNNING_MEASUREMENT, INFO_DO_NOT_DISCONNECT_MEASUREMENT, STOP_TEXT_MEASUREMENT, REMAINING_TIME_MEASUREMENT, "/com/gigatronik/beds/gui/panels/bct/ic_info_33.png");
          setTooltipTexts(TOOLTIP_STOP_TEXT_MEASUREMENT);
          break;
        case DISCHARGE_ERROR:
          setLabelTexts(TITLE_MAIN_FRAME_DISCHARGE, INFO_ERROR_DISCHARGE, INFO_DO_NOT_DISCONNECT_DISCHARGE, STOP_TEXT_DISCHARGE, REMAINING_TIME_DISCHARGE, "/com/gigatronik/beds/gui/panels/bct/ic_warning_33.png");
          setTooltipTexts(TOOLTIP_STOP_TEXT_DISCHARGE);
          break;
        case DISCHARGE_RUNNING:
          setLabelTexts(TITLE_MAIN_FRAME_DISCHARGE, INFO_RUNNING_DISCHARGE, INFO_DO_NOT_DISCONNECT_DISCHARGE, STOP_TEXT_DISCHARGE, REMAINING_TIME_DISCHARGE, "/com/gigatronik/beds/gui/panels/bct/ic_info_33.png");
          setTooltipTexts(TOOLTIP_STOP_TEXT_DISCHARGE);
          break;
      }  
    if (this.communicationManager.getBctCom().getSelectedBattery() == BctBatteryType.VICTOR) {
      this.pnlMeasurementInProgress.setBatteryType(VICTOR_LABEL);
    } else if (this.communicationManager.getBctCom().getSelectedBattery() == BctBatteryType.CLASSIC) {
      this.pnlMeasurementInProgress.setBatteryType(CLASSIC_PLUS_LABEL);
    } 
  }
  
  private void setLabelTexts(String titleFrame, String infoText, String infoText2, String measurementLabelText, String remainingTimeLabel, String iconPath) {
    this.pnlMeasurementInProgress.setMainTitle(titleFrame);
    this.pnlMeasurementInProgress.setInfoText(infoText);
    this.pnlMeasurementInProgress.setInfoText2(infoText2);
    this.pnlMeasurementInProgress.setInfoIcon(iconPath);
    this.pnlMeasurementInProgress.setLabel(measurementLabelText);
    this.remainingTimeLabel = remainingTimeLabel;
  }
  
  private void setTooltipTexts(String tooltipTexts) {
    this.pnlMeasurementInProgress.getStopMeasurementButtonPanel().setToolTipText(tooltipTexts);
  }
  
  public synchronized void addBctErrorListener(BctErrorEventListener listener) {
    if (!this.bctErrorCallbacks.contains(listener))
      this.bctErrorCallbacks.add(listener); 
  }
  
  public synchronized void removeBctErrorListener(BctErrorEventListener listener) {
    this.bctErrorCallbacks.remove(listener);
  }
  
  private synchronized void publishEvent(BctErrorEvent event) {
    this.bctErrorCallbacks.forEach(listener -> this.executor.execute(() -> listener.onBctError(event)));
  }
}

package com.gigatronik.beds.gui.panels.bct.measureinprogress;

    try {
      this.backgroundImage = ImageIO.read(getClass().getClassLoader().getResource("com/gigatronik/beds/gui/panels/bct/measureinprogress/btn-background-normal.png"));

  private void setRoundedInfoText(RoundedInfo infoPanel, String text) {
    infoPanel.setVisible(false);
    if (StringUtils.isNotEmpty(text)) {
      infoPanel.setText(text);
      infoPanel.setVisible(true);
    } 
  }
  
  private void initLabelColors() {
    this.lblBatteryType.setForeground(Color.BLACK);
    this.pnlInfo.getLabel().setForeground(Color.BLACK);
    this.pnlInfoMeasurement.getLabel().setForeground(Color.BLACK);
    this.pnlInfoDischarge.getLabel().setForeground(Color.BLACK);
  }
  
  private void initVisibilityState() {
    this.pnlInfoDischarge.setVisible(false);
    this.pnlInfoMeasurement.setVisible(false);
  }

    return this.btnBatteryTypeSelectionPanel;

  private static final String ICON_INFO = "/com/gigatronik/beds/gui/panels/bct/ic_info_33.png";
  
  private static final String ICON_WARN = "/com/gigatronik/beds/gui/panels/bct/ic_warning_33.png";
  
  private CommunicationManager communicationManager;
  
  private EcuConnectionStateHandler ecuConnectionStateHandler;
  
  private BctEventHandler bctEventHandler;
  
  private ConfigurationManager configurationManager;
  
  private StartMeasurementPanel startMeasurementPanel;
  
  private BctStateViewProvider bctStateViewProvider;
  
  private RightsManager rightsManager;
  
  private EBikeApplication ebikeApplication;
  
  private final AtomicBoolean disableAllBctFeatures = new AtomicBoolean(false);
  
  private final Executor executor = Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor(new BasicThreadFactory.Builder().namingPattern("EventPublisher-%d").build());
  
  private final List<BctErrorEventListener> bctErrorCallbacks = new ArrayList<>();
  
  public StartMeasurementPanelController() {}
  
  public StartMeasurementPanelController(StartMeasurementPanel panel, EBikeApplication ebikeApp, BctStateViewProvider bctStateViewProvider, RightsManager rightsManager) {
    this.startMeasurementPanel = panel;
    this.ebikeApplication = ebikeApp;
    this.communicationManager = ebikeApp.getCommunicationManager();
    this.ecuConnectionStateHandler = ebikeApp.getEcuConnectionStateHandler();
    this.bctEventHandler = ebikeApp.getBctEventHandler();
    this.configurationManager = ebikeApp.getConfigurationManager();
    this.rightsManager = rightsManager;
    this.bctStateViewProvider = bctStateViewProvider;
    init();
  }
  
  private void init() {
    this.bctEventHandler.subscribeBctOperationStateChanges(this);
  }
  
  public void onBctOperationStateChanged(BctOperationStateChangeEvent event) {
    LOGGER.debug("Received BctOperationStateChangeEvent: '{}'", event);
    BctState state = event.getOperatingState();
    if (state == BctState.IDLE_BATTERY_SET) {
      BctBatteryType selectedBattery = this.communicationManager.getBctCom().getSelectedBattery();
      switch (selectedBattery) {
        case CLASSIC:
          setBatteryType(BUNDLE.getString("CapacityTestTab.bctBatteryType.ClassicPlus"));
          setButtonStates();
          break;
        case VICTOR:
          setBatteryType(BUNDLE.getString("CapacityTestTab.bctBatteryType.Victor"));
          setButtonStates();
          break;
        default:
          setBatteryType("NONE");
          this.startMeasurementPanel.enableDischargeButton(false);
          this.startMeasurementPanel.enableMeasurementButton(false);
          break;
      } 
    } 
  }
  
  public void onWarrantyCaseChanged(WarrantyCase warrantyCase) {}
  
  public void onWarrantyConditionsMissing() {
    LOGGER.warn("Warranty conditions are not known, so feature buttons on start measurement screen will be disabled");
    this.startMeasurementPanel.enableDischargeButton(false);
    this.startMeasurementPanel.enableMeasurementButton(false);
    this.disableAllBctFeatures.compareAndSet(false, true);
  }
  
  void startMeasurmentButtonPressed() {
    LOGGER.info("Start measurement button has been pressed!");
    this.startMeasurementPanel.getParent().setCursor(Cursor.getPredefinedCursor(3));
    disableStartButtons();
    startBctOperation(false);
  }
  
  void startDischargeButtonPressed() {
    LOGGER.info("Start discharge button has been pressed!");
    this.startMeasurementPanel.getParent().setCursor(Cursor.getPredefinedCursor(3));
    disableStartButtons();
    startBctOperation(true);
  }
  
  private void disableStartButtons() {
    this.startMeasurementPanel.enableMeasurementButton(false);
    this.startMeasurementPanel.enableDischargeButton(false);
  }
  
  private void startBctOperation(boolean startDischarge) {
    BmsIdentification bmsIdentification = this.configurationManager.getBikeIdentification().getBms1Identification();
    EcuIdentification bctIdentification = this.configurationManager.getBikeIdentification().getBctIdentification();
    Bms bms = this.communicationManager.getBms1Com();
    Bct bct = this.communicationManager.getBctCom();
    if (bms.executeExtendedSessionAndSecurityAccess(this.rightsManager.getUserLevel()).isPositive()) {
      BctResponse startResponse;
      LOGGER.debug("Read diagnostic parameters from BMS");
      BctBatteryData batteryData = this.communicationManager.getBctOperationAssistent().readBatteryData();
      this.ebikeApplication.oBctMeasurementStart();
      if (this.configurationManager.getBikeIdentification().getBms1Identification().getComponentType().isBBP2xx() && !startDischarge)
        try {
          Version bmsSwVer = Version.parse(bmsIdentification.getSwVersion());
          if (MIN_BMS_SW_VER_4_BCT_DATA_RECEIVE.compareTo(bmsSwVer) <= 0) {
            LOGGER.debug("Send BCT parameters to BMS");
            bms.writeBctSerialNumber(bctIdentification.getSerialNumber());
            bms.writeBctSwVersion(bctIdentification.getSwVersion());
            bms.writeBctCurrentDate();
          } else {
            LOGGER.debug("BMS sw version {} is not sufficient to receive BCT data", bmsSwVer);
          } 
        } catch (IOException|NumberFormatException ex) {
          LOGGER.warn("BMS sw version {} could not be parsed, so BCT data will not be send to BMS", bmsIdentification.getSwVersion(), ex);
        }  
      bms.startDefaultSession(false);
      LOGGER.debug("Start measurement");
      if (startDischarge) {
        startResponse = bct.startDischarge(bctIdentification.getSwVersion());
      } else {
        startResponse = bct.startMeasurement(bctIdentification.getSwVersion());
      } 
      if (handleResponse(startResponse, "StartMeasurementPanel.startMeasurement.error.text", startDischarge ? "StartMeasurementPanel.startDischarge.error.title" : "StartMeasurementPanel.startMeasurement.error.title")) {
        LOGGER.debug("Write BMS data to BCT");
        BctResponse writeResponse = this.communicationManager.getBctOperationAssistent().writeBatteryDataToCapacityTester(batteryData);
        handleResponse(writeResponse, "StartMeasurementPanel.writeBatteryData.error.text", "StartMeasurementPanel.writeBatteryData.error.title");
      } 
    } else {
      TestableJOptionPane.showConfirmDialog(this.bctStateViewProvider.getContainer(), BUNDLE.getString("StartMeasurementPanel.bat.communication.error.text"), BUNDLE.getString("StartMeasurementPanel.startMeasurement.error.title"), -1, 0);
    } 
  }
  
  private void setButtonStates() {
    this.communicationManager.getBms1Com().executeExtendedSessionAndSecurityAccess(this.rightsManager.getUserLevel());
    if (!this.disableAllBctFeatures.get())
      try {
        Version bctSwVersion = Version.parse(this.configurationManager.getBikeIdentification().getBctIdentification().getSwVersion());
        Version bmsSwVersion = Version.parse(this.configurationManager.getBikeIdentification().getBms1Identification().getSwVersion());
        boolean bctSwVersionTooOld = (bctSwVersion.compareTo(BCT_SW_VERSION_MEASUREMENT_THRESHOLD) <= 0);
        boolean bmsClassic = this.configurationManager.getBikeIdentification().getBms1Identification().getComponentType().isBBP1xx();
        boolean bmsSwVersionTooOld = (!bmsClassic && bmsSwVersion.compareTo(BMS_SW_VERSION_THRESHOLD) < 0);
        this.startMeasurementPanel.setInfoText(bctSwVersionTooOld ? BUNDLE.getString("Bct.StartMeasurementTab.Update.BCT.Software") : BUNDLE.getString("StartMeasurementPanel.lbInfo.text"));
        this.startMeasurementPanel.setInfoIcon(bctSwVersionTooOld ? "/com/gigatronik/beds/gui/panels/bct/ic_warning_33.png" : "/com/gigatronik/beds/gui/panels/bct/ic_info_33.png");
        validateBtnDischargeStateAndInfoText(bmsSwVersion, bctSwVersionTooOld, bmsSwVersionTooOld);
        validateBtnMeasurementStateAndInfoText(bctSwVersionTooOld, bmsSwVersionTooOld);
      } catch (IOException ex) {
        LOGGER.error("Error parsing software version", (Throwable)ex);
      }  
    this.communicationManager.getBms1Com().startDefaultSession(false);
  }
  
  private void validateBtnDischargeStateAndInfoText(Version bmsSwVersion, boolean bctSwVersionTooOld, boolean bmsSwVersionTooOld) {
    LOGGER.debug("Determine start discharge button state and info text");
    int batteryChargeState = readBatteryChargeState(bmsSwVersion);
    this.startMeasurementPanel.enableDischargeButton((!bctSwVersionTooOld && !bmsSwVersionTooOld && batteryChargeState >= 60));
    setStartDischargeInfoText(batteryChargeState);
  }
  
  private void setStartDischargeInfoText(int batteryChargeState) {
    if (batteryChargeState < 30) {
      this.startMeasurementPanel.setDischargingInfoIcon("/com/gigatronik/beds/gui/panels/bct/ic_info_33.png");
      this.startMeasurementPanel.setDischargingInfoText(BUNDLE.getString("StartMeasurementPanel.lbInfo.Discharge.ChargeBattery.text"));
    } else if (batteryChargeState < 60) {
      this.startMeasurementPanel.setDischargingInfoIcon("/com/gigatronik/beds/gui/panels/bct/ic_info_33.png");
      this.startMeasurementPanel.setDischargingInfoText(BUNDLE.getString("StartMeasurementPanel.lbInfo.Discharge.NoDischarge.text"));
    } else {
      this.startMeasurementPanel.setDischargingInfoText("");
    } 
  }
  
  private int readBatteryChargeState(Version bmsSwVersion) {
    try {
      return Integer.parseInt(this.communicationManager.getBms1Com().readBatteryChargeState(bmsSwVersion).getString());
    } catch (ComplexResponse.DataAccessException|NumberFormatException ex) {
      LOGGER.error("Parsing battery charge state response failed.", (Throwable)ex);
      return 0;
    } 
  }
  
  private void validateBtnMeasurementStateAndInfoText(boolean bctSwVersionTooOld, boolean bmsSwVersionTooOld) {
    LOGGER.debug("Determine start measurement button state and info text");
    boolean hasBatteryMinVoltage = hasBatteryMinimalVoltageOfDischarge();
    this.startMeasurementPanel.enableMeasurementButton((!bctSwVersionTooOld && !bmsSwVersionTooOld && hasBatteryMinVoltage));
    setStartMeasurementInfoText(bmsSwVersionTooOld, hasBatteryMinVoltage);
  }
  
  private void setStartMeasurementInfoText(boolean bmsSwVersionTooOld, boolean hasBatteryMinVoltage) {
    if (bmsSwVersionTooOld) {
      this.startMeasurementPanel.setMeasurementInfoIcon("/com/gigatronik/beds/gui/panels/bct/ic_warning_33.png");
      this.startMeasurementPanel.setMeasurementInfoText(BUNDLE.getString("Bct.StartMeasurementTab.Update.Battery.Software"));
    } else if (!hasBatteryMinVoltage) {
      this.startMeasurementPanel.setMeasurementInfoIcon("/com/gigatronik/beds/gui/panels/bct/ic_info_33.png");
      this.startMeasurementPanel.setMeasurementInfoText(BUNDLE.getString("StartMeasurementPanel.Measurement.Accu"));
    } else {
      this.startMeasurementPanel.setMeasurementInfoText("");
    } 
  }
  
  private boolean hasBatteryMinimalVoltageOfDischarge() {
    try {
      double bmsVoltage = Double.parseDouble(this.communicationManager.getBms1Com().readBatteryVoltage().getString());
      double bctMinimumVoltage = Double.parseDouble(this.communicationManager.getBctCom().readMinimalStartOfDischargeVoltage().getString());
      return (bmsVoltage >= bctMinimumVoltage);
    } catch (ComplexResponse.DataAccessException|NumberFormatException ex) {
      LOGGER.error("Parsing bms voltage or bct discharge start voltage response failed", (Throwable)ex);
      return false;
    } 
  }
  
  private boolean handleResponse(BctResponse bctResponse, String errorTextKey, String errorTitleKey) {
    if (bctResponse == BctResponse.REJECTED) {
      publishEvent(new BctErrorEvent().setTextKey(errorTextKey).setTitleKey(errorTitleKey));
      return false;
    } 
    return true;
  }
  
  void onBatteryTypeSelectionClicked() {
    this.startMeasurementPanel.getBatterySelectionButton().setCursor(Cursor.getPredefinedCursor(3));
    this.startMeasurementPanel.getParent().setCursor(Cursor.getPredefinedCursor(3));
    this.ecuConnectionStateHandler.suspendConnectionStateDetection(true);
    this.communicationManager.getBctCom().selectBattery(BctBatteryType.NONE);
    this.ecuConnectionStateHandler.resumeConnectionStateDetection(false, false);
    this.startMeasurementPanel.getBatterySelectionButton().setCursor(Cursor.getPredefinedCursor(12));
  }
  
  void setBatteryType(String batteryType) {
    this.startMeasurementPanel.setBatteryType(batteryType);
  }
  
  public synchronized void addBctErrorListener(BctErrorEventListener listener) {
    if (!this.bctErrorCallbacks.contains(listener))
      this.bctErrorCallbacks.add(listener); 
  }
  
  private synchronized void publishEvent(BctErrorEvent event) {
    this.bctErrorCallbacks.forEach(listener -> this.executor.execute(() -> listener.onBctError(event)));
  }
}

public class BctErrorEvent {

    return this.titleKey;
  }

    return this;
  }
  
  public String getTextKey() {
    return this.textKey;
  }

    this.textKey = textKey;
    return this;
  }
  
  public BctErrorEvent setDischargeMode(boolean discharge) {

    return this;
  }
  
  public boolean isDischargeMode() {

  }
}

package com.gigatronik.beds.gui.panels.bct.tab.controller;

import com.gigatronik.beds.common.bct.BctError;
import com.gigatronik.beds.common.bct.BctResponse;
import com.gigatronik.beds.common.bct.BctState;
import com.gigatronik.beds.gui.panels.bct.choosebatterytype.ChooseBatteryTypeController;
import com.gigatronik.beds.gui.panels.bct.dischargefinished.DischargeFinishedPanelController;
import com.gigatronik.beds.gui.panels.bct.measurefinished.MeasurementFinishedPanelController;
import com.gigatronik.beds.gui.panels.bct.measurefinished.warranty.WarrantyCase;
import com.gigatronik.beds.gui.panels.bct.measurefinished.warranty.WarrantyCaseChangedListener;

public class BctMeasurementTabController implements BctEventHandler.BctOperationStateListener, BctErrorEventListener, WarrantyCaseChangedListener {
  private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(BctMeasurementTabController.class);
  
  private static final Utf8ResourceBundleFormatted BUNDLE = ResourceBundleFactory.newDefaultResourceBundle();
  
  private static final String BCT_MESSAGE_KEY = "BctMeasurementTabController.bct.read.message";
  
  private static final String BCT_MEASURED_ENERGY_KEY = "BctError.MeasuredEnergy.text";
  
  private static final AtomicBoolean warrantyFileError = new AtomicBoolean(false);
  
  private final EBikeApplication eBikeApplication;
  
  private final CommunicationManager communicationManager;
  
  private final BctEventHandler bctEventHandler;
  
  private final BikeIdentification bikeIdentification;
  
  private final BctMeasurementTabPanel bctMeasurementTab;
  
  private final DischargeFinishedPanelController dischargeFinishedPanelController;
  
  private final MeasurementFinishedPanelController measurementFinishedPanelController;
  
  private final WarrantyPanelController warrantyPanelController;
  
  private BctState lastState;
  
  private ComponentAdapter componentAdapter;
  
  private boolean onDischargeMode;
  
  public BctMeasurementTabController(BctMeasurementTabPanel bctMeasurementTabPanel, EBikeApplication eBikeApp, ChooseBatteryTypeController chooseBatTypeController, RightsManager rightsManager) {
    this.bctMeasurementTab = bctMeasurementTabPanel;
    this.eBikeApplication = eBikeApp;
    this.communicationManager = eBikeApp.getCommunicationManager();
    this.bctEventHandler = eBikeApp.getBctEventHandler();
    this.bikeIdentification = eBikeApp.getConfigurationManager().getBikeIdentification();
    chooseBatTypeController.addBctErrorListener(this);
    this.warrantyPanelController = new WarrantyPanelController(this.eBikeApplication.getDefaultDongleStateListener());
    this.warrantyPanelController.registerWarrantyCaseChangedListener(this);
    this.bctMeasurementTab.getChooseBatteryTypePanel().setController(chooseBatTypeController);
    this.measurementFinishedPanelController = new MeasurementFinishedPanelController(this.bctMeasurementTab.getMeasurementFinishedPanel(), this.eBikeApplication, this.warrantyPanelController, rightsManager);
    this.bctMeasurementTab.getMeasurementFinishedPanel().setController(this.measurementFinishedPanelController);
    this.measurementFinishedPanelController.addBctErrorListener(this);
    this.bctMeasurementTab.getMeasurementFinishedPanel().initCustomComponents();
    StartMeasurementPanelController startMeasurementPanelController = new StartMeasurementPanelController(this.bctMeasurementTab.getStartMeasurementPanel(), this.eBikeApplication, this.bctMeasurementTab, rightsManager);
    this.bctMeasurementTab.getStartMeasurementPanel().setController(startMeasurementPanelController);
    startMeasurementPanelController.addBctErrorListener(this);
    this.warrantyPanelController.registerWarrantyCaseChangedListener(startMeasurementPanelController);
    MeasurementInProgressController measurementInProgressController = new MeasurementInProgressController(this.bctMeasurementTab.getMeasurementInProgressPanel(), this.eBikeApplication);
    this.bctMeasurementTab.getMeasurementInProgressPanel().setController(measurementInProgressController);
    measurementInProgressController.addBctErrorListener(this);
    this.dischargeFinishedPanelController = new DischargeFinishedPanelController(this.bctMeasurementTab.getDischargeFinishedPanel(), this.eBikeApplication);
    this.bctEventHandler.subscribeBctOperationStateChanges(this);
  }
  
  public void onBctOperationStateChanged(BctOperationStateChangeEvent event) {
    LOGGER.debug("Received BctOperationStateChangeEvent: '{}'", event);
    BctState state = event.getOperatingState();
    if (state == BctState.DISCHARGE_FINISHED)
      this.dischargeFinishedPanelController.detectSelectedBatteryType(); 
    BctStatePanel panelByState = BctStatePanel.getPanelNameByState(state);
    LOGGER.info("Bct State is {}, navigating to {}", state, panelByState);
    EventQueue.invokeLater(() -> {
          if (panelByState != BctStatePanel.MEASUREMENT_ERROR && panelByState != BctStatePanel.DISCHARGE_ERROR) {
            this.bctMeasurementTab.navigateTo(panelByState.getPanelname());
          } else {
            BctError bctError = this.communicationManager.getBctCom().getLastError();
            showError(this.lastState);
            if (panelByState == BctStatePanel.MEASUREMENT_ERROR && bctError.isMeasurementError())
              this.bctMeasurementTab.navigateTo(BctStatePanel.MEASUREMENT_FINISHED.getPanelname()); 
          } 
          this.lastState = state;
          this.bctMeasurementTab.setCursor(Cursor.getDefaultCursor());
          this.measurementFinishedPanelController.onBctOperationStateChanged(event);
          this.bctMeasurementTab.getChooseBatteryTypePanel().onBctOperationStateChanged(event);
        });
  }
  
  public void onWarrantyCaseChanged(WarrantyCase warrantyCase) {}
  
  public void onWarrantyConditionsMissing() {
    LOGGER.warn("Warranty conditions are not known!");
    warrantyFileError.compareAndSet(false, true);
    this.measurementFinishedPanelController.disableSaveReportFeatureAndCloseDialog();
    updateDisplayedPanelUponWarrantyConditionsMissing();
    handleDisplayingWarningPopupUponWarrantyConditionsMissing();
  }
  
  private void handleDisplayingWarningPopupUponWarrantyConditionsMissing() {
    if (this.bctMeasurementTab.isShowing()) {
      LOGGER.debug("Show tool reinstallation pop up, because of missing warranty conditions");
      TestableJOptionPane.showMessageDialog(BUNDLE.getString("StartMeasurementPanel.Warranty.Error.text"), BUNDLE.getString("StartMeasurementPanel.Warranty.Error.title"), 1);
    } else {
      this.componentAdapter = new ComponentAdapter() {
          public void componentShown(ComponentEvent e) {
            super.componentShown(e);
            BctMeasurementTabController.LOGGER.debug("Show tool reinstallation pop up, because of missing warranty conditions");
            TestableJOptionPane.showMessageDialog(BctMeasurementTabController.BUNDLE.getString("StartMeasurementPanel.Warranty.Error.text"), BctMeasurementTabController.BUNDLE.getString("StartMeasurementPanel.Warranty.Error.title"), 1);
            BctMeasurementTabController.this.bctMeasurementTab.removeComponentListener(BctMeasurementTabController.this.componentAdapter);
          }
        };
      LOGGER.debug("Remark tool reinstallation pop up to be shown later on change to measurement tab");
      this.bctMeasurementTab.addComponentListener(this.componentAdapter);
    } 
  }
  
  private void updateDisplayedPanelUponWarrantyConditionsMissing() {
    if (this.lastState != BctStatePanel.START_MEASUREMENT_PANEL.getState()) {
      if (this.lastState == BctStatePanel.MEASUREMENT_RUNNING.getState()) {
        BctResponse response = this.communicationManager.getBctCom().stopMeasurement();
        LOGGER.debug("Measurement stopped: '{}'", response);
      } 
      if (this.lastState == BctStatePanel.DISCHARGE_RUNNING_PANEL.getState()) {
        BctResponse response = this.communicationManager.getBctCom().stopDischarge();
        LOGGER.debug("Measurement stopped: '{}'", response);
      } 
      this.bctMeasurementTab.navigateTo(BctStatePanel.START_MEASUREMENT_PANEL.getPanelname());
      this.lastState = BctStatePanel.START_MEASUREMENT_PANEL.getState();
    } 
  }
  
  public void onBctError(BctErrorEvent event) {
    BctError bctError = this.communicationManager.getBctCom().getLastError();
    if (bctError != BctError.UNKNOWN) {
      String errorText;
      switch (bctError) {
        case EMON_MEASUREMENT_CANCELED_BY_TESTER:
          errorText = bctError.getText(event.isDischargeMode());
          break;
        case EMON_NO_FAULT:
          errorText = BUNDLE.getString(event.getTextKey());
          break;
        case EMON_LOST_CAN_COMMUNICATION:
          errorText = handleLostCanCommunicationError(event, bctError);
          break;
        default:
          errorText = BUNDLE.getString(event.getTextKey()) + BUNDLE.getString(event.getTextKey()) + System.lineSeparator() + " " + BUNDLE.getString("BctMeasurementTabController.bct.read.message");
          break;
      } 
      OptionPaneWithLineBreak optionPane = new OptionPaneWithLineBreak();
      optionPane.showConfirmDialogWithLineBreak(this.bctMeasurementTab.getRootPane(), errorText, 
          BUNDLE.getString(event.getTitleKey()), -1, 0);
    } 
    if (!bctError.isMeasurementError() || event.isDischargeMode())
      this.communicationManager.getBctCom().confirmMeasurementError(); 
    this.bctMeasurementTab.setCursor(Cursor.getDefaultCursor());
    this.bctMeasurementTab.getChooseBatteryTypePanel().onBctError(event);
  }
  
  private String handleLostCanCommunicationError(BctErrorEvent event, BctError bctError) {
    String errorText;
    if (this.onDischargeMode) {
      errorText = bctError.getText();
    } else {
      String emonLostCanBatteryEnergy = "";
      try {
        emonLostCanBatteryEnergy = " " + this.communicationManager.getBctCom().readMeasuredBatteryEnergy().getString();
      } catch (ComplexResponse.DataAccessException ex) {
        LOGGER.error("Parsing measured energy response failed", (Throwable)ex);
      } 
      errorText = BUNDLE.getString(event.getTextKey()) + BUNDLE.getString(event.getTextKey()) + System.lineSeparator() + " " + BUNDLE.getString("BctMeasurementTabController.bct.read.message") + "\n" + bctError.getText() + BUNDLE.getString("BctError.MeasuredEnergy.text");
    } 
    return errorText;
  }
  
  private void showError(BctState lastState) {
    String bctSwVer = this.bikeIdentification.getBctIdentification().getSwVersion();
    this.onDischargeMode = StringUtils.equals(this.communicationManager.getBctCom().readOperatingMode(bctSwVer).toString(), "DISCHARGE_FOR_STOCKING");
    BctErrorEvent errorEvent = new BctErrorEvent();
    errorEvent.setDischargeMode(this.onDischargeMode);
    if (lastState == BctState.IDLE_BATTERY_SET) {
      errorEvent.setTitleKey(this.onDischargeMode ? "StartMeasurementPanel.startDischarge.error.title" : "StartMeasurementPanel.startMeasurement.error.title");
      errorEvent.setTextKey(this.onDischargeMode ? "StartMeasurementPanel.startDischarge.error.text" : "StartMeasurementPanel.startMeasurement.error.text");
    } else {
      errorEvent.setTitleKey(this.onDischargeMode ? "CapacityTestTab.dischargeError.title" : "CapacityTestTab.measurementError.title");
      errorEvent.setTextKey(this.onDischargeMode ? "CapacityTestTab.dischargeError.text" : "CapacityTestTab.measurementError.text");
    } 
    onBctError(errorEvent);
  }
  
  public DischargeFinishedPanelController getDischargeFinishedPanelController() {
    return this.dischargeFinishedPanelController;
  }
  
  private enum BctStatePanel {
    CHOOSE_BATTERY_PANEL("chooseBatteryTypePanel", BctState.IDLE),
    START_MEASUREMENT_PANEL("startMeasurementPanel", BctState.IDLE_BATTERY_SET),
    MEASUREMENT_RUNNING("measurementInProgressPanel", BctState.TEST_RUNNING),
    MEASUREMENT_FINISHED("measurementFinishedPanel", BctState.TEST_FINISHED),
    MEASUREMENT_ERROR("errorPanel", BctState.TEST_ERROR),
    DISCHARGE_RUNNING_PANEL("measurementInProgressPanel", BctState.DISCHARGE_RUNNING),
    DISCHARGE_FINISHED("dischargeFinishedPanel", BctState.DISCHARGE_FINISHED),
    DISCHARGE_ERROR("errorPanel", BctState.DISCHARGE_ERROR);
    
    private final String panelname;
    
    private final BctState state;
    
    BctStatePanel(String panelname, BctState state) {
      this.panelname = panelname;
      this.state = state;
    }
    
    public static BctStatePanel getPanelNameByState(BctState state) {
      Optional<BctStatePanel> first = Arrays.<BctStatePanel>asList(values()).stream().filter(e -> (e.getState() == state)).findFirst();
      BctStatePanel panel = first.isPresent() ? first.get() : CHOOSE_BATTERY_PANEL;
      if (BctMeasurementTabController.warrantyFileError.get())
        return determineNextBctStatePanelOnWarrantyFileError(panel); 
      return panel;
    }
    
    private static BctStatePanel determineNextBctStatePanelOnWarrantyFileError(BctStatePanel panelAccordingToHardwareState) {
      if (panelAccordingToHardwareState == CHOOSE_BATTERY_PANEL || panelAccordingToHardwareState == START_MEASUREMENT_PANEL)
        return panelAccordingToHardwareState; 
      return START_MEASUREMENT_PANEL;
    }
    
    private BctState getState() {
      return this.state;
    }
    
    private String getPanelname() {
      return this.panelname;
    }
  }
}

  private boolean enabled;
  
  private boolean duConnected;
  
  private DiagnosticTabSubtabChangeEvent.SELECTED_COMPONENT selectedComponent;
  
  private boolean notClassicPlus;
  
  private boolean bctConnected;
  
  private boolean hmiConnected;
  
  private boolean bctIdle;
  
  private boolean bctFbl;
  
  private final transient CommunicationManager comMgr;
  
  private boolean disablerFunctionEnabled = false;
  
  private final transient BikeIdentification bikeIdentification;
  
  public DiagnosticTabButtonStateController(CommunicationManager comMgr, RightsManager rightsMan, BikeIdentification bikeIdentification, EbikeDisablerPopupController eBikeDisablerPopupController, ConfigurationManager configurationManager) {
    this.bikeIdentification = bikeIdentification;
    this.rightsManager = rightsMan;
    this.comMgr = comMgr;
    this.eBikeDisablerPopupController = eBikeDisablerPopupController;
    this.guiManager = GuiManagerImpl.getInstance();
    ApplicationProcessManager.getInstance().addListener(this);
    configurationManager.addListener((OrderableListener)this);
  }
  
  public void addListener(BtnStateListener listener) {
    setListener(listener);
  }
  
  private void fireStateChanged() {
    if (this.listener != null)
      this.listener.buttonStateChanged(this); 
  }
  
  public void onHardwareConnectionChanged(HardwareConnectionChangedEvent event) {
    LOGGER.debug("HardwareConnectionChangedEvent received: '{}'", event);
    switch (event.getAction()) {
      case ECU_CONNECTED:
        onEcuConnect(event);
        break;
      case ECU_DISCONNECTED:
        onEcuDisconnect(event);
        break;
      case SYSTEM_CONNECTED:
      case SYSTEM_RECONNECTED:
        this.enabled = (!this.disabled && (this.hmiConnected || this.bctConnected || this.bctFbl));
        break;
    } 
    this.diagnosticServiceRunning = ApplicationProcessManager.getInstance().isReadingServiceDataActive();
    if (this.hmiConnected || this.bctConnected || this.bctFbl)
      validateButtonVisibilityStates(); 
    validateButtonEnabledStates();
  }
  
  private void onEcuConnect(HardwareConnectionChangedEvent event) {
    switch (event.getComponent()) {
      case BUI21X:
      case BUI25X:
      case BUI270:
      case BUI275:
      case BUI330:
      case BUI350:
      case COBI:
        this.hmiConnected = true;
        break;
      case CLASSIC_DU:
        this.duConnected = true;
        this.notClassicPlus = false;
        break;
      case VICTOR_DU:
        this.duConnected = true;
        this.notClassicPlus = true;
        readDisablerFunctionState();
        break;
      case BCT:
        this.bctConnected = true;
        this.bctFbl = false;
        break;
    } 
    fireStateChanged();
  }
  
  private void onEcuDisconnect(HardwareConnectionChangedEvent event) {
    switch (event.getComponent()) {
      case BUI21X:
      case BUI25X:
      case BUI270:
      case BUI275:
      case BUI330:
      case BUI350:
      case COBI:
        this.hmiConnected = false;
        break;
      case CLASSIC_DU:
      case VICTOR_DU:
        this.duConnected = false;
        this.notClassicPlus = true;
        this.disablerFunctionEnabled = false;
        break;
      case BCT:
        this.bctConnected = false;
        this.bctFbl = false;
        break;
    } 
    fireStateChanged();
    this.enabled = (!this.disabled && (this.hmiConnected || this.bctConnected || this.bctFbl));
  }
  
  public void onBctStateChange(BctOperationStateChangeEvent event) {
    BctState state = event.getOperatingState();
    switch (state) {
      case CONNECTED_FBL:
        this.bctConnected = false;
        this.bctIdle = false;
        this.bctFbl = true;
        break;
      case TEST_RUNNING:
      case DISCHARGE_RUNNING:
      case TEST_FINISHED:
      case DISCHARGE_FINISHED:
      case TEST_ERROR:
      case DISCHARGE_ERROR:
        this.bctConnected = true;
        this.bctIdle = false;
        this.bctFbl = false;
        break;
      case IDLE:
      case IDLE_BATTERY_SET:
        this.bctIdle = true;
        this.bctConnected = true;
        this.bctFbl = false;
        break;
      default:
        this.bctConnected = false;
        this.bctIdle = false;
        this.bctFbl = false;
        break;
    } 
    this.enabled = (!this.disabled && (this.bctConnected || this.bctFbl));
    validateButtonVisibilityStates();
    validateButtonEnabledStates();
  }
  
  public void onDiagnosticTabButtonStateChanged(DiagnosticTabSubtabChangeEvent event) {
    LOGGER.debug("{}", event);
    addListener(event.getListener());
    this.disabled = event.isDisabled();
    this.enabled = (!this.disabled && (this.hmiConnected || this.bctConnected || this.bctFbl));
    this.selectedComponent = event.getSelectedComponent();
    this.notClassicPlus = event.isNotClassicPlus();
    validateButtonVisibilityStates();
    validateButtonEnabledStates();
  }
  
  private boolean validateCustomerReportVisibleConditions() {
    return (!this.bikeIdentification.isBctConnected() || (
      this.bikeIdentification.isBms1Connected() && this.selectedComponent == DiagnosticTabSubtabChangeEvent.SELECTED_COMPONENT.PN_BMS));
  }
  
  public void validateButtonVisibilityStates() {
    boolean oem = this.rightsManager.isUserInLevel(UserLevel.OEM);
    setOemReportVisible(oem);
    setOemCustomerReportVisible((oem && validateCustomerReportVisibleConditions()));
    setIbdReportVisible(!oem);
    setIbdCustomerReportVisible((!oem && validateCustomerReportVisibleConditions()));
    setEbikeDisablerVisible((this.guiManager.isGuiInMode(GuiManager.GuiMode.EBIKE) && this.selectedComponent == DiagnosticTabSubtabChangeEvent.SELECTED_COMPONENT.SPANE_DU));
    setClearStatisticsVisible((this.selectedComponent == DiagnosticTabSubtabChangeEvent.SELECTED_COMPONENT.SPANE_DU && this.notClassicPlus && this.guiManager.isGuiInMode(GuiManager.GuiMode.EBIKE)));
    setResetSensortestVisible((this.selectedComponent == DiagnosticTabSubtabChangeEvent.SELECTED_COMPONENT.PN_ABS));
    fireStateChanged();
  }
  
  private void validateButtonEnabledStates() {
    setLoadConfigEnabled(determineLoadConfigEnabledState());
    setClearCodeEnabled(determineLoadConfigEnabledState());
    setClearStatisticsEnabled((this.duConnected && this.enabled && !this.diagnosticServiceRunning));
    setEbikeDisablerEnabled((this.enabled && !this.diagnosticServiceRunning && determineEbikeDisablerEnabledState()));
    validateReportButtonsEnabledStates();
    setResetSensortestEnabled((this.bikeIdentification.isAbsConnected() && this.bikeIdentification.getAbsIdentification().isApplication() && !this.diagnosticServiceRunning));
    validateBatteryDeactivationButtonEnabledStates();
    fireStateChanged();
  }
  
  private void validateBatteryDeactivationButtonEnabledStates() {
    if (this.bctConnected) {
      setDisableBatteryEnabled((this.bctIdle && determineDisableBatteryEnabledState()));
    } else {
      setDisableBatteryEnabled(determineDisableBatteryEnabledState());
    } 
  }
  
  private void validateReportButtonsEnabledStates() {
    boolean oem = this.rightsManager.isUserInLevel(UserLevel.OEM);
    if (this.bctConnected) {
      setIbdReportEnabled((!oem && this.bctIdle));
      setIbdCustomerReportEnabled((!oem && this.bctIdle));
      setOemReportEnabled((oem && this.bctIdle));
      setOemCustomerReportEnabled((oem && this.bctIdle));
    } else {
      setIbdReportEnabled((this.enabled && !this.diagnosticServiceRunning && !oem));
      setIbdCustomerReportEnabled((this.enabled && !this.diagnosticServiceRunning && !oem));
      setOemReportEnabled((this.enabled && !this.diagnosticServiceRunning && oem));
      setOemCustomerReportEnabled((this.enabled && !this.diagnosticServiceRunning && oem));
    } 
  }
  
  private void setDisableBatteryEnabled(boolean enabled) {
    this.disableBatteryEnabled = enabled;
  }
  
  private boolean determineLoadConfigEnabledState() {
    if (!this.bctConnected)
      return (this.enabled && !this.diagnosticServiceRunning); 
    return this.bctIdle;
  }
  
  private boolean determineEbikeDisablerEnabledState() {
    return (this.eBikeDisablerPopupController.isDuDisablerCandidate() && this.disablerFunctionEnabled);
  }
  
  private boolean determineDisableBatteryEnabledState() {
    boolean btnEnabled = false;
    boolean classicPlus = this.bikeIdentification.getBms1Identification().getComponentType().isBBP1xx();
    if (!classicPlus && !this.bikeIdentification.isBms2Connected() && !this.diagnosticServiceRunning)
      try {
        String swVersion = this.bikeIdentification.getBms1Identification().getSwVersion();
        if (StringUtils.isNotBlank(swVersion))
          btnEnabled = (Version.parse(swVersion).compareTo(BMS_SW_VERSION_THRESHOLD) > 0); 
      } catch (IOException ex) {
        LOGGER.error("Failed to parse sw version", (Throwable)ex);
      }  
    return btnEnabled;
  }

package com.gigatronik.beds.gui.panels.diagnostictab.controller;

import com.gigatronik.beds.gui.utilities.BtnStateListener;
import org.apache.commons.lang3.builder.ToStringBuilder;
import org.apache.commons.lang3.builder.ToStringStyle;

public class DiagnosticTabSubtabChangeEvent {
  private BtnStateListener listener;
  
  private boolean disabled;
  
  private boolean oem;
  
  private boolean notClassicPlus;
  
  private SELECTED_COMPONENT selectedComponent;
  
  private boolean batteryTab;
  
  public boolean isNotClassicPlus() {
    return this.notClassicPlus;
  }
  
  public DiagnosticTabSubtabChangeEvent setNotClassicPlus(boolean notClassicPlus) {
    this.notClassicPlus = notClassicPlus;
    return this;
  }
  
  public SELECTED_COMPONENT getSelectedComponent() {
    return this.selectedComponent;
  }
  
  public DiagnosticTabSubtabChangeEvent setSelectedComponent(SELECTED_COMPONENT selectedComponent) {
    this.selectedComponent = selectedComponent;
    return this;
  }
  
  public boolean isDisabled() {
    return this.disabled;
  }
  
  public DiagnosticTabSubtabChangeEvent setDisabled(boolean disabled) {
    this.disabled = disabled;
    return this;
  }
  
  public BtnStateListener getListener() {
    return this.listener;
  }
  
  public void setListener(BtnStateListener listener) {
    this.listener = listener;
  }
  
  public String toString() {
    return new ToStringBuilder(this, ToStringStyle.SHORT_PREFIX_STYLE)
      .append("disabled", this.disabled)
      .append("oem", this.oem)
      .append("notClassicPlus", this.notClassicPlus)
      .append("selectedComponent", this.selectedComponent)
      .toString();
  }
  
  public boolean isBatteryTab() {
    return this.batteryTab;
  }
  
  public DiagnosticTabSubtabChangeEvent setBatteryTab(boolean batteryTab) {
    this.batteryTab = batteryTab;
    return this;
  }
  
  public enum SELECTED_COMPONENT {
    PN_GEAR_BOX, SPANE_DU, PN_ABS, PN_BMS;
  }
}

package com.gigatronik.beds.gui.panels.diagnostictab.controller.pdfreport;

  public PdfServiceReportController(DiagnosticTab diagnosticTab, RightsManager rightsManager, EBikeApplication eBikeApplication, TestableJTabbedPane diagnosticTabbedPane, GuiManager guiManager, ServiceParameterDatapool serviceParameterDatapool) {

  }
  
  public void warmUpReportGenerator() {
    this.boschAllInOneDiagnosticTabExecutor.execute(ReportFactory::init);

  public void generateReportWithDialog(final ReportType reportType) {
    final ReportData<File> reportFile = ReportFactory.builder().data();
    final FutureHolder reportTaskFuture = new FutureHolder();
    SwingWorker<Void, Void> worker = new SwingWorker<>() {
        protected Void doInBackground() {
          PdfServiceReportController.LOGGER.trace("generateReportWithDialog({}) - doInBackground()", reportType);
          PdfServiceReportController.this.generateReport(reportType, reportFile, reportTaskFuture);
          return null;
        }
        
        protected void done() {
          PdfServiceReportController.LOGGER.trace("generateReportWithDialog({}) - done", reportType);
          PdfServiceReportController.this.closeReportProgressDialog();
        }
      };
    LOGGER.trace("generateReportWithDialog({}) - start report build", reportType);
    worker.execute();
    boolean isReportDataOk = true;
    if (!this.delegatorCommon.checkDataForReport())
      isReportDataOk = false; 
    String defaultReportFileName = this.delegatorCommon.getServiceReportName(this.bikeIdentification.getBikeId(), reportType, this.rightsManager.isUserInLevel(UserLevel.IBD));
    if (isReportDataOk && this.delegatorCommon.showReportFileChooseDialog(reportFile, defaultReportFileName)) {
      LOGGER.trace("generateReportWithDialog({}) - FileChooseDialog canceled", reportType);
      showReportProgressDialog();
      return;
    } 
    LOGGER.trace("generateReportWithDialog({}) - FileChooseDialog completed", reportType);
    worker.cancel(true);
    reportTaskFuture.cancel();
  }
  
  private void generateReport(ReportType reportType, ReportData<File> file, Consumer<Future> reportTaskFutureConsumer) {
    Stopwatch watch = new Stopwatch();
    watch.start();
    LOGGER.info("generateReport(): Button click to save report for {}, {}", this.rightsManager.getUserLevel(), reportType.getTypeName());
    File tmpReport = null;
    try {
      tmpReport = File.createTempFile("tmpReport_", ".data");
      int connectedComponentsCountBeforeExecution = this.bikeIdentification.getAllConnectedComponentTypes().size();
      switch (reportType) {
        case CUSTOMER:
        case CUSTOMER_BMS_ONLY:
          createPdfReport(reportType, tmpReport, reportTaskFutureConsumer);
          break;
        case DEALER_SERVICE:
        case SERVICE:
          createDiagnosticReport(reportType, tmpReport, reportTaskFutureConsumer);
          break;
      } 
      int connectedComponentsCountAfterExecution = this.bikeIdentification.getAllConnectedComponentTypes().size();
      watch.stop();
      LOGGER.trace("PDF Report from Button press to select a destination took {}ms", Long.valueOf(watch.getMillisecondsElapsed()));
      if (connectedComponentsCountBeforeExecution == connectedComponentsCountAfterExecution) {
        if (file.getValue() != null) {
          FileUtils.moveFile(tmpReport, (File)file.getValue());
          this.eBikeApplication.showStatusInfo(BUNDLE.getString("EBikeStatus.SAVE_REPORT") + ": " + BUNDLE.getString("EBikeStatus.SAVE_REPORT"));
        } 
      } else {
        String message = BUNDLE.getString("EBikeReport.generatingProblem") + "\n" + BUNDLE.getString("EBikeReport.generatingProblem");
        TestableJOptionPane.showMessageDialog(message, BUNDLE.getString("EBikeReport.incompleteData.title"), 2);
      } 
    } catch (Exception e) {
      LOGGER.error("Failed to create a report of type {}", reportType, e);
      this.eBikeApplication.showStatusError(BUNDLE.getString("EBikeStatus.SAVE_REPORT_ERROR"));
    } finally {
      file.getValue();
      FileUtils.deleteQuietly(tmpReport);
    } 
  }
  
  private void showReportProgressDialog() {
    if (this.reportProgressDlg == null) {
      LOGGER.debug("Open service report progress dialog");
      this.reportProgressDlg = new ReportProgressDialog();
      this.reportProgressDlg.showReportProgressDialog(BUNDLE.getString("EBikeServiceTab.report.progressDialog"));
    } 
  }
  
  private void closeReportProgressDialog() {
    if (this.reportProgressDlg != null) {
      LOGGER.debug("Close service report progress dialog");
      this.reportProgressDlg.closeReportProgressDialog();
      this.reportProgressDlg = null;
    } 
  }
  
  private void readServiceDataFromDevice(ServiceReportGeneratorData data, ReportType reportType) {
    Stopwatch watch1 = new Stopwatch();
    watch1.start();
    this.delegatorData.setUpReportDto(data, reportType, this.rightsManager.getUserLevel());
    watch1.stop();
    LOGGER.trace("Read data: setUpReportDto {} ms", Long.valueOf(watch1.getMillisecondsElapsed()));
  }
  
  private void createPdfReport(ReportType reportType, File file, Consumer<Future> reportTaskFutureConsumer) {
    PdfReportGenerator pdfGenerator;
    LOGGER.trace("createPdfReport({}, {})", reportType, file);
    ServiceReportGeneratorDataImpl serviceReportGeneratorDataImpl = new ServiceReportGeneratorDataImpl();
    if (reportType == ReportType.CUSTOMER_BMS_ONLY) {
      pdfGenerator = createPdfReportGeneratorBatteryOnly(reportType);
    } else {
      pdfGenerator = createPdfReportGeneratorBike(reportType);
    } 
    LOGGER.trace("createPdfReport({}, {}) - generateAndSave", reportType, file);
    Future future = pdfGenerator.generateAndSave((ReportGeneratorData)serviceReportGeneratorDataImpl, file);
    reportTaskFutureConsumer.accept(future);
    LOGGER.trace("createPdfReport({}, {}) - read required data", reportType, file);
    readServiceDataFromDevice((ServiceReportGeneratorData)serviceReportGeneratorDataImpl, reportType);
    LOGGER.trace("createPdfReport({}, {}) - wait for complete", reportType, file);
    pdfGenerator.waitForComplete();
  }
  
  private PdfReportGenerator createPdfReportGeneratorBike(ReportType reportType) {
    PdfReportGenerator pdfGenerator = ReportFactory.builder().pdfReportGenerator();
    ((PdfReportGenerator)pdfGenerator.createDocument(reportType))
      .writeGeneralTable()
      .writeEBikeTable()
      .writeComponentTable()
      .writeErrorTable()
      .writeSettingsTable()
      .writeStatisticsTable();
    if (this.bikeIdentification.isAbsConnected())
      pdfGenerator.writeAbsStatisticTable(); 
    pdfGenerator.writeEnergyUsedTable()
      .writeUdamChartTable()
      .writeServiceProtocolList();
    if (!this.bikeIdentification.getSystemType().equals(Constants.SystemType.CLASSIC_PLUS))
      pdfGenerator.writeServiceIntervalTable(); 
    pdfGenerator.writeServiceTable();
    return pdfGenerator;
  }
  
  private PdfReportGenerator createPdfReportGeneratorBatteryOnly(ReportType reportType) {
    PdfReportGenerator pdfGenerator = ReportFactory.builder().pdfReportGenerator();
    ((PdfReportGenerator)pdfGenerator.createDocument(reportType))
      .writeGeneralTable()
      .writeComponentTable()
      .writeErrorTable()
      .writeStatisticsTable()
      .writeServiceProtocolList()
      .writeServiceTable();
    return pdfGenerator;
  }
  
  private void createDiagnosticReport(ReportType reportType, File file, Consumer<Future> reportTaskFutureConsumer) {
    LOGGER.trace("createDiagnosticReport({}, {})", reportType, file);
    ServiceReportGeneratorDataImpl serviceReportGeneratorDataImpl = new ServiceReportGeneratorDataImpl();
    DiagnosticReportGenerator rtfGenerator = ReportFactory.builder().diagnosticReportGenerator();
    ((DiagnosticReportGenerator)rtfGenerator.createDocument(reportType))
      .addTitle();
    if (this.guiManager.isGuiInMode(GuiManager.GuiMode.BCT)) {
      writeBctRtfReport(rtfGenerator);
    } else {
      writeEbikeRtfReport(rtfGenerator, this.bikeIdentification.isBms2Connected());
    } 
    rtfGenerator.writeServiceTable();
    LOGGER.trace("createDiagnosticReport({}, {}) - generateAndSave", reportType, file);
    Future future = rtfGenerator.generateAndSave((ReportGeneratorData)serviceReportGeneratorDataImpl, file);
    reportTaskFutureConsumer.accept(future);
    LOGGER.trace("createDiagnosticReport({}, {}) - read required data", reportType, file);
    readServiceDataFromDevice((ServiceReportGeneratorData)serviceReportGeneratorDataImpl, reportType);
    LOGGER.trace("createDiagnosticReport({}, {}) - wait for complete", reportType, file);
    rtfGenerator.waitForComplete();
  }
  
  private void writeBctRtfReport(DiagnosticReportGenerator rtfGenerator) {
    ComponentType compType = this.bikeIdentification.getBms1Identification().getComponentType();
    rtfGenerator.addBctComponent(this.bikeIdentification.getBctIdentification().getMode(), BUNDLE.getString("EBikeServiceTab.TAB_BCT"))
      .addBmsComponent((compType != ComponentType.NONE) ? Constants.EcuMode.APP : Constants.EcuMode.NONE, this.diagnosticTab.mapBatteryLabel(compType));
  }
  
  private void writeEbikeRtfReport(DiagnosticReportGenerator rtfGenerator, boolean pp2Connected) {
    String optionalNumber = pp2Connected ? " 1" : "";
    rtfGenerator.addHmiComponent(this.bikeIdentification.getHmiIdentification().getMode(), BUNDLE.getString("EBikeServiceTab.TAB_HMI"))
      .addDuComponent(this.bikeIdentification.getDuIdentification().getMode(), BUNDLE.getString("EBikeServiceTab.TAB_DU"))
      .addBmsComponent(this.bikeIdentification.getBms1Identification().getMode(), 
        this.diagnosticTab.mapBatteryLabel(this.bikeIdentification.getBms1Identification().getComponentType()) + this.diagnosticTab.mapBatteryLabel(this.bikeIdentification.getBms1Identification().getComponentType()));
    if (pp2Connected)
      rtfGenerator.addBbp2Component(this.bikeIdentification.getBms2Identification().getMode(), 
          this.diagnosticTab.mapBatteryLabel(this.bikeIdentification.getBms2Identification().getComponentType()) + " 2"); 
    if (this.bikeIdentification.isEshiftConnected())
      rtfGenerator.addEshiftComponent(Constants.EcuMode.APP, BUNDLE.getString("EBikeServiceTab.eShift.title")); 
    if (this.bikeIdentification.isAbsConnected())
      rtfGenerator.addAbsComponent(this.bikeIdentification.getAbsIdentification().getMode(), BUNDLE.getString("EBikeServiceTab.TAB_ABS")); 
    if (this.bikeIdentification.isBcsConnected() && this.rightsManager.isUserInLevel(UserLevel.IBD))
      rtfGenerator.addBcsComponent(this.bikeIdentification.getBcsIdentification().getMode(), BUNDLE.getString("EBikeServiceTab.TAB_BCS")); 
    if (this.bikeIdentification.getSystemType() != Constants.SystemType.CLASSIC_PLUS)
      rtfGenerator.writeServiceIntervalTable(); 
  }
}

package com.gigatronik.beds.gui.panels.diagnostictab.controller.pdfreport;

class PdfServiceReportControllerDelegatorCommon {
  private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(PdfServiceReportControllerDelegatorCommon.class);
  
  private static final Utf8ResourceBundleFormatted BUNDLE = ResourceBundleFactory.newDefaultResourceBundle();
  
  private static final char[] INVALID_CHARS = new char[] { 
      '|', '\\', '?', '*', '<', '"', ':', '>', '+', '[', 
      ']', '/', ',', '.', '\000' };
  
  private static final int MAX_ENTRIES_SERVICE_HISTORY = 10;
  
  private final GuiManager guiManager;
