  public PdfServiceReportControllerDelegatorCommon(GuiManager guiManager, TestableJTabbedPane diagnosticTabbedPane, DiagnosticTab diagnosticTab, BikeIdentification bikeIdentification, CommunicationManager communicationManager) {
    this.guiManager = guiManager;
    this.bikeIdentification = bikeIdentification;
    this.diagnosticTab = diagnosticTab;
    this.diagnosticTabbedPane = diagnosticTabbedPane;
    this.communicationManager = communicationManager;
  }
  
  String getServiceReportName(String bikeID, ReportType reportType, boolean isUserIbd) {
    SimpleDateFormat fmt = new SimpleDateFormat("yyyyMMdd");
    Date myDate = new Date();
    String dateString = fmt.format(myDate);
    String reportName = null;
    String parsedBikeId = "";
    if (null != bikeID)
      parsedBikeId = parseBikeID(bikeID); 
    if (isUserIbd) {
      if (ReportType.SERVICE == reportType)
        reportName = dateString + "_Service_IBD_" + dateString + ".pdf"; 
      if (ReportType.CUSTOMER == reportType || ReportType.CUSTOMER_BMS_ONLY == reportType)
        reportName = dateString + "_Customer_IBD_" + dateString + ".pdf"; 
    } else {
      if (ReportType.SERVICE == reportType)
        reportName = dateString + "_" + dateString + ".pdf"; 
      if (ReportType.CUSTOMER == reportType || ReportType.CUSTOMER_BMS_ONLY == reportType)
        reportName = dateString + "_Customer_" + dateString + ".pdf"; 
    } 
    LOGGER.info("getServiceReportName(): Create report file name -> {}", reportName);
    return reportName;
  }
  
  private String parseBikeID(String bikeID) {
    for (char invalidChar : INVALID_CHARS) {
      if (bikeID.contains(String.valueOf(invalidChar)))
        bikeID = bikeID.replace(invalidChar, '_'); 
    } 
    String noControlChar = bikeID.replaceAll("\\p{Cntrl}", "_");
    return noControlChar.replaceAll("[^\\p{Print}]", "_");
  }
  
  boolean showReportFileChooseDialog(ReportData<File> file, String defaultReportFileName) {
    LOGGER.trace("Open service report file choose dialog");
    JFileChooser fc = CustomFileChooser.getCustomFileChooser();
    File defaultFile = new File(defaultReportFileName);
    fc.setSelectedFile(defaultFile);
    FileNameExtensionFilter pdfFilter = new FileNameExtensionFilter("Portable Document Format (.pdf)", new String[] { "pdf" });
    fc.setFileFilter(pdfFilter);
    int returnVal = fc.showSaveDialog((Component)this.diagnosticTabbedPane);
    if (returnVal == 0) {
      file.setValue(fc.getSelectedFile());
      return true;
    } 
    file.setValue(null);
    return false;
  }
  
  boolean checkDataForReport() {
    if (this.diagnosticTab.isSomeTableEmpty() || hasAnTableNegativResponse()) {
      String message = BUNDLE.getString("EBikeReport.incompleteData.text");
      String title = BUNDLE.getString("EBikeReport.incompleteData.title");
      String[] dialogOptions = { BUNDLE.getString("JOptionPane.Yes"), BUNDLE.getString("JOptionPane.No") };
      int response = TestableJOptionPane.showOptionDialog(message, title, 0, 2, null, dialogOptions, dialogOptions[1]);
      return (response == 0);
    } 
    return true;
  }
  
  private boolean hasAnTableNegativResponse() {
    if (this.guiManager.isGuiInMode(GuiManager.GuiMode.BCT))
      return false; 
    boolean duTableNegativResponse = (this.bikeIdentification.isDuConnected() && this.diagnosticTab.getDuTab().hasDiagnosisTableNegativeResponse());
    boolean pp1TableNegativResponse = (this.bikeIdentification.isBms1Connected() && this.diagnosticTab.getBms1Tab().hasDiagnosisTableNegativeResponse());
    boolean pp2TableNegativResponse = (this.bikeIdentification.isBms2Connected() && this.diagnosticTab.getBms2Tab().hasDiagnosisTableNegativeResponse());
    boolean absTableNegativResponse = (this.bikeIdentification.isAbsConnected() && this.diagnosticTab.getAbsTab().hasDiagnosisTableNegativeResponse());
    boolean eShiftTableNegativResponse = (this.bikeIdentification.isEshiftConnected() && this.diagnosticTab.getEshiftTab().hasDiagnosisTableNegativeResponse());
    boolean bcsTableNegativResponse = (this.bikeIdentification.isBcsConnected() && this.diagnosticTab.getBcsTab().hasDiagnosisTableNegativeResponse());
    LOGGER.debug("hasAnTableNegativResponse() --> DU='{}', BMS1='{}', BMS2='{}', ABS='{}', ESHIFT='{}', BCS='{}'", duTableNegativResponse, pp1TableNegativResponse, pp2TableNegativResponse, absTableNegativResponse, eShiftTableNegativResponse, bcsTableNegativResponse);
    return (duTableNegativResponse || pp1TableNegativResponse || pp2TableNegativResponse || absTableNegativResponse || eShiftTableNegativResponse || bcsTableNegativResponse);
  }
  
  String getGlobalProperty(String key) {
    try {
      return SettingsProxy.getInstance().getGlobalSettings().getProperty(key);
    } catch (ConfigurationNotFoundException e) {
      LOGGER.error("Failed to read global settings property {}", key, e);
      return "";
    } 
  }
  
  List<String> readServiceIntervalDataForReport() throws ConfigurationNotFoundException {
    List<String> serviceData = new ArrayList<>();
    if (this.bikeIdentification.isDuConnected()) {
      String unitDistance = SettingsProxy.getInstance().getGlobalSettings().getProperty("unit_distance");
      boolean convertOdometerToMiles = "1".equalsIgnoreCase(unitDistance);
      for (int index = 0; index < 10; index++)
        readServiceIntervallData(serviceData, convertOdometerToMiles, index); 
    } 
    return serviceData;
  }
  
  private void readServiceIntervallData(List<String> serviceData, boolean convertOdometerToMiles, int index) {
    ComplexResponse response = this.communicationManager.getDuCom().readServiceHistoryByIndex(String.valueOf(index));
    try {
      if (response.isPositive() && !StringUtils.equals(response.getParameterByName("date").getValue(), "2000-00-00")) {
        serviceData.add(response.getParameterByName("date").getValue());
        if (convertOdometerToMiles) {
          serviceData.add(String.format("%.1f mi", ConverterUtil.kilometerToMileWithoutRounding(Double.parseDouble(response.getParameterByName("odometer").getValue()) / 1000.0D)));
        } else {
          serviceData.add(String.format("%.1f km", Double.parseDouble(response.getParameterByName("odometer").getValue()) / 1000.0D));
        } 
      } 
    } catch (ComplexResponse.DataAccessException ex) {
      LOGGER.error("Error reading and parsing service interval data", (Throwable)ex);
    } 
  }
}

    this.diagnosticTab = diagnosticTab;

  void setUpReportDto(ServiceReportGeneratorData data, ReportType reportType, UserLevel userLevel) {
    if (this.guiManager.isGuiInMode(GuiManager.GuiMode.BCT))
      this.communicationManager.getBms1Com().executeExtendedSessionAndSecurityAccess(userLevel); 
    ServiceReportDto dto = new ServiceReportDto(new JTableToDtoConverterImpl());
    addGeneralValues(dto, reportType);
    ReportFactory.setGeneralValuesFromDto((ReportGeneratorData)data, (AbstractReportDto)dto);
    LOGGER.trace("Read data: setGeneralValuesFromDto");
    addServiceGeneralValues(dto, reportType);
    ReportFactory.setServiceGeneralValuesFromDto(data, dto);
    LOGGER.trace("Read data: setServiceGeneralValuesFromDto");
    dto.setBikeIdentification(this.bikeIdentification);
    ReportFactory.setBikeIdentificationFromDto(data, dto);
    LOGGER.trace("Read data: setBikeIdentificationFromDto");
    addTableValues(dto, reportType);
    ReportFactory.setTableValuesFromDto(data, dto);
    LOGGER.trace("Read data: setTableValuesFromDto");
    addServiceIntervalDueDateValues(dto);
    ReportFactory.setServiceIntervalDueDateFromDto(data, dto);
    LOGGER.trace("Read data: setServiceIntervalDueDateFromDto");
    addNominalEnergyValue(dto, reportType);
    ReportFactory.setNominalEnergyFromDto(data, dto);
    LOGGER.trace("Read data: setNominalEnergyFromDto");
    addEmtbValue(dto);
    ReportFactory.setEmbtFlagFromDto(data, dto);
    LOGGER.trace("Read data: setEmbtFlagFromDto");
    dto.setVisibilityServiceConfiguration(isServiceConfigurationValid());
    ReportFactory.setVisibilityServiceConfigurationFromDto(data, dto);
    addServiceIntervallValue(dto);
    ReportFactory.setServiceIntervallDataFromDto(data, dto);
    LOGGER.trace("Read data: setServiceIntervallDataFromDto");
    if (this.guiManager.isGuiInMode(GuiManager.GuiMode.BCT))
      this.communicationManager.getBms1Com().startDefaultSession(false); 
  }
  
  private void addGeneralValues(ServiceReportDto dto, ReportType reportType) {
    ((ServiceReportDto)((ServiceReportDto)((ServiceReportDto)dto.setLocale(I18NUtil.getLocale()))
      .setDisplayVersion(ConfigUtil.getDisplayVersion()))
      .setDataPath(SettingsProxy.getInstance().getDataPath()))
      .setCustomerNumber(this.delegatorCommon.getGlobalProperty("settings_userdata_customerNumber"));
    if (isCustomerReport(reportType))
      ((ServiceReportDto)((ServiceReportDto)((ServiceReportDto)((ServiceReportDto)dto.setCompanyName(this.delegatorCommon.getGlobalProperty("settings_userdata_companyName")))
        .setCustomerEmail(this.delegatorCommon.getGlobalProperty("settings_userdata_customerEMail")))
        .setCustomerAddress(this.delegatorCommon.getGlobalProperty("settings_userdata_customerAddress")))
        .setCustomerPhoneNumber(this.delegatorCommon.getGlobalProperty("settings_userdata_customerPhoneNumber")))
        .setCustomerWebSite(this.delegatorCommon.getGlobalProperty("settings_userdata_customerWebsite")); 
  }
  
  private void addServiceGeneralValues(ServiceReportDto dto, ReportType reportType) {
    dto.setErrorCodeFilter(new StandardErrorCodeFilterImpl());
    if (reportType != ReportType.CUSTOMER_BMS_ONLY)
      dto.setUnitDistance(this.delegatorCommon.getGlobalProperty("unit_distance"))
        .setUdamChart(this.diagnosticTab.getHmiTab().getUdamPanel()[1].getChart())
        .setPieChartAssistModes(this.diagnosticTab.getDuTab().getPnlStatisticsData().getChartForServiceReport()); 
  }
  
  private void addTableValues(ServiceReportDto dto, ReportType reportType) {
    if (reportType == ReportType.CUSTOMER_BMS_ONLY) {
      dto.addBMSDiagnosis(this.diagnosticTab.getBms1Tab().getDiagnosisTable())
        .addBMSErrorCode(this.diagnosticTab.getBms1Tab().getErrorCodeTable());
    } else {
      dto.addDUDiagnosis(this.diagnosticTab.getDuTab().getDiagnosisTable())
        .addHMIDiagnosis(this.diagnosticTab.getHmiTab().getDiagnosisTable())
        .addBMSDiagnosis(this.diagnosticTab.getBms1Tab().getDiagnosisTable())
        .addBCTDiagnosis(this.diagnosticTab.getBctTab().getDiagnosisTable())
        .addBCSDiagnosis(this.diagnosticTab.getBcsTab().getDiagnosisTable())
        .addBBP2Diagnosis(this.diagnosticTab.getBms2Tab().getDiagnosisTable())
        .addAbsDiagnosis(this.diagnosticTab.getAbsTab().getDiagnosisTable())
        .addEshift(this.diagnosticTab.getEshiftTab().getDiagnosisTable())
        .addDUErrorCode(this.diagnosticTab.getDuTab().getErrorCodeTable())
        .addHMIErrorCode(this.diagnosticTab.getHmiTab().getErrorCodeTable())
        .addBMSErrorCode(this.diagnosticTab.getBms1Tab().getErrorCodeTable())
        .addBBP2ErrorCode(this.diagnosticTab.getBms2Tab().getErrorCodeTable())
        .addBCTErrorCode(this.diagnosticTab.getBctTab().getErrorCodeTable())
        .addBCSErrorCode(this.diagnosticTab.getBcsTab().getErrorCodeTable())
        .addAbsErrorCode(this.diagnosticTab.getAbsTab().getErrorCodeTable());
    } 
  }
  
  private void addServiceIntervalDueDateValues(ServiceReportDto dto) {
    String[] serviceIntervalDueData = { "", "" };
    if (this.bikeIdentification.isDuConnected()) {
      ComplexResponse response = this.communicationManager.getDuCom().readServiceIntervalDueData();
      if (response.isPositive()) {
        try {
          serviceIntervalDueData[0] = response.getParameterByName("date").getValue();
          serviceIntervalDueData[1] = response.getParameterByName("odometer").getValue();
        } catch (ComplexResponse.DataAccessException ex) {
          LOGGER.error("Error reading and parsing service interval due data from ComplexResponse", (Throwable)ex);
        } 
      } else {
        LOGGER.error("Negative response reading service interval due data");
      } 
    } 
    dto.setServiceIntervalDueDate(serviceIntervalDueData);
  }
  
  private void addNominalEnergyValue(ServiceReportDto dto, ReportType reportType) {
    List<String> nominalEnergyResponse = new ArrayList<>();
    if (isCustomerReport(reportType)) {
      ComplexResponse readNominalEnergy = this.communicationManager.getBms1Com().readNominalEnergy();
      nominalEnergyResponse.add(readNominalEnergy.isPositive() ? readNominalEnergy.toString() : "");
      if (this.bikeIdentification.isBms2Connected()) {
        ComplexResponse readNominalEnergyBms2 = this.communicationManager.getBms2Com().readNominalEnergy();
        nominalEnergyResponse.add(readNominalEnergyBms2.isPositive() ? readNominalEnergyBms2.toString() : "");
      } 
    } 
    dto.setNominalEnergyValues(nominalEnergyResponse);
  }
  
  private void addEmtbValue(ServiceReportDto dto) {
    boolean emtbFlag = false;
    if (!this.guiManager.isGuiInMode(GuiManager.GuiMode.BCT) && this.bikeIdentification.getDuIdentification().isApplication() && this.bikeIdentification.getSystemType() == Constants.SystemType.VICTOR) {
      if (!this.serviceParameterDatapool.getServiceParameter((ServiceParameter)DuServiceParameter.EMTB_MODE_CONFIGURED).isPositive())
        this.serviceParameterDatapool.resetServiceParameterCache((ServiceParameter)DuServiceParameter.EMTB_MODE_CONFIGURED); 
      emtbFlag = StringUtils.equalsIgnoreCase(this.serviceParameterDatapool.getServiceParameter((ServiceParameter)DuServiceParameter.EMTB_MODE_CONFIGURED).toString(), "TRUE");
    } 
    dto.setEmbtFlag(emtbFlag);
  }
  
  private boolean isServiceConfigurationValid() {
    String duVersion = this.bikeIdentification.getDuIdentification().getSwVersion();
    if (this.configurationManager.isContainerLoaded()) {
      String cffVersion = this.configurationManager.getContainerConfiguration().getContainerController().getBoschContainerCommonInterface().getSwVersionConnectedDu(this.bikeIdentification.getDuIdentification().getComponentType(), this.bikeIdentification.getSystemType(), this.configurationManager.getContainerConfiguration().getConfiguredParId());
      if (!StringUtils.isBlank(cffVersion))
        duVersion = cffVersion; 
    } 
    ComponentType compType = this.bikeIdentification.getDuIdentification().getComponentType();
    return (!this.bikeIdentification.isDuConnected() || (duVersion.compareTo("1.5.0.0") >= 0 && compType.isBDU2xx()) || compType.isBDU3xx() || compType.isBDU4xx());
  }
  
  private boolean isCustomerReport(ReportType reportType) {
    return (reportType == ReportType.CUSTOMER || reportType == ReportType.CUSTOMER_BMS_ONLY);
  }
  
  private void addServiceIntervallValue(ServiceReportDto dto) {
    List<String> serviceIntervallData;
    try {
      serviceIntervallData = this.delegatorCommon.readServiceIntervalDataForReport();
    } catch (ConfigurationNotFoundException e) {
      LOGGER.error("Failed to readServiceIntervalDataForReport", (Throwable)e);
      serviceIntervallData = Collections.emptyList();
    } 
    dto.setServiceIntervallData(serviceIntervallData);
  }
}

import com.gigatronik.beds.service.rightsmanager.api.UserLevel;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.tableEvaluator.impl.TableEvaluatorImpl;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.bosch.service.internationalization.I18NUtil;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.common.configuration.ComplexResponse;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.common.configuration.Constants;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.common.util.SerialNumberHelper;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.LinkedList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

public class AbsSubtab extends AbstractDiagnosticSubtab {
  private static final long serialVersionUID = -3291596592680705182L;
  
  private final transient Abs abs;
  
  public AbsSubtab(RightsManager rightsManager, ConfigurationManager configurationManager, CommunicationManager communicationManager, ServiceParameterDatapool serviceParameterDatapool) {
    super(0, "AbsServiceTable.xml", rightsManager, configurationManager, communicationManager, serviceParameterDatapool, configurationManager.getBikeIdentification().getAbsIdentification());
    this.abs = communicationManager.getAbsCom();
  }
  
  public String getTableComponentName() {
    return "ABS";
  }
  
  protected void afterPopulateTable() {
    readAndDisplayCyclicData();
  }
  
  public void populateDefaultTable() {
    this.environment.clear();
    this.environment.put("showNegativeResponse", "");
    setEnvironmentUserGroup(this.environment);
    List<TableEvaluatorImpl.TableEntry> result = this.tableEvaluator.evaluateTable(this.environment, null, this.bikeIdentification.isDuConnected(), getDuSwVersion());
    this.tblDiagnosis.setModel(getDiagnosticTableModel(result));
  }
  
  public void readAndDisplayCyclicData() {
    if (this.bikeIdentification.getAbsIdentification().isApplication() && this.bikeIdentification.getSystemType() == Constants.SystemType.VICTOR) {
      LOGGER.debug("Reading Cyclic Data from ABS");
      List<ServiceParameter> parametersToUpdate = buildAbsCyclicDataRequest();
      Map<String, ComplexResponse> diagnosticTabData = formatDatapoolToTable(this.serviceParameterDatapool.getCleanServiceParameterBundle(parametersToUpdate));
      Map<String, Object> environment = getCurrentEnvironment(diagnosticTabData);
      environment.put("showNegativeResponse", "");
      updateServiceParameters(environment, diagnosticTabData, this.bikeIdentification.isDuConnected(), getDuSwVersion());
    } 
  }
  
  protected Map<String, ComplexResponse> getData(boolean readFromEcu) {
    List<ServiceParameter> parametersToRequest = buildAbsRequest();
    return readFromEcu ? formatDatapoolToTable(this.serviceParameterDatapool.getCleanServiceParameterBundle(parametersToRequest)) : 
      formatDatapoolToTable(this.serviceParameterDatapool.getServiceParameterBundle(parametersToRequest));
  }
  
  private Map<String, ComplexResponse> formatDatapoolToTable(Map<ServiceParameter, ComplexResponse> inputDatapool) {
    Map<String, ComplexResponse> collectResponse = new HashMap<>();
    for (Map.Entry<ServiceParameter, ComplexResponse> mapEntry : inputDatapool.entrySet()) {
      switch ((AbsServiceParameter)mapEntry.getKey()) {
        case SW_VERSION:
          collectResponse.put(mapEntry.getKey().getText(), formatSwVersionToDisplay(mapEntry.getValue()));
          continue;
        case MANUFACTURE_DATE:
          collectResponse.put((this.rightsManager.getUserLevel() == UserLevel.IBD) ? AbsServiceParameter.MANUFACTURE_DATE_CODED.getText() : AbsServiceParameter.MANUFACTURE_DATE.getText(), CustomizeResponsesForDisplaying.customizeManufacturingDate(mapEntry.getValue(), I18NUtil.getLocale(), this.rightsManager.getUserLevel()));
          continue;
        case PART_NUMBER:
          collectResponse.put(mapEntry.getKey().getText(), formatPartNumberToDisplay(mapEntry.getValue()));
          continue;
        case SERIAL_NUMBER:
          collectResponse.put(mapEntry.getKey().getText(), SerialNumberHelper.getSerialnumberBas100(mapEntry.getValue()));
          continue;
        case WSS_MOUNTING_TEST_BACK_STATUS:
        case WSS_MOUNTING_TEST_FRONT_STATUS:
          collectResponse.put(mapEntry.getKey().getText(), CustomizeResponsesForDisplaying.customizeWSSTestStatus(mapEntry.getValue(), BUNDLE));
          continue;
        case MOUNTING_TEST_RESULT:
          try {
            collectResponse.put(mapEntry.getKey().getText(), CustomizeResponsesForDisplaying.customizeMountingTestResult(this.serviceParameterDatapool.getServiceParameter((ServiceParameter)AbsServiceParameter.SAFETY_LAMP_DEACTIVATION_EVENT), this.serviceParameterDatapool.getServiceParameter((ServiceParameter)AbsServiceParameter.EXTENDED_WSS_MOUNTING_TEST_RESULT), BUNDLE, this.bikeIdentification.getAbsIdentification().getSwVersionResponse().getVersion()));
          } catch (ComplexResponse.DataAccessException e) {
            LOGGER.error("Error parsing abs sw version", (Throwable)e);
          } 
          continue;
      } 
      collectResponse.put(mapEntry.getKey().getText(), mapEntry.getValue());
    } 
    return collectResponse;
  }
  
  private List<ServiceParameter> buildAbsRequest() {
    List<ServiceParameter> parametersToRetrieve = new LinkedList<>();
    parametersToRetrieve.add(AbsServiceParameter.HW_VERSION);
    parametersToRetrieve.add(AbsServiceParameter.SW_VERSION);
    parametersToRetrieve.add(AbsServiceParameter.COMPONENT_TYPE);
    if (this.bikeIdentification.getAbsIdentification().isApplication()) {
      parametersToRetrieve.add(AbsServiceParameter.MANUFACTURE_DATE);
      parametersToRetrieve.add(AbsServiceParameter.PARTNUMBER_KIT);
      parametersToRetrieve.add(AbsServiceParameter.PART_NUMBER);
      parametersToRetrieve.add(AbsServiceParameter.PRODUCT_CODE);
      parametersToRetrieve.add(AbsServiceParameter.SERIAL_NUMBER);
      parametersToRetrieve.add(AbsServiceParameter.FLASH_COUNTER);
      parametersToRetrieve.add(AbsServiceParameter.BREAK_EVENTS);
      parametersToRetrieve.add(AbsServiceParameter.SLIP_EVENTS);
      parametersToRetrieve.add(AbsServiceParameter.LIFT_EVENTS);
      parametersToRetrieve.addAll(buildAbsCyclicDataRequest());
      parametersToRetrieve.add(AbsServiceParameter.VARIANT_CODE);
      parametersToRetrieve.add(AbsServiceParameter.VARIANT_CHECKSUM);
    } 
    return parametersToRetrieve;
  }
  
  private List<ServiceParameter> buildAbsCyclicDataRequest() {
    List<ServiceParameter> parametersToRetrieve = new LinkedList<>();
    parametersToRetrieve.add(AbsServiceParameter.WHEEL_SPEED_FRONT);
    parametersToRetrieve.add(AbsServiceParameter.WHEEL_SPEED_REAR);
    parametersToRetrieve.add(AbsServiceParameter.BRAKE_PRESSURE);
    parametersToRetrieve.add(AbsServiceParameter.WSS_MOUNTING_TEST_FRONT_STATUS);
    parametersToRetrieve.add(AbsServiceParameter.WSS_MOUNTING_TEST_BACK_STATUS);
    parametersToRetrieve.add(AbsServiceParameter.MOUNTING_TEST_RESULT);
    return parametersToRetrieve;
  }
  
  public void resetSensortest() {
    this.abs.resetWSSMountingTestResult();
  }
}

  public TableModel getDiagnosticTableModel(List<TableEvaluatorImpl.TableEntry> data) {
    TableEvaluatorImpl.TableEntry[] resultArray = data.<TableEvaluatorImpl.TableEntry>toArray(new TableEvaluatorImpl.TableEntry[0]);
    List<Object[]> dataList = new LinkedList<>();
    this.rowWithChart = -1;
    for (int i = 0; i < data.size(); i++) {
      if (BUNDLE.getString("EBikeServiceTab.DU_DiagnosticTable.Data.ChartPanel").equals(resultArray[i].getCaption())) {
        dataList.add(new JPanel[] { (JPanel)this.pnlStatisticCaption, (JPanel)this.pnlStatisticData });
        this.rowWithChart = i;
      } else {
        dataList.add(new Object[] { resultArray[i].getCaption(), resultArray[i].getValue() });
      } 
    } 
    return new DiagnosticDefaultTableModel(dataList.toArray(new Object[0][]), DIAGNOSTIC_COLUMNS);
  }
  
  public boolean isDiagnosisTableEmpty() {
    return this.diagnosisTableEmpty.get();
  }
  
  public boolean hasDiagnosisTableNegativeResponse() {
    if (this.tblDiagnosis == null || this.tblDiagnosis.getRowCount() <= 1)
      return false; 
    for (int i = 0; i < this.tblDiagnosis.getRowCount(); i++) {
      Object cell = this.tblDiagnosis.getValueAt(i, 1);
      if (doesCellContainNegativeResponse(cell))
        return true; 
    } 
    return false;
  }
  
  private boolean doesCellContainNegativeResponse(Object cell) {
    if (cell instanceof ComplexResponse) {
      ComplexResponse response = (ComplexResponse)cell;
      try {
        if (response.isNegative() && response.getNegativeResponse() != NegativeResponse.REQUEST_OUT_OF_RANGE)
          return true; 
      } catch (ComplexResponse.DataAccessException ex) {
        LOGGER.error("Failed to parse response pdu", (Throwable)ex);
      } 
    } 
    return false;
  }
  
  public void clearErrorCodeTable() {
    if (this.tblErrorCode != null)
      ((DefaultTableModel)this.tblErrorCode.getModel()).setRowCount(0); 
  }
  
  public void clearDiagnosticTable() {
    for (int i = 0; i < this.tblDiagnosis.getRowCount(); i++)
      this.tblDiagnosis.setValueAt(null, i, 1); 
    this.diagnosisTableEmpty.set(true);
  }
  
  public void updateServiceParameters(Map<String, Object> environment, Map<String, ComplexResponse> collection4Update, boolean duConnected, Version duSwVersion) {
    List<TableEvaluatorImpl.TableEntry> result = this.tableEvaluator.evaluateSet(environment, collection4Update, duConnected, duSwVersion);
    for (TableEvaluatorImpl.TableEntry param : result) {
      for (int i = 0; i < this.tblDiagnosis.getRowCount(); i++) {
        if (this.tblDiagnosis.getValueAt(i, 0) != null && this.tblDiagnosis.getValueAt(i, 0).equals(param.getCaption()))
          this.tblDiagnosis.setValueAt(param.getValue(), i, 1); 
      } 
    } 
  }
  
  public JTable getDiagnosisTable() {
    return this.tblDiagnosis;
  }
  
  public JTable getErrorCodeTable() {
    return this.tblErrorCode;
  }
  
  protected Version getDuSwVersion() {
    Version duSwVersion = null;
    try {
      duSwVersion = Version.parse(this.bikeIdentification.getDuIdentification().getSwVersion());
    } catch (NumberFormatException|java.io.IOException ex) {
      LOGGER.warn("Failed to parse the DU softwareversion: ", (Throwable)ex);
    } 
    return duSwVersion;
  }
  
  public void convertUnitInTable(String parameter, boolean convertToStandardUnit, DiagnosticTab.Measure measure) {
    ConverterUtilAction action = convertToStandardUnit ? ConverterUtilAction.ONLY_FORMAT_TO_STANDARD : ConverterUtilAction.CONVERT_TO_NON_STANDARD;
    for (int i = 0; i < this.tblDiagnosis.getRowCount(); i++) {
      if (this.tblDiagnosis.getValueAt(i, 0) != null && this.tblDiagnosis.getValueAt(i, 0).equals(parameter)) {
        Object value = this.tblDiagnosis.getValueAt(i, 1);
        switch (measure) {
          case DISTANCE:
            this.tblDiagnosis.setValueAt(ConverterUtil.convertDistance(value, action), i, 1);
            break;
          case CIRCUMFERENCE:
            this.tblDiagnosis.setValueAt(ConverterUtil.convertCircumference(value, action), i, 1);
            break;
          case SPEED:
            this.tblDiagnosis.setValueAt(ConverterUtil.convertSpeed(value, action), i, 1);
            break;
          case TEMPERATURE:
            this.tblDiagnosis.setValueAt(ConverterUtil.convertTemperature(value, action), i, 1);
            break;
        } 
        break;
      } 
    } 
  }
  
  public synchronized Map<String, Object> getCurrentEnvironment(Map<String, ComplexResponse> parameters) {
    String hmiVariant;
    Map<String, Object> environment = new HashMap<>();
    ComponentType hmiComponent = this.bikeIdentification.getHmiIdentification().getComponentType();
    switch (hmiComponent) {
      case COMP_CUI100:
        environment.put("hmiVariant", "Cobi");
        break;
      case COMP_BUI350:
        environment.put("hmiVariant", "Nyon 2");
        break;
      default:
        hmiVariant = this.bikeIdentification.getHmiIdentification().getComponentType().getProductName();
        environment.put("hmiVariant", StringUtils.isNotBlank(hmiVariant) ? hmiVariant : "Intuvia");
        break;
    } 
    if (this.ecuIdentification instanceof HmiIdentification) {
      environment.put("hmiDisplayLanguageSupported", Boolean.valueOf(((HmiIdentification)this.ecuIdentification).isDisplayLanguageConfigurable()));
      environment.put("hmiDisplayDistanceUnitSupported", Boolean.valueOf(((HmiIdentification)this.ecuIdentification).isDistanceUnitConfigurable()));
    } 
    environment.put("ecuStateMode", this.ecuIdentification.isBootLoader() ? "FBL" : "APP");
    environment.put("hwVariant", this.bikeIdentification.getSystemType());
    environment.put("lightSwitching", Boolean.valueOf(parameters.containsKey("lightSwitching")));
    environment.put("driveOff", Boolean.valueOf(this.bikeIdentification.isDriveOffSupported()));
    if (parameters.get("DisplayValueMaxSpeed") == null) {
      environment.put("DisplayValueMaxSpeed", Boolean.valueOf(false));
    } else {
      environment.put("DisplayValueMaxSpeed", Boolean.valueOf(true));
    } 
    if (this.rightsManager.getUserLevel() == UserLevel.IBD) {
      environment.put("userGroup", "IBD");
    } else {
      environment.put("userGroup", "OEM");
    } 
    environment.put("absConnected", Boolean.valueOf(this.bikeIdentification.isAbsConnected()));
    return environment;
  }
  
  protected abstract Map<String, ComplexResponse> getData(boolean paramBoolean);
  
  public synchronized void fillTable(boolean readFromEcu) {
    LOGGER.info("Obtaining {} data ...", getTableComponentName());
    this.responseData = getData(readFromEcu);
    LOGGER.info("Fill {} table", getTableComponentName());
    this.environment = getCurrentEnvironment(this.responseData);
    this.environment.put("showNegativeResponse", "");
    populateTable(this.responseData, this.environment);
    this.diagnosisTableEmpty.set(false);
  }
  
  public synchronized void updateTable() {
    setEnvironmentUserGroup(this.environment);
    populateTable(this.responseData, this.environment);
  }
  
  public synchronized void clear() {
    LOGGER.info("Clear {} table", getTableComponentName());
    this.responseData.clear();
    clearErrorCodeTable();
    clearDiagnosticTable();
    LOGGER.debug("Table {} cleared", getTableComponentName());
  }
  
  protected ComplexResponse formatPartNumberToDisplay(ComplexResponse partNumber) {
    if (partNumber != null && partNumber.isPositive() && this.ecuIdentification.isHwSample())
      return new ComplexResponse(partNumber.toString() + " " + partNumber.toString()); 
    return partNumber;
  }
  
  protected ComplexResponse formatSwVersionToDisplay(ComplexResponse swVersion) {
    if (swVersion != null && swVersion.isPositive() && this.ecuIdentification.isSwSample())
      return new ComplexResponse(swVersion.toString() + " " + swVersion.toString()); 
    return swVersion;
  }
  
  protected void setEnvironmentUserGroup(Map<String, Object> environment) {
    if (this.rightsManager.getUserLevel() == UserLevel.IBD) {
      environment.put("userGroup", "IBD");
    } else {
      environment.put("userGroup", "OEM");
    } 
  }
}

package com.gigatronik.beds.gui.panels.diagnostictab.subtab;

import com.gigatronik.beds.diagnosticdatapool.api.ServiceParameterDatapool;
import com.gigatronik.beds.diagnosticdatapool.api.serviceparameter.BcsServiceParameter;
import com.gigatronik.beds.diagnosticdatapool.api.serviceparameter.ServiceParameter;
import com.gigatronik.beds.display.helpers.CustomizeResponsesForDisplaying;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.communication.api.CommunicationManager;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.configuration.ConfigurationManager;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.rightsmanager.api.RightsManager;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.rightsmanager.api.UserLevel;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.tableEvaluator.impl.TableEvaluatorImpl;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.bosch.service.internationalization.I18NUtil;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.common.configuration.ComplexResponse;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.LinkedList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

public class BcsSubtab extends AbstractDiagnosticSubtab {
  private static final long serialVersionUID = 8524246519603550091L;
  
  public BcsSubtab(RightsManager rightsManager, ConfigurationManager configurationManager, CommunicationManager communicationManager, ServiceParameterDatapool serviceParameterDatapool) {
    super(0, "BcsServiceTable.xml", rightsManager, configurationManager, communicationManager, serviceParameterDatapool, configurationManager.getBikeIdentification().getBcsIdentification());
  }
  
  public String getTableComponentName() {
    return "BCS";
  }
  
  protected void afterPopulateTable() {}
  
  public void populateDefaultTable() {
    this.environment.clear();
    this.environment.put("showNegativeResponse", "");
    setEnvironmentUserGroup(this.environment);
    List<TableEvaluatorImpl.TableEntry> result = this.tableEvaluator.evaluateTable(this.environment, null, this.bikeIdentification.isDuConnected(), getDuSwVersion());
    this.tblDiagnosis.setModel(getDiagnosticTableModel(result));
  }
  
  public void readAndDisplayCyclicData() {}
  
  protected Map<String, ComplexResponse> getData(boolean readFromEcu) {
    return readFromEcu ? formatDatapoolToTable(this.serviceParameterDatapool.getCleanServiceParameterBundle(buildBcsRequest())) : 
      formatDatapoolToTable(this.serviceParameterDatapool.getServiceParameterBundle(buildBcsRequest()));
  }
  
  private Map<String, ComplexResponse> formatDatapoolToTable(Map<ServiceParameter, ComplexResponse> inputDatapool) {
    Map<String, ComplexResponse> collectResponse = new HashMap<>();
    for (Map.Entry<ServiceParameter, ComplexResponse> mapEntry : inputDatapool.entrySet()) {
      switch ((BcsServiceParameter)mapEntry.getKey()) {
        case MANUFACTURING_DATE:
          collectResponse.put(mapEntry.getKey().getText(), CustomizeResponsesForDisplaying.customizeManufacturingDate(mapEntry.getValue(), I18NUtil.getLocale(), UserLevel.IBD));
          continue;
        case DELIVERED_CHARGE_OVER_LIFETIME:
          collectResponse.put(mapEntry.getKey().getText(), CustomizeResponsesForDisplaying.customizeProvidedEnergyOverLifetime(mapEntry.getValue()));
          continue;
      } 
      collectResponse.put(mapEntry.getKey().getText(), mapEntry.getValue());
    } 
    return collectResponse;
  }
  
  private List<ServiceParameter> buildBcsRequest() {
    List<ServiceParameter> parametersToRequest = new LinkedList<>();
    parametersToRequest.add(BcsServiceParameter.SW_VERSION);
    parametersToRequest.add(BcsServiceParameter.HW_VERSION);
    parametersToRequest.add(BcsServiceParameter.COMPONENT_TYPE);
    if (this.bikeIdentification.getBcsIdentification().isApplication()) {
      parametersToRequest.add(BcsServiceParameter.MANUFACTURING_DATE);
      parametersToRequest.add(BcsServiceParameter.PART_NUMBER);
      parametersToRequest.add(BcsServiceParameter.PRODUCT_CODE);
      parametersToRequest.add(BcsServiceParameter.SERIAL_NUMBER);
      parametersToRequest.add(BcsServiceParameter.DELIVERED_CHARGE_OVER_LIFETIME);
    } 
    return parametersToRequest;
  }
}

public class BctSubtab extends AbstractDiagnosticSubtab {
  private static final long serialVersionUID = 5824246596103550019L;
  
  private static final List<ServiceParameter> PARAMETERS = Collections.unmodifiableList((List)Arrays.asList(BctServiceParameter.PART_NUMBER, BctServiceParameter.SERIAL_NUMBER, BctServiceParameter.HW_VERSION, BctServiceParameter.SW_VERSION, BctServiceParameter.COMPONENT_TYPE, BctServiceParameter.PRODUCT_CODE));
  
  public BctSubtab(RightsManager rightsManager, ConfigurationManager configurationManager, CommunicationManager communicationManager, ServiceParameterDatapool serviceParameterDatapool) {
    super(0, "BctServiceTable.xml", rightsManager, configurationManager, communicationManager, serviceParameterDatapool, configurationManager.getBikeIdentification().getBctIdentification());
  }
  
  public String getTableComponentName() {
    return "BCT";
  }
  
  protected void afterPopulateTable() {}
  
  public void populateDefaultTable() {
    this.environment.clear();
    this.environment.put("showNegativeResponse", "");
    setEnvironmentUserGroup(this.environment);
    List<TableEvaluatorImpl.TableEntry> result = this.tableEvaluator.evaluateTable(this.environment, null, false, null);
    this.tblDiagnosis.setModel(getDiagnosticTableModel(result));
  }
  
  public void readAndDisplayCyclicData() {}
  
  protected Map<String, ComplexResponse> getData(boolean readFromEcu) {
    return readFromEcu ? formatDatapoolToTable(this.serviceParameterDatapool.getCleanServiceParameterBundle(PARAMETERS)) : 
      formatDatapoolToTable(this.serviceParameterDatapool.getServiceParameterBundle(PARAMETERS));
  }
  
  private Map<String, ComplexResponse> formatDatapoolToTable(Map<ServiceParameter, ComplexResponse> inputDatapool) {
    Map<String, ComplexResponse> collectResponse = new HashMap<>();
    for (Map.Entry<ServiceParameter, ComplexResponse> mapEntry : inputDatapool.entrySet()) {
      if (mapEntry.getKey() == BctServiceParameter.SERIAL_NUMBER) {
        collectResponse.put(mapEntry.getKey().getText(), SerialNumberHelper.getSerialnumberBct(mapEntry.getValue()));
        continue;
      } 
      collectResponse.put(mapEntry.getKey().getText(), mapEntry.getValue());
    } 
    return collectResponse;
  }
}

package com.gigatronik.beds.gui.panels.diagnostictab.subtab;

public class BmsSubTab extends AbstractDiagnosticSubtab {
  private static final long serialVersionUID = -4421952108914898059L;
  
  public BmsSubTab(RightsManager rightsManager, ConfigurationManager configurationManager, CommunicationManager communicationManager, ServiceParameterDatapool serviceParameterDatapool) {
    super(0, "BmsServiceTable.xml", rightsManager, configurationManager, communicationManager, serviceParameterDatapool, (EcuIdentification)configurationManager.getBikeIdentification().getBms1Identification());
  }
  
  public String getTableComponentName() {
    return "BMS";
  }
  
  protected void afterPopulateTable() {}
  
  public void populateDefaultTable() {
    this.environment.clear();
    this.environment.put("hwVariant", Constants.SystemType.VICTOR);
    setEnvironmentUserGroup(this.environment);
    List<TableEvaluatorImpl.TableEntry> result = this.tableEvaluator.evaluateTable(this.environment, null, this.bikeIdentification.isDuConnected(), getDuSwVersion());
    this.tblDiagnosis.setModel(getDiagnosticTableModel(result));
  }
  
  public void convertTemperatureParameters(boolean standardUnit) {
    convertUnitInTable(BUNDLE.getString("EBikeServiceTab.BMS_DiagnosticTable.Data.BATTERY_PACK_TEMPERATURE"), standardUnit, DiagnosticTab.Measure.TEMPERATURE);
    convertUnitInTable(BUNDLE.getString("EBikeServiceTab.BMS_DiagnosticTable.Data.MAX_PACK_TEMPERATURE_IN_LIFE_TIME"), standardUnit, DiagnosticTab.Measure.TEMPERATURE);
    convertUnitInTable(BUNDLE.getString("EBikeServiceTab.BMS_DiagnosticTable.Data.MIN_PACK_TEMPERATURE_IN_LIFE_TIME"), standardUnit, DiagnosticTab.Measure.TEMPERATURE);
  }
  
  public void readAndDisplayCyclicData() {}
  
  protected Map<String, ComplexResponse> getData(boolean readFromEcu) {
    List<ServiceParameter> parametersToRetrieve;
    if (((BmsIdentification)this.ecuIdentification).isBatteryTwo()) {
      parametersToRetrieve = buildBms2Request();
    } else {
      parametersToRetrieve = buildBms1Request();
    } 
    return readFromEcu ? formatDatapoolToTable(this.serviceParameterDatapool.getCleanServiceParameterBundle(parametersToRetrieve)) : 
      formatDatapoolToTable(this.serviceParameterDatapool.getServiceParameterBundle(parametersToRetrieve));
  }
  
  private Map<String, ComplexResponse> formatDatapoolToTable(Map<ServiceParameter, ComplexResponse> inputDatapool) {
    Map<String, ComplexResponse> collectResponse = new HashMap<>();
    if (((BmsIdentification)this.ecuIdentification).isBatteryTwo()) {
      for (Map.Entry<ServiceParameter, ComplexResponse> mapEntry : inputDatapool.entrySet()) {
        switch ((Bms2ServiceParameter)mapEntry.getKey()) {
          case SW_VERSION:
            collectResponse.put(mapEntry.getKey().getText(), formatSwVersionToDisplay(mapEntry.getValue()));
            continue;
          case MANUFACTURING_DATE:
            collectResponse.put(mapEntry.getKey().getText(), CustomizeResponsesForDisplaying.customizeManufacturingDate(mapEntry.getValue(), I18NUtil.getLocale(), this.rightsManager.getUserLevel()));
            continue;
          case PART_NUMBER:
            collectResponse.put(mapEntry.getKey().getText(), formatPartNumberToDisplay(mapEntry.getValue()));
            continue;
        } 
        collectResponse.put(mapEntry.getKey().getText(), mapEntry.getValue());
      } 
    } else {
      for (Map.Entry<ServiceParameter, ComplexResponse> mapEntry : inputDatapool.entrySet()) {
        switch ((BmsServiceParameter)mapEntry.getKey()) {
          case SW_VERSION:
            collectResponse.put(mapEntry.getKey().getText(), formatSwVersionToDisplay(mapEntry.getValue()));
            continue;
          case MANUFACTURING_DATE:
            collectResponse.put(mapEntry.getKey().getText(), CustomizeResponsesForDisplaying.customizeManufacturingDate(mapEntry.getValue(), I18NUtil.getLocale(), this.rightsManager.getUserLevel()));
            continue;
          case PART_NUMBER:
            collectResponse.put(mapEntry.getKey().getText(), formatPartNumberToDisplay(mapEntry.getValue()));
            continue;
        } 
        collectResponse.put(mapEntry.getKey().getText(), mapEntry.getValue());
      } 
    } 
    return collectResponse;
  }
  
  private List<ServiceParameter> buildBms1Request() {
    List<ServiceParameter> parametersToRequest = new LinkedList<>();
    parametersToRequest.add(BmsServiceParameter.HW_VERSION);
    parametersToRequest.add(BmsServiceParameter.SW_VERSION);
    parametersToRequest.add(BmsServiceParameter.COMPONENT_TYPE);
    if (this.ecuIdentification.isApplication()) {
      parametersToRequest.add(BmsServiceParameter.MANUFACTURING_DATE);
      parametersToRequest.add(BmsServiceParameter.PART_NUMBER);
      parametersToRequest.add(BmsServiceParameter.SERIAL_NUMBER);
      parametersToRequest.add(BmsServiceParameter.BATTERY_VOLTAGE);
      parametersToRequest.add(BmsServiceParameter.BATTERY_TEMPERATURE);
      parametersToRequest.add(BmsServiceParameter.BATTERY_CHARGE_STATE);
      parametersToRequest.add(BmsServiceParameter.BATTERY_DEACTIVATION);
      parametersToRequest.add(BmsServiceParameter.LOAD_CYCLES);
      parametersToRequest.add(BmsServiceParameter.MAX_TEMP_LIFETIME);
      parametersToRequest.add(BmsServiceParameter.DURATION_THERMAL_PROTECTION);
      parametersToRequest.add(BmsServiceParameter.PROV_AH_OVER_LIFETIME);
      parametersToRequest.add(BmsServiceParameter.BATTERY_CELLDEBALANCE_THRESHOLDVOLTAGE);
      parametersToRequest.add(BmsServiceParameter.BATTERY_CELLDEBALANCE_TIME);
      parametersToRequest.add(BmsServiceParameter.BATTERY_CELLTYPE);
      if (!this.ecuIdentification.getComponentType().isBBP1xx()) {
        parametersToRequest.add(BmsServiceParameter.PRODUCT_CODE);
        parametersToRequest.add(BmsServiceParameter.LOWEST_BATTERY_CELL_VOLTAGE);
        parametersToRequest.add(BmsServiceParameter.MIN_PACK_TEMPERATURE);
        parametersToRequest.add(BmsServiceParameter.MAX_POSSIBLE_CURRENT_BATTERY);
        parametersToRequest.add(BmsServiceParameter.BATTERY_CODE);
      } 
    } 
    return parametersToRequest;
  }

package com.gigatronik.beds.gui.panels.diagnostictab.subtab;

import com.gigatronik.beds.diagnosticdatapool.api.ServiceParameterDatapool;
import com.gigatronik.beds.diagnosticdatapool.api.serviceparameter.DuServiceParameter;
import com.gigatronik.beds.diagnosticdatapool.api.serviceparameter.ServiceParameter;
import com.gigatronik.beds.display.helpers.CustomizeResponsesForDisplaying;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.communication.api.CommunicationManager;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.configuration.ConfigurationManager;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.ecu.impl.du.AssistanceMode;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.rightsmanager.api.RightsManager;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.rightsmanager.api.UserLevel;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.tableEvaluator.impl.TableEvaluatorImpl;
import com.gigatronik.beds.settings.SettingsProxy;
import com.gigatronik.bosch.utils.ConverterUtil;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.bosch.service.internationalization.I18NUtil;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.framework.plugins.exceptions.ConfigurationNotFoundException;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.common.configuration.ComplexResponse;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.common.configuration.Constants;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.common.configuration.EcuIdentification;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.gui.PnTableWithChartImpl;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.gui.testinterface.TestableJOptionPane;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.LinkedList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import org.apache.commons.collections4.MapUtils;
import org.apache.commons.lang3.StringUtils;

public class DuSubtab extends AbstractDiagnosticSubtab {
  private static final long serialVersionUID = 5801276466090505342L;
  
  private transient Map<String, ComplexResponse> distanceAndEnergyInMode = null;
  
  public DuSubtab(RightsManager rightsManager, ConfigurationManager configurationManager, CommunicationManager communicationManager, ServiceParameterDatapool serviceParameterDatapool) {
    super(0, "DuServiceTable.xml", rightsManager, configurationManager, communicationManager, serviceParameterDatapool, (EcuIdentification)configurationManager.getBikeIdentification().getDuIdentification());
  }
  
  public String getTableComponentName() {
    return "DU";
  }
  
  protected void afterPopulateTable() {
    if (this.rowWithChart > 0)
      this.tblDiagnosis.setRowHeight(this.rowWithChart, 200); 
  }
  
  public void populateDefaultTable() {
    setEmptyCaptionsAssistenceModes();
    this.environment.clear();
    setEnvironmentUserGroup(this.environment);
    this.environment.put("hwVariant", Constants.SystemType.VICTOR);
    this.environment.put("lightSwitching", Boolean.valueOf(false));
    this.environment.put("driveOff", "false");
    this.environment.put("DisplayValueMaxSpeed", Boolean.valueOf(true));
    List<TableEvaluatorImpl.TableEntry> result = this.tableEvaluator.evaluateTable(this.environment, null, this.bikeIdentification.isDuConnected(), getDuSwVersion());
    this.tblDiagnosis.setModel(getDiagnosticTableModel(result));
    if (this.rowWithChart > 0)
      this.tblDiagnosis.setRowHeight(this.rowWithChart, 200); 
  }
  
  private void updateStatisticTable() {
    for (int i = 0; i < this.tblDiagnosis.getRowCount(); i++) {
      if (this.tblDiagnosis.getValueAt(i, 0) != null && this.tblDiagnosis.getValueAt(i, 0) instanceof javax.swing.JPanel) {
        this.tblDiagnosis.setValueAt(this.pnlStatisticData, i, 1);
        break;
      } 
    } 
  }
  
  private void readStatistics(boolean readFromEcu) {
    this.distanceAndEnergyInMode = getDuStatisticData(readFromEcu);
    fillStatisticData();
  }
  
  private void fillStatisticData() {
    if (!MapUtils.isEmpty(this.distanceAndEnergyInMode)) {
      LOGGER.debug("fillStatisticData() with: {}", this.distanceAndEnergyInMode);
      List<AssistanceMode> modes = new LinkedList<>();
      modes.addAll(Arrays.asList(AssistanceMode.getBasicModes()));
      if (this.bikeIdentification.getHmiIdentification().getComponentType().isNyon())
        modes.addAll(Arrays.asList(AssistanceMode.getUserModes())); 
      List<String> distanceList = new LinkedList<>();
      List<String> energyList = new LinkedList<>();
      List<String> captionsList = new LinkedList<>();
      int unitType = determineDistanceUnitFormat();
      boolean emtbModeConfigured = StringUtils.equals(this.distanceAndEnergyInMode.get(DuServiceParameter.EMTB_MODE_CONFIGURED.getText()).toString(), "TRUE");
      for (AssistanceMode mode : modes) {
        addEnergyValue(energyList, mode);
        addCaption(captionsList, emtbModeConfigured, mode);
        addDistanceValue(distanceList, unitType, mode);
      } 
      if (this.bikeIdentification.getSystemType() == Constants.SystemType.VICTOR) {
        captionsList.add(5, BUNDLE.getString("EBikeServiceTab.DU_DiagnosticTable.Data.EnergyConsumption"));
        distanceList.add(5, getEnergyConsumption());
      } 
      this.pnlStatisticCaption.setTableData((String[])captionsList.stream().toArray(x$0 -> new String[x$0]));
      this.pnlStatisticData = new PnTableWithChartImpl(this, true);
      this.pnlStatisticData.setTableData((String[])distanceList.stream().toArray(x$0 -> new String[x$0]));
      this.pnlStatisticData.setChartData((String[])energyList.stream().toArray(x$0 -> new String[x$0]), emtbModeConfigured);
    } else {
      setEmptyCaptionsAssistenceModes();
    } 
  }
  
  private void addEnergyValue(List<String> energyList, AssistanceMode mode) {
    energyList.add(this.distanceAndEnergyInMode.get("ASSIST_MODE_ENERGY_" + mode).toString());
  }
  
  private void addCaption(List<String> captionsList, boolean emtbModeConfigured, AssistanceMode mode) {
    if (mode == AssistanceMode.SPORT && emtbModeConfigured) {
      captionsList.add(BUNDLE.getString("EBikeServiceTab.DU_DiagnosticTable.Data.DISTANCE_IN_eMTB_MODE"));
    } else {
      captionsList.add(BUNDLE.getString(mode.getLanguageProperty()));
    } 
  }
  
  private void addDistanceValue(List<String> distanceList, int unitType, AssistanceMode mode) {
    ComplexResponse distance = this.distanceAndEnergyInMode.get("ASSIST_MODE_DISTANCE_" + mode);
    try {
      String distanceValue = distance.getString();
      if (StringUtils.isBlank(distanceValue)) {
        distanceList.add(" ");
      } else {
        try {
          if (unitType == 1) {
            double valueDouble = Double.parseDouble(distanceValue);
            double valueConverted = ConverterUtil.kilometerToMile(valueDouble);
            distanceList.add(String.format("%.1f mi", valueConverted).replace(",", "."));
          } else {
            distanceList.add(String.format("%s km", distanceValue));
          } 
        } catch (NumberFormatException nfe) {
          LOGGER.error("NumberFormatException " + nfe);
          distanceList.add(BUNDLE.getString("EBikeServiceTab.NEGATIVE_RESPONSE"));
        } 
      } 
    } catch (ComplexResponse.DataAccessException ex) {
      LOGGER.error("Parsing distance in mode {} response failed.", mode, ex);
      distanceList.add(distance.toString());
    } 
  }
  
  private int determineDistanceUnitFormat() {
    int unitType = 0;
    try {
      unitType = SettingsProxy.getInstance().getGlobalSettings().getInteger("unit_distance");
    } catch (ConfigurationNotFoundException e) {
      LOGGER.error("ConfigurationNotFoundException " + e);
    } 
    return unitType;
  }
  
  private String getEnergyConsumption() {
    double sumEnergy = getSumOfInMode("ENERGY");
    double sumDistance = getSumOfInMode("DISTANCE");
    int unitType = 0;
    try {
      unitType = SettingsProxy.getInstance().getGlobalSettings().getInteger("unit_distance");
    } catch (ConfigurationNotFoundException e) {
      LOGGER.error("ConfigurationNotFoundException " + e);
    } 
    if (sumDistance != 0.0D) {
      if (unitType == 1) {
        double valueConverted = ConverterUtil.kilometerToMile(sumDistance);
        return String.format("%.1f Wh/mi", sumEnergy * 100.0D / 3600.0D / valueConverted).replace(",", ".");
      } 
      return String.format("%.1f Wh/km", sumEnergy * 100.0D / 3600.0D / sumDistance);
    } 
    if (unitType == 1)
      return "0.0 Wh/mi"; 
    return "0.0 Wh/km";
  }
  
  private double getSumOfInMode(String unit) {
    double sum = 0.0D;
    for (Map.Entry<String, ComplexResponse> entry : this.distanceAndEnergyInMode.entrySet()) {
      if (entry.getKey().contains(unit) && entry.getValue() != null)
        try {
          sum += Double.parseDouble(entry.getValue().getString());
        } catch (ComplexResponse.DataAccessException ex) {
          LOGGER.error("Parsing distance in mode {} response failed", unit, ex);
        }  
    } 
    return sum;
  }
  
  public void resetStatistics() {
    if (!this.bikeIdentification.getSystemType().equals(Constants.SystemType.CLASSIC_PLUS)) {
      int reply = TestableJOptionPane.showConfirmDialog(BUNDLE.getString("EBikeServiceTab.imgbtnClearStatistics.optionPane"), BUNDLE.getString("EBikeServiceTab.imgbtnClearStatistics.toolTipText"), 0);
      if (reply == 0) {
        LOGGER.info("clearStatistics(): Reset statistics Button click");
        this.pnlStatisticData = new PnTableWithChartImpl(this, true);
        updateStatisticTable();
        this.communicationManager.getDuCom().resetStatistics();
        readStatistics(true);
        updateStatisticTable();
      } 
    } 
  }
  
  private void resetStatisticsTablePart() {
    this.distanceAndEnergyInMode = null;
    if (!this.bikeIdentification.getSystemType().equals(Constants.SystemType.CLASSIC_PLUS)) {
      this.pnlStatisticData = new PnTableWithChartImpl(this, true);
      updateStatisticTable();
    } 
  }
  
  private void setEmptyCaptionsAssistenceModes() {
    List<AssistanceMode> assistanceModesList = new ArrayList<>(Arrays.asList(AssistanceMode.getBasicModes()));
    if (this.bikeIdentification.getHmiIdentification().getComponentType().isNyon())
      assistanceModesList.addAll(Arrays.asList(AssistanceMode.getUserModes())); 
    this.pnlStatisticCaption.setTableData((String[])assistanceModesList.stream().map(mode -> BUNDLE.getString(mode.getLanguageProperty())).toArray(x$0 -> new String[x$0]));
  }

    return this.pnlStatisticData;
  }

      super.fillTable(readFromEcu); 
  }
  
  protected Map<String, ComplexResponse> getData(boolean readFromEcu) {
    List<ServiceParameter> parametersToRetrieve;
    if (this.ecuIdentification.getComponentType().isBDU1xx()) {
      parametersToRetrieve = buildDuClassicServiceParametersRequest();
    } else {
      parametersToRetrieve = buildDuVictorServiceParametersRequest();
      readStatistics(readFromEcu);
    } 
    if (readFromEcu) {
      parametersToRetrieve.remove(DuServiceParameter.MODEL_NAME);
      return formatDatapoolToTable(this.serviceParameterDatapool.getCleanServiceParameterBundle(parametersToRetrieve));
    } 
    return formatDatapoolToTable(this.serviceParameterDatapool.getServiceParameterBundle(parametersToRetrieve));
  }
  
  protected Map<String, ComplexResponse> getDuStatisticData(boolean readFromEcu) {
    List<ServiceParameter> parametersToRetrieve = new LinkedList<>();
    parametersToRetrieve.add(DuServiceParameter.EMTB_MODE_CONFIGURED);
    parametersToRetrieve.add(DuServiceParameter.ASSISTANCE_MODE_DISTANCE_TURBO);
    parametersToRetrieve.add(DuServiceParameter.ASSISTANCE_MODE_DISTANCE_SPORT);
    parametersToRetrieve.add(DuServiceParameter.ASSISTANCE_MODE_DISTANCE_TOUR);
    parametersToRetrieve.add(DuServiceParameter.ASSISTANCE_MODE_DISTANCE_ECO);
    parametersToRetrieve.add(DuServiceParameter.ASSISTANCE_MODE_DISTANCE_OFF);
    parametersToRetrieve.add(DuServiceParameter.ASSISTANCE_MODE_ENERGY_TURBO);
    parametersToRetrieve.add(DuServiceParameter.ASSISTANCE_MODE_ENERGY_SPORT);
    parametersToRetrieve.add(DuServiceParameter.ASSISTANCE_MODE_ENERGY_TOUR);
    parametersToRetrieve.add(DuServiceParameter.ASSISTANCE_MODE_ENERGY_ECO);
    parametersToRetrieve.add(DuServiceParameter.ASSISTANCE_MODE_ENERGY_OFF);
    if (this.bikeIdentification.getHmiIdentification().getComponentType().isNyon()) {
      parametersToRetrieve.add(DuServiceParameter.ASSISTANCE_MODE_DISTANCE_USER1);
      parametersToRetrieve.add(DuServiceParameter.ASSISTANCE_MODE_DISTANCE_USER2);
      parametersToRetrieve.add(DuServiceParameter.ASSISTANCE_MODE_DISTANCE_USER3);
      parametersToRetrieve.add(DuServiceParameter.ASSISTANCE_MODE_DISTANCE_USER4);
      parametersToRetrieve.add(DuServiceParameter.ASSISTANCE_MODE_ENERGY_USER1);
      parametersToRetrieve.add(DuServiceParameter.ASSISTANCE_MODE_ENERGY_USER2);
      parametersToRetrieve.add(DuServiceParameter.ASSISTANCE_MODE_ENERGY_USER3);
      parametersToRetrieve.add(DuServiceParameter.ASSISTANCE_MODE_ENERGY_USER4);
    } 
    return formatDatapoolToTable(readFromEcu ? this.serviceParameterDatapool.getCleanServiceParameterBundle(parametersToRetrieve) : 
        this.serviceParameterDatapool.getServiceParameterBundle(parametersToRetrieve));
  }
  
  private Map<String, ComplexResponse> formatDatapoolToTable(Map<ServiceParameter, ComplexResponse> inputDatapool) {
    Map<String, ComplexResponse> collectResponse = new HashMap<>();
    for (Map.Entry<ServiceParameter, ComplexResponse> mapEntry : inputDatapool.entrySet()) {
      switch ((DuServiceParameter)mapEntry.getKey()) {
        case SW_VERSION:
          collectResponse.put(mapEntry.getKey().getText(), formatSwVersionToDisplay(mapEntry.getValue()));
          continue;
        case PART_NUMBER:
          collectResponse.put(mapEntry.getKey().getText(), formatPartNumberToDisplay(mapEntry.getValue()));
          continue;
        case APPLICATION_ID:
          collectResponse.put(mapEntry.getKey().getText(), CustomizeResponsesForDisplaying.customizeApplicationIdDisplay(mapEntry.getValue(), this.serviceParameterDatapool.getServiceParameter((ServiceParameter)DuServiceParameter.MODEL_NAME)));
          continue;
        case MANUFACTURING_DATE:
          collectResponse.put(mapEntry.getKey().getText(), CustomizeResponsesForDisplaying.customizeManufacturingDate(mapEntry.getValue(), I18NUtil.getLocale(), this.rightsManager.getUserLevel()));
          continue;
        case BIKE_DATE_OF_MANUFACTURE:
          collectResponse.put(mapEntry.getKey().getText(), CustomizeResponsesForDisplaying.customizeManufacturingDate(mapEntry.getValue(), I18NUtil.getLocale(), UserLevel.OEM));
          continue;
        case LIGHT_SWITCH_STATUS:
          collectResponse.put(mapEntry.getKey().getText(), CustomizeResponsesForDisplaying.customizeLightSwitchingMode(mapEntry.getValue(), BUNDLE));
          continue;
        case WALK_ASSIST_STATE:
          collectResponse.put(mapEntry.getKey().getText(), CustomizeResponsesForDisplaying.customizeWalkAssistance(mapEntry.getValue()));
          continue;
        case DRIVE_OFF_STATE:
          collectResponse.put(mapEntry.getKey().getText(), CustomizeResponsesForDisplaying.customizeDriveOff(mapEntry.getValue()));
          continue;
        case MANIPULATION:
          collectResponse.put(mapEntry.getKey().getText(), CustomizeResponsesForDisplaying.customizeManipulationDetected(mapEntry.getValue(), BUNDLE));
          continue;
        case DISABLER_FUNCTION_STATUS:
          collectResponse.put(mapEntry.getKey().getText(), CustomizeResponsesForDisplaying.customizeDisablerFunctionState(mapEntry.getValue(), BUNDLE));
          continue;
        case DISABLER_STATUS:
          collectResponse.put(mapEntry.getKey().getText(), CustomizeResponsesForDisplaying.customizeDisablerState(mapEntry.getValue(), BUNDLE));
          continue;
        case DISABLER_RECOVERY_IDENTIFIER:
          if (!this.ecuIdentification.getComponentType().isBDU2xx()) {
            collectResponse.put(mapEntry.getKey().getText(), CustomizeResponsesForDisplaying.customizeDisablerIdentNumberDependingOnStatus(mapEntry.getValue(), this.serviceParameterDatapool.getServiceParameter((ServiceParameter)DuServiceParameter.DISABLER_FUNCTION_STATUS)));
            continue;
          } 
          collectResponse.put(mapEntry.getKey().getText(), mapEntry.getValue());
          continue;
        case LIGHT_OUTPUT:
          collectResponse.put(mapEntry.getKey().getText(), CustomizeResponsesForDisplaying.customizeLightPowerSupplyLevel(mapEntry.getValue(), (!this.ecuIdentification.getComponentType().isBDU1xx() && !this.ecuIdentification.getComponentType().isBDU2xx())));
          continue;
      } 
      collectResponse.put(mapEntry.getKey().getText(), mapEntry.getValue());
    } 
    return collectResponse;
  }
  
  private List<ServiceParameter> buildDuCommonServiceParametersRequest() {
    List<ServiceParameter> parametersRequest = new LinkedList<>();
    parametersRequest.add(DuServiceParameter.HW_VERSION);
    parametersRequest.add(DuServiceParameter.SW_VERSION);
    parametersRequest.add(DuServiceParameter.COMPONENT_TYPE);
    if (!this.ecuIdentification.getComponentType().isBDU1xx()) {
      parametersRequest.add(DuServiceParameter.PRODUCT_LINE);
      parametersRequest.add(DuServiceParameter.BIKE_TYPE);
      parametersRequest.add(DuServiceParameter.APPLICATION_ID);
    } else if (this.ecuIdentification.isApplication()) {
      parametersRequest.add(DuServiceParameter.APPLICATION_ID);
    } 
    if (this.ecuIdentification.isApplication()) {
      parametersRequest.add(DuServiceParameter.MANUFACTURING_DATE);
      parametersRequest.add(DuServiceParameter.PART_NUMBER);
      parametersRequest.add(DuServiceParameter.SERIAL_NUMBER);
      parametersRequest.add(DuServiceParameter.BIKE_DATE_OF_MANUFACTURE);
      parametersRequest.add(DuServiceParameter.MANUFACTURE_LOCALISATION);
      parametersRequest.add(DuServiceParameter.BIKE_ID);
      parametersRequest.add(DuServiceParameter.LIGHT_SWITCH_STATUS);
      parametersRequest.add(DuServiceParameter.WALK_ASSIST_STATE);
      parametersRequest.add(DuServiceParameter.WHEELSIZE_CIRCUMFERENCE);
      parametersRequest.add(DuServiceParameter.HIGHEST_WHEEL_RATIO);
      parametersRequest.add(DuServiceParameter.LOWEST_WHEEL_RATIO);
      parametersRequest.add(DuServiceParameter.TOT_ACTIVE_OPERATINGTIME_WITH_ASSIST);
      parametersRequest.add(DuServiceParameter.TOT_PASSIVE_OPERATINGTIME_WITHOUT_ASSIST);
      parametersRequest.add(DuServiceParameter.MAX_SPEED_FOR_ASSISTANCE);
    } 
    return parametersRequest;
  }
  
  private List<ServiceParameter> buildDuVictorServiceParametersRequest() {
    List<ServiceParameter> parametersRequest = buildDuCommonServiceParametersRequest();
    if (this.ecuIdentification.isApplication()) {
      parametersRequest.add(DuServiceParameter.BATTERY_LOCK_KEY_NUMBER);
      parametersRequest.add(DuServiceParameter.PRODUCT_CODE);
      parametersRequest.add(DuServiceParameter.HMI_LESS_SYSTEM);
      parametersRequest.add(DuServiceParameter.WHEELSIZE_CORRECTION);
      parametersRequest.add(DuServiceParameter.LIGHT_OUTPUT);
      parametersRequest.add(DuServiceParameter.DRIVE_OFF_STATE);
      parametersRequest.add(DuServiceParameter.ODOMETER);
      parametersRequest.add(DuServiceParameter.MANIPULATION);
      parametersRequest.add(DuServiceParameter.MANIPULATIONS_NUMBER);
      parametersRequest.add(DuServiceParameter.AUTO_DOWN_SHIFT);
      parametersRequest.add(DuServiceParameter.DEFAULT_GEAR);
      parametersRequest.add(DuServiceParameter.TOT_ACTIVE_OPERATINGTIME_WITH_ASSIST);
      parametersRequest.add(DuServiceParameter.TOT_PASSIVE_OPERATINGTIME_WITHOUT_ASSIST);
      parametersRequest.add(DuServiceParameter.MODEL_YEAR);
      parametersRequest.add(DuServiceParameter.HIGH_POWER_PORT);
      parametersRequest.add(DuServiceParameter.DISABLER_FUNCTION_STATUS);
      parametersRequest.add(DuServiceParameter.DISABLER_STATUS);
      parametersRequest.add(DuServiceParameter.DISABLER_RECOVERY_IDENTIFIER);
      if (!this.ecuIdentification.getComponentType().isBDU2xx())
        parametersRequest.add(DuServiceParameter.LIGHT_POWER); 
      parametersRequest.add(DuServiceParameter.WHEELSIZE_CIRCUMFERENCE_CHECKSUM);
      parametersRequest.add(DuServiceParameter.ABS_VARIANT_ID);
      parametersRequest.add(DuServiceParameter.ABS_VARIANT_ID_CHECKSUM);
      parametersRequest.add(DuServiceParameter.AUTO_GEAR);
      parametersRequest.add(DuServiceParameter.AUTO_DOWN_SHIFT);
      parametersRequest.add(DuServiceParameter.DEFAULT_GEAR);
    } 
    return parametersRequest;
  }
  
  private List<ServiceParameter> buildDuClassicServiceParametersRequest() {
    List<ServiceParameter> parametersRequest = buildDuCommonServiceParametersRequest();
    if (this.ecuIdentification.isApplication()) {
      parametersRequest.add(DuServiceParameter.MAX_ALLOWED_MOTOR_POWER);
      parametersRequest.add(DuServiceParameter.MOTOR_GEAR_RATIO);
      parametersRequest.add(DuServiceParameter.START_OF_SLEEP_MODE);
    } 
    return parametersRequest;
  }

    super.clear();
    resetStatisticsTablePart();
  }

    return this.rowWithChart;
  }

  protected Map<String, ComplexResponse> getData(boolean readFromEcu) {
    Map<String, ComplexResponse> diagnosticTabData = new HashMap<>();
    if (this.bikeIdentification.getDuIdentification().isApplication() && this.bikeIdentification.getSystemType() == Constants.SystemType.VICTOR)
      switch (this.bikeIdentification.getEShiftIdentification().getGearPropertiesReceived()) {
        case TRUE_AVAILABLE:
          if (readFromEcu) {
            diagnosticTabData.putAll(formatDatapoolToTable(this.serviceParameterDatapool.getCleanServiceParameterBundle(buildEshiftRequest())));
          } else {
            diagnosticTabData.putAll(formatDatapoolToTable(this.serviceParameterDatapool.getServiceParameterBundle(buildEshiftRequest())));
          } 
          break;
        case FALSE:
          diagnosticTabData.put(EShiftServiceParameter.HW_VERSION.getText(), new ComplexResponse(this.pendingResponseTextForEshiftParameter));
          diagnosticTabData.put(EShiftServiceParameter.PRODUCT_ID.getText(), new ComplexResponse(this.pendingResponseTextForEshiftParameter));
          diagnosticTabData.put(EShiftServiceParameter.SERIAL_NUMBER.getText(), new ComplexResponse(this.pendingResponseTextForEshiftParameter));
          diagnosticTabData.put(EShiftServiceParameter.SW_VERSION.getText(), new ComplexResponse(this.pendingResponseTextForEshiftParameter));
          diagnosticTabData.put(EShiftServiceParameter.VENDOR_ID.getText(), new ComplexResponse(this.pendingResponseTextForEshiftParameter));
          diagnosticTabData.put(EShiftServiceParameter.GEARBOX_TYPE.getText(), new ComplexResponse(this.pendingResponseTextForEshiftParameter));
          diagnosticTabData.put(EShiftServiceParameter.NUMBER_OF_GEARS.getText(), new ComplexResponse(this.pendingResponseTextForEshiftParameter));
          break;
        default:
          diagnosticTabData.put(EShiftServiceParameter.HW_VERSION.getText(), new ComplexResponse(NegativeResponse.REQUEST_OUT_OF_RANGE));
          diagnosticTabData.put(EShiftServiceParameter.PRODUCT_ID.getText(), new ComplexResponse(NegativeResponse.REQUEST_OUT_OF_RANGE));
          diagnosticTabData.put(EShiftServiceParameter.SERIAL_NUMBER.getText(), new ComplexResponse(NegativeResponse.REQUEST_OUT_OF_RANGE));
          diagnosticTabData.put(EShiftServiceParameter.SW_VERSION.getText(), new ComplexResponse(NegativeResponse.REQUEST_OUT_OF_RANGE));
          diagnosticTabData.put(EShiftServiceParameter.VENDOR_ID.getText(), new ComplexResponse(NegativeResponse.REQUEST_OUT_OF_RANGE));
          diagnosticTabData.put(EShiftServiceParameter.GEARBOX_TYPE.getText(), new ComplexResponse(NegativeResponse.REQUEST_OUT_OF_RANGE));
          diagnosticTabData.put(EShiftServiceParameter.NUMBER_OF_GEARS.getText(), new ComplexResponse(NegativeResponse.REQUEST_OUT_OF_RANGE));
          break;
      }  
    return diagnosticTabData;
  }
  
  private List<ServiceParameter> buildEshiftRequest() {
    List<ServiceParameter> parametersToRequest = new LinkedList<>();
    parametersToRequest.add(EShiftServiceParameter.HW_VERSION);
    parametersToRequest.add(EShiftServiceParameter.PRODUCT_ID);
    parametersToRequest.add(EShiftServiceParameter.SERIAL_NUMBER);
    parametersToRequest.add(EShiftServiceParameter.SW_VERSION);
    parametersToRequest.add(EShiftServiceParameter.VENDOR_ID);
    parametersToRequest.add(EShiftServiceParameter.GEARBOX_TYPE);
    parametersToRequest.add(EShiftServiceParameter.NUMBER_OF_GEARS);
    return parametersToRequest;
  }
  
  private Map<String, ComplexResponse> formatDatapoolToTable(Map<ServiceParameter, ComplexResponse> inputDatapool) {
    Map<String, ComplexResponse> collectResponse = new HashMap<>();
    for (Map.Entry<ServiceParameter, ComplexResponse> mapEntry : inputDatapool.entrySet()) {
      if (mapEntry.getKey() == EShiftServiceParameter.SERIAL_NUMBER) {
        collectResponse.put(mapEntry.getKey().getText(), CustomizeResponsesForDisplaying.customizeSerialNumberEshift(mapEntry.getValue(), this.serviceParameterDatapool.getServiceParameter((ServiceParameter)EShiftServiceParameter.VENDOR_ID)));
        continue;
      } 
      collectResponse.put(mapEntry.getKey().getText(), mapEntry.getValue());
    } 
    return collectResponse;
  }
