  }
  
  public void readAndFillUDAM() {
    if (this.bikeIdentification.getHmiIdentification().getComponentType().isNyon() && this.bikeIdentification.getHmiIdentification().isApplication()) {
      ComplexResponse response = this.serviceParameterDatapool.getServiceParameter((ServiceParameter)HmiServiceParameter.UDAM_DATA);
      try {
        setUdamDataSet(response.getParameterByName("UserDefinedAssistanceMode1").getValue(), 
            response.getParameterByName("UserDefinedAssistanceMode2").getValue(), 
            response.getParameterByName("UserDefinedAssistanceMode3").getValue(), 
            response.getParameterByName("UserDefinedAssistanceMode4").getValue());
      } catch (ComplexResponse.DataAccessException ex) {
        LOGGER.error("Error reading and parsing UDMs", (Throwable)ex);
      } 
      getUdamPanel()[0].setVisible(true);
    } else {
      getUdamPanel()[0].setVisible(false);
    } 
  }
  
  public synchronized void clear() {
    super.clear();
    clearUdamDataSet();
  }
  
  protected Map<String, ComplexResponse> getData(boolean readFromEcu) {
    List<ServiceParameter> parametersToRetrieve;
    switch (this.bikeIdentification.getHmiIdentification().getComponentType()) {
      case COMP_BUI210:
      case COMP_BUI215:
        parametersToRetrieve = buildBui21xServiceParametersRequest();
        break;
      case COMP_BUI250:
      case COMP_BUI251:
      case COMP_BUI255:
        parametersToRetrieve = buildBui25xServiceParametersRequest();
        break;
      case COMP_BUI270:
      case COMP_BUI275:
        parametersToRetrieve = buildBui27xServiceParametersRequest();
        break;
      case COMP_BUI330:
        parametersToRetrieve = buildBui33xServiceParametersRequest();
        break;
      case COMP_BUI350:
        parametersToRetrieve = buildBui35xServiceParametersRequest();
        break;
      case COMP_CUI100:
        parametersToRetrieve = buildCui100ServiceParametersRequest();
        break;
      default:
        parametersToRetrieve = new LinkedList<>();
        break;
    } 
    return readFromEcu ? formatDatapoolToTable(this.serviceParameterDatapool.getCleanServiceParameterBundle(parametersToRetrieve)) : 
      formatDatapoolToTable(this.serviceParameterDatapool.getServiceParameterBundle(parametersToRetrieve));
  }
  
  private Map<String, ComplexResponse> formatDatapoolToTable(Map<ServiceParameter, ComplexResponse> inputDatapool) {
    Map<String, ComplexResponse> collectResponse = new HashMap<>();
    for (Map.Entry<ServiceParameter, ComplexResponse> mapEntry : inputDatapool.entrySet()) {
      switch ((HmiServiceParameter)mapEntry.getKey()) {
        case SERIAL_NUMBER:
          formatSerialNumber(collectResponse, mapEntry);
          continue;
        case PART_NUMBER:
          collectResponse.put(mapEntry.getKey().getText(), formatPartNumberToDisplay(mapEntry.getValue()));
          continue;
        case MANUFACTURING_DATE:
          collectResponse.put(mapEntry.getKey().getText(), CustomizeResponsesForDisplaying.customizeManufacturingDate(mapEntry.getValue(), I18NUtil.getLocale(), this.rightsManager.getUserLevel()));
          continue;
        case PRESENT_DATE:
          collectResponse.put(mapEntry.getKey().getText(), CustomizeResponsesForDisplaying.customizeManufacturingDate(mapEntry.getValue(), I18NUtil.getLocale(), UserLevel.OEM));
          continue;
        case SW_VERSION:
          collectResponse.put(mapEntry.getKey().getText(), formatSwVersionToDisplay(mapEntry.getValue()));
          continue;
        case MAP_VERSION_REQUIRED:
          collectResponse.put(mapEntry.getKey().getText(), NyonFlashValidationUtil.customizedMapVersion(mapEntry.getValue()));
          continue;
        case LANGUAGE:
          collectResponse.put(mapEntry.getKey().getText(), customizeLanguage(mapEntry.getValue()));
          continue;
        case CLOCK_FORMAT:
          collectResponse.put(mapEntry.getKey().getText(), customizeClockFormat(mapEntry.getValue()));
          continue;
      } 
      collectResponse.put(mapEntry.getKey().getText(), mapEntry.getValue());
    } 
    return collectResponse;
  }
  
  private void formatSerialNumber(Map<String, ComplexResponse> collectResponse, Map.Entry<ServiceParameter, ComplexResponse> mapEntry) {
    switch (this.bikeIdentification.getHmiIdentification().getComponentType()) {
      case COMP_BUI210:
      case COMP_BUI215:
        collectResponse.put(mapEntry.getKey().getText(), SerialNumberHelper.getSerialnumberBui21x(mapEntry.getValue()));
        break;
      case COMP_BUI250:
      case COMP_BUI251:
      case COMP_BUI255:
        collectResponse.put(mapEntry.getKey().getText(), SerialNumberHelper.getSerialnumberBui25x(mapEntry.getValue()));
        break;
      case COMP_BUI270:
      case COMP_BUI275:
        collectResponse.put(mapEntry.getKey().getText(), SerialNumberHelper.getSerialnumberBui27x(mapEntry.getValue()));
        break;
      case COMP_BUI330:
        collectResponse.put(mapEntry.getKey().getText(), SerialNumberHelper.getSerialnumberBui33x(mapEntry.getValue()));
        break;
      default:
        collectResponse.put(mapEntry.getKey().getText(), mapEntry.getValue());
        break;
    } 
  }
  
  private List<ServiceParameter> buildBui21xServiceParametersRequest() {
    List<ServiceParameter> parametersRequest = new LinkedList<>();
    buildManufacturerInformationRequest(parametersRequest);
    parametersRequest.add(HmiServiceParameter.SW_VERSION);
    if (this.hmiIdentification.isApplication()) {
      parametersRequest.add(HmiServiceParameter.MANUFACTURING_DATE);
      parametersRequest.add(HmiServiceParameter.PRODUCT_CODE);
      parametersRequest.add(HmiServiceParameter.DISTANCE_UNIT);
      parametersRequest.add(HmiServiceParameter.TRIP_DISTANCE);
      parametersRequest.add(HmiServiceParameter.BATTERY_STATE);
    } 
    return parametersRequest;
  }
  
  private List<ServiceParameter> buildBui25xServiceParametersRequest() {
    List<ServiceParameter> parametersRequest = new LinkedList<>();
    parametersRequest.add(HmiServiceParameter.SERIAL_NUMBER);
    parametersRequest.add(HmiServiceParameter.COMPONENT_TYPE);
    parametersRequest.add(HmiServiceParameter.SW_VERSION);
    if (this.hmiIdentification.isApplication()) {
      parametersRequest.add(HmiServiceParameter.PART_NUMBER);
      parametersRequest.add(HmiServiceParameter.HW_VERSION);
      parametersRequest.add(HmiServiceParameter.COMPONENT);
      parametersRequest.add(HmiServiceParameter.MANUFACTURING_DATE);
      parametersRequest.add(HmiServiceParameter.PRODUCT_CODE);
      parametersRequest.add(HmiServiceParameter.DISTANCE_UNIT);
      parametersRequest.add(HmiServiceParameter.TRIP_DISTANCE);
      parametersRequest.add(HmiServiceParameter.TRIP_TIME);
      parametersRequest.add(HmiServiceParameter.LANGUAGE);
      parametersRequest.add(HmiServiceParameter.PRESENT_TIME);
      parametersRequest.add(HmiServiceParameter.PRESENT_DATE);
      parametersRequest.add(HmiServiceParameter.CLOCK_FORMAT);
      parametersRequest.add(HmiServiceParameter.MAX_SPEED);
    } 
    return parametersRequest;
  }
  
  private List<ServiceParameter> buildBui27xServiceParametersRequest() {
    List<ServiceParameter> parametersRequest = new LinkedList<>();
    parametersRequest.add(HmiServiceParameter.COMPONENT_TYPE);
    if (this.hmiIdentification.isApplication()) {
      buildExtendedManufacturerInformationRequest(parametersRequest);
      parametersRequest.add(HmiServiceParameter.TRIP_DISTANCE);
      parametersRequest.add(HmiServiceParameter.TRIP_TIME);
      parametersRequest.add(HmiServiceParameter.PRESENT_TIME);
      parametersRequest.add(HmiServiceParameter.PRESENT_DATE);
      parametersRequest.add(HmiServiceParameter.MAX_SPEED);
      parametersRequest.add(HmiServiceParameter.SW_VERSION);
      parametersRequest.add(HmiServiceParameter.SW_VERSION_FRONTEND);
      parametersRequest.add(HmiServiceParameter.MAP_VERSION_REQUIRED);
      parametersRequest.add(HmiServiceParameter.BATTERY_CHARGE_VALUE);
      parametersRequest.add(HmiServiceParameter.UDAM_DATA);
    } 
    return parametersRequest;
  }
  
  private List<ServiceParameter> buildBui33xServiceParametersRequest() {
    List<ServiceParameter> parametersRequest = new LinkedList<>();
    buildManufacturerInformationRequest(parametersRequest);
    parametersRequest.add(HmiServiceParameter.SW_VERSION);
    if (this.hmiIdentification.isApplication()) {
      parametersRequest.add(HmiServiceParameter.MANUFACTURING_DATE);
      parametersRequest.add(HmiServiceParameter.PRODUCT_CODE);
      parametersRequest.add(HmiServiceParameter.PRESENT_TIME);
      parametersRequest.add(HmiServiceParameter.PRESENT_DATE);
      parametersRequest.add(HmiServiceParameter.CLOCK_FORMAT);
      parametersRequest.add(HmiServiceParameter.MAX_SPEED);
      if (this.hmiIdentification.isNewGenerationKiox()) {
        parametersRequest.add(HmiServiceParameter.DISTANCE_UNIT);
        parametersRequest.add(HmiServiceParameter.LANGUAGE);
      } 
    } 
    return parametersRequest;
  }
  
  private List<ServiceParameter> buildBui35xServiceParametersRequest() {
    List<ServiceParameter> parametersRequest = new LinkedList<>();
    buildManufacturerInformationRequest(parametersRequest);
    parametersRequest.add(HmiServiceParameter.MANUFACTURING_DATE);
    parametersRequest.add(HmiServiceParameter.PRODUCT_CODE);
    parametersRequest.add(HmiServiceParameter.SW_VERSION);
    parametersRequest.add(HmiServiceParameter.MAP_VERSION_REQUIRED);
    if (this.hmiIdentification.isApplication()) {
      parametersRequest.add(HmiServiceParameter.DISTANCE_UNIT);
      parametersRequest.add(HmiServiceParameter.LANGUAGE);
      parametersRequest.add(HmiServiceParameter.PRESENT_TIME);
      parametersRequest.add(HmiServiceParameter.PRESENT_DATE);
      parametersRequest.add(HmiServiceParameter.MAX_SPEED);
      parametersRequest.add(HmiServiceParameter.BATTERY_CHARGE_VALUE);
      parametersRequest.add(HmiServiceParameter.UDAM_DATA);
    } 
    return parametersRequest;
  }
  
  private List<ServiceParameter> buildCui100ServiceParametersRequest() {
    List<ServiceParameter> parametersRequest = new LinkedList<>();
    parametersRequest.add(HmiServiceParameter.COMPONENT_TYPE);
    if (this.hmiIdentification.isApplication()) {
      buildExtendedManufacturerInformationRequest(parametersRequest);
      parametersRequest.add(HmiServiceParameter.SW_VERSION);
    } 
    return parametersRequest;
  }
  
  private void buildExtendedManufacturerInformationRequest(List<ServiceParameter> parametersRequest) {
    parametersRequest.add(HmiServiceParameter.PART_NUMBER);
    parametersRequest.add(HmiServiceParameter.SERIAL_NUMBER);
    parametersRequest.add(HmiServiceParameter.HW_VERSION);
    parametersRequest.add(HmiServiceParameter.COMPONENT);
    parametersRequest.add(HmiServiceParameter.MANUFACTURING_DATE);
    parametersRequest.add(HmiServiceParameter.PRODUCT_CODE);
  }
  
  private void buildManufacturerInformationRequest(List<ServiceParameter> parametersRequest) {
    parametersRequest.add(HmiServiceParameter.PART_NUMBER);
    parametersRequest.add(HmiServiceParameter.SERIAL_NUMBER);
    parametersRequest.add(HmiServiceParameter.HW_VERSION);
    parametersRequest.add(HmiServiceParameter.COMPONENT_TYPE);
    parametersRequest.add(HmiServiceParameter.COMPONENT);
  }
  
  private ComplexResponse customizeLanguage(ComplexResponse value) {
    try {
      return new ComplexResponse(I18NUtil.convIso2DisplayName(value.getString()));
    } catch (ComplexResponse.DataAccessException ex) {
      LOGGER.error("Parsing language response failed.", (Throwable)ex);
      return value;
    } 
  }
  
  private ComplexResponse customizeClockFormat(ComplexResponse value) {
    try {
      String[] displayedValueSplit = StringUtils.split(value.getString().trim(), " ");
      return (displayedValueSplit == null) ? value : new ComplexResponse(displayedValueSplit[1]);
    } catch (ComplexResponse.DataAccessException ex) {
      LOGGER.error("Parsing clock format response failed.", (Throwable)ex);
      return value;
    } 
  }
}

  public synchronized void setBcsVisible(boolean visible) {
    this.pnlBcs.setVisible(visible);
    this.pnl.setVisible((visible || this.pnlAbs.isVisible()));
    rearrangePanelsAbsBcs();
  }
  
  private void rearrangePanelsAbsBcs() {
    GridBagLayout layout = (GridBagLayout)getLayout();
    if (this.pnlBcs.isVisible()) {
      if (this.pnlAbs.isVisible()) {
        GridBagConstraints gbc = layout.getConstraints(this.pnlBcs);
        gbc.gridx = 1;
        gbc.insets = new Insets(0, 0, 5, 5);
        layout.setConstraints(this.pnlBcs, gbc);
        gbc = layout.getConstraints(this.pnl);
        gbc.gridx = 2;
        layout.setConstraints(this.pnl, gbc);
      } else {
        GridBagConstraints gbc = layout.getConstraints(this.pnlBcs);
        gbc.gridx = 0;
        gbc.insets = new Insets(0, 5, 5, 5);
        layout.setConstraints(this.pnlBcs, gbc);
        gbc = layout.getConstraints(this.pnl);
        gbc.gridx = 1;
        layout.setConstraints(this.pnl, gbc);
      } 
    } else {
      GridBagConstraints gbc = layout.getConstraints(this.pnlBcs);
      gbc.gridx = 1;
      gbc.insets = new Insets(0, 0, 5, 5);
      layout.setConstraints(this.pnlBcs, gbc);
      gbc = layout.getConstraints(this.pnl);
      gbc.gridx = 1;
      layout.setConstraints(this.pnl, gbc);
    } 
    revalidate();
    repaint();
  }
  
  public HeaderInfoPanel getHeaderInfoPanel() {
    return this.pnlHeaderInfoPanel;
  }
}

package com.gigatronik.beds.gui.panels.header;

import com.gigatronik.beds.common.order.OrderableListener;
import com.gigatronik.beds.gui.color.GuiColors;
import com.gigatronik.beds.gui.service.guimanager.api.GuiManager;
import com.gigatronik.beds.gui.service.guimanager.api.GuiModeChangedListener;
import com.gigatronik.beds.gui.service.guimanager.impl.GuiManagerImpl;
import com.gigatronik.beds.samplevalidator.api.SampleValidator;
import com.gigatronik.beds.samplevalidator.impl.SampleValidatorFactory;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.configuration.ConfigurationManager;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.configuration.api.HardwareConnectionChangesListener;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.configuration.event.HardwareConnectionChangedEvent;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.ecuconnectionstate.api.EcuConnectionStateHandler;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.ecuconnectionstate.impl.event.EcuConnectionStateRefreshEvent;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.ecuflash.api.FlashProgressEventListener;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.ecuflash.impl.BaseFlashProcedure;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.ecuflash.impl.event.FlashProgressEvent;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.bosch.service.internationalization.ResourceBundleFactory;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.bosch.service.internationalization.Utf8ResourceBundleFormatted;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.common.configuration.BikeIdentification;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.common.configuration.ComponentType;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.common.configuration.Constants;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.common.configuration.EcuIdentification;
import java.awt.Color;
import java.awt.EventQueue;
import org.slf4j.Logger;
import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;

public class EBikeHeaderPanelController implements EcuConnectionStateHandler.EcuConnectionStateRefreshListener, FlashProgressEventListener, GuiModeChangedListener, HardwareConnectionChangesListener {
  private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(EBikeHeaderPanelController.class);
  
  private static final Utf8ResourceBundleFormatted BUNDLE = ResourceBundleFactory.newDefaultResourceBundle();
  
  private static final Color RED = GuiColors.RED;
  
  private static final Color ORANGE = Color.ORANGE;
  
  private static final Color GREEN = GuiColors.GREEN;
  
  private static final Color SAMPLE_ECU = new Color(153, 0, 61);
  
  private static final Color PANEL_BLUE = GuiColors.LIGHT_BLUISH;
  
  private static final int BBP1 = 1;
  
  private static final int BBP2 = 2;
  
  private static final int ONE_BATTERY = 1;
  
  private static final int TWO_BATTERIES = 2;
  
  private static final String BCT_CON_LBL_TEXT = ComponentType.COMP_BCT100.getDisplayName() + ":";
  
  private static final String ABS_CON_LBL_TEXT = BUNDLE.getString("ComponentType." + ComponentType.COMP_BBA100) + ":";
  
  private static final String BCS_CON_LBL_TEXT = ComponentType.COMP_BCS250.getDisplayName() + ":";
  
  private static final String BBP_TOOLTIP_TEXT_GENERIC = BUNDLE.getString("EBikeHeader.panel_BaPa.toolTipText");
  
  private static final String NOT_CONNECTED = BUNDLE.getString("EBikeHeader.NOT_CONNECTED");
  
  private static final String CONNECTED_APP = BUNDLE.getString("EBikeHeader.CONNECTED");
  
  private static final String CONNECTED_FBL = BUNDLE.getString("EBikeHeader.CONNECTED_BOOTLOADER");
  
  private static final String CONNECTED_PROGRAMMING = BUNDLE.getString("EBikeHeader.CONNECTED_PROGRAMMING");
  
  private static final String LABEL_POWERPACK = BUNDLE.getString("EBikeServiceTab.TAB_BAPA");
  
  private static final String LABEL_POWERTUBE = BUNDLE.getString("ProductName.powerTube");
  
  private static final String SAMPLE_APPENDIX = " | " + BUNDLE.getString("EBikeHeader.Sample");
  
  private final transient BikeIdentification bikeIdentification;
  
  private final transient ConfigurationManager configurationManager;
  
  private final transient EcuConnectionStateHandler ecuConnectionStateHandler;
  
  private final transient EBikeHeaderPanel pnlHeader;
  
  private final transient SampleValidator sampleValidator;
  
  public EBikeHeaderPanelController(EBikeHeaderPanel panel, ConfigurationManager configurationManager, EcuConnectionStateHandler ecuConnectionStateHandler) {
    this.pnlHeader = panel;
    this.configurationManager = configurationManager;
    this.bikeIdentification = configurationManager.getBikeIdentification();
    this.ecuConnectionStateHandler = ecuConnectionStateHandler;
    this.sampleValidator = SampleValidatorFactory.getSampleValidator();
    init();
  }
  
  private void init() {
    GuiManagerImpl.getInstance().addGuiModeChangedListener(this);
    this.configurationManager.addListener((OrderableListener)this);
    this.ecuConnectionStateHandler.subscribeEcuConnectionStateRefreshEvents(this);
    this.pnlHeader.setPowerPack1Label(mapBatteryLabel((EcuIdentification)this.bikeIdentification.getBms1Identification()) + ":");
    this.pnlHeader.setPowerPack1Tooltip(String.format(BBP_TOOLTIP_TEXT_GENERIC, mapBatteryLabel((EcuIdentification)this.bikeIdentification.getBms1Identification())));
  }
  
  public void setBikeNotConnected() {
    this.pnlHeader.setBctVisible(false);
    this.pnlHeader.setBcsVisible(false);
    this.pnlHeader.setAbsVisible(false);
    this.pnlHeader.setPowerPack2Visible(false);
    this.pnlHeader.setHmiState(NOT_CONNECTED, RED, PANEL_BLUE);
    this.pnlHeader.setDuState(NOT_CONNECTED, RED, PANEL_BLUE);
    this.pnlHeader.setPowerPack1State(NOT_CONNECTED, RED, PANEL_BLUE);
  }
  
  private void onBctConnected(Color color, String text, Color panelBackground) {
    this.pnlHeader.setBctLabel(BCT_CON_LBL_TEXT);
    setFirstRowVisible(false);
    this.pnlHeader.setPowerPack2Visible(false);
    this.pnlHeader.setAbsVisible(false);
    this.pnlHeader.setBctVisible(true);
    this.pnlHeader.setBctState(text, color, panelBackground);
  }
  
  private void onAbsConnected(boolean connected, Color color, String text, Color panelBackground) {
    this.pnlHeader.setAbsLabel(ABS_CON_LBL_TEXT);
    this.pnlHeader.setAbsVisible(connected);
    this.pnlHeader.setBctVisible(false);
    this.pnlHeader.setAbsState(text, color, panelBackground);
  }
  
  private void onBcsConnected(boolean connected, Color color, String text, Color panelBackground) {
    this.pnlHeader.setBcsLabel(BCS_CON_LBL_TEXT);
    this.pnlHeader.setBcsVisible(connected);
    this.pnlHeader.setBctVisible(false);
    this.pnlHeader.setBcsState(text, color, panelBackground);
  }
  
  private void onHmiConnected(boolean connected, Color color, String text, Color panelBackground) {
    setFirstRowVisible(true);
    if (!connected) {
      this.pnlHeader.setPowerPack2Visible(false);
      this.pnlHeader.setAbsVisible(false);
    } 
    this.pnlHeader.setBctVisible(false);
    this.pnlHeader.setHmiState(text, color, panelBackground);
  }
  
  private void onDuConnected(Color color, String text, Color panelBackground) {
    this.pnlHeader.setDuState(text, color, panelBackground);
  }
  
  private void onFirstPpConnected(boolean connected, Color color, String text, Color panelBackground) {
    boolean dualBatteryBike = this.bikeIdentification.isBms2Connected();
    setBatteryDisplayNames(connected, dualBatteryBike ? 2 : 1);
    this.pnlHeader.setPowerPack1State(text, color, panelBackground);
  }
  
  private void onSecondPpConnected(boolean connected, Color color, String text, Color panelBackground) {
    this.pnlHeader.setPowerPack2Visible(connected);
    setBatteryDisplayNames(connected, 2);
    this.pnlHeader.setPowerPack2State(text, color, panelBackground);
  }
  
  public void onEcuConnectionStateRefresh(EcuConnectionStateRefreshEvent event) {
    LOGGER.debug("EcuConnectionStateRefreshEvent received: '{}'", event);
    EventQueue.invokeLater(() -> onEcuConnect(event.getEcuType(), event.getEcuMode()));
  }
  
  private void onEcuConnect(Constants.EcuType type, Constants.EcuMode mode) {
    boolean sampleEcu = this.sampleValidator.checkEcuForSample(type, this.bikeIdentification);
    notifyComponent(true, type, getStatusColor(mode), getStatusText(mode, sampleEcu), getPanelBackgroundColor(sampleEcu));
  }
  
  private synchronized void notifyComponent(boolean connected, Constants.EcuType type, Color color, String text, Color panelBackground) {
    switch (type) {
      case BCS250:
        onBcsConnected(connected, color, text, panelBackground);
        break;
      case BCT:
        onBctConnected(color, text, panelBackground);
        break;
      case BAS100:
        onAbsConnected(connected, color, text, panelBackground);
        break;
      case BUI21X:
      case BUI25X:
      case BUI270:
      case BUI275:
      case BUI330:
      case BUI350:
      case COBI:
        onHmiConnected(connected, color, text, panelBackground);
        break;
      case CLASSIC_DU:
      case VICTOR_DU:
        onDuConnected(color, text, panelBackground);
        break;
      case CLASSIC_PP:
      case VICTOR_PP1:
        onFirstPpConnected(connected, color, text, panelBackground);
        break;
      case VICTOR_PP2:
        onSecondPpConnected(connected, color, text, panelBackground);
        break;
    } 
  }
  
  private void onEcuDisconnect(Constants.EcuType type) {
    String text = NOT_CONNECTED;
    Color color = RED;
    Color pnlBackground = getPanelBackgroundColor(false);
    notifyComponent(false, type, color, text, pnlBackground);
  }
  
  private void setBatteryDisplayNames(boolean connected, int numberOfBatteries) {
    if (numberOfBatteries == 1) {
      adjustPp1DisplayName(connected);
    } else if (numberOfBatteries == 2) {
      adjustPp2DisplayName(connected);
    } 
  }
  
  private void adjustPp1DisplayName(boolean connected) {
    if (connected) {
      this.pnlHeader.setPowerPack1Label(mapBatteryLabel((EcuIdentification)this.bikeIdentification.getBms1Identification()) + ":");
      this.pnlHeader.setPowerPack1Tooltip(String.format(BBP_TOOLTIP_TEXT_GENERIC, mapBatteryLabel((EcuIdentification)this.bikeIdentification.getBms1Identification())));
    } else {
      this.pnlHeader.setPowerPack1Label(LABEL_POWERPACK + ":");
      this.pnlHeader.setPowerPack1Tooltip(String.format(BBP_TOOLTIP_TEXT_GENERIC, LABEL_POWERPACK));
    } 
  }
  
  private void adjustPp2DisplayName(boolean connected) {
    if (connected) {
      this.pnlHeader.setPowerPack1Label(mapBatteryLabel((EcuIdentification)this.bikeIdentification.getBms1Identification()) + " 1:");
      this.pnlHeader.setPowerPack1Tooltip(String.format(BBP_TOOLTIP_TEXT_GENERIC, mapBatteryLabel((EcuIdentification)this.bikeIdentification.getBms1Identification())));
      this.pnlHeader.setPowerPack2Label(mapBatteryLabel((EcuIdentification)this.bikeIdentification.getBms2Identification()) + " 2:");
      this.pnlHeader.setPowerPack2Tooltip(String.format(BBP_TOOLTIP_TEXT_GENERIC, mapBatteryLabel((EcuIdentification)this.bikeIdentification.getBms2Identification())));
    } else {
      if (this.bikeIdentification.isBms2Connected() && !this.bikeIdentification.isBms1Connected()) {
        this.pnlHeader.setPowerPack1Label(LABEL_POWERPACK + " 1:");
      } else {
        this.pnlHeader.setPowerPack1Label(LABEL_POWERPACK + ":");
      } 
      this.pnlHeader.setPowerPack1Tooltip(String.format(BBP_TOOLTIP_TEXT_GENERIC, LABEL_POWERPACK));
    } 
  }
  
  public void setFirstRowVisible(boolean visible) {
    this.pnlHeader.setHmiVisible(visible);
    this.pnlHeader.setDuVisible(visible);
    this.pnlHeader.setPowerPack1Visible(visible);
  }
  
  public void setHmiState(Constants.EcuMode mode) {
    boolean isSample = this.sampleValidator.checkEcuForSample(Constants.EcuType.BUI21X, this.bikeIdentification);
    this.pnlHeader.setHmiState(getStatusText(mode, isSample), getStatusColor(mode), getPanelBackgroundColor(isSample));
  }
  
  public void setDuState(Constants.EcuMode mode) {
    boolean isSample = this.sampleValidator.checkEcuForSample(Constants.EcuType.VICTOR_DU, this.bikeIdentification);
    this.pnlHeader.setDuState(getStatusText(mode, isSample), getStatusColor(mode), getPanelBackgroundColor(isSample));
  }
  
  public void setPp1State(Constants.EcuMode mode) {
    boolean isSample = this.sampleValidator.checkEcuForSample(Constants.EcuType.VICTOR_PP1, this.bikeIdentification);
    this.pnlHeader.setPowerPack1State(getStatusText(mode, isSample), getStatusColor(mode), getPanelBackgroundColor(isSample));
  }
  
  public void setPp2State(Constants.EcuMode mode) {
    boolean isSample = this.sampleValidator.checkEcuForSample(Constants.EcuType.VICTOR_PP2, this.bikeIdentification);
    this.pnlHeader.setPowerPack2State(getStatusText(mode, isSample), getStatusColor(mode), getPanelBackgroundColor(isSample));
  }
  
  public void setAbsState(Constants.EcuMode mode) {
    boolean isSample = this.sampleValidator.checkEcuForSample(Constants.EcuType.BAS100, this.bikeIdentification);
    this.pnlHeader.setAbsState(getStatusText(mode, isSample), getStatusColor(mode), getPanelBackgroundColor(isSample));
  }
  
  public void setBcsState(Constants.EcuMode mode) {
    boolean isSample = this.sampleValidator.checkEcuForSample(Constants.EcuType.BCS250, this.bikeIdentification);
    this.pnlHeader.setBcsState(getStatusText(mode, isSample), getStatusColor(mode), getPanelBackgroundColor(isSample));
  }
  
  public void setBctState(Constants.EcuMode mode) {
    boolean isSample = this.sampleValidator.checkEcuForSample(Constants.EcuType.BCT, this.bikeIdentification);
    this.pnlHeader.setBctState(getStatusText(mode, isSample), getStatusColor(mode), getPanelBackgroundColor(isSample));
  }
  
  private String getStatusText(Constants.EcuMode mode, boolean isSample) {
    String text;
    switch (mode) {
      case APP:
        text = CONNECTED_APP + CONNECTED_APP;
        break;
      case FBL:
      case MASS_STORAGE:
        text = CONNECTED_FBL;
        break;
      case PROGRAMMING:
        text = CONNECTED_PROGRAMMING + CONNECTED_PROGRAMMING;
        break;
      default:
        text = NOT_CONNECTED;
        break;
    } 
    return text;
  }
  
  private Color getStatusColor(Constants.EcuMode mode) {
    Color color;
    switch (mode) {
      case APP:
        color = GREEN;
        break;
      case FBL:
      case MASS_STORAGE:
      case PROGRAMMING:
        color = ORANGE;
        break;
      default:
        color = RED;
        break;
    } 
    return color;
  }
  
  private String mapBatteryLabel(EcuIdentification config) {
    if (config.getComponentType().isPowerTube())
      return LABEL_POWERTUBE; 
    return LABEL_POWERPACK;
  }
  
  public void onHardwareConnectionChanged(HardwareConnectionChangedEvent event) {
    LOGGER.debug("HardwareConnectionChangedEvent received: '{}'", event);
    switch (event.getAction()) {
      case ECU_CONNECTED:
        EventQueue.invokeLater(() -> onEcuConnect(event.getComponent(), event.getMode()));
        break;
      case ECU_DISCONNECTED:
        EventQueue.invokeLater(() -> onEcuDisconnect(event.getComponent()));
        break;
    } 
  }
  
  public String getOrderingName() {
    return "HeaderPanel";
  }
  
  public void onFlashProgress(FlashProgressEvent event) {
    LOGGER.debug("Received FlashProgressEvent {} {}", event.getComponentType(), Integer.valueOf(event.getProgress()));
    BaseFlashProcedure.FlashProgressType type = event.getProgressType();
    switch (type) {
      case HMI:
        EventQueue.invokeLater(() -> updateHmiState(event.getProgress()));
        break;
      case BCT:
        EventQueue.invokeLater(() -> updateBctState(event.getProgress()));
        break;
      case BCS:
        EventQueue.invokeLater(() -> updateBcsState(event.getProgress()));
        break;
      case DU:
        EventQueue.invokeLater(() -> updateDuState(event.getProgress()));
        break;
      case ABS:
        EventQueue.invokeLater(() -> updateAbsState(event.getProgress()));
        break;
      case BMS1:
        EventQueue.invokeLater(() -> updatePp1State(event.getProgress()));
        break;
      case BMS2:
        EventQueue.invokeLater(() -> updatePp2State(event.getProgress()));
        break;
      default:
        LOGGER.trace("Received unhandled flash progress type: {}", type);
        break;
    } 
  }
  
  private void updateHmiState(int progress) {
    if (progress > 0 && progress < 100) {
      setHmiState(Constants.EcuMode.PROGRAMMING);
      setDuState(Constants.EcuMode.NONE);
      setPp1State(Constants.EcuMode.NONE);
      setPp2State(Constants.EcuMode.NONE);
      setAbsState(Constants.EcuMode.NONE);
    } else if (progress == 100) {
      setHmiState(Constants.EcuMode.APP);
    } 
  }
  
  private void updateBctState(int progress) {
    if (progress > 0 && progress < 100) {
      setBctState(Constants.EcuMode.PROGRAMMING);
    } else if (progress == 100) {
      setBctState(Constants.EcuMode.APP);
    } 
  }
  
  private void updateBcsState(int progress) {
    if (progress > 0 && progress < 100) {
      setBcsState(Constants.EcuMode.PROGRAMMING);
    } else if (progress == 100) {
      setBcsState(Constants.EcuMode.APP);
    } 
  }
  
  private void updateAbsState(int progress) {
    if (progress > 0 && progress < 100) {
      setAbsState(Constants.EcuMode.PROGRAMMING);
    } else if (progress == 100) {
      setAbsState(Constants.EcuMode.APP);
    } 
  }
  
  private void updateDuState(int progress) {
    if (progress > 0 && progress < 100) {
      setDuState(Constants.EcuMode.PROGRAMMING);
    } else if (progress == 100) {
      setDuState(Constants.EcuMode.APP);
    } 
  }
  
  private void updatePp1State(int progress) {
    if (progress > 0 && progress < 100) {
      setPp1State(Constants.EcuMode.PROGRAMMING);
    } else if (progress == 100) {
      setPp1State(Constants.EcuMode.APP);
      if (!this.bikeIdentification.isBms2Connected())
        setDuState(this.bikeIdentification.getDuIdentification().getMode()); 
    } 
  }
  
  private void updatePp2State(int progress) {
    if (progress > 0 && progress < 100) {
      setPp2State(Constants.EcuMode.PROGRAMMING);
    } else if (progress == 100) {
      setPp2State(Constants.EcuMode.APP);
      setDuState(this.bikeIdentification.getDuIdentification().getMode());
    } 
  }
  
  private Color getPanelBackgroundColor(boolean isSample) {
    if (isSample)
      return SAMPLE_ECU; 
    return PANEL_BLUE;
  }
  
  public void onGuiModeChanged(GuiManager.GuiMode newMode, GuiManager.GuiMode oldMode) {
    switch (newMode) {
      case EBIKE:
        if (!this.bikeIdentification.isHmiConnected()) {
          setBikeNotConnected();
          setFirstRowVisible(true);
        } 
        break;
      case BCT:
        if (!this.bikeIdentification.isBctConnected())
          onEcuDisconnect(Constants.EcuType.BCT); 
        break;
      case BCS:
        if (!this.bikeIdentification.isBcsConnected())
          onEcuDisconnect(Constants.EcuType.BCS250); 
        break;
    } 
  }
}

package com.gigatronik.beds.gui.panels.header;

import com.gigatronik.beds.common.order.OrderableListener;

public class HeaderInfoPanelController implements Serializable, RightsChangedEventListener, PreliminaryContainerDownloaderListener, BikeConfigurationChangesListener, ContainerConfigurationChangesListener, HardwareConnectionChangesListener {
  private static final Utf8ResourceBundleFormatted BUNDLE = ResourceBundleFactory.newDefaultResourceBundle();
  
  private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(HeaderInfoPanelController.class);
  
  private static final long serialVersionUID = -4385949859673083369L;
  
  private static final String LABEL_APP_ID = BUNDLE.getString("EBikeHeader.AppID");
  
  private static final String LABEL_PRODUCT_LINE = BUNDLE.getString("EBikeHeader.PRODUCT_LINE");
  
  private static final String LABEL_BIKE_ID = BUNDLE.getString("EBikeHeader.eBikeID");
  
  private static final String EMPTY_VERSION = "0.0.0.0";
  
  private final transient BikeIdentification bikeIdentification;
  
  private final transient BoschContainerController cffController;
  
  private final transient ConfigurationManager configurationManager;
  
  private final transient RightsManager rightsmanager;
  
  private final transient GuiManager guiManager;
  
  private final transient HeaderInfoPanel pnlHeaderInfo;
  
  private boolean bikeModelSetInHeaderPanel = false;
  
  public HeaderInfoPanelController(HeaderInfoPanel panel, RightsManager rightsmanager, ConfigurationManager configurationManager) {
    this.pnlHeaderInfo = panel;
    this.rightsmanager = rightsmanager;
    this.bikeIdentification = configurationManager.getBikeIdentification();
    this.cffController = configurationManager.getContainerConfiguration().getContainerController();
    this.configurationManager = configurationManager;
    this.guiManager = GuiManagerImpl.getInstance();
    init();
    listenPreliminaryContainerDownloader(PreliminaryContainerDownloaderFactory.getPreliminaryContainerDownloader());
  }
  
  private void init() {
    this.configurationManager.addListener((OrderableListener)this);
    this.rightsmanager.addListener(this);
    this.pnlHeaderInfo.setLanguageSelectionAction(e -> onLanguageChange(e));
  }
  
  private void setBctHeaderText() {
    LOGGER.info("Initialize bct header");
    EcuIdentification bctConf = this.bikeIdentification.getBctIdentification();
    String serialNo = bctConf.getSerialNumberResponse().isPositive() ? SerialNumberHelper.getSerialnumberBct(bctConf.getSerialNumberResponse()).toString() : "";
    String hwVersion = StringUtils.equals(bctConf.getHwVersion(), "0.0.0.0") ? "" : bctConf.getHwVersion();
    String swVersion = StringUtils.equals(bctConf.getSwVersion(), "0.0.0.0") ? "" : bctConf.getSwVersion();
    this.pnlHeaderInfo.setFirstLine(BUNDLE.getString("EBikeHeader.bctSerialNo") + " " + BUNDLE.getString("EBikeHeader.bctSerialNo"));
    this.pnlHeaderInfo.setSecondLine(BUNDLE.getString("EBikeHeader.bctHWVersion") + " " + BUNDLE.getString("EBikeHeader.bctHWVersion"));
    this.pnlHeaderInfo.setThirdLine(BUNDLE.getString("EBikeHeader.bctSWVersion") + " " + BUNDLE.getString("EBikeHeader.bctSWVersion"));
  }
  
  public void setEbikeHeaderText() {
    LOGGER.info("Initialize ebike header");
    String bikeID = (this.bikeIdentification.getBikeId() == null) ? "" : this.bikeIdentification.getBikeId();
    String productLine = (this.bikeIdentification.getProductLine() == ProductLine.NONE) ? "" : this.bikeIdentification.getProductLineDisplayName();
    this.pnlHeaderInfo.setFirstLine(LABEL_PRODUCT_LINE + " " + LABEL_PRODUCT_LINE);
    this.pnlHeaderInfo.setSecondLine(LABEL_BIKE_ID + " " + LABEL_BIKE_ID);
    setEbikeHeaderApplicationId(null);
  }
  
  public synchronized void setEbikeHeaderApplicationId(String bikeModel) {
    if (!this.guiManager.isGuiInMode(GuiManager.GuiMode.EBIKE) && !this.guiManager.isGuiInMode(GuiManager.GuiMode.BCS))
      return; 
    String appID = this.bikeIdentification.getApplicationId();
    if (appID == null)
      appID = ""; 
    if (StringUtils.isEmpty(appID) && this.bikeIdentification.isDuConnected()) {
      this.pnlHeaderInfo.setThirdLine(String.format("<html>%s <font color=red>%s</font></html>", LABEL_APP_ID, BUNDLE.getString("EBikeHeader.AppIDError")));
    } else if (!this.bikeIdentification.isDuConnected()) {
      this.pnlHeaderInfo.setThirdLine(LABEL_APP_ID);
    } else if (!this.bikeModelSetInHeaderPanel) {
      String thirdLine = LABEL_APP_ID + " " + LABEL_APP_ID;
      this.pnlHeaderInfo.setThirdLine(thirdLine);
      String modelNameOdx = bikeModel;
      if (StringUtils.isBlank(modelNameOdx))
        modelNameOdx = this.cffController.getBoschContainerCommonInterface().getEbikeModel(appID.trim()); 
      if (StringUtils.isNotBlank(modelNameOdx)) {
        String model = BikeModelTranslationHelper.createTranslatedBikeModel(modelNameOdx);
        this.pnlHeaderInfo.setThirdLine(appendToThirdInfoValue(thirdLine, String.format(" (%s)", model)));
        this.bikeModelSetInHeaderPanel = true;
      } 
    } 
  }
  
  private void onEcuConnect(Constants.EcuType type) {
    switch (type) {
      case CLASSIC_DU:
      case VICTOR_DU:
        EventQueue.invokeLater(this::setEbikeHeaderText);
        break;
      case BCT:
        EventQueue.invokeLater(this::setBctHeaderText);
        break;
    } 
  }
  
  private void onEcuDisconnect(Constants.EcuType type) {
    switch (type) {
      case CLASSIC_DU:
      case VICTOR_DU:
      case BCT:
        EventQueue.invokeLater(this::clearFields);
        break;
    } 
  }
  
  private void clearFields() {
    this.pnlHeaderInfo.setFirstLine(LABEL_PRODUCT_LINE);
    this.pnlHeaderInfo.setSecondLine(LABEL_BIKE_ID);
    this.pnlHeaderInfo.setThirdLine(LABEL_APP_ID);
    this.bikeModelSetInHeaderPanel = false;
  }
  
  public void onLanguageChange(ActionEvent e) {
    JComboBox cmbLanguage = (JComboBox)e.getSource();
    String selectedLanguage = (String)cmbLanguage.getSelectedItem();
    try {
      if (I18NUtil.checkLanguageSettingNeedsUpdate(selectedLanguage)) {
        I18NUtil.writeLocaleSetting(selectedLanguage);
        LOGGER.info("The language of application changed to {}", selectedLanguage);
        cmbLanguage.hidePopup();
        String message = BUNDLE.getString("EBikeHeader.cboxLanguage.showMessageDialog.message");
        String title = BUNDLE.getString("EBikeHeader.cboxLanguage.showMessageDialog.title");
        TestableJOptionPane.showMessageDialog(message, title, 1);
      } 
    } catch (ConfigurationNotFoundException e1) {
      LOGGER.error("Cannot change the language of the application - > " + e1.getMessage(), (Throwable)e1);
    } 
  }
  
  private String appendToThirdInfoValue(String value, String paraAppendix) {
    return value.concat((paraAppendix == null) ? "" : paraAppendix);
  }
  
  public void onBikeConfigurationChanged(BikeConfigurationChangedEvent event) {
    LOGGER.debug("BikeConfigurationChangedEvent received: '{}'", event);
    if (event.getAction() == BikeConfigurationChangedEvent.Action.WRITE_TO_BIKE)
      EventQueue.invokeLater(this::setEbikeHeaderText); 
  }
  
  public void onHardwareConnectionChanged(HardwareConnectionChangedEvent event) {
    LOGGER.debug("HardwareConnectionChangedEvent received: '{}'", event);
    switch (event.getAction()) {
      case ECU_CONNECTED:
        onEcuConnect(event.getComponent());
        break;
      case ECU_DISCONNECTED:
        onEcuDisconnect(event.getComponent());
        break;
    } 
  }

  }

          this.pnlHeaderInfo.onRightsChanged(event);
        });
  }

  }

  }

package com.gigatronik.beds.gui.panels.mapstab.checkboxtree;

import java.awt.BorderLayout;
import java.awt.Component;
import javax.swing.JPanel;
import javax.swing.JTree;
import javax.swing.tree.TreeCellRenderer;
import javax.swing.tree.TreePath;

class CheckTreeCellRenderer extends JPanel implements TreeCellRenderer {
  private static final long serialVersionUID = 1L;
  
  private final CheckTreeSelectionModel selectionModel;
  
  private final transient TreeCellRenderer delegate;
  
  private final TristateCheckBox2 checkBox = new TristateCheckBox2();
  
  CheckTreeCellRenderer(TreeCellRenderer delegate, CheckTreeSelectionModel selectionModel) {
    this.delegate = delegate;
    this.selectionModel = selectionModel;
    setLayout(new BorderLayout());
    setOpaque(false);
    this.checkBox.setOpaque(false);
    this.checkBox.setName("chbTristateCheck");
  }
  
  public Component getTreeCellRendererComponent(JTree tree, Object value, boolean selected, boolean expanded, boolean leaf, int row, boolean hasFocus) {
    Component renderer = this.delegate.getTreeCellRendererComponent(tree, value, selected, expanded, leaf, row, hasFocus);
    TreePath path = tree.getPathForRow(row);
    if (path != null)
      if (this.selectionModel.isPathSelected(path, true)) {
        this.checkBox.setSelected(true);
      } else if (this.selectionModel.isPartiallySelected(path)) {
        this.checkBox.setIndeterminate();
      } else {
        this.checkBox.setSelected(false);
      }  
    removeAll();
    add(this.checkBox, "West");
    add(renderer, "Center");
    this.checkBox.setEnabled(tree.isEnabled());
    return this;
  }
}

========================================================================================================================
package com.gigatronik.beds.gui.panels.mapstab.checkboxtree;

import com.gigatronik.beds.gui.panels.mapstab.dualtree.TreeTableNode;
import com.gigatronik.beds.gui.panels.mapstab.parser.MapData;
import java.awt.event.MouseAdapter;
import java.awt.event.MouseEvent;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import javax.swing.JCheckBox;
import javax.swing.JTree;
import javax.swing.event.TreeSelectionEvent;
import javax.swing.event.TreeSelectionListener;
import javax.swing.tree.DefaultMutableTreeNode;
import javax.swing.tree.TreeNode;
import javax.swing.tree.TreePath;

public class CheckTreeManager extends MouseAdapter implements TreeSelectionListener {
  private final int checkBoxWidth = (new JCheckBox().getPreferredSize()).width;
  
  private final CheckTreeSelectionModel selectionModel;
  
  private final JTree tree;
  
  private DisplayMode displayMode = DisplayMode.DISPLAY_EDITABLE;
  
  private enum DisplayMode {
    DISPLAY_READ_ONLY, DISPLAY_EDITABLE, DOWNLOAD, DELETE;
    
    boolean isMapEditable(boolean isMapInRepository) {
      switch (this) {
        case DELETE:
          return isMapInRepository;
        case DISPLAY_READ_ONLY:
          return false;
      } 
      return true;
    }
  }
  
  public CheckTreeManager(JTree tree) {
    this.tree = tree;
    this.selectionModel = new CheckTreeSelectionModel(tree.getModel());
    tree.setCellRenderer(new CheckTreeCellRenderer(tree.getCellRenderer(), this.selectionModel));
    tree.addMouseListener(this);
    this.selectionModel.addTreeSelectionListener(this);
  }
  
  public void mousePressed(MouseEvent event) {
    if (this.tree.isEnabled()) {
      TreePath path = this.tree.getPathForLocation(event.getX(), event.getY());
      if (path != null && isElementEditable(path) && hasCheckboxBeenHit(event, path))
        toggleSelectionStateOfNode(path); 
    } 
  }
  
  private boolean isElementEditable(TreePath path) {
    boolean inRepository = false;
    Object node = path.getLastPathComponent();
    if (node instanceof TreeTableNode) {
      inRepository = ((TreeTableNode)node).getMapData().isInRepository();
    } else if (node instanceof DefaultMutableTreeNode) {
      Object userObject = ((DefaultMutableTreeNode)node).getUserObject();
      if (userObject instanceof MapData) {
        inRepository = ((MapData)userObject).isInRepository();
      } else {
        inRepository = true;
      } 
    } 
    return this.displayMode.isMapEditable(inRepository);
  }
  
  private boolean hasCheckboxBeenHit(MouseEvent me, TreePath path) {
    return (me.getX() <= (this.tree.getPathBounds(path)).x + this.checkBoxWidth);
  }
  
  private void toggleSelectionStateOfNode(TreePath path) {
    boolean selected = this.selectionModel.isPathSelected(path, true);
    updateSelectionStateOfNode(path, !selected);
  }
  
  private void updateSelectionStateOfNode(TreePath path, boolean selectIt) {
    this.selectionModel.removeTreeSelectionListener(this);
    try {
      if (selectIt) {
        this.selectionModel.addSelectionPath(path);
      } else {
        this.selectionModel.removeSelectionPath(path);
      } 
    } finally {
      this.selectionModel.addTreeSelectionListener(this);
      this.tree.treeDidChange();
    } 
  }
  
  private void preSelectAllMapsThatAreOnHardDisk() {
    Object root = this.tree.getModel().getRoot();
    if (root instanceof TreeTableNode)
      checkNodeAndEverythingBeyond((TreeTableNode)root); 
  }
  
  private void checkNodeAndEverythingBeyond(TreeTableNode node) {
    tickMapIfInRepository(node);
    checkChildren(node);
  }
  
  private void checkChildren(TreeTableNode node) {
    for (int i = 0; i < this.tree.getModel().getChildCount(node); i++) {
      Object child = this.tree.getModel().getChild(node, i);
      if (child instanceof TreeTableNode)
        checkNodeAndEverythingBeyond((TreeTableNode)child); 
    } 
  }
  
  private void tickMapIfInRepository(TreeTableNode node) {
    if (node.getMapData().isInRepository()) {
      TreePath path = getPathFromNode(node);
      updateSelectionStateOfNode(path, true);
    } 
  }
  
  private TreePath getPathFromNode(TreeNode node) {
    List<Object> nodes = new ArrayList();
    if (node != null) {
      nodes.add(node);
      node = node.getParent();
      while (node != null) {
        nodes.add(0, node);
        node = node.getParent();
      } 
    } 
    return nodes.isEmpty() ? null : new TreePath(nodes.toArray());
  }
  
  public CheckTreeSelectionModel getSelectionModel() {
    return this.selectionModel;
  }
  
  public void setDisplayState(boolean editable) {
    this.displayMode = editable ? DisplayMode.DISPLAY_EDITABLE : DisplayMode.DISPLAY_READ_ONLY;
  }
  
  public void setDownloadState() {
    this.displayMode = DisplayMode.DOWNLOAD;
    preSelectAllMapsThatAreOnHardDisk();
  }
  
  public void setDeleteState() {
    this.displayMode = DisplayMode.DELETE;
  }
  
  public void valueChanged(TreeSelectionEvent e) {
    this.tree.treeDidChange();
  }
}

ITEM 197: com/gigatronik/beds/gui/panels/mapstab/checkboxtree/CheckTreeSelectionModel.java
========================================================================================================================
package com.gigatronik.beds.gui.panels.mapstab.checkboxtree;

import java.util.ArrayDeque;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Deque;
import java.util.List;
import javax.swing.tree.DefaultTreeSelectionModel;
import javax.swing.tree.TreeModel;
import javax.swing.tree.TreePath;

public class CheckTreeSelectionModel extends DefaultTreeSelectionModel {
  private static final long serialVersionUID = 1L;
  
  private final transient TreeModel model;
  
  CheckTreeSelectionModel(TreeModel model) {
    this.model = model;
    setSelectionMode(4);
  }
  
  boolean isPartiallySelected(TreePath path) {
    if (isPathSelected(path, true))
      return false; 
    TreePath[] selectionPaths = getSelectionPaths();
    if (selectionPaths == null)
      return false; 
    for (int j = 0; j < selectionPaths.length; j++) {
      if (isDescendant(selectionPaths[j], path))
        return true; 
    } 
    return false;
  }
  
  boolean isPathSelected(TreePath path, boolean dig) {
    if (!dig)
      return isPathSelected(path); 
    while (path != null && !isPathSelected(path))
      path = path.getParentPath(); 
    return (path != null);
  }
  
  private boolean isDescendant(TreePath path1, TreePath path2) {
    Object[] obj1 = path1.getPath();
    Object[] obj2 = path2.getPath();
    for (int i = 0; i < obj2.length; i++) {
      if (obj1[i] != obj2[i])
        return false; 
    } 
    return true;
  }
  
  public void setSelectionPaths(TreePath[] pPaths) {
    clearSelection();
    for (int i = 0; i < pPaths.length; i++)
      addSelectionPath(pPaths[i]); 
  }
  
  public void addSelectionPaths(TreePath[] paths) {
    unSelectDescendants(paths);
    for (TreePath path : paths) {
      TreePath temp = null;
      while (areSiblingsSelected(path)) {
        temp = path;
        if (path.getParentPath() == null)
          break; 
        path = path.getParentPath();
      } 
      if (temp != null) {
        if (temp.getParentPath() != null) {
          addSelectionPath(temp.getParentPath());
        } else {
          if (!isSelectionEmpty())
            removeSelectionPaths(getSelectionPaths()); 
          super.addSelectionPaths(new TreePath[] { temp });
        } 
      } else {
        super.addSelectionPaths(new TreePath[] { path });
      } 
    } 
  }
  
  private void unSelectDescendants(TreePath[] paths) {
    for (TreePath path : paths) {
      TreePath[] selectionPaths = getSelectionPaths();
      if (selectionPaths == null)
        break; 
      List<TreePath> toBeRemoved = new ArrayList<>();
      for (TreePath selectionPath : selectionPaths) {
        if (isDescendant(selectionPath, path))
          toBeRemoved.add(selectionPath); 
      } 
      super.removeSelectionPaths(toBeRemoved.<TreePath>toArray(new TreePath[toBeRemoved.size()]));
    } 
  }
  
  private boolean areSiblingsSelected(TreePath path) {
    TreePath parent = path.getParentPath();
    if (parent == null)
      return true; 
    Object node = path.getLastPathComponent();
    Object parentNode = parent.getLastPathComponent();
    int childCount = this.model.getChildCount(parentNode);
    for (int i = 0; i < childCount; i++) {
      Object childNode = this.model.getChild(parentNode, i);
      if (childNode != node)
        if (!isPathSelected(parent.pathByAddingChild(childNode)))
          return false;  
    } 
    return true;
  }
  
  public void removeSelectionPaths(TreePath[] paths) {
    for (TreePath path : paths) {
      if (path.getPathCount() == 1) {
        super.removeSelectionPaths(new TreePath[] { path });
      } else {
        toggleRemoveSelection(path);
      } 
    } 
  }
  
  private void toggleRemoveSelection(TreePath path) {
    Deque<TreePath> stack = new ArrayDeque<>();
    TreePath parent = path.getParentPath();
    while (parent != null && !isPathSelected(parent)) {
      stack.push(parent);
      parent = parent.getParentPath();
    } 
    if (parent != null) {
      stack.push(parent);
    } else {
      super.removeSelectionPaths(new TreePath[] { path });
      return;
    } 
    while (!stack.isEmpty()) {
      TreePath temp = stack.pop();
      TreePath peekPath = stack.isEmpty() ? path : stack.peek();
      Object node = temp.getLastPathComponent();
      Object peekNode = peekPath.getLastPathComponent();
      int childCount = this.model.getChildCount(node);
      for (int i = 0; i < childCount; i++) {
        Object childNode = this.model.getChild(node, i);
        if (childNode != peekNode)
          super.addSelectionPaths(new TreePath[] { temp.pathByAddingChild(childNode) }); 
      } 
    } 
    super.removeSelectionPaths(new TreePath[] { parent });
  }
}

package com.gigatronik.beds.gui.panels.mapstab.checkboxtree;

import java.awt.event.ItemEvent;
import javax.swing.JToggleButton;

class TristateButtonModel extends JToggleButton.ToggleButtonModel {
  private static final long serialVersionUID = 1L;
  
  private TristateState state = TristateState.DESELECTED;
  
  TristateButtonModel(TristateState state) {
    setState(state);
  }
  
  void setIndeterminate() {
    setState(TristateState.INDETERMINATE);
  }
  
  public void setEnabled(boolean enabled) {
    super.setEnabled(enabled);
    displayState();
  }
  
  public void setSelected(boolean selected) {
    setState(selected ? TristateState.SELECTED : TristateState.DESELECTED);
  }
  
  public void setArmed(boolean b) {}
  
  public void setPressed(boolean b) {}
  
  void iterateState() {
    setState(this.state.next());
  }
  
  private void setState(TristateState state) {
    this.state = state;
    displayState();
    if (state == TristateState.INDETERMINATE && isEnabled()) {
      fireStateChanged();
      int indeterminate = 3;
      fireItemStateChanged(new ItemEvent(this, 701, this, 3));
    } 
  }
  
  private void displayState() {
    super.setSelected((this.state != TristateState.DESELECTED));
    super.setArmed((this.state == TristateState.INDETERMINATE));
    super.setPressed((this.state == TristateState.INDETERMINATE));
  }
}

package com.gigatronik.beds.gui.panels.mapstab.checkboxtree;

import java.awt.AWTEvent;
import java.awt.EventQueue;
import java.awt.event.ActionEvent;
import java.awt.event.InputEvent;
import java.awt.event.MouseAdapter;
import java.awt.event.MouseEvent;
import java.awt.event.MouseListener;
import javax.swing.AbstractAction;
import javax.swing.ActionMap;
import javax.swing.ButtonModel;
import javax.swing.Icon;
import javax.swing.JCheckBox;
import javax.swing.SwingUtilities;
import javax.swing.event.ChangeEvent;
import javax.swing.event.ChangeListener;
import javax.swing.plaf.ActionMapUIResource;

final class TristateCheckBox2 extends JCheckBox {
  private static final long serialVersionUID = 1L;
  
  private final transient ChangeListener enableListener = e -> setFocusable(getModel().isEnabled());
  
  TristateCheckBox2() {
    this(null);
  }
  
  private TristateCheckBox2(String text) {
    this(text, null, TristateState.DESELECTED);
  }
  
  private TristateCheckBox2(String text, Icon icon, TristateState initial) {
    super(text, icon);
    setModel(new TristateButtonModel(initial));
    super.addMouseListener(new MouseAdapter() {
          public void mousePressed(MouseEvent e) {
            TristateCheckBox2.this.iterateState();
          }
        });
    ActionMap actions = new ActionMapUIResource();
    actions.put("pressed", new AbstractAction() {
          private static final long serialVersionUID = 1L;
          
          public void actionPerformed(ActionEvent e) {
            TristateCheckBox2.this.iterateState();
          }
        });
    actions.put("released", null);
    SwingUtilities.replaceUIActionMap(this, actions);
  }
  
  void setIndeterminate() {
    getTristateModel().setIndeterminate();
  }
  
  public void setModel(ButtonModel newModel) {
    super.setModel(newModel);
    if (this.model instanceof TristateButtonModel)
      this.model.addChangeListener(this.enableListener); 
  }
  
  public void addMouseListener(MouseListener l) {}
  
  private void iterateState() {
    if (!getModel().isEnabled())
      return; 
    grabFocus();
    getTristateModel().iterateState();
    int modifiers = 0;
    AWTEvent currentEvent = EventQueue.getCurrentEvent();
    if (currentEvent instanceof InputEvent) {
      modifiers = ((InputEvent)currentEvent).getModifiers();
    } else if (currentEvent instanceof ActionEvent) {
      modifiers = ((ActionEvent)currentEvent).getModifiers();
    } 
    fireActionPerformed(new ActionEvent(this, 1001, getText(), System.currentTimeMillis(), modifiers));
  }
  
  private TristateButtonModel getTristateModel() {
    return (TristateButtonModel)getModel();
  }
}

package com.gigatronik.beds.gui.panels.mapstab.checkboxtree;

enum TristateState {
  SELECTED {
    public TristateState next() {
      return INDETERMINATE;
    }
  },
  INDETERMINATE {
    public TristateState next() {
      return DESELECTED;
    }
  },
  DESELECTED {
    public TristateState next() {
      return SELECTED;
    }
  };
  
  abstract TristateState next();
}

ITEM 204: com/gigatronik/beds/gui/panels/mapstab/dualtree/AbstractTreeTableModel.java
========================================================================================================================
package com.gigatronik.beds.gui.panels.mapstab.dualtree;

import javax.swing.event.EventListenerList;
import javax.swing.event.TreeModelEvent;
import javax.swing.event.TreeModelListener;
import javax.swing.tree.TreePath;

public abstract class AbstractTreeTableModel implements TreeTableModel {
  protected Object root;
  
  protected EventListenerList listenerList = new EventListenerList();
  
  private static final int CHANGED = 0;
  
  private static final int INSERTED = 1;
  
  private static final int REMOVED = 2;
  
  private static final int STRUCTURE_CHANEGED = 3;
  
  public AbstractTreeTableModel(Object root) {
    this.root = root;
  }
  
  public Object getRoot() {
    return this.root;
  }
  
  public boolean isLeaf(Object node) {
    return (getChildCount(node) == 0);
  }
  
  public void valueForPathChanged(TreePath path, Object newValue) {}
  
  public int getIndexOfChild(Object parent, Object child) {
    return 0;
  }
  
  public void addTreeModelListener(TreeModelListener l) {
    this.listenerList.add(TreeModelListener.class, l);
  }
  
  public void removeTreeModelListener(TreeModelListener l) {
    this.listenerList.remove(TreeModelListener.class, l);
  }
  
  private void fireTreeNode(int changeType, Object source, Object[] path, int[] childIndices, Object[] children) {
    Object[] listeners = this.listenerList.getListenerList();
    TreeModelEvent e = new TreeModelEvent(source, path, childIndices, children);
    for (int i = listeners.length - 2; i >= 0; i -= 2) {
      if (listeners[i] == TreeModelListener.class)
        switch (changeType) {
          case 0:
            ((TreeModelListener)listeners[i + 1]).treeNodesChanged(e);
            break;
          case 1:
            ((TreeModelListener)listeners[i + 1]).treeNodesInserted(e);
            break;
          case 2:
            ((TreeModelListener)listeners[i + 1]).treeNodesRemoved(e);
            break;
          case 3:
            ((TreeModelListener)listeners[i + 1]).treeStructureChanged(e);
            break;
        }  
    } 
  }
  
  private void fireTreeNode(int changeType, Object source, TreePath path) {
    Object[] listeners = this.listenerList.getListenerList();
    TreeModelEvent e = new TreeModelEvent(source, path);
    for (int i = listeners.length - 2; i >= 0; i -= 2) {
      if (listeners[i] == TreeModelListener.class)
        switch (changeType) {
          case 0:
            ((TreeModelListener)listeners[i + 1]).treeNodesChanged(e);
            break;
          case 1:
            ((TreeModelListener)listeners[i + 1]).treeNodesInserted(e);
            break;
          case 2:
            ((TreeModelListener)listeners[i + 1]).treeNodesRemoved(e);
            break;
          case 3:
            ((TreeModelListener)listeners[i + 1]).treeStructureChanged(e);
            break;
        }  
    } 
  }
  
  protected void fireTreeNodeChanged(Object source, Object[] path, int[] childIndices, Object[] children) {
    fireTreeNode(0, source, path, childIndices, children);
  }
  
  protected void fireTreeNodeChanged(Object source, TreePath path) {
    fireTreeNode(0, source, path);
  }
  
  protected void fireTreeNodeInserted(Object source, Object[] path, int[] childIndices, Object[] children) {
    fireTreeNode(1, source, path, childIndices, children);
  }
  
  protected void fireTreeNodeInserted(Object source, TreePath path) {
    fireTreeNode(1, source, path);
  }
  
  protected void fireTreeNodeRemoved(Object source, Object[] path, int[] childIndices, Object[] children) {
    fireTreeNode(2, source, path, childIndices, children);
  }
  
  protected void fireTreeNodeRemoved(Object source, TreePath path) {
    fireTreeNode(2, source, path);
  }
  
  protected void fireTreeStructureChanged(Object source, Object[] path, int[] childIndices, Object[] children) {
    fireTreeNode(3, source, path, childIndices, children);
  }
  
  protected void fireTreeStructureChanged(Object source, TreePath path) {
    fireTreeNode(3, source, path);
  }
}

    this.tree = tree;
    this.table = table;
  }
  
  public Component getTableCellEditorComponent(JTable table, Object value, boolean isSelected, int r, int c) {
    return this.tree;
  }
  
  public boolean isCellEditable(EventObject e) {
    if (e instanceof MouseEvent) {
      int treeColumn = 0;
      MouseEvent me = (MouseEvent)e;
      int doubleClick = 2;
      MouseEvent newME = new MouseEvent(this.tree, me.getID(), me.getWhen(), me.getModifiers(), 
          me.getX() - (this.table.getCellRect(0, treeColumn, true)).x, me.getY(), doubleClick, me.isPopupTrigger());
      this.tree.dispatchEvent(newME);
    } 
    return false;
  }
  
  public Object getCellEditorValue() {
    return null;
  }
}

ITEM 208: com/gigatronik/beds/gui/panels/mapstab/dualtree/TreeTableCellRenderer.java

package com.gigatronik.beds.gui.panels.mapstab.dualtree;

import java.awt.Component;
import java.awt.Graphics;
import javax.swing.JTable;
import javax.swing.JTree;
import javax.swing.table.TableCellRenderer;
import javax.swing.tree.TreeModel;
import javax.swing.tree.TreePath;

public class TreeTableCellRenderer extends JTree implements TableCellRenderer {
  private static final long serialVersionUID = 141457863922782730L;
  
  protected int visibleRow;
  
  private final TreeTable treeTable;
  
  public TreeTableCellRenderer(TreeTable treeTable, TreeModel model) {
    super(model);
    this.treeTable = treeTable;
    setRowHeight(getRowHeight());
  }
  
  public void setRowHeight(int rowHeight) {
    if (rowHeight > 0) {
      super.setRowHeight(rowHeight);
      if (this.treeTable != null && this.treeTable.getRowHeight() != rowHeight)
        this.treeTable.setRowHeight(getRowHeight()); 
    } 
  }
  
  public void setBounds(int x, int y, int w, int h) {
    super.setBounds(x, 0, w, this.treeTable.getHeight());
  }
  
  public void paint(Graphics g) {
    g.translate(0, -this.visibleRow * getRowHeight());
    super.paint(g);
  }
  
  public Component getTableCellRendererComponent(JTable table, Object value, boolean isSelected, boolean hasFocus, int row, int column) {
    setBackground(isSelected ? table.getSelectionBackground() : table.getBackground());
    this.visibleRow = row;
    return this;
  }
  
  protected TreeTableNode getTreeTableNode(int row) {
    TreePath treePath = getPathForRow(row);
    if (treePath != null)
      return (TreeTableNode)treePath.getLastPathComponent(); 
    return null;
  }
}

package com.gigatronik.beds.gui.panels.mapstab.dualtree;

import java.awt.Component;
import java.awt.GridBagLayout;
import javax.swing.JCheckBox;
import javax.swing.JPanel;
import javax.swing.JTable;
import javax.swing.table.TableCellRenderer;

public class TreeTableCellRendererForMapDelete extends JPanel implements TableCellRenderer {
  private static final long serialVersionUID = 1L;
  
  protected JCheckBox checkBox;
  
  protected TreeTable treeTable;
  
  protected boolean isBUI27x;
  
  public TreeTableCellRendererForMapDelete(TreeTable treeTable, boolean isBUI27x) {
    super(new GridBagLayout());
    this.treeTable = treeTable;
    this.isBUI27x = isBUI27x;
    init();
  }
  
  private void init() {
    this.checkBox = new JCheckBox();
    this.checkBox.setHorizontalAlignment(0);
    this.checkBox.setOpaque(false);
    add(this.checkBox);
  }
  
  public Component getTableCellRendererComponent(JTable table, Object value, boolean isSelected, boolean hasFocus, int row, int column) {
    setBackground(isSelected ? table.getSelectionBackground() : table.getBackground());
    this.checkBox.setSelected((value != null && (Boolean)value));
    setVisibilityCheckbox(row);
    return this;
  }
  
  protected void setVisibilityCheckbox(int row) {
    TreeTableNode node = this.treeTable.getTreeTableNodeOfRow(row);
    if (node != null)
      if (this.isBUI27x) {
        this.checkBox.setVisible(node.doesBui27xMapExist());
      } else {
        this.checkBox.setVisible(node.doesBui350MapExist());
      }  
  }
}

ITEM 211: com/gigatronik/beds/gui/panels/mapstab/dualtree/TreeTableCreator.java

package com.gigatronik.beds.gui.panels.mapstab.dualtree;

import com.gigatronik.beds.gui.panels.mapstab.parser.MapData;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import javax.swing.JComponent;
import javax.swing.JTree;
import javax.swing.ToolTipManager;
import javax.swing.tree.TreePath;

public class TreeTableCreator {
  private final TreeTable treeTable;
  
  public TreeTableCreator() {
    this.treeTable = initTreeTable();
  }
  
  public TreeTableCreator(TreeTable treeTable) {
    this.treeTable = treeTable;
  }
  
  public TreeTable getTreeTable() {
    return this.treeTable;
  }
  
  private TreeTable initTreeTable() {
    AbstractTreeTableModel treeTableModel = new TreeTableDataModel(createRootNode());
    TreeTable tempTreeTable = new TreeTable(treeTableModel);
    ToolTipManager.sharedInstance().registerComponent((JComponent)tempTreeTable);
    HeaderTreeTableCellRenderer renderer = new HeaderTreeTableCellRenderer();
    renderer.setImageToHeader(treeTableModel, tempTreeTable.getColumnModel().getColumn(0), 
        tempTreeTable.getColumnModel().getColumn(1), tempTreeTable.getColumnModel().getColumn(2));
    tempTreeTable.getSelectionModel().setSelectionMode(1);
    tempTreeTable.setFillsViewportHeight(true);
    tempTreeTable.getColumnModel().getColumn(0).setPreferredWidth(220);
    return tempTreeTable;
  }
  
  public void setDisplayEditState() {
    TreeTableDataModel model = getTreeTableModel();
    model.setState(TreeTableDataModel.DISPLAY_STATES.DISPLAY);
    this.treeTable.getColumnModel().getColumn(1).setCellRenderer(null);
    this.treeTable.getColumnModel().getColumn(2).setCellRenderer(null);
  }
  
  public void setDeleteEditState() {
    TreeTableDataModel model = getTreeTableModel();
    model.setState(TreeTableDataModel.DISPLAY_STATES.DELETE);
    this.treeTable.getColumnModel().getColumn(1).setCellRenderer(new TreeTableCellRendererForMapDelete(this.treeTable, true));
    this.treeTable.getColumnModel().getColumn(2).setCellRenderer(new TreeTableCellRendererForMapDelete(this.treeTable, false));
  }
  
  public void setDownloadEditState() {
    TreeTableDataModel model = getTreeTableModel();
    model.setState(TreeTableDataModel.DISPLAY_STATES.DOWNLOAD);
    this.treeTable.getColumnModel().getColumn(1).setCellRenderer(new TreeTableCellRendererForMapDownload(this.treeTable, true));
    this.treeTable.getColumnModel().getColumn(2).setCellRenderer(new TreeTableCellRendererForMapDownload(this.treeTable, false));
  }
  
  public void setNodesToTreeTable(TreeTableNode node) {
    TreeTableDataModel tempModel = getTreeTableModel();
    getTree(this.treeTable).collapsePath(new TreePath(tempModel.getRoot()));
    tempModel.setRoot(node);
    if (node != null) {
      if (node.getChildCount() > 0)
        getTree(this.treeTable).expandPath(new TreePath(node.getFirstChild())); 
      setSelectedNode(node);
    } 
  }
  
  public List<MapData> getSelectedMaps() {
    List<MapData> selectedMaps = new ArrayList<>();
    TreeTableNode rootNode = (TreeTableNode)getTreeTableModel().getRoot();
    getSelectedChildren(rootNode, selectedMaps);
    return selectedMaps;
  }
  
  private void getSelectedChildren(TreeTableNode parentNode, List<MapData> selectedMaps) {
    if (parentNode != null && parentNode.getChildCount() > 0)
      parentNode.getChildren().stream().map(node -> {
            proveMapSelected(node, selectedMaps);
            return node;
          }).forEachOrdered(node -> 
          getSelectedChildren(node, selectedMaps)); 
  }
  
  private void proveMapSelected(TreeTableNode node, List<MapData> selectedMaps) {
    if (node.isBUI27xChecked()) {
      MapData entry = node.getMapData();
      if (entry.isBui27xMap() && isMap(entry))
        selectedMaps.add(node.getMapData()); 
      entry = node.getMapDataOtherBUI();
      if (entry != null && entry.isBui27xMap() && isMap(entry))
        selectedMaps.add(node.getMapDataOtherBUI()); 
    } 
    if (node.isBUI350Checked()) {
      MapData entry = node.getMapData();
      if (!entry.isBui27xMap() && isMap(entry))
        selectedMaps.add(node.getMapData()); 
      entry = node.getMapDataOtherBUI();
      if (entry != null && !entry.isBui27xMap() && isMap(entry))
        selectedMaps.add(node.getMapDataOtherBUI()); 
    } 
  }
  
  private boolean isMap(MapData object) {
    return (object.getMapSize() > 0.0D);
  }
  
  private TreeTableDataModel getTreeTableModel() {
    TreeTableModelAdapter tempAd = (TreeTableModelAdapter)this.treeTable.getModel();
    TreeTableDataModel tempDataModel = (TreeTableDataModel)tempAd.treeTableModel;
    return tempDataModel;
  }
  
  private TreeTableNode createRootNode() {
    TreeTableNode root = new TreeTableNode(new TreeTableNodeObject(new MapData(), null, false, false));
    return root;
  }
  
  private JTree getTree(TreeTable treeTable) {
    return ((TreeTableModelAdapter)treeTable.getModel()).tree;
  }
  
  private void setSelectedNode(TreeTableNode selectingNode) {
    JTree tempTree = getTree(this.treeTable);
    int rowIndex = tempTree.getRowForPath(new TreePath((Object[])selectingNode.getPath()));
    tempTree.setSelectionRow(rowIndex);
  }
}

ITEM 212: com/gigatronik/beds/gui/panels/mapstab/dualtree/TreeTableDataModel.java
========================================================================================================================
package com.gigatronik.beds.gui.panels.mapstab.dualtree;

import com.gigatronik.dart2.bosch.service.internationalization.ResourceBundleFactory;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.bosch.service.internationalization.Utf8ResourceBundleFormatted;
import javax.swing.tree.TreeNode;

public class TreeTableDataModel extends AbstractTreeTableModel {
  public static final Utf8ResourceBundleFormatted BUNDLE = ResourceBundleFactory.newDefaultResourceBundle();
  
  private DISPLAY_STATES state;
  
  private static final int CARD_NAME_COLUMN = 0;
  
  private static final int BUI27X_COLUMN = 1;
  
  private static final int BUI350_COLUMN = 2;
  
  protected String[] columnNames;
  
  public enum DISPLAY_STATES {
    DISPLAY, DOWNLOAD, DELETE;
  }
  
  protected static Class<?>[] columnTypes = new Class<?>[] { TreeTableModel.class, Boolean.class, Boolean.class };
  
  public TreeTableDataModel(TreeTableNode rootNode) {
    super(rootNode);
    this.root = rootNode;
    String[] tempColumnNames = { BUNDLE.getString("EBikeMainTabbed.mapTab.text"), BUNDLE.getString("TreeTableMaps_ColumnHeader_BUI27x"), BUNDLE.getString("TreeTableMaps_ColumnHeader_BUI350") };
    this.columnNames = tempColumnNames;
  }
  
  public void setState(DISPLAY_STATES state) {
    this.state = state;
  }
  
  public Object getChild(Object parent, int index) {
    return ((TreeTableNode)parent).getChildren().get(index);
  }
  
  public int getChildCount(Object parent) {
    return ((TreeTableNode)parent).getChildCount();
  }
  
  public int getColumnCount() {
    return this.columnNames.length;
  }
  
  public String getColumnName(int column) {
    return this.columnNames[column];
  }
  
  public Class<?> getColumnClass(int column) {
    return columnTypes[column];
  }
  
  public Object getValueAt(Object node, int column) {
    switch (column) {
      case 0:
        return ((TreeTableNode)node).getMapData().getAreaName();
      case 1:
        return ((TreeTableNode)node).isBUI27xChecked();
      case 2:
        return ((TreeTableNode)node).isBUI350Checked();
    } 
    return null;
  }
  
  public boolean isCellEditable(Object node, int column) {
    switch (this.state) {
      case DISPLAY:
        return isCellEditableDisplayState(column);
      case DOWNLOAD:
        return isCellEditableDownloadState(node, column);
      case DELETE:
        return isCellEditableDeleteState(node, column);
    } 
    return true;
  }
  
  private boolean isCellEditableDisplayState(int column) {
    return (column != 1 && column != 2);
  }
  
  private boolean isCellEditableDownloadState(Object node, int column) {
    TreeTableNode treeNode = (TreeTableNode)node;
    return ((column != 1 || treeNode.doesBui27xMapExist()) && (column != 2 || 
      treeNode.doesBui350MapExist()));
  }
  
  private boolean isCellEditableDeleteState(Object node, int column) {
    TreeTableNode treeNode = (TreeTableNode)node;
    return ((column != 1 || treeNode.doesBui27xMapExist()) && (column != 2 || 
      treeNode.doesBui350MapExist()));
  }
  
  public void setValueAt(Object aValue, Object node, int column) {
    switch (column) {
      case 1:
        ((TreeTableNode)node).setBUI27xChecked(((Boolean)aValue).booleanValue());
        break;
      case 2:
        ((TreeTableNode)node).setBUI350Checked(((Boolean)aValue).booleanValue());
        break;
    } 
  }
  
  public void setRoot(TreeNode root) {
    Object oldRoot = this.root;
    this.root = root;
    if (root == null && oldRoot != null) {
      fireTreeStructureChanged(this, null);
    } else {
      nodeStructureChanged(root);
    } 
  }
  
  public void nodeStructureChanged(TreeNode node) {
    if (node != null)
      fireTreeStructureChanged(this, getPathToRoot(node), null, null); 
  }
  
  public TreeNode[] getPathToRoot(TreeNode aNode) {
    return getPathToRoot(aNode, 0);
  }
  
  protected TreeNode[] getPathToRoot(TreeNode aNode, int depth) {
    TreeNode[] retNodes;
    if (aNode == null) {
      if (depth == 0)
        return null; 
      retNodes = new TreeNode[depth];
    } else {
      depth++;
      if (aNode == this.root) {
        retNodes = new TreeNode[depth];
      } else {
        retNodes = getPathToRoot(aNode.getParent(), depth);
      } 
      retNodes[retNodes.length - depth] = aNode;
    } 
    return retNodes;
  }
}

ITEM 214: com/gigatronik/beds/gui/panels/mapstab/dualtree/TreeTableModelAdapter.java

package com.gigatronik.beds.gui.panels.mapstab.dualtree;

import java.util.function.Consumer;
import javax.swing.JTree;
import javax.swing.event.TableModelEvent;
import javax.swing.event.TableModelListener;
import javax.swing.event.TreeExpansionEvent;
import javax.swing.event.TreeExpansionListener;
import javax.swing.table.AbstractTableModel;
import javax.swing.tree.TreePath;

public class TreeTableModelAdapter extends AbstractTableModel {
  private static final long serialVersionUID = -1989327444859566857L;
  
  JTree tree;
  
  transient AbstractTreeTableModel treeTableModel;
  
  public TreeTableModelAdapter(AbstractTreeTableModel treeTableModel, JTree tree) {
    this.tree = tree;
    this.treeTableModel = treeTableModel;
    tree.addTreeExpansionListener(new TreeExpansionListener() {
          public void treeExpanded(TreeExpansionEvent arg0) {
            TreeTableModelAdapter.this.fireTableDataChanged();
          }
          
          public void treeCollapsed(TreeExpansionEvent arg0) {
            TreeTableModelAdapter.this.fireTableDataChanged();
          }
        });
  }
  
  public int getColumnCount() {
    return this.treeTableModel.getColumnCount();
  }
  
  public String getColumnName(int column) {
    return this.treeTableModel.getColumnName(column);
  }
  
  public Class<?> getColumnClass(int column) {
    return this.treeTableModel.getColumnClass(column);
  }
  
  public int getRowCount() {
    return this.tree.getRowCount();
  }
  
  protected Object nodeForRow(int row) {
    TreePath treePath = this.tree.getPathForRow(row);
    if (treePath == null)
      return null; 
    return treePath.getLastPathComponent();
  }
  
  public Object getValueAt(int row, int column) {
    return this.treeTableModel.getValueAt(nodeForRow(row), column);
  }
  
  public boolean isCellEditable(int row, int column) {
    return this.treeTableModel.isCellEditable(nodeForRow(row), column);
  }
  
  public void setValueAt(Object value, int row, int column) {
    if (nodeForRow(row) == null)
      return; 
    this.treeTableModel.setValueAt(value, nodeForRow(row), column);
    setSelectionStateChildSameAsDirectory(value, row, column);
  }
  
  private void setSelectionStateChildSameAsDirectory(Object value, int row, int column) {
    TreeTableNode node = (TreeTableNode)nodeForRow(row);
    boolean isChecked = (Boolean)value;
    if (node.getChildCount() > 0 && column != 0) {
      node.getChildren().forEach((Consumer<? super TreeTableNode>)(childNode -> {
            this.tree.collapsePath(new TreePath((Object[])childNode.getPath()));
            this.tree.expandPath(new TreePath((Object[])childNode.getPath()));
          }));
      node.getChildren().stream().map(childNode -> this.tree.getRowForPath(new TreePath((Object[])childNode.getPath()))).forEachOrdered(rowChild -> 
          setValueAt(Boolean.valueOf(isChecked), rowChild.intValue(), column));
      for (TableModelListener listener : getTableModelListeners())
        listener.tableChanged(new TableModelEvent(this, row, row, column, -1)); 
    } 
  }
}
