package com.gigatronik.beds.gui.panels.mapstab.dualtree;

import com.gigatronik.beds.gui.panels.mapstab.parser.MapData;
import java.util.Vector;
import javax.swing.tree.DefaultMutableTreeNode;
import javax.swing.tree.TreeNode;

public class TreeTableNode extends DefaultMutableTreeNode {
  private static final long serialVersionUID = -1299970906523424249L;
  
  public TreeTableNode(TreeTableNodeObject dataNodeObject) {
    super(dataNodeObject);
    this.parent = null;
    this.userObject = dataNodeObject;
    this.allowsChildren = true;
  }
  
  public Object getUserObject() {
    return getMapData();
  }
  
  public Object getElement() {
    return ((TreeTableNodeObject)this.userObject).getElement();
  }
  
  public MapData getMapData() {
    return ((TreeTableNodeObject)this.userObject).getMapData();
  }
  
  public MapData getMapDataOtherBUI() {
    return ((TreeTableNodeObject)this.userObject).getMapDataOtherBUI();
  }
  
  public void setMapDataOtherBUI(MapData map) {
    ((TreeTableNodeObject)this.userObject).setMapDataOtherBUI(map);
  }
  
  public boolean isBUI27xChecked() {
    return ((TreeTableNodeObject)this.userObject).isBUI27xChecked();
  }
  
  public void setBUI27xChecked(boolean isChecked) {
    ((TreeTableNodeObject)this.userObject).setBUI27xChecked(isChecked);
  }
  
  public boolean isBUI350Checked() {
    return ((TreeTableNodeObject)this.userObject).isBUI350Checked();
  }
  
  public void setBUI350Checked(boolean isChecked) {
    ((TreeTableNodeObject)this.userObject).setBUI350Checked(isChecked);
  }
  
  public boolean isBui27xMapInRepository() {
    return ((getMapData().isBui27xMap() && getMapData().isInRepository()) || (
      getMapDataOtherBUI() != null && getMapDataOtherBUI().isBui27xMap() && getMapDataOtherBUI().isInRepository()));
  }
  
  public boolean isBui350MapInRepository() {
    return ((!getMapData().isBui27xMap() && getMapData().isInRepository()) || (
      getMapDataOtherBUI() != null && !getMapDataOtherBUI().isBui27xMap() && getMapDataOtherBUI().isInRepository()));
  }
  
  public boolean doesBui27xMapExist() {
    return (getMapData().isBui27xMap() || (getMapDataOtherBUI() != null && getMapDataOtherBUI().isBui27xMap()));
  }
  
  public boolean doesBui350MapExist() {
    return (!getMapData().isBui27xMap() || (
      getMapDataOtherBUI() != null && !getMapDataOtherBUI().isBui27xMap()));
  }
  
  public Vector<TreeTableNode> getChildren() {
    if (this.children == null)
      return null; 
    Vector<TreeTableNode> nodes = new Vector<>();
    for (TreeNode node : this.children)
      nodes.add((TreeTableNode)node); 
    return nodes;
  }
  
  public String toString() {
    return ((TreeTableNodeObject)this.userObject).getMapData().toString();
  }
  
  public void setUserObject(Object object) {
    if (object.getClass() == TreeTableNodeObject.class)
      this.userObject = object; 
  }
}

package com.gigatronik.beds.gui.panels.mapstab.exception;

public class FileDownloadFailedException extends Exception {
  public enum FAILED_FILE {
    MAP_SELECTION_XML, CONTEXT_XML, UNDEFINED;
  }
  
  private FAILED_FILE file = FAILED_FILE.UNDEFINED;
  
  public FileDownloadFailedException(String text, FAILED_FILE file) {
    super(text);
    this.file = file;
  }
  
  public FileDownloadFailedException(String text) {
    super(text);
  }
  
  public FAILED_FILE getFailedFile() {
    return this.file;
  }
}

ITEM 222: com/gigatronik/beds/gui/panels/mapstab/MapDeleteController.java

package com.gigatronik.beds.gui.panels.mapstab;

import com.gigatronik.beds.gui.panels.mapstab.displaydialog.MapDisplayDialog;
import com.gigatronik.beds.gui.panels.mapstab.displaydialog.MapDisplayDialogFactory;
import com.gigatronik.beds.gui.panels.mapstab.dualtree.TreeTableNode;
import com.gigatronik.beds.gui.panels.mapstab.exception.XmlFileParsingException;
import com.gigatronik.beds.gui.panels.mapstab.parser.MapData;
import com.gigatronik.beds.gui.panels.mapstab.parser.MapXmlFileParser;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.bosch.service.internationalization.ResourceBundleFactory;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.bosch.service.internationalization.Utf8ResourceBundleFormatted;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.framework.plugins.exceptions.ConfigurationNotFoundException;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.gui.EBikeApplication;
import java.io.File;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Paths;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Objects;
import javax.swing.tree.DefaultMutableTreeNode;
import org.apache.commons.io.FileUtils;
import org.slf4j.Logger;
import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;

class MapDeleteController {
  private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(MapDeleteController.class);
  
  private static final Utf8ResourceBundleFormatted BUNDLE = ResourceBundleFactory.newDefaultResourceBundle();
  
  private final MapXmlFileParser mapXmlFileParser;
  
  private final MapTabController mapTabController;
  
  private final EBikeApplication eBikeApplication;
  
  private final MapDisplayDialogFactory dialogFactory;
  
  private final MapRepositorySettingHandler settingHandler = new MapRepositorySettingHandler();
  
  MapDeleteController(MapXmlFileParser mapXmlFileParser, MapTabController mapTabController, EBikeApplication eBikeApplication, MapDisplayDialogFactory dialogFactory) {
    this.mapXmlFileParser = mapXmlFileParser;
    this.mapTabController = mapTabController;
    this.eBikeApplication = eBikeApplication;
    this.dialogFactory = dialogFactory;
  }
  
  void onDeleteLocalMapsButtonPressed() {
    try {
      onDeleteLocalMapsButtonPressedTry();
    } catch (ConfigurationNotFoundException|XmlFileParsingException|IOException ex) {
      LOGGER.warn("Maps deletion procedure failed!", (Throwable)ex);
      updateStatusBar(false);
    } 
  }
  
  private void onDeleteLocalMapsButtonPressedTry() throws ConfigurationNotFoundException, IOException, XmlFileParsingException {
    LOGGER.info("Delete local maps button pressed");
    MapDisplayDialog dialog = createMapSelectionDialog();
    if (showDialog(dialog) == 0)
      deleteAction(dialog.getSelectedMapsFromTree()); 
  }
  
  private MapDisplayDialog createMapSelectionDialog() throws XmlFileParsingException, ConfigurationNotFoundException {
    if (this.settingHandler.isBui350Supported()) {
      TreeTableNode treeTableNode = this.mapXmlFileParser.createDualTreeFromRepository();
      this.mapXmlFileParser.deselectNodes(treeTableNode);
      return this.dialogFactory.createDeletionDialogDualTree(treeTableNode);
    } 
    DefaultMutableTreeNode tree = this.mapXmlFileParser.createBui27xTreeFromRepository();
    return this.dialogFactory.createDeletionDialogSingleTree(tree);
  }
  
  private int showDialog(MapDisplayDialog dialog) {
    int userFeedback = dialog.showMapDialog();
    LOGGER.info("User pressed button '{}' on maps deletion dialog with the following selected maps: {}", Integer.valueOf(userFeedback), dialog.getSelectedMapsFromTree().toArray());
    return userFeedback;
  }
  
  private void deleteAction(List<MapData> selectedMaps) throws ConfigurationNotFoundException, IOException {
    if (!selectedMaps.isEmpty()) {
      updateRepositoryContent(selectedMaps);
      updateGuiAfterDeletionAction();
    } 
  }
  
  private void updateRepositoryContent(List<MapData> mapsToBeDeleted) throws ConfigurationNotFoundException, IOException {
    deleteMaps(mapsToBeDeleted);
    removeEmptyDirectories();
    removeRepositoryIfAllMapsDeleted();
  }
  
  private void deleteMaps(List<MapData> selectedMaps) throws IOException {
    for (MapData map : selectedMaps) {
      LOGGER.info("Deleting map: '{}' at '{}'", map.getAreaName(), map.getMapUrl());
      Files.deleteIfExists(Paths.get(map.getMapUrl()));
    } 
  }
  
  private void removeEmptyDirectories() throws ConfigurationNotFoundException, IOException {
    String path = this.settingHandler.getLocalEBikeMapsDirectoryPath();
    removeEmptyDirectoriesRecursivly(path);
  }
  
  private void removeEmptyDirectoriesRecursivly(String path) throws IOException {
    File directory = new File(path);
    File[] listofFiles = directory.listFiles();
    assert listofFiles != null;
    if (listofFiles.length == 0) {
      deleteEmptyDirectory(directory);
    } else if (doesContainOnlyEmptyDirectories(directory)) {
      deleteEmptyDirectoriesRecursivly(directory);
    } else {
      checkContainedDirectories(listofFiles);
    } 
  }
  
  private void deleteEmptyDirectory(File directory) {
    LOGGER.debug("Deleting empty directory '{}'", directory.getAbsolutePath());
    try {
      Files.delete(directory.toPath());
    } catch (IOException e) {
      LOGGER.warn("The directory {} cannot be deleted", directory.getName(), e);
    } 
  }
  
  private void deleteEmptyDirectoriesRecursivly(File directory) throws IOException {
    LOGGER.debug("Deleting empty directories in '{}'", directory.getAbsolutePath());
    FileUtils.deleteDirectory(directory);
  }
  
  private void checkContainedDirectories(File[] listOfFiles) throws IOException {
    for (File file : listOfFiles) {
      if (file.isDirectory())
        removeEmptyDirectoriesRecursivly(file.getAbsolutePath()); 
    } 
  }
  
  private boolean doesContainOnlyEmptyDirectories(File directory) {
    return doesContainOnlyEmptyDirectories(Objects.<File[]>requireNonNull(directory.listFiles()));
  }
  
  private boolean doesContainOnlyEmptyDirectories(File[] files) {
    for (File file : files) {
      if (!file.isDirectory() || !doesContainOnlyEmptyDirectories(file))
        return false; 
    } 
    return true;
  }
  
  private void removeRepositoryIfAllMapsDeleted() throws ConfigurationNotFoundException {
    removeRepositoryIfAllMapsDeleted(this.settingHandler.getLocalBui27xDirectoryPath());
    removeRepositoryIfAllMapsDeleted(this.settingHandler.getLocalBui350DirectoryPath());
  }
  
  private void removeRepositoryIfAllMapsDeleted(String filePath) {
    File directory = new File(filePath);
    if (directory.exists()) {
      File[] listOfFiles = directory.listFiles();
      if (listOfFiles != null && listOfFiles.length == 1 && listOfFiles[0].getName().equals("MapSelection.xml")) {
        LOGGER.debug("Delete '{}' as well, as there are no more maps in the repository.", directory.getAbsolutePath());
        try {
          Files.delete(listOfFiles[0].toPath());
          Files.delete(directory.toPath());
        } catch (IOException e) {
          LOGGER.warn("An error occurred trying to delete the repository", (Throwable)e);
        } 
      } 
    } 
  }
  
  private void updateGuiAfterDeletionAction() {
    this.mapTabController.refreshLocalDisplayedMaps();
    this.mapTabController.updateDeleteButtonState();
    updateStatusBar(true);
  }
  
  private void updateStatusBar(boolean success) {
    if (success) {
      this.eBikeApplication.showStatusInfo(BUNDLE.getString("EBikeMapTab.status.delete.success"));
    } else {
      this.eBikeApplication.showStatusError(BUNDLE.getString("EBikeMapTab.status.delete.failure"));
    } 
  }
}

ITEM 223: com/gigatronik/beds/gui/panels/mapstab/MapDownloadController.java

package com.gigatronik.beds.gui.panels.mapstab;

import com.gigatronik.beds.gui.panels.mapstab.displaydialog.MapDisplayDialog;
import com.gigatronik.beds.gui.panels.mapstab.displaydialog.MapDisplayDialogFactory;
import com.gigatronik.beds.gui.panels.mapstab.dualtree.TreeTableNode;
import com.gigatronik.beds.gui.panels.mapstab.exception.FileDownloadFailedException;
import com.gigatronik.beds.gui.panels.mapstab.exception.XmlFileParsingException;
import com.gigatronik.beds.gui.panels.mapstab.parser.MapData;
import com.gigatronik.beds.gui.panels.mapstab.parser.MapXmlFileParser;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.bosch.applicationprocess.ApplicationProcessManager;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.bosch.service.internationalization.ResourceBundleFactory;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.bosch.service.internationalization.Utf8ResourceBundleFormatted;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.bosch.updateserver.UPDATE_SERVER_URL;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.bosch.updateserver.UpdateServerConnection;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.framework.plugins.exceptions.ConfigurationNotFoundException;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.gui.EBikeApplication;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.gui.testinterface.TestableJOptionPane;
import java.lang.reflect.InvocationTargetException;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Optional;
import java.util.concurrent.ExecutorService;
import java.util.concurrent.Executors;
import java.util.function.Predicate;
import javax.swing.SwingUtilities;
import javax.swing.tree.DefaultMutableTreeNode;
import org.apache.commons.lang3.StringUtils;
import org.apache.commons.lang3.concurrent.BasicThreadFactory;
import org.slf4j.Logger;
import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;

public class MapDownloadController {
  private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(EBikeMapTab.class);
  
  private static final Utf8ResourceBundleFormatted BUNDLE = ResourceBundleFactory.newDefaultResourceBundle();
  
  static final String MAP_SELECTION_XML = "MapSelection.xml";
  
  private static final String CONTENT_XML = "content.xml";
  
  private final UpdateServerConnection updateServerConnection;
  
  private final EBikeApplication eBikeApplication;
  
  private final ApplicationProcessManager applicationProcessManager;
  
  private final MapXmlFileParser mapXmlFileParser;
  
  private final MapTabController mapTabController;
  
  private final EBikeMapTab mapTab;
  
  private final MapTabBtnStateChangeEvent buttonChangeEvent;
  
  private final MapDisplayDialogFactory displayDialogFactory;
  
  private final MapRepositorySettingHandler settingHandler = new MapRepositorySettingHandler();
  
  private MapDownloader mapDownloader;
  
  MapDownloadController(EBikeMapTab eBikeMapTab, MapTabController mapTabController, MapTabBtnStateChangeEvent buttonChangeEvent, UpdateServerConnection updateServerConnection, EBikeApplication eBikeApplication, ApplicationProcessManager applicationProcessManager, MapDisplayDialogFactory displayDialogFactory, MapXmlFileParser mapXmlFileParser) {
    this.updateServerConnection = updateServerConnection;
    this.eBikeApplication = eBikeApplication;
    this.applicationProcessManager = applicationProcessManager;
    this.mapTabController = mapTabController;
    this.mapTab = eBikeMapTab;
    this.buttonChangeEvent = buttonChangeEvent;
    this.displayDialogFactory = displayDialogFactory;
    this.mapXmlFileParser = mapXmlFileParser;
  }
  
  void onMapsDownloadButtonPressed() {
    LOGGER.info("Maps download button pressed");
    updateMapsDownloadButtonEnableState(false);
    if (this.updateServerConnection.isServerAvailable(true)) {
      prepareGuiForMapsDownload();
      downloadMapCatalog();
    } else {
      LOGGER.warn("Update server not available on map download");
      updateMapsDownloadButtonEnableState(true);
    } 
  }
  
  private void downloadMapCatalog() {
    ExecutorService scheduler = Executors.newSingleThreadScheduledExecutor(new BasicThreadFactory.Builder().namingPattern("MapDownloadButtonPressedProcessor-%d").build());
    scheduler.submit(this::downloadMapCatalogDelegated);
    scheduler.shutdown();
  }
  
  private void updateMapsDownloadButtonEnableState(boolean newState) {
    this.mapTabController.onMapTabButtonChanged(this.buttonChangeEvent.setDownloadButtonPressed(!newState));
  }
  
  private void prepareGuiForMapsDownload() {
    this.mapTab.updateMapDownloadFileProgressBarValue(0);
    this.mapTab.updateMapDownloadTotalProgressBarValue(0);
  }
  
  private void downloadMapCatalogDelegated() {
    try {
      XmlDownloadResult xmlDownloadResult = downloadMapsCatalogFromServer();
      onMapsCatalogSuccessfullyDownloaded(xmlDownloadResult);
    } catch (ConfigurationNotFoundException e) {
      openPopup("EBikeMapTab.mapRepositoryMissing.optionPane.title", "EBikeMapTab.mapRepositoryMissing.optionPane.message");
      uponExceptionCaughtDuringMapCatalogDownload();
    } catch (FileDownloadFailedException e) {
      FileDownloadFailedException.FAILED_FILE failedFile = e.getFailedFile();
      if (failedFile == FileDownloadFailedException.FAILED_FILE.CONTEXT_XML) {
        openPopup("EBikeMapTab.mapContentMissing.optionPane.title", "EBikeMapTab.mapContentMissing.optionPane.message");
      } else if (failedFile == FileDownloadFailedException.FAILED_FILE.MAP_SELECTION_XML) {
        openPopup("EBikeMapTab.mapSelectionMissing.optionPane.title", "EBikeMapTab.mapSelectionMissing.optionPane.message");
      } 
      uponExceptionCaughtDuringMapCatalogDownload();
    } 
  }
  
  private void uponExceptionCaughtDuringMapCatalogDownload() {
    this.applicationProcessManager.setProcessState(ApplicationProcessManager.ApplicationProcess.DOWNLOAD_MAP, false);
    updateMapsDownloadButtonEnableState(true);
  }
  
  private void onMapsCatalogSuccessfullyDownloaded(XmlDownloadResult result) {
    try {
      onMapsCatalogDownloadedTry(result);
    } catch (XmlFileParsingException|ConfigurationNotFoundException ex) {
      LOGGER.warn("Failed parsing downloaded XML content from update server!", (Throwable)ex);
      openPopup("EBikeMapTab.mapContentMissing.optionPane.title", "EBikeMapTab.mapContentMissing.optionPane.message");
      this.applicationProcessManager.setProcessState(ApplicationProcessManager.ApplicationProcess.DOWNLOAD_MAP, false);
    } 
    updateMapsDownloadButtonEnableState(true);
  }
  
  private void onMapsCatalogDownloadedTry(XmlDownloadResult result) throws ConfigurationNotFoundException, XmlFileParsingException {
    MapDisplayDialog mapDialog = createDownloadDialog(result);
    if (mapDialog.showMapDialog() == 0 && this.updateServerConnection.isServerAvailable(true)) {
      onUserFinishedMapSelection(result, mapDialog.getSelectedMapsFromTree());
    } else {
      LOGGER.info("User closed maps download selection dialog");
      this.applicationProcessManager.setProcessState(ApplicationProcessManager.ApplicationProcess.DOWNLOAD_MAP, false);
    } 
  }
  
  private MapDisplayDialog createDownloadDialog(XmlDownloadResult result) throws XmlFileParsingException, ConfigurationNotFoundException {
    if (this.settingHandler.isBui350Supported()) {
      TreeTableNode treeTableNode = this.mapXmlFileParser.createDualTreeFromContentXml(result.getBui27xDownloadResult().getXmlContent(), 
          result.getBui27xDownloadResult().getXmlMapSelection(), 
          result.getBui350DownloadResult().getXmlContent(), 
          result.getBui350DownloadResult().getXmlMapSelection());
      return this.displayDialogFactory.createDownloadDialogDualTree(treeTableNode);
    } 
    DefaultMutableTreeNode tree = this.mapXmlFileParser.createSingleTreeFromContentXml(result.getBui27xDownloadResult().getXmlContent(), 
        result.getBui27xDownloadResult().getXmlMapSelection());
    return this.displayDialogFactory.createDownloadDialogSingleTree(tree);
  }
  
  private void onUserFinishedMapSelection(XmlDownloadResult downloadResult, List<MapData> selectedMaps) throws ConfigurationNotFoundException, XmlFileParsingException {
    MapsVersionComparisionResult comparisionResult = checkMapsVersionDifferences(selectedMaps);
    if (comparisionResult.doesAnyMapsVersionDiffer()) {
      int dialogResult = showRepositoryResetDialog(comparisionResult);
      LOGGER.info("User pressed button '{}' on map selection dialog", Integer.valueOf(dialogResult));
      if (dialogResult == 2) {
        this.applicationProcessManager.setProcessState(ApplicationProcessManager.ApplicationProcess.DOWNLOAD_MAP, false);
        return;
      } 
    } 
    List<MapData> mapsForDownload = filterMapsSelection(selectedMaps, comparisionResult);
    if (!mapsForDownload.isEmpty()) {
      this.mapTab.getMapUpdateChecker().resetUpdateAvailableState();
      downloadSelectedMaps(mapsForDownload, comparisionResult, downloadResult);
    } else {
      this.applicationProcessManager.setProcessState(ApplicationProcessManager.ApplicationProcess.DOWNLOAD_MAP, false);
    } 
  }
  
  private List<MapData> filterMapsSelection(List<MapData> selectedMaps, MapsVersionComparisionResult comparisionResult) {
    LOGGER.debug("Maps selected by user: {}", selectedMaps);
    List<MapData> result = new ArrayList<>();
    for (MapData map : selectedMaps) {
      if (!map.isInRepository() || isExistingMapOutdated(map, comparisionResult))
        result.add(map); 
    } 
    LOGGER.debug("Maps to be downloaded: {}", result);
    return result;
  }
  
  private boolean isExistingMapOutdated(MapData map, MapsVersionComparisionResult comparisionResult) {
    return ((comparisionResult.doBui27xMapsVersionDiffer() && map.isBui27xMap()) || (comparisionResult.doBui350MapsVersionDiffer() && !map.isBui27xMap()));
  }
  
  private void downloadSelectedMaps(List<MapData> selectedMaps, MapsVersionComparisionResult comparisionResult, XmlDownloadResult downloadResult) {
    this.mapDownloader = new MapDownloader(selectedMaps, comparisionResult, downloadResult, this.eBikeApplication, this.applicationProcessManager, this.updateServerConnection, this.mapTabController, this.mapTab, this.mapXmlFileParser, this.buttonChangeEvent);
    ExecutorService scheduler = Executors.newSingleThreadScheduledExecutor(new BasicThreadFactory.Builder().namingPattern("MapDownloader-%d").build());
    scheduler.submit(this.mapDownloader);
    scheduler.shutdown();
  }
  
  private boolean areBui27xMapsSelected(List<MapData> selectedMaps) {
    return selectedMaps.stream().anyMatch(MapData::isBui27xMap);
  }
  
  private boolean areBui350MapsSelected(List<MapData> selectedMaps) {
    return selectedMaps.stream().anyMatch(map -> !map.isBui27xMap());
  }
  
  private MapsVersionComparisionResult checkMapsVersionDifferences(List<MapData> selectedMaps) throws ConfigurationNotFoundException, XmlFileParsingException {
    boolean bui27xVersionsDiffer = (areBui27xMapsSelected(selectedMaps) && doBui27xVersionsDiffer(selectedMaps));
    boolean bui350VersionsDiffer = (areBui350MapsSelected(selectedMaps) && doBui350VersionsDiffer(selectedMaps));
    return new MapsVersionComparisionResult(bui27xVersionsDiffer, bui350VersionsDiffer);
  }
  
  private boolean doBui27xVersionsDiffer(List<MapData> selectedMaps) throws XmlFileParsingException, ConfigurationNotFoundException {
    String serverMapVersion = getMapVersionFromList(selectedMaps, MapData::isBui27xMap);
    String localMapVersion = getLocalMapVersionBui27x();
    LOGGER.debug("Compare BUI27x map versions: local='{}', server='{}'", localMapVersion, serverMapVersion);
    return doMapVersionsDiffer(localMapVersion, serverMapVersion);
  }
  
  private boolean doBui350VersionsDiffer(List<MapData> selectedMaps) throws XmlFileParsingException, ConfigurationNotFoundException {
    String serverMapVersion = getMapVersionFromList(selectedMaps, mapData -> !mapData.isBui27xMap());
    String localMapVersion = getLocalMapVersionBui350();
    LOGGER.debug("Compare BUI350 map versions: local='{}', server='{}'", localMapVersion, serverMapVersion);
    return doMapVersionsDiffer(localMapVersion, serverMapVersion);
  }
  
  private String getLocalMapVersionBui27x() throws ConfigurationNotFoundException {
    try {
      List<MapData> list = this.mapXmlFileParser.parseBUI27xMapSelectionXmlFromRepository();
      return getMapVersionFromList(list, MapData::isBui27xMap);
    } catch (XmlFileParsingException ex) {
      LOGGER.warn("Local maps version for BUI27x is unknown!", (Throwable)ex);
      return "";
    } 
  }
  
  private String getLocalMapVersionBui350() throws ConfigurationNotFoundException {
    try {
      List<MapData> list = this.mapXmlFileParser.parseBUI350MapSelectionXmlFromRepository();
      return getMapVersionFromList(list, mapData -> !mapData.isBui27xMap());
    } catch (XmlFileParsingException ex) {
      LOGGER.warn("Local maps version for BUI350 is unknown!", (Throwable)ex);
      return "";
    } 
  }
  
  private String getMapVersionFromList(List<MapData> list, Predicate<MapData> filter) {
    if (!list.isEmpty()) {
      Optional<MapData> first = list.stream().filter(filter).findFirst();
      if (first.isPresent())
        return first.get().getMapVersion(); 
    } 
    return "";
  }
  
  private boolean doMapVersionsDiffer(String local, String remote) throws XmlFileParsingException {
    if (StringUtils.isBlank(remote))
      throw new XmlFileParsingException("Remote maps version '" + remote + "' must be valid to download maps!"); 
    if (StringUtils.isBlank(local)) {
      LOGGER.warn("Assume no local maps exist, as localMapsVersion='{}'", local);
      return false;
    } 
    return !local.equals(remote);
  }
  
  private int showRepositoryResetDialog(MapsVersionComparisionResult result) {
    String deviceText;
    if (result.doBothMapsVersionDiffer()) {
      deviceText = "BUI27x & BUI350";
    } else if (result.doBui350MapsVersionDiffer()) {
      deviceText = "BUI350";
    } else {
      deviceText = "BUI27x";
    } 
    String message = String.format(BUNDLE.getString("EBikeMapTab.newMapVersion.optionPane.message"), deviceText);
    String title = BUNDLE.getString("EBikeMapTab.newMapVersion.optionPane.title");
    return TestableJOptionPane.showConfirmDialog(message, title, 2);
  }
  
  private XmlDownloadResult downloadMapsCatalogFromServer() throws ConfigurationNotFoundException, FileDownloadFailedException {
    this.applicationProcessManager.setProcessState(ApplicationProcessManager.ApplicationProcess.DOWNLOAD_MAP, true);
    checkMapsRepositoryConfig();
    String contentXml = downloadBui27xContentXmlFile();
    String mapSelectionXml = downloadBui27xMapSelectionXmlFile();
    XmlDownloadResultDevice bui27xDownloadResult = new XmlDownloadResultDevice(contentXml, mapSelectionXml);
    XmlDownloadResultDevice bui350DownloadResult = null;
    if (this.settingHandler.isBui350Supported()) {
      contentXml = downloadBui350ContentXmlFile();
      mapSelectionXml = downloadBui350MapSelectionXmlFile();
      bui350DownloadResult = new XmlDownloadResultDevice(contentXml, mapSelectionXml);
    } 
    return new XmlDownloadResult(bui27xDownloadResult, bui350DownloadResult);
  }
  
  private void checkMapsRepositoryConfig() throws ConfigurationNotFoundException {
    this.settingHandler.getLocalMapsRepositoryPath();
  }
  
  private String downloadBui27xContentXmlFile() throws FileDownloadFailedException {
    return downloadFile(getUrlBui27x() + "content.xml", FileDownloadFailedException.FAILED_FILE.CONTEXT_XML);
  }
  
  private String downloadBui350ContentXmlFile() throws FileDownloadFailedException {
    return downloadFile(getUrlBui350() + "content.xml", FileDownloadFailedException.FAILED_FILE.CONTEXT_XML);
  }
  
  public String downloadBui27xMapSelectionXmlFile() throws FileDownloadFailedException {
    return downloadFile(getUrlBui27x() + "MapSelection.xml", FileDownloadFailedException.FAILED_FILE.MAP_SELECTION_XML);
  }
  
  public String downloadBui350MapSelectionXmlFile() throws FileDownloadFailedException {
    return downloadFile(getUrlBui350() + "MapSelection.xml", FileDownloadFailedException.FAILED_FILE.MAP_SELECTION_XML);
  }
  
  private String downloadFile(String url, FileDownloadFailedException.FAILED_FILE file) throws FileDownloadFailedException {
    String pathDownloadedFile = this.updateServerConnection.downloadFileSync(url);
    if (StringUtils.isBlank(pathDownloadedFile))
      throw new FileDownloadFailedException("File missing on server: " + url, file); 
    LOGGER.debug("'{}' downloaded successfully!", url);
    return pathDownloadedFile;
  }
  
  private void openPopup(String titleKey, String messageKey) {
    if (SwingUtilities.isEventDispatchThread()) {
      openPopupFromCurrentThread(titleKey, messageKey);
    } else {
      delegateOpeningPopupToEDT(titleKey, messageKey);
    } 
  }
  
  private void delegateOpeningPopupToEDT(String titleKey, String messageKey) {
    try {
      SwingUtilities.invokeAndWait(() -> openPopupFromCurrentThread(titleKey, messageKey));
    } catch (InvocationTargetException ex) {
      LOGGER.warn("Waiting skipped!", (Throwable)ex);
    } catch (InterruptedException in) {
      Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
      LOGGER.warn("Waiting skipped!", (Throwable)in);
    } 
  }
  
  private void openPopupFromCurrentThread(String titleKey, String messageKey) {
    TestableJOptionPane.showMessageDialog(BUNDLE.getString(messageKey), BUNDLE.getString(titleKey), 0);
  }
  
  void onAbordDownloadButtonPressed() {
    this.mapDownloader.abortDownloading();
  }
  
  private String getUrlBui27x() {
    return UPDATE_SERVER_URL.get(UPDATE_SERVER_URL.MAP_BUI27X_DOWNLOAD).toString();
  }
  
  private String getUrlBui350() {
    return UPDATE_SERVER_URL.get(UPDATE_SERVER_URL.MAP_BUI350_DOWNLOAD).toString();
  }
}

ITEM 224: com/gigatronik/beds/gui/panels/mapstab/MapDownloader.java

package com.gigatronik.beds.gui.panels.mapstab;

import com.gigatronik.beds.gui.panels.mapstab.exception.FileDownloadFailedException;
import com.gigatronik.beds.gui.panels.mapstab.parser.MapData;
import com.gigatronik.beds.gui.panels.mapstab.parser.MapXmlFileParser;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.bosch.applicationprocess.ApplicationProcessManager;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.bosch.service.internationalization.ResourceBundleFactory;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.bosch.service.internationalization.Utf8ResourceBundleFormatted;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.bosch.updateserver.UpdateServerConnection;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.framework.plugins.exceptions.ConfigurationNotFoundException;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.gui.EBikeApplication;
import java.io.File;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.util.List;
import org.apache.commons.lang3.StringUtils;
import org.slf4j.Logger;
import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;

public class MapDownloader implements Runnable {
  private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(MapDownloader.class);
  
  private static final Utf8ResourceBundleFormatted BUNDLE = ResourceBundleFactory.newDefaultResourceBundle();
  
  public static final String REMOTE_REPOSITORY_BUI27X_DIRECTORY = "/Map/";
  
  public static final String REMOTE_REPOSITORY_BUI350_DIRECTORY = "/Map_BUI350/";
  
  private final EBikeMapTab mapTab;
  
  private final EBikeApplication eBikeApplication;
  
  private final ApplicationProcessManager applicationProcessManager;
  
  private final UpdateServerConnection updateServerConnection;
  
  private final MapTabController mapTabController;
  
  private final MapTabBtnStateChangeEvent buttonChangeEvent;
  
  private final MapXmlFileParser mapXmlFileParser;
  
  private final MapRepositorySettingHandler settingHandler = new MapRepositorySettingHandler();
  
  private final List<MapData> mapsToBeDownloaded;
  
  private final MapsVersionComparisionResult versionCheckResult;
  
  private final XmlDownloadResult xmlDownloadResult;
  
  private MapDownloadProgressUpdater mapDownloadProgressUpdater;
  
  private int numDownloadErrors = 0;
  
  private boolean bui27xMapsRepositoryResetDone = false;
  
  private boolean bui350MapsRepositoryResetDone = false;
  
  private boolean bui27xMapSelectionXmlCopied = false;
  
  private boolean bui350MapSelectionXmlCopied = false;
  
  MapDownloader(List<MapData> maps, MapsVersionComparisionResult versionCheckResult, XmlDownloadResult xmlDownloadResult, EBikeApplication eBikeApplication, ApplicationProcessManager applicationProcessManager, UpdateServerConnection updateServerConnection, MapTabController mapTabController, EBikeMapTab eBikeMapTab, MapXmlFileParser mapXmlFileParser, MapTabBtnStateChangeEvent buttonChangeEvent) {
    this.mapsToBeDownloaded = maps;
    this.versionCheckResult = versionCheckResult;
    this.xmlDownloadResult = xmlDownloadResult;
    this.eBikeApplication = eBikeApplication;
    this.applicationProcessManager = applicationProcessManager;
    this.updateServerConnection = updateServerConnection;
    this.mapTab = eBikeMapTab;
    this.mapTabController = mapTabController;
    this.buttonChangeEvent = buttonChangeEvent;
    this.mapXmlFileParser = mapXmlFileParser;
  }
  
  public void run() {
    LOGGER.info("Thread MapDownloader started");
    prepareMapsDownload();
    downloadMaps();
    processDownloadResult();
    finalizeMapsDownload();
    LOGGER.info("Thread MapDownloader finished");
  }
  
  private void prepareMapsDownload() {
    updateGuiToMapDownloadState();
    initializeProgressUpdater();
  }
  
  private void updateGuiToMapDownloadState() {
    this.mapTabController.onMapDownloadStart();
    this.eBikeApplication.showStatusInfo(BUNDLE.getString("EbikeMapTab.status.download.start"));
  }
  
  private void initializeProgressUpdater() {
    this.mapDownloadProgressUpdater = new MapDownloadProgressUpdater(this.mapTab);
    double sizeOfAllMaps = computeSizeOfAllMaps();
    this.mapDownloadProgressUpdater.setCompleteSize(sizeOfAllMaps);
  }
  
  private double computeSizeOfAllMaps() {
    return this.mapsToBeDownloaded.stream()
      .map(MapData::getMapSize)
      .reduce((sum, element) -> sum + element)
      .orElse(Double.valueOf(0.0D));
  }
  
  private void downloadMaps() {
    try {
      downloadMapsTry();
    } catch (ConfigurationNotFoundException ex) {
      LOGGER.error("Downloading maps not possible, 'cause of unconfigured target directory", (Throwable)ex);
      incrementDownloadFailureCounter(this.mapsToBeDownloaded.size());
    } 
  }
  
  private void downloadMapsTry() throws ConfigurationNotFoundException {
    for (int i = 0; i < this.mapsToBeDownloaded.size() && !this.buttonChangeEvent.isCancelInProgress(); i++) {
      MapData map = this.mapsToBeDownloaded.get(i);
      LOGGER.info("Start download of map file: {}", map.getMapUrl());
      updateGuiForIndividualMapDownload(map);
      downloadMap(map);
    } 
  }
  
  private void updateGuiForIndividualMapDownload(MapData map) {
    updateMapDownloadProgressLabelText(map);
    this.mapDownloadProgressUpdater.setFileSize(map.getMapSize());
  }
  
  private void updateMapDownloadProgressLabelText(MapData map) {
    int currentFileNumber = this.mapsToBeDownloaded.indexOf(map) + 1;
    int totalFileNumber = this.mapsToBeDownloaded.size();
    String mapName = map.getAreaName();
    String deviceExtension = getDeviceExtensionText(map);
    String labelText = String.format(BUNDLE.getString("EBikeMapTab.lbl_DownloadProgress.text.download"), currentFileNumber, totalFileNumber, mapName + mapName);
    this.mapTab.setMapDownloadProgressLabelText(labelText);
  }
  
  private String getDeviceExtensionText(MapData map) {
    if (this.settingHandler.isBui350Supported())
      return map.isBui27xMap() ? " (BUI27x)" : " (BUI350)"; 
    return "";
  }
  
  private void downloadMap(MapData map) throws ConfigurationNotFoundException {
    try {
      downloadMapTry(map);
    } catch (IOException|FileDownloadFailedException ex) {
      LOGGER.error("Download of map '" + map.getMapUrl() + "' failed", (Throwable)ex);
      this.eBikeApplication.showStatusError(BUNDLE.getString("EBikeMapTab.status.download.error") + BUNDLE.getString("EBikeMapTab.status.download.error"));
      incrementDownloadFailureCounter(1);
    } 
  }
  
  private void downloadMapTry(MapData map) throws ConfigurationNotFoundException, IOException, FileDownloadFailedException {
    String pathDownloadedMap = this.updateServerConnection.downloadFileSync(map.getMapUrl(), this.mapDownloadProgressUpdater);
    if (this.updateServerConnection.isDownloadCanceled()) {
      LOGGER.info("Download was aborted.");
    } else if (StringUtils.isNotBlank(pathDownloadedMap)) {
      onMapDownloadSuccess(map, pathDownloadedMap);
    } else {
      throw new FileDownloadFailedException("Error while downloading map file: '" + map.getMapUrl() + "'");
    } 
  }
  
  private void onMapDownloadSuccess(MapData map, String pathDownloadedMap) throws ConfigurationNotFoundException, IOException {
    LOGGER.info("Successful download of map file: {}", map.getMapUrl());
    String targetName = extractFileNameWithRelativePath(map);
    DownloadedMapFile file = new DownloadedMapFile(pathDownloadedMap, targetName, map);
    if (isRepositoryResetNecessary(map))
      resetRepository(map); 
    if (isRepositoryInitializationNecessary(map))
      copyMapSelectionXml(map); 
    copyFileToRepository(file);
  }
  
  private boolean isRepositoryResetNecessary(MapData map) {
    if (map.isBui27xMap() && this.versionCheckResult.doBui27xMapsVersionDiffer() && !this.bui27xMapsRepositoryResetDone) {
      this.bui27xMapsRepositoryResetDone = true;
      return true;
    } 
    if (!map.isBui27xMap() && this.versionCheckResult.doBui350MapsVersionDiffer() && !this.bui350MapsRepositoryResetDone) {
      this.bui350MapsRepositoryResetDone = true;
      return true;
    } 
    return false;
  }
  
  private void resetRepository(MapData map) throws IOException, ConfigurationNotFoundException {
    LOGGER.debug("Reset local maps repository (BUI27x: '{}', BUI350: '{}')", Boolean.valueOf(map.isBui27xMap()), Boolean.valueOf(!map.isBui27xMap()));
    if (map.isBui27xMap()) {
      this.mapXmlFileParser.cleanBui27xMapsRepository();
    } else {
      this.mapXmlFileParser.cleanBui350MapsRepository();
    } 
  }
  
  private boolean isRepositoryInitializationNecessary(MapData map) {
    if (map.isBui27xMap() && !this.bui27xMapSelectionXmlCopied) {
      this.bui27xMapSelectionXmlCopied = true;
      return true;
    } 
    if (!map.isBui27xMap() && !this.bui350MapSelectionXmlCopied) {
      this.bui350MapSelectionXmlCopied = true;
      return true;
    } 
    return false;
  }
  
  private void copyMapSelectionXml(MapData map) throws IOException, ConfigurationNotFoundException {
    LOGGER.debug("Initialize local maps repository (BUI27x: '{}', BUI350: '{}')", Boolean.valueOf(map.isBui27xMap()), Boolean.valueOf(!map.isBui27xMap()));
    if (map.isBui27xMap()) {
      this.mapXmlFileParser.copyFileToBui27xRepository(this.xmlDownloadResult.getBui27xDownloadResult().getXmlMapSelection(), "MapSelection.xml");
    } else {
      this.mapXmlFileParser.copyFileToBui350Repository(this.xmlDownloadResult.getBui350DownloadResult().getXmlMapSelection(), "MapSelection.xml");
    } 
  }
  
  private void copyFileToRepository(DownloadedMapFile map) throws ConfigurationNotFoundException, IOException {
    if (map.getData().isBui27xMap()) {
      this.mapXmlFileParser.copyFileToBui27xRepository(map.getSourcePath(), map.getTargetName());
    } else {
      this.mapXmlFileParser.copyFileToBui350Repository(map.getSourcePath(), map.getTargetName());
    } 
  }
  
  private String extractFileNameWithRelativePath(MapData map) {
    String directory = getDeviceSpecificDirectoryName(map);
    String url = map.getMapUrl();
    int index = url.indexOf(directory);
    String result = url.substring(index + directory.length());
    return result.replace('/', File.separatorChar);
  }
  
  private String getDeviceSpecificDirectoryName(MapData map) {
    if (map.isBui27xMap())
      return "/Map/"; 
    return "/Map_BUI350/";
  }
  
  private void processDownloadResult() {
    if (this.buttonChangeEvent.isCancelInProgress()) {
      updateGuiUponDownloadAborted();
    } else if (this.numDownloadErrors == 0) {
      updateGuiUponDownloadSuccess();
    } else {
      updateGuiUponDownloadFailure();
    } 
  }
  
  private void updateGuiUponDownloadAborted() {
    this.mapTab.setMapDownloadProgressLabelText(BUNDLE.getString("EBikeMapTab.lbl_DownloadProgress.text.abort"));
    this.eBikeApplication.showStatusInfo(BUNDLE.getString("EbikeMapTab.status.download.abort"));
  }
  
  private void updateGuiUponDownloadSuccess() {
    this.mapTab.setMapDownloadProgressLabelText(BUNDLE.getString("EBikeMapTab.lbl_DownloadProgress.text.success"));
    this.eBikeApplication.showStatusInfo(BUNDLE.getString("EBikeMapTab.status.download.success"));
    this.mapTab.updateMapDownloadFileProgressBarValue(100);
    this.mapTab.updateMapDownloadTotalProgressBarValue(100);
  }
  
  private void updateGuiUponDownloadFailure() {
    this.mapTab.setMapDownloadProgressLabelText(String.format(BUNDLE.getString("EBikeMapTab.lbl_DownloadProgress.text.error"), this.numDownloadErrors, this.mapsToBeDownloaded.size()));
    this.eBikeApplication.showStatusError(String.format(BUNDLE.getString("EBikeMapTab.status.download.partialError"), this.numDownloadErrors, this.mapsToBeDownloaded.size()));
  }
  
  private void finalizeMapsDownload() {
    this.mapDownloadProgressUpdater.cancel();
    this.mapTabController.onMapDownloadFinished();
    this.applicationProcessManager.setProcessState(ApplicationProcessManager.ApplicationProcess.DOWNLOAD_MAP, false);
  }
  
  private void incrementDownloadFailureCounter(int value) {
    this.numDownloadErrors += value;
  }
  
  void abortDownloading() {
    LOGGER.info("User aborts the map download");
    this.mapTabController.onMapTabButtonChanged(this.buttonChangeEvent.setCancelInProgress(true));
    this.updateServerConnection.cancelCurrentDownload();
  }
  
  private static class DownloadedMapFile {
    private final String sourcePath;
    
    private final String targetName;
    
    private final MapData data;
    
    DownloadedMapFile(String sourcePath, String targetName, MapData data) {
      this.sourcePath = sourcePath;
      this.targetName = targetName;
      this.data = data;
    }
    
    String getSourcePath() {
      return this.sourcePath;
    }
    
    String getTargetName() {
      return this.targetName;
    }
    
    MapData getData() {
      return this.data;
    }
  }
}

  private int calculateWidthForMapDownloadButton(JButton button) {
    AffineTransform at = new AffineTransform();
    FontRenderContext frc = new FontRenderContext(at, true, true);
    double widthDownload = button.getFont().getStringBounds(BUNDLE.getString("EBikeMapTab.btn_Download.text"), frc).getWidth();
    double widthAbort = (double)(int)button.getFont().getStringBounds(BUNDLE.getString("EBikeMapTab.btn_Download.abortDownload.text"), frc).getWidth();
    int maxWidth = (int)widthDownload + 1;
    if (widthDownload < widthAbort)
      maxWidth = (int)widthAbort + 1; 
    Insets insets = button.getInsets();
    maxWidth = maxWidth + insets.left + insets.right;
    return maxWidth;
  }

package com.gigatronik.beds.gui.panels.mapstab;

import com.gigatronik.dart2.bosch.updateserver.DownloadProgressStateListener;

class MapDownloadProgressUpdater implements DownloadProgressStateListener {
  private final EBikeMapTab mapTab;
  
  private double allFilesSizeTotal = 0.0D;
  
  private double allCompletedFilesSizeTotal = 0.0D;
  
  private double fileSizeTotal = 0.0D;
  
  private int fileProgressPercentual = 0;
  
  private boolean active = true;
  
  MapDownloadProgressUpdater(EBikeMapTab eBikeMapTab) {
    this.mapTab = eBikeMapTab;
  }
  
  public void onDownloadProgressStateChanged(int progress) {
    if (progress == this.fileProgressPercentual)
      return; 
    this.fileProgressPercentual = progress;
    updateGui();
  }
  
  private void updateGui() {
    if (this.active) {
      updateFileProgress();
      updateTotalProgress();
    } 
  }
  
  private void updateFileProgress() {
    this.mapTab.updateMapDownloadFileProgressBarValue(this.fileProgressPercentual);
  }
  
  private void updateTotalProgress() {
    double currentFileSize = computeSizeOfCurrentDownloadingFile();
    if (this.allFilesSizeTotal > 0.0D) {
      int currentTotalProgress = computeCurrentTotalProgress(currentFileSize);
      this.mapTab.updateMapDownloadTotalProgressBarValue(currentTotalProgress);
    } 
  }
  
  private int computeCurrentTotalProgress(double currentFileSize) {
    double currentCompleteDownloadedSize = this.allCompletedFilesSizeTotal + currentFileSize;
    double totalProgressPercentual = currentCompleteDownloadedSize / this.allFilesSizeTotal;
    return (int)(totalProgressPercentual * 100.0D);
  }
  
  private double computeSizeOfCurrentDownloadingFile() {
    return this.fileSizeTotal * (double)this.fileProgressPercentual / 100.0D;
  }
  
  void setCompleteSize(double size) {
    this.allFilesSizeTotal = size;
    this.fileSizeTotal = 0.0D;
  }
  
  void setFileSize(double size) {
    if (this.fileSizeTotal > 0.0D)
      this.allCompletedFilesSizeTotal += this.fileSizeTotal; 
    this.fileSizeTotal = size;
  }
  
  void cancel() {
    this.active = false;
  }
}

package com.gigatronik.beds.gui.panels.mapstab;

import com.gigatronik.beds.gui.panels.mapstab.parser.MapData;
import com.gigatronik.beds.gui.panels.mapstab.parser.MapXmlFileParser;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.communication.api.CommunicationManager;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.configuration.ConfigurationManager;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.ecuconnectionstate.api.EcuConnectionStateHandler;

import com.gigatronik.beds.service.ecuflash.impl.FlashResult;

import com.gigatronik.ebike.utils.NyonFlashValidationUtil;
import java.awt.Component;
import java.awt.EventQueue;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.List;

import java.util.concurrent.ScheduledExecutorService;
import javax.swing.tree.TreePath;
import org.apache.commons.lang3.concurrent.BasicThreadFactory;
import org.slf4j.Logger;
import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;

class MapFlashController {
  private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(MapFlashController.class);
  
  private static final Utf8ResourceBundleFormatted BUNDLE = ResourceBundleFactory.newDefaultResourceBundle();
  
  private final ScheduledExecutorService executor = Executors.newSingleThreadScheduledExecutor(new BasicThreadFactory.Builder().namingPattern("MapsFlashExecutor-%d").build());
  
  private final CommunicationManager communicationManager;
  
  private final ConfigurationManager configurationManager;
  
  private final EcuConnectionStateHandler ecuConnectionStateHandler;
  
  private final EBikeApplication eBikeApplication;
  
  private final ApplicationProcessManager applicationProcessManager;
  
  private final MapXmlFileParser mapSelectionParser;
  
  private final NyonFlashValidationUtil nyonFlashValidationUtil;
  
  private final EBikeMapTab mapTab;
  
  private final MapTabBtnStateChangeEvent buttonChangeEvent;
  
  private final MapTabController mapTabController;
  
  private SystemFlashProcedure flashPlugin;
  
  private FlashProgressDialog flashProgressDialog;
  
  private MapFlashProgressEventListener mapFlashProgressEventListener;
  
  MapFlashController(EBikeMapTab eBikeMapTab, MapTabController mapTabController, CommunicationManager communicationManager, ConfigurationManager configurationManager, EcuConnectionStateHandler ecuConnectionStateHandler, EBikeApplication eBikeApplication, ApplicationProcessManager applicationProcessManager, MapXmlFileParser mapSelectionParser, MapTabBtnStateChangeEvent buttonChangeEvent) {
    this.communicationManager = communicationManager;
    this.configurationManager = configurationManager;
    this.ecuConnectionStateHandler = ecuConnectionStateHandler;
    this.eBikeApplication = eBikeApplication;
    this.applicationProcessManager = applicationProcessManager;
    this.mapSelectionParser = mapSelectionParser;
    this.buttonChangeEvent = buttonChangeEvent;
    this.mapTab = eBikeMapTab;
    this.mapTabController = mapTabController;
    this.nyonFlashValidationUtil = new NyonFlashValidationUtil(configurationManager, communicationManager);
  }
  
  void onFlashButtonPressed() {
    LOGGER.info("Maps flash button pressed");
    if (areMapsFlashPreconditionsFulfilled()) {
      createInstancesAndRegisterListeners();
      triggerFlashProcedureInBackgroundThread();
    } 
  }
  
  private boolean areMapsFlashPreconditionsFulfilled() {
    if (this.nyonFlashValidationUtil.checkNyonChargeLevel()) {
      NyonFlashValidationUtil.MapVersionCompare result = this.nyonFlashValidationUtil.checkNyonMapVersionToLocal();
      return processMapVersionCompareResult(result);
    } 
    TestableJOptionPane.showMessageDialog(BUNDLE.getString("EbikeMapTab.map.flash.nyon.battery.too.low.message"), BUNDLE.getString("EbikeMapTab.map.flash.nyon.battery.too.low.title"), 0);
    return false;
  }
  
  private boolean processMapVersionCompareResult(NyonFlashValidationUtil.MapVersionCompare mapVersionCompare) {
    switch (mapVersionCompare) {
      case EQUAL:
        return true;
      case NYON_MAPS_OUTDATED:
        TestableJOptionPane.showMessageDialog(BUNDLE.getString("EbikeMapTab.map.flash.nyon.sw.too.old.message"), BUNDLE.getString("EbikeMapTab.map.flash.nyon.sw.too.old.title"), 0);
        return false;
      case LOCAL_MAPS_OUTDATED:
        TestableJOptionPane.showMessageDialog(BUNDLE.getString("EbikeMapTab.map.flash.nyon.local.maps.too.old.message"), BUNDLE.getString("EbikeMapTab.map.flash.nyon.local.maps.too.old.title"), 0);
        return false;
    } 
    return false;
  }
  
  private void createInstancesAndRegisterListeners() {
    this.flashPlugin = new SystemFlashProcedureImpl(this.communicationManager, this.configurationManager.getBikeIdentification(), new BoschContainerControllerImpl(), UserLevel.IBD, false, this.configurationManager.getContainerConfiguration());
    this.flashProgressDialog = new FlashProgressDialog(TestableJOptionPane.getDefaultParentFrame());
    this.mapFlashProgressEventListener = new MapFlashProgressEventListener(this.flashProgressDialog);
    this.flashPlugin.addFlashProgressEventListener(this.mapFlashProgressEventListener);
  }
  
  private void triggerFlashProcedureInBackgroundThread() {
    this.executor.execute(() -> {
          FlashResult flashResult = startMapsFlashing();
          onMapsFlashingDone(flashResult);
        });
  }
  
  private FlashResult startMapsFlashing() {
    LOGGER.debug("Start maps flashing");
    initializeDialog();
    showDialog();
    changeApplicationToMapsFlashingState(true);
    return flashMaps();
  }
  
  private void initializeDialog() {
    EventQueue.invokeLater(() -> {
          this.flashProgressDialog.setProgressBarHMIValue(0);
          this.flashProgressDialog.setProgressBarHMI270Value(0);
          this.flashProgressDialog.setName("dlgFlashMapsProgressBar");
        });
  }
  
  private void showDialog() {
    this.flashProgressDialog.showProgressBar(FlashProgressDialog.FlashProgressbarMode.MAP_FLASH, this.configurationManager.getBikeIdentification());
  }
  
  private void changeApplicationToMapsFlashingState(boolean active) {
    if (active) {
      this.ecuConnectionStateHandler.suspendConnectionStateDetection(true);
      this.eBikeApplication.stopDetectingInactivity();
      this.applicationProcessManager.setProcessState(ApplicationProcessManager.ApplicationProcess.FLASH_MAPS, true);
    } else {
      this.ecuConnectionStateHandler.resumeConnectionStateDetection(true, false);
      this.eBikeApplication.startDetectingInactivity();
      this.applicationProcessManager.setProcessState(ApplicationProcessManager.ApplicationProcess.FLASH_MAPS, false);
    } 
    updateGuiToMapsFlashingState(active);
  }
  
  private void updateGuiToMapsFlashingState(boolean active) {
    this.mapTabController.onMapTabButtonChanged(this.buttonChangeEvent.setFlashUpdateInProgress(active));
  }
  
  private FlashResult flashMaps() {
    Map<String, String> mapsToBeFlashed = getSelectedMaps();
    return this.flashPlugin.flashMapsToNyon(mapsToBeFlashed);
  }
  
  private Map<String, String> getSelectedMaps() {
    Map<String, String> maps = new HashMap<>();
    TreePath[] checkingPaths = this.mapTab.getSingleTreeManager().getSelectionModel().getSelectionPaths();
    List<MapData> mapSelection = this.mapSelectionParser.getMapSelection(checkingPaths);
    mapSelection.stream().forEach(map -> maps.put(map.getMapId(), map.getMapUrl()));
    return maps;
  }
  
  private void onMapsFlashingDone(FlashResult flashResult) {
    LOGGER.debug("Maps flashing done");
    if (!flashResult.isSuccessful())
      openPopupUponFlashFailure(); 
    displayDoneButtonOnDialog();
    changeApplicationToMapsFlashingState(false);
  }
  
  private void openPopupUponFlashFailure() {
    LOGGER.error("Map flashing failed");
    TestableJOptionPane.showMessageDialog((Component)this.flashProgressDialog, BUNDLE.getString("EBikeStatus.FLASHING_FAILED"), BUNDLE.getString("EBikeFlashProgressBar.flashError.optionPane.title"), 0);
  }
  
  private void displayDoneButtonOnDialog() {
    this.flashProgressDialog.setDoneButtonVisibleAndWait();
  }
}

package com.gigatronik.beds.gui.panels.mapstab;

import com.gigatronik.beds.service.ecuflash.api.FlashProgressEventListener;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.ecuflash.impl.BaseFlashProcedure;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.ecuflash.impl.event.FlashProgressEvent;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.flash.FlashProgressDialog;
import java.awt.EventQueue;
import org.slf4j.Logger;
import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;

class MapFlashProgressEventListener implements FlashProgressEventListener {
  private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(MapFlashProgressEventListener.class);
  
  private final FlashProgressDialog flashProgressDialog;
  
  private int flashState = 0;
  
  MapFlashProgressEventListener(FlashProgressDialog flashProgressDialog) {
    this.flashProgressDialog = flashProgressDialog;
  }
  
  public void onFlashProgress(FlashProgressEvent event) {
    LOGGER.info("Received FlashProgressEvent {} {}", event.getProgressType(), Integer.valueOf(event.getProgress()));
    switch (event.getProgressType()) {
      case STATE:
        this.flashState = event.getProgress();
        break;
      case HMI:
        EventQueue.invokeLater(() -> updateProgress(event));
        break;
      case HMI_STEP:
        EventQueue.invokeLater(() -> updateStepProgress(event));
        break;
    } 
  }
  
  private void updateProgress(FlashProgressEvent event) {
    String info = event.getInfo();
    this.flashProgressDialog.setProgressBarInfo(info);
    int progress = event.getProgress();
    if (progress >= 0 && progress < 99) {
      this.flashProgressDialog.setProgressBarHMIValue(progress);
    } else if (progress >= 99) {
      this.flashProgressDialog.setProgressBarHMIValue(100);
      this.flashProgressDialog.setProgressBarHMI270Value(100);
    } 
  }
  
  private void updateStepProgress(FlashProgressEvent event) {
    String info = event.getInfo();
    this.flashProgressDialog.setProgressBarInfo(info);
    this.flashProgressDialog.setProgressBarHMI270Value(event.getProgress());
  }
  
  int getFlashState() {
    return this.flashState;
  }
}

ITEM 229: com/gigatronik/beds/gui/panels/mapstab/MapRepositoryConsistencyManager.java
========================================================================================================================
package com.gigatronik.beds.gui.panels.mapstab;

import com.gigatronik.beds.gui.panels.mapstab.parser.MapXmlFileParser;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.bosch.service.internationalization.ResourceBundleFactory;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.bosch.service.internationalization.Utf8ResourceBundleFormatted;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.framework.plugins.exceptions.ConfigurationNotFoundException;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.gui.testinterface.TestableJOptionPane;
import java.awt.EventQueue;
import java.io.File;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Paths;
import java.util.concurrent.Executors;
import java.util.concurrent.ScheduledExecutorService;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicBoolean;
import org.apache.commons.io.FileExistsException;
import org.apache.commons.io.FileUtils;
import org.apache.commons.lang3.concurrent.BasicThreadFactory;
import org.slf4j.Logger;
import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;

class MapRepositoryConsistencyManager {
  private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(MapXmlFileParser.class);
  
  private static final Utf8ResourceBundleFormatted BUNDLE = ResourceBundleFactory.newDefaultResourceBundle();
  
  private static final String DEFAULT_REPOSITORY_PATH = System.getenv("DART2_HOME") + System.getenv("DART2_HOME") + "data";
  
  private final ScheduledExecutorService executor = Executors.newSingleThreadScheduledExecutor(new BasicThreadFactory.Builder().namingPattern("MapRepositoryConsistencyExecutor-%d").build());
  
  private final AtomicBoolean executorIsRunning = new AtomicBoolean(false);
  
  private final MapTabController mapTabController;
  
  private final MapTabBtnStateChangeEvent buttonChangeEvent;
  
  private final MapRepositorySettingHandler settingHandler = new MapRepositorySettingHandler();
  
  private boolean repositoryReconfigured;
  
  MapRepositoryConsistencyManager(MapTabController mapTabController, MapTabBtnStateChangeEvent buttonChangeEvent) {
    this.mapTabController = mapTabController;
    this.buttonChangeEvent = buttonChangeEvent;
  }
  
  void ensureRepositoryConsistencyAsynchronous() {
    if (this.executorIsRunning.compareAndSet(false, true)) {
      LOGGER.info("Ensure maps repository consistency");
      this.executor.execute(() -> ensureRepositoryConsistencySynchronous());
    } 
  }
  
  private void ensureRepositoryConsistencySynchronous() {
    this.repositoryReconfigured = false;
    try {
      ensureRepositoryConsistencyTry();
    } catch (MapsRepositoryInconsistentException ex) {
      LOGGER.warn("MapTab will be disabled, 'cause the maps repository's not operatable.", (Throwable)ex);
      updateGui(false);
    } 
    this.executorIsRunning.set(false);
  }
  
  private void ensureRepositoryConsistencyTry() throws MapsRepositoryInconsistentException {
    try {
      checkRepositorySetting();
    } catch (ConfigurationNotFoundException ex) {
      LOGGER.warn("Maps repository path is not configured -> set to default '{}'", DEFAULT_REPOSITORY_PATH, ex);
      setRepositoryPathToDefault();
    } 
    checkRepositoryFormatting();
    updateGui(true);
  }
  
  private void checkRepositorySetting() throws ConfigurationNotFoundException, MapsRepositoryInconsistentException {
    LOGGER.debug("Check maps repository setting");
    String path = this.settingHandler.getLocalMapsRepositoryPath();
    ensureDirectoryExistence(path);
    ensureWritePermission(path);
  }
  
  private void ensureDirectoryExistence(String path) throws MapsRepositoryInconsistentException {
    File directory = new File(path);
    if (!directory.exists())
      throw new MapsRepositoryInconsistentException("Configured maps repository directory does not exist!"); 
  }
  
  private void ensureWritePermission(String path) throws MapsRepositoryInconsistentException {
    if (!Files.isWritable(Paths.get(path)))
      throw new MapsRepositoryInconsistentException("Configured maps repository directory is read-only!"); 
  }
  
  private void setRepositoryPathToDefault() throws MapsRepositoryInconsistentException {
    try {
      this.settingHandler.setLocalMapsRepositoryPath(DEFAULT_REPOSITORY_PATH);
      this.repositoryReconfigured = true;
    } catch (ConfigurationNotFoundException ex) {
      throw new MapsRepositoryInconsistentException("Repository path could not be set to default!", ex);
    } 
  }
  
  private void checkRepositoryFormatting() throws MapsRepositoryInconsistentException {
    try {
      LOGGER.debug("Check maps repository formatting");
      checkRepositoryFormattingTry();
    } catch (ConfigurationNotFoundException ex) {
      throw new MapsRepositoryInconsistentException("Checking or rather updating maps repository was not successful!", ex);
    } 
  }
  
  private void checkRepositoryFormattingTry() throws ConfigurationNotFoundException, MapsRepositoryInconsistentException {
    String repositoryPath = this.settingHandler.getLocalEBikeMapsDirectoryPath();
    File eBikeMapsDirectory = new File(repositoryPath);
    if (eBikeMapsDirectory.exists()) {
      File[] filesInRepository = eBikeMapsDirectory.listFiles();
      if (!isNewFormatting(filesInRepository))
        updateRepositoryFormatting(filesInRepository); 
    } 
  }
  
  private void updateRepositoryFormatting(File[] filesInRepository) throws MapsRepositoryInconsistentException {
    try {
      LOGGER.info("Update maps repository formatting");
      writeFormattingInProgressTextToTextArea();
      updateRepositoryFormattingTry(filesInRepository);
      this.repositoryReconfigured = true;
    } catch (IOException ex) {
      throw new MapsRepositoryInconsistentException("Updating maps repository format failed!", ex);
    } 
  }
  
  private void updateRepositoryFormattingTry(File[] filesInRepository) throws IOException {
    for (File source : filesInRepository) {
      if (shouldFileBeMoved(source)) {
        File target = new File(computeTargetPath(source));
        moveFileOrDirectory(source, target);
      } 
    } 
  }
  
  private boolean shouldFileBeMoved(File file) {
    return (!file.isDirectory() || (!file.getName().equals("BUI27x") && 
      !file.getName().equals("BUI350")));
  }
  
  private String computeTargetPath(File source) throws IOException {
    try {
      String eBikeMapsPath = this.settingHandler.getLocalEBikeMapsDirectoryPath();
      String relativeFilePathInsideRepo = source.getAbsolutePath().substring(eBikeMapsPath.length());
      return eBikeMapsPath + eBikeMapsPath + "BUI27x" + File.separator;
    } catch (ConfigurationNotFoundException ex) {
      throw new IOException("Constructing destination path for ' " + source.getAbsolutePath() + "' failed", ex);
    } 
  }
  
  private void moveFileOrDirectory(File source, File target) throws IOException {
    if (source.isDirectory()) {
      updateRepositoryFormattingTry(source.listFiles());
      deleteEmtpyDirectory(source);
    } else {
      moveFile(source, target);
    } 
  }
  
  private void moveFile(File source, File target) throws IOException {
    try {
      LOGGER.debug("Move file from '{}' to '{}'", source.getAbsolutePath(), target.getAbsolutePath());
      FileUtils.moveFile(source, target);
    } catch (FileExistsException ex) {
      LOGGER.warn("Target file '{}' already exists", target.getAbsolutePath(), ex);
      if (!source.delete())
        throw new IOException("Deletion of source file '" + source.getAbsolutePath() + "' was not possible"); 
    } 
  }
  
  private void deleteEmtpyDirectory(File directory) throws IOException {
    if (!directory.delete())
      throw new IOException("Deletion of source directory '" + directory.getAbsolutePath() + "' was not possible"); 
  }
  
  private boolean isNewFormatting(File[] filesInRepo) {
    return (isRepositoryEmpty(filesInRepo) || isOneBuiDirectoryContainedOnly(filesInRepo) || areBothBuiDirectoriesContainedOnly(filesInRepo));
  }
  
  private boolean isRepositoryEmpty(File[] filesInRepo) {
    return (filesInRepo.length == 0);
  }
  
  private boolean isOneBuiDirectoryContainedOnly(File[] filesInRepo) {
    return (filesInRepo.length == 1 && (
      buiDirectoryExists("BUI27x", filesInRepo) || 
      buiDirectoryExists("BUI350", filesInRepo)));
  }
  
  private boolean areBothBuiDirectoriesContainedOnly(File[] filesInRepo) {
    return (filesInRepo.length == 2 && 
      buiDirectoryExists("BUI27x", filesInRepo) && 
      buiDirectoryExists("BUI350", filesInRepo));
  }
  
  private boolean buiDirectoryExists(String buiType, File[] filesInRepository) {
    for (File file : filesInRepository) {
      if (file.isDirectory() && file.getName().equals(buiType))
        return true; 
    } 
    return false;
  }
  
  private void updateGui(boolean operationSuccess) {
    if (!operationSuccess) {
      displayMapTabDisablePopUp();
      writeFormattingFailedTextToTextArea();
    } else if (this.repositoryReconfigured) {
      this.mapTabController.onLocalMapDirectoryConfigurationChanged();
    } 
    changeMapTabButtonEnableStatesTo(operationSuccess);
  }
  
  private void displayMapTabDisablePopUp() {
    String path = getLocalMapsRepositoryPathOrBlankIfNotSet();
    String text = String.format(BUNDLE.getString("EBikeMapTab.popUp.repositoryInconsistency.text"), path);
    EventQueue.invokeLater(() -> TestableJOptionPane.showMessageDialog(text, BUNDLE.getString("Bosch.diagnostic.tool"), 2));
  }
  
  private String getLocalMapsRepositoryPathOrBlankIfNotSet() {
    try {
      return this.settingHandler.getLocalMapsRepositoryPath();
    } catch (ConfigurationNotFoundException ex) {
      LOGGER.warn("Displaying actual configured maps repository not possible, 'cause it is not set!", (Throwable)ex);
      return "";
    } 
  }
  
  private void changeMapTabButtonEnableStatesTo(boolean newState) {
    this.mapTabController.onMapTabButtonChanged(this.buttonChangeEvent.setRepositoryConsistent(newState));
  }
  
  private void writeFormattingInProgressTextToTextArea() {
    this.mapTabController.writeTextToDisplayedMapsTextArea(BUNDLE.getString("EBikeMapTab.displayedMapsTextArea.repositoryFormatting.inProgress.text"));
  }
  
  private void writeFormattingFailedTextToTextArea() {
    String path = getLocalMapsRepositoryPathOrBlankIfNotSet();
    String rawText = String.format(BUNDLE.getString("EBikeMapTab.popUp.repositoryInconsistency.text"), path);
    String popUpText = addWhitespaceBetweenSentences(rawText);
    this.mapTabController.writeTextToDisplayedMapsTextArea(BUNDLE.getString(popUpText));
  }
  
  private String addWhitespaceBetweenSentences(String text) {
    if (text.contains(".")) {
      String[] sentences = text.split("\\.");
      if (sentences != null && sentences.length == 2)
        return sentences[0] + ". " + sentences[0]; 
    } 
    return text;
  }
  
  private class MapsRepositoryInconsistentException extends Exception {
    public MapsRepositoryInconsistentException(String text) {
      super(text);
    }
    
    public MapsRepositoryInconsistentException(String text, Throwable cause) {
      super(text, cause);
    }
  }
}

package com.gigatronik.beds.gui.panels.mapstab;

import com.gigatronik.beds.settings.SettingsProxy;
import com.gigatronik.beds.settings.global.GlobalSettingsProxy;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.framework.plugins.exceptions.ConfigurationNotFoundException;
import org.apache.commons.lang3.StringUtils;
import org.slf4j.Logger;
import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;

public class MapRepositorySettingHandler {
  private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(MapRepositorySettingHandler.class);
  
  public static final String BUI27X_REPOSITORY_PATH_POSTFIX = "BUI27x";
  
  public static final String BUI350_REPOSITORY_PATH_POSTFIX = "BUI350";
  
  private static final String PROPERTY_KEY_LOCAL_MAP_DIRECTORY = "local_map_directory";
  
  private static final String FOLDER_EBIKE_MAPS = "eBike_Maps";
  
  private static Boolean isBui350Supported = null;
  
  public String getBui27xMapSelectionXmlFilePath() throws ConfigurationNotFoundException {
    String bui27xPath = getLocalBui27xDirectoryPath();
    return bui27xPath + bui27xPath + "MapSelection.xml";
  }
  
  public String getBui350MapSelectionXmlFilePath() throws ConfigurationNotFoundException {
    String bui350Path = getLocalBui350DirectoryPath();
    return bui350Path + bui350Path + "MapSelection.xml";
  }
  
  public String getLocalBui27xDirectoryPath() throws ConfigurationNotFoundException {
    String eBikeMapsPath = getLocalEBikeMapsDirectoryPath();
    return eBikeMapsPath + eBikeMapsPath + "BUI27x";
  }
  
  public String getLocalBui350DirectoryPath() throws ConfigurationNotFoundException {
    String eBikeMapsPath = getLocalEBikeMapsDirectoryPath();
    return eBikeMapsPath + eBikeMapsPath + "BUI350";
  }
  
  public String getLocalEBikeMapsDirectoryPath() throws ConfigurationNotFoundException {
    String repositoryPath = getLocalMapsRepositoryPath();
    return repositoryPath + repositoryPath + "eBike_Maps";
  }
  
  public String getLocalMapsRepositoryPath() throws ConfigurationNotFoundException {
    String property = SettingsProxy.getInstance().getGlobalSettings().getProperty("local_map_directory");
    if (StringUtils.isBlank(property))
      throw new ConfigurationNotFoundException("Property 'local_map_directory' is empty"); 
    return property;
  }
  
  public void setLocalMapsRepositoryPath(String newPath) throws ConfigurationNotFoundException {
    SettingsProxy.getInstance().getGlobalSettings().setProperty("local_map_directory", newPath);
  }
  
  public boolean isBui350Supported() {
    if (isBui350Supported == null)
      initBui350SupportedSetting(); 
    return isBui350Supported;
  }
  
  private static void initBui350SupportedSetting() {
    try {
      GlobalSettingsProxy globalSettings = SettingsProxy.getInstance().getGlobalSettings();
      isBui350Supported = globalSettings.getBoolean("mapTabBui350Support");
    } catch (ConfigurationNotFoundException ex) {
      LOGGER.debug("Support of BUI350 on MapTab is not configured in settings, so only BUI27x will be supported! ({})", ex.getMessage());
      isBui350Supported = false;
    } 
    LOGGER.debug("Setting 'mapTabBui350Support' configuration is '{}'", isBui350Supported);
  }
}

package com.gigatronik.beds.gui.panels.mapstab;

import com.gigatronik.dart2.bosch.service.internationalization.ResourceBundleFactory;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.bosch.service.internationalization.Utf8ResourceBundleFormatted;
import java.awt.Dimension;
import java.awt.GridBagConstraints;
import java.awt.GridBagLayout;
import java.awt.event.ActionEvent;
import java.awt.event.ActionListener;
import javax.swing.JButton;
import javax.swing.JLabel;
import javax.swing.JPanel;
import javax.swing.JTextField;

public class MapSourcePanel extends JPanel {
  private static final Utf8ResourceBundleFormatted BUNDLE = ResourceBundleFactory.newDefaultResourceBundle();
  
  private transient MapDeleteController mapDeleteController;
  
  private JButton btnDeleteLocalMaps;
  
  private JLabel lblMapSource;
  
  private JTextField txtMapSource;
  
  public MapSourcePanel() {
    initComponents();
  }
  
  public MapSourcePanel(MapDeleteController mapDeleteController) {
    this.mapDeleteController = mapDeleteController;
    initComponents();
  }
  
  private void initComponents() {
    this.lblMapSource = new JLabel();
    this.txtMapSource = new JTextField();
    this.btnDeleteLocalMaps = new JButton();
    setMinimumSize(new Dimension(600, 45));
    setName("pnlMapSource");
    setPreferredSize(new Dimension(600, 45));
    GridBagLayout layout = new GridBagLayout();
    layout.columnWidths = new int[] { 10, 0, 10, 0, 10, 0, 10 };
    layout.rowHeights = new int[] { 10, 0, 10 };

package com.gigatronik.beds.gui.panels.mapstab;

class MapsVersionComparisionResult {
  private boolean bui27xMapsVersionDiffer;
  
  private boolean bui350MapsVersionDiffer;
  
  MapsVersionComparisionResult(boolean bui27xMapsVersionDiffer, boolean bui350MapsVersionDiffer) {
    this.bui27xMapsVersionDiffer = bui27xMapsVersionDiffer;
    this.bui350MapsVersionDiffer = bui350MapsVersionDiffer;
  }
  
  boolean doesAnyMapsVersionDiffer() {
    return (this.bui27xMapsVersionDiffer || this.bui350MapsVersionDiffer);
  }
  
  boolean doBothMapsVersionDiffer() {
    return (this.bui27xMapsVersionDiffer && this.bui350MapsVersionDiffer);
  }
  
  boolean doBui27xMapsVersionDiffer() {
    return this.bui27xMapsVersionDiffer;
  }
  
  boolean doBui350MapsVersionDiffer() {
    return this.bui350MapsVersionDiffer;
  }
}

package com.gigatronik.beds.gui.panels.mapstab;

import com.gigatronik.beds.service.configuration.ConfigurationManager;
import java.io.Serializable;
import org.slf4j.Logger;
import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;

class MapTabBtnState implements Serializable {
  public static final long serialVersionUID = 1L;
  
  private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(MapTabBtnState.class);
  
  private final transient ConfigurationManager configurationManager;
  
  private boolean downloadButtonEnabled;
  
  private boolean deleteButtonEnabled;
  
  private boolean flashButtonEnabled;
  
  private final EBikeMapTab mapTab;
  
  MapTabBtnState(EBikeMapTab tab, ConfigurationManager configManager) {
    this.mapTab = tab;
    this.configurationManager = configManager;
  }
  
  void onMapTabButtonChanged(MapTabBtnStateChangeEvent event) {
    LOGGER.debug(event.toString());
    boolean flashUpdateInProgress = event.isFlashUpdateInProgress();
    boolean downloadActive = event.isDownLoadActive();
    boolean downloadButtonPressed = event.isDownloadButtonPressed();
    boolean cancelInProgress = event.isCancelInProgress();
    boolean bcsConnected = event.isBcsMode();
    boolean mapSizeValid = mapSizeValid(event.getSelectedMapSize(), event.getMaxMapSize());
    boolean localMapsExist = event.doLocalMapsExist();
    boolean repositoryConsistent = event.isRepositoryConsistent();
    boolean mapDownloadInProgress = (downloadActive || cancelInProgress);
    boolean commonCondition = (!flashUpdateInProgress && repositoryConsistent);
    setDownloadButtonEnabled((commonCondition && !downloadButtonPressed));
    setFlashButtonEnabled((commonCondition && !mapDownloadInProgress && !bcsConnected && bui27xConnected() && mapSizeValid));
    setDeleteButtonEnabled((commonCondition && !mapDownloadInProgress && localMapsExist));
    this.mapTab.buttonStateChanged(this);
  }
  
  private boolean bui27xConnected() {
    return (this.configurationManager.getBikeIdentification().getHmiIdentification().getComponentType().isBUI27x() && 
      this.configurationManager.getBikeIdentification().getHmiIdentification().isApplication());
  }
  
  private static boolean mapSizeValid(double selectedMapSize, double maxMapSize) {
    return (selectedMapSize > 0.0D && selectedMapSize <= maxMapSize);
  }
  
  boolean isDownloadButtonEnabled() {
    return this.downloadButtonEnabled;
  }
  
  private void setDownloadButtonEnabled(boolean downloadButtonEnabled) {
    this.downloadButtonEnabled = downloadButtonEnabled;
  }
  
  boolean isFlashButtonEnabled() {
    return this.flashButtonEnabled;
  }
  
  private void setFlashButtonEnabled(boolean updateButtonEnabled) {
    this.flashButtonEnabled = updateButtonEnabled;
  }
  
  boolean isDeleteButtonEnabled() {
    return this.deleteButtonEnabled;
  }
  
  private void setDeleteButtonEnabled(boolean deleteButtonEnabled) {
    this.deleteButtonEnabled = deleteButtonEnabled;
  }
}

package com.gigatronik.beds.gui.panels.mapstab;

import com.gigatronik.beds.common.order.OrderableListener;
import com.gigatronik.beds.gui.panels.mapstab.checkboxtree.CheckTreeSelectionModel;
import com.gigatronik.beds.gui.panels.mapstab.dualtree.TreeTable;
import com.gigatronik.beds.gui.panels.mapstab.dualtree.TreeTableCreator;
import com.gigatronik.beds.gui.panels.mapstab.exception.XmlFileParsingException;
import com.gigatronik.beds.gui.panels.mapstab.parser.MapData;
import com.gigatronik.beds.gui.panels.mapstab.parser.MapXmlFileParser;
import com.gigatronik.beds.gui.panels.mapstab.updatecheck.MapUpdateChecker;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.configuration.ConfigurationManager;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.configuration.api.HardwareConnectionChangesListener;

import com.gigatronik.dart2.bosch.service.internationalization.Utf8ResourceBundleFormatted;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.framework.plugins.exceptions.ConfigurationNotFoundException;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.common.configuration.ComponentType;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.common.configuration.Constants;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.common.configuration.HmiIdentification;
import java.awt.Color;
import java.awt.EventQueue;
import java.awt.SystemColor;
import java.awt.event.ActionEvent;
import java.awt.event.ActionListener;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Objects;
import javax.swing.BorderFactory;
import javax.swing.JButton;
import javax.swing.JLabel;
import javax.swing.JProgressBar;
import javax.swing.JScrollPane;
import javax.swing.JTextField;
import javax.swing.JTree;
import javax.swing.JViewport;
import javax.swing.SwingUtilities;
import javax.swing.event.TreeSelectionListener;
import javax.swing.tree.DefaultTreeModel;
