import javax.swing.tree.TreePath;
import org.slf4j.Logger;
import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;

public class MapTabController implements MapUpdateChecker.MapUptodateListener, HardwareConnectionChangesListener {
  private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(MapTabController.class);
  
  private static final Utf8ResourceBundleFormatted BUNDLE = ResourceBundleFactory.newDefaultResourceBundle();
  
  private static final double BUI270_MEMORY_SPACE_MB = 500.0D;
  
  private static final double BUI275_MEMORY_SPACE_MB = 6000.0D;
  
  private static final double BUI350_MEMORY_SPACE_MB = 1000.0D;
  
  private final MapTabBtnStateChangeEvent buttonChangeEvent;
  
  private final EBikeMapTab mapTab;
  
  private final MapTabBtnState mapTabBtnState;
  
  private final ConfigurationManager configurationManager;
  
  private final MapXmlFileParser mapXmlFileParser;
  
  private final MapRepositorySettingHandler settingHandler = new MapRepositorySettingHandler();
  
  MapTabController(EBikeMapTab mapTab, MapTabBtnStateChangeEvent buttonChangeEvent, ConfigurationManager configurationManager, MapXmlFileParser mapSelectionParser) {
    this.buttonChangeEvent = buttonChangeEvent;
    this.mapTab = mapTab;
    this.configurationManager = configurationManager;
    this.mapXmlFileParser = mapSelectionParser;
    this.mapTabBtnState = new MapTabBtnState(mapTab, configurationManager);
    configurationManager.addListener((OrderableListener)this);
  }
  
  public void onHardwareConnectionChanged(HardwareConnectionChangedEvent event) {
    LOGGER.debug("HardwareConnectionChangedEvent received: '{}'", event);
    switch (event.getAction()) {
      case ECU_CONNECTED:
        onEcuConnect(event.getComponent(), event.getMode());
        break;
      case ECU_DISCONNECTED:
        onEcuDisconnect(event.getComponent());
        break;
    } 
  }
  
  private void onEcuConnect(Constants.EcuType type, Constants.EcuMode mode) {
    if (mode == Constants.EcuMode.APP)
      switch (type) {
        case BUI270:
        case BUI275:
          nyonConnectionStateChangeAction();
          this.mapTab.setAllElementsOnFlashPanelVisible(true);
          break;
        case BUI350:
          if (this.settingHandler.isBui350Supported())
            nyonConnectionStateChangeAction(); 
          break;
      }  
    if (type == Constants.EcuType.BCS250)
      onBcsConnectionStateChanged(true); 
  }
  
  private void onEcuDisconnect(Constants.EcuType type) {
    switch (type) {
      case BUI270:
      case BUI275:
        nyonDisconnectionAction();
        nyonConnectionStateChangeAction();
        this.mapTab.setAllElementsOnFlashPanelVisible(false);
        break;
      case BUI350:
        if (this.settingHandler.isBui350Supported()) {
          nyonDisconnectionAction();
          nyonConnectionStateChangeAction();
        } 
        break;
      case BCS250:
        onBcsConnectionStateChanged(false);
        break;
    } 
  }
  
  private void nyonConnectionStateChangeAction() {
    refreshLocalDisplayedMaps();
    refreshButtonStates();
    updateSingleTreeEditableState();
    resetDisplayedSelectedMapSize();
  }
  
  private void nyonDisconnectionAction() {
    clearMapSelection();
    removeTreeListener();
    resetDisplayedSelectedMapSize();
  }
  
  void updateSingleTreeEditableState() {
    boolean hmiConnected = this.configurationManager.getBikeIdentification().isHmiConnected();
    boolean isNyon = this.configurationManager.getBikeIdentification().getHmiIdentification().getComponentType().isNyon();
    this.mapTab.getSingleTreeManager().setDisplayState((hmiConnected && isNyon));
  }
  
  private void clearMapSelection() {
    this.mapTab.getSingleTreeManager().getSelectionModel().clearSelection();
  }
  
  private void removeTreeListener() {
    TreeSelectionListener[] treeSelectionListeners = this.mapTab.getMapsTree().getTreeSelectionListeners();
    if (treeSelectionListeners != null && treeSelectionListeners.length > 0)
      this.mapTab.getSingleTreeManager().getSelectionModel().removeTreeSelectionListener(treeSelectionListeners[0]); 
  }
  
  private void resetDisplayedSelectedMapSize() {
    updateDisplayedSelectedMapSize(new ArrayList<>());
  }
  
  private void refreshButtonStates() {
    onMapTabButtonChanged(this.buttonChangeEvent);
  }
  
  private void onBcsConnectionStateChanged(boolean newState) {
    onMapTabButtonChanged(this.buttonChangeEvent.setBcsMode(newState));
  }
  
  void onMapTabButtonChanged(MapTabBtnStateChangeEvent event) {
    if (SwingUtilities.isEventDispatchThread()) {
      onMapTabButtonChangedAction(event);
    } else {
      EventQueue.invokeLater(() -> onMapTabButtonChangedAction(event));
    } 
  }
  
  private void onMapTabButtonChangedAction(MapTabBtnStateChangeEvent event) {
    LOGGER.debug("Refresh map tab button states: '{}'", event);
    JButton downloadButton = this.mapTab.getMapDownloadButton();
    Objects.requireNonNull(downloadButton);
    Arrays.<ActionListener>asList(downloadButton.getActionListeners()).forEach(downloadButton::removeActionListener);
    if (event.isDownLoadActive()) {
      downloadButton.setText(BUNDLE.getString("EBikeMapTab.btn_Download.abortDownload.text"));
      downloadButton.setToolTipText(null);
      downloadButton.addActionListener(e -> this.mapTab.getMapDownloadController().onAbordDownloadButtonPressed());
    } else {
      downloadButton.setText(BUNDLE.getString("EBikeMapTab.btn_Download.text"));
      downloadButton.setToolTipText(BUNDLE.getString("EBikeMapTab.btn_Download.tooltip"));
      downloadButton.addActionListener(e -> this.mapTab.getMapDownloadController().onMapsDownloadButtonPressed());
    } 
    this.mapTabBtnState.onMapTabButtonChanged(event);
  }
  
  void onTreeSelectionChange() {
    LOGGER.debug("Refresh displayed computed maps size");
    TreePath[] checkingPaths = this.mapTab.getSingleTreeManager().getSelectionModel().getSelectionPaths();
    List<MapData> listOfSelectedMaps = this.mapXmlFileParser.getMapSelection(checkingPaths);
    updateDisplayedSelectedMapSize(listOfSelectedMaps);
  }
  
  private void updateDisplayedSelectedMapSize(List<MapData> mapSelection) {
    double selectedMapSize = computeSizeSum(mapSelection);
    double maxMapSize = getNyonMemorySpace();
    JProgressBar progressBarMemory = this.mapTab.getMapsMemoryUsageProgressBar();
    if (maxMapSize > 0.0D) {
      if (mapSelection.isEmpty() || (selectedMapSize >= 0.0D && selectedMapSize <= maxMapSize)) {
        int memoryFilled = (int)(100.0D * selectedMapSize / maxMapSize);
        progressBarMemory.setValue(memoryFilled);
        progressBarMemory.setForeground(SystemColor.textHighlight);
        this.mapTab.setDefaultBorder4MapsMemoryUsageProgressBar();
      } else {
        progressBarMemory.setValue(100);
        progressBarMemory.setForeground(Color.red);
        progressBarMemory.setBorder(BorderFactory.createLineBorder(Color.RED, 2));
      } 
      SwingUtilities.updateComponentTreeUI(progressBarMemory);
      progressBarMemory.validate();
    } 
    this.mapTab.setMapsMemoryUsageLabelText(String.format(BUNDLE.getString("EBikeMapTab.lbl_MemoryText.text"), (int)selectedMapSize, (int)maxMapSize));
    onMapTabButtonChanged(this.buttonChangeEvent.setSelectedMapSize(selectedMapSize).setMaxMapSize(maxMapSize));
  }
  
  private double computeSizeSum(List<MapData> mapSelection) {
    double result = 0.0D;
    for (MapData map : mapSelection)
      result += map.getMapSize(); 
    return result;
  }
  
  private double getNyonMemorySpace() {
    double size = 0.0D;
    ComponentType hmiType = this.configurationManager.getBikeIdentification().getHmiIdentification().getComponentType();
    switch (hmiType) {
      case COMP_BUI270:
        size = 500.0D;
        break;
      case COMP_BUI275:
        size = 6000.0D;
        break;
      case COMP_BUI350:
        if (this.settingHandler.isBui350Supported())
          size = 1000.0D; 
        break;
    } 
    return size;
  }
  
  void updateDeleteButtonState() {
    boolean emtpyState = true;
    try {
      emtpyState = this.mapXmlFileParser.isRepositoryEmpty();
    } catch (ConfigurationNotFoundException ex) {
      LOGGER.warn("Disable map delete button, 'cause of map repository inconsistency", (Throwable)ex);
    } 
    onMapTabButtonChanged(this.buttonChangeEvent.setLocalMapsExist(!emtpyState));
  }
  
  public void onLocalMapDirectoryConfigurationChanged() {
    LOGGER.info("Local map directory path (re)configured");
    refreshLocalDisplayedMaps();
    updateMapSourceTextField();
    updateDeleteButtonState();
  }
  
  private void updateMapSourceTextField() {
    try {
      String path = this.settingHandler.getLocalMapsRepositoryPath();
      JTextField textField = this.mapTab.getMapSourceFieldText();
      EventQueue.invokeLater(() -> {
            textField.setText(path);
            textField.setToolTipText(path);
          });
    } catch (ConfigurationNotFoundException ex) {
      LOGGER.warn("Updating map source text field failed!", (Throwable)ex);
    } 
  }
  
  void onMapDownloadStart() {
    LOGGER.debug("Change GUI to maps download state");
    onMapTabButtonChanged(this.buttonChangeEvent.setDownLoadActive(true));
  }
  
  void onMapDownloadFinished() {
    LOGGER.debug("Change GUI back to normal operating state after map download");
    onMapTabButtonChanged(this.buttonChangeEvent.setDownLoadActive(false).setCancelInProgress(false));
    updateDeleteButtonState();
    refreshLocalDisplayedMaps();
  }
  
  void refreshLocalDisplayedMaps() {
    LOGGER.debug("Refresh displayed maps.");
    try {
      refreshLocalDisplayedMapsTry();
    } catch (ConfigurationNotFoundException|XmlFileParsingException ex) {
      LOGGER.error("Refreshing local displayed maps failed!", (Throwable)ex);
      setEmtpyModelTreeView();
    } 
  }
  
  private void refreshLocalDisplayedMapsTry() throws ConfigurationNotFoundException, XmlFileParsingException {
    HmiIdentification hmi = this.configurationManager.getBikeIdentification().getHmiIdentification();
    if (!this.settingHandler.isBui350Supported() || (hmi.isConnected() && hmi.getComponentType().isNyon())) {
      loadMapsFromRepositorySingleTree();
    } else {
      loadMapsFromRepositoryDualTree();
    } 
  }
  
  private void loadMapsFromRepositorySingleTree() throws ConfigurationNotFoundException, XmlFileParsingException {
    JTree treeMaps = this.mapTab.getMapsTree();
    CheckTreeSelectionModel treeModel = this.mapTab.getSingleTreeManager().getSelectionModel();
    TreeSelectionListener[] treeSelectionListeners = treeMaps.getTreeSelectionListeners();
    treeModel.clearSelection();
    if (treeSelectionListeners != null && treeSelectionListeners.length > 0)
      treeModel.removeTreeSelectionListener(treeSelectionListeners[0]); 
    treeMaps.setModel(new DefaultTreeModel(createSingleTreeFromRepository()));
    treeMaps.setRootVisible(true);
    if (treeSelectionListeners != null && treeSelectionListeners.length > 0)
      treeModel.addTreeSelectionListener(treeSelectionListeners[0]); 
    replaceLabelWithTreeIfNecessary(treeMaps);
  }
  
  private TreeNode createSingleTreeFromRepository() throws ConfigurationNotFoundException, XmlFileParsingException {
    if (this.settingHandler.isBui350Supported() && this.configurationManager.getBikeIdentification().getHmiIdentification().getComponentType() == ComponentType.COMP_BUI350)
      return this.mapXmlFileParser.createBui350TreeFromRepository(); 
    return this.mapXmlFileParser.createBui27xTreeFromRepository();
  }
  
  private void loadMapsFromRepositoryDualTree() throws ConfigurationNotFoundException, XmlFileParsingException {
    TreeTable treeMaps = this.mapTab.getMapsTreeTable();
    TreeTableCreator treeTableCreator = new TreeTableCreator(treeMaps);
    treeTableCreator.setDisplayEditState();
    treeTableCreator.setNodesToTreeTable(this.mapXmlFileParser.createDualTreeFromRepository());
  }
  
  private void replaceLabelWithTreeIfNecessary(JTree treeMaps) {
    JViewport viewport = this.mapTab.getDisplayedMapsScrollPane().getViewport();
    if (viewport.getComponent(0) instanceof JLabel) {
      LOGGER.debug("Remove label from textarea");
      viewport.remove(0);
      viewport.add(treeMaps);
    } 
  }
  
  private void setEmtpyModelTreeView() {
    this.mapTab.getMapsTree().setModel(new DefaultTreeModel(null));
  }
  
  public void onMapsUptodateStateChange(boolean newMapsOnServer) {
    String text = newMapsOnServer ? BUNDLE.getString("EBikeMapTab.lblNewMapsAvailable.text.newMapsAvailableOnServer") : "";
    LOGGER.debug("Update NewMapsAvailableLabelText='{}'", text);
    this.mapTab.setNewMapsAvailableLabelText(text);
  }
  
  void writeTextToDisplayedMapsTextArea(String text) {
    JLabel label = new JLabel(text);
    label.setHorizontalAlignment(2);
    label.setVerticalAlignment(1);
    JScrollPane scrollPane = this.mapTab.getDisplayedMapsScrollPane();
    EventQueue.invokeLater(() -> scrollPane.setViewportView(label));
  }
}

ITEM 238: com/gigatronik/beds/gui/panels/mapstab/parser/ContentXmlParser.java

package com.gigatronik.beds.gui.panels.mapstab.parser;

import com.gigatronik.beds.gui.panels.mapstab.dualtree.TreeTableNode;
import com.gigatronik.beds.gui.panels.mapstab.dualtree.TreeTableNodeObject;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.bosch.service.internationalization.ResourceBundleFactory;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.bosch.service.internationalization.Utf8ResourceBundleFormatted;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.bosch.updateserver.UPDATE_SERVER_URL;
import java.io.BufferedReader;
import java.io.File;
import java.io.FileInputStream;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.InputStreamReader;
import java.nio.charset.Charset;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Vector;
import javax.swing.tree.DefaultMutableTreeNode;
import javax.xml.parsers.DocumentBuilder;
import javax.xml.parsers.DocumentBuilderFactory;
import javax.xml.parsers.ParserConfigurationException;
import org.apache.commons.lang3.StringUtils;
import org.slf4j.Logger;
import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
import org.w3c.dom.Attr;
import org.w3c.dom.Document;
import org.w3c.dom.Node;
import org.w3c.dom.NodeList;

class ContentXmlParser {
  private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(MapXmlFileParser.class);
  
  private static final Utf8ResourceBundleFormatted BUNDLE = ResourceBundleFactory.newDefaultResourceBundle();
  
  private static final String CONTENT_XML_TAG_CONTENT = "content";
  
  private static final String CONTENT_XML_TAG_DIRECTORY = "directory";
  
  private static final String CONTENT_XML_TAG_FILE = "file";
  
  private static final String CONTENT_XML_PARAMETER_NAME = "name";
  
  List<String> parseContentXml(String sourcePath) {
    List<String> mapUrls = new ArrayList<>();
    File fXmlFile = new File(sourcePath);
    try {
      LOGGER.info("Parsing content XML: " + fXmlFile.getAbsolutePath());
      DocumentBuilderFactory dbFactory = DocumentBuilderFactory.newInstance();
      DocumentBuilder dBuilder = dbFactory.newDocumentBuilder();
      Document parsedDoc = dBuilder.parse(fXmlFile);
      parsedDoc.getDocumentElement().normalize();
      NodeList contentNodes = parsedDoc.getElementsByTagName("content");
      if (contentNodes.getLength() > 0)
        mapUrls.addAll(parseContentXmlNode(contentNodes.item(0), "")); 
      LOGGER.info("Successfully parsed XML.");
    } catch (ParserConfigurationException|org.xml.sax.SAXException|IOException e) {
      LOGGER.error("Failed to parse content.xml", (Throwable)e);
    } 
    return mapUrls;
  }
  
  private List<String> parseContentXmlNode(Node parent, String rootFolder) {
    List<String> mapUrls = new ArrayList<>();
    String folder = "";
    String path = "";
    if (StringUtils.equals(parent.getNodeName(), "directory")) {
      Attr name = (Attr)parent.getAttributes().getNamedItem("name");
      if (name != null)
        folder = name.getNodeValue(); 
    } 
    if (!rootFolder.isEmpty())
      path = rootFolder; 
    if (!folder.isEmpty())
      path = path + path + "/"; 
    NodeList childs = parent.getChildNodes();
    for (int i = 0; i < childs.getLength(); i++) {
      Node child = childs.item(i);
      if (StringUtils.equals(child.getNodeName(), "file")) {
        String file = child.getTextContent();
        mapUrls.add(path + path);
      } else if (StringUtils.equals(child.getNodeName(), "directory")) {
        mapUrls.addAll(parseContentXmlNode(child, path));
      } 
    } 
    return mapUrls;
  }
  
  DefaultMutableTreeNode createSingleTreeFromContentXml(String contentXmlFilePath, List<MapData> knownMapsFromMapSelectionXml, String repositoryPath) {
    TreeTableNode root = createRootNode();
    createNodesBUI27x(contentXmlFilePath, root, knownMapsFromMapSelectionXml);
    deleteEmptyFoldersFromRoot(root);
    MapXmlFileParser.sortMapTree(root);
    setSelectedStateForMapsThatExistInRepository(root, repositoryPath, "");
    return root;
  }
  
  TreeTableNode createDualTreeFromContentXml(String contentXmlFilePath27x, String contentXmlFilePath350, List<MapData> mapSelectionXmlBUI27x, List<MapData> mapSelectionXmlBUI350, String repositoryPathBui27x, String repositoryPathBui350) {
    TreeTableNode root = createRootNode();
    createNodesBUI27x(contentXmlFilePath27x, root, mapSelectionXmlBUI27x);
    createNodesBUI350(contentXmlFilePath350, root, mapSelectionXmlBUI350);
    deleteEmptyFoldersFromRoot(root);
    MapXmlFileParser.sortMapTree(root);
    setSelectedStateForMapsThatExistInRepository(root, repositoryPathBui27x, repositoryPathBui350);
    return root;
  }
  
  private TreeTableNode createRootNode() {
    MapData mapBUI27x = new MapData();
    mapBUI27x.setAreaName(BUNDLE.getString("EBikeMapTab.MAPS"));
    mapBUI27x.setBuiType(true);
    MapData mapBUI350 = new MapData();
    mapBUI350.setBuiType(false);
    return new TreeTableNode(new TreeTableNodeObject(mapBUI27x, mapBUI350, false, false));
  }
  
  private void deleteEmptyFoldersFromRoot(TreeTableNode root) {
    boolean finished = false;
    while (!finished) {
      TreeTableNode child = (TreeTableNode)root.getFirstLeaf();
      if (child.getLevel() == 1) {
        root.remove(child);
        continue;
      } 
      finished = true;
    } 
  }
  
  private void setSelectedStateForMapsThatExistInRepository(TreeTableNode node, String repositoryPathBui27x, String repositoryPathBui350) {
    List<File> filesBUI27x = new ArrayList<>();
    List<File> filesBUI350 = new ArrayList<>();
    getMapFilesFromDirectory(repositoryPathBui27x, filesBUI27x);
    getMapFilesFromDirectory(repositoryPathBui350, filesBUI350);
    selectMapsOfRepositoryInContentNodes(node, filesBUI27x, true);
    selectMapsOfRepositoryInContentNodes(node, filesBUI350, false);
  }
  
  private void selectMapsOfRepositoryInContentNodes(TreeTableNode node, List<File> files, boolean isBUI27x) {
    files.stream()
      .map(file -> extractMapIdFromFileName(file.getAbsolutePath()))
      .filter(id -> (id != null))
      .map(id -> findNodeById(node, id))
      .filter(temp -> (temp != null))
      .forEachOrdered(temp -> {
          if (isBUI27x) {
            if (temp.getMapData().isBui27xMap() || (temp.getMapDataOtherBUI() != null && temp.getMapDataOtherBUI().isBui27xMap())) {
              temp.setBUI27xChecked(true);
              setMapIsInRepositoryStateToTrueBui27x(temp);
            } 
          } else if (!temp.getMapData().isBui27xMap() || (temp.getMapDataOtherBUI() != null && !temp.getMapDataOtherBUI().isBui27xMap())) {
            temp.setBUI350Checked(true);
            setMapIsInRepositoryStateToTrueBui350(temp);
          } 
        });
  }
  
  private void setMapIsInRepositoryStateToTrueBui27x(TreeTableNode temp) {
    if (temp.getMapDataOtherBUI() != null && temp.getMapDataOtherBUI().isBui27xMap()) {
      temp.getMapDataOtherBUI().updateIsInRepositoryState(true);
    } else {
      temp.getMapData().updateIsInRepositoryState(true);
    } 
  }
  
  private void setMapIsInRepositoryStateToTrueBui350(TreeTableNode temp) {
    if (temp.getMapDataOtherBUI() != null && !temp.getMapDataOtherBUI().isBui27xMap()) {
      temp.getMapDataOtherBUI().updateIsInRepositoryState(true);
    } else {
      temp.getMapData().updateIsInRepositoryState(true);
    } 
  }
  
  private void getMapFilesFromDirectory(String directoryPath, List<File> foundFiles) {
    File dir = new File(directoryPath);
    File[] files = dir.listFiles();
    if (files != null)
      for (File file : files) {
        if (file.isDirectory()) {
          getMapFilesFromDirectory(file.getAbsolutePath(), foundFiles);
        } else {
          foundFiles.add(file);
        } 
      }  
  }
  
  private void createNodesBUI27x(String contentXmlFilePath, TreeTableNode root, List<MapData> mapSelectionXml) {
    LOGGER.debug("Parsing context.xml for BUI27x");
    TreeTableNode nodeParent = root;
    String directoryPath = "";
    try (BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(new FileInputStream(contentXmlFilePath), Charset.forName("UTF-8")))) {
      String line;
      while ((line = br.readLine()) != null) {
        line = line.trim();
        if (line.startsWith("<directory") && !line.endsWith("</directory>")) {
          nodeParent = createDirectoryNode(line, nodeParent, mapSelectionXml, true);
          directoryPath = adaptRelativeDirectoryPath(directoryPath, line);
          continue;
        } 
        if (line.startsWith("</directory")) {
          nodeParent = (TreeTableNode)nodeParent.getParent();
          directoryPath = adaptRelativeDirectoryPath(directoryPath, line);
          continue;
        } 
        if (line.startsWith("<file>maps_"))
          createFileNode(line, nodeParent, mapSelectionXml, directoryPath, true); 
      } 
    } catch (IOException e) {
      LOGGER.error("Error parsing XML", (Throwable)e);
    } 
  }
  
  private String adaptRelativeDirectoryPath(String path, String line) {
    if (line.startsWith("<directory")) {
      String name = extractNameAttributeFromDirectoryLine(line);
      if (StringUtils.isNotBlank(path))
        path = path + "/"; 
      path = path + path;
    } else if (line.startsWith("</directory")) {
      if (path.contains("/")) {
        int index = path.lastIndexOf("/");
        path = path.substring(0, index);
      } else {
        path = "";
      } 
    } 
    return path;
  }
  
  private void createNodesBUI350(String contentXmlFilePath, TreeTableNode root, List<MapData> mapSelectionXml) {
    LOGGER.debug("Parsing context.xml for BUI350");
    TreeTableNode nodeParent = root;
    String directoryPath = "";
    try (BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(new FileInputStream(contentXmlFilePath), Charset.forName("UTF-8")))) {
      String line;
      while ((line = br.readLine()) != null) {
        line = line.trim();
        if (line.startsWith("<directory") && !line.endsWith("</directory>")) {
          nodeParent = integrateDirectoryToTree(nodeParent, line, mapSelectionXml);
          directoryPath = adaptRelativeDirectoryPath(directoryPath, line);
          continue;
        } 
        if (line.startsWith("</directory")) {
          nodeParent = (TreeTableNode)nodeParent.getParent();
          directoryPath = adaptRelativeDirectoryPath(directoryPath, line);
          continue;
        } 
        if (line.startsWith("<file>maps_"))
          integrateFileToTree(nodeParent, line, mapSelectionXml, directoryPath); 
      } 
    } catch (IOException e) {
      LOGGER.error("Error parsing XML", (Throwable)e);
    } 
  }
  
  private void integrateFileToTree(TreeTableNode nodeParent, String line, List<MapData> mapSelectionXml, String currentRelativeDirectoryPath) {
    TreeTableNode existNode = findFileNode(line, nodeParent);
    if (existNode != null) {
      addMapToExistFileNode(existNode, mapSelectionXml);
    } else {
      createFileNode(line, nodeParent, mapSelectionXml, currentRelativeDirectoryPath, false);
    } 
  }
  
  private TreeTableNode integrateDirectoryToTree(TreeTableNode nodeParent, String line, List<MapData> mapSelectionXml) {
    TreeTableNode existNode = findDirectoryNode(line, nodeParent);
    if (existNode != null) {
      addMapToExistDirectoryNode(existNode, mapSelectionXml);
      return existNode;
    } 
    return createDirectoryNode(line, nodeParent, mapSelectionXml, false);
  }
  
  private void addMapToExistDirectoryNode(TreeTableNode existNode, List<MapData> mapSelectionXml) {
    for (MapData map : mapSelectionXml) {
      if (map.getMapId().equals(existNode.getMapData().getMapId())) {
        map.setMapSize(0.0D);
        map.setBuiType(false);
        existNode.setMapDataOtherBUI(map);
        break;
      } 
    } 
  }
  
  private void addMapToExistFileNode(TreeTableNode existNode, List<MapData> mapSelectionXml) {
    for (MapData map : mapSelectionXml) {
      if (map.getMapId().equals(existNode.getMapData().getMapId())) {
        setMapUrlForBui350FromBui27x(existNode, map);
        existNode.setMapDataOtherBUI(map);
        break;
      } 
    } 
  }
  
  private void setMapUrlForBui350FromBui27x(TreeTableNode bui27xNode, MapData bui350Map) {
    String bui27xUrl = bui27xNode.getMapData().getMapUrl();
    String bui350Url = bui27xUrl.replace("/Map/", "/Map_BUI350/");
    bui350Map.setMapUrl(bui350Url);
  }
  
  private TreeTableNode findDirectoryNode(String line, TreeTableNode parentNode) {
    int posStart = line.indexOf("name=") + 6;
    int posEnd = line.indexOf("\"", posStart);
    String id = line.substring(posStart, posEnd);
    return findNodeById((TreeTableNode)parentNode.getRoot(), id);
  }
  
  private TreeTableNode findFileNode(String line, TreeTableNode parentNode) {
    int posStart = line.indexOf(">maps_");
    if (posStart > 0) {
      posStart += 6;
      int posEnd = line.indexOf(".tar.bz2<", posStart);
      String id = line.substring(posStart, posEnd);
      return findNodeById((TreeTableNode)parentNode.getRoot(), id);
    } 
    return null;
  }
  
  private TreeTableNode findNodeById(TreeTableNode actualNode, String id) {
    TreeTableNode correctNode = null;
    if (actualNode.getMapData().getMapId().equalsIgnoreCase(id)) {
      correctNode = actualNode;
    } else {
      Vector<TreeTableNode> childNodes = actualNode.getChildren();
      if (childNodes != null)
        for (TreeTableNode child : childNodes) {
          correctNode = findNodeById(child, id);
          if (correctNode != null)
            break; 
        }  
    } 
    return correctNode;
  }
  
  private TreeTableNode createDirectoryNode(String line, TreeTableNode parentNode, List<MapData> mapSelectionXml, boolean isBUI27x) {
    String directoryName = extractNameAttributeFromDirectoryLine(line);
    for (MapData map : mapSelectionXml) {
      if (map.getMapId().equals(directoryName)) {
        map.setMapSize(0.0D);
        map.setBuiType(isBUI27x);
        TreeTableNodeObject temp = new TreeTableNodeObject(map, null, false, false);
        TreeTableNode dirNode = new TreeTableNode(temp);
        parentNode.add(dirNode);
        return dirNode;
      } 
    } 
    return parentNode;
  }
  
  private String extractNameAttributeFromDirectoryLine(String line) {
    int posStart = line.indexOf("name=") + 6;
    int posEnd = line.indexOf("\"", posStart);
    return line.substring(posStart, posEnd);
  }
  
  private void createFileNode(String line, TreeTableNode parentNode, List<MapData> mapSelectionXml, String currentRelativeDirectoryPath, boolean trueOnBUI27xFalseOnBui350) {
    String mapId = extractMapIdFromFileLine(line);
    for (MapData map : mapSelectionXml) {
      if (map.getMapId().equals(mapId)) {
        addDownloadUrlToPojo(map, currentRelativeDirectoryPath, line, trueOnBUI27xFalseOnBui350);
        TreeTableNodeObject temp = new TreeTableNodeObject(map, null, false, false);
        TreeTableNode nodeFile = new TreeTableNode(temp);
        parentNode.add(nodeFile);
        break;
      } 
    } 
  }
  
  private String extractMapIdFromFileLine(String line) {
    String startPattern = "<file>maps_";
    int startIndex = line.indexOf(startPattern) + startPattern.length();
    int endIndex = line.lastIndexOf(".tar.bz2</file>");
    return line.substring(startIndex, endIndex);
  }
  
  private void addDownloadUrlToPojo(MapData map, String relativeDiretoryPath, String line, boolean trueOnBUI27xFalseOnBui350) {
    String relativeFilePath = createRelativeFilePath(relativeDiretoryPath, line);
    String baseUrl = getBaseUrl(trueOnBUI27xFalseOnBui350);
    String absolutePath = baseUrl + baseUrl;
    map.setMapUrl(absolutePath);
  }
  
  private String createRelativeFilePath(String relativeDiretoryPath, String line) {
    String fileName = extractFileNameFromFileLine(line);
    return relativeDiretoryPath + "/" + relativeDiretoryPath;
  }
  
  private String extractFileNameFromFileLine(String line) {
    int posStart = line.indexOf("<file>") + 6;
    int posEnd = line.indexOf("</file>", posStart);
    return line.substring(posStart, posEnd);
  }
  
  private String extractMapIdFromFileName(String name) {
    int posStart = name.indexOf("maps_") + 5;
    int posEnd = name.indexOf(".tar.bz2", posStart);
    if (posStart < posEnd)
      return name.substring(posStart, posEnd); 
    return null;
  }
  
  private String getBaseUrl(boolean trueOnBUI27xFalseOnBui350) {
    if (trueOnBUI27xFalseOnBui350)
      return UPDATE_SERVER_URL.get(UPDATE_SERVER_URL.MAP_BUI27X_DOWNLOAD).toString(); 
    return UPDATE_SERVER_URL.get(UPDATE_SERVER_URL.MAP_BUI350_DOWNLOAD).toString();
  }
}

========================================================================================================================
package com.gigatronik.beds.gui.panels.mapstab.parser;

import java.text.DecimalFormat;
import java.text.NumberFormat;
import java.util.Locale;

public class MapData {
  private static final double EPSILON = 1.0E-8D;
  
  private String areaName = "";
  
  private double sizeInMB = 0.0D;
  
  private String id = "";
  
  private String url = "";
  
  private boolean isBui27xMap;
  
  private String mapVersion;
  
  private boolean isInRepository;
  
  public String getAreaName() {
    return this.areaName;
  }
  
  public void setAreaName(String areaName) {
    this.areaName = areaName;
  }
  
  public double getMapSize() {
    return this.sizeInMB;
  }
  
  public void setMapSize(double mapSize) {
    this.sizeInMB = mapSize;
  }
  
  public String getMapId() {
    return this.id;
  }
  
  public void setMapId(String mapId) {
    this.id = mapId;
  }
  
  public String getMapUrl() {
    return this.url;
  }
  
  public void setMapUrl(String mapUrl) {
    this.url = mapUrl;
  }
  
  public void setBuiType(boolean trueOnBui27xFalseOnBui350) {
    this.isBui27xMap = trueOnBui27xFalseOnBui350;
  }
  
  public boolean isBui27xMap() {
    return this.isBui27xMap;
  }
  
  public void setMapVersion(String mapVersion) {
    this.mapVersion = mapVersion;
  }
  
  public String getMapVersion() {
    return this.mapVersion;
  }
  
  public void updateIsInRepositoryState(boolean isInRepository) {
    this.isInRepository = isInRepository;
  }
  
  public boolean isInRepository() {
    return this.isInRepository;
  }
  
  public String toString() {
    if (Math.abs(this.sizeInMB) > 1.0E-8D) {
      DecimalFormat nf = (DecimalFormat)NumberFormat.getNumberInstance(Locale.ENGLISH);
      nf.setGroupingUsed(false);
      nf.setMaximumFractionDigits(2);
      return String.format("%s (%s MB)", this.areaName, nf.format(this.sizeInMB));
    } 
    return this.areaName;
  }

package com.gigatronik.beds.gui.panels.mapstab.parser;

import com.gigatronik.beds.gui.panels.mapstab.exception.XmlFileParsingException;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.bosch.service.internationalization.I18NUtil;
import java.io.File;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import javax.xml.parsers.DocumentBuilder;
import javax.xml.parsers.DocumentBuilderFactory;
import javax.xml.parsers.ParserConfigurationException;
import org.apache.commons.lang3.StringUtils;
import org.slf4j.Logger;
import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
import org.w3c.dom.Attr;
import org.w3c.dom.Document;
import org.w3c.dom.Node;
import org.w3c.dom.NodeList;

class MapSelectionXmlParser {
  private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(MapXmlFileParser.class);
  
  private static final String TAG_VERSION = "version";
  
  private static final String TAG_AREA = "area";
  
  private static final String TAG_NAME = "name";
  
  private static final String TAG_MAP = "map";
  
  private static final String PARAMETER_DESCRIPTION = "description";
  
  private static final String PARAMETER_LANGUAGE = "language";
  
  private static final String PARAMETER_NAME = "name";
  
  private static final String PARAMETER_MAP_ID = "map-id";
  
  private static final String PARAMETER_MAP_SIZE = "map-size";
  
  private String language;
  
  List<MapData> parseMapSelectionXml(String path, boolean trueOnBui27xFalseOnBui350) throws XmlFileParsingException {
    LOGGER.info("Parsing MapSelection.xml: '{}'", path);
    this.language = I18NUtil.getLocale().getISO3Language();
    List<MapData> maps = new ArrayList<>();
    Document parsedDocument = parseFile(path);
    String mapsVersion = extractMapVersion(parsedDocument);
    NodeList areas = parsedDocument.getElementsByTagName("area");
    for (int i = 0; i < areas.getLength(); i++) {
      MapData entry = createMapPojo(areas.item(i));
      entry.setBuiType(trueOnBui27xFalseOnBui350);
      entry.setMapVersion(mapsVersion);
      maps.add(entry);
    } 
    return maps;
  }
  
  private Document parseFile(String path) throws XmlFileParsingException {
    try {
      File fXmlFile = new File(path);
      DocumentBuilderFactory dbFactory = DocumentBuilderFactory.newInstance();
      DocumentBuilder dBuilder = dbFactory.newDocumentBuilder();
      Document parsedDoc = dBuilder.parse(fXmlFile);
      parsedDoc.getDocumentElement().normalize();
      return parsedDoc;
    } catch (ParserConfigurationException|org.xml.sax.SAXException|java.io.IOException ex) {
      throw new XmlFileParsingException("Failed to parse MapSelection.xml!", ex);
    } 
  }
  
  private String extractMapVersion(Document parsedDoc) throws XmlFileParsingException {
    NodeList version = parsedDoc.getElementsByTagName("version");
    if (version.getLength() < 1)
      throw new XmlFileParsingException("Maps version is not contained in MapSelection.xml!"); 
    return version.item(0).getTextContent();
  }
  
  private MapData createMapPojo(Node area) throws XmlFileParsingException {
    MapData result = new MapData();
    result.setAreaName(getDefaultAreaName(area));
    NodeList areaChilds = area.getChildNodes();
    for (int n = 0; n < areaChilds.getLength(); n++) {
      Node child = areaChilds.item(n);
      if (StringUtils.equals(child.getNodeName(), "name") && isCorrectLanaguage(child) && isNameNotNull(child)) {
        result.setAreaName(getAreaName(child));
      } else if (StringUtils.equals(child.getNodeName(), "map")) {
        result.setMapId(getMapId(child));
        result.setMapSize(getMapSize(child));
      } 
    } 
    return result;
  }
  
  private String getDefaultAreaName(Node area) throws XmlFileParsingException {
    Attr descriptionAttr = (Attr)area.getAttributes().getNamedItem("description");
    if (descriptionAttr != null)
      return descriptionAttr.getValue(); 
    throw new XmlFileParsingException("Area description for map is not available!");
  }
  
  private boolean isCorrectLanaguage(Node node) {
    Attr lang = (Attr)node.getAttributes().getNamedItem("language");
    return (lang != null && lang.getValue().equals(this.language));
  }
  
  private boolean isNameNotNull(Node node) {
    return ((Attr)node.getAttributes().getNamedItem("name") != null);
  }
  
  private String getAreaName(Node node) {
    return ((Attr)node.getAttributes().getNamedItem("name")).getValue();
  }
  
  private String getMapId(Node node) throws XmlFileParsingException {
    Attr mapId = (Attr)node.getAttributes().getNamedItem("map-id");
    if (mapId != null)
      return mapId.getValue(); 
    throw new XmlFileParsingException("Map-ID for map is not available!");
  }
  
  private double getMapSize(Node node) throws XmlFileParsingException {
    Attr size = (Attr)node.getAttributes().getNamedItem("map-size");
    if (size != null)
      return Double.valueOf(size.getValue()) / 1000000.0D; 
    throw new XmlFileParsingException("Map size for map is not available!");
  }
}

package com.gigatronik.beds.gui.panels.mapstab.parser;

import com.gigatronik.beds.gui.panels.mapstab.MapRepositorySettingHandler;
import com.gigatronik.beds.gui.panels.mapstab.dualtree.TreeTableNode;
import com.gigatronik.beds.gui.panels.mapstab.dualtree.TreeTableNodeObject;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.framework.plugins.exceptions.ConfigurationNotFoundException;
import java.io.File;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import javax.swing.tree.DefaultMutableTreeNode;

class MapsRepositoryParser {
  private static final String MAP_FILE_PREFIX = "maps_";
  
  private static final String MAP_FILE_EXTENSION = ".tar.bz2";
  
  private final MapRepositorySettingHandler settingHandler = new MapRepositorySettingHandler();
  
  private List<MapData> mapSelectionXmlBUI27x;
  
  private List<MapData> mapSelectionXmlBUI350;
  
  List<DefaultMutableTreeNode> createBui27xTreeFromRepository(List<MapData> knownMapsFromMapSelectionXml) throws ConfigurationNotFoundException {
    return createSingleTreeFromRepository(this.settingHandler.getLocalBui27xDirectoryPath(), knownMapsFromMapSelectionXml);
  }
  
  List<DefaultMutableTreeNode> createBui350TreeFromRepository(List<MapData> knownMapsFromMapSelectionXml) throws ConfigurationNotFoundException {
    return createSingleTreeFromRepository(this.settingHandler.getLocalBui350DirectoryPath(), knownMapsFromMapSelectionXml);
  }
  
  private List<DefaultMutableTreeNode> createSingleTreeFromRepository(String repositoryPath, List<MapData> knownMapsFromMapSelectionXml) {
    List<DefaultMutableTreeNode> nodes = new ArrayList<>();
    File directory = new File(repositoryPath);
    File[] files = directory.listFiles();
    if (files != null)
      for (File file : files) {
        DefaultMutableTreeNode node = createFileOrDirectoryNode(file, knownMapsFromMapSelectionXml);
        if (node != null)
          nodes.add(node); 
      }  
    return nodes;
  }
  
  private DefaultMutableTreeNode createFileOrDirectoryNode(File file, List<MapData> knownMapsFromMapSelectionXml) {
    DefaultMutableTreeNode node = null;
    if (file.isFile()) {
      node = createFileNode(file, knownMapsFromMapSelectionXml);
    } else if (file.isDirectory()) {
      node = createDirectoryNode(file, knownMapsFromMapSelectionXml);
    } 
    return node;
  }
  
  private DefaultMutableTreeNode createFileNode(File file, List<MapData> knownMapsFromMapSelectionXml) {
    String name = file.getName().replace("maps_", "").replace(".tar.bz2", "");
    for (MapData map : knownMapsFromMapSelectionXml) {
      if (map.getMapId().equals(name)) {
        map.setMapUrl(file.getAbsolutePath());
        map.updateIsInRepositoryState(true);
        return new DefaultMutableTreeNode(map);
      } 
    } 
    return null;
  }
  
  private DefaultMutableTreeNode createDirectoryNode(File file, List<MapData> knownMapsFromMapSelectionXml) {
    String name = file.getName();
    for (MapData map : knownMapsFromMapSelectionXml) {
      if (map.getMapId().equals(name)) {
        map.setMapSize(0.0D);
        map.updateIsInRepositoryState(true);
        DefaultMutableTreeNode node = new DefaultMutableTreeNode(map);
        List<DefaultMutableTreeNode> children = createSingleTreeFromRepository(file.getAbsolutePath(), knownMapsFromMapSelectionXml);
        addChildrenNodes(node, children);
        return node;
      } 
    } 
    return null;
  }
  
  private void addChildrenNodes(DefaultMutableTreeNode parent, List<DefaultMutableTreeNode> children) {
    for (int i = 0; i < children.size(); i++)
      parent.add(children.get(i)); 
  }
  
  List<TreeTableNode> createDualTreeFromRepository(List<MapData> knownMapSelectionXmlBUI27x, List<MapData> knownMapSelectionXmlBUI350) throws ConfigurationNotFoundException {
    String repositoryPath = this.settingHandler.getLocalEBikeMapsDirectoryPath();
    this.mapSelectionXmlBUI27x = knownMapSelectionXmlBUI27x;
    this.mapSelectionXmlBUI350 = knownMapSelectionXmlBUI350;
    return createDualTreeFromRepositoryAction(repositoryPath);
  }
  
  private List<TreeTableNode> createDualTreeFromRepositoryAction(String repositoryPath) {
    File mainDirectory = new File(repositoryPath);
    File[] files = mainDirectory.listFiles();
    String repositoryPathBUI27x = null;
    String repositoryPathBUI350 = null;
    if (files != null)
      for (File file : files) {
        if (file.isDirectory()) {
          String name = file.getName();
          if (name.equalsIgnoreCase("BUI27x")) {
            repositoryPathBUI27x = file.getAbsolutePath();
          } else if (name.equalsIgnoreCase("BUI350")) {
            repositoryPathBUI350 = file.getAbsolutePath();
          } 
        } 
      }  
    List<TreeTableNode> nyonNodes = createDualTreeNodesAction(repositoryPathBUI27x, repositoryPathBUI350);
    return nyonNodes;
  }
  
  private List<TreeTableNode> createDualTreeNodesAction(String repositoryPathBUI27x, String repositoryPathBUI350) {
    List<TreeTableNode> nodes = new ArrayList<>();
    List<File> filesInBothDirectories = new ArrayList<>();
    File[] filesBUI27x = getFilesOfDirectory(repositoryPathBUI27x);
    File[] filesBUI350 = getFilesOfDirectory(repositoryPathBUI350);
    if (filesBUI27x != null)
      for (File file27x : filesBUI27x) {
        if (file27x.isFile()) {
          createFileNodeBUI27x(filesBUI350, file27x, filesInBothDirectories, nodes);
        } else if (file27x.isDirectory()) {
          createDirectoryNode(filesBUI350, file27x, filesInBothDirectories, nodes);
        } 
      }  
    createStandaloneNodesBUI350(filesBUI350, filesInBothDirectories, nodes);
    return nodes;
  }
  
  private void createFileNodeBUI27x(File[] filesOtherDirectory, File actualFile, List<File> fileInBothDirectories, List<TreeTableNode> nodes) {
    boolean isFileInBoth = false;
    if (filesOtherDirectory != null)
      for (File fileInOtherDirectory : filesOtherDirectory) {
        if (actualFile.getName().equalsIgnoreCase(fileInOtherDirectory.getName())) {
          createDualNodeForFile(nodes, actualFile, fileInOtherDirectory, true, true);
          fileInBothDirectories.add(fileInOtherDirectory);
          isFileInBoth = true;
          break;
        } 
      }  
    if (!isFileInBoth)
      createNodeForFile(nodes, actualFile, this.mapSelectionXmlBUI27x, true, false); 
  }
  
  private void createDirectoryNode(File[] filesOtherDirectory, File actualFile, List<File> fileInBothDirectories, List<TreeTableNode> nodes) {
    boolean isDirectoryInBoth = false;
    if (filesOtherDirectory != null)
      for (File fileOtherDirectory : filesOtherDirectory) {
        if (actualFile.getName().equalsIgnoreCase(fileOtherDirectory.getName())) {
          createDualNodeForDirectory(nodes, actualFile, fileOtherDirectory, true, true);
          fileInBothDirectories.add(fileOtherDirectory);
          isDirectoryInBoth = true;
          break;
        } 
      }  
    if (!isDirectoryInBoth)
      createNodeForDirectory(nodes, actualFile, null, true, false); 
  }
  
  private void createStandaloneNodesBUI350(File[] filesDirectory, List<File> filesBUI350InBUI27x, List<TreeTableNode> nodes) {
    boolean exists = false;
    if (filesDirectory != null)
      for (File file : filesDirectory) {
        for (File isInBUI27x : filesBUI350InBUI27x) {
          if (file.getName().equalsIgnoreCase(isInBUI27x.getName())) {
            exists = true;
            break;
          } 
        } 
        if (!exists)
          if (file.isFile()) {
            createNodeForFile(nodes, file, this.mapSelectionXmlBUI350, false, true);
          } else if (file.isDirectory()) {
            createNodeForDirectory(nodes, null, file, false, true);
          }  
        exists = false;
      }  
  }
  
  private void createDualNodeForFile(List<TreeTableNode> nodes, File fileBUI27x, File fileBUI350, boolean isBUI27x, boolean isBUI350) {
    String name = fileBUI27x.getName().replace("maps_", "").replace(".tar.bz2", "");
    for (MapData mapBUI27x : this.mapSelectionXmlBUI27x) {
      if (mapBUI27x.getMapId().equals(name))
        for (MapData mapBUI350 : this.mapSelectionXmlBUI350) {
          if (mapBUI350.getMapId().equals(name)) {
            mapBUI27x.setMapUrl(fileBUI27x.getAbsolutePath());
            mapBUI350.setMapUrl(fileBUI350.getAbsolutePath());
            TreeTableNodeObject temp = new TreeTableNodeObject(mapBUI27x, mapBUI350, isBUI27x, isBUI350);
            TreeTableNode node = new TreeTableNode(temp);
            nodes.add(node);
          } 
        }  
    } 
  }
  
  private void createNodeForFile(List<TreeTableNode> nodes, File file, List<MapData> knownMapsFromMapSelectionXml, boolean isBUI27x, boolean isBUI350) {
    String name = file.getName().replace("maps_", "").replace(".tar.bz2", "");
    for (MapData map : knownMapsFromMapSelectionXml) {
      if (map.getMapId().equals(name)) {
        map.setMapUrl(file.getAbsolutePath());
        TreeTableNodeObject temp = new TreeTableNodeObject(map, null, isBUI27x, isBUI350);
        TreeTableNode node = new TreeTableNode(temp);
        nodes.add(node);
        break;
      } 
    } 
  }
  
  private void createDualNodeForDirectory(List<TreeTableNode> nodes, File fileBUI27x, File fileBUI350, boolean isBUI27x, boolean isBUI350) {
    for (MapData mapBUI27x : this.mapSelectionXmlBUI27x) {
      if (mapBUI27x.getMapId().equals(fileBUI27x.getName()))
        for (MapData mapBUI350 : this.mapSelectionXmlBUI350) {
          if (mapBUI350.getMapId().equals(fileBUI350.getName())) {
            mapBUI27x.setMapSize(0.0D);
            mapBUI350.setMapSize(0.0D);
            TreeTableNodeObject tempNode = new TreeTableNodeObject(mapBUI27x, mapBUI350, isBUI27x, isBUI350);
            TreeTableNode node = new TreeTableNode(tempNode);
            nodes.add(node);
            List<TreeTableNode> subNodes = createDualTreeNodesAction(fileBUI27x.getAbsolutePath(), fileBUI350.getAbsolutePath());
            for (int i = 0; i < subNodes.size(); i++)
              node.add(subNodes.get(i)); 
          } 
        }  
    } 
  }
  
  private void createNodeForDirectory(List<TreeTableNode> nodes, File fileBUI27x, File fileBUI350, boolean isBUI27x, boolean isBUI350) {
    File file;
    List<MapData> mapSelection;
    String filePathBUI27x = null;
    String filePathBUI350 = null;
    if (fileBUI27x != null) {
      file = fileBUI27x;
      mapSelection = this.mapSelectionXmlBUI27x;
      filePathBUI27x = fileBUI27x.getAbsolutePath();
    } else {
      file = fileBUI350;
      mapSelection = this.mapSelectionXmlBUI350;
      filePathBUI350 = fileBUI350.getAbsolutePath();
    } 
    for (MapData map : mapSelection) {
      if (map.getMapId().equals(file.getName())) {
        map.setMapSize(0.0D);
        TreeTableNodeObject tempNode = new TreeTableNodeObject(map, null, isBUI27x, isBUI350);
        TreeTableNode node = new TreeTableNode(tempNode);
        nodes.add(node);
        List<TreeTableNode> subNodes = createDualTreeNodesAction(filePathBUI27x, filePathBUI350);
        for (int i = 0; i < subNodes.size(); i++)
          node.add(subNodes.get(i)); 
        break;
      } 
    } 
  }
  
  private File[] getFilesOfDirectory(String repositoryPath) {
    File[] files = null;
    if (repositoryPath != null) {
      File dir = new File(repositoryPath);
      files = dir.listFiles();
    } 
    return files;
  }
}

  private DefaultMutableTreeNode createSingleTreeFromList(List<DefaultMutableTreeNode> nodes, String rootNodeDeviceTextExtension) {
    DefaultMutableTreeNode root = new DefaultMutableTreeNode(getRootNodeText(rootNodeDeviceTextExtension));

  private String getRootNodeText(String rootNodeDeviceTextExtension) {

    if (this.settingHandler.isBui350Supported() && text != null) {
      String[] words = text.split(" ");
      if (words.length == 2)
        text = words[0] + " " + words[0] + " " + rootNodeDeviceTextExtension; 
    } 
    return text;
  }
  
  public TreeTableNode createDualTreeFromRepository() throws ConfigurationNotFoundException, XmlFileParsingException {
    List<MapData> mapSelectionXmlContentBUI27x = createBui27xMapListFromMapSelectionXmlFromRepository();
    List<MapData> mapSelectionXmlContentBUI350 = createBui350MapListFromMapSelectionXmlFromRepository();
    checkMapSelectionParsingResult(mapSelectionXmlContentBUI27x, mapSelectionXmlContentBUI350);
    List<TreeTableNode> nodes = this.mapsRepositoryParser.createDualTreeFromRepository(mapSelectionXmlContentBUI27x, mapSelectionXmlContentBUI350);
    return createDualTreeFromList(nodes);
  }
  
  public void deselectNodes(TreeTableNode node) {
    Vector<TreeTableNode> childNodes = node.getChildren();
    if (childNodes != null)
      childNodes.stream().map(child -> {
            child.setBUI27xChecked(false);
            child.setBUI350Checked(false);
            return child;
          }).forEachOrdered(child -> 
          deselectNodes(child)); 
  }
  
  private List<MapData> createBui27xMapListFromMapSelectionXmlFromRepository() throws ConfigurationNotFoundException {
    try {
      return parseBUI27xMapSelectionXmlFromRepository();
    } catch (XmlFileParsingException ex) {
      LOGGER.warn("MapSelection.xml for BUI27x parsing failure", (Throwable)ex);
      return new ArrayList<>();
    } 
  }
  
  private List<MapData> createBui350MapListFromMapSelectionXmlFromRepository() throws ConfigurationNotFoundException {
    try {
      return parseBUI350MapSelectionXmlFromRepository();
    } catch (XmlFileParsingException ex) {
      LOGGER.warn("MapSelection.xml for BUI350 parsing failure", (Throwable)ex);
      return new ArrayList<>();
    } 
  }
  
  private void checkMapSelectionParsingResult(List<MapData> mapSelectionXmlContentBUI27x, List<MapData> mapSelectionXmlContentBUI350) throws XmlFileParsingException {
    if (mapSelectionXmlContentBUI27x.isEmpty() && mapSelectionXmlContentBUI350.isEmpty())
      throw new XmlFileParsingException("Both MapSelection.xml files are corrupt or n/a"); 
  }
  
  private TreeTableNode createDualTreeFromList(List<TreeTableNode> nodes) {
    MapData mapBUI27x = new MapData();
    mapBUI27x.setAreaName(BUNDLE.getString("EBikeMapTab.MAPS"));
    mapBUI27x.setBuiType(true);
    MapData mapBUI350 = new MapData();
    mapBUI350.setBuiType(false);
    TreeTableNode root = new TreeTableNode(new TreeTableNodeObject(mapBUI27x, mapBUI350, false, false));
    for (int i = 0; i < nodes.size(); i++)
      root.add(nodes.get(i)); 
    return root;
  }
  
  public TreeTableNode createDualTreeFromContentXml(String contentXmlBui27xPath, String mapSelectionXmlBui27xPath, String contentXmlBui350Path, String mapSelectionXmlBui350Path) throws XmlFileParsingException, ConfigurationNotFoundException {
    List<MapData> mapSelectionXmlContentBui27x = parseBui27xMapSelectionXml(mapSelectionXmlBui27xPath);
    List<MapData> mapSelectionXmlContentBui350 = parseBui350MapSelectionXml(mapSelectionXmlBui350Path);
    return this.contentXmlParser.createDualTreeFromContentXml(contentXmlBui27xPath, contentXmlBui350Path, mapSelectionXmlContentBui27x, mapSelectionXmlContentBui350, this.settingHandler.getLocalBui27xDirectoryPath(), this.settingHandler.getLocalBui350DirectoryPath());
  }
  
  public DefaultMutableTreeNode createSingleTreeFromContentXml(String contentXmlBui27xPath, String mapSelectionXmlBui27xPath) throws XmlFileParsingException, ConfigurationNotFoundException {
    List<MapData> mapSelectionXmlContentBui27x = parseBui27xMapSelectionXml(mapSelectionXmlBui27xPath);
    return this.contentXmlParser.createSingleTreeFromContentXml(contentXmlBui27xPath, mapSelectionXmlContentBui27x, this.settingHandler.getLocalBui27xDirectoryPath());
  }
  
  public static <T extends DefaultMutableTreeNode> void sortMapTree(T node) {
    Collections.<TreeNode>list(node.children()).stream()
      .map(treeNode -> treeNode)
      
      .sorted((o1, o2) -> {
          String s1 = ((MapData)o1.getUserObject()).getAreaName();
          String s2 = ((MapData)o2.getUserObject()).getAreaName();
          Collator collatorInstance = Collator.getInstance(I18NUtil.getLocale());
          collatorInstance.setStrength(1);
          return collatorInstance.compare(s1, s2);
        }).forEach(child -> {
          if (child.getChildCount() > 0)
            sortMapTree(child); 
          node.add(child);
        });
  }
  
  public List<MapData> getMapSelection(TreePath[] paths) {
    List<MapData> ids = new ArrayList<>();
    if (paths != null && paths.length != 0)
      for (TreePath path : paths) {
        DefaultMutableTreeNode node = (DefaultMutableTreeNode)path.getLastPathComponent();
        if (node.isLeaf()) {
          Object object = node.getUserObject();
          if (object instanceof MapData) {
            ids.add((MapData)object);
          } else if (object instanceof TreeTableNodeObject) {
            ids.add(((TreeTableNodeObject)object).getMapData());
          } 
        } else {
          List<TreePath> subPaths = new ArrayList<>();
          for (int k = 0; k < node.getChildCount(); k++)
            subPaths.add(new TreePath(node.getChildAt(k))); 
          ids.addAll(getMapSelection(subPaths.<TreePath>toArray(new TreePath[subPaths.size()])));
        } 
      }  
    return ids;
  }
}

ITEM 245: com/gigatronik/beds/gui/panels/mapstab/updatecheck/MapUpdateCheckerImpl.java
========================================================================================================================
package com.gigatronik.beds.gui.panels.mapstab.updatecheck;

import com.gigatronik.beds.gui.panels.mapstab.MapDownloadController;
import com.gigatronik.beds.gui.panels.mapstab.MapRepositorySettingHandler;
import com.gigatronik.beds.gui.panels.mapstab.exception.FileDownloadFailedException;
import com.gigatronik.beds.gui.panels.mapstab.exception.XmlFileParsingException;
import com.gigatronik.beds.gui.panels.mapstab.parser.MapData;
import com.gigatronik.beds.gui.panels.mapstab.parser.MapXmlFileParser;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.rightsmanager.api.RightsChangedEvent;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.rightsmanager.api.RightsManager;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.rightsmanager.api.UserLevel;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.framework.plugins.exceptions.ConfigurationNotFoundException;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Enumeration;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.concurrent.ScheduledExecutorService;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicBoolean;
import javax.swing.tree.DefaultMutableTreeNode;
import javax.swing.tree.TreeNode;
import org.apache.commons.lang3.StringUtils;
import org.slf4j.Logger;
import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;

class MapUpdateCheckerImpl implements MapUpdateChecker {
  private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(MapUpdateCheckerImpl.class);
  
  private final List<MapUpdateChecker.MapUptodateListener> mapUpdateListener = new ArrayList<>();
  
  private final AtomicBoolean isCheckDone = new AtomicBoolean(false);
  
  private final MapDownloadController mapDownloadController;
  
  private final ScheduledExecutorService executor;
  
  private final MapXmlFileParser mapXmlFileParser;
  
  private final MapRepositorySettingHandler settingHandler = new MapRepositorySettingHandler();
  
  MapUpdateCheckerImpl(MapDownloadController mapDownloadController, ScheduledExecutorService executor, MapXmlFileParser mapXmlFileParser, RightsManager rightsManager) {
    this.mapDownloadController = mapDownloadController;
    this.executor = executor;
    this.mapXmlFileParser = mapXmlFileParser;
    rightsManager.addListener(this);
  }
  
  public void onRightsChanged(RightsChangedEvent event) {
    LOGGER.debug("Received rights changed event '{}'", event);
    if (event.getUserLevel() == UserLevel.IBD && this.isCheckDone.compareAndSet(false, true))
      this.executor.execute(() -> checkLocalMapsUpToDateState()); 
  }
  
  private void checkLocalMapsUpToDateState() {
    try {
      checkLocalMapsUptodateStateTry();
    } catch (ConfigurationNotFoundException ex) {
      LOGGER.warn("Please configure the local map repository to enable the automatic map update check!", (Throwable)ex);
    } 
  }
  
  private void checkLocalMapsUptodateStateTry() throws ConfigurationNotFoundException {
    LOGGER.info("Check if server maps have a newer version then the local ones ...");
    if (doesRepositoryContainMaps()) {
      executeCheck();
    } else {
      LOGGER.info("Local maps repository does not contain any maps");
    } 
  }
  
  private boolean doesRepositoryContainMaps() throws ConfigurationNotFoundException {
    return (doesBui27xRepositoryContainMaps() || (this.settingHandler.isBui350Supported() && doesBui350RepositoryContainMaps()));
  }
  
  private boolean doesBui27xRepositoryContainMaps() throws ConfigurationNotFoundException {
    try {
      DefaultMutableTreeNode tree = this.mapXmlFileParser.createBui27xTreeFromRepository();
      return doesTreeContainMaps(tree);
    } catch (XmlFileParsingException ex) {
      LOGGER.warn("Map update check for BUI27x not possible", (Throwable)ex);
      return false;
    } 
  }
  
  private boolean doesBui350RepositoryContainMaps() throws ConfigurationNotFoundException {
    try {
      DefaultMutableTreeNode tree = this.mapXmlFileParser.createBui350TreeFromRepository();
      return doesTreeContainMaps(tree);
    } catch (XmlFileParsingException ex) {
      LOGGER.warn("Map update check for BUI350 not possible", (Throwable)ex);
      return false;
    } 
  }
  
  private boolean doesTreeContainMaps(DefaultMutableTreeNode parent) {
    Enumeration<TreeNode> children = parent.children();
    while (children.hasMoreElements()) {
      Object childObject = children.nextElement();
      if (childObject instanceof DefaultMutableTreeNode) {
        DefaultMutableTreeNode child = (DefaultMutableTreeNode)childObject;
        if (isMap(child) || doesTreeContainMaps(child))
          return true; 
      } 
    } 
    return false;
  }
  
  private boolean isMap(DefaultMutableTreeNode element) {
    return (element.getUserObject() instanceof MapData) ? ((((MapData)element.getUserObject()).getMapSize() > 0.0D)) : false;
  }
  
  private void executeCheck() throws ConfigurationNotFoundException {
    boolean bui27xMapsOutdated = areLocalBui27xMapsOutdated();
    boolean bui350MapsOutdated = this.settingHandler.isBui350Supported() ? areLocalBui350MapsOutdated() : false;
    processCheckResult(bui27xMapsOutdated, bui350MapsOutdated);
  }
  
  private void processCheckResult(boolean bui27xMapsOutdated, boolean bui350MapsOutdated) {
    if (bui27xMapsOutdated || bui350MapsOutdated) {
      LOGGER.info("Local maps are outdated! BUI27x='{}' BUI350='{}'", Boolean.valueOf(bui27xMapsOutdated), Boolean.valueOf(bui350MapsOutdated));
      fireMapsUp2dateStateChangeEvent(true);
    } else {
      LOGGER.info("Local maps are up to date");
    } 
  }
  
  private boolean areLocalBui27xMapsOutdated() throws ConfigurationNotFoundException {
    try {
      return areLocalBui27xMapsOutdatedTry();
    } catch (FileDownloadFailedException ex) {
      LOGGER.warn("MapSelection.xml file for BUI27x could not be downloaded from update server", (Throwable)ex);
    } catch (XmlFileParsingException|NumberFormatException ex) {
      LOGGER.warn("MapSelection.xml file for BUI27x either from hard disk or from update server is corrupt", (Throwable)ex);
    } 
    return false;
  }
  
  private boolean areLocalBui27xMapsOutdatedTry() throws FileDownloadFailedException, NumberFormatException, XmlFileParsingException, ConfigurationNotFoundException {
    String localMapVersion = getLocalMapsVersionBui27x();
    if (StringUtils.isNotBlank(localMapVersion)) {
      String serverMapVersion = getServerBui27xMapVersion();
      LOGGER.debug("BUI27X: localMapVersion='{}' serverMapVersion='{}'", localMapVersion, serverMapVersion);
      return determineUpToDateState(localMapVersion, serverMapVersion);
    } 
    return false;
  }
  
  private boolean areLocalBui350MapsOutdated() throws ConfigurationNotFoundException {
    try {
      return areLocalBui350MapsOutdatedTry();
    } catch (FileDownloadFailedException ex) {
      LOGGER.warn("MapSelection.xml file for BUI350 could not be downloaded from update server", (Throwable)ex);
    } catch (XmlFileParsingException|NumberFormatException ex) {
      LOGGER.warn("MapSelection.xml file for BUI350 either from hard disk or from update server is corrupt", (Throwable)ex);
    } 
    return false;
  }
  
  private boolean areLocalBui350MapsOutdatedTry() throws FileDownloadFailedException, NumberFormatException, XmlFileParsingException, ConfigurationNotFoundException {
    String localMapVersion = getLocalMapsVersionBui350();
    if (StringUtils.isNotBlank(localMapVersion)) {
      String serverMapVersion = getServerBui350MapVersion();
      LOGGER.debug("BUI350: localMapVersion='{}' serverMapVersion='{}'", localMapVersion, serverMapVersion);
      return determineUpToDateState(localMapVersion, serverMapVersion);
    } 
    return false;
  }
  
  private String getLocalMapsVersionBui27x() throws ConfigurationNotFoundException, XmlFileParsingException {
    List<MapData> list = this.mapXmlFileParser.parseBUI27xMapSelectionXmlFromRepository();
    return getMapVersionFromMapsList(list);
  }
  
  private String getLocalMapsVersionBui350() throws ConfigurationNotFoundException, XmlFileParsingException {
    List<MapData> list = this.mapXmlFileParser.parseBUI350MapSelectionXmlFromRepository();
    return getMapVersionFromMapsList(list);
  }
  
  private String getServerBui27xMapVersion() throws FileDownloadFailedException, XmlFileParsingException {
    String filePath = this.mapDownloadController.downloadBui27xMapSelectionXmlFile();
    List<MapData> list = this.mapXmlFileParser.parseBui27xMapSelectionXml(filePath);
    return getMapVersionFromMapsList(list);
  }
  
  private String getServerBui350MapVersion() throws FileDownloadFailedException, XmlFileParsingException {
    String filePath = this.mapDownloadController.downloadBui350MapSelectionXmlFile();
    List<MapData> list = this.mapXmlFileParser.parseBui350MapSelectionXml(filePath);
    return getMapVersionFromMapsList(list);
  }
  
  private String getMapVersionFromMapsList(List<MapData> list) {
    if (list.size() > 0)
      return list.get(0).getMapVersion(); 
    return "";
  }
  
  private boolean determineUpToDateState(String localMapVersionStr, String serverMapVersionStr) throws NumberFormatException {
    Integer localMapVersion = Integer.parseInt(localMapVersionStr);
    Integer serverMapVersion = Integer.parseInt(serverMapVersionStr);
    return (serverMapVersion > localMapVersion);
  }
  
  private void fireMapsUp2dateStateChangeEvent(boolean newMapsAvailableOnServer) {
    LOGGER.debug("Fire MapsUp2dateStateChangeEvent newMapsAvailableOnServer='{}'", Boolean.valueOf(newMapsAvailableOnServer));
    this.mapUpdateListener.forEach(t -> t.onMapsUptodateStateChange(newMapsAvailableOnServer));
  }
  
  public void resetUpdateAvailableState() {
    fireMapsUp2dateStateChangeEvent(false);
  }
  
  public void registerForMapsUptodateStateChangeEvents(MapUpdateChecker.MapUptodateListener listener) {
    this.mapUpdateListener.add(listener);
  }
  
  public void unregisterForMapsUptodateStateChangeEvents(MapUpdateChecker.MapUptodateListener listener) {
    this.mapUpdateListener.remove(listener);
  }
}

package com.gigatronik.beds.gui.panels.settings;

import com.gigatronik.beds.gui.panels.settings.event.ProxySettingsChangeEvent;
import com.gigatronik.beds.gui.panels.settings.event.UserSettingsBtnStateChangeEvent;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.framework.util.ProxyManager;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.gui.tabSettings.EBikeSettingsTab;
import java.io.Serializable;
import org.apache.commons.lang3.StringUtils;
import org.slf4j.Logger;
import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;

public class SettingsTabBtnState implements Serializable {
  private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(SettingsTabBtnState.class);
  
  private static final long serialVersionUID = 2563730330485330344L;
  
  private final EBikeSettingsTab settingsTab;
  
  private String txtProxyAddress;
  
  private String txtProxyPort;
  
  private String txtProxyUserName;
  
  private String txtProxyUserPwd;
  
  private ProxyManager.ProxyMode proxyMode;
  
  private boolean saveEnabled;
  
  private final transient ProxyManager proxy;
  
  private boolean userSettingsSaveEnabled;
  
  public SettingsTabBtnState(EBikeSettingsTab tab) {
    this.settingsTab = tab;
    this.proxy = ProxyManager.getInstance();
    this.proxyMode = this.proxy.getMode();
  }
  
  public void onProxySettingsChanged(ProxySettingsChangeEvent event) {
    LOGGER.debug(event.toString());
    this.txtProxyAddress = event.getAddress();
    this.txtProxyPort = event.getPort();
    this.txtProxyUserName = event.getUserName();
    this.txtProxyUserPwd = event.getUserPwd();
    setSaveEnabled((proxySettingsChanged() || hasModeChanged()));
    this.settingsTab.setBtnSaveEnabledState(this.saveEnabled);
  }
  
  public void onProxyModeChanged(ProxyManager.ProxyMode mode) {
    this.proxyMode = mode;
    setSaveEnabled((proxySettingsChanged() || hasModeChanged()));
    this.settingsTab.setBtnSaveEnabledState(this.saveEnabled);
  }
  
  public void onUserSettingsBtnStateChanged(UserSettingsBtnStateChangeEvent event) {
    setUserSettingsSaveEnabled(event.isSettingsHaveChanged());
    event.getListener().buttonStateChanged(this);
  }
  
  private boolean proxySettingsChanged() {
    boolean hostHasChanged = hasHostChanged();
    boolean usernameHasChanged = hasUsernameChanged();
    boolean passwordHasChanged = hasPasswordChanged();
    boolean portHasChanged = hasPortChanged();
    return (hostHasChanged || usernameHasChanged || passwordHasChanged || portHasChanged);
  }
  
  private boolean hasPortChanged() {
    Integer proxyPortSettings = (this.proxy.getPort() == null) ? 0 : this.proxy.getPort();
    Integer proxyPortGui = StringUtils.isEmpty(this.txtProxyPort) ? 0 : Integer.parseInt(this.txtProxyPort);
    return !proxyPortGui.equals(proxyPortSettings);
  }
  
  private boolean hasModeChanged() {
    return (this.proxyMode != this.proxy.getMode() && this.proxyMode != null);
  }
  
  private boolean hasPasswordChanged() {
    return (!StringUtils.equals(this.txtProxyUserPwd, this.proxy.getPassword()) && this.txtProxyUserPwd != null);
  }
  
  private boolean hasUsernameChanged() {
    return (!StringUtils.equals(this.txtProxyUserName, this.proxy.getUsername()) && this.txtProxyUserName != null);
  }
  
  private boolean hasHostChanged() {
    return (!StringUtils.equals(this.txtProxyAddress, this.proxy.getHost()) && this.txtProxyAddress != null);
  }
  
  public boolean isSaveEnabled() {
    return this.saveEnabled;
  }
  
  public void setSaveEnabled(boolean saveEnabled) {
    this.saveEnabled = saveEnabled;
  }
  
  public boolean isUserSettingsSaveEnabled() {
    return this.userSettingsSaveEnabled;
  }
  
  public void setUserSettingsSaveEnabled(boolean userSettingsSaveEnabled) {
    this.userSettingsSaveEnabled = userSettingsSaveEnabled;
  }
}

package com.gigatronik.beds.gui.panels.settingstab;

import com.gigatronik.dart2.bosch.service.internationalization.ResourceBundleFactory;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.bosch.service.internationalization.Utf8ResourceBundleFormatted;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.gui.EBikeApplicationPanel;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.gui.testinterface.TestableJPanel;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.utils.functional.action.ActionFunction;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.utils.functional.action.FunctionalAbstractAction;
import java.awt.GridBagConstraints;
import java.awt.GridBagLayout;
import java.awt.Insets;
import javax.swing.BorderFactory;
import javax.swing.JButton;
import javax.swing.JCheckBox;
import javax.swing.JLabel;

import org.apache.commons.lang3.StringUtils;

class EBikeConfigurationSettingsPanel extends TestableJPanel {
  private static final Utf8ResourceBundleFormatted BUNDLE = ResourceBundleFactory.newDefaultResourceBundle();
  
  private JButton btnSpecificationtable;
  
  private JCheckBox chbBatteryKeyNecessary;
  
  private JCheckBox chbCommentEnabled;
  
  private JCheckBox chbFlashAssistActive;
  
  private JCheckBox chbFlashAutomatically;
  
  private JLabel lblSpecificationtable;
  
  private JTextField txtSpecificationtable;
  
  public EBikeConfigurationSettingsPanel() {
    initComponents();
  }
  
  void setFlashAssistantEnabledAction(ActionFunction action) {
    this.chbFlashAssistActive.addActionListener(FunctionalAbstractAction.perform(action));
  }
  
  void setFlashAssistantEnabled(boolean enabled) {
    this.chbFlashAssistActive.setSelected(enabled);
  }
  
  boolean isFlashAssistantEnabled() {
    return this.chbFlashAssistActive.isSelected();

package com.gigatronik.beds.gui.panels.settingstab;

import com.gigatronik.beds.gui.configtab.bike.BikeConfigurationPanelController;
