public class EBikeConfigurationSettingsPanelController {
  private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(EBikeConfigurationSettingsPanelController.class);
  
  private static final String FLASHASSISTANT_PROPERTY_ASSISTANT_BUTTON_ENABLED = "flashassistant_button_enabled";
  
  public static final String FLASHASSISTANT_PROPERTY_BATTERYKEY_VISIBLE = "flashassistant_battery_key_visible";
  
  private static final String FLASHASSISTANT_PROPERTY_FLASH_AUTOMATICALLY = "flashassistant_flash_automatically_activated";
  
  private static final String FLASHASSISTANT_PROPERTY_SPECIFICATIONTABLE_FILE_LOCATION = "flashassistant_specificationtable_location";
  
  public static final String CONFIGURATIONTAB_PROPERTY_CONFIGURATION_COMMENT_VISIBLE = "configurationtab_configuration_comment_visible";
  
  private EBikeConfigurationSettingsPanel flashAssistantSettingsPanel = null;
  
  private BikeConfigurationPanelController bikeConfigurationPanelController;
  
  public EBikeConfigurationSettingsPanelController(BikeConfigurationPanelController bikeConfigurationPanelController) {
    createAndInitPanel();
    this.bikeConfigurationPanelController = bikeConfigurationPanelController;
  }
  
  public JPanel getFlashAssistantSettingsPanel() {
    if (this.flashAssistantSettingsPanel == null)
      createAndInitPanel(); 
    return (JPanel)this.flashAssistantSettingsPanel;
  }
  
  private void createAndInitPanel() {
    this.flashAssistantSettingsPanel = new EBikeConfigurationSettingsPanel();
    this.flashAssistantSettingsPanel.setFlashAssistantEnabledAction(this::onFlashAssistantEnabled);
    this.flashAssistantSettingsPanel.setFlashAssistantEnabled(isFlashAssistantEnabled());
    this.flashAssistantSettingsPanel.setBatteryKeyNecessaryAction(this::onShowBatteryLock);
    this.flashAssistantSettingsPanel.setBatteryKeyNecessaryEnabled(isShowBatteryLockEnabled());
    this.flashAssistantSettingsPanel.setFlashAutomaticallyEnabled(isFlashAutomaticallyActivated());
    this.flashAssistantSettingsPanel.setFlashAutomaticallyEnabledAction(this::onFlashAutomatically);
    this.flashAssistantSettingsPanel.setCommentEnabled(isCommentEnabled());
    this.flashAssistantSettingsPanel.setCommentAction(this::onCommentVisible);
    this.flashAssistantSettingsPanel.setSpecificationtableText(getSpecificationtableLocation());
    this.flashAssistantSettingsPanel.setSpecificationtableButtonAction(this::onSaveSpecificationtableLocation);
  }
  
  private String getSpecificationtableLocation() {
    String result = "";
    try {
      result = SettingsProxy.getInstance().getGlobalSettings().getProperty("flashassistant_specificationtable_location", result);
    } catch (ConfigurationNotFoundException ex) {
      LOGGER.debug("Failed to read flash assistant setting {} from global settings configuration. Default settings used.", "flashassistant_specificationtable_location", ex.getMessage());
    } 
    return result;
  }
  
  private boolean isFlashAssistantEnabled() {
    boolean result = false;
    try {
      result = SettingsProxy.getInstance().getGlobalSettings().getBoolean("flashassistant_button_enabled");
    } catch (ConfigurationNotFoundException ex) {
      LOGGER.debug("Failed to read flash assistant setting {} from global settings configuration. Default settings used.", "flashassistant_button_enabled", ex.getMessage());
    } 
    return result;
  }
  
  private boolean isShowBatteryLockEnabled() {
    boolean result = false;
    try {
      result = SettingsProxy.getInstance().getGlobalSettings().getBoolean("flashassistant_battery_key_visible");
    } catch (ConfigurationNotFoundException ex) {
      LOGGER.debug("Failed to read flash assistant setting from global setting {} configuration. Default setting used.", "flashassistant_battery_key_visible", ex.getMessage());
    } 
    return result;
  }
  
  private boolean isFlashAutomaticallyActivated() {
    boolean result = false;
    try {
      result = SettingsProxy.getInstance().getGlobalSettings().getBoolean("flashassistant_flash_automatically_activated");
    } catch (ConfigurationNotFoundException ex) {
      LOGGER.debug("Failed to read flash assistant setting from global setting {} configuration. Default setting used.", "flashassistant_flash_automatically_activated", ex.getMessage());
    } 
    return result;
  }
  
  private boolean isCommentEnabled() {
    boolean result = false;
    try {
      result = SettingsProxy.getInstance().getGlobalSettings().getBoolean("configurationtab_configuration_comment_visible");
    } catch (ConfigurationNotFoundException ex) {
      LOGGER.debug("Failed to read configuration comment setting from global setting {} configuration. Default setting used.", "configurationtab_configuration_comment_visible", ex.getMessage());
    } 
    return result;
  }
  
  private void onSaveSpecificationtableLocation(ActionEvent e) {
    try {
      GlobalSettingsProxy globalSettings = SettingsProxy.getInstance().getGlobalSettings();
      if (globalSettings != null) {
        String orgPath = globalSettings.getProperty("flashassistant_specificationtable_location");
        LOGGER.info("Open filechooser for specificationtable file location at current path {}", orgPath);
        JFileChooser fc = new JFileChooser(orgPath);
        fc.setMultiSelectionEnabled(false);
        fc.setFileSelectionMode(0);
        fc.setFileFilter(new FileNameExtensionFilter("*.csv", new String[] { "csv", "CSV" }));
        int returnValue = fc.showOpenDialog(SwingUtilities.getRoot((Component)this.flashAssistantSettingsPanel));
        if (returnValue == 0) {
          String newPath = fc.getSelectedFile().getAbsolutePath();
          if (!StringUtils.equalsIgnoreCase(orgPath, newPath)) {
            new File(newPath).mkdirs();
            globalSettings.setProperty("flashassistant_specificationtable_location", newPath);
            this.flashAssistantSettingsPanel.setSpecificationtableText(newPath);
            SpecificationTable.readSpecificationTable();
          } 
        } 
      } 
    } catch (ConfigurationNotFoundException ex) {
      LOGGER.error("Failed to change {}. Configuration file is missing", "flashassistant_specificationtable_location", ex);
    } 
  }
  
  private void onFlashAssistantEnabled(ActionEvent e) {
    LOGGER.info("settings action: {} status changed to: {}", "flashassistant_button_enabled", Boolean.valueOf(this.flashAssistantSettingsPanel.isFlashAssistantEnabled()));
    try {
      SettingsProxy.getInstance().getGlobalSettings().setProperty("flashassistant_button_enabled", String.valueOf(this.flashAssistantSettingsPanel.isFlashAssistantEnabled()));
    } catch (ConfigurationNotFoundException e1) {
      LOGGER.error("Cannot set {} property: Error -> {}", "flashassistant_button_enabled", e1.getMessage(), e1);
    } 
  }
  
  private void onShowBatteryLock(ActionEvent e) {
    LOGGER.info("settings action: {} status changed to: {}", "flashassistant_battery_key_visible", Boolean.valueOf(this.flashAssistantSettingsPanel.isBatteryKeyNecessaryEnabled()));
    try {
      SettingsProxy.getInstance().getGlobalSettings().setProperty("flashassistant_battery_key_visible", String.valueOf(this.flashAssistantSettingsPanel.isBatteryKeyNecessaryEnabled()));
      this.bikeConfigurationPanelController.getBatteryLockKeyController().validateSettings();
    } catch (ConfigurationNotFoundException e1) {
      LOGGER.error("Cannot set {} property: Error -> {}", "flashassistant_battery_key_visible", e1.getMessage(), e1);
    } 
  }
  
  private void onFlashAutomatically(ActionEvent e) {
    LOGGER.info("settings action: {} status changed to: {}", "flashassistant_flash_automatically_activated", Boolean.valueOf(this.flashAssistantSettingsPanel.isFlashAutomaticallyEnabled()));
    try {
      SettingsProxy.getInstance().getGlobalSettings().setProperty("flashassistant_flash_automatically_activated", String.valueOf(this.flashAssistantSettingsPanel.isFlashAutomaticallyEnabled()));
    } catch (ConfigurationNotFoundException e1) {
      LOGGER.error("Cannot set {} property: Error -> {}", "flashassistant_flash_automatically_activated", e1.getMessage(), e1);
    } 
  }
  
  private void onCommentVisible(ActionEvent e) {
    LOGGER.info("settings action: {} status changed to: {}", "configurationtab_configuration_comment_visible", Boolean.valueOf(this.flashAssistantSettingsPanel.isCommentEnabled()));
    try {
      SettingsProxy.getInstance().getGlobalSettings().setProperty("configurationtab_configuration_comment_visible", String.valueOf(this.flashAssistantSettingsPanel.isCommentEnabled()));
      this.bikeConfigurationPanelController.getInfoTextController().validateSettings();
    } catch (ConfigurationNotFoundException e1) {
      LOGGER.error("Cannot set {} property: Error -> {}", "configurationtab_configuration_comment_visible", e1.getMessage(), e1);
    } 
  }
}

package com.gigatronik.beds.gui.panels.supporttab;

import com.gigatronik.beds.settings.SettingsProxy;
import java.io.File;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.attribute.BasicFileAttributes;
import java.nio.file.attribute.FileTime;
import java.text.DateFormat;
import java.text.SimpleDateFormat;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.Date;
import java.util.Iterator;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Objects;
import net.lingala.zip4j.core.ZipFile;
import net.lingala.zip4j.exception.ZipException;
import net.lingala.zip4j.model.ZipParameters;
import org.apache.commons.io.FileUtils;
import org.apache.commons.io.FilenameUtils;
import org.slf4j.Logger;
import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;

public class SupportTabPanelController {
  private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(SupportTabPanelController.class);
  
  private static final String LOG_DIRECTORY_NAME = "logs";
  
  private static final long MAX_LOG_FILE_SIZE = 125829120L;
  
  private static final long MAX_LOG_FILE_AGE_MILLIS = 259200000L;
  
  private static final File TEMP_DIR = new File(System.getProperty("java.io.tmpdir") + System.getProperty("java.io.tmpdir") + "logs");
  
  private File getLogfileFolder() {
    return new File(SettingsProxy.getInstance().getDart2HomePath(), "logs");
  }
  
  public void createLogsArchive(File zipFilePath) throws ZipException {
    createZip(zipFilePath);
    createFullZip(zipFilePath);
  }
  
  public File getLogsArchiveName() {
    DateFormat dateFormat = new SimpleDateFormat("yyyyMMdd-HHmm");
    String destFilename = String.format("log_%s.zip", dateFormat.format(new Date()));
    return new File(destFilename);
  }
  
  private List<File> searchForLogfiles() {
    List<File> serviceToolLogs = Collections.emptyList();
    File[] serviceToolLogFiles = getLogfileFolder().listFiles((dir, name) -> name.startsWith("e-Bike_ServiceTool_Log"));
    if (serviceToolLogFiles != null) {
      serviceToolLogs = Arrays.asList(serviceToolLogFiles);
      serviceToolLogs.sort(this::compareFilesByModifiedDate);
    } 
    List<File> remoteLogs = Collections.emptyList();
    File[] remoteLogFiles = getLogfileFolder().listFiles((dir, name) -> name.startsWith("e-Bike_ServiceTool_remote_Log"));
    if (remoteLogFiles != null) {
      remoteLogs = Arrays.asList(remoteLogFiles);
      remoteLogs.sort(this::compareFilesByModifiedDate);
    } 
    List<File> logFileList = buildLogFileList(serviceToolLogs, remoteLogs);
    File[] mfgToolLogFiles = getLogfileFolder().listFiles((dir, name) -> name.startsWith("MfgTool_Log_"));
    if (mfgToolLogFiles != null)
      for (File mfgToolLog : mfgToolLogFiles) {
        if (checkFileByModifiedDate(mfgToolLog))
          logFileList.add(mfgToolLog); 
      }  
    return logFileList;
  }
  
  private int compareFilesByModifiedDate(File o1, File o2) {
    try {
      FileTime creationTimeO1 = Files.<BasicFileAttributes>readAttributes(o1.toPath(), BasicFileAttributes.class).lastModifiedTime();
      FileTime creationTimeO2 = Files.<BasicFileAttributes>readAttributes(o2.toPath(), BasicFileAttributes.class).lastModifiedTime();
      return creationTimeO2.compareTo(creationTimeO1);
    } catch (IOException ex) {
      LOGGER.error("Could not read creationtime of file", (Throwable)ex);
      return 0;
    } 
  }
  
  private boolean checkFileByModifiedDate(File file) {
    try {
      long dateMillis = new Date().getTime();
      FileTime fileTime = Files.<BasicFileAttributes>readAttributes(file.toPath(), BasicFileAttributes.class).lastModifiedTime();
      long fileMillis = fileTime.toMillis();
      return (dateMillis - fileMillis < 259200000L);
    } catch (IOException ex) {
      LOGGER.error("Could not read creationtime of file", (Throwable)ex);
      return true;
    } 
  }
  
  private List<File> buildLogFileList(final List<File> listServiceToolLogs, final List<File> listRemoteLogs) {
    Iterator<File> logIterator = new Iterator<>() {
        Iterator<File> i1 = listServiceToolLogs.iterator();
        
        Iterator<File> i2 = listRemoteLogs.iterator();
        
        public boolean hasNext() {
          return (this.i1.hasNext() || this.i2.hasNext());
        }
        
        public File next() {
          if (this.i1.hasNext()) {
            File result = this.i1.next();
            Iterator<File> tmp = this.i1;
            this.i1 = this.i2;
            this.i2 = tmp;
            return result;
          } 
          return this.i2.next();
        }
      };
    ArrayList<File> resultList = new ArrayList<>();
    long currentLogsSize = 0L;
    while (logIterator.hasNext()) {
      File logFile = logIterator.next();
      if (checkFileByModifiedDate(logFile)) {
        currentLogsSize += logFile.length();
        if (currentLogsSize > 125829120L)
          break; 
        resultList.add(logFile);
      } 
    } 
    return resultList;
  }
  
  private List<File> getLogFileList(File dir) {
    List<File> files = new ArrayList<>();
    File[] logFiles = dir.listFiles();
    if (logFiles != null)
      for (File file : logFiles) {
        if (file.isDirectory()) {
          files.addAll(getLogFileList(file));
        } else if (checkFileByModifiedDate(file)) {
          files.add(file);
        } 
      }  
    return files;
  }
  
  private void createZip(File zipFilePath) throws ZipException {
    ZipFile zipFile = new ZipFile(zipFilePath);
    ZipParameters parameters = new ZipParameters();
    parameters.setCompressionMethod(8);
    parameters.setCompressionLevel(7);
    copyZipDeleteTmpLogFiles(searchForLogfiles(), zipFile, parameters);
  }
  
  private void createFullZip(File zipFilePath) throws ZipException {
    String path = zipFilePath.getAbsolutePath();
    String fullPath = FilenameUtils.getFullPath(path);
    String baseName = FilenameUtils.getBaseName(path);
    String extension = FilenameUtils.getExtension(path);
    ZipFile zipFile = new ZipFile(fullPath + fullPath + "_full." + baseName);
    ZipParameters parameters = new ZipParameters();
    parameters.setCompressionMethod(8);
    parameters.setCompressionLevel(7);
    copyZipDeleteTmpLogFiles(getLogFileList(getLogfileFolder()), zipFile, parameters);
  }
  
  private void copyZipDeleteTmpLogFiles(List<File> logFiles, ZipFile zipFile, ZipParameters parameters) {
    createCleanTmpDir();
    logFiles.forEach(f1 -> {
          try {
            LOGGER.info("Copying to temporal directory the file {} with size '{} kb'", f1.getName(), Long.valueOf(f1.length() / 1024L));
            FileUtils.copyFileToDirectory(f1, TEMP_DIR);
          } catch (IOException ex) {
            LOGGER.debug("Exception while attempt to copy temp file to tmp directory", (Throwable)ex);
          } 
        });
    try {
      ArrayList<File> tmpDirFiles = new ArrayList<>(Arrays.asList(Objects.<File[]>requireNonNull(TEMP_DIR.listFiles())));
      for (File file : tmpDirFiles)
        LOGGER.info("Adding file {} with size '{} kb' to the zip.", file.getName(), Long.valueOf(file.length() / 1024L)); 
      zipFile.createZipFile(tmpDirFiles, parameters, true, 10485760L);
    } catch (ZipException ex) {
      LOGGER.error("Error while zipping files", (Throwable)ex);
    } catch (NullPointerException ex) {
      LOGGER.error("The list of temporal files is null => Error while zipping files", (Throwable)ex);
    } 
    clearTmpDir();
  }
  
  private void createCleanTmpDir() {
    try {
      FileUtils.forceMkdir(TEMP_DIR);
    } catch (IOException ex) {
      LOGGER.error("Error creating tmp dir for log files", (Throwable)ex);
    } 
    clearTmpDir();
  }
  
  private void clearTmpDir() {
    try {
      FileUtils.cleanDirectory(TEMP_DIR);
    } catch (IOException ex) {
      LOGGER.error("Error cleaning tmp dir for log files", (Throwable)ex);
    } 
  }
}

public class GuiManagerImpl implements GuiManager, HardwareConnectionChangesListener {
  private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(GuiManagerImpl.class);
  
  private final AtomicReference<GuiManager.GuiMode> currentGuiMode = new AtomicReference<>(GuiManager.GuiMode.EBIKE);
  
  private final AtomicBoolean guiModeChanged = new AtomicBoolean(false);

    return instance;
  }
  
  public synchronized GuiManager.GuiMode getGuiMode() {
    return this.currentGuiMode.get();
  }
  
  public boolean isGuiInMode(GuiManager.GuiMode mode) {
    return (this.currentGuiMode.get() == mode);
  }
  
  public boolean hasGuiModeChanged() {
    return this.guiModeChanged.get();
  }
  
  private void onEcuConnect(Constants.EcuType type) {
    GuiManager.GuiMode newMode = null;
    switch (type) {
      case BCT:
        newMode = GuiManager.GuiMode.BCT;
        break;
      case BCS250:
        newMode = GuiManager.GuiMode.BCS;
        break;
      case BUI21X:
      case BUI25X:
      case BUI270:
      case BUI275:
      case BUI330:
      case BUI350:
      case COBI:
        if (this.currentGuiMode.get() != GuiManager.GuiMode.BCS)
          newMode = GuiManager.GuiMode.EBIKE; 
        break;
    } 
    if (newMode != null && newMode != this.currentGuiMode.get()) {
      LOGGER.debug("GUI-Mode changed to {}", newMode);
      setGuiMode(newMode);
      this.guiModeChanged.set(true);
    } else {
      this.guiModeChanged.set(false);
    } 
  }
  
  private void onEcuDisconnect(Constants.EcuType type) {
    if (type == Constants.EcuType.BCS250) {
      setGuiMode(GuiManager.GuiMode.EBIKE);
      this.guiModeChanged.set(true);
    } else {
      this.guiModeChanged.set(false);
    } 
  }
  
  public void reset() {
    this.guiModeChanged.set(false);
    setGuiMode(GuiManager.GuiMode.EBIKE);
  }
  
  public void onHardwareConnectionChanged(HardwareConnectionChangedEvent event) {
    LOGGER.debug("HardwareConnectionChangedEvent received: '{}'", event);
    switch (event.getAction()) {
      case ECU_CONNECTED:
        onEcuConnect(event.getComponent());
        break;
      case ECU_DISCONNECTED:
        onEcuDisconnect(event.getComponent());
        break;
    } 
  }
  
  private synchronized void setGuiMode(GuiManager.GuiMode newMode) {
    GuiManager.GuiMode oldMode = this.currentGuiMode.getAndSet(newMode);
    if (oldMode != newMode)
      EventQueue.invokeLater(() -> this.guiModeChangedListeners.forEach(guiModeChangedListener -> guiModeChangedListener.onGuiModeChanged(newMode, oldMode))); 
  }
  
  public void addGuiModeChangedListener(GuiModeChangedListener guiModeChangedListener) {
    if (guiModeChangedListener != null && !this.guiModeChangedListeners.contains(guiModeChangedListener))
      this.guiModeChangedListeners.add(guiModeChangedListener); 
  }
  
  public void removeGuiModeChangedListener(GuiModeChangedListener guiModeChangedListener) {
    this.guiModeChangedListeners.remove(guiModeChangedListener);
  }
  
  public String getOrderingName() {
    return "GuiManager";
  }
}

  private SplashScreenFrame frame;

      instance = new SplashScreenLauncher();

  }
  
  public void showSplashScreen() {
    LOGGER.info("showSplashScreen() called.");
    EventQueue.invokeLater(() -> {
          Dimension scrnSize = Toolkit.getDefaultToolkit().getScreenSize();
          this.frame = new SplashScreenFrame();
          TestableJOptionPane.setDefaultParentFrame(this.frame);
          this.frame.setVisible(true);
          this.frame.setAlwaysOnTop(true);
          int dx = (int)scrnSize.getWidth() / 2 - this.frame.getWidth() / 2;
          int dy = (int)scrnSize.getHeight() / 2 - this.frame.getHeight() / 2;
          this.frame.setBounds(dx, dy, this.frame.getWidth(), this.frame.getHeight());
          LOGGER.info("showSplashScreen() executed with result SplashScreenFrame {}.", this.frame);
        });
  }

    EventQueue.invokeLater(() -> {
          LOGGER.info("closeSplashScreen() executed for SplashScreenFrame {}.", this.frame);
          if (this.frame != null) {
            this.frame.setVisible(false);
            this.frame.dispose();
          } 
        });
  }
}

ITEM 262: com/gigatronik/beds/gui/utilities/FutureHolder.java
========================================================================================================================
package com.gigatronik.beds.gui.utilities;

import java.util.concurrent.Future;
import java.util.function.Consumer;

public class FutureHolder implements Consumer<Future> {
  private Future future;
  
  private boolean cancel;
  
  public synchronized void accept(Future future) {
    if (this.cancel) {
      future.cancel(true);
    } else {
      this.future = future;
    } 
  }
  
  public synchronized void cancel() {
    this.cancel = true;
    if (this.future != null)
      this.future.cancel(true); 
  }
}

ITEM 265: com/gigatronik/beds/samplevalidator/impl/AbstractSampleValidator.java
========================================================================================================================
package com.gigatronik.beds.samplevalidator.impl;

import com.gigatronik.ebike.common.configuration.BikeIdentification;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.common.configuration.BmsIdentification;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.common.configuration.ComponentType;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.common.configuration.Constants;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.common.configuration.DuIdentification;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.common.configuration.EcuIdentification;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.common.configuration.HmiIdentification;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import org.apache.commons.lang3.StringUtils;

abstract class AbstractSampleValidator {
  String getComponentsTexts(ArrayList<ComponentType> components) {
    String result = "";
    for (int i = 0; i < components.size(); i++) {
      if (components.get(i) != ComponentType.NONE && components.get(i) != ComponentType.COMP_UNSPECIFIED) {
        String text = components.get(i).getName();
        if (StringUtils.startsWith(text, "BDU") || StringUtils.startsWith(text, "BBP")) {
          text = StringUtils.substring(text, 0, 4) + "xx";
        } else if (StringUtils.startsWith(text, "BUI")) {
          text = StringUtils.substring(text, 0, 5) + "x";
        } else if (components.get(i) == ComponentType.COMP_BBA100) {
          text = "BAS100";
        } 
        if (StringUtils.isEmpty(result)) {
          result = text;
        } else if (!StringUtils.contains(result, text)) {
          result = result + ", " + result;
        } 
      } 
    } 
    return result;
  }
  
  ArrayList<ComponentType> getAllConnectedSampleHwEcus(BikeIdentification bikeIdentification) {
    ArrayList<ComponentType> sampleHardwareComponentsList = new ArrayList<>();
    if (bikeIdentification == null)
      return sampleHardwareComponentsList; 
    addComponentIfSampleHw((EcuIdentification)bikeIdentification.getHmiIdentification(), sampleHardwareComponentsList);
    addComponentIfSampleHw((EcuIdentification)bikeIdentification.getDuIdentification(), sampleHardwareComponentsList);
    addComponentIfSampleHw((EcuIdentification)bikeIdentification.getBms1Identification(), sampleHardwareComponentsList);
    addComponentIfSampleHw((EcuIdentification)bikeIdentification.getBms2Identification(), sampleHardwareComponentsList);
    return sampleHardwareComponentsList;
  }
  
  private void addComponentIfSampleHw(EcuIdentification ecuIdentification, ArrayList<ComponentType> sampleHardwareComponentsList) {
    if (ecuIdentification.isConnected() && ecuIdentification.isHwSample())
      sampleHardwareComponentsList.add(ecuIdentification.getComponentType()); 
  }
  
  EcuIdentification getEcuByType(Constants.EcuType type, BikeIdentification bikeIdentification) {
    EcuIdentification ecuIdentification1;
    HmiIdentification hmiIdentification;
    DuIdentification duIdentification;
    BmsIdentification bmsIdentification2, bmsIdentification1;
    EcuIdentification ecuIdentification;
    if (type == null || bikeIdentification == null)
      return null; 
    switch (type) {
      case BCS250:
        ecuIdentification1 = bikeIdentification.getBcsIdentification();
        break;
      case BCT:
        ecuIdentification1 = bikeIdentification.getBctIdentification();
        break;
      case BAS100:
        ecuIdentification1 = bikeIdentification.getAbsIdentification();
        break;
      case BUI21X:
      case BUI25X:
      case BUI270:
      case BUI275:
      case BUI330:
      case BUI350:
      case COBI:
        hmiIdentification = bikeIdentification.getHmiIdentification();
        break;
      case CLASSIC_DU:
      case VICTOR_DU:
        duIdentification = bikeIdentification.getDuIdentification();
        break;
      case CLASSIC_PP:
      case VICTOR_PP1:
        bmsIdentification2 = bikeIdentification.getBms1Identification();
        break;
      case VICTOR_PP2:
        bmsIdentification1 = bikeIdentification.getBms2Identification();
        break;
      default:
        ecuIdentification = null;
        break;
    } 
    return ecuIdentification;
  }
}

package com.gigatronik.beds.samplevalidator.impl;

import com.gigatronik.beds.service.configuration.ConfigurationManager;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.configuration.impl.ContainerConfiguration;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.flashcontainer.api.BoschContainerController;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.flashcontainer.impl.OemParamDto;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.rightsmanager.api.Mode;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.bosch.service.internationalization.ResourceBundleFactory;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.bosch.service.internationalization.Utf8ResourceBundleFormatted;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.common.configuration.ComponentType;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.gui.testinterface.TestableJOptionPane;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.function.Consumer;
import org.apache.commons.lang3.StringUtils;

class SampleValidatorContainer extends AbstractSampleValidator {
  private static final Utf8ResourceBundleFormatted BUNDLE = ResourceBundleFactory.newDefaultResourceBundle();
  
  private static final String SAMPLE_SOFTWARE_OEMPARAMETER_REQUEST = "2EDE9501";
  
  boolean checkContainerForSampleSoftware(Mode mode, ConfigurationManager configurationManager) {
    boolean resume = true;
    ArrayList<ComponentType> sampleSoftwareComponentsList = getComponentsWithSampleSoftwareInContainer(configurationManager.getContainerConfiguration());
    if (!sampleSoftwareComponentsList.isEmpty()) {
      resume = false;
      String components = getComponentsTexts(sampleSoftwareComponentsList);
      String title = BUNDLE.getString("Bosch.diagnostic.tool");
      if (mode == Mode.OEM_ADMIN) {
        String message = String.format(BUNDLE.getString("SampleDetection.CffContainer.OemAdmin"), components);
        message = message + "\n" + message;
        if (TestableJOptionPane.showConfirmDialog(message, title, 0) == 0)
          resume = true; 
      } else {
        String message = String.format(BUNDLE.getString("SampleDetection.CffContainer.OemWorkerAndIbd"), components);
        TestableJOptionPane.showMessageDialog(message, title, -1);
      } 
    } 
    if (!resume)
      configurationManager.clearContainer(); 
    return resume;
  }
  
  boolean isSampleSoftwareInContainer(ContainerConfiguration cffConfiguration) {
    return !getComponentsWithSampleSoftwareInContainer(cffConfiguration).isEmpty();
  }
  
  private ArrayList<ComponentType> getComponentsWithSampleSoftwareInContainer(ContainerConfiguration cffConfiguration) {
    ArrayList<ComponentType> sampleSoftwareComponentsList = new ArrayList<>();
    if (cffConfiguration.isLoaded()) {
      ArrayList<ComponentType> componentsExists = new ArrayList<>(Arrays.asList(ComponentType.values()));
      componentsExists.forEach((Consumer<? super ComponentType>)(comp -> {
            if (isSampleSoftwareInContainerForComponent(comp, cffConfiguration.getContainerController()))
              sampleSoftwareComponentsList.add(comp); 
          }));
    } 
    return sampleSoftwareComponentsList;
  }
  
  private boolean isSampleSoftwareInContainerForComponent(ComponentType component, BoschContainerController boschContainerController) {
    BoschContainerController.ContainerType currentContainerType = boschContainerController.getContainerType();
    if (null == currentContainerType)
      return false; 
    List<OemParamDto> oemParams = boschContainerController.getBoschContainerCommonInterface().getOemParameter(component);
    return oemParams.stream().anyMatch(oemParam -> StringUtils.equals("2EDE9501", oemParam.getRequest()));
  }
}

package com.gigatronik.beds.samplevalidator.impl;

import com.gigatronik.beds.service.rightsmanager.api.Mode;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.bosch.service.internationalization.ResourceBundleFactory;

import com.gigatronik.ebike.gui.testinterface.TestableJOptionPane;
import java.util.ArrayList;

class SampleValidatorFlashButton extends AbstractSampleValidator {
  private static final Utf8ResourceBundleFormatted BUNDLE = ResourceBundleFactory.newDefaultResourceBundle();
  
  boolean checkStartFlashingSampleValidation(Mode mode, BikeIdentification bikeIdentification) {
    boolean allowFlashing = true;
    ArrayList<ComponentType> connectedSampleHardwareComponentsList = getAllConnectedSampleHwEcus(bikeIdentification);
    if (!connectedSampleHardwareComponentsList.isEmpty())
      if (mode != Mode.OEM_ADMIN) {
        allowFlashing = false;
      } else {
        String components = getComponentsTexts(connectedSampleHardwareComponentsList);
        String title = BUNDLE.getString("Bosch.diagnostic.tool");
        String message = String.format(BUNDLE.getString("SampleDetection.SampleEcuFlash.OemAdmin"), components);
        message = message + "\n" + message;
        if (TestableJOptionPane.showConfirmDialog(message, title, 0) != 0)
          allowFlashing = false; 
      }  
    return allowFlashing;
  }
  
  boolean checkEnableFlashbutton(Mode mode, BikeIdentification bikeIdentification) {
    ArrayList<ComponentType> connectedSampleHardwareComponentsList = getAllConnectedSampleHwEcus(bikeIdentification);
    if (!connectedSampleHardwareComponentsList.isEmpty())
      return (mode == Mode.OEM_ADMIN); 
    return true;
  }
}

      this.dialogIsShown = false;
    }

ITEM 271: com/gigatronik/beds/settings/download/CloudSettingsDownloadTrigger.java
========================================================================================================================
package com.gigatronik.beds.settings.download;

import com.gigatronik.beds.service.rightsmanager.api.RightsChangedEvent;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.rightsmanager.api.RightsChangedEventListener;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.rightsmanager.api.RightsManager;
import com.gigatronik.beds.settings.global.cloud.CloudSettingsUpdater;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.bosch.updateserver.settings.CloudSettingsDownloader;
import java.util.concurrent.Executors;
import java.util.concurrent.ScheduledExecutorService;
import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit;
import org.apache.commons.lang3.concurrent.BasicThreadFactory;
import org.slf4j.Logger;
import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;

public class CloudSettingsDownloadTrigger implements RightsChangedEventListener {
  private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(CloudSettingsDownloadTrigger.class);
  
  private static final int DELAY_BETWEEN_CALLBACK_AND_SETTINGS_UPDATE = 2;
  
  private final ScheduledExecutorService executor = Executors.newSingleThreadScheduledExecutor(new BasicThreadFactory.Builder().namingPattern("cloudSettingsUpdater-%d").build());
  
  private boolean isFirstCallbackReceived = false;
  
  public CloudSettingsDownloadTrigger(RightsManager rightsManager) {
    rightsManager.addListener(this);
  }
  
  public void onRightsChanged(RightsChangedEvent event) {
    LOGGER.debug("Received rights changed event '{}'", event);
    if (!this.isFirstCallbackReceived) {
      this.isFirstCallbackReceived = true;
      triggerCloudSettingsDownload();
    } 
  }
  
  private void triggerCloudSettingsDownload() {
    LOGGER.debug("Trigger cloud settings update procedure asynchronous");
    this.executor.schedule(this::triggerCloudSettingsDownloadDelegated, 2L, TimeUnit.SECONDS);
  }
  
  private void triggerCloudSettingsDownloadDelegated() {
    CloudSettingsDownloader cloudSettingsDownloader = new CloudSettingsDownloader();
    CloudSettingsUpdater updater = new CloudSettingsUpdater((CloudSettingsDownloaderFacade)cloudSettingsDownloader);
    updater.updateCloudSettings();
  }
}

package com.gigatronik.ebike.custom;

import com.gigatronik.beds.settings.SettingsProxy;

import com.gigatronik.dart2.framework.plugins.exceptions.ConfigurationNotFoundException;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.gui.testinterface.TestableJOptionPane;
import java.io.File;
import java.io.FileNotFoundException;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.NoSuchFileException;
import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.List;
import javax.swing.JFileChooser;
import javax.swing.filechooser.FileNameExtensionFilter;
import org.apache.commons.lang3.StringUtils;
import org.slf4j.Logger;
import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;

public class CustomFileChooser extends JFileChooser {
  private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(CustomFileChooser.class);
  
  private static final long serialVersionUID = 1L;
  
  private static final Utf8ResourceBundleFormatted BUNDLE = ResourceBundleFactory.newDefaultResourceBundle();
  
  private CustomFileChooser() {
    setName("dlgChooseFile");
    setOpaque(true);
    setAcceptAllFileFilterUsed(false);
    setCurrentDirectoryToLastOpenedFile();
  }
  
  public static JFileChooser getCustomFileChooser() {
    return new CustomFileChooser();
  }
  
  private void setCurrentDirectoryToLastOpenedFile() {
    try {
      File lastSelectedFile = new File(SettingsProxy.getInstance().getGlobalSettings().getProperty("last_opened_file"));
      File directoryOfLastSelectedFile = lastSelectedFile.getParentFile();
      if (directoryOfLastSelectedFile != null && directoryOfLastSelectedFile.isDirectory())
        setCurrentDirectory(directoryOfLastSelectedFile); 
    } catch (ConfigurationNotFoundException e) {
      LOGGER.error("Error in getCustomFileChooser: ", (Throwable)e);
    } 
  }
  
  public void approveSelection() {
    File selectedFile = getSelectedFile();
    saveLastOpenedDirectory(selectedFile);
    try {
      checkFileValidity(selectedFile);
      selectedFile = checkFileExtensions(selectedFile);
      switch (getDialogType()) {
        case 1:
          handleSaveFile(selectedFile);
          break;
        case 0:
          handleOpenFile(selectedFile);
          break;
      } 
      setSelectedFile(selectedFile);
      super.approveSelection();
    } catch (Exception e) {
      LOGGER.info(e.toString());
    } 
  }
  
  private void handleSaveFile(File file) throws FileNotDeletedException {
    if (file.exists() && !handleRepeatedFile(file))
      throw new FileNotDeletedException(); 
  }
  
  private void handleOpenFile(File file) throws FileNotFoundException {
    if (!file.exists()) {
      LOGGER.warn("The selected file {} does not exist any more.", file);
      TestableJOptionPane.showMessageDialog(BUNDLE.getString("CustomFileChooser.nonExistingFileSelected.optionPane.message"), 
          BUNDLE.getString("CustomFileChooser.nonExistingFileSelected.optionPane.title"), 0);
      setSelectedFile(new File(""));
      throw new FileNotFoundException();
    } 
  }
  
  private boolean handleRepeatedFile(File file) {
    int result = TestableJOptionPane.showConfirmDialog(BUNDLE.getString("CustomFileChooser.fileExists.optionPane.message"), 
        BUNDLE.getString("CustomFileChooser.fileExists.optionPane.title"), 0);
    if (result == 0) {
      try {
        Files.delete(file.toPath());
        return true;
      } catch (NoSuchFileException e) {
        LOGGER.warn("The file {} doesn't exist. Maybe it's scheduled to be deleted by the SO but another program is using it", file);
      } catch (IOException e) {
        LOGGER.error("The file {} cannot be deleted: ", file, e);
      } catch (SecurityException e) {
        LOGGER.warn("Security delete access to the file {} not granted", file);
      } finally {
        if (file.exists())
          TestableJOptionPane.showMessageDialog(BUNDLE.getString("CustomFileChooser.fileDeleteFailed.optionPane.message"), 
              BUNDLE.getString("CustomFileChooser.fileDeleteFailed.optionPane.title"), 0); 
      } 
    } else {
      LOGGER.info("User canceled saving the file {}", file);
    } 
    return false;
  }
  
  private void saveLastOpenedDirectory(File f) {
    try {
      SettingsProxy.getInstance().getGlobalSettings().setProperty("last_opened_file", f.getCanonicalPath());
    } catch (ConfigurationNotFoundException|IOException e) {
      LOGGER.error("Error in approveSelection: ", (Throwable)e);
    } 
  }
  
  private File checkFileExtensions(File file) throws ExtensionNotMatchingException {
    if (getFileFilter() instanceof FileNameExtensionFilter) {
      FileNameExtensionFilter fileFilter = (FileNameExtensionFilter)getFileFilter();
      List<String> extensions = Arrays.asList(fileFilter.getExtensions());
      try {
        if (extensions.size() == 1) {
          if (!endsWithIgnoreCase(file.getName(), "." + (String)extensions.get(0)))
            return new File(file.getCanonicalPath().concat("." + (String)extensions.get(0))); 
        } else {
          String currentFileName = file.getName();
          if (extensions.stream().noneMatch(ext -> endsWithIgnoreCase(currentFileName, "." + ext))) {
            TestableJOptionPane.showMessageDialog(BUNDLE.getString("CustomFileChooser.noFileExtension.optionPane.message"), 
                BUNDLE.getString("CustomFileChooser.noFileExtension.optionPane.title"), 0);
            throw new ExtensionNotMatchingException();
          } 
        } 
      } catch (IOException e) {
        LOGGER.error("IOException: ", (Throwable)e);
      } 
    } 
    return file;
  }
  
  private static boolean endsWithIgnoreCase(String str, String suffix) {
    int suffixLength = suffix.length();
    return str.regionMatches(true, str.length() - suffixLength, suffix, 0, suffixLength);
  }
  
  private void checkFileValidity(File file) throws FileCannotBeCreatedException {
    if (StringUtils.contains(file.getName(), ":")) {
      TestableJOptionPane.showMessageDialog(BUNDLE.getString("CustomFileChooser.invalidFilename.optionPane.message"), 
          BUNDLE.getString("CustomFileChooser.invalidFilename.optionPane.title"), 0);
      throw new FileCannotBeCreatedException();
    } 
  }
  
  static class FileNotDeletedException extends Exception {
    FileNotDeletedException() {
      super("The selected file already exists and has not been deleted");
    }
  }
  
  static class ExtensionNotMatchingException extends Exception {
    ExtensionNotMatchingException() {
      super("The given file has no extension and there are more than one possibilities.");
    }
  }
  
  static class FileCannotBeCreatedException extends Exception {
    FileCannotBeCreatedException() {
      super("The specified path name is not valid.");
    }
  }
}

package com.gigatronik.ebike.custom;

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import javax.swing.SpinnerNumberModel;

public class CustomSpinnerNumberModel extends SpinnerNumberModel {
  private static final long serialVersionUID = 1L;
  
  public CustomSpinnerNumberModel(double i, double j, double k, double l) {
    super(i, j, k, l);
  }
  
  public CustomSpinnerNumberModel(Number i, Comparable<?> j, Comparable<?> k, Number l) {
    super(i, j, k, l);
  }
  
  public Object getPreviousValue() {
    BigDecimal newValue;
    Number v = getNumber();
    BigDecimal value = new BigDecimal(v.toString());
    BigDecimal stepSize = new BigDecimal(getStepSize().toString());
    BigDecimal maximum = new BigDecimal(getMaximum().toString());
    BigDecimal minimum = new BigDecimal(getMinimum().toString());
    if (v instanceof Double) {
      newValue = value.subtract(stepSize);
    } else {
      return super.getPreviousValue();
    } 
    if (maximum != null && maximum.compareTo(newValue) < 0)
      return null; 
    if (minimum != null && minimum.compareTo(newValue) > 0)
      return null; 
    return newValue;
  }
  
  public Object getNextValue() {
    BigDecimal newValue;
    Number v = getNumber();
    BigDecimal value = new BigDecimal(v.toString());
    BigDecimal stepSize = new BigDecimal(getStepSize().toString());
    BigDecimal maximum = new BigDecimal(getMaximum().toString());
    BigDecimal minimum = new BigDecimal(getMinimum().toString());
    if (v instanceof Double) {
      newValue = value.add(stepSize);
    } else {
      return super.getPreviousValue();
    } 
    if (maximum != null && maximum.compareTo(newValue) < 0)
      return null; 
    if (minimum != null && minimum.compareTo(newValue) > 0)
      return null; 
    return newValue;
  }
}

package com.gigatronik.ebike.custom;

import java.awt.BorderLayout;
import java.awt.Color;
import java.net.URL;
import javax.swing.ImageIcon;
import javax.swing.JLabel;
import javax.swing.JPanel;
import javax.swing.JTabbedPane;
import javax.swing.border.EmptyBorder;

public class CustomTab extends JPanel {
  private static final long serialVersionUID = 1L;
  
  private final JTabbedPane pane;
  
  public CustomTab(JTabbedPane pane, String tabText, URL imageURL) {
    super(new BorderLayout());
    if (pane == null)
      throw new NullPointerException("TabbedPane is null"); 
    this.pane = pane;
    this.pane.setTabLayoutPolicy(0);
    setOpaque(false);
    JLabel label = new JLabel(tabText, 0);
    label.setName("lblTabText");
    label.setForeground(Color.BLACK);
    label.setBorder(new EmptyBorder(0, 0, 5, 0));
    add(label, "Center");
    ImageIcon icon = new ImageIcon(imageURL);
    JLabel lblIcon = new JLabel(icon);
    lblIcon.setName("lblIcon");
    add(lblIcon, "North");
  }
}

package com.gigatronik.ebike.custom;

import com.gigatronik.beds.gui.panels.diagnostictab.subtab.AbstractDiagnosticSubtab;
import com.gigatronik.beds.gui.panels.diagnostictab.subtab.DuSubtab;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.tableEvaluator.impl.THead;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.common.configuration.ComplexResponse;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.common.configuration.Constants;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.gui.EBikeApplicationPanel;
import java.awt.Color;
import java.awt.Component;
import javax.swing.JLabel;
import javax.swing.JPanel;
import javax.swing.JTable;
import javax.swing.border.EmptyBorder;
import javax.swing.table.DefaultTableCellRenderer;

public class DiagnosisTableCellRenderer extends DefaultTableCellRenderer {
  private static final long serialVersionUID = 1L;
  
  private AbstractDiagnosticSubtab subtab;
  
  public DiagnosisTableCellRenderer() {}
  
  public DiagnosisTableCellRenderer(AbstractDiagnosticSubtab tab) {
    this.subtab = tab;
  }
  
  public Component getTableCellRendererComponent(JTable table, Object value, boolean isSelected, boolean hasFocus, int row, int column) {
    if (value instanceof com.gigatronik.ebike.gui.PnTableWithChartImpl)
      return (JPanel)value; 
    boolean isHead = false;
    if (value instanceof THead) {
      isHead = true;
      value = ((THead)value).getValue();
    } 
    JLabel cell = (JLabel)super.getTableCellRendererComponent(table, value, isSelected, hasFocus, row, column);
    cell.setName("lblCell");
    if (value instanceof ComplexResponse) {
      if (((ComplexResponse)value).isPositive() || value.toString().contains(Constants.DISPLAY_VALUE_NOT_AVAILABLE)) {
        cell.setForeground(Color.BLACK);
      } else {
        cell.setForeground(Color.RED);
      } 
      cell.setText(((ComplexResponse)value).toString());
    } else {
      cell.setForeground(Color.BLACK);
      cell.setText((value != null) ? value.toString() : "");
    } 
    if (!isSelected) {
      DuSubtab duSubTab = null;
      if (this.subtab != null && this.subtab instanceof DuSubtab)
        duSubTab = (DuSubtab)this.subtab; 
      if (duSubTab != null && row > duSubTab.getRowWithChart()) {
        cell.setBackground((row % 2 == 0) ? Color.LIGHT_GRAY : Color.WHITE);
      } else {
        cell.setBackground((row % 2 == 0) ? Color.WHITE : Color.LIGHT_GRAY);
      } 
    } 
    cell.setBorder(new EmptyBorder(5, 5, 5, 5));
    if (column == 0)
      if (isHead) {
        cell.setFont(EBikeApplicationPanel.DEFAULT_FONT.deriveFont(1));
      } else {
        cell.setFont(EBikeApplicationPanel.DEFAULT_FONT);
        cell.setBorder(new EmptyBorder(5, 35, 5, 5));
      }  
    return cell;
  }
}

package com.gigatronik.ebike.custom;

import com.gigatronik.dart2.bosch.service.internationalization.ResourceBundleFactory;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.bosch.service.internationalization.Utf8ResourceBundleFormatted;
import java.awt.Color;
import java.awt.Component;
import java.util.MissingResourceException;
import javax.swing.JLabel;
import javax.swing.JTable;
import javax.swing.border.EmptyBorder;
import javax.swing.table.DefaultTableCellRenderer;
import org.slf4j.Logger;
import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;

public class ErrorCodeTableCellRenderer extends DefaultTableCellRenderer {
  private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(ErrorCodeTableCellRenderer.class);
  
  private static final long serialVersionUID = 1L;
  
  private final transient Utf8ResourceBundleFormatted bundle = ResourceBundleFactory.newDefaultResourceBundle();
  
  public Component getTableCellRendererComponent(JTable table, Object value, boolean isSelected, boolean hasFocus, int row, int column) {
    JLabel cell = (JLabel)super.getTableCellRendererComponent(table, value, isSelected, hasFocus, row, column);
    cell.setName("lblCell");
    if (column == 2) {
      if (!value.equals(this.bundle.getString("EBikeServiceTab.ErrorCodeTable.NO_ERROR")) && 
        !value.equals(this.bundle.getString("EBikeServiceTab.NEGATIVE_RESPONSE"))) {
        StringBuilder key = new StringBuilder();
        String cellText = table.getValueAt(row, 0).toString().substring(2);
        if (cellText.startsWith("01")) {
          key.append("ErrorManagerConfiguration.DU.");
        } else if (cellText.startsWith("4")) {
          key.append("ErrorManagerConfiguration.HMI.");
        } else if (cellText.startsWith("02")) {
          key.append("ErrorManagerConfiguration.BMS.");
        } 
        key.append(cellText);
        key.append(".activity");
        try {
          String toolTipText = this.bundle.getString(key.toString());
          cell.setToolTipText(toolTipText);
        } catch (MissingResourceException e) {
          LOGGER.error("error loading language string", (Throwable)e);
          cell.setToolTipText(null);
        } 
      } else {
        cell.setToolTipText(null);
      } 
    } else {
      cell.setToolTipText(null);
      cell.setForeground(Color.BLACK);
    } 
    if (column == 1)
      if (value != null && value.toString().equals(this.bundle.getString("EBikeServiceTab.NEGATIVE_RESPONSE"))) {
        cell.setForeground(Color.RED);
      } else {
        cell.setForeground(Color.BLACK);
      }  
    if (!isSelected)
      cell.setBackground((row % 2 == 0) ? Color.WHITE : Color.LIGHT_GRAY); 
    cell.setBorder(new EmptyBorder(5, 5, 5, 5));
    return cell;
  }
}

package com.gigatronik.ebike.custom;

import java.awt.Color;
import java.awt.Dimension;
import java.awt.Insets;
import java.awt.event.ActionEvent;
import java.net.URL;
import javax.swing.ImageIcon;
import javax.swing.JButton;
import org.apache.commons.io.FilenameUtils;
import org.slf4j.Logger;
import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;

public class ImageButton extends JButton {
  private static final long serialVersionUID = -8515429055782738968L;
  
  private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(ImageButton.class);
  
  private static final String RESOURCES_SUB_DIR = "resources/";
  
  private static final int MINSIZE = 10;
  
  private URL iconPath;
  
  private String iconPathAndNameOnly;
  
  private String iconName;
  
  private String iconExtension;
  
  public ImageButton() {
    initialize();
  }
  
  public ImageButton(String iconUrl) {
    init(iconUrl);
  }
  
  private void init(String iconUrl) {
    LOGGER.debug("iconName {}", iconUrl);
    this.iconName = iconUrl;
    setIconValues();
    initialize();
    setIcons();
  }
  
  private void setIconValues() {
    if (this.iconName != null) {
      this.iconExtension = FilenameUtils.EXTENSION_SEPARATOR_STR + FilenameUtils.EXTENSION_SEPARATOR_STR;
      this.iconName = FilenameUtils.getBaseName(this.iconName);
    } else if (this.iconPath != null) {
      this.iconExtension = FilenameUtils.EXTENSION_SEPARATOR_STR + FilenameUtils.EXTENSION_SEPARATOR_STR;
      this.iconPathAndNameOnly = FilenameUtils.getFullPath(this.iconPath.getPath()) + FilenameUtils.getFullPath(this.iconPath.getPath());
    } 
  }
  
  private void initialize() {
    setBorder(null);
    setContentAreaFilled(false);
    setBorderPainted(false);
    setMargin(new Insets(0, 0, 0, 0));
    setOpaque(true);
    setBackground(new Color(9939385));
    setMinimumSize(new Dimension(10, 10));
    addActionListener(e -> requestFocusInWindow());
  }
  
  public void setImage(URL iconUrl) {
    this.iconPath = iconUrl;
    setIconValues();
    setIcons();
  }
  
  public URL getImage() {
    return this.iconPath;
  }
  
  public void setImage(String iconUrl) {
    init(iconUrl);
  }
  
  private void setIcons() {
    setToolTipText(getToolTipText());
    if (this.iconName != null) {
      LOGGER.debug(ImageButton.class.getResource("").getPath());
      setIcon(new ImageIcon(ImageButton.class.getResource("resources/" + this.iconName + this.iconExtension)));
      setRolloverIcon(new ImageIcon(ImageButton.class.getResource("resources/" + this.iconName + "_Entered" + this.iconExtension)));
      setPressedIcon(new ImageIcon(ImageButton.class.getResource("resources/" + this.iconName + "_Pressed" + this.iconExtension)));
      setDisabledIcon(new ImageIcon(ImageButton.class.getResource("resources/" + this.iconName + "_Disabled" + this.iconExtension)));
      setSelectedIcon(new ImageIcon(ImageButton.class.getResource("resources/" + this.iconName + "_Pressed" + this.iconExtension)));
    } else if (this.iconPath != null) {
      setIcon(new ImageIcon(this.iconPath));
      setRolloverIcon(new ImageIcon(this.iconPathAndNameOnly + "_Entered" + this.iconPathAndNameOnly));
      setPressedIcon(new ImageIcon(this.iconPathAndNameOnly + "_Pressed" + this.iconPathAndNameOnly));
      setDisabledIcon(new ImageIcon(this.iconPathAndNameOnly + "_Disabled" + this.iconPathAndNameOnly));
      setSelectedIcon(new ImageIcon(this.iconPathAndNameOnly + "_Pressed" + this.iconPathAndNameOnly));
    } 
  }
  
  public void doClickIfFocusCanGet() {
    if (requestFocusInWindow() || isFocusOwner())
      doClick(); 
  }
}

  }

    return -1;
  }
  
  public Image getIcon(int iconKind) {
    switch (iconKind) {
      case 1:
        if (iconNameC16 == null)
          return null; 
        if (iconColor16 == null)
          iconColor16 = loadImage(iconNameC16); 
        return iconColor16;
      case 2:
        if (iconNameC32 == null)
          return null; 
        if (iconColor32 == null)
          iconColor32 = loadImage(iconNameC32); 
        return iconColor32;
      case 3:
        if (iconNameM16 == null)
          return null; 
        if (iconMono16 == null)
          iconMono16 = loadImage(iconNameM16); 
        return iconMono16;
      case 4:
        if (iconNameM32 == null)
          return null; 
        if (iconMono32 == null)
          iconMono32 = loadImage(iconNameM32); 
        return iconMono32;
    } 
    return null;
  }

ITEM 279: com/gigatronik/ebike/custom/JTextFieldLimiter.java
========================================================================================================================
package com.gigatronik.ebike.custom;

import javax.swing.text.AttributeSet;
import javax.swing.text.BadLocationException;
import javax.swing.text.PlainDocument;

public class JTextFieldLimiter extends PlainDocument {
  private static final long serialVersionUID = 1L;
  
  private boolean allowSpaces = false;
  
  private int limit = -1;
  
  public JTextFieldLimiter(boolean allowSpaces) {
    this.allowSpaces = allowSpaces;
  }
  
  public JTextFieldLimiter(boolean allowSpaces, int limit) {
    this.allowSpaces = allowSpaces;
    this.limit = limit;
  }
  
  public void insertString(int offset, String str, AttributeSet attr) throws BadLocationException {
    if (str == null)
      return; 
    StringBuilder newstr = new StringBuilder(str);
    if (!this.allowSpaces)
      for (int i = newstr.length() - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        if (Character.isWhitespace(str.charAt(i)))
          newstr.deleteCharAt(i); 
      }  
    if (this.limit == -1) {
      super.insertString(offset, newstr.toString(), attr);
    } else if (getLength() + str.length() <= this.limit) {
      super.insertString(offset, str, attr);
    } 
  }
}

  private int lineCount = 0;
  
  private int height = 0;
  
  public void doCalculation(String text, FontMetrics fontMetrics, float width) {
    if (text == null)
      throw new IllegalArgumentException("text should not be null"); 
    if (fontMetrics == null)
      throw new IllegalArgumentException("fontMetrics should not be null"); 
    if (width <= 0.0F)
      throw new IllegalArgumentException("width should be greater than 0"); 
    AttributedString attributedText = new AttributedString(text);
    attributedText.addAttribute(TextAttribute.FONT, fontMetrics.getFont());
    FontRenderContext fontRenderContext = fontMetrics.getFontRenderContext();
    AttributedCharacterIterator iterator = attributedText.getIterator();
    LineBreakMeasurer lineBreakMeasurer = new LineBreakMeasurer(iterator, fontRenderContext);
    lineBreakMeasurer.setPosition(iterator.getBeginIndex());
    this.lineCount = 0;
    while (lineBreakMeasurer.getPosition() < iterator.getEndIndex()) {
      lineBreakMeasurer.nextLayout(width);
      this.lineCount++;
    } 
    this.height = fontMetrics.getHeight() * this.lineCount;
  }
  
  public int getHeight() {
    return this.height;
  }
  
  public int getLineCount() {
    return this.lineCount;
  }
}

        cell.setBackground((row % 2 == 0) ? Color.LIGHT_GRAY : Color.WHITE);

package com.gigatronik.ebike.custom;

import java.awt.BorderLayout;
import java.awt.Color;
import java.awt.event.FocusEvent;
import java.awt.event.FocusListener;
import javax.swing.JLabel;
import javax.swing.border.EmptyBorder;
import javax.swing.event.DocumentEvent;
import javax.swing.event.DocumentListener;
import javax.swing.text.Document;
import javax.swing.text.JTextComponent;

public class TextPrompt extends JLabel implements FocusListener, DocumentListener {
  private static final long serialVersionUID = 1L;
  
  private final JTextComponent component;
  
  private transient Document document;
  
  private Show show;
  
  private boolean showPromptOnce;
  
  private int focusLost;
  
  public enum Show {
    ALWAYS, FOCUS_GAINED, FOCUS_LOST;
  }
  
  public TextPrompt(String text, JTextComponent component) {
    this(text, component, Show.ALWAYS);
  }
  
  public TextPrompt(String text, JTextComponent component, Show show) {
    this.component = component;
    setShow(show);
    this.document = component.getDocument();
    setText(text);
    setFont(component.getFont());
    setForeground(component.getForeground());
    setBorder(new EmptyBorder(component.getInsets()));
    setHorizontalAlignment(10);
    component.addFocusListener(this);
    this.document.addDocumentListener(this);
    component.setLayout(new BorderLayout(5, 5));
    component.add(this);
    checkForPrompt();
  }
  
  public void changeAlpha(float alpha) {
    changeAlpha((int)(alpha * 255.0F));
  }
  
  public void changeAlpha(int alpha) {
    alpha = (alpha > 255) ? 255 : ((alpha < 0) ? 0 : alpha);
    Color foreground = getForeground();
    int red = foreground.getRed();
    int green = foreground.getGreen();
    int blue = foreground.getBlue();
    Color withAlpha = new Color(red, green, blue, alpha);
    setForeground(withAlpha);
  }
  
  public void changeStyle(int style) {
    setFont(getFont().deriveFont(style));
  }
  
  public Show getShow() {
    return this.show;
  }
  
  public void setShow(Show show) {
    this.show = show;
  }
  
  public boolean getShowPromptOnce() {
    return this.showPromptOnce;
  }
  
  public void setShowPromptOnce(boolean showPromptOnce) {
    this.showPromptOnce = showPromptOnce;
  }
  
  private void checkForPrompt() {
    if (this.document.getLength() > 0) {
      setVisible(false);
      return;
    } 
    if (this.showPromptOnce && this.focusLost > 0) {
      setVisible(false);
      return;
    } 
    if (this.component.hasFocus()) {
      if (this.show == Show.ALWAYS || this.show == Show.FOCUS_GAINED) {
        setVisible(true);
      } else {
        setVisible(false);
      } 
    } else if (this.show == Show.ALWAYS || this.show == Show.FOCUS_LOST) {
      setVisible(true);
    } else {
      setVisible(false);
    } 
  }
  
  public void focusGained(FocusEvent e) {
    checkForPrompt();
  }
  
  public void focusLost(FocusEvent e) {
    this.focusLost++;
    checkForPrompt();
  }
  
  public void insertUpdate(DocumentEvent e) {
    checkForPrompt();
  }
  
  public void removeUpdate(DocumentEvent e) {
    checkForPrompt();
  }
  
  public void changedUpdate(DocumentEvent e) {}
}

ITEM 283: com/gigatronik/ebike/custom/WordWrapCellRenderer.java
========================================================================================================================
package com.gigatronik.ebike.custom;

import com.gigatronik.ebike.common.configuration.ComplexResponse;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.gui.EBikeApplicationPanel;
import java.awt.Color;
import java.awt.Component;
import java.awt.Insets;
import java.util.Enumeration;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.Map;
import javax.swing.JScrollPane;
import javax.swing.JTable;
import javax.swing.JTextArea;
import javax.swing.border.EmptyBorder;
import javax.swing.table.TableCellRenderer;
import javax.swing.table.TableColumn;
import javax.swing.table.TableColumnModel;

public class WordWrapCellRenderer extends JTextArea implements TableCellRenderer {
  private static final long serialVersionUID = -3788536252477784006L;
  
  private static final int MIN_RIGHT_BORDER = 3;
  
  private static final int RIGHT_BORDER_OFFSET_NO_SCROLLBAR = 4;
  
  private final transient MultilineTextCalculator multilineTextCalculator;
  
  private final transient Map<JTable, Map<Object, Map<Object, Integer>>> cellSizes;
  
  public WordWrapCellRenderer() {
    this.cellSizes = new HashMap<>();
    this.multilineTextCalculator = new MultilineTextCalculator();
    setLineWrap(true);
    setWrapStyleWord(true);
    setFont(EBikeApplicationPanel.DEFAULT_FONT);
  }
  
  public Component getTableCellRendererComponent(JTable table, Object value, boolean isSelected, boolean hasFocus, int row, int column) {
    if (value instanceof ComplexResponse) {
      setText(((ComplexResponse)value).toString());
    } else {
      setText((String)value);
    } 
    int rightBorder = 3;
    if (column == table.getColumnCount() - 1 && table.getParent().getParent() instanceof JScrollPane) {
      JScrollPane parent = (JScrollPane)table.getParent().getParent();
      if (!parent.getVerticalScrollBar().isShowing())
        rightBorder = Integer.max(3, (parent.getVerticalScrollBar().getBounds()).width - 4); 
    } 
    setBorder(new EmptyBorder(3, 3, 3, rightBorder));
    setTableSize(table, column, row);
    setForegroundColor(value);
    if (!isSelected)
      setBackground((row % 2 == 0) ? Color.WHITE : Color.LIGHT_GRAY); 
    return this;
  }
  
  private int calculateHeightAndSetRows(JTable table, int column) {
    TableColumnModel columnModel = table.getColumnModel();
    Insets insets = getInsets();
    int width = columnModel.getColumn(column).getWidth() - insets.left - insets.right;
    String text = getText();
    int height = 0;
    if (text != null && !text.isEmpty()) {
      this.multilineTextCalculator.doCalculation(text, getFontMetrics(getFont()), (float)width);
      setRows(this.multilineTextCalculator.getLineCount());
      height = this.multilineTextCalculator.getHeight() + insets.bottom + insets.top;
    } 
    return height;
  }
  
  private void setTableSize(JTable table, int column, int row) {
    int preferredHeight = calculateHeightAndSetRows(table, column);
    addSize(table, row, column, preferredHeight);
    preferredHeight = findTotalMaximumRowSize(table, row);
    if (preferredHeight != table.getRowHeight(row))
      table.setRowHeight(row, preferredHeight); 
  }
  
  private void addSize(JTable table, int row, int column, int height) {
    Map<Object, Map<Object, Integer>> rowsMap = this.cellSizes.get(table);
    if (rowsMap == null) {
      rowsMap = new HashMap<>();
      this.cellSizes.put(table, rowsMap);
    } 
    Map<Object, Integer> rowHeightsMap = rowsMap.get(Integer.valueOf(row));
    if (rowHeightsMap == null) {
      rowHeightsMap = new HashMap<>();
      rowsMap.put(Integer.valueOf(row), rowHeightsMap);
    } 
    rowHeightsMap.put(Integer.valueOf(column), Integer.valueOf(height));
  }
  
  private int findTotalMaximumRowSize(JTable table, int row) {
    int maxHeight = 0;
    Enumeration<TableColumn> columns = table.getColumnModel().getColumns();
    while (columns.hasMoreElements()) {
      TableColumn tc = columns.nextElement();
      TableCellRenderer cellRenderer = tc.getCellRenderer();
      if (cellRenderer instanceof WordWrapCellRenderer) {
        WordWrapCellRenderer wwCellRenderer = (WordWrapCellRenderer)cellRenderer;
        int preferredSize = wwCellRenderer.findPreferredRowSize(table, row);
        maxHeight = Math.max(maxHeight, preferredSize);
      } 
    } 
    return maxHeight;
  }
  
  private int findPreferredRowSize(JTable table, int row) {
    Map<Object, Map<Object, Integer>> rows = this.cellSizes.get(table);
    if (rows == null)
      return 0; 
    Map<Object, Integer> rowHeights = rows.get(Integer.valueOf(row));
    if (rowHeights == null)
      return 0; 
    int preferredHeight = table.getRowHeight();
    for (Map.Entry<Object, Integer> entry : rowHeights.entrySet()) {
      int cellHeight = entry.getValue();
      if (cellHeight > preferredHeight)
        preferredHeight = cellHeight; 
    } 
    return preferredHeight;
  }
  
  private void setForegroundColor(Object value) {
    if (value instanceof ComplexResponse)
      if (((ComplexResponse)value).isPositive()) {
        setForeground(Color.BLACK);
      } else {
        setForeground(Color.RED);
      }  
  }
}

ITEM 284: com/gigatronik/ebike/custom/WrapLayout.java
========================================================================================================================
package com.gigatronik.ebike.custom;

import java.awt.Component;
import java.awt.Container;
import java.awt.Dimension;
import java.awt.FlowLayout;
import java.awt.Insets;
import javax.swing.JScrollPane;
import javax.swing.SwingUtilities;

public class WrapLayout extends FlowLayout {
  private static final long serialVersionUID = 1L;
  
  public WrapLayout() {}
  
  public WrapLayout(int align) {
    super(align);
  }
  
  public WrapLayout(int align, int hgap, int vgap) {
    super(align, hgap, vgap);
  }
  
  public Dimension preferredLayoutSize(Container target) {
    return layoutSize(target, true);
  }
  
  public Dimension minimumLayoutSize(Container target) {
    Dimension minimum = layoutSize(target, false);
    minimum.width -= getHgap() + 1;
    return minimum;
  }
  
  private Dimension layoutSize(Container target, boolean preferred) {
    synchronized (target.getTreeLock()) {
      int targetWidth = (target.getSize()).width;
      if (targetWidth == 0)
        targetWidth = Integer.MAX_VALUE; 
      int hgap = getHgap();
      int vgap = getVgap();
      Insets insets = target.getInsets();
      int horizontalInsetsAndGap = insets.left + insets.right + hgap * 2;
      int maxWidth = targetWidth - horizontalInsetsAndGap;
      Dimension dim = new Dimension(0, 0);
      int rowWidth = 0;
      int rowHeight = 0;
      int nmembers = target.getComponentCount();
      for (int i = 0; i < nmembers; i++) {
        Component m = target.getComponent(i);
        if (m.isVisible()) {
          Dimension d = preferred ? m.getPreferredSize() : m.getMinimumSize();
          if (rowWidth + d.width > maxWidth) {
            addRow(dim, rowWidth, rowHeight);
            rowWidth = 0;
            rowHeight = 0;
          } 
          if (rowWidth != 0)
            rowWidth += hgap; 
          rowWidth += d.width;
          rowHeight = Math.max(rowHeight, d.height);
        } 
      } 
      addRow(dim, rowWidth, rowHeight);
      dim.width += horizontalInsetsAndGap;
      dim.height += insets.top + insets.bottom + vgap * 2;
      Container scrollPane = SwingUtilities.getAncestorOfClass(JScrollPane.class, target);
      if (scrollPane != null && target.isValid())
        dim.width -= hgap + 1; 
      return dim;
    } 
  }
  
  private void addRow(Dimension dim, int rowWidth, int rowHeight) {
    dim.width = Math.max(dim.width, rowWidth);
    if (dim.height > 0)
      dim.height += getVgap(); 
    dim.height += rowHeight;
  }
}
