public class FlashProcess {
  private static final Utf8ResourceBundleFormatted BUNDLE = ResourceBundleFactory.newDefaultResourceBundle();
  
  private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(FlashProcess.class);
  
  private static final String FLASH_PROGRAMMING_ERROR_DIALOG_TITLE = BUNDLE.getString("EBikeFlashProgressBar.flashError.optionPane.title");
  
  private static final String FLASH_PROGRAMMING_ERROR_STATUS = BUNDLE.getString("EBikeStatus.FLASHING_FAILED");
  
  private static final int PROGRESS_SIM_START = 8;
  
  private final CommunicationManager communicationManager;
  
  private final EcuConnectionStateHandler ecuConnectionStateHandler;
  
  private final ConfigurationManager configurationManager;
  
  private final SecurityAccessFailurePopupHandler securityAccessFailurePopupHandler;
  
  private final BikeIdentification bikeIdentification;
  
  private final EBikeApplication ebikeApplication;
  
  private final UserLevel userLevel;
  
  private final BikeConfigurationData configurationData;
  
  private final BoschContainerController containerController;
  
  private final RightsManager rightsManager;
  
  private SystemFlashProcedure flashPlugin;
  
  private FlashProgressDialog flashProgressDialog;
  
  private final FlashResultLogger flashResultLogger = new FlashResultLogger();
  
  private boolean transferCffDirectly;
  
  public FlashProcess(EBikeApplication eBikeApplication, BikeConfigurationData configuration, RightsManager rightsManager) {
    this.ebikeApplication = eBikeApplication;
    this.configurationManager = eBikeApplication.getConfigurationManager();
    this.bikeIdentification = this.configurationManager.getBikeIdentification();
    this.containerController = this.configurationManager.getContainerConfiguration().getContainerController();
    this.communicationManager = eBikeApplication.getCommunicationManager();
    this.ecuConnectionStateHandler = eBikeApplication.getEcuConnectionStateHandler();
    this.securityAccessFailurePopupHandler = SecurityAccessFailurePopupHandlerFactory.createInstance(rightsManager);
    this.rightsManager = rightsManager;
    this.configurationData = configuration;
    this.userLevel = rightsManager.getUserLevel();
  }
  
  public void flashFirmware(boolean forceFlash, boolean transferDirectly, boolean isHmiResetCheckboxTickedOnGui, boolean autoCloseProgressDialog) {
    TaskQueue taskQueue = TaskQueueFactory.getInstance();
    if (!taskQueue.isTypeRunning(TaskType.FLASHING) && !taskQueue.isTypeQueued(TaskType.FLASHING))
      taskQueue.add(TaskType.FLASHING, () -> flashFirmwareDelegated(forceFlash, transferDirectly, isHmiResetCheckboxTickedOnGui, autoCloseProgressDialog)); 
  }
  
  private void flashFirmwareDelegated(boolean forceFlash, boolean transferDirectly, boolean isHmiResetCheckboxTickedOnGui, boolean autoCloseProgressDialog) {
    this.transferCffDirectly = transferDirectly;
    LOGGER.info("Flash process started ...");
    if (!checkPreconditions(isHmiResetCheckboxTickedOnGui)) {
      LOGGER.error("Flash preconditions not fulfilled. Flash process cancelled.");
      resetFlashApplicationState();
      return;
    } 
    boolean buiStandalone = this.bikeIdentification.isHmiStandalone();
    setUserDefinedCanTimeout();
    initializeFlashProcess(forceFlash);
    FlashResult flashResult = this.flashPlugin.flashFirmwareToEcus(isHmiResetCheckboxTickedOnGui);
    if (flashResult.isSuccessful()) {
      UserLevel currentUserLevel = this.rightsManager.getUserLevel();
      if (this.userLevel == currentUserLevel) {
        if (isWriteOemParameterConditionFulfilled()) {
          writeOemParametersDelegate(flashResult);
        } else {
          LOGGER.info("OEM Parameter conditions weren't fulfilled");
          this.flashProgressDialog.setProgressBarAppParamValue(100);
        } 
        if (isWriteConfigConditionFulfilled())
          flashResult.setConfigParamsWritten(writeConfigParameters()); 
      } else {
        LOGGER.error("User level changed from {} to {} during firmware update. Writing of configuration parameters is not possible!", this.userLevel, currentUserLevel);
        if (!isBctOrBcsFlashSession()) {
          flashResult.setOemParamsWritten(false);
          flashResult.setConfigParamsWritten(false);
        } 
      } 
    } 
    onFlashProcessFinished(flashResult, autoCloseProgressDialog, buiStandalone);
    boolean successful = flashResult.isSuccessful();
    LOGGER.info("Flash process finished with result successful={}", Boolean.valueOf(successful));
  }
  
  private void writeOemParametersDelegate(FlashResult flashResult) {
    flashResult.setOemParamsWritten(writeOemParameters());
    if (flashResult.isWriteOemParametersFailed()) {
      LOGGER.info("Error writing OEM parameters");
      this.flashProgressDialog.setProgressBarAppParamValue(0);
    } else {
      LOGGER.info("OEM parameters have been written successfully");
      this.flashProgressDialog.setProgressBarAppParamValue(100);
    } 
  }
  
  private void setUserDefinedCanTimeout() {
    int flashCanDeviceTimeout = SettingsProxy.getInstance().getGlobalSettingsNoException().getInteger("flashCanDeviceTimeout", 200);
    BoschServer.getInstance().setUserdefinedCanReadTimeout(flashCanDeviceTimeout);
  }
  
  private void resetUserDefinedCanTimeout() {
    BoschServer.getInstance().setUserdefinedCanReadTimeout(0);
  }
  
  private void onFlashProcessFinished(FlashResult flashResult, boolean autoCloseProgressDialog, boolean buiStandalone) {
    LOGGER.info("Flash process finished with result {}", flashResult);
    clearDriveUnitStatisticsOnApplicationIdChange();
    this.communicationManager.clearSystemErrorMemory();
    addFlashRunToManufactureLog(flashResult, buiStandalone);
    this.ebikeApplication.setRemoteFlashActive(false);
    checkFlashResult(flashResult);
    this.flashResultLogger.logFlashResult(flashResult);
    this.ebikeApplication.onFlashUpdateFinished(flashResult);
    if (this.bikeIdentification.isAbsConnected())
      this.communicationManager.getAbsCom().startDefaultSession(false); 
    waitForFlashDialogClosed(autoCloseProgressDialog);
    resetUserDefinedCanTimeout();
    resetHmiFactoryResetCheckbox();
    ContainerFileSelectionPanelController containerFileSelectionPanelController = this.ebikeApplication.getApplicationPanel().getMainTabbedController().getBikeConfigTab().getController().getContainerFileSelectionPanelController();
    if (this.transferCffDirectly && (flashResult.isSuccessful() || null == containerFileSelectionPanelController.saveReplyCffContainer(containerFileSelectionPanelController.getLoadedCffFile().getAbsolutePath())))
      this.configurationManager.clearContainer(); 
    this.ecuConnectionStateHandler.resumeConnectionStateDetection(true, this.bikeIdentification.isBcsConnected());
    this.ebikeApplication.startDetectingInactivity();
    resetFlashApplicationState();
    LOGGER.info("FlashProcess completely finished");
  }
  
  private void resetHmiFactoryResetCheckbox() {
    this.configurationManager.setBuiResetEnabled(false);
  }
  
  private void waitForFlashDialogClosed(boolean autoCloseProgressDialog) {
    if (autoCloseProgressDialog) {
      EventQueue.invokeLater(() -> this.flashProgressDialog.close());
    } else {
      try {
        EventQueue.invokeAndWait(() -> this.flashProgressDialog.setDoneButtonVisibleAndWait());
        LOGGER.debug("Flash progress dialog closed.");
      } catch (InvocationTargetException ex) {
        LOGGER.error("Failed to display done button on flash progress dialog", (Throwable)ex);
      } catch (InterruptedException in) {
        Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
        LOGGER.error("Error in thread. This thread was interrupted. Failed to display done button on flash progress dialog");
      } 
    } 
  }
  
  private void addFlashRunToManufactureLog(FlashResult flashResult, boolean buiStandalone) {
    if (!isBctOrBcsFlashSession()) {
      ManufacturingLog manufacturingLog = this.ebikeApplication.getManufacturingLog();
      if (manufacturingLog != null) {
        ManufacturingLog.FlashSubject flashSubject = buiStandalone ? ManufacturingLog.FlashSubject.STANDALONE : ManufacturingLog.FlashSubject.FULL;
        manufacturingLog.writeManufactureLog(this.ebikeApplication.isRemoteSessionActive(), (this.userLevel == UserLevel.OEM), flashSubject, flashResult.isSuccessful());
      } else {
        LOGGER.error("Manufacture log instance is 'null'");
      } 
    } 
  }
  
  private boolean checkPreconditions(boolean isHmiResetCheckboxTickedOnGui) {
    LOGGER.info("Checking flash preconditions ...");
    boolean isHmiResetAccepted = determineActualHmiFactoryResetState(isHmiResetCheckboxTickedOnGui);
    boolean isToolVersionSufficient = isToolVersionSufficient();
    return (isHmiResetAccepted && isToolVersionSufficient);
  }
  
  private boolean determineActualHmiFactoryResetState(boolean isHmiResetCheckboxTickedOnGui) {
    if (isHmiResetCheckboxTickedOnGui) {
      boolean isResetConfirmed = this.ebikeApplication.getApplicationPanel().getMainTabbedController().getBikeConfigTabController().getCff2DetailsPanelController().confirmBuiReset();
      if (!isResetConfirmed)
        resetHmiFactoryResetCheckbox(); 
      return isResetConfirmed;
    } 
    return true;
  }
  
  private boolean isNyonMapsUpToDate() {
    try {
      Hmi hmiCom = this.communicationManager.getHmiCom();
      Version requiredMapSwVersion = hmiCom.readSoftwareVersionMapRequired().getVersion();
      Version curMapVersion = hmiCom.readSoftwareVersionMapInstalled().getVersion();
      return (curMapVersion.compareTo(requiredMapSwVersion) >= 0);
    } catch (ComplexResponse.DataAccessException ex) {
      LOGGER.error("Received map version is empty or null (see previous communication log for details)", (Throwable)ex);
      return true;
    } 
  }
  
  private void resetFlashApplicationState() {
    ApplicationProcessManager.getInstance().setProcessState(ApplicationProcessManager.ApplicationProcess.FLASH_EBIKE, false);
    ApplicationProcessManager.getInstance().setProcessState(ApplicationProcessManager.ApplicationProcess.FLASH_EBIKE_DIRECT, false);
  }
  
  private void initializeFlashProcess(boolean forceFlash) {
    LOGGER.info("Initialize flash process ...");
    this.ebikeApplication.setRemoteFlashActive(true);
    this.ecuConnectionStateHandler.suspendConnectionStateDetection(true);
    this.ebikeApplication.stopDetectingInactivity();
    this.flashProgressDialog = new FlashProgressDialog(TestableJOptionPane.getDefaultParentFrame());
    this.flashPlugin = new SystemFlashProcedureImpl(this.communicationManager, this.bikeIdentification, this.containerController, this.userLevel, forceFlash, this.configurationManager.getContainerConfiguration());
    this.flashPlugin.addFlashProgressEventListener(this.flashProgressDialog);
    this.flashPlugin.addFlashProgressEventListener(this.ebikeApplication.getHeaderPanelController());
    showProgressDialog();
  }
  
  private void showProgressDialog() {
    FlashProgressDialog.FlashProgressbarMode progressbarMode;
    if (this.bikeIdentification.isBctConnected()) {
      progressbarMode = FlashProgressDialog.FlashProgressbarMode.BCT_FLASH;
    } else if (this.bikeIdentification.isBcsConnected()) {
      progressbarMode = FlashProgressDialog.FlashProgressbarMode.BCS_FLASH;
    } else {
      progressbarMode = FlashProgressDialog.FlashProgressbarMode.BIKE_FLASH;
    } 
    LOGGER.debug("Show flash progress dialog");
    this.flashProgressDialog.showProgressBar(progressbarMode, this.bikeIdentification);
  }
  
  private void showErrorDialog(String text, String title) {
    EventQueue.invokeLater(() -> TestableJOptionPane.showMessageDialog(text, title, 0));
  }
  
  private boolean isToolVersionSufficient() {
    String runningToolVerStr = ConfigUtil.getDisplayVersion();
    String requiredToolVerStr = this.containerController.getBoschContainerCommonInterface().getRequiredVciVersion();
    if (runningToolVerStr != null && requiredToolVerStr != null)
      try {
        Version runningToolVer = Version.parse(runningToolVerStr);
        Version requiredToolVer = Version.parse(requiredToolVerStr);
        if (runningToolVer.compareTo(requiredToolVer) >= 0)
          return true; 
        displayPcToolVersionsTooLowPopUp(runningToolVerStr, requiredToolVerStr);
      } catch (IOException|NumberFormatException ex) {
        LOGGER.error("Parsing the tool version either the actual '{}' or the one from the container '{}' failed.", runningToolVerStr, requiredToolVerStr, ex);
      }  
    return false;
  }
  
  private void displayPcToolVersionsTooLowPopUp(String runningToolVerStr, String requiredToolVerStr) {
    try {
      AppVersionCheckDialog dialog = new AppVersionCheckDialog(TestableJOptionPane.getDefaultParentFrame());
      AppVersionCheckDialogController controller = new AppVersionCheckDialogController(dialog);
      dialog.setController(controller);
      EventQueue.invokeAndWait(() -> {
            controller.setCurrentVersion(runningToolVerStr);
            controller.setRequiredVersion(requiredToolVerStr);
            dialog.setModal(true);
            dialog.setVisible(true);
          });
    } catch (InvocationTargetException ex) {
      LOGGER.error("Showing 'displayPcToolVersionsTooLowPopUp' failed", (Throwable)ex);
    } catch (InterruptedException in) {
      Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
      LOGGER.error("Error in thread. This thread was interrupted. Showing 'displayPcToolVersionsTooLowPopUp' failed");
    } 
  }
  
  private int getNumberOfOemParameters() {
    int numberOfOemParameters = 0;
    for (List<OemParamDto> list : (Iterable<List<OemParamDto>>)this.flashPlugin.getOemParameterFromLoadedContainer().values())
      numberOfOemParameters += list.size(); 
    return (numberOfOemParameters != 0) ? numberOfOemParameters : 1;
  }
  
  private boolean writeOemParameters() {
    LOGGER.info("Write OEM parameters to bike ...");
    int minimumProgressStep = (100 - this.flashProgressDialog.getProgressBarAppParamValue()) / getNumberOfOemParameters();
    try {
      int progress = this.flashProgressDialog.getProgressBarAppParamValue();
      this.flashProgressDialog.setProgressBarAppParamValue(progress);
      ComponentType componentType = this.bikeIdentification.getHmiIdentification().getComponentType();
      List<String> response = this.flashPlugin.writeOemParameters("BUI", componentType);
      if (response.contains("NEGATIVE"))
        return false; 
      progress += minimumProgressStep * this.flashPlugin.getNumberOfOemParameters(componentType);
      this.flashProgressDialog.setProgressBarAppParamValue(progress);
      componentType = this.bikeIdentification.getDuIdentification().getComponentType();
      response = this.flashPlugin.writeOemParameters((this.bikeIdentification.getSystemType() == Constants.SystemType.CLASSIC_PLUS) ? "DU" : "BDU", componentType);
      if (response.contains("NEGATIVE"))
        return false; 
      progress += minimumProgressStep * this.flashPlugin.getNumberOfOemParameters(componentType);
      this.flashProgressDialog.setProgressBarAppParamValue(progress);
      componentType = this.bikeIdentification.getBms1Identification().getComponentType();
      response = this.flashPlugin.writeOemParameters((this.bikeIdentification.getSystemType() == Constants.SystemType.CLASSIC_PLUS) ? "BMS" : "BBP1", componentType);
      if (response.contains("NEGATIVE"))
        return false; 
      progress += minimumProgressStep * this.flashPlugin.getNumberOfOemParameters(componentType);
      this.flashProgressDialog.setProgressBarAppParamValue(progress);
      componentType = this.bikeIdentification.getBms2Identification().getComponentType();
      response = this.flashPlugin.writeOemParameters("BBP2", componentType);
      if (response.contains("NEGATIVE"))
        return false; 
      progress += minimumProgressStep * this.flashPlugin.getNumberOfOemParameters(componentType);
      this.flashProgressDialog.setProgressBarAppParamValue(progress);
      componentType = this.bikeIdentification.getAbsIdentification().getComponentType();
      response = this.flashPlugin.writeOemParameters(componentType.getOdxEcuName(), componentType);
      if (response.contains("NEGATIVE"))
        return false; 
      progress += minimumProgressStep * this.flashPlugin.getNumberOfOemParameters(componentType);
      this.flashProgressDialog.setProgressBarAppParamValue(progress);
      componentType = this.bikeIdentification.getBctIdentification().getComponentType();
      response = this.flashPlugin.writeOemParameters(componentType.getOdxEcuName(), componentType);
      if (response.contains("NEGATIVE"))
        return false; 
      progress += minimumProgressStep * this.flashPlugin.getNumberOfOemParameters(componentType);
      this.flashProgressDialog.setProgressBarAppParamValue(progress);
      componentType = this.bikeIdentification.getBcsIdentification().getComponentType();
      response = this.flashPlugin.writeOemParameters(componentType.getOdxEcuName(), componentType);
      if (response.contains("NEGATIVE"))
        return false; 
      progress += minimumProgressStep * this.flashPlugin.getNumberOfOemParameters(componentType);
      this.flashProgressDialog.setProgressBarAppParamValue(progress);
    } catch (ConfigurationNotFoundException e) {
      LOGGER.error("FlashProcess -> writeOemParameters(): Error -> " + e.getMessage(), (Throwable)e);
      return false;
    } 
    this.flashProgressDialog.setProgressBarAppParamValue(100);
    return true;
  }
  
  private boolean writeConfigParameters() {
    LOGGER.info("Write configuration parameters to bike ...");
    this.flashProgressDialog.setProgressBarBikeConfigValue(8);
    if (this.configurationManager.writeConfigurationToBike(this.configurationData, this.userLevel, true)) {
      LOGGER.info("Config parameters have been written successfully");
      this.flashProgressDialog.setProgressBarBikeConfigValue(100);
      return true;
    } 
    LOGGER.error("Failed to write config parameters");
    this.flashProgressDialog.setProgressBarBikeConfigValue(0);
    return false;
  }
  
  private void checkFlashResult(FlashResult flashResult) {
    if (flashResult.isSuccessful()) {
      LOGGER.info("Flashing of ECUs successful");
      this.ebikeApplication.showStatusInfo(BUNDLE.getString("EBikeStatus.FLASHING_SUCCESSFUL"));
      checkOnSuccess();
    } else {
      LOGGER.error("Flashing ECUs failed");
      this.ebikeApplication.showStatusError(FLASH_PROGRAMMING_ERROR_STATUS);
      handleFlashError(flashResult);
    } 
  }
  
  private void checkOnSuccess() {
    if (this.userLevel == UserLevel.IBD && this.bikeIdentification.getHmiIdentification().getComponentType().isBUI27x() && isNotBcsFlashSession() && !isNyonMapsUpToDate())
      try {
        EventQueue.invokeAndWait(() -> TestableJOptionPane.showMessageDialog(BUNDLE.getString("FlashProcess.CheckNyonMaps.NotUpToDate.message"), BUNDLE.getString("FlashProcess.CheckNyonMaps.NotUpToDate.title"), 1));
      } catch (InterruptedException e) {
        LOGGER.error("The GUI thread has been interrupted during the Nyon Map version comparison");
        Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
      } catch (InvocationTargetException e) {
        LOGGER.error("Some error occurs during the Nyon map version comparison", (Throwable)e);
      }  
    if (!isBctOrBcsFlashSession())
      if (bmsFBLRestoreCondition()) {
        EventQueue.invokeLater(() -> TestableJOptionPane.showMessageDialog(BUNDLE.getString("FlashProcess.uncompleteFlashingNotification.bms.text"), BUNDLE.getString("FlashProcess.uncompleteFlashingNotification.title"), 2));
      } else if (incompleteFlashingNotificationCondition()) {
        EventQueue.invokeLater(() -> TestableJOptionPane.showMessageDialog(BUNDLE.getString("FlashProcess.uncompleteFlashingNotification.text"), BUNDLE.getString("FlashProcess.uncompleteFlashingNotification.title"), 2));
      }  
  }
  
  private boolean isNotBcsFlashSession() {
    return !this.bikeIdentification.isBcsConnected();
  }
  
  private void handleFlashError(FlashResult flashResult) {
    if (flashResult.getState() == FlashProcedure.FlashState.FLASH_ERROR)
      this.flashProgressDialog.setErrorState(flashResult.getFlashError()); 
    if (this.bikeIdentification.isBctConnected()) {
      showBctErrorDialog();
    } else {
      showFlashErrorDialog(flashResult);
    } 
  }
  
  private void showFlashErrorDialog(FlashResult flashResult) {
    String errorCode;
    boolean writeOemParamsFailed = flashResult.isWriteOemParametersFailed();
    boolean writeConfigParamsFailed = flashResult.isWriteConfigParametersFailed();
    if (writeOemParamsFailed || writeConfigParamsFailed) {
      LOGGER.error("Programming of OEM parameters (success = {}) or configuration (success = {}) was not successful", Boolean.valueOf(!writeOemParamsFailed), Boolean.valueOf(!writeConfigParamsFailed));
      String text = BUNDLE.getString((this.userLevel == UserLevel.OEM) ? "EBikeConfigurationTab.writeBikeConfigurationData.error.oem.message" : "EBikeConfigurationTab.writeBikeConfigurationData.error.ibd.message");
      showErrorDialog(text, BUNDLE.getString("EBikeConfigurationTab.writeBikeConfigurationData.error.optionPane.title"));
      return;
    } 
    FlashError flashError = flashResult.getFlashError();
    if (flashError == null) {
      showDefaultErrorDialog();
      return;
    } 
    ComponentType compType = flashError.getComponentType();
    String productName = compType.getProductName();
    boolean dualBattery = (flashResult.getFlashStatisticOf(BaseFlashProcedure.FlashProgressType.BMS2) != null);
    if (compType.isBms() && dualBattery)
      productName = getBmsProductname(productName, flashError); 
    switch (flashError.getErrorType()) {
      case NYON_TIMEOUT:
        LOGGER.warn("Timeout: HMI");
        showErrorDialog(BUNDLE.getString("EBikeConfigurationTab.FlashError.NyonTimeout.message"), BUNDLE.getString("EBikeConfigurationTab.FlashError.NyonTimeout.title"));
        break;
      case ERROR_PROGRAMMING:
        errorCode = getErrorCodeFromFlashStatistic(flashResult, flashError);
        LOGGER.error("Programming of component '{}' failed with error '{}'", productName, errorCode);
        showDefaultErrorDialog();
        break;
      case SECURITY_ACCESS_FAILED:
        LOGGER.error("Security access failed: '{}'", productName);
        this.securityAccessFailurePopupHandler.displaySecurityAccessFailedDialog(false, flashError.getComponentType());
        break;
      case PRE_CHECK_ERROR_DOWNGRADE:
        LOGGER.error("Downgrade: '{}'", productName);
        showErrorDialog(BUNDLE.getString("EBikeConfigurationTab.FlashError.downgrade.optionPane.message"), BUNDLE.getString("EBikeConfigurationTab.FlashError.downgrade.optionPane.title"));
        break;
      case PRE_CHECK_ERROR_CFF:
        LOGGER.error("Incompatible container");
        showErrorDialog(BUNDLE.getString("EBikeConfigurationTab.FlashError.incompatibleCFF.optionPane.message"), BUNDLE.getString("EBikeConfigurationTab.FlashError.incompatibleCFF.optionPane.title"));
        break;
      case PRE_CHECK_ERROR_PRODUCT_LINE:
        LOGGER.error("Product line wrong");
        showErrorDialog(BUNDLE.getString("EBikeConfigurationTab.FlashError.invalidProductLine.optionPane.message"), BUNDLE.getString("EBikeConfigurationTab.FlashError.invalidBikeVariant.optionPane.title"));
        break;
      case NYON_RESET_SCRIPT_MISSING:
        LOGGER.error("Nyon reset script is missing");
        showErrorDialog(BUNDLE.getString("EBikeFlashProgressBar.flashError.nyonReset.scriptMissing.message"), FLASH_PROGRAMMING_ERROR_DIALOG_TITLE);
        break;
      case ACCESS_DENIED_MASS_STORAGE_DEVICE:
        LOGGER.warn("Copying firmware failed, 'cause device denied access");
        if (this.bikeIdentification.getHmiIdentification().getComponentType().isBUI33x()) {
          showErrorDialog(BUNDLE.getString("EBikeFlashProgressBar.flashError.kiox.accessDenied.message"), BUNDLE.getString("Bosch.diagnostic.tool"));
        } else {
          showDefaultErrorDialog();
        } 
        break;
      case PRE_CHECK_PROGRAMMING_PRECONDITIONS:
        LOGGER.warn("Preconditions check failed.");
        if (compType.isBUI35x()) {
          showErrorDialog(BUNDLE.getString("FlashError.Bui350.insufficientMemory.message"), BUNDLE.getString("FlashError.Bui350.insufficientMemory.title"));
        } else {
          showDefaultErrorDialog();
        } 
        break;
      default:
        LOGGER.error("Unhandled flash error {} for component {}. Display default error dialog.", flashError.getErrorType(), productName);
        showDefaultErrorDialog();
        break;
    } 
  }
  
  private String getErrorCodeFromFlashStatistic(FlashResult flashResult, FlashError flashError) {
    String errorCode;
    FlashStatistic statistic = flashResult.getFlashStatisticOf(flashError.getProgressType());
    if (statistic != null) {
      errorCode = statistic.getFirstErrorCode();
    } else {
      errorCode = "";
    } 
    return errorCode;
  }
  
  private String getBmsProductname(String productName, FlashError flashError) {
    switch (flashError.getProgressType()) {
      case BMS1:
        productName = productName + " 1";
        break;
      case BMS2:
        productName = productName + " 2";
        break;
    } 
    return productName;
  }
  
  private void showBctErrorDialog() {
    String text = FLASH_PROGRAMMING_ERROR_STATUS + FLASH_PROGRAMMING_ERROR_STATUS + 
      System.lineSeparator() + 
      BUNDLE.getString("EBikeFlashProgressBar.flashError.bct.repeat") + 
      System.lineSeparator();
    showErrorDialog(text, FLASH_PROGRAMMING_ERROR_DIALOG_TITLE);
  }
  
  private void showDefaultErrorDialog() {
    showErrorDialog(getDefaultErrorText(), FLASH_PROGRAMMING_ERROR_DIALOG_TITLE);
  }
  
  private String getDefaultErrorText() {
    if (this.transferCffDirectly && !this.bikeIdentification.isBctConnected())
      return BUNDLE.getString("EBikeFlashProgressBar.flashError.genericTextWithSaveCFF.optionPane.message"); 
    String errorText = FLASH_PROGRAMMING_ERROR_STATUS + FLASH_PROGRAMMING_ERROR_STATUS + 
      System.lineSeparator();
    if (this.bikeIdentification.getHmiIdentification().getComponentType().isBUI35x())
      return errorText.concat(getBui35xSpecificErrorMessage()); 
    return errorText;
  }
  
  private String getBui35xSpecificErrorMessage() {
    return System.lineSeparator() + System.lineSeparator();
  }
  
  private boolean incompleteFlashingNotificationCondition() {
    if (this.userLevel == UserLevel.IBD)
      return false; 
    HmiIdentification buiConfig = this.bikeIdentification.getHmiIdentification();
    DuIdentification duConfig = this.bikeIdentification.getDuIdentification();
    BmsIdentification bmsIdentification1 = this.bikeIdentification.getBms1Identification();
    BmsIdentification bmsIdentification2 = this.bikeIdentification.getBms2Identification();
    EcuIdentification absConfig = this.bikeIdentification.getAbsIdentification();
    boolean buiStandalone = (buiConfig.isApplication() && !duConfig.isConnected() && !bmsIdentification1.isConnected() && !bmsIdentification2.isConnected());
    boolean fblRestore = (buiConfig.isBootLoader() || duConfig.isBootLoader() || absConfig.isBootLoader());
    return (buiStandalone || fblRestore);
  }
  
  private boolean bmsFBLRestoreCondition() {
    BmsIdentification bmsIdentification1 = this.bikeIdentification.getBms1Identification();
    BmsIdentification bmsIdentification2 = this.bikeIdentification.getBms2Identification();
    return (bmsIdentification1.isBootLoader() || bmsIdentification2.isBootLoader());
  }
  
  private boolean isWriteOemParameterConditionFulfilled() {
    return isBikeInApplicationModeConnected();
  }
  
  private boolean isWriteConfigConditionFulfilled() {
    return (isBikeInApplicationModeConnected() && !ApplicationProcessManager.getInstance().isProcessActive(ApplicationProcessManager.ApplicationProcess.FLASH_EBIKE_DIRECT));
  }
  
  private boolean isBikeInApplicationModeConnected() {
    if (this.bikeIdentification.isBcsConnected() || this.bikeIdentification.isBctConnected())
      return false; 
    boolean buiStandaloneInApp = (this.bikeIdentification.getHmiIdentification().isApplication() && !this.bikeIdentification.isBms1Connected() && !this.bikeIdentification.isBms2Connected());
    boolean isBui27x = this.bikeIdentification.getHmiIdentification().getComponentType().isBUI27x();
    boolean vDu = this.bikeIdentification.getDuIdentification().isApplication();
    boolean vBbp1 = (!this.bikeIdentification.isBms1Connected() || this.bikeIdentification.getBms1Identification().isApplication());
    boolean vBbp2 = (!this.bikeIdentification.isBms2Connected() || this.bikeIdentification.getBms2Identification().isApplication());
    boolean vAbs = (!this.bikeIdentification.isAbsConnected() || this.bikeIdentification.getAbsIdentification().isApplication());
    boolean eBikeInApp = (vDu && vBbp1 && vBbp2 && vAbs);
    return ((buiStandaloneInApp && !isBui27x) || eBikeInApp);
  }
  
  private boolean isBctOrBcsFlashSession() {
    return (this.bikeIdentification.isBcsConnected() || this.bikeIdentification.isBctConnected());
  }
  
  void clearDriveUnitStatisticsOnApplicationIdChange() {
    if (this.bikeIdentification.getDuIdentification().isConnected() && this.bikeIdentification.getSystemType() == Constants.SystemType.VICTOR) {
      LOGGER.debug("Check for application id change...");
      try {
        String newAppId = this.communicationManager.getDuCom().readApplicationId().getString();
        String oldAppId = this.configurationManager.getBikeIdentification().getApplicationId();
        if (!StringUtils.equals(oldAppId, newAppId)) {
          LOGGER.info("Application id changed after flashing. Resetting statistics of drive unit ...");
          this.communicationManager.getDuCom().resetStatistics();
        } 
      } catch (ComplexResponse.DataAccessException ex) {
        LOGGER.error("Reading application id from DU failed", (Throwable)ex);
      } 
    } 
  }
}

  }
  
  public FlashProgressDialog(JFrame parent) {
    super(parent);
    this.parentFrame = parent;
    this.pnlProgressBars = new TestableJPanel();

  private boolean isNewGenerationKiox(HmiIdentification hmiIdentification) {
    try {
      return (hmiIdentification.getSwVersionResponse().getVersion().compareTo(new Version(new Integer[] { 1, 2, 0, 0 })) >= 0);
    } catch (ComplexResponse.DataAccessException e) {
      LOGGER.warn("We cannot retrieve the Kiox version, fallback to first generation");
      return false;
    } 
  }
  
  private void showEbikeFlashProgressbar(BikeIdentification bikeIdentification) {
    boolean buiStandaloneInApp = (bikeIdentification.getHmiIdentification().isApplication() && !bikeIdentification.isBms1Connected() && !bikeIdentification.isBms2Connected());
    boolean isNyon = bikeIdentification.getHmiIdentification().getComponentType().isBUI27x();
    boolean isCobi = bikeIdentification.getHmiIdentification().getComponentType().isCUI1xx();
    boolean isNyon2 = bikeIdentification.getHmiIdentification().getComponentType().isBUI35x();
    boolean isKiox = bikeIdentification.getHmiIdentification().getComponentType().isBUI33x();
    boolean vDu = bikeIdentification.getDuIdentification().isApplication();
    boolean vBbp1 = bikeIdentification.isBms1Connected() ? bikeIdentification.getBms1Identification().isApplication() : true;
    boolean vBbp2 = bikeIdentification.isBms2Connected() ? bikeIdentification.getBms2Identification().isApplication() : true;
    boolean vAbs = bikeIdentification.isAbsConnected() ? bikeIdentification.getAbsIdentification().isApplication() : true;
    boolean eBikeInApp = (vDu && vBbp1 && vBbp2 && vAbs);
    boolean flashBikeDirect = ApplicationProcessManager.getInstance().isProcessActive(ApplicationProcessManager.ApplicationProcess.FLASH_EBIKE_DIRECT);
    boolean configVisible = (((buiStandaloneInApp && !isNyon && (!isKiox || isNewGenerationKiox(bikeIdentification.getHmiIdentification()))) || eBikeInApp) && !flashBikeDirect);
    boolean cobiFlashAllowed = isCobiFlashActivatedInSettings();
    this.pnlHmi.setVisible((!isCobi || cobiFlashAllowed));
    this.pnlHmi270.setVisible((isNyon || isNyon2));
    ComponentType bapa1 = bikeIdentification.isBms1Connected() ? bikeIdentification.getBms1Identification().getComponentType() : null;
    ComponentType bapa2 = bikeIdentification.isBms2Connected() ? bikeIdentification.getBms2Identification().getComponentType() : null;
    setBbpDisplayName(bapa1, bapa2);
    this.pnlBaPa1.setVisible(bikeIdentification.isBms1Connected());
    this.pnlBaPa2.setVisible(bikeIdentification.isBms2Connected());
    this.pnlAbs.setVisible((bikeIdentification.isAbsConnected() && vBbp1 && vBbp2));
    this.pnlDu.setVisible((bikeIdentification.isDuConnected() && vBbp1 && vBbp2 && vAbs));
    this.pnlAppParameter.setVisible(eBikeInApp);
    this.pnlConfigParameter.setVisible(configVisible);
  }

  public void showProgressBar(FlashProgressbarMode mode, BikeIdentification bikeIdentification) {
    initProgressBarValues();
    EventQueue.invokeLater(() -> {
          if (null != mode)
            switch (mode) {
              case BCT_FLASH:
                showBctFlashProgressbar();
                break;
              case BCS_FLASH:
                showBcsFlashProgressbar();
                break;
              case BIKE_FLASH:
                showEbikeFlashProgressbar(bikeIdentification);
                break;
              case MAP_FLASH:
                showMapFlashProgressbar();
                break;
              case CONFIG_FLASH:
                showConfigFlashProgressbar();
                break;
              default:
                showEbikeFlashProgressbar(bikeIdentification);
                break;
            }  
          getContentPane().setCursor(Cursor.getPredefinedCursor(3));
          this.parentFrame.getContentPane().setCursor(Cursor.getPredefinedCursor(3));
          pack();
          setLocationRelativeTo(this.parentFrame);
          setVisible(true);
        });
  }
  
  private void initProgressBarValues() {
    setName("dlgFlashProgress");
    setProgressBarHMIValue(0);
    setProgressBarDUValue(0);
    setProgressBarBaPaValue(0);
    setProgressBarBaPa2Value(0);
    setProgressBarAbsValue(0);
    setProgressBarAppParamValue(0);
    setProgressBarBikeConfigValue(0);
  }

  public void setErrorState(FlashError flashError) {
    if (flashError == null) {
      LOGGER.error("Failed to set error state. Flash error is null");
      return;
    } 
    switch (flashError.getProgressType()) {
      case HMI:
        if (flashError.getErrorType() == FlashErrorType.NYON_TIMEOUT) {
          setProgressBarHMIValue(100);
        } else {
          setProgressBarHMIValue(0);
        } 
        break;
      case DU:
        setProgressBarDUValue(0);
        break;
      case BMS1:
        setProgressBarBaPaValue(0);
        break;
      case BMS2:
        setProgressBarBaPa2Value(0);
        break;
      case BCT:
        setProgressBarBctValue(0);
        break;
      case BCS:
        setProgressBarBcsValue(0);
        break;
      case ABS:
        setProgressBarAbsValue(0);
        break;
      case PARAM:
        setProgressBarAppParamValue(0);
        break;
      default:
        LOGGER.error("Got unknown component");
        break;
    } 
  }
  
  public void onFlashProgress(FlashProgressEvent event) {
    LOGGER.debug("Received FlashProgressEvent {} {}", event.getComponentType(), Integer.valueOf(event.getProgress()));
    BaseFlashProcedure.FlashProgressType type = event.getProgressType();
    switch (type) {
      case HMI:
        EventQueue.invokeLater(() -> updateHmiProgress(event));
        break;
      case HMI_STEP:
        EventQueue.invokeLater(() -> updateHmiStepProgress(event));
        break;
      case BCT:
        EventQueue.invokeLater(() -> updateHmiProgress(event));
        break;
      case BCS:
        EventQueue.invokeLater(() -> updateBcsProgress(event));
        break;
      case DU:
        EventQueue.invokeLater(() -> updateDuProgress(event));
        break;
      case ABS:
        EventQueue.invokeLater(() -> updateAbsProgress(event));
        break;
      case BMS1:
        EventQueue.invokeLater(() -> updatePp1Progress(event));
        break;
      case BMS2:
        EventQueue.invokeLater(() -> updatePp2Progress(event));
        break;
      case PARAM:
        EventQueue.invokeLater(() -> updateParamProgress(event));
        break;
      default:
        LOGGER.error("Received unknown flash progress type: {}", type);
        break;
    } 
  }
  
  private void updateHmiProgress(FlashProgressEvent event) {
    int progress = event.getProgress();
    if (progress >= 0 && progress < 100) {
      setProgressBarHMIValue(progress);
    } else if (progress == 100) {
      setProgressBarHMIValue(100);
      setProgressBarHMI270Value(100);
      LOGGER.debug("Flash process: BUI flashing successful");
    } 
  }
  
  private void updateHmiStepProgress(FlashProgressEvent event) {
    setProgressBarInfo(event.getInfo());
    setProgressBarHMI270Value(event.getProgress());
  }
  
  private void updateAbsProgress(FlashProgressEvent event) {
    int progress = event.getProgress();
    if (progress >= 0 && progress < 100) {
      setProgressBarAbsValue(progress);
    } else if (progress == 100) {
      setProgressBarAbsValue(100);
      LOGGER.info("Flash process: ABS flashing successful");
    } 
  }
  
  private void updateDuProgress(FlashProgressEvent event) {
    int progress = event.getProgress();
    if (progress >= 0 && progress < 100) {
      setProgressBarDUValue(progress);
    } else if (progress == 100) {
      setProgressBarDUValue(100);
      LOGGER.info("Flash process: DU flashing successful");
    } 
  }
  
  private void updatePp1Progress(FlashProgressEvent event) {
    int progress = event.getProgress();
    if (progress >= 0 && progress < 100) {
      setProgressBarBaPaValue(progress);
    } else if (progress == 100) {
      setProgressBarBaPaValue(100);
      LOGGER.info("Flash process: BMS flashing successful");
    } 
  }
  
  private void updatePp2Progress(FlashProgressEvent event) {
    int progress = event.getProgress();
    if (progress >= 0 && progress < 100) {
      setProgressBarBaPa2Value(progress);
    } else if (progress == 100) {
      setProgressBarBaPa2Value(100);
      LOGGER.info("Flash process: BBP2 flashing successful");
    } 
  }
  
  private void updateBcsProgress(FlashProgressEvent event) {
    int progress = event.getProgress();
    if (progress >= 0 && progress < 100) {
      setProgressBarBcsValue(progress);
    } else if (progress == 100) {
      setProgressBarBcsValue(100);
      LOGGER.info("Flash process: BCS flashing successful");
    } 
  }
  
  private void updateParamProgress(FlashProgressEvent event) {
    int progress = event.getProgress();
    if (progress >= 0 && progress < 100) {
      setProgressBarAppParamValue(progress);
    } else if (progress == 100) {
      setProgressBarAppParamValue(100);
      LOGGER.info("Flash process: Applicaton parameter writing successful");
    } else if (progress < 0) {
      setProgressBarAppParamValue(0);
    } 
  }
}

package com.gigatronik.ebike.gui;

import com.gigatronik.beds.gui.panels.diagnostictab.subtab.BmsSubTab;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.communication.api.CommunicationManager;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.rightsmanager.api.UserLevel;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.bosch.service.internationalization.ResourceBundleFactory;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.bosch.service.internationalization.Utf8ResourceBundleFormatted;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.common.configuration.ComplexResponse;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.gui.testinterface.TestableJOptionPane;
import java.awt.Color;
import java.awt.event.ActionEvent;
import javax.swing.JButton;
import javax.swing.JCheckBox;
import javax.swing.JComponent;
import javax.swing.JOptionPane;
import org.apache.commons.lang3.StringUtils;
import org.slf4j.Logger;
import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;

class BatteryDisabler {
  private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(BatteryDisabler.class);
  
  private static final Utf8ResourceBundleFormatted BUNDLE = ResourceBundleFactory.newDefaultResourceBundle();
  
  public static final String DIALOG_TEXT_SUCCESS = "EBikeServiceTab.imgbtnDisableBattery.feedbackDialogTitle";
  
  public static final String DIALOG_TEXT_FAILURE = "EBikeServiceTab.imgbtnDisableBattery.NegativeResponse.text";
  
  public static final String DIALOG_TITLE = "EBikeServiceTab.DisableBattery";
  
  private final CommunicationManager communicationManager;
  
  private final BmsSubTab bmsSubTab;
  
  private final BatterySelectionChecker batterySelectionChecker;
  
  BatteryDisabler(CommunicationManager communicationManager, BmsSubTab bmsSubTab, BatterySelectionChecker batterySelectionChecker) {
    this.communicationManager = communicationManager;
    this.bmsSubTab = bmsSubTab;
    this.batterySelectionChecker = batterySelectionChecker;
  }
  
  void onButtonPressed(boolean isBctSession, UserLevel currentUserLevel) {
    LOGGER.info("Disable battery button clicked");
    int dialogResponse = createAndDisplayWarningDialog();
    if (dialogResponse == 0)
      onUserAgreedWarningDialog(isBctSession, currentUserLevel); 
  }
  
  private void onUserAgreedWarningDialog(boolean isBctSession, UserLevel currentUserLevel) {
    LOGGER.info("User agreed warning dialog");
    boolean success = disableBattery(isBctSession, currentUserLevel);
    displayOperationTerminationFeedbackPopUp(success);
    updateBmsDiagnosticTabTable();
  }
  
  private boolean disableBattery(boolean isBctSession, UserLevel currentUserLevel) {
    if (isBctSession)
      return disableBatteryBctSession(currentUserLevel); 
    return disableBatteryAction();
  }
  
  private boolean disableBatteryBctSession(UserLevel currentUserLevel) {
    boolean success;
    if (this.batterySelectionChecker.ensureBatteryIsSelected()) {
      this.communicationManager.getBms1Com().executeExtendedSessionAndSecurityAccess(currentUserLevel);
      success = disableBatteryAction();
      this.communicationManager.getBms1Com().startDefaultSession(false);
    } else {
      success = false;
    } 
    return success;
  }
  
  private boolean disableBatteryAction() {
    ComplexResponse deactivationResponse = this.communicationManager.getBms1Com().deactivateBattery();
    ComplexResponse verificationResponse = this.communicationManager.getBms1Com().readBatteryDeactivationState();
    boolean deactivated = StringUtils.equals(verificationResponse.toString(), "TRUE");
    return (deactivationResponse.isPositive() && deactivated);
  }
  
  void displayOperationTerminationFeedbackPopUp(boolean success) {
    if (success) {
      LOGGER.info("Show 'disabling battery was successful' popup");
      TestableJOptionPane.showMessageDialog(BUNDLE.getString("EBikeServiceTab.imgbtnDisableBattery.feedbackDialogTitle"), BUNDLE.getString("EBikeServiceTab.DisableBattery"), 1);
    } else {
      LOGGER.warn("Show 'disabling battery failed' popup");
      TestableJOptionPane.showMessageDialog(BUNDLE.getString("EBikeServiceTab.imgbtnDisableBattery.NegativeResponse.text"), BUNDLE.getString("EBikeServiceTab.DisableBattery"), 0);
    } 
  }
  
  private void updateBmsDiagnosticTabTable() {
    LOGGER.debug("Refresh BMS subtab table");
    this.bmsSubTab.fillTable(true);
  }
  
  private int createAndDisplayWarningDialog() {
    JButton okayButton = new JButton(BUNDLE.getString("Button.Text.Deactivate"));
    okayButton.setEnabled(false);
    okayButton.addActionListener(this::onButtonActionEvent);
    JButton cancelButton = new JButton(BUNDLE.getString("EBikeReportDialog.cancelButton.text"));
    cancelButton.setEnabled(true);
    cancelButton.addActionListener(this::onButtonActionEvent);
    cancelButton.requestFocusInWindow();
    JCheckBox confirmBox = new JCheckBox(BUNDLE.getString("EBikeServiceTab.imgbtnDisableBattery.warningDialogCheckBoxText"));
    confirmBox.setForeground(Color.red);
    confirmBox.setSelected(false);
    confirmBox.setOpaque(false);
    confirmBox.addActionListener(e -> okayButton.setEnabled(confirmBox.isSelected()));
    Object[] params = { BUNDLE.getString("EBikeServiceTab.imgbtnDisableBattery.warningDialogText"), confirmBox };
    Object[] options = { okayButton, cancelButton };
    return showDialog(params, options);
  }
  
  private void onButtonActionEvent(ActionEvent e) {
    JButton button = (JButton)e.getSource();
    JOptionPane pane = getOptionPane(button);
    pane.setValue(button);
  }
  
  private JOptionPane getOptionPane(JComponent parent) {
    return !(parent instanceof JOptionPane) ? getOptionPane((JComponent)parent.getParent()) : (JOptionPane)parent;
  }
  
  int showDialog(Object[] params, Object[] options) {
    return TestableJOptionPane.showOptionDialog(params, BUNDLE.getString("EBikeServiceTab.DisableBattery"), 2, 2, null, options, options[1]);
  }
}

package com.gigatronik.ebike.gui;

import com.gigatronik.beds.common.bct.BctState;
import com.gigatronik.beds.common.order.OrderableListener;
import com.gigatronik.beds.gui.panels.bct.choosebatterytype.ChooseBatteryTypeController;
import com.gigatronik.beds.gui.panels.diagnostictab.bct.ChooseBatteryTypeDialog;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.communication.api.CommunicationManager;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.configuration.ConfigurationManager;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.configuration.api.HardwareConnectionChangesListener;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.configuration.event.HardwareConnectionChangedEvent;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.ecuconnectionstate.api.BctEventHandler;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.ecuconnectionstate.api.EcuConnectionStateHandler;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.ecuconnectionstate.impl.event.BctOperationStateChangeEvent;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.ecuconnectionstate.impl.synchronization.ActionSynchronizer;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.common.configuration.Constants;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.gui.testinterface.TestableJOptionPane;
import java.awt.EventQueue;
import javax.swing.JDialog;
import org.slf4j.Logger;
import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;

public class BatterySelectionChecker implements HardwareConnectionChangesListener, BctEventHandler.BctOperationStateListener {
  private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(BatterySelectionChecker.class);
  
  public static final int TIMEOUT = 5000;
  
  private final EcuConnectionStateHandler ecuConnectionStateHandler;
  
  private final CommunicationManager communicationManager;
  
  private final ChooseBatteryTypeController chooseBatTypeController;
  
  private final ActionSynchronizer synchronizer;
  
  private JDialog bctBatterySelectionDialog;
  
  public BatterySelectionChecker(EcuConnectionStateHandler ecuConnectionStateHandler, CommunicationManager communicationManager, ChooseBatteryTypeController chooseBatTypeController, BctEventHandler bctEventHandler, ConfigurationManager configurationManager, ActionSynchronizer synchronizer) {
    this.ecuConnectionStateHandler = ecuConnectionStateHandler;
    this.communicationManager = communicationManager;
    this.chooseBatTypeController = chooseBatTypeController;
    this.synchronizer = synchronizer;
    bctEventHandler.subscribeBctOperationStateChanges(this);
    configurationManager.addListener((OrderableListener)this);
  }
  
  public boolean ensureBatteryIsSelected() {
    boolean isBatterySelected = isBctBatteryTypeSet();
    if (!isBatterySelected) {
      this.synchronizer.clear();
      ensureEcuConnectionStatePollingIsOn();
      openDialog();
      isBatterySelected = isBctBatteryTypeSet();
      if (isBatterySelected)
        waitForConcurrentTasks(); 
      return isBatterySelected;
    } 
    return true;
  }
  
  public boolean isBctBatteryTypeSet() {
    boolean bctBatteryTypeSet = false;
    BctState state = this.communicationManager.getBctCom().readOperatingState();
    switch (state) {
      case IDLE_BATTERY_SET:
      case TEST_RUNNING:
      case TEST_FINISHED:
      case TEST_ERROR:
      case DISCHARGE_RUNNING:
      case DISCHARGE_FINISHED:
      case DISCHARGE_ERROR:
        bctBatteryTypeSet = true;
        break;
    } 
    return bctBatteryTypeSet;
  }
  
  private void ensureEcuConnectionStatePollingIsOn() {
    if (this.ecuConnectionStateHandler.isConnectionStateDetectionSuspended())
      this.ecuConnectionStateHandler.resumeConnectionStateDetection(false, false); 
  }
  
  private void waitForConcurrentTasks() {
    LOGGER.debug("Wait for concurrent jobs to terminate ...");
    try {
      boolean completed = this.synchronizer.waitCompletion(5000L);
      LOGGER.debug("... stop waiting. Start reading diagnostic tab data. Timeout = '{}'", Boolean.valueOf(!completed));
    } catch (InterruptedException e) {
      LOGGER.error("Waiting got interrupted!", (Throwable)e);
      Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
    } 
  }
  
  public void onHardwareConnectionChanged(HardwareConnectionChangedEvent event) {
    LOGGER.debug("HardwareConnectionChangedEvent received: '{}'", event);
    if (event.getAction() == HardwareConnectionChangedEvent.HardwareConnectionStateChange.ECU_DISCONNECTED && (
      event.getComponent() == Constants.EcuType.VICTOR_PP1 || event.getComponent() == Constants.EcuType.CLASSIC_PP))
      EventQueue.invokeLater(this::closeDialogIfOpen); 
  }
  
  public void onBctOperationStateChanged(BctOperationStateChangeEvent event) {
    LOGGER.debug("Received BctOperationStateChangeEvent: '{}'", event);
    if (event.getOperatingState() == BctState.IDLE || 
      event.getOperatingState() == BctState.CONNECTED_FBL || 
      event.getOperatingState() == BctState.NOT_CONNECTED)
      EventQueue.invokeLater(this::closeDialogIfOpen); 
  }
  
  void openDialog() {
    LOGGER.debug("Open battery selection dialog");
    this.bctBatterySelectionDialog = new ChooseBatteryTypeDialog(TestableJOptionPane.getDefaultParentFrame(), true, this.chooseBatTypeController);
    this.bctBatterySelectionDialog.setVisible(true);
    this.bctBatterySelectionDialog = null;
  }
  
  private void closeDialogIfOpen() {
    if (this.bctBatterySelectionDialog != null) {
      LOGGER.debug("Dispose battery selection dialog");
      this.bctBatterySelectionDialog.dispose();
      this.bctBatterySelectionDialog = null;
    } 
  }
}

package com.gigatronik.ebike.gui;

import com.gigatronik.beds.common.order.OrderableListener;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.configuration.ConfigurationManager;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.configuration.api.HardwareConnectionChangesListener;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.configuration.event.HardwareConnectionChangedEvent;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.rightsmanager.api.RightsManager;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.rightsmanager.api.UserLevel;
import com.gigatronik.bosch.utils.TimeProvider;
import com.gigatronik.bosch.utils.WinServicesUtil;
import com.gigatronik.bosch.utils.ui.CancelableProgressDialog;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.bosch.service.internationalization.ResourceBundleFactory;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.bosch.service.internationalization.Utf8ResourceBundleFormatted;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.framework.util.benchmark.Stopwatch;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.common.configuration.Constants;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.gui.testinterface.TestableJOptionPane;
import java.awt.EventQueue;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.lang.reflect.InvocationTargetException;
import org.slf4j.Logger;
import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;

public class BoschDevNodeCleanServiceManager implements HardwareConnectionChangesListener {
  private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(BoschDevNodeCleanServiceManager.class);
  
  private static final Utf8ResourceBundleFormatted BUNDLE = ResourceBundleFactory.newDefaultResourceBundle();
  
  private static final String SERVICE_BOSCH_DEV_NODE_CLEAN_NAME = "BoschDevNodeService";
  
  private static final String BUNDLE_KEYS_BOSCH_DIAGNOSTIC_TOOL = "Bosch.diagnostic.tool";
  
  private static final int SERVICE_BOSCH_DEV_NODE_CLEAN_TIMEOUT_MS = 600000;
  
  private final RightsManager rightsManager;
  
  private final TimeProvider timeProvider;
  
  private final WinServicesUtil serviceUtil;
  
  private long startTimeout = 600000L;
  
  public BoschDevNodeCleanServiceManager(WinServicesUtil servUtil, RightsManager rightsMan, TimeProvider provider, ConfigurationManager configurationManager) {
    this.serviceUtil = servUtil;
    this.rightsManager = rightsMan;
    this.timeProvider = provider;
    configurationManager.addListener((OrderableListener)this);
  }
  
  void setTimeout(long timeout) {
    this.startTimeout = timeout;
  }
  
  private boolean checkWinServiceState() {
    WinServicesUtil.ServiceState state = null;
    try {
      Stopwatch watch = new Stopwatch();
      watch.start();
      state = this.serviceUtil.checkService("BoschDevNodeService");
      watch.stop();
      LOGGER.info("Checking service state took {}ms and returned {}", Long.valueOf(watch.getMillisecondsElapsed()), state);
    } catch (IOException ex) {
      LOGGER.error("Failed to check service state", (Throwable)ex);
    } 
    if (null != state)
      switch (state) {
        case RUNNING:
          return true;
        case UNKNOWN_SERVICE:
          LOGGER.error("Service is not installed");
          showServiceNotInstalledError();
          break;
        case STOPPED:
          LOGGER.error("Service installed but not running.");
          return startService();
        case UNKNOWN_STATE:
          LOGGER.error("Failed to check service state. Unknown state");
          break;
        default:
          LOGGER.warn("Service not ready. Service has state {}", state);
          break;
      }  
    return false;
  }
  
  private boolean startService() {
    if (startWinServiceWithDialog())
      return true; 
    LOGGER.error("Service could not be started.");
    showServiceStartError();
    return false;
  }
  
  private boolean startWinServiceWithDialog() {
    CancelableProgressDialog dialog = displayStartingProgress();
    try {
      LOGGER.debug("Start Service...");
      long startTime = this.timeProvider.millis();
      WinServicesUtil.ServiceState state = this.serviceUtil.startService("BoschDevNodeService");
      LOGGER.debug("Service is starting, state={}, waiting...", state);
      while (state != WinServicesUtil.ServiceState.RUNNING && 
        !dialog.isCanceledByUser() && 
        !isTimedOut(startTime)) {
        Thread.sleep(300L);
        state = this.serviceUtil.checkService("BoschDevNodeService");
      } 
      if (state == WinServicesUtil.ServiceState.RUNNING) {
        LOGGER.debug("Service started successfully");
        return true;
      } 
      if (dialog.isCanceledByUser()) {
        LOGGER.debug("Service start not completed: canceled by user");
      } else if (isTimedOut(startTime)) {
        LOGGER.debug("Service start not completed: timeout");
      } else {
        LOGGER.debug("Service start not completed, state={}", state);
      } 
    } catch (IOException ex) {
      LOGGER.error("Failed to start Service", (Throwable)ex);
    } catch (InterruptedException ex) {
      LOGGER.error("Sleep interrupted on waiting for service start", (Throwable)ex);
      Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
    } finally {
      dialog.dispose();
    } 
    return false;
  }
  
  private void showServiceNotInstalledError() {
    try {
      EventQueue.invokeAndWait(() -> 
          TestableJOptionPane.showMessageDialog(BUNDLE.getString(this.rightsManager.isUserInLevel(UserLevel.OEM) ? "BoschDevNodeCleanService.not.installed.OEM" : "BoschDevNodeCleanService.not.installed.IBD"), 
            BUNDLE.getString("Bosch.diagnostic.tool"), 0));
    } catch (InvocationTargetException ex) {
      LOGGER.error("Failed to show service not installed error", (Throwable)ex);
    } catch (InterruptedException in) {
      LOGGER.error("Error in thread. This thread was interrupted. Failed to show service not installed error");
      Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
    } 
  }
  
  private void showServiceStartError() {
    try {
      EventQueue.invokeAndWait(() -> 
          TestableJOptionPane.showMessageDialog(BUNDLE.getString(this.rightsManager.isUserInLevel(UserLevel.OEM) ? "BoschDevNodeCleanService.not.started.OEM" : "BoschDevNodeCleanService.not.started.IBD"), 
            BUNDLE.getString("Bosch.diagnostic.tool"), 0));
    } catch (InvocationTargetException ex) {
      LOGGER.error("Failed to show service not started error", (Throwable)ex);
    } catch (InterruptedException in) {
      LOGGER.error("Error in thread. This thread was interrupted. Failed to show service not started error");
      Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
    } 
  }
  
  private boolean isTimedOut(long startTime) {
    return (this.timeProvider.millis() - startTime > this.startTimeout);
  }
  
  private CancelableProgressDialog displayStartingProgress() {
    CancelableProgressDialog dialog = new CancelableProgressDialog(TestableJOptionPane.getDefaultParentFrame(), BUNDLE.getString("Bosch.diagnostic.tool"), BUNDLE.getString("BoschDevNodeCleanService.starting.dialog"));
    dialog.display();
    return dialog;
  }
  
  public void onHardwareConnectionChanged(HardwareConnectionChangedEvent event) {
    LOGGER.debug("HardwareConnectionChangedEvent received: '{}'", event);
    boolean ecuConnected = (event.getAction() == HardwareConnectionChangedEvent.HardwareConnectionStateChange.ECU_CONNECTED);
    if (ecuConnected && (event.getComponent() == Constants.EcuType.BUI330 || event.getComponent() == Constants.EcuType.BUI350)) {
      LOGGER.info("Checking Bosch Device Node Cleaner Service ...");
      checkWinServiceState();
    } 
  }
  
  public String getOrderingName() {
    return "BoschDeviceNodeCleanServiceManager";
  }
}

package com.gigatronik.ebike.gui;

import com.gigatronik.dart2.bosch.service.internationalization.ResourceBundleFactory;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.bosch.service.internationalization.Utf8ResourceBundleFormatted;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.framework.plugins.interfaces.RemoteClientDartPlugin;
import com.gigatronik.rdc.RemotePluginFacade;
import com.gigatronik.rdc.RemotePluginImpl;
import java.awt.event.ActionEvent;
import java.awt.event.ActionListener;
import javax.swing.JButton;
import org.slf4j.Logger;
import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;

public class BtnStartRemoteSession extends JButton implements RemoteClientDartPlugin.RemoteClientListener, RemotePluginImpl.ConnectRequestListener {
  private static final long serialVersionUID = 6258465736561267864L;
  
  private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(BtnStartRemoteSession.class);
  
  private static final Utf8ResourceBundleFormatted BUNDLE = ResourceBundleFactory.newDefaultResourceBundle();
  
  private boolean conState = false;
  
  private boolean sessionState = false;
  
  private boolean conRequestSent = false;
  
  private final transient EBikeSupportTab supportTab;
  
  public BtnStartRemoteSession(EBikeSupportTab tab) {
    this.supportTab = tab;
    setText(BUNDLE.getString("EBikeSupportTab.btnRemoteSessionStart.text"));
    setName("btnRemoteSessionStart");
    setEnabled(false);
    addActionListener(new ActionListener() {
          public void actionPerformed(ActionEvent e) {
            BtnStartRemoteSession.LOGGER.info("Clicked button btnRemoteSessionStart");
            try {
              if (!BtnStartRemoteSession.this.sessionState && !BtnStartRemoteSession.this.conRequestSent) {
                BtnStartRemoteSession.LOGGER.debug("Button btnRemoteSessionStart clicked to connect to other client...");
                BtnStartRemoteSession.this.supportTab.startRemoteSession();
              } else {
                BtnStartRemoteSession.LOGGER.debug("Button btnRemoteSessionStart clicked to disconnect from other client...");
                BtnStartRemoteSession.this.setEnabled(false);
                RemotePluginFacade.getInstance().disconnectFromClient();
                BtnStartRemoteSession.this.conRequestSent = false;
              } 
            } catch (Exception ex) {
              BtnStartRemoteSession.LOGGER.error("Error executing btnRemoteSessionStart", (Throwable)ex);
            } 
          }
        });
    RemotePluginFacade.getInstance().addConnectRequestListener(this);
  }
  
  public void onClientIDChanged(String id) {}
  
  public void onConnectionStateChanged(boolean established, String server) {
    LOGGER.debug("Connection state changed to {} peerId {}", Boolean.valueOf(established), server);
    this.conState = established;
    if (!established) {
      setEnabled(false);
      this.supportTab.getTxtRemoteClientId().setText("");
    } 
  }
  
  public void onSessionStateChanged(boolean established, String peerId) {
    LOGGER.debug("Session state changed to {} peerId {}", Boolean.valueOf(established), peerId);
    this.sessionState = established;
    setText(BUNDLE.getString("EBikeSupportTab.btnRemoteSessionStart.text"));
    setEnabled(!established);
    if (!established)
      this.conRequestSent = false; 
  }
  
  public void onConnectRequestSent() {
    this.conRequestSent = true;
    setText(BUNDLE.getString("EBikeSupportTab.btnRemoteSessionStart.Disconnect"));
  }
  
  public void setEnabled(boolean enabled) {
    if (enabled && isRemSessionPossible()) {
      super.setEnabled(true);
    } else {
      super.setEnabled(false);
    } 
  }
  
  private boolean isRemSessionPossible() {
    return (this.conState && !this.sessionState);
  }
}

package com.gigatronik.ebike.gui.component.custom;

import java.awt.event.MouseAdapter;
import java.awt.event.MouseEvent;
import java.util.concurrent.ScheduledExecutorService;
import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit;

public class DoubleClickMouseListener extends MouseAdapter {
  private static final int DOUBLE_CLICK = 2;
  
  private final ScheduledExecutorService executor;
  
  private final Runnable doubleClickAction;
  
  private final long doubleClickInterval;
  
  public DoubleClickMouseListener(ScheduledExecutorService executor, Runnable doubleClickAction, long doubleClickInterval) {
    this.executor = executor;
    this.doubleClickAction = doubleClickAction;
    this.doubleClickInterval = doubleClickInterval;
  }
  
  public void mouseClicked(MouseEvent me) {
    if (me.getButton() == 1 && me.getClickCount() == 2)
      this.executor.schedule(this.doubleClickAction, this.doubleClickInterval, TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS); 
  }
}

package com.gigatronik.ebike.gui.component.datepicker;

import com.gigatronik.beds.common.event.ApplicationEventQueue;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.bosch.service.internationalization.I18NDateTimesFormats;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.bosch.service.internationalization.I18NUtil;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.gui.EBikeApplicationPanel;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.gui.component.custom.DoubleClickMouseListener;
import com.github.lgooddatepicker.components.DatePicker;
import com.github.lgooddatepicker.components.DatePickerSettings;
import com.github.lgooddatepicker.optionalusertools.DateHighlightPolicy;
import com.github.lgooddatepicker.zinternaltools.HighlightInformation;
import java.awt.Color;
import java.awt.EventQueue;
import java.awt.Toolkit;
import java.awt.event.FocusEvent;
import java.awt.event.FocusListener;
import java.time.DayOfWeek;
import java.time.LocalDate;
import java.time.format.DateTimeFormatter;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Objects;
import java.util.concurrent.ScheduledExecutorService;
import javax.swing.JButton;

public class DatePickerFactory {
  public static final Color WEEKEND_BACKGROUND_COLOR = new Color(15658734);
  
  private static final String MULTI_CHECK_INTERVAL = "awt.multiClickInterval";
  
  private static final int DOUBLE_CLICK_INTERVAL = (Integer)Toolkit.getDefaultToolkit().getDesktopProperty("awt.multiClickInterval");
  
  private static final int TWENTIETH_CENTURY_THRESHOLD = 2050;
  
  private static final ScheduledExecutorService executor = ApplicationEventQueue.getExecutor();
  
  public static DatePicker createDatePicker(String name, String toolTipText, boolean isEnabled) {
    final DatePicker datePicker = new DatePicker(createDatePickerSettings()) {
        public void openPopup() {
          LocalDate currentDate = getDate();
          if (currentDate != null && currentDate.getYear() < 100) {
            LocalDate newDate = (currentDate.getYear() + 2000 > 2050) ? currentDate.plusYears(1900L) : currentDate.plusYears(2000L);
            setDate(newDate);
          } 
          super.openPopup();
        }
      };
    datePicker.setName(name);
    datePicker.setToolTipText(toolTipText);
    datePicker.setEnabled(isEnabled);
    datePicker.setFont(EBikeApplicationPanel.DEFAULT_FONT);
    datePicker.setForeground(EBikeApplicationPanel.FOREGROUND_COLOR);
    datePicker.getComponentDateTextField().setName("txt" + name + "CompDateTextField");
    JButton datePickerButton = datePicker.getComponentToggleCalendarButton();
    datePickerButton.setName("btn" + name + "CompToggleCalendarButton");
    datePickerButton.addMouseListener(new DoubleClickMouseListener(executor, () -> {
            Objects.requireNonNull(datePicker);
            EventQueue.invokeLater(datePicker::setDateToToday);
          }, (long)DOUBLE_CLICK_INTERVAL));
    datePicker.getComponentDateTextField().addFocusListener(new FocusListener() {
          public void focusGained(FocusEvent e) {}
          
          public void focusLost(FocusEvent e) {
            LocalDate currentDate = datePicker.getDate();
            if (currentDate != null && currentDate.getYear() < 100) {
              LocalDate newDate = (currentDate.getYear() + 2000 > 2050) ? currentDate.plusYears(1900L) : currentDate.plusYears(2000L);
              datePicker.setDate(newDate);
            } 
          }
        });
    return datePicker;
  }
  
  private static DatePickerSettings createDatePickerSettings() {
    String dateFormatPattern = I18NDateTimesFormats.getDateFormatterByCurrentLocale();
    ArrayList<DateTimeFormatter> formatsForParsing = new ArrayList<>();
    formatsForParsing.add(DateTimeFormatter.ofPattern(dateFormatPattern));
    DatePickerSettings settings = new DatePickerSettings();
    settings.setHighlightPolicy(new HighlightPolicy());
    settings.setLocale(I18NUtil.getLocale());
    settings.setFormatForDatesCommonEra(dateFormatPattern);
    settings.setFormatsForParsing(formatsForParsing);
    settings.setFormatForTodayButton(DateTimeFormatter.ofPattern(dateFormatPattern));
    settings.setColor(DatePickerSettings.DateArea.BackgroundOverallCalendarPanel, EBikeApplicationPanel.BACKGROUND_COLOR);
    settings.setColor(DatePickerSettings.DateArea.BackgroundTodayLabel, EBikeApplicationPanel.BACKGROUND_COLOR);
    settings.setColor(DatePickerSettings.DateArea.BackgroundClearLabel, EBikeApplicationPanel.BACKGROUND_COLOR);
    settings.setColor(DatePickerSettings.DateArea.BackgroundMonthAndYearMenuLabels, EBikeApplicationPanel.BACKGROUND_COLOR);
    return settings;
  }
  
  private static class HighlightPolicy implements DateHighlightPolicy {
    public HighlightInformation getHighlightInformationOrNull(LocalDate date) {
      if (DayOfWeek.SATURDAY == date.getDayOfWeek() || DayOfWeek.SUNDAY == date.getDayOfWeek())
        return new HighlightInformation(DatePickerFactory.WEEKEND_BACKGROUND_COLOR, Color.black, null); 
      return new HighlightInformation(Color.white, Color.black, null);
    }
  }
}

ITEM 295: com/gigatronik/ebike/gui/CyclicDataReadingManager.java
========================================================================================================================
package com.gigatronik.ebike.gui;

import com.gigatronik.beds.common.order.OrderableListener;
import com.gigatronik.beds.gui.panels.diagnostictab.subtab.AbstractDiagnosticSubtab;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.configuration.ConfigurationManager;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.configuration.api.HardwareConnectionChangesListener;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.configuration.event.HardwareConnectionChangedEvent;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.common.configuration.BikeIdentification;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.common.configuration.Constants;
import java.awt.Component;
import java.util.Timer;
import java.util.TimerTask;
import org.slf4j.Logger;
import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;

class CyclicDataReadingManager implements HardwareConnectionChangesListener {
  private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(CyclicDataReadingManager.class);
  
  public static final int HMI_DATA_READ_PERIOD = 400;
  
  public static final int HMI_DATA_READ_INITIAL_DELAY = 400;
  
  public static final int ABS_DATA_READ_PERIOD = 200;
  
  public static final int ABS_DATA_READ_INITIAL_DELAY = 200;
  
  private final AbstractDiagnosticSubtab subTabHmi;
  
  private final AbstractDiagnosticSubtab subTabAbs;
  
  private final BikeIdentification bikeIdentification;
  
  private Timer dataReadTimerHmi;
  
  private Timer dataReadTimerAbs;
  
  private Component focusedSubTab;
  
  private boolean isDiagnosticTabFocused;
  
  private boolean isSuspended = false;
  
  CyclicDataReadingManager(AbstractDiagnosticSubtab subTabHmi, AbstractDiagnosticSubtab subTabAbs, BikeIdentification bikeIdentification, ConfigurationManager configurationManager) {
    this.subTabHmi = subTabHmi;
    this.subTabAbs = subTabAbs;
    this.bikeIdentification = bikeIdentification;
    configurationManager.addListener((OrderableListener)this);
  }
  
  void onDiagnosticTabFocusChange(boolean focused) {
    LOGGER.debug("DiagnosticTab focus has changed to '{}'", Boolean.valueOf(focused));
    this.isDiagnosticTabFocused = focused;
    updateDataReadingStates();
  }
  
  void onSubTabChange(Component selectedTab) {
    LOGGER.debug("DiagnosticTab subTab focus has changed: HMI='{}', ABS='{}'", Boolean.valueOf((selectedTab == this.subTabHmi)), Boolean.valueOf((selectedTab == this.subTabAbs)));
    this.focusedSubTab = selectedTab;
    updateDataReadingStates();
  }
  
  synchronized void suspendPolling() {
    LOGGER.debug("Suspend cyclic data reading (isSuspended='{}')", Boolean.valueOf(this.isSuspended));
    if (!this.isSuspended) {
      stopDataReading();
      this.isSuspended = true;
    } 
  }
  
  synchronized void resumePolling() {
    LOGGER.debug("Resume cyclic data reading (isSuspended='{}')", Boolean.valueOf(this.isSuspended));
    if (this.isSuspended) {
      this.isSuspended = false;
      updateDataReadingStates();
    } 
  }
  
  private synchronized void updateDataReadingStates() {
    if (this.isDiagnosticTabFocused && !this.isSuspended) {
      updateHmiDataReadingState();
      updateAbsDataReadingState();
    } else {
      stopDataReading();
    } 
  }
  
  private void updateHmiDataReadingState() {
    if ((this.focusedSubTab == null || this.focusedSubTab == this.subTabHmi) && this.bikeIdentification.getHmiIdentification().isApplication()) {
      startHmiDataReading();
    } else {
      stopHmiDataReading();
    } 
  }
  
  private void updateAbsDataReadingState() {
    if (this.focusedSubTab == this.subTabAbs && this.bikeIdentification.getAbsIdentification().isApplication()) {
      startAbsDataReading();
    } else {
      stopAbsDataReading();
    } 
  }
  
  public void onHardwareConnectionChanged(HardwareConnectionChangedEvent event) {
    LOGGER.debug("HardwareConnectionChangedEvent received: '{}'", event);
    resetFocusedSubTabBackUpUponPossibleGuiRecreation(event);
    updateDataReadingStates();
  }
  
  private void resetFocusedSubTabBackUpUponPossibleGuiRecreation(HardwareConnectionChangedEvent event) {
    if (event.getComponent() == Constants.EcuType.BCT || event.getComponent() == Constants.EcuType.BCS250) {
      LOGGER.trace("Reset buffered focus settings, as GUI mode changes");
      this.isDiagnosticTabFocused = false;
      this.focusedSubTab = null;
    } 
  }
  
  private void startHmiDataReading() {
    if (this.dataReadTimerHmi == null) {
      LOGGER.debug("Start HMI cyclic data reading");
      this.dataReadTimerHmi = startDataReading(400L, 400L, this.subTabHmi, "HMI");
    } 
  }
  
  private void startAbsDataReading() {
    if (this.dataReadTimerAbs == null) {
      LOGGER.debug("Start ABS cyclic data reading");
      this.dataReadTimerAbs = startDataReading(200L, 200L, this.subTabAbs, "ABS");
    } 
  }
  
  private void stopDataReading() {
    stopHmiDataReading();
    stopAbsDataReading();
  }
  
  private void stopHmiDataReading() {
    if (this.dataReadTimerHmi != null) {
      LOGGER.debug("Stop HMI cyclic data reading");
      stopDataReading(this.dataReadTimerHmi);
      this.dataReadTimerHmi = null;
    } 
  }
  
  private void stopAbsDataReading() {
    if (this.dataReadTimerAbs != null) {
      LOGGER.debug("Stop ABS cyclic data reading");
      stopDataReading(this.dataReadTimerAbs);
      this.dataReadTimerAbs = null;
    } 
  }
  
  private Timer startDataReading(long delay, long period, AbstractDiagnosticSubtab subTab, String ecuName) {
    Timer timer = new Timer("Cyclic-" + ecuName + "-DataReader");
    TimerTask task = new CyclicDataReader(subTab);
    timer.schedule(task, delay, period);
    return timer;
  }
  
  private void stopDataReading(Timer timer) {
    timer.cancel();
  }
}

ITEM 296: com/gigatronik/ebike/gui/DefaultDongleStateListener.java

package com.gigatronik.ebike.gui;

import com.gigatronik.beds.service.donglemanager.api.DongleManager;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.donglemanager.api.DongleStateChangedEvent;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.donglemanager.api.DongleStateChangedEventListener;
import java.awt.EventQueue;
import org.slf4j.Logger;
import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;

public class DefaultDongleStateListener implements DongleStateChangedEventListener {
  private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(DefaultDongleStateListener.class);
  
  private EBikeDongleDialog connectDongleDialog;
  
  private boolean isFirstDongleConnect = true;
  
  private volatile boolean isDongleConnected = false;
  
  private final EBikeApplication ebikeApplication;
  
  public DefaultDongleStateListener(EBikeApplication eBikeApplication, DongleManager dongleMonitor) {
    this.ebikeApplication = eBikeApplication;
    dongleMonitor.addDongleStateListener(this);
  }
  
  public void onDongleStateChanged(DongleStateChangedEvent event) {
    LOGGER.debug("Received dongle state changed event '{}'", event);
    boolean connected = event.isDongleConnected();
    this.isDongleConnected = connected;
    if (connected)
      synchronized (this) {
        notifyAll();
      }  
    if (this.isFirstDongleConnect) {
      if (!connected)
        EventQueue.invokeLater(() -> {
              LOGGER.debug("Process dongle state change event now from EDT");
              try {
                this.ebikeApplication.getApplicationPanel().getMainTabbedController().switchToSupportTabAndDisableTheOtherTabs();
              } catch (Exception ex) {
                LOGGER.debug("Cannot switch to Support tab: ", (Throwable)ex);
              } 
            }); 
      this.isFirstDongleConnect = false;
    } 
    EventQueue.invokeLater(() -> {
          LOGGER.debug("Process dongle state change event now from EDT");
          if (this.connectDongleDialog == null)
            this.connectDongleDialog = new EBikeDongleDialog(this.ebikeApplication); 
          if ((!this.connectDongleDialog.isVisible() && !connected) || (this.connectDongleDialog.isVisible() && connected))
            this.connectDongleDialog.setVisible(!connected); 
        });
  }
  
  public void displayDongleIsMissingDialog() {
    EventQueue.invokeLater(() -> {
          if (this.connectDongleDialog == null)
            this.connectDongleDialog = new EBikeDongleDialog(this.ebikeApplication); 
          if (!this.connectDongleDialog.isVisible()) {
            LOGGER.info("Display blocking 'dongle is missing' dialog");
            this.connectDongleDialog.setVisible(true);
          } 
        });
  }
  
  synchronized void waitForInitializedDongle() {
    LOGGER.debug("Waiting for dongle connect...");
    while (!this.isDongleConnected && !Thread.currentThread().isInterrupted()) {
      try {
        wait();
      } catch (InterruptedException e) {
        Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
        LOGGER.error("wait interrupted", (Throwable)e);
      } 
    } 
    LOGGER.debug("Dongle is connected");
  }
  
  public String getOrderingName() {
    return "DefaultDongleStateListener";
  }
}

  public void onRightsChanged(RightsChangedEvent event) {
    LOGGER.debug("Received rights changed event '{}'", event);
    if (event.getUserLevel() != UserLevel.UNKNOWN)
      EventQueue.invokeLater(() -> {
            LOGGER.debug("Process rights change event now from EDT");
            this.diagnosticTabButtonStateController.validateButtonVisibilityStates();
            evaluateTableSettings();
          }); 
  }
  
  private void evaluateTableSettings() {
    if (this.guiManager.isGuiInMode(GuiManager.GuiMode.BCT)) {
      this.subtabBCT.updateTable();
    } else {
      this.subtabHMI.updateTable();
      this.subtabDU.updateTable();
      this.subtabBaPa.updateTable();
      this.subtabBBP2.updateTable();
      this.subtabAbs.updateTable();
      this.subtabEShift.updateTable();
      this.subtabBCS.updateTable();
    } 
  }
  
  private void onTabChange() {
    if (!this.rebuildGUI) {
      Component selected = this.diagnosticTabbedPane.getSelectedComponent();
      if (selected != null) {
        LOGGER.info("Change to {} DiagnosticSubTab.", selected.getClass().getSimpleName());
        boolean isBatteryTab = (selected.equals(this.subtabBaPa) || selected.equals(this.subtabBBP2));
        this.buttonChangeEvent.setBatteryTab(isBatteryTab);
        if (this.guiManager.isGuiInMode(GuiManager.GuiMode.BCT) && this.subtabBaPa.isDiagnosisTableEmpty())
          startDiagnosticServiceWhenEmptyBct(); 
        this.cyclicDataReadingManager.onSubTabChange(selected);
        validateButtonStates();
      } 
    } 
  }
