  private void setDefaultTables() {
    this.rebuildGUI = true;
    if (this.guiManager.isGuiInMode(GuiManager.GuiMode.EBIKE) || this.guiManager.isGuiInMode(GuiManager.GuiMode.BCS)) {
      this.subtabHMI.getUdamPanel()[0].setVisible(this.bikeIdentification.getHmiIdentification().getComponentType().isNyon());
      this.diagnosticTabbedPane.removeAll();
      this.diagnosticTabbedPane.addTab(BUNDLE.getString("EBikeServiceTab.TAB_HMI"), null, this.subtabHMI, BUNDLE.getString("EBikeServiceTab.Tab_HMI.toolTipText"));
      this.subtabHMI.populateDefaultTable();
      this.diagnosticTabbedPane.addTab(BUNDLE.getString("EBikeServiceTab.TAB_DU"), null, this.subtabDU, 
          BUNDLE.getString("EBikeServiceTab.Tab_DU.toolTipText"));
      this.subtabDU.populateDefaultTable();
      this.diagnosticTabbedPane.addTab(mapBatteryLabel(this.bikeIdentification.getBms1Identification().getComponentType()), null, this.subtabBaPa, 
          mapBatteryTooltip(this.bikeIdentification.getBms1Identification().getComponentType()));
      this.subtabBaPa.populateDefaultTable();
      if (this.guiManager.isGuiInMode(GuiManager.GuiMode.BCS))
        addBcsTab(); 
    } else if (this.guiManager.isGuiInMode(GuiManager.GuiMode.BCT)) {
      this.diagnosticTabbedPane.removeAll();
      this.diagnosticTabbedPane.addTab(BUNDLE.getString("EBikeServiceTab.TAB_BCT"), null, this.subtabBCT, 
          BUNDLE.getString("EBikeServiceTab.Tab_BCT.toolTipText"));
      this.subtabBCT.populateDefaultTable();
      ComponentType bmsType = this.bikeIdentification.getBms1Identification().getComponentType();
      this.diagnosticTabbedPane.addTab(mapBatteryLabel(bmsType), null, this.subtabBaPa, mapBatteryTooltip(bmsType));
      this.subtabBaPa.populateDefaultTable();
    } 
    adjustTooltipTexts();
    validateButtonStates();
    this.rebuildGUI = false;
  }
  
  public void onUnitChangeEvent(UnitChangeEvent event) {
    TableEvaluatorImpl.Unit unit = event.getUnit();
    switch (unit) {
      case CIRCUMFERENCE:
        refreshAfterCircumferenceUnitChanged();
        break;
      case DISTANCE:
        refreshAfterDistanceUnitChanged();
        break;
      case SPEED:
        refreshAfterSpeedUnitChanged();
        break;
      case TEMPERATURE:
        refreshAfterTemperatureUnitChanged();
        break;
      default:
        LOGGER.warn("unit could not be refreshed {}", unit);
        break;
    } 
  }
  
  public void refreshAfterDistanceUnitChanged() {
    EventQueue.invokeLater(() -> {
          this.subtabDU.fillTable(false);
          this.subtabHMI.fillTable(false);
        });
  }
  
  public void refreshAfterTemperatureUnitChanged() {
    EventQueue.invokeLater(() -> {
          this.subtabBaPa.fillTable(false);
          this.subtabBBP2.fillTable(false);
        });
  }
  
  public void refreshAfterCircumferenceUnitChanged() {
    EventQueue.invokeLater(() -> this.subtabDU.fillTable(false));
  }
  
  public void refreshAfterSpeedUnitChanged() {
    EventQueue.invokeLater(() -> {
          this.subtabDU.fillTable(false);
          this.subtabHMI.fillTable(false);
        });
  }
  
  public void buttonStateChanged(DiagnosticTabButtonStateController state) {
    this.imgbtnLoadConfigFromBike.setEnabled(state.isLoadConfigEnabled());
    this.imgbtnClearCode.setEnabled(state.isClearCodeEnabled());
    this.imgbtnClearStatistics.setEnabled(state.isClearStatisticsEnabled());
    this.imgbtnClearStatistics.setVisible(state.isClearStatisticsVisible());
    this.imgbtnGenerateReportIBDCostumer.setEnabled(state.isIbdCustomerReportEnabled());
    this.imgbtnGenerateReportIBDCostumer.setVisible(state.isIbdCustomerReportVisible());
    this.imgbtnGenerateReportIBDDealer.setEnabled(state.isIbdReportEnabled());
    this.imgbtnGenerateReportIBDDealer.setVisible(state.isIbdReportVisible());
    this.imgbtnGenerateReportOEMCostumer.setEnabled(state.isOemCustomerReportEnabled());
    this.imgbtnGenerateReportOEMCostumer.setVisible(state.isOemCustomerReportVisible());
    this.imgbtnGenerateReportOEMService.setEnabled(state.isOemReportEnabled());
    this.imgbtnGenerateReportOEMService.setVisible(state.isOemReportVisible());
    this.imgbtnGenerateReportOEMService.setEnabled(state.isOemReportEnabled());
    this.imgbtnGenerateReportOEMService.setVisible(state.isOemReportVisible());
    this.imgbtnResetSensortest.setEnabled(state.isResetSensortestEnabled());
    this.imgbtnResetSensortest.setVisible(state.isResetSensortestVisible());
    this.imgbtnDisableBattery.setEnabled(state.isDisableBatteryEnabled());
    this.imgbtnEbikeDisabler.setEnabled(state.isEbikeDisablerEnabled());
    this.imgbtnEbikeDisabler.setVisible(state.isEbikeDisablerVisible());
    this.imgbtnDisableBattery.setToolTipText(state.isDisableBatteryEnabled() ? BUNDLE.getString("EBikeServiceTab.DisableBattery") : BUNDLE.getString("DisableBattery.function.not.available"));
  }
  
  private void adjustTooltipTexts() {
    if (this.guiManager.isGuiInMode(GuiManager.GuiMode.BCT)) {
      this.imgbtnLoadConfigFromBike.setToolTipText(BUNDLE.getString("EBikeServiceTab.imgbtnLoadConfigFromBike.bct.toolTipText"));
      this.imgbtnClearCode.setToolTipText(BUNDLE.getString("EBikeServiceTab.imgbtnClearCode.bct.toolTipText"));
    } else {
      this.imgbtnLoadConfigFromBike.setToolTipText(BUNDLE.getString("EBikeServiceTab.imgbtnLoadConfigFromBike.toolTipText"));
      this.imgbtnClearCode.setToolTipText(BUNDLE.getString("EBikeServiceTab.imgbtnClearCode.toolTipText"));
    } 
  }
  
  public void onBikeConfigurationChanged(BikeConfigurationChangedEvent event) {
    LOGGER.debug("BikeConfigurationChangedEvent received: '{}'", event);
    if (event.getAction() == BikeConfigurationChangedEvent.Action.WRITE_TO_BIKE)
      onConfigurationWriteToBike(); 
  }
  
  public void onHardwareConnectionChanged(HardwareConnectionChangedEvent event) {
    LOGGER.debug("HardwareConnectionChangedEvent received: '{}'", event);
    switch (event.getAction()) {
      case SYSTEM_CONNECTED:
      case SYSTEM_RECONNECTED:
        onSystemConnect();
        break;
      case ECU_CONNECTED:
        onEcuConnect(event.getComponent());
        break;
      case ECU_DISCONNECTED:
        onEcuDisconnect(event.getComponent());
        break;
    } 
  }
  
  public void onDatapoolUpdated() {
    EventQueue.invokeLater(() -> this.subtabDU.fillTable(false));
  }
  
  public void onGuiModeChanged(GuiManager.GuiMode newMode, GuiManager.GuiMode oldMode) {
    switch (newMode) {
      case EBIKE:
        setDefaultTables();
        adjustHmiLabel();
        break;
      case BCT:
        setDefaultTables();
        break;
      case BCS:
        if (oldMode == GuiManager.GuiMode.BCT) {
          setDefaultTables();
        } else {
          addBcsTab();
        } 
        break;
    } 
  }
  
  private void addBcsTab() {
    this.diagnosticTabbedPane.addTab(BUNDLE.getString("EBikeServiceTab.TAB_BCS"), null, this.subtabBCS, BUNDLE.getString("EBikeServiceTab.Tab_BCS.toolTipText"));
    this.subtabBCS.populateDefaultTable();
  }
  
  public void onExecutionFinished(TaskCompletionEvent event) {
    ApplicationProcessManager.getInstance().setProcessState(ApplicationProcessManager.ApplicationProcess.READ_SERVICE_PARAMS, false);
  }
  
  public ServiceParameterDatapool getServiceParameterDatapool() {
    return this.serviceParameterDatapool;
  }
  
  public enum Measure {
    DISTANCE, CIRCUMFERENCE, SPEED, TEMPERATURE;
  }
  
  public void startDiagnosticServiceWhenEmpty() {
    if (TokenPluginProxy.getInstance().isDongleAvailable() && isSomeTableEmpty())
      startDiagnosticService(false); 
  }
  
  public boolean isSomeTableEmpty() {
    if (this.guiManager.isGuiInMode(GuiManager.GuiMode.BCT)) {
      boolean bctTableEmpty = (this.bikeIdentification.isBctConnected() && this.subtabBCT.isDiagnosisTableEmpty());
      LOGGER.debug("isSomeTableEmpty() --> BCT='{}'", Boolean.valueOf(bctTableEmpty));
      return bctTableEmpty;
    } 
    boolean hmiTableEmpty = (this.bikeIdentification.isHmiConnected() && this.subtabHMI.isDiagnosisTableEmpty());
    boolean duTableEmpty = (this.bikeIdentification.isDuConnected() && this.subtabDU.isDiagnosisTableEmpty());
    boolean pp1TableEmpty = (this.bikeIdentification.isBms1Connected() && this.subtabBaPa.isDiagnosisTableEmpty());
    boolean pp2TableEmpty = (this.bikeIdentification.isBms2Connected() && this.subtabBBP2.isDiagnosisTableEmpty());
    boolean absTableEmpty = (this.bikeIdentification.isAbsConnected() && this.subtabAbs.isDiagnosisTableEmpty());
    boolean eShiftTableEmpty = (this.bikeIdentification.isEshiftConnected() && this.subtabEShift.isDiagnosisTableEmpty());
    boolean bcsTableEmpty = (this.bikeIdentification.isBcsConnected() && this.subtabBCS.isDiagnosisTableEmpty());
    LOGGER.debug("isSomeTableEmpty() --> HMI='{}', DU='{}', BMS1='{}', BMS2='{}', ABS='{}', ESHIFT='{}', BCS='{}'", hmiTableEmpty, duTableEmpty, pp1TableEmpty, pp2TableEmpty, absTableEmpty, eShiftTableEmpty, bcsTableEmpty);
    return (hmiTableEmpty || duTableEmpty || pp1TableEmpty || pp2TableEmpty || absTableEmpty || eShiftTableEmpty || bcsTableEmpty);
  }
  
  public void startDiagnosticServiceWhenEmptyBct() {
    if (TokenPluginProxy.getInstance().isDongleAvailable() && this.bikeIdentification.isBctConnected() && isSomeBctTableEmpty())
      startDiagnosticService(false); 
  }
  
  private boolean isSomeBctTableEmpty() {
    return (this.subtabBCT.isDiagnosisTableEmpty() || this.subtabBaPa.isDiagnosisTableEmpty());
  }
  
  private void adjustBatteryLabel(ComponentType bmsType) {
    boolean dualBatteryBike = this.bikeIdentification.isBms2Connected();
    this.diagnosticTabbedPane.setTitleAt(this.diagnosticTabbedPane.indexOfComponent(this.subtabBaPa), mapBatteryLabel(bmsType) + mapBatteryLabel(bmsType));
    this.diagnosticTabbedPane.setToolTipTextAt(this.diagnosticTabbedPane.indexOfComponent(this.subtabBaPa), mapBatteryTooltip(bmsType));
  }
  
  private void resetBatteryLabelAndTooltip() {
    this.diagnosticTabbedPane.setTitleAt(this.diagnosticTabbedPane.indexOfComponent(this.subtabBaPa), mapBatteryLabel(ComponentType.NONE));
    this.diagnosticTabbedPane.setToolTipTextAt(this.diagnosticTabbedPane.indexOfComponent(this.subtabBaPa), mapBatteryTooltip(ComponentType.NONE));
  }
  
  private void adjustHmiLabel() {
    this.diagnosticTabbedPane.setTitleAt(this.diagnosticTabbedPane.indexOfComponent(this.subtabHMI), BUNDLE.getString("EBikeServiceTab.TAB_HMI"));
    this.diagnosticTabbedPane.setToolTipTextAt(this.diagnosticTabbedPane.indexOfComponent(this.subtabHMI), 
        BUNDLE.getString("EBikeServiceTab.Tab_HMI.toolTipText"));
  }
  
  private void startDiagnosticService(boolean restartSession) {
    if (this.guiManager.isGuiInMode(GuiManager.GuiMode.BCT) && this.bikeIdentification.getBctIdentification().isApplication() && 
      this.subtabBaPa.equals(this.diagnosticTabbedPane.getSelectedComponent()) && !this.batterySelectionChecker.ensureBatteryIsSelected())
      return; 
    delegateServiceParameterReadingToTaskQueue(() -> {
          this.systemAlreadyInitialized.compareAndSet(false, true);
          this.diagnosticTabTableManager.readParametersAndPopulateTables(restartSession);
        });
  }
  
  private void delegateServiceParameterReadingToTaskQueue(Runnable task) {
    ApplicationProcessManager.getInstance().setProcessState(ApplicationProcessManager.ApplicationProcess.READ_SERVICE_PARAMS, true);
    TaskQueue taskQueue = TaskQueueFactory.getInstance();
    taskQueue.add(TaskType.DIAGNOSTIC_TAB_DATA_READING, task, this);
  }
  
  private void clearErrorMemoryLog(Component component) {
    LOGGER.info("readDtcsAndPopulateTable(): Clear error log Button click");
    if (component.equals(this.subtabHMI)) {
      this.communicationManager.getHmiCom().clearErrorMemory();
      this.serviceParameterDatapool.resetDtcCache(ServiceParameter.Ecu.HMI);
      readDtcsAndPopulateTable(component);
    } else if (component.equals(this.subtabDU)) {
      this.communicationManager.getDuCom().clearErrorMemory();
      this.serviceParameterDatapool.resetDtcCache(ServiceParameter.Ecu.DU);
      readDtcsAndPopulateTable(component);
    } else if (component.equals(this.subtabBaPa)) {
      if (this.guiManager.isGuiInMode(GuiManager.GuiMode.BCT) && 
        this.communicationManager.getBms1Com().executeExtendedSessionAndSecurityAccess(this.rightsManagerImpl.getUserLevel()).isNegative())
        this.securityAccessFailurePopupHandler.displaySecurityAccessFailedDialog(false, ComponentType.COMP_BBP280); 
      this.communicationManager.getBms1Com().clearErrorMemory();
      this.serviceParameterDatapool.resetDtcCache(ServiceParameter.Ecu.BMS1);
      readDtcsAndPopulateTable(component);
      if (this.guiManager.isGuiInMode(GuiManager.GuiMode.BCT))
        this.communicationManager.getBms1Com().startDefaultSession(false); 
    } else if (component.equals(this.subtabBBP2)) {
      this.communicationManager.getBms2Com().clearErrorMemory();
      this.serviceParameterDatapool.resetDtcCache(ServiceParameter.Ecu.BMS2);
      readDtcsAndPopulateTable(component);
    } else if (component.equals(this.subtabBCT)) {
      this.communicationManager.getBctCom().clearErrorMemory();
      this.serviceParameterDatapool.resetDtcCache(ServiceParameter.Ecu.BCT);
      readDtcsAndPopulateTable(component);
    } else if (component.equals(this.subtabAbs)) {
      this.communicationManager.getAbsCom().clearErrorMemory();
      this.serviceParameterDatapool.resetDtcCache(ServiceParameter.Ecu.ABS);
      readDtcsAndPopulateTable(component);
    } else if (component.equals(this.subtabBCS)) {
      this.communicationManager.getBcsCom().clearErrorMemory();
      this.serviceParameterDatapool.resetDtcCache(ServiceParameter.Ecu.BCS);
      readDtcsAndPopulateTable(component);
    } 
  }
  
  private void readDtcsAndPopulateTable(Component subtab) {
    if (subtab != null && subtab instanceof AbstractDiagnosticSubtab) {
      this.diagnosticTabTableManager.readDtcsAndPopulateTable((AbstractDiagnosticSubtab)subtab);
      this.eBikeApplication.showStatusInfo(BUNDLE.getString("EBikeStatus.CLEAR_ERROR_MEMORY_SUCCESS"));
    } 
  }
  
  private void validateButtonStates() {
    Component selectedTab = this.diagnosticTabbedPane.getSelectedComponent();
    DiagnosticTabSubtabChangeEvent.SELECTED_COMPONENT selectedComponent = null;
    boolean isNotClassicPlus = !this.bikeIdentification.getSystemType().equals(Constants.SystemType.CLASSIC_PLUS);
    if (selectedTab != null) {
      if (selectedTab.equals(this.subtabEShift))
        selectedComponent = DiagnosticTabSubtabChangeEvent.SELECTED_COMPONENT.PN_GEAR_BOX; 
      if (selectedTab.equals(this.subtabDU))
        selectedComponent = DiagnosticTabSubtabChangeEvent.SELECTED_COMPONENT.SPANE_DU; 
      if (selectedTab.equals(this.subtabAbs))
        selectedComponent = DiagnosticTabSubtabChangeEvent.SELECTED_COMPONENT.PN_ABS; 
      if (selectedTab.equals(this.subtabBaPa) || selectedTab.equals(this.subtabBBP2))
        selectedComponent = DiagnosticTabSubtabChangeEvent.SELECTED_COMPONENT.PN_BMS; 
      this.imgbtnDisableBattery.setVisible((selectedTab == this.subtabBaPa || selectedTab == this.subtabBBP2));
    } 
    this.diagnosticTabButtonStateController.onDiagnosticTabButtonStateChanged(this.buttonChangeEvent.setSelectedComponent(selectedComponent).setNotClassicPlus(isNotClassicPlus));
  }
  
  private boolean isBctIdleWithBatteryTypeSet() {
    BctState bctState = this.communicationManager.getBctCom().readOperatingState();
    return (bctState == BctState.IDLE_BATTERY_SET);
  }
  
  public String mapBatteryLabel(ComponentType componentType) {
    return BUNDLE.getString(componentType.isPowerTube() ? "ProductName.powerTube" : "EBikeServiceTab.TAB_BAPA");
  }
  
  private String mapBatteryTooltip(ComponentType componentType) {
    return BUNDLE.getString(componentType.isPowerTube() ? "EBikeServiceTab.powerTube.toolTipText" : "EBikeServiceTab.Tab_BaPa.toolTipText");
  }
  
  private void onSystemConnect() {
    if (this.configurationManager.getBikeIdentification().getBctIdentification().isConnected()) {
      if (this.rightsManagerImpl.isUserInLevel(UserLevel.IBD) && isBctIdleWithBatteryTypeSet())
        startDiagnosticServiceWhenEmptyBct(); 
      return;
    } 
    if (this.rightsManagerImpl.isModeActive(Mode.OEM_WORKER) || (this.rightsManagerImpl.isModeActive(Mode.OEM_ADMIN) && !this.isDiagnosticTabFocused)) {
      LOGGER.debug("No reading of service parameters in OEM worker mode and not in OEM admin 'cause the diagnostic tab is not focused");
      return;
    } 
    if (this.systemAlreadyInitialized.get()) {
      LOGGER.warn("Automatic service parameter reading prevented, 'cause of non 1st time system connection callback");
      return;
    } 
    startDiagnosticService(false);
  }
  
  private void onConfigurationWriteToBike() {
    if (this.rightsManagerImpl.isModeActive(Mode.OEM_WORKER))
      return; 
    startDiagnosticService(false);
  }
  
  private void onEcuConnect(Constants.EcuType type) {
    switch (type) {
      case BUI21X:
      case BUI25X:
      case BUI270:
      case BUI275:
      case BUI330:
      case BUI350:
      case COBI:
        EventQueue.invokeLater(() -> 
            adjustHmiLabel());
        break;
      case CLASSIC_DU:
      case VICTOR_DU:
        connectDu(type);
        break;
      case BAS100:
        EventQueue.invokeLater(() -> {
              int indexBCSSubtab = this.diagnosticTabbedPane.indexOfComponent(this.subtabBCS);
              if (indexBCSSubtab > 0) {
                this.diagnosticTabbedPane.insertTab(BUNDLE.getString("EBikeServiceTab.TAB_ABS"), null, this.subtabAbs, BUNDLE.getString("EBikeServiceTab.Tab_ABS.toolTipText"), indexBCSSubtab);
              } else {
                this.diagnosticTabbedPane.addTab(BUNDLE.getString("EBikeServiceTab.TAB_ABS"), null, this.subtabAbs, BUNDLE.getString("EBikeServiceTab.Tab_ABS.toolTipText"));
              } 
              this.subtabAbs.populateDefaultTable();
            });
        fillSubTabIfConnectedLately(type);
        break;
      case CLASSIC_PP:
      case VICTOR_PP1:
        EventQueue.invokeLater(() -> adjustBatteryLabel(this.bikeIdentification.getBms1Identification().getComponentType()));
        fillSubTabIfConnectedLately(type);
        break;
      case VICTOR_PP2:
        EventQueue.invokeLater(() -> {
              this.diagnosticTabbedPane.setTitleAt(
                  this.diagnosticTabbedPane.indexOfComponent(this.subtabBaPa), 
                  mapBatteryLabel(this.bikeIdentification.getBms1Identification().getComponentType()) + " 1");
              ComponentType bms2Type = this.bikeIdentification.getBms2Identification().getComponentType();
              this.diagnosticTabbedPane.insertTab(mapBatteryLabel(bms2Type) + " 2", null, this.subtabBBP2, mapBatteryTooltip(bms2Type), 3);
            });
        fillSubTabIfConnectedLately(type);
        break;
      case BCT:
        EventQueue.invokeLater(() -> 
            this.eBikeApplication.showStatusInfo(" "));
        break;
      case BCS250:
        fillSubTabIfConnectedLately(type);
        break;
      case ESHIFT:
        refreshEshiftParameter();
        break;
    } 
  }
  
  private void fillSubTabIfConnectedLately(Constants.EcuType ecu) {
    if (this.systemAlreadyInitialized.get() && (this.rightsManagerImpl.isUserInLevel(UserLevel.IBD) || (this.rightsManagerImpl.isModeActive(Mode.OEM_ADMIN) && this.isDiagnosticTabFocused)))
      delegateServiceParameterReadingToTaskQueue(() -> this.diagnosticTabTableManager.readParametersAndPopulateTables(ecu, false)); 
  }
  
  private void connectDu(Constants.EcuType type) {
    if (this.bikeIdentification.isDuConnected()) {
      EventQueue.invokeLater(() -> {
            this.imgbtnClearStatistics.setEnabled(true);
            if (this.bikeIdentification.isEshiftConnected())
              this.diagnosticTabbedPane.addTab(BUNDLE.getString("EBikeServiceTab.eShift.title"), null, this.subtabEShift, 
                  BUNDLE.getString("EBikeServiceTab.eShift.tooltip")); 
          });
      fillSubTabIfConnectedLately(type);
    } 
  }
  
  private void refreshEshiftParameter() {
    if (this.systemAlreadyInitialized.get())
      delegateServiceParameterReadingToTaskQueue(() -> {
            LOGGER.debug("Refresh displayed eShift parameters, now that reading is allowed");
            this.serviceParameterDatapool.resetServiceParameterCache((ServiceParameter)DuServiceParameter.AUTO_DOWN_SHIFT);
            this.serviceParameterDatapool.resetServiceParameterCache((ServiceParameter)DuServiceParameter.DEFAULT_GEAR);
            this.subtabDU.fillTable(false);
            this.subtabEShift.fillTable(true);
            LOGGER.debug("Refreshed displayed eShift parameters");
          }); 
  }
  
  private void onEcuDisconnect(Constants.EcuType type) {
    switch (type) {
      case BUI21X:
      case BUI25X:
      case BUI270:
      case BUI275:
      case BUI330:
      case BUI350:
      case COBI:
        EventQueue.invokeLater(this::disconnectBui);
        break;
      case CLASSIC_DU:
      case VICTOR_DU:
        EventQueue.invokeLater(this::disconnectDu);
        break;
      case CLASSIC_PP:
      case VICTOR_PP1:
        EventQueue.invokeLater(this::disconnectPp1);
        break;
      case VICTOR_PP2:
        EventQueue.invokeLater(this::disconnectPp2);
        break;
      case BCT:
        EventQueue.invokeLater(this::disconnectBct);
        break;
      case BAS100:
        EventQueue.invokeLater(this::disconnectAbs);
        break;
      case BCS250:
        EventQueue.invokeLater(this::disconnectBcs);
        break;
    } 
  }
  
  private void disconnectBui() {
    this.systemAlreadyInitialized.set(false);
  }
  
  private void disconnectPp1() {
    this.subtabBaPa.clear();
    if (!this.bikeIdentification.isBms2Connected())
      resetBatteryLabelAndTooltip(); 
  }
  
  private void disconnectPp2() {
    this.subtabBBP2.clear();
    this.diagnosticTabbedPane.remove(this.subtabBBP2);
    adjustBatteryLabel(this.bikeIdentification.getBms1Identification().getComponentType());
  }
  
  private void disconnectDu() {
    this.subtabDU.clear();
    this.subtabEShift.clear();
    this.diagnosticTabbedPane.remove(this.subtabEShift);
  }
  
  private void disconnectBct() {
    this.subtabBCT.clear();
    this.subtabBaPa.clear();
  }
  
  private void disconnectAbs() {
    this.subtabAbs.clear();
    this.diagnosticTabbedPane.remove(this.subtabAbs);
  }
  
  private void disconnectBcs() {
    this.subtabBCS.clear();
    this.diagnosticTabbedPane.remove(this.subtabBCS);
  }
  
  public void onBctOperationStateChanged(BctOperationStateChangeEvent event) {
    LOGGER.debug("Received BctOperationStateChangeEvent: '{}'", event);
    this.diagnosticTabButtonStateController.onBctStateChange(event);
    BctState state = event.getOperatingState();
    switch (state) {
      case NOT_CONNECTED:
      case CONNECTED_FBL:
      case IDLE:
        disconnectPp1();
        break;
      case IDLE_BATTERY_SET:
        adjustBatteryLabel(this.bikeIdentification.getBms1Identification().getComponentType());
        break;
    } 
  }
  
  public void onConnectedBikeChargingStateChanges(ChargingStateEvent event) {
    if (event.getState() == ChargingStateEvent.ChargingState.START_CHARGING) {
      disableButtons(true);
    } else if (event.getState() == ChargingStateEvent.ChargingState.STOP_CHARGING) {
      disableButtons(false);
    } 
  }
  
  public void setFocus(boolean focused) {
    this.isDiagnosticTabFocused = focused;
    this.cyclicDataReadingManager.onDiagnosticTabFocusChange(focused);
  }

  public void refreshAfterDisablerUnlocked() {
    this.serviceParameterDatapool.resetServiceParameterCache((ServiceParameter)DuServiceParameter.DISABLER_FUNCTION_STATUS);
    this.serviceParameterDatapool.resetServiceParameterCache((ServiceParameter)DuServiceParameter.DISABLER_STATUS);
    this.serviceParameterDatapool.resetServiceParameterCache((ServiceParameter)DuServiceParameter.DISABLER_RECOVERY_IDENTIFIER);
    this.diagnosticTabButtonStateController.setDisablerFunctionState(this.serviceParameterDatapool.getServiceParameter((ServiceParameter)DuServiceParameter.DISABLER_FUNCTION_STATUS));
    EventQueue.invokeLater(() -> {
          this.subtabDU.fillTable(false);
          validateButtonStates();
        });
  }
  
  private void onImgbtnEbikeDisablerActionEvent() {
    LOGGER.debug("Ebike Disabler button clicked");
    ComplexResponse disablerIdentifier = this.serviceParameterDatapool.getServiceParameter((ServiceParameter)DuServiceParameter.DISABLER_RECOVERY_IDENTIFIER);
    if (this.ebikeDisablerDialogController.showDialog(disablerIdentifier))
      refreshAfterDisablerUnlocked(); 
  }

  public BcsSubtab getBcsTab() {
    return this.subtabBCS;
  }
  
  public EShiftSubtab getEshiftTab() {
    return this.subtabEShift;
  }

package com.gigatronik.ebike.gui;

import com.gigatronik.beds.diagnosticdatapool.api.ServiceParameterDatapool;
import com.gigatronik.beds.diagnosticdatapool.api.serviceparameter.ServiceParameter;
import com.gigatronik.beds.gui.panels.diagnostictab.subtab.AbstractDiagnosticSubtab;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.ecu.data.Dtc;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.ecu.data.DtcResponse;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.bosch.service.internationalization.ResourceBundleFactory;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.bosch.service.internationalization.Utf8ResourceBundleFormatted;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.common.configuration.BikeIdentification;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.custom.WordWrapCellRenderer;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Enumeration;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Objects;
import javax.swing.JTable;
import javax.swing.table.DefaultTableModel;
import javax.swing.table.TableColumn;
import org.slf4j.Logger;
import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;

class DiagnosticTabDtcTableManager {
  private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(DiagnosticTabDtcTableManager.class);
  
  private static Utf8ResourceBundleFormatted bundle = ResourceBundleFactory.newDefaultResourceBundle();
  
  private static final String BUNDLE_KEY_HMI = "HMI";
  
  private static final String BUNDLE_KEY_BCT = "BCT";
  
  private static final String BUNDLE_KEY_DU = "BDU";
  
  private static final String BUNDLE_KEY_DU_CLASSIC = "DU";
  
  private static final String BUNDLE_KEY_BMS = "BBP";
  
  private static final String BUNDLE_KEY_BMS_CLASSIC = "BMS";
  
  private static final String BUNDLE_KEY_ABS = "ABS";
  
  private static final String BUNDLE_KEY_BCS = "BCS";
  
  private final SubTabProvider subTabProvider;
  
  private final ServiceParameterDatapool serviceParameterDatapool;
  
  private final BikeIdentification bikeIdentification;
  
  DiagnosticTabDtcTableManager(SubTabProvider subTabProvider, ServiceParameterDatapool serviceParameterDatapool, BikeIdentification bikeIdentification) {
    this.subTabProvider = subTabProvider;
    this.serviceParameterDatapool = serviceParameterDatapool;
    this.bikeIdentification = bikeIdentification;
  }
  
  void readDtcsAndPopulateTable(AbstractDiagnosticSubtab subTab) {
    JTable table = subTab.getErrorCodeTable();
    clearTable(table);
    setCellRenderer(table);
    DefaultTableModel model = (DefaultTableModel)table.getModel();
    DtcResponse ecuResponse = readDtcsFromEcu(subTab);
    if (ecuResponse.isNegative()) {
      LOGGER.warn("DTC response was '{}' for ECU '{}'", ecuResponse, subTab.getTableComponentName());
      model.insertRow(0, new Object[] { "", bundle.getString("EBikeServiceTab.NEGATIVE_RESPONSE") });
      return;
    } 
    List<String> errorCodes = convertToStringList(ecuResponse);
    if (errorCodes.isEmpty()) {
      LOGGER.debug("No DTCs present for ECU '{}'", subTab.getTableComponentName());
      model.insertRow(0, new Object[] { "", bundle.getString("EBikeServiceTab.ErrorCodeTable.NO_ERROR") });
      return;
    } 
    String ecuBundleKeyName = determineEcuBundleKeyName(subTab);
    populateRows(model, ecuBundleKeyName, errorCodes);
  }
  
  private void populateRows(DefaultTableModel model, String ecuBundleKeyName, List<String> errorCodes) {
    for (String errorCode : errorCodes)
      populateRow(model, ecuBundleKeyName, errorCode); 
  }
  
  private List<String> convertToStringList(DtcResponse dtcResponse) {
    List<String> returnedErrorCodes = new ArrayList<>();
    Objects.requireNonNull(returnedErrorCodes);
    dtcResponse.getDtcs().stream().map(Dtc::getHexCode).forEach(returnedErrorCodes::add);
    return returnedErrorCodes;
  }
  
  private void setCellRenderer(JTable table) {
    Enumeration<TableColumn> columns = table.getColumnModel().getColumns();
    while (columns.hasMoreElements()) {
      TableColumn tc = columns.nextElement();
      tc.setCellRenderer(new WordWrapCellRenderer());
    } 
  }
  
  private void clearTable(JTable table) {
    DefaultTableModel model = (DefaultTableModel)table.getModel();
    while (model.getRowCount() > 0)
      model.removeRow(0); 
  }
  
  private void populateRow(DefaultTableModel model, String ecuBundleKeyName, String errorCodeWithoutPrefix) {
    String errorCodeWithPrefix = "0x" + errorCodeWithoutPrefix;
    String descriptionBundleKey = buildBundleKey(ecuBundleKeyName, errorCodeWithoutPrefix, ".description");
    String activityBundleKey = buildBundleKey(ecuBundleKeyName, errorCodeWithoutPrefix, ".activity");
    String description = getText(descriptionBundleKey, "Servicetable.errorcode.unknown.desc.placeholder");
    String activity = getText(activityBundleKey, "Servicetable.errorcode.unknown.activity.placeholder");
    model.insertRow(0, new Object[] { errorCodeWithPrefix, description, activity });
  }
  
  private String buildBundleKey(String ecuBundleKeyName, String errorCodeNumber, String bundlePostfix) {
    StringBuilder bundleKey = new StringBuilder();
    bundleKey.append("ErrorManagerConfiguration.");
    bundleKey.append(ecuBundleKeyName);
    bundleKey.append(".");
    bundleKey.append(errorCodeNumber);
    bundleKey.append(bundlePostfix);
    return bundleKey.toString();
  }
  
  private String getText(String bundleKey, String fallbackBundleKey) {
    String text = bundle.getString(bundleKey);
    if (text.equals(bundleKey)) {
      LOGGER.warn("Missing text for key '{}'", bundleKey);
      return bundle.getString(fallbackBundleKey);
    } 
    return text;
  }
  
  private DtcResponse readDtcsFromEcu(AbstractDiagnosticSubtab subTab) {
    if (subTab == this.subTabProvider.getHmiTab())
      return this.serviceParameterDatapool.getErrorMemoryContent(ServiceParameter.Ecu.HMI); 
    if (subTab == this.subTabProvider.getBctTab())
      return this.serviceParameterDatapool.getErrorMemoryContent(ServiceParameter.Ecu.BCT); 
    if (subTab == this.subTabProvider.getDuTab())
      return this.serviceParameterDatapool.getErrorMemoryContent(ServiceParameter.Ecu.DU); 
    if (subTab == this.subTabProvider.getBms1Tab())
      return this.serviceParameterDatapool.getErrorMemoryContent(ServiceParameter.Ecu.BMS1); 
    if (subTab == this.subTabProvider.getBms2Tab())
      return this.serviceParameterDatapool.getErrorMemoryContent(ServiceParameter.Ecu.BMS2); 
    if (subTab == this.subTabProvider.getAbsTab())
      return this.serviceParameterDatapool.getErrorMemoryContent(ServiceParameter.Ecu.ABS); 
    if (subTab == this.subTabProvider.getBcsTab())
      return this.serviceParameterDatapool.getErrorMemoryContent(ServiceParameter.Ecu.BCS); 
    throw new IllegalArgumentException("No DTC service available for ECU '" + subTab.getTableComponentName() + "'");
  }
  
  private String determineEcuBundleKeyName(AbstractDiagnosticSubtab subTab) {
    if (subTab == this.subTabProvider.getHmiTab())
      return "HMI"; 
    if (subTab == this.subTabProvider.getBctTab())
      return "BCT"; 
    if (subTab == this.subTabProvider.getDuTab())
      return this.bikeIdentification.getSystemType().isClassicPlus() ? "DU" : "BDU"; 
    if (subTab == this.subTabProvider.getBms1Tab() || subTab == this.subTabProvider.getBms2Tab())
      return this.bikeIdentification.getSystemType().isClassicPlus() ? "BMS" : "BBP"; 
    if (subTab == this.subTabProvider.getAbsTab())
      return "ABS"; 
    if (subTab == this.subTabProvider.getBcsTab())
      return "BCS"; 
    throw new IllegalArgumentException("No DTC service available for ECU '" + subTab.getTableComponentName() + "'");
  }
}

package com.gigatronik.ebike.gui;

import com.gigatronik.beds.common.bct.BctState;
import com.gigatronik.beds.gui.panels.diagnostictab.subtab.AbstractDiagnosticSubtab;
import com.gigatronik.beds.gui.panels.diagnostictab.subtab.HmiSubtab;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.communication.api.CommunicationManager;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.rightsmanager.api.RightsManager;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.common.configuration.BikeIdentification;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.common.configuration.Constants;
import org.slf4j.Logger;
import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;

class DiagnosticTabParameterTableManager {
  private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(DiagnosticTab.class);
  
  private static final String PROGRESS_TEXT_ERROR_CODES = "EBikeServiceTab.progressText.ErrorCodes";
  
  private static final String PROGRESS_TEXT_HMI = "EBikeServiceTab.progressText.HMI";
  
  private static final String PROGRESS_TEXT_BCT = "EBikeServiceTab.progressText.BCT";
  
  private static final String PROGRESS_TEXT_DU = "EBikeServiceTab.progressText.DU";
  
  private static final String PROGRESS_TEXT_BMS = "EBikeServiceTab.progressText.BMS";
  
  private static final String PROGRESS_TEXT_ABS = "EBikeServiceTab.progressText.ABS";
  
  private static final String PROGRESS_TEXT_BCS = "EBikeServiceTab.progressText.BCS";
  
  private static final String PROGRESS_TEXT_ESHIFT = "EBikeServiceTab.progressText.ESHIFT";
  
  private final CommunicationManager communicationManager;
  
  private final BikeIdentification bikeIdentification;
  
  private final DiagnosticTabProgressDialogController progressDialogController;
  
  private final SubTabProvider subTabProvider;
  
  private final DiagnosticTabDtcTableManager dtcTableManager;
  
  private final RightsManager rightsManager;
  
  DiagnosticTabParameterTableManager(CommunicationManager communicationManager, BikeIdentification bikeIdentification, DiagnosticTabProgressDialogController diagnosticTabProgressDialogController, SubTabProvider subTabProvider, DiagnosticTabDtcTableManager diagnosticTabDtcTableManager, RightsManager rightsManager) {
    this.communicationManager = communicationManager;
    this.bikeIdentification = bikeIdentification;
    this.progressDialogController = diagnosticTabProgressDialogController;
    this.subTabProvider = subTabProvider;
    this.dtcTableManager = diagnosticTabDtcTableManager;
    this.rightsManager = rightsManager;
  }
  
  void readServiceParametersEbike() {
    int increment = computeProgressPerStepEbike();
    int currentProgress = increment;
    this.progressDialogController.setProgress(currentProgress, "EBikeServiceTab.progressText.ErrorCodes");
    readErrorMemoryFromAllEcus();
    currentProgress = incrementProgressAndUpdateUI(increment, currentProgress, "EBikeServiceTab.progressText.HMI");
    AbstractDiagnosticSubtab hmiSubTab = this.subTabProvider.getHmiTab();
    hmiSubTab.fillTable(true);
    ((HmiSubtab)hmiSubTab).readAndFillUDAM();
    if (this.bikeIdentification.isDuConnected()) {
      currentProgress = incrementProgressAndUpdateUI(increment, currentProgress, "EBikeServiceTab.progressText.DU");
      this.subTabProvider.getDuTab().fillTable(true);
    } 
    if (this.bikeIdentification.isBms1Connected()) {
      currentProgress = incrementProgressAndUpdateUI(increment, currentProgress, "EBikeServiceTab.progressText.BMS");
      this.subTabProvider.getBms1Tab().fillTable(true);
    } 
    if (this.bikeIdentification.isBms2Connected()) {
      currentProgress = incrementProgressAndUpdateUI(increment, currentProgress, "EBikeServiceTab.progressText.BMS");
      this.subTabProvider.getBms2Tab().fillTable(true);
    } 
    if (this.bikeIdentification.isAbsConnected()) {
      currentProgress = incrementProgressAndUpdateUI(increment, currentProgress, "EBikeServiceTab.progressText.ABS");
      this.subTabProvider.getAbsTab().fillTable(true);
    } 
    if (this.bikeIdentification.isEshiftConnected()) {
      currentProgress = incrementProgressAndUpdateUI(increment, currentProgress, "EBikeServiceTab.progressText.ESHIFT");
      this.subTabProvider.getEshiftTab().fillTable(true);
    } 
    if (this.bikeIdentification.isBcsConnected()) {
      incrementProgressAndUpdateUI(increment, currentProgress, "EBikeServiceTab.progressText.BCS");
      this.subTabProvider.getBcsTab().fillTable(true);
    } 
  }
  
  void readServiceParametersBct() {
    boolean shouldBmsBeRead = shouldBmsBeReadBctSession();
    int increment = computeProgressPerStepBct(shouldBmsBeRead);
    int currentProgress = increment;
    this.progressDialogController.setProgress(currentProgress, "EBikeServiceTab.progressText.ErrorCodes");
    this.dtcTableManager.readDtcsAndPopulateTable(this.subTabProvider.getBctTab());
    currentProgress = incrementProgressAndUpdateUI(increment, currentProgress, "EBikeServiceTab.progressText.BCT");
    this.subTabProvider.getBctTab().fillTable(true);
    if (shouldBmsBeRead) {
      currentProgress = incrementProgressAndUpdateUI(increment, currentProgress, "EBikeServiceTab.progressText.BMS");
      this.communicationManager.getBms1Com().executeExtendedSessionAndSecurityAccess(this.rightsManager.getUserLevel());
      currentProgress = incrementProgressAndUpdateUI(increment, currentProgress, "EBikeServiceTab.progressText.BMS");
      this.dtcTableManager.readDtcsAndPopulateTable(this.subTabProvider.getBms1Tab());
      currentProgress = incrementProgressAndUpdateUI(increment, currentProgress, "EBikeServiceTab.progressText.BMS");
      this.subTabProvider.getBms1Tab().fillTable(true);
      incrementProgressAndUpdateUI(increment, currentProgress, "EBikeServiceTab.progressText.BMS");
      this.communicationManager.getBms1Com().startDefaultSession(false);
    } 
  }
  
  void readServiceParameters(Constants.EcuType ecu) {
    LOGGER.debug("Read service parameters from ECUs '{}' and fill diagnostic tab table", ecu);
    int currentProgress = 34;
    int increment = 33;
    if (ecu.isDriveUnit()) {
      this.progressDialogController.setProgress(currentProgress, "EBikeServiceTab.progressText.DU");
      this.dtcTableManager.readDtcsAndPopulateTable(this.subTabProvider.getDuTab());
      currentProgress = incrementProgressAndUpdateUI(increment, currentProgress, "EBikeServiceTab.progressText.DU");
      this.subTabProvider.getDuTab().fillTable(true);
      incrementProgressAndUpdateUI(increment, currentProgress, "EBikeServiceTab.progressText.DU");
    } else if (ecu.isBattery1()) {
      this.progressDialogController.setProgress(currentProgress, "EBikeServiceTab.progressText.BMS");
      this.dtcTableManager.readDtcsAndPopulateTable(this.subTabProvider.getBms1Tab());
      currentProgress = incrementProgressAndUpdateUI(increment, currentProgress, "EBikeServiceTab.progressText.BMS");
      this.subTabProvider.getBms1Tab().fillTable(true);
      incrementProgressAndUpdateUI(increment, currentProgress, "EBikeServiceTab.progressText.BMS");
    } else if (ecu == Constants.EcuType.VICTOR_PP2) {
      this.progressDialogController.setProgress(currentProgress, "EBikeServiceTab.progressText.BMS");
      this.dtcTableManager.readDtcsAndPopulateTable(this.subTabProvider.getBms2Tab());
      currentProgress = incrementProgressAndUpdateUI(increment, currentProgress, "EBikeServiceTab.progressText.BMS");
      this.subTabProvider.getBms2Tab().fillTable(true);
      incrementProgressAndUpdateUI(increment, currentProgress, "EBikeServiceTab.progressText.BMS");
    } else if (ecu == Constants.EcuType.BAS100) {
      this.progressDialogController.setProgress(currentProgress, "EBikeServiceTab.progressText.ABS");
      this.dtcTableManager.readDtcsAndPopulateTable(this.subTabProvider.getAbsTab());
      currentProgress = incrementProgressAndUpdateUI(increment, currentProgress, "EBikeServiceTab.progressText.ABS");
      this.subTabProvider.getAbsTab().fillTable(true);
      incrementProgressAndUpdateUI(increment, currentProgress, "EBikeServiceTab.progressText.ABS");
    } else if (ecu == Constants.EcuType.BCS250) {
      this.progressDialogController.setProgress(currentProgress, "EBikeServiceTab.progressText.BCS");
      this.dtcTableManager.readDtcsAndPopulateTable(this.subTabProvider.getBcsTab());
      currentProgress = incrementProgressAndUpdateUI(increment, currentProgress, "EBikeServiceTab.progressText.BCS");
      this.subTabProvider.getBcsTab().fillTable(true);
      incrementProgressAndUpdateUI(increment, currentProgress, "EBikeServiceTab.progressText.BCS");
    } 
  }
  
  private int computeProgressPerStepBct(boolean shouldBmsBeRead) {
    int numberOfSteps = 3;
    if (shouldBmsBeRead)
      numberOfSteps += 4; 
    return 100 / numberOfSteps;
  }
  
  private int computeProgressPerStepEbike() {
    int numberOfSteps = 3;
    if (this.bikeIdentification.isDuConnected())
      numberOfSteps++; 
    if (this.bikeIdentification.isBms1Connected())
      numberOfSteps++; 
    if (this.bikeIdentification.isBms2Connected())
      numberOfSteps++; 
    if (this.bikeIdentification.isAbsConnected())
      numberOfSteps++; 
    if (this.bikeIdentification.isEshiftConnected())
      numberOfSteps++; 
    if (this.bikeIdentification.isBcsConnected())
      numberOfSteps++; 
    return 100 / numberOfSteps;
  }
  
  private void readErrorMemoryFromAllEcus() {
    if (this.bikeIdentification.getHmiIdentification().isApplication())
      this.dtcTableManager.readDtcsAndPopulateTable(this.subTabProvider.getHmiTab()); 
    if (this.bikeIdentification.getDuIdentification().isApplication())
      this.dtcTableManager.readDtcsAndPopulateTable(this.subTabProvider.getDuTab()); 
    if (this.bikeIdentification.getBms1Identification().isApplication())
      this.dtcTableManager.readDtcsAndPopulateTable(this.subTabProvider.getBms1Tab()); 
    if (this.bikeIdentification.getBms2Identification().isApplication())
      this.dtcTableManager.readDtcsAndPopulateTable(this.subTabProvider.getBms2Tab()); 
    if (this.bikeIdentification.getAbsIdentification().isApplication())
      this.dtcTableManager.readDtcsAndPopulateTable(this.subTabProvider.getAbsTab()); 
    if (this.bikeIdentification.getBcsIdentification().isApplication())
      this.dtcTableManager.readDtcsAndPopulateTable(this.subTabProvider.getBcsTab()); 
  }
  
  private boolean shouldBmsBeReadBctSession() {
    BctState bctState = this.communicationManager.getBctCom().readOperatingState();
    return (bctState == BctState.IDLE_BATTERY_SET);
  }
  
  private int incrementProgressAndUpdateUI(int increment, int currentProgress, String uiText) {
    currentProgress += increment;
    this.progressDialogController.setProgress(currentProgress, uiText);
    return currentProgress;
  }
}

package com.gigatronik.ebike.gui;

import com.gigatronik.ebike.gui.genericprogress.EBikeGenericProgressBar;
import org.slf4j.Logger;
import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;

class DiagnosticTabProgressDialogController {
  private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(DiagnosticTabProgressDialogController.class);
  
  private static final String PROGRESS_TEXT_INIT = "EBikeApplication.INITIALIZING_SYSTEM";
  
  private EBikeGenericProgressBar dialog;
  
  void openProgressBarDialog() {
    if (this.dialog == null) {
      LOGGER.debug("Open diagnostic tab progress dialog");
      this.dialog = EBikeGenericProgressBar.getInstance();
      this.dialog.setName("dlgProgressBar");
      this.dialog.showProgressBar();
    } 
    setProgress(0, "EBikeApplication.INITIALIZING_SYSTEM");
  }
  
  void closeProgressBarDialog() {
    if (this.dialog != null) {
      LOGGER.debug("Close diagnostic tab progress dialog");
      this.dialog.disposeProgressBar();
      this.dialog = null;
    } 
  }
  
  void setProgress(int percent, String messageKey) {
    if (this.dialog != null) {
      LOGGER.debug("Update diagnostic tab progress dialog to '{}' %", Integer.valueOf(percent));
      this.dialog.setProgressBarValue(percent);
      this.dialog.setProgressMessage(messageKey);
    } 
  }
}

package com.gigatronik.ebike.gui;

import com.gigatronik.beds.common.order.OrderableListener;
import com.gigatronik.beds.gui.panels.diagnostictab.subtab.AbstractDiagnosticSubtab;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.communication.api.CommunicationManager;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.communication.api.SecurityAccessFailurePopupHandler;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.communication.impl.SystemDiagnosticSessionResult;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.configuration.ConfigurationManager;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.configuration.api.HardwareConnectionChangesListener;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.configuration.event.HardwareConnectionChangedEvent;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.ecuconnectionstate.api.EcuConnectionStateHandler;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.bosch.service.internationalization.ResourceBundleFactory;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.bosch.service.internationalization.Utf8ResourceBundleFormatted;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.common.configuration.BikeIdentification;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.common.configuration.Constants;
import java.awt.EventQueue;
import org.slf4j.Logger;
import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;

class DiagnosticTabTableManager implements HardwareConnectionChangesListener {
  private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(DiagnosticTab.class);
  
  private static final Utf8ResourceBundleFormatted BUNDLE = ResourceBundleFactory.newDefaultResourceBundle();
  
  private final EcuConnectionStateHandler ecuConnectionStateHandler;
  
  private final StatusBarUpdater statusBarUpdater;
  
  private final BikeIdentification bikeIdentification;
  
  private final CyclicDataReadingManager cyclicDataReadingManager;
  
  private final CommunicationManager communicationManager;
  
  private final SecurityAccessFailurePopupHandler securityAccessFailurePopupHandler;
  
  private final SubTabProvider subTabProvider;
  
  private final DiagnosticTabDtcTableManager dtcTableManager;
  
  private final DiagnosticTabParameterTableManager parameterTableManager;
  
  private final DiagnosticTabProgressDialogController progressDialogController;
  
  DiagnosticTabTableManager(EcuConnectionStateHandler ecuConnectionStateHandler, CommunicationManager communicationManager, SecurityAccessFailurePopupHandler securityAccessFailurePopupHandler, StatusBarUpdater statusBarUpdate, BikeIdentification bikeIdentification, CyclicDataReadingManager cyclicDataReadingManager, ConfigurationManager configurationManager, SubTabProvider subTabProvider, DiagnosticTabDtcTableManager dtcTableManager, DiagnosticTabParameterTableManager parameterTableManager, DiagnosticTabProgressDialogController progressDialogController) {
    this.ecuConnectionStateHandler = ecuConnectionStateHandler;
    this.statusBarUpdater = statusBarUpdate;
    this.bikeIdentification = bikeIdentification;
    this.cyclicDataReadingManager = cyclicDataReadingManager;
    this.communicationManager = communicationManager;
    this.securityAccessFailurePopupHandler = securityAccessFailurePopupHandler;
    this.subTabProvider = subTabProvider;
    this.progressDialogController = progressDialogController;
    this.dtcTableManager = dtcTableManager;
    this.parameterTableManager = parameterTableManager;
    configurationManager.addListener((OrderableListener)this);
  }
  
  void readParametersAndPopulateTables(boolean reInitializeEcus) {
    readParametersAndPopulateTables(null, reInitializeEcus);
  }
  
  void readParametersAndPopulateTables(Constants.EcuType ecu, boolean reInitializeEcus) {
    LOGGER.debug("Diagnostic tab data gathering procedure triggered: ecu='{}', reInitializeEcus='{}'", ecu, Boolean.valueOf(reInitializeEcus));
    this.progressDialogController.openProgressBarDialog();
    this.ecuConnectionStateHandler.suspendConnectionStateDetection(false);
    this.cyclicDataReadingManager.suspendPolling();
    readServiceParameters(ecu, reInitializeEcus);
    this.cyclicDataReadingManager.resumePolling();
    this.ecuConnectionStateHandler.resumeConnectionStateDetection(false, false);
    this.progressDialogController.closeProgressBarDialog();
    updateStatusPanel();
    LOGGER.debug("Diagnostic tab data gathering procedure finished");
  }
  
  private void readServiceParameters(Constants.EcuType ecu, boolean reInitializeEcus) {
    try {
      readServiceParametersTry(ecu, reInitializeEcus);
    } catch (Exception ex) {
      LOGGER.error("Unexpected error occurred while gathering diagnostic tab data!", (Throwable)ex);
    } 
  }
  
  private void readServiceParametersTry(Constants.EcuType ecu, boolean reInitializeEcus) {
    if (reInitializeEcus)
      reInitializeEcus(); 
    if (ecu == null) {
      readServiceParameters();
    } else {
      this.parameterTableManager.readServiceParameters(ecu);
    } 
  }
  
  private void reInitializeEcus() {
    SystemDiagnosticSessionResult result = this.communicationManager.startSystemDiagnosticSession();
    if (!result.wasSuccessful())
      this.securityAccessFailurePopupHandler.displaySecurityAccessFailedDialog(false, result.getBadEcu()); 
  }
  
  private void readServiceParameters() {
    LOGGER.debug("Read service parameters from all connected ECUs and fill diagnostic tab tables");
    clearAllTables();
    if (this.bikeIdentification.isBctConnected()) {
      this.parameterTableManager.readServiceParametersBct();
    } else {
      this.parameterTableManager.readServiceParametersEbike();
    } 
  }
  
  private void updateStatusPanel() {
    if (this.bikeIdentification.isBctConnected()) {
      this.statusBarUpdater.showStatusInfo(BUNDLE.getString("EBikeStatus.GET_ECU_PARAMS_BCT"));
    } else {
      this.statusBarUpdater.showStatusInfo(BUNDLE.getString("EBikeStatus.GET_ECU_PARAMS"));
    } 
  }
  
  public void onHardwareConnectionChanged(HardwareConnectionChangedEvent event) {
    LOGGER.debug("HardwareConnectionChangedEvent received: '{}'", event);
    if (event.getAction() == HardwareConnectionChangedEvent.HardwareConnectionStateChange.ECU_DISCONNECTED && event.getComponent().isGatewayEcu())
      EventQueue.invokeLater(this::clearAllTables); 
  }
  
  private void clearAllTables() {
    this.subTabProvider.getHmiTab().clear();
    this.subTabProvider.getBctTab().clear();
    this.subTabProvider.getDuTab().clear();
    this.subTabProvider.getBms1Tab().clear();
    this.subTabProvider.getBms2Tab().clear();
    this.subTabProvider.getAbsTab().clear();
    this.subTabProvider.getBcsTab().clear();
    this.subTabProvider.getEshiftTab().clear();
  }
  
  void readDtcsAndPopulateTable(AbstractDiagnosticSubtab subTab) {
    this.dtcTableManager.readDtcsAndPopulateTable(subTab);
  }

package com.gigatronik.ebike.gui;

import com.gigatronik.beds.service.dongleblacklist.api.BlacklistDownloadStateChanged;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.dongleblacklist.api.BlacklistDownloadStateChangedListener;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.dongleblacklist.api.BlacklistIntegrityException;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.dongleblacklist.api.BlacklistUpdateListener;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.dongleblacklist.api.DongleBlacklistService;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.dongleblacklist.impl.DongleBlacklist;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.dongleblacklist.impl.DongleBlacklistFactory;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.donglemanager.api.DongleManager;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.donglemanager.api.DongleStateChangedEvent;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.donglemanager.api.DongleStateChangedEventListener;
import com.gigatronik.bosch.plugin.tokenproxy.TokenPluginProxy;
import com.gigatronik.bosch.plugin.unitoken.TokenException;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.bosch.service.internationalization.ResourceBundleFactory;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.bosch.service.internationalization.Utf8ResourceBundleFormatted;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.bosch.startproject.api.ApplicationController;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.framework.plugins.exceptions.ConfigurationNotFoundException;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.framework.plugins.interfaces.TokenDartPlugin;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.gui.testinterface.TestableJOptionPane;
import java.awt.EventQueue;
import java.lang.reflect.InvocationTargetException;
import org.slf4j.Logger;
import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;

public class DongleBlacklistEvaluator implements DongleStateChangedEventListener, BlacklistUpdateListener, BlacklistDownloadStateChangedListener {
  private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(DongleBlacklistEvaluator.class);
  
  private DongleBlacklistService blacklist;
  
  private final Utf8ResourceBundleFormatted bundle = ResourceBundleFactory.newDefaultResourceBundle();
  
  private final TokenDartPlugin dongle;
  
  private final ApplicationController appController;
  
  private final EBikeApplication eBikeApplication;
  
  private final DongleBlacklistFactory dongleBlacklistFactory;
  
  private boolean locked = false;
  
  private boolean alreadyStarted = false;
  
  public DongleBlacklistEvaluator(EBikeApplication eBikeApplication, ApplicationController applicationController, DongleBlacklistFactory dongleBlacklistFactory, DongleManager dongleMonitor) {
    this.dongleBlacklistFactory = dongleBlacklistFactory;
    this.eBikeApplication = eBikeApplication;
    this.dongle = TokenPluginProxy.getInstance().getToken(TokenPluginProxy.TokenType.LOCAL);
    this.appController = applicationController;
    dongleMonitor.addDongleStateListener(this);
  }
  
  public void onDongleStateChanged(DongleStateChangedEvent event) {
    LOGGER.debug("Received dongle state changed event '{}'", event);
    try {
      if (event.isDongleInitialized()) {
        this.blacklist = this.dongleBlacklistFactory.newBlacklistInstance();
        if (this.alreadyStarted) {
          isDongleBlacklisted();
        } else {
          this.blacklist.update(this);
          this.alreadyStarted = true;
        } 
      } 
    } catch (ConfigurationNotFoundException ex) {
      LOGGER.error("Failed to instantiate blacklist instance", (Throwable)ex);
    } catch (TokenException ex) {
      LOGGER.error("Failed to decrypt blacklist file key via dongle, block further tool usage!", (Throwable)ex);
      this.eBikeApplication.getDefaultDongleStateListener().displayDongleIsMissingDialog();
    } 
  }
  
  public void isDongleBlacklisted() {
    LOGGER.info("Check if Dongle is Blacklisted...");
    if (!this.locked) {
      String dongleId = this.dongle.getId();
      try {
        if (this.blacklist.isBlacklisted(dongleId)) {
          LOGGER.error("Dongle error BLX");
          showDongleBlacklistedDialog();
        } else {
          LOGGER.info("Dongle is not blacklisted");
        } 
      } catch (BlacklistIntegrityException ex) {
        LOGGER.error("Dongle error BLY", (Throwable)ex);
        showBlacklistManipulationDialog();
      } 
    } 
  }
  
  private synchronized void showDongleBlacklistedDialog() {
    showDialogAndClose(this.bundle.getString("dialog.dongle.error1.message"), this.bundle.getString("dialog.dongle.error1.title"));
  }
  
  private synchronized void showBlacklistManipulationDialog() {
    showDialogAndClose(this.bundle.getString("dialog.dongle.error2.message"), this.bundle.getString("dialog.dongle.error2.title"));
  }
  
  private void showDialogAndClose(String message, String title) {
    try {
      EventQueue.invokeAndWait(() -> {
            TestableJOptionPane.showMessageDialog(message, title, 0);
            this.appController.exit();
          });
    } catch (InvocationTargetException ex) {
      LOGGER.error("Displaying message box was interrupted", (Throwable)ex);
    } catch (InterruptedException in) {
      LOGGER.error("Error in thread. This thread was interrupted. Displaying message box was interrupted");
      Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
    } 
  }
  
  public void onUpdateCycleStart() {}
  
  public void onUpdateCycleEnd() {}
  
  public void onListAvailable(DongleBlacklist list) {
    try {
      this.blacklist = this.dongleBlacklistFactory.newBlacklistInstance();
      isDongleBlacklisted();
    } catch (ConfigurationNotFoundException ex) {
      LOGGER.error("Failed to instantiate blacklist instance", (Throwable)ex);
    } catch (TokenException ex) {
      LOGGER.error("Failed to decrypt blacklist file key via dongle, block further tool usage!", (Throwable)ex);
      this.eBikeApplication.getDefaultDongleStateListener().displayDongleIsMissingDialog();
    } 
  }
  
  public void onDownloadFailed(BlacklistDownloadStateChanged event) {
    String dongleId = this.dongle.getId();
    try {
      if (this.blacklist.isBlacklisted(dongleId)) {
        LOGGER.error("Dongle error BLX");
        this.locked = true;
        showDongleBlacklistedDialog();
      } 
    } catch (BlacklistIntegrityException ex) {
      LOGGER.error("Dongle error BLY", (Throwable)ex);
      this.locked = true;
      showBlacklistManipulationDialog();
    } 
  }
}

  public void setRemoteFlashActive(boolean state) {
    if (RemotePluginFacade.getInstance().isRemoteEnabled() && isRemoteSessionActive()) {
      boolean screenUpdateEnabled = true;
      try {
        screenUpdateEnabled = SettingsProxy.getInstance().getGlobalSettings().getBoolean("remote.screenupdate.on.flashing");
      } catch (ConfigurationNotFoundException ex) {
        LOGGER.debug("Property to deactivate screen update while flash process not found, error={}.", ex.getMessage());
      } 
      if (!screenUpdateEnabled)
        fireRemoteFlashState(state); 
    } 
  }
  
  public void onFlashUpdateFinished(FlashResult result) {

  }
  
  private void fireRemoteFlashState(boolean state) {
    LOGGER.debug("Remote Flash-Process state changed to: {}", Boolean.valueOf(state));
    if (state) {
      LOGGER.info("Remote Session active, Screen-Capturing will be paused before flashing...");
      try {
        EventQueue.invokeAndWait(() -> 
            TestableJOptionPane.showMessageDialog(BUNDLE.getString("EBikeApplication.RemoteFlashWin10.Dialog.text"), 
              BUNDLE.getString("EBikeApplication.RemoteFlashWin10.Dialog.title"), 1));
      } catch (InvocationTargetException ex) {
        LOGGER.error("Failed to display remote flashing dialog", (Throwable)ex);
      } catch (InterruptedException in) {
        LOGGER.error("Error in thread. This thread was interrupted. Failed to display remote flashing dialog");
        Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
      } 
    } 
    LOGGER.debug("Updating Remote Flash-Process state to: {}", Boolean.valueOf(state));
    RemotePluginFacade.getInstance().updateFlashState(state);
  }
  
  public boolean isRemoteSessionActive() {
    return (RemotePluginFacade.getInstance().isRemoteEnabled() && this.remSessionActive);

  private void createInactivityDetectorInstance() {
    if (this.inactivityDetector == null) {
      int rectSideLenght;
      try {
        rectSideLenght = SettingsProxy.getInstance().getInternalSettings().getInteger("com.gigatronik.userinactivity.inactivityRectLength");
      } catch (ConfigurationNotFoundException ex) {
        rectSideLenght = 200;
        LOGGER.warn("Error reading com.gigatronik.userinactivity.inactivityRectLength from internal settings. Set to default value: 200", (Throwable)ex);
      } 
      InactivityDetectorFactory factory = new InactivityDetectorFactory(rectSideLenght);
      this.inactivityDetector = factory.createInactivityDetectorInstance();
      this.inactivityDetector.subscribe((InactivityDetector.InactivityListener)this.communicationManager);
      this.inactivityDetector.subscribe((InactivityDetector.InactivityListener)this.ecuConnectionStateHandler);
    } 
  }

  public void startUp() throws ConfigurationNotFoundException, InterruptedException {
    LOGGER.info("Start up application...");
    if (this.rightsManager.getUserLevel() == UserLevel.UNKNOWN)
      this.dongleMonitor.fireInitialState(); 
    LOGGER.info("Start up: Waiting for dongle connected...");
    waitForDongleConnection();
    LOGGER.info("Start up: Waiting for dongle rights set...");
    this.rightsManager.waitForRightsInitialized();
    LOGGER.info("Start up: dongle UserLevel: {}", this.rightsManager.getUserLevel());
    ensureValidUserLevel();
    if (!this.remSessionActive && this.rightsManager.isUserInLevel(UserLevel.OEM) && this.manufacturingLog.checkOnStart()) {
      ManufactureLogGuiController manufactureLogGuiController = new ManufactureLogGuiController(this.manufacturingLog);
      manufactureLogGuiController.saveManufactureLogToFileForced();
    } 
    if (!this.remSessionActive && this.rightsManager.isUserInLevel(UserLevel.IBD))
      checkForSoftwareUpdate(); 
    createInactivityDetectorInstance();
    startDetectingInactivity();
    this.ecuConnectionStateHandler.startConnectionStateDetection();
    LOGGER.info("Application start up finished. DiagnosticTool is ready to use.");
  }
  
  private void ensureValidUserLevel() {
    if (this.rightsManager.getUserLevel() == null || this.rightsManager.getUserLevel() == UserLevel.UNKNOWN)
      this.invalidDongleConnectionHandler.handleInvalidDongleConnection(true); 
  }
  
  private void checkForSoftwareUpdate() throws InterruptedException {
    SoftwareUpdate swUpdate = new SoftwareUpdate(this, new UpdateServerConnection());
    FutureTask task = new FutureTask(() -> {
          swUpdate.checkForSoftwareUpdate(ConfigUtil.getFullVersion().toString());
          return true;
        });
    ExecutorService scheduler = Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor();
    scheduler.submit(task);
    scheduler.shutdown();
    try {
      task.get();
    } catch (ExecutionException ex) {
      LOGGER.error("Failed to check for or download software update", (Throwable)ex);
    } catch (InterruptedException ex) {
      LOGGER.error("Thread interrupted on software update", (Throwable)ex);
      throw ex;
    } 
  }
  
  private void initDataMining() {
    if (DataMining.isDataMiningEnabled()) {
      this.dataMining = new DataMining(this.configurationManager, this.communicationManager, this.rightsManager, this.bctEventHandler, new UpdateServerConnection(), ConfigUtil.getDisplayVersion());
    } else {
      LOGGER.info("DataMining disabled");
    } 
  }
  
  private void initGuiManager() {

  }
  
  private void initStandbyDetector(ApplicationController appController) {
    int gracePeriod = determineStandbyDetectionGracePeriod();
    StandbyDetectorImpl standbyDetectorImpl = new StandbyDetectorImpl(UtilsFactory.get().timeProvider(), 
        Executors.newSingleThreadScheduledExecutor(new BasicThreadFactory.Builder().namingPattern("standby-detector-%d").priority(10).build()), gracePeriod);
    standbyDetectorImpl.subscribe(new RestartApplicationStandbyListener(appController));
  }
  
  private int determineStandbyDetectionGracePeriod() {
    int gracePeriod;
    try {
      gracePeriod = SettingsProxy.getInstance().getInternalSettings().getInteger("com.gigatronik.standbydetector.graceperiod");
    } catch (ConfigurationNotFoundException ex) {
      LOGGER.error("'com.gigatronik.standbydetector.graceperiod' missing in internal settings, set default {}ms", Integer.valueOf(5000), ex);
      gracePeriod = 5000;
    } 
    return gracePeriod;
  }
  
  private void initStandbyPrevention() {
    MouseInterface mouseInterface;
    int gracePeriod = determineStandbyPreventionGracePeriod();
    try {
      mouseInterface = UtilsFactory.get().mouseInterface();
    } catch (AWTException e) {
      LOGGER.error("Failed to instantiate mouse interface, StandbyPreventionService will not be started", (Throwable)e);
      return;
    } 
    new StandbyPreventionService(Executors.newSingleThreadScheduledExecutor(new BasicThreadFactory.Builder().namingPattern("Standby-Prevention-Thread-%d").build()), mouseInterface, 
        
        RemotePluginFacade.getInstance(), gracePeriod);
  }
  
  private int determineStandbyPreventionGracePeriod() {
    int gracePeriod;
    try {
      gracePeriod = SettingsProxy.getInstance().getInternalSettings().getInteger("com.gigatronik.beds.service.standbyprevention");
    } catch (ConfigurationNotFoundException ex) {
      LOGGER.error("'com.gigatronik.beds.service.standbyprevention' missing in internal settings, set default {}ms", Integer.valueOf(60000), ex);
      gracePeriod = 60000;
    } 
    return gracePeriod;
  }
  
  private void initPreliminaryContainerDownloader() {
    FirmwareUpdate fwUpdate = new FirmwareUpdate(this, this.configurationManager.getBikeIdentification(), this.bctEventHandler);
    BikeIdentification bikeIdentification = this.configurationManager.getBikeIdentification();
    PreliminaryContainerDownloaderFactory.createPreliminaryContainerDownloader(this.configurationManager.getContainerConfiguration().getContainerController(), bikeIdentification, ConfigUtil.getDisplayVersion(), bikeIdentification.getSystemType());
    new FirmwareUpdatesManager(this.rightsManager, fwUpdate, this.configurationManager);
  }
  
  public void quit(int exitCode, boolean confirmationDialog) {
    int answer;
    String msg = BUNDLE.getString("EBikeApplication.quit.optionPane.message");
    String title = BUNDLE.getString("EBikeApplication.quit.optionPane.title");
    if (confirmationDialog) {
      answer = TestableJOptionPane.showConfirmDialog(msg, title, 0);
    } else {
      answer = 0;
    } 
    if (answer == 0) {
      LOGGER.info("quit(): User quitting the application.");
      try {
        ManufactureLogGuiController manufactureLogGuiController = new ManufactureLogGuiController(this.manufacturingLog);
        if (this.rightsManager.isUserInLevel(UserLevel.OEM) && !manufactureLogGuiController.saveOnExit())
          return; 
      } catch (ConfigurationNotFoundException e) {
        LOGGER.error("Unable to save manufacture log", (Throwable)e);
        return;
      } 
      if (this.dataMining != null)
        this.dataMining.onApplicationClosed(); 
      this.ecuConnectionStateHandler.suspendConnectionStateDetection(true);
      this.communicationManager.startSystemDefaultSession();
      this.frame.saveWindowPositionAndSize();
      this.frame.dispose();
      this.applicationController.exit();
    } 
  }
  
  public void resetGui() {
    this.configurationManager.clearContainer();
    this.configurationManager.clearConfiguration();
    GuiManagerImpl.getInstance().reset();
  }
  
  public void showStatusInfo(String text) {
    EBikeApplicationPanel appPanel = (this.frame == null) ? null : this.frame.getApplicationPanel();
    if (appPanel != null)
      appPanel.geteBikeStatus().showInfo(text); 
  }
  
  public void showStatusInfo(String text, int tab) {
    EBikeApplicationPanel appPanel = (this.frame == null) ? null : this.frame.getApplicationPanel();
    if (appPanel != null)
      appPanel.geteBikeStatus().showInfo(text, tab);

      if (this.remoteTokenThread == null)
        this

          
          .remoteTokenThread = new RemoteTokenThread(this.rightsManager, new ScheduledThreadPoolExecutor(1, new BasicThreadFactory.Builder().namingPattern("RemoteTokenThread-%d").build()), (RemoteClientDartPlugin)RemotePluginFacade.getInstance(), TokenPluginProxy::getInstance); 
      this.remoteTokenThread.start();
    } 
  }

    this.remSessionActive = established;
    if (!established && this.remoteTokenThread != null)
      this.remoteTokenThread.stop(); 
  }
  
  public void onConnectedBikeChargingStateChanges(ChargingStateEvent event) {
    switch (event.getState()) {
      case START_CHARGING:
        if (this.chargingDialog == null) {
          this.chargingDialog = new EBikeChargingDialog((JFrame)this.frame, event.getMessage());
          this.chargingDialog.setName("dlgCharging");
          this.chargingDialog.showDialog();
        } 
        break;
      case STOP_CHARGING:
        if (this.chargingDialog != null) {
          this.chargingDialog.disposeDialog();
          this.chargingDialog = null;
        } 
        break;
    } 
  }

    this.progressSimulator.stop();

  private String getChargingText(ChargingStateEvent.ChargingMessage message) {
    String chargingText;
    switch (message) {
      case IBD_HINT:
        chargingText = BUNDLE.getString("EBikeChargingDialog.lblCharging.ibdHint.text");
        break;
      case EBIKE_AND_DUALBAT:
        chargingText = BUNDLE.getString("EBikeChargingDialog.lblCharging.ebikeAndDualbat.text");
        break;
      case EBIKE:
        chargingText = BUNDLE.getString("EBikeChargingDialog.lblCharging.ebike.text");
        break;
      case DUALBAT:
        chargingText = BUNDLE.getString("EBikeChargingDialog.lblCharging.dualbat.text");
        break;
      default:
        chargingText = BUNDLE.getString("EBikeChargingDialog.lblCharging.text");
        break;
    } 
    return chargingText;
  }
}

  public static void showESLosError(List<String[]> errorMessage, int numberOfDialogs, EBikeESLosErrorDialog dialog) {
    try {
      int dialogCount = 0;
      int messageCounter = 0;
      while (dialogCount < numberOfDialogs) {
        StringBuilder builder = new StringBuilder();
        dialogCount++;
        if (numberOfDialogs == dialogCount) {
          for (int i = messageCounter; i < errorMessage.size(); i++) {
            if (!"".equals(((String[])errorMessage.get(i))[2])) {
              LOGGER.info("showESLosError()");
              builder.append("" + i + 1 + ".");
              builder.append("\n");
              builder.append(((String[])errorMessage.get(i))[2]);
              if (!StringUtils.isBlank(((String[])errorMessage.get(i))[0]))
                builder.append(" (ID " + ((String[])errorMessage.get(i))[0] + ")"); 
              builder.append("\n");
              builder.append("\n");
            } 
          } 
        } else {
          for (int i = messageCounter; i < messageCounter + 10; i++) {
            if (!StringUtils.isBlank(((String[])errorMessage.get(i))[2])) {
              LOGGER.info("showESLosError()");
              builder.append("" + i + 1 + ".");
              builder.append("\n");
              builder.append(((String[])errorMessage.get(i))[2]);
              if (!StringUtils.isBlank(((String[])errorMessage.get(i))[0]))
                builder.append(" (ID " + ((String[])errorMessage.get(i))[0] + ")"); 
              builder.append("\n");
              builder.append("\n");
            } 
          } 
          messageCounter += 10;
        } 
        dialog.setName("dlgESLosErrorDialog");
        dialog.txtAreaErrorText.setText(builder.toString());
        dialog.setVisible(true);
      } 
    } catch (Exception e) {
      LOGGER.error("Exception showing errors", (Throwable)e);
    } 
  }
}

public class EBikeFlashwareUpdateDialog extends TestableJDialog {
  private static final long serialVersionUID = 7283380050295079682L;
  
  private static final Utf8ResourceBundleFormatted BUNDLE = ResourceBundleFactory.newDefaultResourceBundle();
  
  private final JPanel contentPanel = new JPanel();
  
  private final transient BikeIdentification bikeIdentification;
  
  private final int heightVersions = 30;
  
  private final int heightRelNotes = 100;
  
  private final int weight = 0;
  
  private int returnValue = 1;
  
  private Boolean bNewDataAvaiable = false;
  
  private GridBagLayout gbl_contentPanel;
  
  private JLabel lblHmiSwVersionText;
  
  private JLabel lblHmiSwVersion;
  
  private JLabel lblHmiSwVersionApplText;
  
  private JLabel lblHmiSwVersionAppl;
  
  private JLabel lblHmiSwVersionBackendText;
  
  private JLabel lblHmiSwVersionBackend;
  
  private JLabel lblDriveUnitSwVersionText;
  
  private JLabel lblDriveUnitSwVersion;
  
  private JLabel lblAbsSwVersionText;
  
  private JLabel lblAbsSwVersion;
  
  private JLabel lblBatterySwVersionText;
  
  private JLabel lblBatterySwVersion;
  
  private JLabel lblBctSwVersionText;
  
  private JLabel lblBctSwVersion;
  
  private JLabel lblBcsSwVersionText;
  
  private JLabel lblBcsSwVersion;
  
  private JTextPane txtHmiSwVersionReleaseNotes;
  
  private JTextPane txtHmiSwVersionApplReleaseNotes;
