  private JScrollPane spAbsSwVersionReleaseNotes;
  
  private JScrollPane spBatterySwVersionReleaseNotes;
  
  private JScrollPane spBcsSwVersionReleaseNotes;
  
  public EBikeFlashwareUpdateDialog(BikeIdentification bikeIdent) {
    super(TestableJOptionPane.getDefaultParentFrame());
    this.bikeIdentification = bikeIdent;
    setResizable(false);
    setPreferredSize(new Dimension(800, 600));
    setMaximumSize(new Dimension(800, 600));
    getContentPane().setLayout(new BorderLayout());
    this.contentPanel.setBorder(new EmptyBorder(5, 5, 5, 5));
    this.contentPanel.setName("pnlFlashwareUpdateDialog");
    getContentPane().add(this.contentPanel, "Center");
    GridBagLayout gbl_contentPanel = new GridBagLayout();
    gbl_contentPanel.columnWidths = new int[] { 30, 600, 70, 30, 0 };
    gbl_contentPanel.rowHeights = new int[] { 
        0, 25, 50, 0, 50, 0, 50, 0, 42, 0, 
        50, 0, 0 };
    gbl_contentPanel.columnWeights = new double[] { 1.0D, 1.0D, 0.0D, 1.0D, Double.MIN_VALUE };
    gbl_contentPanel.rowWeights = new double[] { 
        0.0D, 0.0D, 1.0D, 0.0D, 1.0D, 0.0D, 1.0D, 0.0D, 0.0D, 0.0D, 
        1.0D, 0.0D, Double.MIN_VALUE };
    this.contentPanel.setLayout(gbl_contentPanel);
    JLabel lblUpdateAvailable = new JLabel(BUNDLE.getString("EBikeFlashwareUpdateDialog.lblUpdateAvailable.text"));
    lblUpdateAvailable.setName("lblUpdateAvailable");
    GridBagConstraints gbc_lblUpdateAvailable = new GridBagConstraints();
    gbc_lblUpdateAvailable.anchor = 17;
    gbc_lblUpdateAvailable.gridwidth = 2;
    gbc_lblUpdateAvailable.insets = new Insets(5, 0, 5, 5);
    gbc_lblUpdateAvailable.gridx = 1;
    gbc_lblUpdateAvailable.gridy = 0;
    this.contentPanel.add(lblUpdateAvailable, gbc_lblUpdateAvailable);
    addHmiGuiElements();
    addHmiApplGuiElements();
    addHmiBackendGuiElements();
    addDuGuiElements();
    addBatGuiElements();
    addAbsGuiElements();
    addBctGuiElements();
    addBcsGuiElements();
    JLabel lblUpdateQuestion = new JLabel(BUNDLE.getString("EBikeFlashwareUpdateDialog.lblUpdateQuestion.text"));
    lblUpdateQuestion.setName("lblUpdateQuestion");
    GridBagConstraints gbc_lblUpdateQuestion = new GridBagConstraints();
    gbc_lblUpdateQuestion.anchor = 17;
    gbc_lblUpdateQuestion.gridwidth = 2;
    gbc_lblUpdateQuestion.insets = new Insets(0, 0, 0, 5);
    gbc_lblUpdateQuestion.gridx = 1;
    gbc_lblUpdateQuestion.gridy = 13;
    this.contentPanel.add(lblUpdateQuestion, gbc_lblUpdateQuestion);
    JPanel buttonPane = new JPanel();
    buttonPane.setLayout(new FlowLayout(1));
    buttonPane.setName("flashwareUpdateDlgBtnPane");
    getContentPane().add(buttonPane, "South");
    JButton btnYes = new JButton(BUNDLE.getString("JOptionPane.Yes"));
    btnYes.setName("btnYes");
    btnYes.addActionListener(new ActionListener() {
          public void actionPerformed(ActionEvent e) {
            EBikeFlashwareUpdateDialog.this.returnValue = 0;
            EBikeFlashwareUpdateDialog.this.setVisible(false);
            EBikeFlashwareUpdateDialog.this.dispose();
          }
        });
    buttonPane.add(btnYes);
    getRootPane().setDefaultButton(btnYes);
    JButton btnNo = new JButton(BUNDLE.getString("JOptionPane.No"));
    btnNo.setName("btnNo");
    btnNo.addActionListener(new ActionListener() {
          public void actionPerformed(ActionEvent e) {
            EBikeFlashwareUpdateDialog.this.returnValue = 1;
            EBikeFlashwareUpdateDialog.this.setVisible(false);
            EBikeFlashwareUpdateDialog.this.dispose();
          }
        });
    buttonPane.add(btnNo);
    setModal(true);
    setTitle(BUNDLE.getString("EBikeFlashwareUpdateDialog.title.text"));
    setDefaultCloseOperation(0);
    pack();
    setLocationRelativeTo(TestableJOptionPane.getDefaultParentFrame());
    setVisible(false);
    addWindowListener(new WindowAdapter() {
          public void windowClosing(WindowEvent e) {
            EBikeFlashwareUpdateDialog.this.returnValue = 1;
            EBikeFlashwareUpdateDialog.this.setVisible(false);
            EBikeFlashwareUpdateDialog.this.dispose();
          }
        });
  }
  
  public int showDialog() {
    int height = 0;
    for (int h : this.gbl_contentPanel.rowHeights)
      height += h; 
    height += 50;
    this.contentPanel.setPreferredSize(new Dimension(getWidth(), height));
    setPreferredSize(new Dimension(getWidth(), height + 40));
    pack();
    setLocationRelativeTo(TestableJOptionPane.getDefaultParentFrame());
    this.returnValue = 1;
    if (this.bNewDataAvaiable)
      setVisible(true); 
    return this.returnValue;
  }
  
  public boolean isNewDataAvailable() {
    return this.bNewDataAvaiable;
  }
  
  public void prepareNewData(Map<String, String> versions) {
    this.gbl_contentPanel = (GridBagLayout)this.contentPanel.getLayout();
    this.gbl_contentPanel.rowHeights[2] = 0;
    this.gbl_contentPanel.rowHeights[4] = 0;
    this.gbl_contentPanel.rowHeights[6] = 0;
    this.gbl_contentPanel.rowHeights[8] = 0;
    this.gbl_contentPanel.rowHeights[10] = 0;
    this.gbl_contentPanel.rowHeights[12] = 0;
    this.gbl_contentPanel.rowHeights[0] = 25;
    this.gbl_contentPanel.rowHeights[1] = 0;
    this.gbl_contentPanel.rowHeights[3] = 0;
    this.gbl_contentPanel.rowHeights[5] = 0;
    this.gbl_contentPanel.rowHeights[7] = 0;
    this.gbl_contentPanel.rowHeights[9] = 0;
    this.gbl_contentPanel.rowHeights[11] = 0;
    this.gbl_contentPanel.rowWeights[2] = 0.0D;
    this.gbl_contentPanel.rowWeights[3] = 0.0D;
    this.gbl_contentPanel.rowWeights[4] = 0.0D;
    this.gbl_contentPanel.rowWeights[5] = 0.0D;
    this.gbl_contentPanel.rowWeights[6] = 0.0D;
    this.gbl_contentPanel.rowWeights[7] = 0.0D;
    this.gbl_contentPanel.rowWeights[8] = 0.0D;
    this.gbl_contentPanel.rowWeights[9] = 0.0D;
    this.gbl_contentPanel.rowWeights[10] = 0.0D;
    this.gbl_contentPanel.rowWeights[11] = 0.0D;
    this.gbl_contentPanel.rowWeights[12] = 0.0D;
    this.spHmiSwVersionBackendReleaseNotes.setVisible(false);
    this.spHmiSwVersionApplReleaseNotes.setVisible(false);
    this.spDriveUnitSwVersionReleaseNotes.setVisible(false);
    this.spBatterySwVersionReleaseNotes.setVisible(false);
    this.spHmiSwVersionReleaseNotes.setVisible(false);
    this.spAbsSwVersionReleaseNotes.setVisible(false);
    this.spBcsSwVersionReleaseNotes.setVisible(false);
    this.bNewDataAvaiable = false;
    if (versions.containsKey("Bcs_Sw_Version")) {
      this.bNewDataAvaiable = true;
      this.lblBcsSwVersionText.setVisible(true);
      this.lblBcsSwVersionText.setText(this.lblBcsSwVersionText.getText() + this.lblBcsSwVersionText.getText());
      this.gbl_contentPanel.rowHeights[1] = 30;
      if (versions.containsKey("Bcs_Sw_RelNotes")) {
        this.spBcsSwVersionReleaseNotes.setVisible(true);
        this.txtBcsSwVersionReleaseNotes.setVisible(true);
        this.txtBcsSwVersionReleaseNotes.setText(versions.get("Bcs_Sw_RelNotes"));
        this.gbl_contentPanel.rowHeights[2] = 100;
      } 
    } else {
      if (this.bikeIdentification.getHmiIdentification().getComponentType().isBUI27x()) {
        if (versions.containsKey("backend-app")) {
          this.bNewDataAvaiable = true;
          this.lblHmiSwVersionBackendText.setVisible(true);
          this.lblHmiSwVersionBackendText.setText(this.lblHmiSwVersionBackendText.getText() + this.lblHmiSwVersionBackendText.getText());
          this.gbl_contentPanel.rowHeights[5] = 30;
          if (versions.containsKey("backend-RelNotes")) {
            this.spHmiSwVersionBackendReleaseNotes.setVisible(true);
            this.txtHmiSwVersionBackendReleaseNotes.setVisible(true);
            this.txtHmiSwVersionBackendReleaseNotes.setText(versions.get("backend-RelNotes"));
            this.gbl_contentPanel.rowHeights[6] = 100;
          } 
        } else {
          this.lblHmiSwVersionBackendText.setVisible(false);
          this.lblHmiSwVersionBackend.setVisible(false);
        } 
        if (versions.containsKey("frontend-app")) {
          this.bNewDataAvaiable = true;
          this.lblHmiSwVersionApplText.setVisible(true);
          this.lblHmiSwVersionApplText.setText(this.lblHmiSwVersionApplText.getText() + this.lblHmiSwVersionApplText.getText());
          this.gbl_contentPanel.rowHeights[3] = 30;
          if (versions.containsKey("frontend-RelNotes")) {
            this.spHmiSwVersionApplReleaseNotes.setVisible(true);
            this.txtHmiSwVersionApplReleaseNotes.setVisible(true);
            this.txtHmiSwVersionApplReleaseNotes.setText(versions.get("frontend-RelNotes"));
            this.gbl_contentPanel.rowHeights[4] = 100;
          } 
        } else {
          this.lblHmiSwVersionApplText.setVisible(false);
          this.lblHmiSwVersionAppl.setVisible(false);
        } 
      } else if (versions.containsKey("Hmi_Sw_Version")) {
        this.bNewDataAvaiable = true;
        this.lblHmiSwVersionText.setVisible(true);
        this.lblHmiSwVersionText.setText(this.lblHmiSwVersionText.getText() + this.lblHmiSwVersionText.getText());
        this.gbl_contentPanel.rowHeights[1] = 30;
        if (versions.containsKey("Hmi_Sw-RelNotes")) {
          this.spHmiSwVersionReleaseNotes.setVisible(true);
          this.txtHmiSwVersionReleaseNotes.setVisible(true);
          this.txtHmiSwVersionReleaseNotes.setText(versions.get("Hmi_Sw-RelNotes"));
          this.gbl_contentPanel.rowHeights[2] = 100;
        } 
      } else if (versions.containsKey("Bct_Sw_Version")) {
        this.bNewDataAvaiable = true;
        this.lblBctSwVersionText.setVisible(true);
        this.lblBctSwVersionText.setText(this.lblBctSwVersionText.getText() + this.lblBctSwVersionText.getText());
        this.gbl_contentPanel.rowHeights[1] = 30;
      } else {
        this.lblHmiSwVersionText.setVisible(false);
        this.lblHmiSwVersion.setVisible(false);
        this.lblBctSwVersionText.setVisible(false);
        this.lblBctSwVersion.setVisible(false);
      } 
      if (this.bikeIdentification.getSystemType() == Constants.SystemType.CLASSIC_PLUS) {
        if (versions.containsKey("Bms_Sw_Version")) {
          this.bNewDataAvaiable = true;
          this.lblBatterySwVersionText.setVisible(true);
          this.lblBatterySwVersionText.setText(this.lblBatterySwVersionText.getText() + this.lblBatterySwVersionText.getText());
          this.gbl_contentPanel.rowHeights[9] = 30;
          if (versions.containsKey("Bms_Sw-RelNotes")) {
            this.spBatterySwVersionReleaseNotes.setVisible(true);
            this.txtBatterySwVersionReleaseNotes.setVisible(true);
            this.txtBatterySwVersionReleaseNotes.setText(versions.get("Bms_Sw-RelNotes"));
            this.gbl_contentPanel.rowHeights[10] = 100;
          } 
        } else {
          this.lblBatterySwVersionText.setVisible(false);
          this.lblBatterySwVersion.setVisible(false);
        } 
        if (versions.containsKey("Du_Sw_Version")) {
          this.bNewDataAvaiable = true;
          this.lblDriveUnitSwVersionText.setVisible(true);
          this.lblDriveUnitSwVersionText.setText(this.lblDriveUnitSwVersionText.getText() + this.lblDriveUnitSwVersionText.getText());
          this.gbl_contentPanel.rowHeights[7] = 30;
          if (versions.containsKey("Du_Sw-RelNotes")) {
            this.spDriveUnitSwVersionReleaseNotes.setVisible(true);
            this.txtDriveUnitSwVersionReleaseNotes.setVisible(true);
            this.txtDriveUnitSwVersionReleaseNotes.setText(versions.get("Du_Sw-RelNotes"));
            this.gbl_contentPanel.rowHeights[8] = 100;
          } 
        } else {
          this.lblDriveUnitSwVersionText.setVisible(false);
          this.lblDriveUnitSwVersion.setVisible(false);
        } 
      } else {
        if (versions.containsKey("Bbp1_Sw_Version")) {
          this.bNewDataAvaiable = true;
          this.lblBatterySwVersionText.setVisible(true);
          this.lblBatterySwVersionText.setText(this.lblBatterySwVersionText.getText() + this.lblBatterySwVersionText.getText());
          this.gbl_contentPanel.rowHeights[9] = 30;
          if (versions.containsKey("Bbp1_Sw-RelNotes")) {
            this.spBatterySwVersionReleaseNotes.setVisible(true);
            this.txtBatterySwVersionReleaseNotes.setVisible(true);
            this.txtBatterySwVersionReleaseNotes.setText(new String(versions.get("Bbp1_Sw-RelNotes")));
            this.gbl_contentPanel.rowHeights[10] = 100;
          } 
        } else if (versions.containsKey("Bbp2_Sw_Version")) {
          this.bNewDataAvaiable = true;
          this.lblBatterySwVersionText.setVisible(true);
          this.lblBatterySwVersionText.setText(this.lblBatterySwVersionText.getText() + this.lblBatterySwVersionText.getText());
          this.gbl_contentPanel.rowHeights[9] = 30;
          if (versions.containsKey("Bbp2_Sw-RelNotes")) {
            this.spBatterySwVersionReleaseNotes.setVisible(true);
            this.txtBatterySwVersionReleaseNotes.setVisible(true);
            this.txtBatterySwVersionReleaseNotes.setText(new String(versions.get("Bbp2_Sw-RelNotes")));
            this.gbl_contentPanel.rowHeights[10] = 100;
          } 
        } else {
          this.lblBatterySwVersionText.setVisible(false);
          this.lblBatterySwVersion.setVisible(false);
        } 
        if (versions.containsKey("Bdu_Sw_Version")) {
          this.bNewDataAvaiable = true;
          this.lblDriveUnitSwVersionText.setVisible(true);
          this.lblDriveUnitSwVersionText.setText(this.lblDriveUnitSwVersionText.getText() + this.lblDriveUnitSwVersionText.getText());
          this.gbl_contentPanel.rowHeights[7] = 30;
          if (versions.containsKey("Bdu_Sw-RelNotes")) {
            this.spDriveUnitSwVersionReleaseNotes.setVisible(true);
            this.txtDriveUnitSwVersionReleaseNotes.setVisible(true);
            this.txtDriveUnitSwVersionReleaseNotes.setText(new String(versions.get("Bdu_Sw-RelNotes")));
            this.gbl_contentPanel.rowHeights[8] = 100;
          } 
        } else {
          this.lblDriveUnitSwVersionText.setVisible(false);
          this.lblDriveUnitSwVersion.setVisible(false);
        } 
        if (versions.containsKey("Abs_Sw_Version")) {
          this.bNewDataAvaiable = true;
          this.lblAbsSwVersionText.setVisible(true);
          this.lblAbsSwVersionText.setText(this.lblAbsSwVersionText.getText() + this.lblAbsSwVersionText.getText());
          this.gbl_contentPanel.rowHeights[11] = 30;
          if (versions.containsKey("Abs_Sw_RelNotes")) {
            this.spAbsSwVersionReleaseNotes.setVisible(true);
            this.txtAbsSwVersionReleaseNotes.setVisible(true);
            this.txtAbsSwVersionReleaseNotes.setText(versions.get("Abs_Sw_RelNotes"));
            this.gbl_contentPanel.rowHeights[12] = 100;
          } 
        } else {
          this.lblAbsSwVersionText.setVisible(false);
          this.lblAbsSwVersion.setVisible(false);
        } 
      } 
    } 
    this.spHmiSwVersionBackendReleaseNotes.getVerticalScrollBar().setValue(0);
    this.spHmiSwVersionApplReleaseNotes.getVerticalScrollBar().setValue(0);
    this.spDriveUnitSwVersionReleaseNotes.getVerticalScrollBar().setValue(0);
    this.spBatterySwVersionReleaseNotes.getVerticalScrollBar().setValue(0);
    this.spHmiSwVersionReleaseNotes.getVerticalScrollBar().setValue(0);
    this.spAbsSwVersionReleaseNotes.getVerticalScrollBar().setValue(0);
    this.spBcsSwVersionReleaseNotes.getVerticalScrollBar().setValue(0);
  }

  private void addAbsGuiElements() {
    this.lblAbsSwVersionText = new JLabel(BUNDLE.getString("EBikeConfigurationTab.lblBasSoftwareVersion.text") + ": ");
    this.lblAbsSwVersionText.setName("lblAbsSwVersionText");
    this.lblAbsSwVersionText.setVisible(false);
    GridBagConstraints gbc_lblAbsSwVersionText = new GridBagConstraints();
    gbc_lblAbsSwVersionText.anchor = 17;
    gbc_lblAbsSwVersionText.insets = new Insets(0, 0, 5, 5);
    gbc_lblAbsSwVersionText.gridx = 1;
    gbc_lblAbsSwVersionText.gridy = 11;
    this.contentPanel.add(this.lblAbsSwVersionText, gbc_lblAbsSwVersionText);
    this.lblAbsSwVersion = new JLabel("");
    this.lblAbsSwVersion.setName("lblAbsSwVersion");
    this.lblAbsSwVersion.setVisible(false);
    GridBagConstraints gbc_lblAbsSwVersion = new GridBagConstraints();
    gbc_lblAbsSwVersion.insets = new Insets(0, 0, 5, 5);
    gbc_lblAbsSwVersion.gridx = 2;
    gbc_lblAbsSwVersion.gridy = 11;
    this.contentPanel.add(this.lblAbsSwVersion, gbc_lblAbsSwVersion);
    this.txtAbsSwVersionReleaseNotes = new JTextPane();
    this.txtAbsSwVersionReleaseNotes.setContentType("text/html");
    this.txtAbsSwVersionReleaseNotes.setEnabled(false);
    this.txtAbsSwVersionReleaseNotes.setFont(this.txtAbsSwVersionReleaseNotes.getFont().deriveFont(this.txtAbsSwVersionReleaseNotes.getFont().getStyle() | 0x0, 8.0F));
    this.spAbsSwVersionReleaseNotes = new JScrollPane(this.txtAbsSwVersionReleaseNotes);
    GridBagConstraints gbc_sptxtAbsSwVersionReleaseNotes = new GridBagConstraints();
    gbc_sptxtAbsSwVersionReleaseNotes.gridwidth = 2;
    gbc_sptxtAbsSwVersionReleaseNotes.insets = new Insets(0, 0, 5, 5);
    gbc_sptxtAbsSwVersionReleaseNotes.fill = 1;
    gbc_sptxtAbsSwVersionReleaseNotes.gridx = 1;
    gbc_sptxtAbsSwVersionReleaseNotes.gridy = 12;
    this.contentPanel.add(this.spAbsSwVersionReleaseNotes, gbc_sptxtAbsSwVersionReleaseNotes);
  }

package com.gigatronik.ebike.gui;

import com.gigatronik.dart2.bosch.service.internationalization.ResourceBundleFactory;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.bosch.service.internationalization.Utf8ResourceBundleFormatted;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.bosch.updateserver.DownloadProgressStateListener;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.gui.testinterface.TestableJDialog;
import java.awt.Cursor;
import java.awt.Dimension;
import java.awt.GridBagConstraints;
import java.awt.GridBagLayout;
import java.awt.Insets;
import java.awt.event.ActionEvent;
import javax.swing.JButton;
import javax.swing.JFrame;
import javax.swing.JLabel;
import javax.swing.JPanel;
import javax.swing.JProgressBar;

public class EBikeSoftwareUpdateProgressDialog extends TestableJDialog implements DownloadProgressStateListener {
  private static final String DOWNLOAD_ERROR = "EBikeSoftwareUpdateProgressBar.DOWNLOAD_ERROR";
  
  private final JLabel lblUpdateStatus;
  
  private final JLabel lblPleaseWait;
  
  private final JProgressBar progressBar;
  
  private final JButton btnClose;
  
  private transient Thread showThread;
  
  private static final Utf8ResourceBundleFormatted BUNDLE = ResourceBundleFactory.newDefaultResourceBundle();
  
  private final JFrame parentFrame;
  
  public EBikeSoftwareUpdateProgressDialog(JFrame parent, String titleKey, String messageKey) {
    this(BUNDLE.getString(titleKey), BUNDLE.getString(messageKey), parent);
  }
  
  public EBikeSoftwareUpdateProgressDialog(String title, String message, JFrame parent) {
    super(parent);
    this.parentFrame = parent;
    setName("dlgSoftwareUpdateProgress");
    JPanel contentPane = new JPanel();
    contentPane.setName("pnlSoftwareUpdateProgressDialog");
    getContentPane().add(contentPane, "Center");
    GridBagLayout gbl_contentPane = new GridBagLayout();
    gbl_contentPane.columnWidths = new int[] { 350, 0 };
    gbl_contentPane.rowHeights = new int[] { 25, 25, 30, 0 };
    gbl_contentPane.columnWeights = new double[] { 0.0D, Double.MIN_VALUE };
    gbl_contentPane.rowWeights = new double[] { 0.0D, 0.0D, 0.0D, Double.MIN_VALUE };
    contentPane.setLayout(gbl_contentPane);
    this.lblUpdateStatus = new JLabel(message);
    this.lblUpdateStatus.setName("lblUpdateStatus");
    this.lblUpdateStatus.setVisible(true);
    this.lblUpdateStatus.setMinimumSize(new Dimension(350, 20));
    this.lblUpdateStatus.setPreferredSize(new Dimension(350, 20));
    this.lblUpdateStatus.setVerticalAlignment(3);
    GridBagConstraints gbc_lblUpdateStatus = new GridBagConstraints();
    gbc_lblUpdateStatus.insets = new Insets(5, 10, 0, 10);
    gbc_lblUpdateStatus.gridx = 0;
    gbc_lblUpdateStatus.gridy = 0;
    contentPane.add(this.lblUpdateStatus, gbc_lblUpdateStatus);
    this.lblPleaseWait = new JLabel(BUNDLE.getString("ProgressMonitor.progressText"));
    this.lblPleaseWait.setName("lblPleaseWait");
    this.lblPleaseWait.setVisible(true);
    this.lblPleaseWait.setMinimumSize(new Dimension(350, 20));
    this.lblPleaseWait.setPreferredSize(new Dimension(350, 20));
    this.lblPleaseWait.setVerticalAlignment(1);
    GridBagConstraints gbc_lblPleaseWait = new GridBagConstraints();
    gbc_lblPleaseWait.insets = new Insets(0, 10, 5, 10);
    gbc_lblPleaseWait.gridx = 0;
    gbc_lblPleaseWait.gridy = 1;
    contentPane.add(this.lblPleaseWait, gbc_lblPleaseWait);
    this.progressBar = new JProgressBar();
    this.progressBar.setName("pgrUpdateStatus");
    this.progressBar.setStringPainted(true);
    GridBagConstraints gbc_progressBar = new GridBagConstraints();
    gbc_progressBar.fill = 1;
    gbc_progressBar.insets = new Insets(0, 10, 5, 10);
    gbc_progressBar.gridx = 0;
    gbc_progressBar.gridy = 2;
    contentPane.add(this.progressBar, gbc_progressBar);
    JPanel panel_button = new JPanel();
    getContentPane().add(panel_button, "South");
    this.btnClose = new JButton("Close");
    this.btnClose.setName("btnClose");
    this.btnClose.addActionListener(e -> 
        disposeDialog());
    this.btnClose.setVisible(false);
    panel_button.add(this.btnClose);
    setResizable(false);
    setModal(true);
    setTitle(title);
    setDefaultCloseOperation(0);
    pack();
    setLocationRelativeTo(this.parentFrame);
    setVisible(false);
  }
  
  public void setStatusText(String text) {
    this.lblUpdateStatus.setText(text);
  }
  
  public void showDialog() {
    this.showThread = new Thread(() -> {
          this.parentFrame.getContentPane().setCursor(Cursor.getPredefinedCursor(3));
          getContentPane().setCursor(Cursor.getPredefinedCursor(3));
          setLocationRelativeTo(this.parentFrame);
          setVisible(true);
        });
    this.showThread.start();
  }
  
  public void disposeDialog() {
    this.showThread = null;
    this.parentFrame.getContentPane().setCursor(Cursor.getPredefinedCursor(0));
    setVisible(false);
    dispose();
  }
  
  public void setCloseButtonVisible(boolean visible) {
    this.parentFrame.setCursor(null);
    this.parentFrame.getContentPane().setCursor(null);
    getContentPane().setCursor(null);
    this.btnClose.setVisible(visible);
    pack();
  }
  
  public void setProgress(int value) {
    if (100 >= value && value >= 0) {
      this.progressBar.setIndeterminate(false);
      this.progressBar.setStringPainted(true);
      this.progressBar.setValue(value);
    } else {
      this.progressBar.setStringPainted(false);
      this.progressBar.setIndeterminate(true);
    } 
  }
  
  public void onDownloadProgressStateChanged(int progress) {
    setProgress(progress);
  }
  
  public void setErrorState() {
    setStatusText(BUNDLE.getString("EBikeSoftwareUpdateProgressBar.DOWNLOAD_ERROR"));
    resetPleaseWaitText();
    setProgress(0);
    setCloseButtonVisible(true);
  }
  
  public void setSuccessState(String bundleKeyMessage) {
    setStatusText(BUNDLE.getString(bundleKeyMessage));
    setProgress(100);
  }
  
  private void resetPleaseWaitText() {
    this.lblPleaseWait.setText("");
  }
}

  public String getStatusText() {

  public void showInfo(String text) {
    this.statText[this.selectedPanel] = text;
    this.statColor[this.selectedPanel] = FONT_COLOR_OK;
    this.lblStatusInfo.setForeground(FONT_COLOR_OK);
    this.lblStatusInfo.setText(text);
  }
  
  public void showInfo(String text, int tab) {
    this.statText[tab] = text;
    this.statColor[tab] = FONT_COLOR_OK;
    if (tab == this.selectedPanel) {
      this.lblStatusInfo.setForeground(FONT_COLOR_OK);
      this.lblStatusInfo.setText(text);
    } 
  }
  
  public void showError(String text) {
    this.statText[this.selectedPanel] = text.isEmpty() ? " " : text;
    this.statColor[this.selectedPanel] = FONT_COLOR_ERROR;
    this.lblStatusInfo.setForeground(FONT_COLOR_ERROR);
    this.lblStatusInfo.setText(text);
  }
  
  public void showError(String text, int tab) {
    this.statText[tab] = text.isEmpty() ? " " : text;
    this.statColor[tab] = FONT_COLOR_ERROR;
    if (tab == this.selectedPanel) {
      this.lblStatusInfo.setForeground(FONT_COLOR_ERROR);
      this.lblStatusInfo.setText(text);
    } 
  }
  
  public void showWarning(final String text, final int time) {
    if (this.textBlinkWorker != null && !this.textBlinkWorker.isDone())
      return; 
    this.textBlinkWorker = new SwingWorker<>() {
        String currentText = EBikeStatus.this.lblStatusInfo.getText();
        
        Color currentColor = EBikeStatus.this.lblStatusInfo.getForeground();
        
        protected Void doInBackground() throws IOException, ConfigurationNotFoundException, InterruptedException {
          long endTime = System.currentTimeMillis() + (long)(time * 1000);
          while (System.currentTimeMillis() < endTime) {
            publish(new Boolean[] { true });
            Thread.sleep(500L);
            publish(new Boolean[] { false });
            Thread.sleep(250L);
          } 
          return null;
        }
        
        protected void process(List<Boolean> chunks) {
          Boolean bright = chunks.get(chunks.size() - 1);
          if (!StringUtils.equals(text, EBikeStatus.this.lblStatusInfo.getText())) {
            this.currentText = EBikeStatus.this.lblStatusInfo.getText();
            this.currentColor = EBikeStatus.this.lblStatusInfo.getForeground();
            EBikeStatus.this.lblStatusInfo.setText(text);
          } 
          if (bright) {
            EBikeStatus.this.lblStatusInfo.setForeground(EBikeStatus.FONT_COLOR_WARNING_BRIGHT);
          } else {
            EBikeStatus.this.lblStatusInfo.setForeground(EBikeStatus.FONT_COLOR_WARNING_DARK);
          } 
        }
        
        protected void done() {
          EBikeStatus.this.lblStatusInfo.setText(this.currentText);
          EBikeStatus.this.lblStatusInfo.setForeground(this.currentColor);
        }
      };
    this.lblStatusInfo.setText(text);
    this.textBlinkWorker.execute();
  }
  
  public void selectPanel(int index) {
    if (index != this.selectedPanel && index >= 0 && 
      index < this.statText.length) {
      this.lblStatusInfo.setText(this.statText[index]);
      this.lblStatusInfo.setForeground(this.statColor[index]);
      this.selectedPanel = index;
    } 
  }
}

  private double determineMultiplierFactor() {
    double multiplierFactor;
    Locale language = I18NUtil.getLocale();
    if (language == Locale.CHINESE || language == Locale.JAPANESE || language == I18NUtil.KOREAN_LOCALE) {
      multiplierFactor = 0.5D;
    } else {
      multiplierFactor = 0.25D;
    } 
    return multiplierFactor;
  }

  private void onOpenManual(ActionEvent arg) {
    LOGGER.info("support action: button 'user manual' clicked with args {}, but were ignored", arg);

      openUserManual();

  void startRemoteSession() {
    this.eBikeApplication.showStatusInfo(" ");
    try {
      this.remotePluginFacade.connectToClient(txtRemoteClientId.getText().trim());
    } catch (IOException e) {
      LOGGER.error("error in startRemoteSession()", (Throwable)e);
      this.eBikeApplication.showStatusError(BUNDLE.getString("EBikeSupportTab.errorClientIdNotFound"));
    } 
  }
  
  class UppercaseDocumentFilter extends DocumentFilter {
    public void replace(DocumentFilter.FilterBypass fb, int offset, int length, String text, AttributeSet attrs) throws BadLocationException {
      int oldIdSize = EBikeSupportTab.txtRemoteClientId.getText().length();
      int newIdSize = oldIdSize - length + text.length();
      EventQueue.invokeLater(() -> EBikeSupportTab.btnRemoteSessionStart.setEnabled(validateClientIdLength(text, newIdSize, oldIdSize)));
      if (text.matches("[A-Za-z0-9]*") && newIdSize <= 8)
        fb.replace(offset, length, text.toUpperCase(), attrs); 
    }
    
    public void remove(DocumentFilter.FilterBypass fb, int offset, int length) throws BadLocationException {
      fb.remove(offset, length);
      EBikeSupportTab.btnRemoteSessionStart.setEnabled((EBikeSupportTab.txtRemoteClientId.getText().length() == 8));
    }
    
    private boolean validateClientIdLength(String text, int newIdSize, int oldIdSize) {
      if (text != null && EBikeSupportTab.REMOTE_ID_PATTERN.matcher(text).matches() && newIdSize <= 8)
        return (newIdSize == 8); 
      return (oldIdSize == 8);
    }
  }
  
  private void setSupportInformationForUserLevel(UserLevel level) {
    if (level == UserLevel.OEM) {
      this.panelTechInfo.setVisible(false);
      this.lblTechSupport.setVisible(true);
    } else {
      this.panelTechInfo.setVisible(true);
      this.lblTechSupport.setVisible(false);
    } 
  }
  
  private void setRemotePanelVisible(UserLevel level) {
    boolean visible = (level != UserLevel.UNKNOWN && RemotePluginFacade.getInstance().isRemoteEnabled() && !Boolean.parseBoolean(RemotePluginFacade.getInstance().getProperties().getProperty("USE_REMOTE_DONGLE")));
    this.pnlRemote.setVisible(visible);
    this.lblRemoteClientId.setVisible((level == UserLevel.OEM));
    txtRemoteClientId.setVisible((level == UserLevel.OEM));
    btnRemoteSessionStart.setVisible((level == UserLevel.OEM));
  }
  
  private void setDongleUid() {
    String dongleId = TokenPluginProxy.getInstance().getId();
    if (StringUtils.isNotBlank(dongleId)) {
      LOGGER.debug("Write dongle ID '{}' in support tab", dongleId);
      this.lblDongleUID.setText(BUNDLE.getString("EBikeSupportTab.lblDongleUID.text") + " " + BUNDLE.getString("EBikeSupportTab.lblDongleUID.text"));
    } 
  }
  
  private void openUserManual() {
    LOGGER.info("openUserManual(): Opening PDF from resource directory.");
    String fileNameWithLanguage = createFileNameWithLanguage();
    File manualFile = new File(EXTERNAL_MANUAL_PATH + EXTERNAL_MANUAL_PATH);
    if (manualFile.exists()) {
      openManualByDesktop(manualFile);
    } else {
      TestableJOptionPane.showConfirmDialog(BUNDLE.getString("EBikeSupportTab.manual.not.found.text"), BUNDLE.getString("EBikeSupportTab.manual.not.found.title"), -1, 0);
    } 
  }
  
  private void openManualByDesktop(File file) {
    if (this.desktopSupported) {
      try {
        LOGGER.info("Opening user manual file {} by desktop ...", file.getAbsolutePath());
        Desktop.getDesktop().open(file);
      } catch (IOException ex) {
        LOGGER.error("Error opening user manual file by Desktop API", (Throwable)ex);
        TestableJOptionPane.showMessageDialog(BUNDLE.getString("EBikeSupportTab.NoDefaultApplication.optionPane.message"), 
            BUNDLE.getString("EBikeSupportTab.NoDefaultApplication.optionPane.title"), 0);
        saveFileManually(file);
      } 
    } else {
      saveFileManually(file);
    } 
  }
  
  private String createFileNameWithLanguage() {
    String language = I18NUtil.getLocale().getISO3Language();
    String userGroupName = "IBD";
    if (this.rightsManager.isUserInLevel(UserLevel.OEM))
      userGroupName = "OEM"; 
    String fileNameWithLanguage = "User Manual " + userGroupName + " " + language + ".pdf";
    LOGGER.info("Manual tmp file {}", fileNameWithLanguage);
    return fileNameWithLanguage;
  }
  
  private void saveFileManually(File file) {
    JFileChooser fc = CustomFileChooser.getCustomFileChooser();
    fc.setSelectedFile(new File(file.getName()));
    int returnVal = fc.showSaveDialog(TestableJOptionPane.getDefaultParentFrame());
    if (returnVal == 0) {
      File destFile = fc.getSelectedFile();
      try {
        FileUtils.copyFile(file, destFile);
      } catch (IOException e) {
        LOGGER.error("File copy error", (Throwable)e);
      } 
    } 
  }
  
  private void saveLogFile() {
    try {
      JFileChooser fcSave = CustomFileChooser.getCustomFileChooser();
      FileFilter filter = new FileNameExtensionFilter("Log archive (.zip)", new String[] { "zip" });
      fcSave.setFileFilter(filter);
      fcSave.setSelectedFile(this.supportTabPanelController.getLogsArchiveName());
      fcSave.setCurrentDirectory(new File(getLogPath()));
      int returnVal = fcSave.showSaveDialog(TestableJOptionPane.getDefaultParentFrame());
      if (returnVal == 0) {
        setLogPath(fcSave.getSelectedFile().getParent());
        LOGGER.info("saveLogFile(): Saving log file.");
        File selectedFile = fcSave.getSelectedFile();
        this.supportTabPanelController.createLogsArchive(selectedFile);
      } else {
        LOGGER.warn("Not saving the log file, the selected path {} is not approved.", Integer.valueOf(returnVal));
      } 
    } catch (Exception e) {
      LOGGER.error("Error saving logfile archive", (Throwable)e);
    } 
  }
  
  private String getLogPath() {
    try {
      String logPath = SettingsProxy.getInstance().getGlobalSettings().getProperty("logFolder");
      return (logPath != null) ? logPath : "";
    } catch (ConfigurationNotFoundException ex) {
      LOGGER.error("Error getting last selected log folder from settings", ex.getCause());
      return "";
    } 
  }
  
  private void setLogPath(String path) {
    try {
      SettingsProxy.getInstance().getGlobalSettings().setProperty("logFolder", path);
    } catch (ConfigurationNotFoundException ex) {
      LOGGER.error("Error setting last selected log folder in settings", ex.getCause());
    } 
  }
  
  public void onRightsChanged(RightsChangedEvent event) {
    LOGGER.debug("Received rights changed event '{}'", event);
    if (event.getUserLevel() != UserLevel.UNKNOWN)
      EventQueue.invokeLater(() -> {
            LOGGER.debug("Process rights change event now from EDT");
            setSupportInformationForUserLevel(event.getUserLevel());
            setRemotePanelVisible(event.getUserLevel());
            setDongleUid();
            if (event.getUserLevel() == UserLevel.UNKNOWN) {
              this.lblTechSupportIBDTitle.setVisible(true);
              this.lblTechSupportOEMTitle.setVisible(true);
              this.panelTechInfo.setVisible(true);
              this.lblTechSupport.setVisible(true);
            } else {
              this.lblTechSupportOEMTitle.setVisible(false);
              this.lblTechSupportIBDTitle.setVisible(false);
              setSupportInformationForUserLevel(event.getUserLevel());
            } 
          }); 
  }
}

  private static JFreeChart createUdamChart(XYDataset dataset) {
    Color greenColor = new Color(10008916);
    Color redColor = new Color(12194073);
    Color blueColor = new Color(4882107);
    Color lilaColor = new Color(8216736);
    JFreeChart chart = ChartFactory.createXYLineChart(BUNDLE.getString("EBikeServiceTab.HMI_DiagnosticTable.Udams.TITLE"), 
        BUNDLE.getString("EBikeServiceTab.HMI_DiagnosticTable.Udams.X_AXIS"), BUNDLE.getString("EBikeServiceTab.HMI_DiagnosticTable.Udams.Y_AXIS"), dataset, PlotOrientation.VERTICAL, false, false, false);
    chart.getTitle().setPaint(Color.white);
    chart.getTitle().setFont(EBikeApplicationPanel.DEFAULT_FONT.deriveFont(1, 15.0F));
    chart.setBackgroundPaint(Color.LIGHT_GRAY);
    XYPlot plot = definePlot(chart);
    chart.addLegend(createLegend(plot));
    XYLineAndShapeRenderer renderer = createCustomRenderer(blueColor, redColor, greenColor, lilaColor);
    plot.setRenderer((XYItemRenderer)renderer);
    defineYAxis((NumberAxis)plot.getRangeAxis());
    defineXAxis((NumberAxis)plot.getDomainAxis());
    return chart;
  }
  
  private static void defineYAxis(NumberAxis rangeAxis) {
    rangeAxis.setAxisLineVisible(true);
    rangeAxis.setTickLabelsVisible(true);
    rangeAxis.setTickMarksVisible(true);
    rangeAxis.setLabelPaint(Color.white);
    rangeAxis.setAxisLinePaint(Color.white);
    rangeAxis.setTickLabelPaint(Color.white);
    rangeAxis.setTickMarkPaint(Color.white);
    rangeAxis.setLabelFont(EBikeApplicationPanel.DEFAULT_FONT.deriveFont(13.0F));
    rangeAxis.setTickLabelFont(EBikeApplicationPanel.DEFAULT_FONT.deriveFont(0));
    rangeAxis.setAutoRangeStickyZero(false);
    rangeAxis.setLowerMargin(0.05D);
    rangeAxis.setUpperMargin(0.1D);
  }
  
  private static LegendTitle createLegend(XYPlot plot) {
    LegendTitle legendTitleNew = new LegendTitle((LegendItemSource)plot, new ColumnArrangement(), new ColumnArrangement());
    legendTitleNew.setPosition(RectangleEdge.RIGHT);
    legendTitleNew.setBackgroundPaint(Color.LIGHT_GRAY);
    legendTitleNew.setItemPaint(Color.white);
    legendTitleNew.setItemFont(EBikeApplicationPanel.DEFAULT_FONT.deriveFont(0));
    legendTitleNew.setMargin(0.0D, 0.0D, 0.0D, 12.0D);
    legendTitleNew.setLegendItemGraphicPadding(new RectangleInsets(0.0D, 0.0D, 0.0D, 7.0D));
    return legendTitleNew;
  }
  
  private static XYLineAndShapeRenderer createCustomRenderer(Color blueColor, Color redColor, Color greenColor, Color lilaColor) {
    XYLineAndShapeRenderer renderer = new XYLineAndShapeRenderer();
    renderer.setSeriesStroke(0, new BasicStroke(2.0F, 1, 1, 1.0F, new float[] { 1.5F, 4.0F }, 0.0F));
    renderer.setSeriesStroke(1, new BasicStroke(2.0F, 1, 1, 1.0F, new float[] { 6.0F, 6.0F }, 0.0F));
    renderer.setSeriesStroke(2, new BasicStroke(2.0F, 1, 1, 1.0F, new float[] { 10.0F, 8.0F }, 0.0F));
    renderer.setSeriesStroke(3, new BasicStroke(2.0F, 1, 1, 1.0F, new float[] { 5.0F, 0.0F }, 0.0F));
    renderer.setSeriesPaint(0, blueColor);
    renderer.setSeriesPaint(1, redColor);
    renderer.setSeriesPaint(2, greenColor);
    renderer.setSeriesPaint(3, lilaColor);
    renderer.setSeriesShape(0, new Ellipse2D.Double(-2.5D, -2.5D, 5.0D, 5.0D));
    renderer.setSeriesShape(1, new Ellipse2D.Double(-2.5D, -2.5D, 5.0D, 5.0D));
    renderer.setSeriesShape(2, new Ellipse2D.Double(-2.5D, -2.5D, 5.0D, 5.0D));
    renderer.setSeriesShape(3, new Ellipse2D.Double(-2.5D, -2.5D, 5.0D, 5.0D));
    renderer.setLegendShape(0, new Rectangle2D.Double(0.0D, 0.0D, 0.0D, 0.0D));
    renderer.setLegendShape(1, new Rectangle2D.Double(0.0D, 0.0D, 0.0D, 0.0D));
    renderer.setLegendShape(2, new Rectangle2D.Double(0.0D, 0.0D, 0.0D, 0.0D));
    renderer.setLegendShape(3, new Rectangle2D.Double(0.0D, 0.0D, 0.0D, 0.0D));
    renderer.setLegendLine(new Line2D.Double(0.0D, 0.0D, 40.0D, 0.0D));
    return renderer;
  }
  
  private static void defineXAxis(NumberAxis domainAxis) {
    domainAxis.setAxisLineVisible(true);
    domainAxis.setTickLabelsVisible(true);
    domainAxis.setTickMarksVisible(true);
    domainAxis.setLabelPaint(Color.white);

  private static XYPlot definePlot(JFreeChart chart1) {
    XYPlot plot = chart1.getXYPlot();
    plot.setBackgroundPaint(Color.LIGHT_GRAY);
    plot.setDomainGridlinePaint(Color.white);
    plot.setRangeGridlinePaint(Color.white);
    plot.setOutlinePaint(Color.white);
    plot.setNoDataMessage(BUNDLE.getString("EBikeServiceTab.HMI_DiagnosticTable.Udams.NO_DATA"));
    plot.setNoDataMessageFont(new Font("SansSerif", 1, 14));
    plot.setNoDataMessagePaint(Color.WHITE);
    return plot;
  }
  
  protected static XYDataset createUdamDataset(String udam1, String udam2, String udam3, String udam4, boolean inMph) {
    XYSeriesCollection dataset = new XYSeriesCollection();
    dataset = makeSeries(BUNDLE.getString("EBikeServiceTab.HMI_DiagnosticTable.Udams.MODE") + " 1", udam1, dataset, inMph);
    dataset = makeSeries(BUNDLE.getString("EBikeServiceTab.HMI_DiagnosticTable.Udams.MODE") + " 2", udam2, dataset, inMph);
    dataset = makeSeries(BUNDLE.getString("EBikeServiceTab.HMI_DiagnosticTable.Udams.MODE") + " 3", udam3, dataset, inMph);
    dataset = makeSeries(BUNDLE.getString("EBikeServiceTab.HMI_DiagnosticTable.Udams.MODE") + " 4", udam4, dataset, inMph);
    return (XYDataset)dataset;
  }
  
  private static XYSeriesCollection makeSeries(String seriesName, String udam, XYSeriesCollection dataset, boolean inMph) {
    if (StringUtils.isNotBlank(udam)) {
      String[] udamArray = udam.replaceAll(",", ".").split(";");
      if (udamArray.length > 7)
        addDataToSeries(seriesName, udamArray, dataset, inMph); 
    } 
    return dataset;
  }
  
  private static void addDataToSeries(String seriesName, String[] udamArray, XYSeriesCollection dataset, boolean inMph) {
    XYSeries series = new XYSeries(seriesName);
    try {
      series.add(0.0D, Double.parseDouble(udamArray[4]) * 10.0D);
      if (inMph) {
        series.add(ConverterUtil.kilometerToMile(Double.parseDouble(udamArray[0])), Double.parseDouble(udamArray[5]) * 10.0D);
        series.add(ConverterUtil.kilometerToMile(Double.parseDouble(udamArray[1])), Double.parseDouble(udamArray[6]) * 10.0D);
        series.add(ConverterUtil.kilometerToMile(Double.parseDouble(udamArray[2])), Double.parseDouble(udamArray[7]) * 10.0D);
        series.add(ConverterUtil.kilometerToMile(Double.parseDouble(udamArray[3])), 0.0D);
      } else {
        series.add(Double.parseDouble(udamArray[0]), Double.parseDouble(udamArray[5]) * 10.0D);
        series.add(Double.parseDouble(udamArray[1]), Double.parseDouble(udamArray[6]) * 10.0D);
        series.add(Double.parseDouble(udamArray[2]), Double.parseDouble(udamArray[7]) * 10.0D);
        series.add(Double.parseDouble(udamArray[3]), 0.0D);
      } 
      dataset.addSeries(series);
    } catch (NumberFormatException nfe) {
      LOGGER.error("Number format error", (Throwable)nfe);
    } 
  }
  
  private EBikeUdam() {
    super("");
    chart = createUdamChart(null);
    ChartPanel chartPanel = new ChartPanel(chart);
    chartPanel.setPreferredSize(new Dimension(875, 200));
    setContentPane((Container)chartPanel);
  }
  
  public static JFreeChart getChart() {
    return chart;
  }
}

  private static JFreeChart createAndDefineChart(XYDataset dataset) {
    JFreeChart chart = ChartFactory.createXYLineChart(null,

    RectangleInsets rectangleInsets = new RectangleInsets(0.0D, 12.0D, 0.0D, 0.0D);

  private static XYLineAndShapeRenderer createCustomRenderer() {
    XYLineAndShapeRenderer renderer = new XYLineAndShapeRenderer();
    renderer.setSeriesPaint(3, ChartConstants.COLOR_GREEN_DARK);
    renderer.setSeriesPaint(2, ChartConstants.COLOR_GREEN_LIGHT);
    renderer.setSeriesPaint(1, ChartConstants.COLOR_TURQUOISE);
    renderer.setSeriesPaint(0, ChartConstants.COLOR_GRAY_DARK);
    renderer.setSeriesStroke(3, new BasicStroke(2.0F, 1, 1, 1.0F));
    renderer.setSeriesStroke(2, new BasicStroke(2.0F, 1, 1, 1.0F));
    renderer.setSeriesStroke(1, new BasicStroke(2.0F, 1, 1, 1.0F, new float[] { 6.0F, 6.0F }, 0.0F));
    renderer.setSeriesStroke(0, new BasicStroke(2.0F, 1, 1, 1.0F, new float[] { 1.5F, 4.0F }, 0.0F));
    renderer.setSeriesShape(3, new Ellipse2D.Double(-2.5D, -2.5D, 5.0D, 5.0D));
    renderer.setSeriesShape(2, new Ellipse2D.Double(-2.5D, -2.5D, 5.0D, 5.0D));
    renderer.setSeriesShape(1, new Ellipse2D.Double(-2.5D, -2.5D, 5.0D, 5.0D));
    renderer.setSeriesShape(0, new Ellipse2D.Double(-2.5D, -2.5D, 5.0D, 5.0D));
    renderer.setLegendShape(3, new Rectangle2D.Double(0.0D, 0.0D, 0.0D, 0.0D));
    renderer.setLegendShape(2, new Rectangle2D.Double(0.0D, 0.0D, 0.0D, 0.0D));
    renderer.setLegendShape(1, new Rectangle2D.Double(0.0D, 0.0D, 0.0D, 0.0D));

package com.gigatronik.ebike.gui;

import com.gigatronik.beds.service.ecu.impl.du.AssistanceMode;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.bosch.service.internationalization.ResourceBundleFactory;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.bosch.service.internationalization.Utf8ResourceBundleFormatted;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.common.util.ConverterUtils;
import java.awt.Color;
import java.awt.Dimension;
import java.awt.Font;
import org.jfree.chart.ChartFactory;
import org.jfree.chart.ChartPanel;
import org.jfree.chart.JFreeChart;
import org.jfree.chart.LegendItemSource;
import org.jfree.chart.block.ColumnArrangement;
import org.jfree.chart.labels.PieSectionLabelGenerator;
import org.jfree.chart.labels.StandardPieSectionLabelGenerator;
import org.jfree.chart.plot.PiePlot;
import org.jfree.chart.title.LegendTitle;
import org.jfree.chart.ui.RectangleEdge;
import org.jfree.chart.ui.RectangleInsets;
import org.jfree.data.general.DefaultPieDataset;
import org.jfree.data.general.PieDataset;

public class EnergyPieChart extends ChartPanel {
  private static final long serialVersionUID = -2715941944338450796L;
  
  private static final Utf8ResourceBundleFormatted BUNDLE = ResourceBundleFactory.newDefaultResourceBundle();
  
  private static final String TEXT_ECO = BUNDLE.getString("PieChart.ECO");
  
  private static final String TEXT_TOUR = BUNDLE.getString("PieChart.TOUR");
  
  private static final String TEXT_SPORT = BUNDLE.getString("PieChart.SPORT");
  
  private static final String TEXT_TURBO = BUNDLE.getString("PieChart.TURBO");
  
  private static final String TEXT_EMTB = BUNDLE.getString("PieChart.EMTB");
  
  private static final String TEXT_UDAM_1 = BUNDLE.getString("PieChart.UDAM1");
  
  private static final String TEXT_UDAM_2 = BUNDLE.getString("PieChart.UDAM2");
  
  private static final String TEXT_UDAM_3 = BUNDLE.getString("PieChart.UDAM3");
  
  private static final String TEXT_UDAM_4 = BUNDLE.getString("PieChart.UDAM4");
  
  private static PieDataset createDataset() {
    DefaultPieDataset dataset = new DefaultPieDataset();
    dataset.setValue(TEXT_ECO, new Double(43.2D));
    dataset.setValue(TEXT_TOUR, new Double(10.0D));
    dataset.setValue(TEXT_SPORT, new Double(27.5D));
    dataset.setValue(TEXT_TURBO, new Double(17.5D));
    dataset.setValue(TEXT_UDAM_1, new Double(11.0D));
    dataset.setValue(TEXT_UDAM_2, new Double(7.4D));
    dataset.setValue(TEXT_UDAM_3, new Double(25.4D));
    dataset.setValue(TEXT_UDAM_4, new Double(30.4D));
    return (PieDataset)dataset;
  }
  
  protected static PieDataset createDataset(String[] data, boolean emtbModeConfigured) {
    DefaultPieDataset dataset = new DefaultPieDataset();
    if (data.length > 3) {
      if (ConverterUtils.isDouble(data[AssistanceMode.ECO.ordinal()]))
        dataset.setValue(TEXT_ECO, Double.parseDouble(data[AssistanceMode.ECO.ordinal()])); 
      if (ConverterUtils.isDouble(data[AssistanceMode.TOUR.ordinal()]))
        dataset.setValue(TEXT_TOUR, Double.parseDouble(data[AssistanceMode.TOUR.ordinal()])); 
      if (ConverterUtils.isDouble(data[AssistanceMode.SPORT.ordinal()])) {
        String modeName = emtbModeConfigured ? TEXT_EMTB : TEXT_SPORT;
        dataset.setValue(modeName, Double.parseDouble(data[AssistanceMode.SPORT.ordinal()]));
      } 
      if (ConverterUtils.isDouble(data[AssistanceMode.TURBO.ordinal()]))
        dataset.setValue(TEXT_TURBO, Double.parseDouble(data[AssistanceMode.TURBO.ordinal()])); 
    } 
    if (data.length > 7) {
      if (ConverterUtils.isDouble(data[AssistanceMode.USER1.ordinal()]))
        dataset.setValue(TEXT_UDAM_1, Double.parseDouble(data[AssistanceMode.USER1.ordinal()])); 
      if (ConverterUtils.isDouble(data[AssistanceMode.USER2.ordinal()]))
        dataset.setValue(TEXT_UDAM_2, Double.parseDouble(data[AssistanceMode.USER2.ordinal()])); 
      if (ConverterUtils.isDouble(data[AssistanceMode.USER3.ordinal()]))
        dataset.setValue(TEXT_UDAM_3, Double.parseDouble(data[AssistanceMode.USER3.ordinal()])); 
      if (ConverterUtils.isDouble(data[AssistanceMode.USER4.ordinal()]))
        dataset.setValue(TEXT_UDAM_4, Double.parseDouble(data[AssistanceMode.USER4.ordinal()])); 
    } 
    return (PieDataset)dataset;
  }
  
  private static JFreeChart createChart(PieDataset dataset) {
    JFreeChart chart = ChartFactory.createPieChart(BUNDLE.getString("EBikeServiceTab.HMI_DiagnosticTable.Data.PIE_CHART"), dataset, false, true, false);
    chart.getTitle().setFont(EBikeApplicationPanel.DEFAULT_FONT.deriveFont(1, 12.0F));
    chart.setBackgroundPaint(Color.WHITE);
    PiePlot plot = definePlot(chart);
    definePlotLabels(plot, new Font("SansSerif", 0, 12));
    definePlotColors(plot);
    definePlotLegend(plot);
    return chart;
  }
  
  private static void definePlotLegend(PiePlot plot) {
    plot.setLegendLabelGenerator(new StandardPieSectionLabelGenerator("{0}: {2}"));
    LegendTitle legendTitleNew = new LegendTitle((LegendItemSource)plot, new ColumnArrangement(), new ColumnArrangement());
    legendTitleNew.setPosition(RectangleEdge.RIGHT);
    legendTitleNew.setItemFont(EBikeApplicationPanel.DEFAULT_FONT.deriveFont(0));
    legendTitleNew.setMargin(0.0D, 0.0D, 0.0D, 12.0D);
    legendTitleNew.setLegendItemGraphicPadding(new RectangleInsets(0.0D, 0.0D, 0.0D, 7.0D));
  }
  
  private static void definePlotColors(PiePlot plot) {
    Color greenColor = new Color(10008916);
    Color redColor = new Color(12194073);
    Color blueColor = new Color(4882107);
    Color lilaColor = new Color(8216736);
    Color yellow = new Color(16705620);
    Color red = new Color(15672852);
    Color newGreen = new Color(357632);
    Color gray = new Color(9939385);
    if (plot.getDataset().getKeys().size() >= 4) {
      plot.setSectionPaint(plot.getDataset().getKey(0), newGreen);
      plot.setSectionPaint(plot.getDataset().getKey(1), red);
      plot.setSectionPaint(plot.getDataset().getKey(2), gray);
      plot.setSectionPaint(plot.getDataset().getKey(3), yellow);
      if (plot.getDataset().getKeys().size() >= 8) {
        plot.setSectionPaint(plot.getDataset().getKey(4), blueColor);
        plot.setSectionPaint(plot.getDataset().getKey(5), redColor);
        plot.setSectionPaint(plot.getDataset().getKey(6), greenColor);
        plot.setSectionPaint(plot.getDataset().getKey(7), lilaColor);
      } 
    } 
  }
  
  protected static void definePlotLabels(PiePlot plot, Font fontLabels) {
    plot.setLabelGenerator(null);
    plot.setLabelFont(fontLabels);
    plot.setLabelGap(0.02D);
    plot.setLabelBackgroundPaint(Color.WHITE);
    plot.setLabelOutlinePaint(Color.WHITE);
    plot.setLabelShadowPaint(Color.WHITE);
    StandardPieSectionLabelGenerator labels = new StandardPieSectionLabelGenerator("{0}: {2}");
    plot.setLabelGenerator((PieSectionLabelGenerator)labels);
  }
  
  protected static PiePlot definePlot(JFreeChart chart) {
    PiePlot plot = (PiePlot)chart.getPlot();
    plot.setBackgroundPaint(Color.WHITE);
    plot.setOutlinePaint(Color.WHITE);
    plot.setShadowPaint(Color.WHITE);
    plot.setNoDataMessage(BUNDLE.getString("EBikeServiceTab.HMI_DiagnosticTable.Udams.NO_DATA"));
    return plot;
  }
  
  public EnergyPieChart(String[] data, boolean emtbModeConfigured) {
    super(createChart(createDataset(data, emtbModeConfigured)));
    setPreferredSize(new Dimension(390, 180));
  }
}

package com.gigatronik.ebike.gui;

import com.gigatronik.beds.report.chart.ChartConstants;
import org.jfree.chart.ChartFactory;
import org.jfree.chart.ChartPanel;
import org.jfree.chart.JFreeChart;
import org.jfree.chart.plot.PiePlot;
import org.jfree.data.general.PieDataset;

public class EnergyPieChartServiceReport extends ChartPanel {
  private static final long serialVersionUID = -2715941944338450796L;
  
  private static PieDataset createDataset(String[] data, boolean emtbModeConfigured) {
    return EnergyPieChart.createDataset(data, emtbModeConfigured);
  }
  
  private static JFreeChart createChart(PieDataset dataset) {
    JFreeChart chart = ChartFactory.createPieChart(null, dataset, false, true, false);
    PiePlot plot = EnergyPieChart.definePlot(chart);
    EnergyPieChart.definePlotLabels(plot, ChartConstants.FONT_SANS_REG_26);
    definePlotColors(plot);
    return chart;
  }
  
  private static void definePlotColors(PiePlot plot) {
    PieDataset dataset = plot.getDataset();
    int datasetKeysAmount = dataset.getKeys().size();
    if (datasetKeysAmount >= 4) {
      plot.setSectionPaint(dataset.getKey(0), ChartConstants.COLOR_BLUE_LIGHT);
      plot.setSectionPaint(dataset.getKey(1), ChartConstants.COLOR_BLUE);
      plot.setSectionPaint(dataset.getKey(2), ChartConstants.COLOR_GRAY_LIGHT);
      plot.setSectionPaint(dataset.getKey(3), ChartConstants.COLOR_GRAY);
      if (datasetKeysAmount >= 8) {
        plot.setSectionPaint(dataset.getKey(4), ChartConstants.COLOR_GRAY_DARK);
        plot.setSectionPaint(dataset.getKey(5), ChartConstants.COLOR_TURQUOISE);
        plot.setSectionPaint(dataset.getKey(6), ChartConstants.COLOR_GREEN_LIGHT);
        plot.setSectionPaint(dataset.getKey(7), ChartConstants.COLOR_GREEN_DARK);
      } 
    } 
  }
  
  public EnergyPieChartServiceReport(String[] data, boolean emtbModeConfigured) {
    super(createChart(createDataset(data, emtbModeConfigured)));
  }
}

package com.gigatronik.ebike.gui.genericprogress;

import com.gigatronik.beds.service.ecuconnectionstate.api.EcuConnectionStateHandler;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.ecuconnectionstate.impl.event.ProgressBarEvent;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.bosch.service.internationalization.ResourceBundleFactory;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.bosch.service.internationalization.Utf8ResourceBundleFormatted;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.gui.testinterface.TestableJDialog;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.gui.testinterface.TestableJOptionPane;
import java.awt.BorderLayout;
import java.awt.Cursor;
import java.awt.Dimension;
import java.awt.EventQueue;
import javax.swing.JFrame;
import javax.swing.JLabel;
import javax.swing.JPanel;
import javax.swing.JProgressBar;
import javax.swing.border.EmptyBorder;
import org.apache.commons.lang3.StringUtils;
import org.slf4j.Logger;
import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;

public class EBikeGenericProgressBar extends TestableJDialog implements EcuConnectionStateHandler.ProgressBarEventListener {
  private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(EBikeGenericProgressBar.class);
  
  private static final long serialVersionUID = 5804253510171585327L;
  
  private final transient Utf8ResourceBundleFormatted bundle = ResourceBundleFactory.newDefaultResourceBundle();
  
  private final JPanel contentPanel = new JPanel();
  
  private JLabel lblProgressMessage;
  
  private JProgressBar progressBar;
  
  private JFrame parentFrame;
  
  private static EBikeGenericProgressBar instance;
  
  private EBikeGenericProgressBar() {
    super(TestableJOptionPane.getDefaultParentFrame());
    createGui();
  }
  
  public static synchronized EBikeGenericProgressBar getInstance() {
    if (instance == null)
      instance = new EBikeGenericProgressBar(); 
    return instance;
  }
  
  private void createGui() {
    setMinimumSize(new Dimension(250, 50));
    getContentPane().setLayout(new BorderLayout(0, 0));
    this.contentPanel.setBorder(new EmptyBorder(10, 10, 10, 10));
    this.contentPanel.setName("pnlGenericProgressbar");
    getContentPane().add(this.contentPanel);
    this.contentPanel.setLayout(new BorderLayout(0, 0));
    this.lblProgressMessage = new JLabel();
    this.lblProgressMessage.setName("lblProgressMessage");
    this.lblProgressMessage.setHorizontalAlignment(0);
    this.lblProgressMessage.setBorder(new EmptyBorder(5, 5, 10, 5));
    this.lblProgressMessage.setAlignmentX(0.5F);
    this.contentPanel.add(this.lblProgressMessage, "Center");
    this.progressBar = new JProgressBar();
    this.progressBar.setName("prgProgress");
    this.contentPanel.add(this.progressBar, "South");
    setResizable(false);
    setModal(true);
    setTitle(this.bundle.getString("ProgressMonitor.progressText"));
    setDefaultCloseOperation(0);
    pack();
    setVisible(false);
  }
  
  public void showProgressBar() {
    EventQueue.invokeLater(() -> {
          if (!isVisible())
            displayProgressBar(); 
        });
  }
  
  private void displayProgressBar() {
    LOGGER.trace("Display progressbar ...");
    this.parentFrame = TestableJOptionPane.getDefaultParentFrame();
    this.parentFrame.getContentPane().setCursor(Cursor.getPredefinedCursor(3));
    getContentPane().setCursor(Cursor.getPredefinedCursor(3));
    setLocationRelativeTo(this.parentFrame);
    setVisible(true);
  }
  
  public void disposeProgressBar() {
    EventQueue.invokeLater(() -> {
          LOGGER.trace("Dispose progressbar ...");
          this.parentFrame.getContentPane().setCursor(null);
          getContentPane().setCursor(null);
          setVisible(false);
          dispose();
        });
  }
  
  public void setProgressMessage(String key) {
    EventQueue.invokeLater(() -> {
          if (StringUtils.isNotBlank(key)) {
            this.lblProgressMessage.setText(this.bundle.getString(key));
          } else if (StringUtils.isEmpty(key)) {
            this.lblProgressMessage.setText("");
          } else {
            this.lblProgressMessage.setText(this.bundle.getString("ProgressMonitor.progressText"));
          } 
          pack();
        });
  }
  
  public void setProgressBarValue(int progress) {
    EventQueue.invokeLater(() -> {
          if (progress < 0 || progress > 100) {
            this.progressBar.setIndeterminate(true);
          } else {
            this.progressBar.setIndeterminate(false);
            this.progressBar.setValue(progress);
          } 
        });
  }
  
  public void onProgressBarEvent(ProgressBarEvent event) {
    if (event.getState() == ProgressBarEvent.PROGRESS_BAR_STATE.SHOW) {
      setProgressBarValue(event.getProgressBarValue());
      setName(event.getName());
      setProgressMessage(event.getProgressMessageKey());
      showProgressBar();
    } else if (event.getState() == ProgressBarEvent.PROGRESS_BAR_STATE.DISPOSE) {
      disposeProgressBar();
    } 
  }
}

    this.configurationManager.addListener((OrderableListener)this);
    this.rightsManager.addListener(this);
    this.guiManager.addGuiModeChangedListener(this);
  }
  
  public MainTabbedPanel loadDefaultTabs() {
    this.mainTabbed.getTabbedPane().removeAll();
    if (this.rightsManager.isUserInLevel(UserLevel.IBD)) {
      this.ibdTabs.setTabsToMainPane();
    } else {
      this.oemTabs.setTabsToMainPane();
    } 
    this.mainTabbed.getTabbedPane().addChangeListener(this::onTabChange);
    this.mainTabbed.getTabbedPane().addMouseListener(new MouseAdapter() {
          public void mouseClicked(MouseEvent e) {
            int clickedIndex = MainTabbedController.this.mainTabbed.getTabbedPane().getUI().tabForCoordinate(MainTabbedController.this.mainTabbed.getTabbedPane(), e.getX(), e.getY());
            if (clickedIndex >= 0) {
              Component comp = MainTabbedController.this.mainTabbed.getTabbedPane().getTabComponentAt(clickedIndex);
              if (comp instanceof CustomTab)
                MainTabbedController.LOGGER.debug("USER clicked on EBikeMainTabbed_Old on index {} which is {} and has state enabled {}", clickedIndex, ((CustomTab)comp).getName(), MainTabbedController.this.mainTabbed.getTabbedPane().isEnabledAt(clickedIndex)); 
            } 
          }
        });
    return this.mainTabbed;
  }
  
  private void createTabs() {
    createConfigurationTab();
    createBctConfigurationTab();
    createBcsConfigurationTab();
    this.diagnosticTab = new DiagnosticTab(this.eBikeApplication, this.chooseBatteryTypeController, this.ecuConnectionStateHandler, this.rightsManager);
    CrmInternalFactory crmFactory = CrmInternalFactory.getInstance(TokenPluginProxy.getInstance(), this.rightsManager, this.diagnosticTab.getServiceParameterDatapool(), this.chooseBatteryTypeController, this.eBikeApplication, ApplicationProcessManager.getInstance(), this);
    this.crmMainTabPanel = new CrmMainTabPanel(crmFactory);
    this.eBikeSettingsTab = new EBikeSettingsTab(this.eBikeApplication, this.rightsManager, getBikeConfigTabController());
    this.eBikeSupportTab = new EBikeSupportTab(this.eBikeApplication, this.rightsManager);
    this.bctMeasurementTab = new BctMeasurementTabPanel();
    BctMeasurementTabController bctMeasurementTabController = new BctMeasurementTabController(this.bctMeasurementTab, this.eBikeApplication, this.chooseBatteryTypeController, this.rightsManager);
    this.bctMeasurementTab.setController(bctMeasurementTabController);
    createMapTab();
  }
  
  private void createConfigurationTab() {
    BikeConfigurationPanelController bikeConfigurationTabController = new BikeConfigurationPanelController(this.eBikeApplication, this.rightsManager);
    this.bikeConfigurationTab = new BikeConfigurationPanel(this.eBikeApplication, bikeConfigurationTabController, this.rightsManager);
    bikeConfigurationTabController.setPanel(this.bikeConfigurationTab);
  }
  
  private void createBctConfigurationTab() {
    this.bctConfigurationTab = new BctConfigurationTab();
    BctConfigurationTabController bctConfigurationTabController = new BctConfigurationTabController(this.bctConfigurationTab, this.eBikeApplication, this.configurationManager, this.rightsManager);
    this.bctConfigurationTab.setController(bctConfigurationTabController);
    this.bctEventHandler.subscribeBctOperationStateChanges(bctConfigurationTabController);
  }
  
  private void createBcsConfigurationTab() {
    this.bcsConfigurationTab = new BcsConfigurationTab();
    BcsConfigurationTabController bcsConfigurationTabController = new BcsConfigurationTabController(this.bcsConfigurationTab, this.eBikeApplication, this.configurationManager, this.rightsManager);
    this.bcsConfigurationTab.setController(bcsConfigurationTabController);
  }
  
  public void createMapTab() {
    this.eBikeMapTab = new EBikeMapTab(this.eBikeApplication, this.communicationManager, this.configurationManager, this.ecuConnectionStateHandler, ApplicationProcessManager.getInstance(), this.rightsManager);
    this.eBikeMapTab.getMapUpdateChecker().registerForMapsUptodateStateChangeEvents(this);
  }
  
  private void loadEBikeTabs() {
    this.isGuiUpdateJobRunning = true;
    this.mainTabbed.getTabbedPane().removeAll();
    if (this.rightsManager.getUserLevel().equals(UserLevel.IBD)) {
      this.ibdTabs.setTabsToMainPane();
    } else {
      this.oemTabs.setTabsToMainPane();
    } 
    this.isGuiUpdateJobRunning = false;
  }
  
  private void loadBctTabs() {
    this.isGuiUpdateJobRunning = true;
    this.mainTabbed.getTabbedPane().removeAll();
    if (this.rightsManager.getUserLevel().equals(UserLevel.IBD)) {
      this.bctIbdTabs.setTabsToMainPane();
    } else {
      this.bctOemTabs.setTabsToMainPane();
    } 
    this.bctOemTabs.setSpecialToolTipText((Component)this.diagnosticTab);
    switchToComponentTab((Component)this.bctConfigurationTab);
    this.isGuiUpdateJobRunning = false;
  }
  
  private void loadBcsTab() {
    this.isGuiUpdateJobRunning = true;
    this.mainTabbed.getTabbedPane().removeAll();
    if (this.rightsManager.isUserInLevel(UserLevel.IBD)) {
      this.bcsIbdTabs.setTabsToMainPane();
    } else {
      this.bcsOemTabs.setTabsToMainPane();
    } 
    switchToComponentTab((Component)this.bcsConfigurationTab);
    this.isGuiUpdateJobRunning = false;
  }
  
  private void onEcuConnect(Constants.EcuType type, Constants.EcuMode mode) {
    switch (type) {
      case BCT:
        arrangeTabsForBct(mode);
        break;
      case BCS250:
        arrangeTabForBcs();
        break;
      case BUI21X:
      case BUI25X:
      case BUI270:
      case BUI275:
      case BUI330:
      case BUI350:
      case COBI:
        arrangeTabsForEBike(this.guiManager.hasGuiModeChanged());
        break;
    } 
  }
  
  private void arrangeTabsForBct(Constants.EcuMode mode) {
    this.mainTabbed.getTabbedPane().setEnabledAt(this.mainTabbed.getTabbedPane().indexOfComponent((Component)this.bctMeasurementTab), (mode == Constants.EcuMode.APP));
    BctState bctState = this.communicationManager.getBctCom().readOperatingState();
    if (bctState == BctState.TEST_FINISHED || bctState == BctState.TEST_ERROR || bctState == BctState.DISCHARGE_FINISHED) {
      this.mainTabbed.getTabbedPane().setSelectedIndex(this.mainTabbed.getTabbedPane().indexOfComponent((Component)this.bctMeasurementTab));
    } else {
      this.mainTabbed.getTabbedPane().setSelectedIndex(this.mainTabbed.getTabbedPane().indexOfComponent((Component)this.bctConfigurationTab));
    } 
  }
  
  private void arrangeTabForBcs() {
    this.mainTabbed.getTabbedPane().setEnabledAt(this.mainTabbed.getTabbedPane().indexOfComponent((Component)this.bcsConfigurationTab), true);
    this.mainTabbed.getTabbedPane().setSelectedIndex(this.mainTabbed.getTabbedPane().indexOfComponent((Component)this.bcsConfigurationTab));
  }
  
  private void arrangeTabsForEBike(boolean guiModeChanged) {
    if (guiModeChanged)
      arrangeTabsByUserLevel(this.rightsManager.getUserLevel(), this.rightsManager.getMode()); 
  }
  
  private void arrangeTabsByUserLevel(UserLevel userLevel, Mode oemMode) {
    if (userLevel.equals(UserLevel.OEM)) {
      arrangeTabsByOemMode(oemMode);
    } else if (userLevel.equals(UserLevel.IBD)) {
      arrangeTabsByIBDMode();
    } 
  }
  
  private void arrangeTabsByOemMode(Mode oemMode) {
    this.mainTabbed.getTabbedPane().removeAll();
    this.oemTabs.setTabsToMainPane();
    if (oemMode.equals(Mode.OEM_ADMIN)) {
      switchToComponentTab((Component)this.bikeConfigurationTab);
    } else if (oemMode.equals(Mode.OEM_WORKER)) {
      disableAllComponentWithoutComponent((Component)this.bikeConfigurationTab);
    } 
  }
  
  private void arrangeTabsByIBDMode() {
    this.mainTabbed.getTabbedPane().removeAll();
    this.ibdTabs.setTabsToMainPane();
    switchToComponentTab((Component)this.bikeConfigurationTab);
  }
  
  private void switchToComponentTab(Component component) {
    LOGGER.debug("switchToComponentTab() Method was called with component {}", component.getName());
    this.mainTabbed.getTabbedPane().setSelectedIndex(this.mainTabbed.getTabbedPane().indexOfComponent(component));
    for (int i = 0; i < this.mainTabbed.getTabbedPane().getTabCount(); i++)
      this.mainTabbed.getTabbedPane().setEnabledAt(i, true); 
  }
  
  public void switchToSupportTabAndDisableTheOtherTabs() {
    disableAllComponentWithoutComponent((Component)this.eBikeSupportTab);
  }
  
  public void switchToDiagnosticTab() {
    switchToComponentTab((Component)this.diagnosticTab);
  }
  
  private void disableAllComponentWithoutComponent(Component component) {
    for (int i = 0; i < this.mainTabbed.getTabbedPane().getTabCount(); i++)
      this.mainTabbed.getTabbedPane().setEnabledAt(i, false); 
    this.mainTabbed.getTabbedPane().setSelectedIndex(this.mainTabbed.getTabbedPane().indexOfComponent(component));
    this.mainTabbed.getTabbedPane().setEnabledAt(this.mainTabbed.getTabbedPane().indexOfComponent(component), true);
  }
  
  private void onEcuDisconnect(Constants.EcuType type) {
    if (type.equals(Constants.EcuType.BCT) && this.guiManager.isGuiInMode(GuiManager.GuiMode.BCT))
      disableMeasurementTab(); 
    if (type.equals(Constants.EcuType.BCS250))
      quitBcsConnection(); 
  }
  
  private void disableMeasurementTab() {
    EventQueue.invokeLater(() -> {
          if (this.bctMeasurementTab.equals(this.mainTabbed.getTabbedPane().getSelectedComponent()))
            this.mainTabbed.getTabbedPane().setSelectedComponent(this.eBikeSettingsTab); 
          this.mainTabbed.getTabbedPane().setEnabledAt(this.mainTabbed.getTabbedPane().indexOfComponent((Component)this.bctMeasurementTab), false);
        });
  }
  
  private void quitBcsConnection() {
    this.isGuiUpdateJobRunning = true;
    int index = this.mainTabbed.getTabbedPane().getSelectedIndex();
    this.mainTabbed.getTabbedPane().removeAll();
    this.ibdTabs.setTabsToMainPane();
    this.mainTabbed.getTabbedPane().setSelectedIndex(index);
    this.isGuiUpdateJobRunning = false;
  }
  
  private void updateMapTabIcon(boolean isAlternativeIcon) {
    if (this.rightsManager.getUserLevel().equals(UserLevel.IBD) && !this.guiManager.isGuiInMode(GuiManager.GuiMode.BCT)) {
      LOGGER.debug("Update MapTab icon");
      this.ibdTabs.updateTabIcon((Component)this.eBikeMapTab, isAlternativeIcon);
      this.bcsIbdTabs.updateTabIcon((Component)this.eBikeMapTab, isAlternativeIcon);
    } 
  }
  
  private void onTabChange(ChangeEvent e) {
    if (this.mainTabbed.getTabbedPane().getSelectedComponent() == null)
      return; 
    if (this.applicationProcessManager.isProcessActive(ApplicationProcessManager.ApplicationProcess.SET_BMS_TYPE_IN_BCT)) {
      this.mainTabbed.getTabbedPane().setSelectedComponent((Component)this.bctMeasurementTab);
      return;
    } 
    int selectedIndex = this.mainTabbed.getTabbedPane().getSelectedIndex();
    Component selectedComponent = this.mainTabbed.getTabbedPane().getSelectedComponent();
    if (!this.isGuiUpdateJobRunning) {
      LOGGER.info("Change to {} Tab.", this.mainTabbed.getTabbedPane().getSelectedComponent().getClass().getSimpleName());
      if (this.lastSelectedIndex == this.mainTabbed.getTabbedPane().indexOfComponent((Component)this.bctMeasurementTab) && this.guiManager.isGuiInMode(GuiManager.GuiMode.BCT))
        onBctMeasurementFinishedTabFocusLost(); 
      if (selectedComponent.getClass() == this.bikeConfigurationTab.getClass() || 
        selectedComponent.getClass() == this.bctConfigurationTab.getClass() || 
        selectedComponent.getClass() == this.bcsConfigurationTab.getClass()) {
        this.bikeConfigurationTab.getController().onActivation();
        if (this.guiManager.isGuiInMode(GuiManager.GuiMode.BCS) && selectedComponent.getClass() != this.bcsConfigurationTab.getClass())
          loadBcsTab(); 
      } 
      handleDiagnosticTabAfterTabChange(selectedComponent);
      if (selectedComponent.getClass() == this.crmMainTabPanel.getClass()) {
        this.crmMainTabPanel.onTabGetActive();
      } else if (this.lastSelectedIndex == this.mainTabbed.getTabbedPane().indexOfComponent((Component)this.crmMainTabPanel) || this.mainTabbed.getTabbedPane().indexOfComponent((Component)this.crmMainTabPanel) == -1) {
        this.crmMainTabPanel.onTabGetInactive();
      } 
      if (selectedComponent.getClass() == this.eBikeMapTab.getClass() && !this.guiManager.isGuiInMode(GuiManager.GuiMode.BCT))
        this.eBikeMapTab.ensureMapsRepositoryConsistency(); 
      if (this.rightsManager.isUserInLevel(UserLevel.IBD) && selectedComponent.getClass() == this.eBikeSettingsTab.getClass())
        this.eBikeSettingsTab.refreshDisplayedMapsRepositoryPath(); 
      this.eBikeApplication.onTabChanged(selectedIndex);
    } 
    this.lastSelectedIndex = selectedIndex;
  }
  
  private void handleDiagnosticTabAfterTabChange(Component selectedComponent) {
    if (selectedComponent.getClass() == this.diagnosticTab.getClass()) {
      this.diagnosticTab.setFocus(true);
      if (this.guiManager.isGuiInMode(GuiManager.GuiMode.EBIKE) || this.guiManager.isGuiInMode(GuiManager.GuiMode.BCS)) {
        this.diagnosticTab.startDiagnosticServiceWhenEmpty();
      } else if (this.guiManager.isGuiInMode(GuiManager.GuiMode.BCT)) {
        this.diagnosticTab.startDiagnosticServiceWhenEmptyBct();
      } 
    } else {
      this.diagnosticTab.setFocus(false);
    } 
  }
  
  private void onBctMeasurementFinishedTabFocusLost() {
    if (this.communicationManager.getBctCom().readOperatingState() == BctState.DISCHARGE_FINISHED)
      this.communicationManager.getBctCom().confirmMeasurementFinished(); 
  }
  
  public void onMapsUptodateStateChange(boolean newMapsOnServer) {
    updateMapTabIcon(newMapsOnServer);
  }
  
  public void onGuiModeChanged(GuiManager.GuiMode newMode, GuiManager.GuiMode oldMode) {
    switch (newMode) {
      case EBIKE:
        loadEBikeTabs();
        break;
      case BCS:
        loadBcsTab();
        break;
      case BCT:
        loadBctTabs();
        break;
    } 
  }
  
  public void onHardwareConnectionChanged(HardwareConnectionChangedEvent event) {
    LOGGER.debug("HardwareConnectionChangedEvent received: '{}'", event);
    switch (event.getAction()) {
      case ECU_CONNECTED:
        EventQueue.invokeLater(() -> onEcuConnect(event.getComponent(), event.getMode()));
        break;
      case ECU_DISCONNECTED:
        onEcuDisconnect(event.getComponent());
        break;
    } 
  }
  
  public void onRightsChanged(RightsChangedEvent event) {
    LOGGER.debug("Received rights changed event '{}'", event);
    if (event.getUserLevel() != UserLevel.UNKNOWN)
      EventQueue.invokeLater(() -> {
            LOGGER.debug("Process rights change event now from EDT");
            if (this.guiManager.isGuiInMode(GuiManager.GuiMode.EBIKE))
              arrangeTabsByUserLevel(event.getUserLevel(), event.getMode()); 
          }); 
  }
  
  public MainTabbedPanel getEBikeMainTabbed() {
    return this.mainTabbed;
  }
  
  public BikeConfigurationPanel getBikeConfigTab() {
    return this.bikeConfigurationTab;
  }
  
  public BikeConfigurationPanelController getBikeConfigTabController() {
    return this.bikeConfigurationTab.getController();
  }
  
  public BctConfigurationTab getBctConfigTab() {
    return this.bctConfigurationTab;
  }
  
  public BcsConfigurationTab getBcsConfigTab() {
    return this.bcsConfigurationTab;
  }
  
  public DiagnosticTab getDiagnosticTab() {
    return this.diagnosticTab;
  }
  
  public EBikeMapTab getMapTab() {
    return this.eBikeMapTab;
  }
  
  public BctMeasurementTabPanel getBctMeasurementTab() {
    return this.bctMeasurementTab;
  }
  
  public EBikeSettingsTab getSettingsTab() {
    return this.eBikeSettingsTab;
  }
  
  public EBikeSupportTab getSupportTab() {
    return this.eBikeSupportTab;
  }
  
  public boolean isBikeConfigurationTabActive() {
    return (this.mainTabbed.getTabbedPane().getSelectedComponent() == this.bikeConfigurationTab);
  }
}

package com.gigatronik.ebike.gui;

import com.gigatronik.beds.gui.panels.bct.choosebatterytype.ChooseBatteryTypeController;
import com.gigatronik.beds.gui.service.guimanager.api.GuiManager;
import com.gigatronik.beds.gui.service.guimanager.impl.GuiManagerImpl;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.communication.api.CommunicationManager;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.configuration.ConfigurationManager;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.ecuconnectionstate.api.BctEventHandler;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.ecuconnectionstate.api.EcuConnectionStateHandler;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.rightsmanager.api.RightsManager;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.bosch.applicationprocess.ApplicationProcessManager;

public class MainTabbedControllerFactory {
  public MainTabbedController create(EBikeApplication eBikeApplication, RightsManager rightsManager) {
    MainTabbedPanel panel = new MainTabbedPanel();
    CommunicationManager communicationManager = eBikeApplication.getCommunicationManager();
    BctEventHandler bctEventHandler = eBikeApplication.getBctEventHandler();
    EcuConnectionStateHandler ecuConnStateHandler = eBikeApplication.getEcuConnectionStateHandler();
    ConfigurationManager configManager = eBikeApplication.getConfigurationManager();
    GuiManager guiManager = GuiManagerImpl.getInstance();
    ChooseBatteryTypeController chooseBatteryTypeController = new ChooseBatteryTypeController(communicationManager, ecuConnStateHandler);
    ApplicationProcessManager applicationProcessManager = ApplicationProcessManager.getInstance();
    MainTabbedController controller = new MainTabbedController(eBikeApplication, panel, rightsManager, communicationManager, bctEventHandler, ecuConnStateHandler, configManager, chooseBatteryTypeController, guiManager, applicationProcessManager);
    return controller;
  }
}

  private void setAttributes() {
    if (this.guiComponent.getClass() == BikeConfigurationPanel.class || this.guiComponent.getClass() == BcsConfigurationTab.class) {
      this.attributes = COMPONENT_ATTRIBUTES.CONFIGURATION;
    } else if (this.guiComponent.getClass() == BctConfigurationTab.class) {
      this.attributes = COMPONENT_ATTRIBUTES.CONFIGURATION_BCT;
    } else if (this.guiComponent.getClass() == DiagnosticTab.class) {
      this.attributes = COMPONENT_ATTRIBUTES.DIAGNOSTIC;
    } else if (this.guiComponent.getClass() == CrmMainTabPanel.class) {
      this.attributes = COMPONENT_ATTRIBUTES.CRM_SERVICE;
    } else if (this.guiComponent.getClass() == EBikeSupportTab.class) {
      this.attributes = COMPONENT_ATTRIBUTES.SUPPORT;
    } else if (this.guiComponent.getClass() == EBikeSettingsTab.class) {
      this.attributes = COMPONENT_ATTRIBUTES.SETTINGS;
    } else if (this.guiComponent.getClass() == EBikeMapTab.class) {
      this.attributes = COMPONENT_ATTRIBUTES.MAP;
    } else if (this.guiComponent.getClass() == BctMeasurementTabPanel.class) {
      this.attributes = COMPONENT_ATTRIBUTES.MEASUREMENT;
    } 
  }
  
  public Component getGuiComponent() {
    return this.guiComponent;
  }
  
  public String getLanguageFileNameKey() {
    return this.attributes.getLanguageFileNameKey();
  }
  
  public String getTabName() {
    return this.attributes.getTabName();
  }
  
  public String getParentTabName() {
    return this.attributes.getParentTabName();
  }
  
  public String getIconPath() {
    return this.attributes.getIconPath();
  }
  
  public String getAlternativeIconPath() {
    return this.attributes.getAlternativeIconPath();
  }

  public boolean isAlternativeIcon() {
    return this.isAlternativeIcon;
  }
  
  public void setAlternativeIcon(boolean isAlternativeIcon) {
    this.isAlternativeIcon = isAlternativeIcon;
  }
  
  private enum COMPONENT_ATTRIBUTES {
