package com.gigatronik.ebike.gui;

import com.gigatronik.dart2.bosch.service.internationalization.ResourceBundleFactory;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.bosch.service.internationalization.Utf8ResourceBundleFormatted;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.custom.CustomTab;
import java.awt.Component;
import java.awt.EventQueue;
import java.net.URL;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import javax.swing.JTabbedPane;

public class MainTabbedTabs {
  private static final Utf8ResourceBundleFormatted BUNDLE = ResourceBundleFactory.newDefaultResourceBundle();
  
  private final JTabbedPane mainTabPane;
  
  private List<MainTabbedTabElement> tabElements;
  
  public MainTabbedTabs(JTabbedPane mainPane, List<Component> tabs) {
    this.mainTabPane = mainPane;
    createTabElements(tabs);
  }
  
  public void setTabsToMainPane() {
    for (MainTabbedTabElement element : this.tabElements) {
      String pathToIcon = element.isAlternativeIcon() ? element.getAlternativeIconPath() : element.getIconPath();
      this.mainTabPane.add(BUNDLE.getString(element.getLanguageFileNameKey()), element.getGuiComponent());
      int index = this.mainTabPane.indexOfComponent(element.getGuiComponent());
      CustomTab customTab = new CustomTab(this.mainTabPane, BUNDLE.getString(element.getLanguageFileNameKey()), getClass().getResource(pathToIcon));
      this.mainTabPane.setTabComponentAt(index, customTab);
      this.mainTabPane.getTabComponentAt(index).setName(element.getTabName());
      if (element.getParentTabName() != null)
        this.mainTabPane.getTabComponentAt(index).getParent().setName(element.getParentTabName()); 
      this.mainTabPane.setToolTipTextAt(index, BUNDLE.getString(element.getDefaultToolTipKey()));
    } 
  }
  
  public void updateTabIcon(Component component, boolean alternativeIcon) {
    MainTabbedTabElement tempElement = getElement(component);
    if (tempElement != null) {
      tempElement.setAlternativeIcon(alternativeIcon);
      EventQueue.invokeLater(() -> {
            CustomTab mapTab = new CustomTab(this.mainTabPane, BUNDLE.getString(tempElement.getLanguageFileNameKey()), 
                getResourceURL(component, alternativeIcon));
            mapTab.setName(tempElement.getTabName());
            this.mainTabPane.setTabComponentAt(this.mainTabPane.indexOfComponent(component), mapTab);
          });
    } 
  }
  
  public void setSpecialToolTipText(Component tab) {
    MainTabbedTabElement element = getElement(tab);
    if (element != null) {
      String alternativeToolTipKey = element.getAlternativeToolTipKey();
      if (alternativeToolTipKey != null)
        this.mainTabPane.setToolTipTextAt(this.mainTabPane.indexOfComponent(tab), BUNDLE.getString(alternativeToolTipKey)); 
    } 
  }
  
  private MainTabbedTabElement getElement(Component component) {
    for (MainTabbedTabElement temp : this.tabElements) {
      if (temp.getGuiComponent() == component)
        return temp; 
    } 
    return null;
  }
  
  private URL getResourceURL(Component component, boolean alternativeURL) {
    MainTabbedTabElement element = getElement(component);
    if (element != null) {
      if (alternativeURL)
        return getClass().getResource(element.getAlternativeIconPath()); 
      return getClass().getResource(element.getIconPath());
    } 
    return null;
  }
  
  private void createTabElements(List<Component> tabs) {
    this.tabElements = new ArrayList<>();
    tabs.forEach(temp -> this.tabElements.add(new MainTabbedTabElement(temp)));
  }
}

package com.gigatronik.ebike.gui;

import com.gigatronik.beds.manufacturelog.api.ManufacturingLog;
import com.gigatronik.beds.settings.SettingsProxy;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.bosch.service.internationalization.ResourceBundleFactory;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.bosch.service.internationalization.Utf8ResourceBundleFormatted;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.framework.plugins.exceptions.ConfigurationNotFoundException;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.custom.CustomFileChooser;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.gui.testinterface.TestableJOptionPane;
import java.io.File;
import java.text.SimpleDateFormat;
import java.util.Date;
import javax.swing.JFileChooser;

public class ManufactureLogGuiController {
  private static final String MANUFACTURE_LOG_DIRECTORY = "manufacture_log_directory";
  
  private static final Utf8ResourceBundleFormatted BUNDLE = ResourceBundleFactory.newDefaultResourceBundle();
  
  private final ManufacturingLog manufacturingLog;
  
  public ManufactureLogGuiController(ManufacturingLog manufacturingLog) {
    this.manufacturingLog = manufacturingLog;
  }
  
  public void saveManufactureLogToFile() throws ConfigurationNotFoundException {
    JFileChooser fc = CustomFileChooser.getCustomFileChooser();
    fc.setCurrentDirectory(new File(
          SettingsProxy.getInstance().getGlobalSettings().getProperty("manufacture_log_directory")));
    SimpleDateFormat dateFormat = new SimpleDateFormat("yyyyMMdd'_'HHmm");
    Date date = new Date();
    fc.setSelectedFile(new File("manufacturing_log_" + dateFormat.format(date) + ".csv"));
    int returnValue = fc.showSaveDialog(TestableJOptionPane.getDefaultParentFrame());
    if (returnValue == 0)
      this.manufacturingLog.saveToFile(fc.getSelectedFile()); 
  }
  
  public void saveManufactureLogToFileForced() throws ConfigurationNotFoundException {
    JFileChooser fc = CustomFileChooser.getCustomFileChooser();
    SimpleDateFormat dateFormat = new SimpleDateFormat("yyyyMMdd'_'HHmm");
    Date date = new Date();
    fc.setSelectedFile(new File("manufacturing_log_" + dateFormat.format(date) + ".csv"));
    while (fc.showSaveDialog(TestableJOptionPane.getDefaultParentFrame()) == 1) {
      String title = BUNDLE.getString("ManufacturingLog.formatcheck.title");
      String msg = String.format(BUNDLE.getString("ManufacturingLog.formatcheck.message"), 2000);
      TestableJOptionPane.showMessageDialog(msg, title, 2);
    } 
    this.manufacturingLog.saveToFile(fc.getSelectedFile());
  }
  
  public boolean saveOnExit() throws ConfigurationNotFoundException {
    if (this.manufacturingLog.isManufacturerlogPathValid()) {
      this.manufacturingLog.writeToFile();
      if (this.manufacturingLog.isManufacturingLogTooBig()) {
        String title = BUNDLE.getString("ManufacturingLog.sizecheck.title");
        String msg = String.format(BUNDLE.getString("ManufacturingLog.sizecheck.message"), 2000);
        if (TestableJOptionPane.showConfirmDialog(msg, title, 0) == 0)
          saveManufactureLogToFile(); 
      } 
      return true;
    } 
    return false;
  }
}

  public void onActivation(boolean readServiceHistoryAsynchronous) {
    if (this.bikeIdentification.getHmiIdentification().getComponentType().isBUI21x()) {
      this.lblNextServiceDate.setVisible(false);
      this.datePickerNextServiceDate.setVisible(false);
    } else {
      this.lblNextServiceDate.setVisible(true);
      this.datePickerNextServiceDate.setVisible(true);
    } 
    clearData();
    if (this.bikeIdentification.isDuConnected()) {
      readServiceData();
      if (readServiceHistoryAsynchronous) {
        readServiceHistory();
      } else {
        readServiceHistorySynchronous();
      } 
    } 
    validateButtonStates();
  }
  
  private void clearData() {
    setNextServiceDate(null);
    setNextServiceMileage(0L);
    setCurrentOdometer("");
    for (int row = 0; row < 10; row++) {
      this.tableServiceHistory.setValueAt("", row, 0);
      this.tableServiceHistory.setValueAt("", row, 1);
    } 
  }
  
  private void validateButtonStates() {
    boolean duComActive = this.bikeIdentification.getDuIdentification().isApplication();
    this.imgbtnWriteServiceHistory.setEnabled((duComActive && isNextServiceDateValid() && isNextServiceMileageValid()));
    this.imgbtnResetNextServiceInterval.setEnabled(duComActive);
  }
  
  private void setCurrentOdometer(String value) {
    boolean milesSet = getOdometerToMilesFlag();
    if (StringUtils.isNotBlank(value)) {
      double mileage = Double.parseDouble(value);
      if (milesSet) {
        mileage = ConverterUtil.kilometerToMile(mileage);
        this.textFieldCurrentOdometer.setText(String.format("%s mi", mileage));
      } else {
        this.textFieldCurrentOdometer.setText(String.format("%s km", mileage));
      } 
      this.txtNextServiceMileage.setRange(mileage + 0.01D, milesSet ? (double)MAX_VAL_MILES : 4294967.0D);
    } else {
      this.textFieldCurrentOdometer.setText("");
      this.txtNextServiceMileage.setRange(0.0D, milesSet ? (double)MAX_VAL_MILES : 4294967.0D);
    } 
  }
  
  private int getCurrentOdometerInMeter() {
    String odometer = this.textFieldCurrentOdometer.getText().replaceAll(" km", "").replaceAll(" mi", "");
    double mileage = 0.0D;
    if (!odometer.isEmpty()) {
      mileage = Double.valueOf(odometer);
      if (getOdometerToMilesFlag())
        mileage = ConverterUtil.mileToKilometerWithoutRounding(mileage); 
    } 
    return (int)Math.round(mileage * (double)KILOMETER_IN_METER);
  }
  
  private void setNextServiceDate(String value) {
    if (value == null || value.equals("2000-00-00") || this.bikeIdentification.getHmiIdentification().getComponentType().isBUI21x()) {
      this.datePickerNextServiceDate.setDate(null);
    } else {
      try {
        Date formattedDate = I18NDateTimesFormats.getInternalDateFormat().parse(value);
        this.datePickerNextServiceDate.setDate(formattedDate.toInstant().atZone(ZoneId.systemDefault()).toLocalDate());
      } catch (ParseException ex) {
        LOGGER.error("could not parse date {}", value, ex);
      } 
    } 
  }
  
  private long convertToMeters(long value) {
    return getOdometerToMilesFlag() ? (long)(ConverterUtil.mileToKilometerWithoutRounding((double)value) * (double)KILOMETER_IN_METER) : ((long)KILOMETER_IN_METER * value);
  }
  
  private long getNextServiceMileageInMeters() {
    String nextServiceMileage = ((JTextField)this.txtNextServiceMileage).getText();
    if (ConverterUtils.isDouble(nextServiceMileage))
      return convertToMeters(Math.round(Double.parseDouble(nextServiceMileage))); 
    return 0L;
  }
  
  private void setNextServiceMileage(long value) {
    try {
      double km = (double)value / (double)KILOMETER_IN_METER;
      if ("1".equals(SettingsProxy.getInstance().getGlobalSettings().getProperty("unit_distance"))) {
        this.txtNextServiceMileage.setText(String.format("%.0f", ConverterUtil.kilometerToMileWithoutRounding(km)));
      } else {
        this.txtNextServiceMileage.setText(String.format("%.0f", km));
      } 
    } catch (ConfigurationNotFoundException e) {
      LOGGER.error("Config not found", (Throwable)e);
      this.txtNextServiceMileage.setText("0");
    } 
  }
  
  private void readServiceData() {
    LOGGER.info("readServiceDate()");
    try {
      setCurrentOdometer(this.communicationManager.getDuCom().readOdometer().getString());
    } catch (ComplexResponse.DataAccessException ex) {
      LOGGER.error("Parsing odometer response failed", (Throwable)ex);
    } 
    ComplexResponse nextService = this.communicationManager.getDuCom().readServiceIntervalDueData();
    try {
      setNextServiceDate(nextService.getParameterByName("date").getValue());
      setNextServiceMileage(Long.parseUnsignedLong(nextService.getParameterByName("odometer").getValue()));
    } catch (ComplexResponse.DataAccessException|NumberFormatException ex) {
      LOGGER.error("Error reading and parsing service interval due data", (Throwable)ex);
    } 
  }
  
  private void readServiceHistorySynchronous() {
    LOGGER.info("readServiceHistorySynchron()");
    setCursor(Cursor.getPredefinedCursor(3));
    int row = 0;
    boolean convertOdometerToMiles = getOdometerToMilesFlag();
    for (int index = 0; index < 10; index++) {
      String[] serviceData = readServiceHistoryByIndex(index, convertOdometerToMiles);
      this.tableServiceHistory.setValueAt(serviceData[0], row, 0);
      this.tableServiceHistory.setValueAt(serviceData[1], row, 1);
      row++;
    } 
    setCursor(Cursor.getPredefinedCursor(0));
  }
  
  private void readServiceHistory() {
    SwingWorker<Void, String[]> worker = new SwingWorker<>() {
        int row = 0;
        
        protected Void doInBackground() {
          boolean convertOdometerToMiles = PnServiceConfiguration.this.getOdometerToMilesFlag();
          for (int index = 0; index < 10; index++) {
            String[] serviceData = PnServiceConfiguration.this.readServiceHistoryByIndex(index, convertOdometerToMiles);
            publish(new String[][] { serviceData });
          } 
          return null;
        }
        
        protected void process(List<String[]> chunks) {
          String[] serviceData = chunks.get(chunks.size() - 1);
          PnServiceConfiguration.this.tableServiceHistory.setValueAt(serviceData[0], this.row, 0);
          PnServiceConfiguration.this.tableServiceHistory.setValueAt(serviceData[1], this.row, 1);
          this.row++;
        }
        
        protected void done() {
          PnServiceConfiguration.this.setCursor(Cursor.getPredefinedCursor(0));
        }
      };
    LOGGER.info("readServiceHistory()");
    setCursor(Cursor.getPredefinedCursor(3));
    worker.execute();
  }
  
  private String[] readServiceHistoryByIndex(int index, boolean convertOdometerToMiles) {
    String[] serviceData = new String[2];
    ComplexResponse data = this.communicationManager.getDuCom().readServiceHistoryByIndex(String.valueOf(index));
    try {
      if ("2000-00-00".equals(data.getParameterByName("date").getValue())) {
        serviceData[0] = "";
        serviceData[1] = "";
      } else {
        serviceData[0] = I18NDateTimesFormats.reFormatDateByLocale(data.getParameterByName("date").getValue(), I18NUtil.getLocale());
        if (convertOdometerToMiles) {
          serviceData[1] = String.format("%.1f mi", ConverterUtil.kilometerToMileWithoutRounding(doubleFromString(data.getParameterByName("odometer").getValue()) / (double)KILOMETER_IN_METER));
        } else {
          serviceData[1] = String.format("%.1f km", doubleFromString(data.getParameterByName("odometer").getValue()) / (double)KILOMETER_IN_METER);
        } 
      } 
    } catch (ComplexResponse.DataAccessException ex) {
      LOGGER.error("Error reading and parsing service history", (Throwable)ex);
    } 
    return serviceData;
  }
  
  private double doubleFromString(String value) {
    try {
      return Double.parseDouble(value);
    } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
      LOGGER.error("Could not parse the data", (Throwable)e);
      return 0.0D;
    } 
  }
  
  private boolean getOdometerToMilesFlag() {
    try {
      return "1".equals(SettingsProxy.getInstance().getGlobalSettings().getProperty("unit_distance"));
    } catch (ConfigurationNotFoundException e) {
      LOGGER.error("Config not found", (Throwable)e);
      return false;
    } 
  }
  
  private void writeServiceConfiguration() {
    if (this.bikeIdentification.getSystemType() == Constants.SystemType.CLASSIC_PLUS) {
      TestableJOptionPane.showMessageDialog(BUNDLE.getString("ServiceConfiguration.ClassicPlus"), BUNDLE.getString("Bosch.diagnostic.tool"), 1);
      return;
    } 
    String serviceDate = "0000-00-00";
    LocalDate service = this.datePickerNextServiceDate.getDate();
    if (service != null)
      serviceDate = I18NDateTimesFormats.formatDateToInternalToolFormat(service); 
    long nextServiceMileage = getNextServiceMileageInMeters();
    String serviceMileage = String.valueOf(nextServiceMileage);
    boolean isServiceConfigurationWritten = this.communicationManager.getDuCom().writeServiceIntervalDueData(serviceDate, serviceMileage).isPositive();
    boolean isServiceHistoryWritten = writeServiceHistory();
    showWriteServiceConfigurationResultMessage(isServiceConfigurationWritten, isServiceHistoryWritten);
    readServiceData();
    readServiceHistory();
  }
  
  private void resetNextServiceInterval() {
    this.datePickerNextServiceDate.setDate(null);
    this.txtNextServiceMileage.setText("0");
    boolean isServiceConfigurationWritten = this.communicationManager.getDuCom().writeServiceIntervalDueData("0000-00-00", "0").isPositive();
    showResetServiceIntervalResultMessage(isServiceConfigurationWritten);
    readServiceHistory();
  }
  
  private void showWriteServiceConfigurationResultMessage(boolean isServiceConfigurationWritten, boolean isServiceHistoryWritten) {
    String resultMessage = (isServiceConfigurationWritten && isServiceHistoryWritten) ? BUNDLE.getString("EBikeConfigurationTab.ServiceConfiguration.writeService.success") : BUNDLE.getString("EBikeConfigurationTab.ServiceConfiguration.error.write.data");
    TestableJOptionPane.showMessageDialog(resultMessage, BUNDLE.getString("EBikeConfigurationTab.ServiceConfiguration.writeServiceInterval.msgbox.title"), 1);
  }
  
  private void showResetServiceIntervalResultMessage(boolean isServiceIntervalReseted) {
    String resultMessage = isServiceIntervalReseted ? BUNDLE.getString("EBikeConfigurationTab.ServiceConfiguration.resetServiceInterval.success") : BUNDLE.getString("EBikeConfigurationTab.ServiceConfiguration.error.resetServiceInterval");
    TestableJOptionPane.showMessageDialog(resultMessage, BUNDLE.getString("EBikeConfigurationTab.ServiceConfiguration.resetServiceInterval.msgbox.title"), 1);
  }
  
  private boolean writeServiceHistory() {
    LOGGER.info("writeServiceConfiguration()");
    String serviceDate = I18NDateTimesFormats.formatDateToInternalToolFormat(Calendar.getInstance().getTime());
    String serviceMileage = String.valueOf(getCurrentOdometerInMeter());
    if (serviceDate.isEmpty() && serviceMileage.isEmpty())
      return false; 
    ComplexResponse data = this.communicationManager.getDuCom().readServiceHistoryByIndex(String.valueOf(0));
    if (data.isPositive()) {
      try {
        if (data.getParameterList().size() == 2 && !data.getParameterByName("date").getValue().equals(serviceDate))
          this.communicationManager.getDuCom().writeNewServiceHistoryEntry(serviceDate, serviceMileage); 
      } catch (ComplexResponse.DataAccessException ex) {
        LOGGER.error("Error reading service history", (Throwable)ex);
      } 
    } else {
      this.communicationManager.getDuCom().writeNewServiceHistoryEntry(serviceDate, serviceMileage);
    } 
    return true;
  }
  
  private void paintNextServiceDateBorder(boolean valid) {
    JTextField txtField = this.datePickerNextServiceDate.getComponentDateTextField();
    txtField.setForeground(GuiColors.TEXT_VALID);
    txtField.setBorder(valid ? this.validBorder : this.invalidBorder);
  }
  
  private void validateServiceDate() {
    if (this.datePickerNextServiceDate.isVisible())
      paintNextServiceDateBorder(isNextServiceDateValid()); 
  }
  
  private boolean isNextServiceDateValid() {
    LocalDate today = LocalDate.now();
    LocalDate selectedDate = this.datePickerNextServiceDate.getDate();
    return (StringUtils.isBlank(this.datePickerNextServiceDate.getText()) || (selectedDate != null && selectedDate.isAfter(today) && isWithinHardwareAcceptedInterval(selectedDate)));
  }
  
  private boolean isWithinHardwareAcceptedInterval(LocalDate selectedDate) {
    int year = selectedDate.getYear();
    return (year > 2000 && year < 2100);
  }
  
  private boolean isNextServiceMileageValid() {
    String nextServiceMileage = ((JTextField)this.txtNextServiceMileage).getText();
    if (ConverterUtils.isInteger(nextServiceMileage)) {
      long odometer = (long)getCurrentOdometerInMeter();
      long nextService = convertToMeters(Math.round(Double.parseDouble(nextServiceMileage)));
      return (nextService == 0L || (nextService > odometer && nextService < 4294967294L));
    } 
    return false;
  }
}

    setSize(getWidth(), 180);
  }
  
  public void setTableVisible(boolean visible) {
    this.table.setVisible(visible);
  }
  
  public void setRowNumber(int rows) {
    DefaultTableModel model = (DefaultTableModel)this.table.getModel();
    int rowCount = model.getRowCount();
    if (rows < model.getRowCount()) {
      while (model.getRowCount() > rows)
        model.removeRow(model.getRowCount() - 1); 
    } else if (rows > model.getRowCount()) {
      for (int n = rowCount; n < rows; n++) {
        model.addRow(new String[] { "" });
      } 
    } 
    this.table.setModel(model);
    resizePanel();
  }
  
  public TableModel getTableModel() {
    if (this.table != null)
      return this.table.getModel(); 
    return null;
  }
  
  public int getRowCount() {
    return this.table.getRowCount();
  }
  
  public Object getValueAt(int i, int i1) {
    return this.table.getValueAt(i, i1);
  }
  
  public void setRowHeight(int height) {
    this.table.setRowHeight(height);
    resizePanel();
  }
  
  public void clearTable() {
    setTableData(new String[0]);
  }
  
  public void setTableData(String[] data) {
    DefaultTableModel model = (DefaultTableModel)this.table.getModel();
    model.setRowCount(10);
    for (int n = 0; n < data.length; n++) {
      if (data[n] != null) {
        model.setValueAt(data[n], n, 0);
      } else {
        model.setValueAt("", n, 0);
      } 
    } 
    for (int m = data.length; m < 10; m++)
      model.setValueAt("", m, 0); 
    this.table.setModel(model);
    setSize(getWidth(), 180);
  }
  
  public void setChartData(String[] data, boolean emtbModeConfigured) {
    if (this.isChartVisible) {
      this.panelChart = new EnergyPieChart(data, emtbModeConfigured);
      this.panelChart.setName("pnlChart");
      this.panelChartServiceReport = new EnergyPieChartServiceReport(data, emtbModeConfigured);
      this.panelChartServiceReport.setName("pnlChartServiceReport");
      GridBagConstraints gbcPanelChart = new GridBagConstraints();
      gbcPanelChart.fill = 3;
      gbcPanelChart.weighty = 1.0D;
      gbcPanelChart.gridx = 1;
      gbcPanelChart.gridy = 0;
      add((Component)this.panelChart, "East");
    } 
  }
  
  private void resizePanel() {
    int height = this.table.getRowHeight() * this.table.getModel().getRowCount();
    setSize(getWidth(), height);
  }
  
  private TableModel getStatisticsTableModel(String[] columnName) {
    return new DefaultTableModel(new Object[0][], columnName) {
        private static final long serialVersionUID = -6313560975922162760L;
        
        Class[] columnTypes = new Class<?>[] { String.class };
        
        boolean[] columnEditables = new boolean[] { false };
        
        public Class getColumnClass(int columnIndex) {
          return this.columnTypes[columnIndex];
        }
        
        public boolean isCellEditable(int row, int column) {
          return this.columnEditables[column];
        }
      };
  }
  
  public JFreeChart getChartForServiceReport() {
    if (this.panelChartServiceReport != null) {
      this.panelChartServiceReport.getChart().setBorderVisible(false);
      this.panelChartServiceReport.getChart().setTitle("");
      return this.panelChartServiceReport.getChart();
    } 
    return null;
  }
  
  public JFreeChart getChartDiagnosticTab() {
    if (this.panelChart != null)
      return this.panelChart.getChart(); 
    return null;
  }
  
  public Object getValueWsdl() {
    return this.table;
  }
}

package com.gigatronik.ebike.gui;

import javax.swing.text.AttributeSet;
import javax.swing.text.BadLocationException;
import javax.swing.text.DocumentFilter;
import org.apache.commons.lang3.StringUtils;
import org.slf4j.Logger;
import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;

public class SpecialCharacterFilter extends DocumentFilter {
  private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(SpecialCharacterFilter.class);
  
  private final char[] bannedCharacters = new char[] { 'µ', 'å', '∑', '®' };
  
  private final DocumentFilter delegate;
  
  public SpecialCharacterFilter(DocumentFilter delegate) {
    this.delegate = delegate;
  }
  
  public void replace(DocumentFilter.FilterBypass fb, int offset, int length, String text, AttributeSet attrs) throws BadLocationException {
    if (!StringUtils.containsAny(text, this.bannedCharacters)) {
      if (this.delegate != null) {
        this.delegate.replace(fb, offset, length, text, attrs);
      } else {
        super.replace(fb, offset, length, text, attrs);
      } 
    } else {
      LOGGER.warn("{} was prevented from rendering", text);
    } 
  }
  
  public void insertString(DocumentFilter.FilterBypass fb, int offset, String string, AttributeSet attr) throws BadLocationException {
    if (this.delegate != null) {
      this.delegate.insertString(fb, offset, string, attr);
    } else {
      super.insertString(fb, offset, string, attr);
    } 
  }
  
  public void remove(DocumentFilter.FilterBypass fb, int offset, int length) throws BadLocationException {
    if (this.delegate != null) {
      this.delegate.remove(fb, offset, length);
    } else {
      super.remove(fb, offset, length);
    } 
  }
}

  public EBikeSettingsTab(EBikeApplication eBikeApp, RightsManager rightsMan, BikeConfigurationPanelController bikeConfigurationPanelController) {
    this.eBikeApplication = eBikeApp;
    this.rightsManager = rightsMan;
    this.bikeConfigurationPanelController = bikeConfigurationPanelController;
    this.settingsTabBtnState = new SettingsTabBtnState(this);
    this.settingHandler = new MapRepositorySettingHandler();
    try {
      this.eslosUrl = SettingsProxy.getInstance().getGlobalSettings().getProperty("eslos_url");
    } catch (ConfigurationNotFoundException ex) {
      LOGGER.error("Error loading eslo URL", (Throwable)ex);
    } 
    createGui();
    init();
    this.rightsManager.addListener(this);
    ApplicationProcessManager.getInstance().addListener(this);
  }

    this.btnApply.addActionListener(new ActionListener() {
          public void actionPerformed(ActionEvent e) {
            EBikeSettingsTab.LOGGER.info("settings action: apply button clicked to change update URL");
            try {
              URI newUrl;
              String newUrlStr = EBikeSettingsTab.txtUpdateUrl.getText().trim();
              try {
                newUrl = new URL(EBikeSettingsTab.txtUpdateUrl.getText().trim()).toURI();
              } catch (URISyntaxException ex) {
                EBikeSettingsTab.LOGGER.warn("URISyntaxException for new Eslos URL: {} , Eslos URL will not be updated", newUrlStr, ex);
                EBikeSettingsTab.this.showNoConnectionToUrlErrorMessage(newUrlStr);
                return;
              } 
              if (!StringUtils.equals(newUrl.toString(), EBikeSettingsTab.this.eslosUrl)) {
                int httpResponse = new UpdateServerConnection().isBoschUpdateServer(newUrl);
                if (httpResponse == 401) {
                  EBikeSettingsTab.LOGGER.warn("Authentication error on update server '{}'", newUrl);
                  EBikeSettingsTab.this.showUpdateServerAuthenticationErrorMessage();
                  return;
                } 
                if (httpResponse < 200 || httpResponse >= 300) {
                  EBikeSettingsTab.LOGGER.warn("No connection to new Eslos URL: {} , Eslos URL will not be updated", newUrl);
                  EBikeSettingsTab.this.showNoConnectionToUrlErrorMessage(newUrl.toString());
                  return;
                } 
              } 
              int returnedValue = TestableJOptionPane.showConfirmDialog(EBikeSettingsTab.this.pnlServerSettings, EBikeSettingsTab.BUNDLE.getString("EBikeSettingsTab.updateUrl.optionPane.message"), 
                  EBikeSettingsTab.BUNDLE.getString("EBikeSettingsTab.updateUrl.optionPane.title"), 0);
              if (returnedValue == 0) {
                EBikeSettingsTab.LOGGER.info("Inserting new URL \"{}\" to update site list", EBikeSettingsTab.txtUpdateUrl.getText());
                EBikeSettingsTab.this.updateWorkingServerUrl(newUrl.toString());
                EBikeSettingsTab.this.eBikeApplication.showStatusInfo(EBikeSettingsTab.BUNDLE.getString("EBikeStatus.SERVER_URL_SET"));
              } 
            } catch (MalformedURLException ex) {
              EBikeSettingsTab.LOGGER.warn("updateBoschServerURL(): Invalid URL provided by user.", (Throwable)ex);
              String message = EBikeSettingsTab.BUNDLE.getString("EBikeSettingsTab.invalidUrl.optionPane.message");
              String title = EBikeSettingsTab.BUNDLE.getString("EBikeSettingsTab.invalidUrl.optionPane.title");
              TestableJOptionPane.showMessageDialog(EBikeSettingsTab.this.pnlServerSettings, message, title, 0);
              EBikeSettingsTab.txtUpdateUrl.requestFocusInWindow();
            } catch (ConfigurationNotFoundException ex) {
              EBikeSettingsTab.LOGGER.error("Configuration file is missing", (Throwable)ex);
            } 
          }
        });

    gbcBtnApply.insets = new Insets(0, 5, 5, 5);

    try {
      this.cmbDistance.setSelectedIndex(SettingsProxy.getInstance().getGlobalSettings().getInteger("unit_distance"));
    } catch (NumberFormatException|ConfigurationNotFoundException nfe) {
      LOGGER.warn("No unit conversion setting in config. Setting to default.", (Throwable)nfe);
      this.cmbDistance.setSelectedIndex(0);
    } 
    this.cmbDistance.addItemListener(new ItemListener() {
          public void itemStateChanged(ItemEvent e) {
            if (e.getStateChange() == 1) {
              int selectedIndex = EBikeSettingsTab.this.cmbDistance.getSelectedIndex();
              try {
                SettingsProxy.getInstance().getGlobalSettings().setProperty(TableEvaluatorImpl.Unit.DISTANCE.getUnitName(), String.valueOf(selectedIndex));
              } catch (ConfigurationNotFoundException e1) {
                EBikeSettingsTab.LOGGER.error("Cannot set distance unit property: Error -> " + e1.getMessage(), (Throwable)e1);
              } 
              String selectedDistance = (String)EBikeSettingsTab.this.cmbDistance.getSelectedItem();
              EBikeSettingsTab.LOGGER.info("settings action: the distance unit changed to " + selectedDistance);
              EBikeSettingsTab.this.publishEvent(new UnitChangeEvent(TableEvaluatorImpl.Unit.DISTANCE));
            } 
          }
        });

  private void selectProxySettings() {
    switch (ProxyManager.getInstance().getMode()) {
      case CUSTOM:
        this.rdbtnManualProxySettings.setSelected(true);
        this.txtProxyAddress.setEnabled(true);
        this.txtProxyPort.setEnabled(true);
        this.txtProxyUserName.setEnabled(true);
        this.txtProxyUserPwd.setEnabled(true);
        break;
      case DISABLE:
        this.rdbtnNoProxy.setSelected(true);
        this.txtProxyAddress.setEnabled(false);
        this.txtProxyPort.setEnabled(false);
        this.txtProxyUserName.setEnabled(false);
        this.txtProxyUserPwd.setEnabled(false);
        break;
      case SYSTEM:
        this.rdbtnSystemProxySettings.setSelected(true);
        this.txtProxyAddress.setEnabled(false);
        this.txtProxyPort.setEnabled(false);
        this.txtProxyUserName.setEnabled(false);
        this.txtProxyUserPwd.setEnabled(false);
        break;
    } 
  }
  
  private void initPasswordFilter() {
    PasswordDocumentFilter passwordFilter = new PasswordDocumentFilter("[! \"#$%&\\\\'()*+,-./0123456789:;<=>?@ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ\\]\\[^_`abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz{|}~]+");
    passwordFilter.setListener(() -> {
          if (!this.rdbtnManualProxySettings.isSelected())
            return; 
          Toolkit.getDefaultToolkit().beep();
          TestableJOptionPane.showMessageDialog(BUNDLE.getString("EBikeSettingsTab.passwordChanged.optionPane.message"), 
              BUNDLE.getString("EBikeSettingsTab.passwordChanged.optionPane.title"), 0);
        });
    ((AbstractDocument)this.txtProxyUserPwd.getDocument()).setDocumentFilter(passwordFilter);
  }
  
  private void fillProxySettings() {
    LOGGER.info("Read proxy config and set GUI elements");
    if (ProxyManager.getInstance().getHost() != null) {
      String host = ProxyManager.getInstance().getHost();
      this.txtProxyAddress.setText(host);
    } 
    if (ProxyManager.getInstance().getPort() != null)
      this.txtProxyPort.setText("" + ProxyManager.getInstance().getPort()); 
    if (ProxyManager.getInstance().getUsername() != null)
      this.txtProxyUserName.setText(ProxyManager.getInstance().getUsername()); 
    if (ProxyManager.getInstance().getPassword() != null)
      this.txtProxyUserPwd.setText(ProxyManager.getInstance().getPassword()); 
  }
  
  private void buildSettingUserData() {
    SettingUserData pnlCustomData = new SettingUserData(this.settingsTabBtnState);
    pnlCustomData.setName("pnlUserDataSettings");
    GridBagConstraints gbc_panel_CustomData = new GridBagConstraints();
    gbc_panel_CustomData.anchor = 11;
    gbc_panel_CustomData.fill = 2;
    gbc_panel_CustomData.gridx = 0;
    gbc_panel_CustomData.gridy = 8;
    this.pnlSettings.add(pnlCustomData, gbc_panel_CustomData);
  }
  
  public void updateWorkingServerUrl(String updateUrl) throws ConfigurationNotFoundException {
    SettingsProxy.getInstance().getGlobalSettings().setProperty("eslos_url", updateUrl);
    LOGGER.info("ESLos-URL updated in global settings to {}.", updateUrl);
    this.eslosUrl = updateUrl;
    txtFieldCurrentUrl.setText(updateUrl);
    txtUpdateUrl.setText("https://");
    LOGGER.info("ESLos-URL updated in the current URL field to {}.", updateUrl);
  }
  
  public void setUpdateSettings(UserLevel userLevel) {
    if (userLevel == UserLevel.OEM) {
      this.eBikeConfigurationPanelController.getFlashAssistantSettingsPanel().setVisible(true);
      this.pnlManufactureLogLocation.setVisible(true);
      this.pnlRemoteLogLocation.setVisible(true);
    } else {
      this.eBikeConfigurationPanelController.getFlashAssistantSettingsPanel().setVisible(false);
      this.pnlManufactureLogLocation.setVisible(false);
      this.pnlRemoteLogLocation.setVisible(false);
    } 
  }
  
  private void saveProxySettings() throws ConfigurationNotFoundException {
    LOGGER.info("Save the proxy settings into config properties.");
    ProxyManager.getInstance().setMode(getSelectedProxyMode());
    ProxyManager.getInstance().setHost(this.txtProxyAddress.getText().trim());
    ProxyManager.getInstance().setUsername(this.txtProxyUserName.getText().trim());
    ProxyManager.getInstance().setPassword(String.valueOf(this.txtProxyUserPwd.getPassword()).trim());
    if (!this.txtProxyPort.getText().trim().isEmpty()) {
      ProxyManager.getInstance().setPort(Integer.valueOf(this.txtProxyPort.getText().trim()));
    } else {
      ProxyManager.getInstance().setPort(null);
    } 
    TestableJOptionPane.showMessageDialog(BUNDLE.getString("EBikeSettingsTab.proxyChanged.optionPane.message"), 
        BUNDLE.getString("EBikeSettingsTab.proxyChanged.optionPane.title"), 1);
    fireProxySettingsChanged();
    this.eBikeApplication.showStatusInfo(BUNDLE.getString("EBikeStatus.PROXY_SAVED"));
  }
  
  private ProxyManager.ProxyMode getSelectedProxyMode() {
    if (this.rdbtnNoProxy.isSelected())
      return ProxyManager.ProxyMode.DISABLE; 
    if (this.rdbtnSystemProxySettings.isSelected())
      return ProxyManager.ProxyMode.SYSTEM; 
    return ProxyManager.ProxyMode.CUSTOM;
  }
  
  private void fireProxySettingsChanged() {
    this.settingsTabBtnState.onProxySettingsChanged(new ProxySettingsChangeEvent(this, this.txtProxyAddress.getText().trim(), this.txtProxyPort.getText().trim(), this.txtProxyUserName.getText().trim(), String.valueOf(this.txtProxyUserPwd.getPassword()).trim()));
  }
  
  private void fireProxyModeChanged() {
    this.settingsTabBtnState.onProxyModeChanged(getSelectedProxyMode());
  }
  
  public void setBtnSaveEnabledState(boolean enabled) {
    this.btnSave.setEnabled(enabled);
  }

      EventQueue.invokeLater(() -> {

            updateMapsRepositoryLocationConfigurationButtonEnableStateTo(true);
          });

  class PortDocumentFilter extends DocumentFilter {
    public void replace(DocumentFilter.FilterBypass fb, int offset, int length, String text, AttributeSet attrs) throws BadLocationException {
      String oldValue = fb.getDocument().getText(0, fb.getDocument().getLength());
      if (text.matches("[0-9]*") && fb.getDocument().getLength() - length + text.length() < 6) {
        fb.replace(offset, length, text, attrs);
        int newValue = Integer.parseInt(fb.getDocument().getText(0, fb.getDocument().getLength()));
        if (newValue > 65535 || newValue < 1)
          EBikeSettingsTab.this.txtProxyPort.setText(oldValue); 
      } else {
        Toolkit.getDefaultToolkit().beep();
      } 
    }
  }
  
  public void onRightsChanged(RightsChangedEvent event) {
    LOGGER.debug("Received rights changed event '{}'", event);
    if (event.getUserLevel() != UserLevel.UNKNOWN)
      EventQueue.invokeLater(() -> {
            LOGGER.debug("Process rights change event now from EDT");
            boolean visible = (event.getUserLevel() == UserLevel.IBD);
            this.pnlMapRepository.setVisible(visible);
            setUpdateSettings(event.getUserLevel());
          }); 
  }

  private void saveRemoteLoggingLocation(ActionEvent e) {
    try {
      GlobalSettingsProxy globalSettings = SettingsProxy.getInstance().getGlobalSettings();
      if (globalSettings != null) {
        String orgPath = globalSettings.getProperty("remote_log_directory");
        LOGGER.info("Open filechooser for remote session log at current path {}", orgPath);
        JFileChooser fc = new JFileChooser(orgPath);
        fc.setMultiSelectionEnabled(false);
        fc.setFileSelectionMode(1);
        int returnValue = fc.showOpenDialog(TestableJOptionPane.getDefaultParentFrame());
        if (returnValue == 0) {
          String newPath = fc.getSelectedFile().getAbsolutePath();
          if (!StringUtils.equalsIgnoreCase(orgPath, newPath)) {
            new File(newPath).mkdirs();
            globalSettings.setProperty("remote_log_directory", newPath);
            this.txtRemoteLogLocation.setText(globalSettings.getProperty("remote_log_directory"));
            File orgFile = new File(orgPath + orgPath + "remote-diagnostic.log");
            moveFile(orgFile, orgPath, newPath);
          } 
        } 
      } 
    } catch (ConfigurationNotFoundException ex) {
      LOGGER.error("Failed to change remote session log directory. Configuration file is missing", (Throwable)ex);
    } 
  }
  
  private void moveFile(File orgFile, String orgPath, String newPath) {
    if (orgFile.exists() && !orgFile.isDirectory())
      try {
        String orgFilePath = orgPath + orgPath + "remote-diagnostic.log";
        String newFilePath = newPath + newPath + "remote-diagnostic.log";
        Files.move(Paths.get(orgFilePath), Paths.get(newFilePath), StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING);
      } catch (IOException ex) {
        LOGGER.error("Error while copying remote session log to new location", (Throwable)ex);
      }  
  }
  
  private void copyOriginalManufactureLogToNewLoaction(String orgPath, String newPath) {
    try(InputStream in = new FileInputStream(orgPath + orgPath + "manufacture.log"); 
        OutputStream out = new FileOutputStream(newPath + newPath + "manufacture.log")) {
      IOUtils.copy(in, out);
    } catch (IOException ex) {
      LOGGER.error("Error while copying manufacture log to new location", (Throwable)ex);
    } 
  }

    LOGGER.info("settings action: btnSelectRepository clicked to open file chooser dialog");

    File directory = new File(path);

      throw new ConfigurationNotFoundException("Directory at '" + path + "' does not exist");
    } 
  }

package com.gigatronik.ebike.gui.tabSettings.filter;

import javax.swing.text.AttributeSet;
import javax.swing.text.BadLocationException;
import javax.swing.text.DocumentFilter;

public class PasswordDocumentFilter extends DocumentFilter {
  private InvalidPasswordListener listener;
  
  private final String validCharsRegex;
  
  public PasswordDocumentFilter(String regex) {
    this.validCharsRegex = regex;
  }
  
  public void replace(DocumentFilter.FilterBypass fb, int offset, int length, String text, AttributeSet attrs) throws BadLocationException {
    if (!text.matches(this.validCharsRegex)) {
      fireOnInvalidPasswordCharactersFound();
    } else {
      super.replace(fb, offset, length, text, attrs);
    } 
  }
  
  private void fireOnInvalidPasswordCharactersFound() {
    if (this.listener != null)
      this.listener.onInvalidPassword(); 
  }
  
  public void setListener(InvalidPasswordListener listener) {
    this.listener = listener;
  }
  
  public static interface InvalidPasswordListener {
    void onInvalidPassword();
  }
}

ITEM 332: com/gigatronik/ebike/gui/tabSettings/JpegReader.java
========================================================================================================================
package com.gigatronik.ebike.gui.tabSettings;

import java.awt.color.ColorSpace;
import java.awt.color.ICC_ColorSpace;
import java.awt.color.ICC_Profile;
import java.awt.image.BufferedImage;
import java.awt.image.ColorConvertOp;
import java.awt.image.Raster;
import java.awt.image.WritableRaster;
import java.io.File;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Iterator;
import javax.imageio.IIOException;
import javax.imageio.ImageIO;
import javax.imageio.ImageReader;
import javax.imageio.stream.ImageInputStream;
import org.apache.sanselan.ImageReadException;
import org.apache.sanselan.Sanselan;
import org.apache.sanselan.common.byteSources.ByteSource;
import org.apache.sanselan.common.byteSources.ByteSourceFile;
import org.apache.sanselan.formats.jpeg.JpegImageParser;
import org.apache.sanselan.formats.jpeg.segments.UnknownSegment;
import org.slf4j.Logger;
import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;

public final class JpegReader {
  private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(JpegReader.class);
  
  public static final int COLOR_TYPE_RGB = 1;
  
  public static final int COLOR_TYPE_CMYK = 2;
  
  public static final int COLOR_TYPE_YCCK = 3;
  
  private static int colorType = 1;
  
  private static boolean hasAdobeMarker = false;
  
  public static BufferedImage readImage(File file) throws IOException, ImageReadException {
    colorType = 1;
    hasAdobeMarker = false;
    ImageInputStream stream = ImageIO.createImageInputStream(file);
    Iterator<ImageReader> iter = ImageIO.getImageReaders(stream);
    if (iter.hasNext()) {
      BufferedImage image;
      ImageReader reader = iter.next();
      reader.setInput(stream);
      ICC_Profile profile = null;
      try {
        image = reader.read(0);
      } catch (IIOException e) {
        LOGGER.error("Error reading image", (Throwable)e);
        colorType = 2;
        checkAdobeMarker(file);
        profile = Sanselan.getICCProfile(file);
        WritableRaster raster = (WritableRaster)reader.readRaster(0, null);
        if (colorType == 3)
          convertYcckToCmyk(raster); 
        if (hasAdobeMarker)
          convertInvertedColors(raster); 
        image = convertCmykToRgb(raster, profile);
      } 
      return image;
    } 
    return null;
  }
  
  private static void checkAdobeMarker(File file) throws IOException, ImageReadException {
    JpegImageParser parser = new JpegImageParser();
    ByteSourceFile byteSourceFile = new ByteSourceFile(file);
    ArrayList<UnknownSegment> segments = parser.readSegments((ByteSource)byteSourceFile, new int[] { 65518 }, true);
    if (segments != null && segments.size() >= 1) {
      UnknownSegment app14Segment = segments.get(0);
      byte[] data = app14Segment.bytes;
      if (data.length >= 12 && data[0] == 65 && data[1] == 100 && data[2] == 111 && data[3] == 98 && data[4] == 101) {
        hasAdobeMarker = true;
        int transform = app14Segment.bytes[11] & 0xFF;
        if (transform == 2)
          colorType = 3; 
      } 
    } 
  }
  
  private static void convertYcckToCmyk(WritableRaster raster) {
    int height = raster.getHeight();
    int width = raster.getWidth();
    int stride = width * 4;
    int[] pixelRow = new int[stride];
    for (int h = 0; h < height; h++) {
      raster.getPixels(0, h, width, 1, pixelRow);
      for (int x = 0; x < stride; x += 4) {
        int y = pixelRow[x];
        int cb = pixelRow[x + 1];
        int cr = pixelRow[x + 2];
        int c = (int)((double)y + 1.402D * (double)cr - 178.956D);
        int m = (int)((double)y - 0.34414D * (double)cb - 0.71414D * (double)cr + 135.95984D);
        y = (int)((double)y + 1.772D * (double)cb - 226.316D);
        if (c < 0) {
          c = 0;
        } else if (c > 255) {
          c = 255;
        } 
        if (m < 0) {
          m = 0;
        } else if (m > 255) {
          m = 255;
        } 
        if (y < 0) {
          y = 0;
        } else if (y > 255) {
          y = 255;
        } 
        pixelRow[x] = 255 - c;
        pixelRow[x + 1] = 255 - m;
        pixelRow[x + 2] = 255 - y;
      } 
      raster.setPixels(0, h, width, 1, pixelRow);
    } 
  }
  
  private static void convertInvertedColors(WritableRaster raster) {
    int height = raster.getHeight();
    int width = raster.getWidth();
    int stride = width * 4;
    int[] pixelRow = new int[stride];
    for (int h = 0; h < height; h++) {
      raster.getPixels(0, h, width, 1, pixelRow);
      for (int x = 0; x < stride; x++)
        pixelRow[x] = 255 - pixelRow[x]; 
      raster.setPixels(0, h, width, 1, pixelRow);
    } 
  }
  
  private static BufferedImage convertCmykToRgb(Raster cmykRaster, ICC_Profile cmykProfile) throws IOException {
    if (cmykProfile == null)
      cmykProfile = ICC_Profile.getInstance(JpegReader.class.getClassLoader().getResourceAsStream("ICC-Profiles/CoatedFOGRA27.icc")); 
    if (cmykProfile.getProfileClass() != 1) {
      byte[] profileData = cmykProfile.getData();
      if (profileData[64] == 0) {
        intToBigEndian(1835955314, profileData, 12);
        cmykProfile = ICC_Profile.getInstance(profileData);
      } 
    } 
    ICC_ColorSpace cmykCS = new ICC_ColorSpace(cmykProfile);
    BufferedImage rgbImage = new BufferedImage(cmykRaster.getWidth(), cmykRaster.getHeight(), 1);
    WritableRaster rgbRaster = rgbImage.getRaster();
    ColorSpace rgbCS = rgbImage.getColorModel().getColorSpace();
    ColorConvertOp cmykToRgb = new ColorConvertOp(cmykCS, rgbCS, null);
    cmykToRgb.filter(cmykRaster, rgbRaster);
    return rgbImage;
  }
  
  static void intToBigEndian(int value, byte[] array, int index) {
    array[index] = (byte)(value >> 24);
    array[index + 1] = (byte)(value >> 16);
    array[index + 2] = (byte)(value >> 8);
    array[index + 3] = (byte)value;
  }
}

  private void selectImage() {
    JFileChooser fileChooser;
    try {
      fileChooser = new JFileChooser(SettingsProxy.getInstance().getGlobalSettings().getProperty("last_loaded_logo"));
    } catch (ConfigurationNotFoundException e) {
      LOGGER.error("Error in selectImage: " + e);
      fileChooser = new JFileChooser();
    } 
    fileChooser.removeChoosableFileFilter(fileChooser.getFileFilter());
    fileChooser.setFileFilter(new FileNameExtensionFilter("jpg, jpeg, bmp, tif, png", new String[] { "JPG", "JPEG", "BMP", "TIF", "PNG" }));
    String sResPath = SettingsProxy.getInstance().getDataPath();
    int status = fileChooser.showOpenDialog(TestableJOptionPane.getDefaultParentFrame());
    if (status == 0) {
      String selectedFilename = fileChooser.getSelectedFile().getAbsoluteFile().getPath();
      try {
        SettingsProxy.getInstance().getGlobalSettings().setProperty("last_loaded_logo", selectedFilename);
      } catch (ConfigurationNotFoundException e) {
        LOGGER.error("Failed to set last loaded logo property:", (Throwable)e);
      } 
      try {
        loadResizeAndSaveSelectedImage(sResPath, selectedFilename);
      } catch (ImageReadException|IOException e) {
        LOGGER.error("Failed to resize and save selected logo", (Throwable)e);
        TestableJOptionPane.showMessageDialog(BUNDLE.getString("SettingUserData.selectImage.error.optionPane.message"), 
            BUNDLE.getString("SettingUserData.selectImage.error.optionPane.title"), 0);
        return;
      } 
      String resLogo = sResPath + sResPath + "Logo_Temp.png";
      ImageIcon pic = new ImageIcon(resLogo);
      pic.getImage().flush();
      pic = new ImageIcon(resLogo);
      this.lblLogo.setIcon(pic);
      this.btnClearLogo.setEnabled(true);
      fireSettingsChangedEvent();
    } 
  }
  
  private void clearImage() {
    this.lblLogo.setIcon(null);
    this.lblLogo.revalidate();
    this.btnClearLogo.setEnabled(false);
    try {
      String dataPath = SettingsProxy.getInstance().getDataPath();
      FileUtils.forceDelete(new File(dataPath + dataPath + "Logo_Customer.png"));
      FileUtils.forceDelete(new File(dataPath + dataPath + "Logo_Temp.png"));
      SettingsProxy.getInstance().getGlobalSettings().setProperty("last_saved_logo", "");
    } catch (IOException ex) {
      LOGGER.error("Failed to delete logo files in data directory", (Throwable)ex);
    } catch (ConfigurationNotFoundException ex) {
      LOGGER.error("Failed to reset last saved logo property", (Throwable)ex);
    } 
  }
  
  private void loadResizeAndSaveSelectedImage(String resPath, String filename) throws ImageReadException, IOException {
    String ext = FilenameUtils.getExtension(filename);
    if (ext.compareToIgnoreCase("jpeg") == 0 || ext.compareToIgnoreCase("jpg") == 0) {
      File file = new File(filename);
      BufferedImage outImg = JpegReader.readImage(file);
      resizeImageAndSave(resPath, outImg);
    } else {
      File file = new File(filename);
      BufferedImage img = ImageIO.read(file);
      resizeImageAndSave(resPath, img);
    } 
  }
  
  public void buttonStateChanged(SettingsTabBtnState state) {
    this.btnSave.setEnabled(state.isUserSettingsSaveEnabled());
  }
  
  class SettingUserDataTextFieldListener implements DocumentListener {
    private void textChange() {
      SettingUserData.this.fireSettingsChangedEvent();
    }
    
    public void changedUpdate(DocumentEvent e) {
      textChange();
    }
    
    public void insertUpdate(DocumentEvent e) {
      textChange();
    }
    
    public void removeUpdate(DocumentEvent e) {
      textChange();
    }
  }
  
  private void fireSettingsChangedEvent() {
    try {
      boolean nameChanged = !StringUtils.equals(txtCompanyName.getText().trim(), SettingsProxy.getInstance().getGlobalSettings().getProperty("settings_userdata_companyName"));
      boolean custNumberChanged = !StringUtils.equals(txtCustomerNumber.getText().trim(), 
          SettingsProxy.getInstance().getGlobalSettings().getProperty("settings_userdata_customerNumber"));
      boolean adrChanged = !StringUtils.equals(txtCustomerAddress.getText().trim(), 
          SettingsProxy.getInstance().getGlobalSettings().getProperty("settings_userdata_customerAddress"));
      boolean phoneNumberChanged = !StringUtils.equals(txtCustomerPhoneNumber.getText().trim(), 
          SettingsProxy.getInstance().getGlobalSettings().getProperty("settings_userdata_customerPhoneNumber"));
      boolean emailChanged = !StringUtils.equals(this.customerEmailText, 
          SettingsProxy.getInstance().getGlobalSettings().getProperty("settings_userdata_customerEMail"));
      boolean websiteChanged = !StringUtils.equals(txtCustomerWebsite.getText().trim(), 
          SettingsProxy.getInstance().getGlobalSettings().getProperty("settings_userdata_customerWebsite"));
      boolean picChanged = !StringUtils.equals(SettingsProxy.getInstance().getGlobalSettings().getProperty("last_loaded_logo"), 
          SettingsProxy.getInstance().getGlobalSettings().getProperty("last_saved_logo"));
      boolean settingsHaveChanged = (picChanged || nameChanged || custNumberChanged || adrChanged || phoneNumberChanged || emailChanged || websiteChanged);
      this.settingsTabBtnState.onUserSettingsBtnStateChanged(this.event.setSettingsHaveChanged(settingsHaveChanged));
    } catch (ConfigurationNotFoundException e1) {
      LOGGER.error("ConfigurationNotFound: " + e1);
    } 
  }
  
  private void resizeImageAndSave(String resPath, BufferedImage outImg) throws IOException {
    int imgOrigWidth = outImg.getWidth(null);
    int imgOrigHeight = outImg.getHeight(null);
    int imgNewWidth = this.lblLogo.getWidth();
    int imgNewHeight = this.lblLogo.getHeight();
    double imgScaleWidth = (double)imgNewWidth / (double)imgOrigWidth;
    double imgScaleHeight = (double)imgNewHeight / (double)imgOrigHeight;
    if (imgScaleWidth > imgScaleHeight) {
      imgNewWidth = (int)((double)imgOrigWidth * imgScaleHeight);
      imgNewHeight = (int)((double)imgOrigHeight * imgScaleHeight);
    } else {
      imgNewWidth = (int)((double)imgOrigWidth * imgScaleWidth);
      imgNewHeight = (int)((double)imgOrigHeight * imgScaleWidth);
    } 
    Image scaledImage = outImg.getScaledInstance(imgNewWidth, imgNewHeight, 4);
    BufferedImage outImgScaled = new BufferedImage(imgNewWidth, imgNewHeight, 2);
    Graphics g = outImgScaled.getGraphics();
    g.drawImage(scaledImage, 0, 0, null);
    g.dispose();
    String tempLogo = "Logo_Temp.png";
    String sResource_Testbild = resPath + resPath + "Logo_Temp.png";
    File fTempLogo = new File(sResource_Testbild);
    fTempLogo.getParentFile().mkdirs();
    ImageIO.write(outImgScaled, "png", fTempLogo);
  }
}

      setText(this.bundle.getString("EBikeHeader.NOT_CONNECTED"));

      this.statusPanel.displayClientIdText();
      setFont(this.idFont);

  }

    setClientId(id);
  }

  }

    LOGGER.debug("Session state changed to {} peerId {}", Boolean.valueOf(established), peerId);
  }

ITEM 335: com/gigatronik/ebike/threads/RemoteTokenThread.java
========================================================================================================================
package com.gigatronik.ebike.threads;

import com.gigatronik.beds.service.rightsmanager.api.RightsManager;
import com.gigatronik.bosch.plugin.tokenproxy.TokenPluginProxy;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.framework.plugins.interfaces.RemoteClientDartPlugin;
import java.util.concurrent.CountDownLatch;
import java.util.concurrent.Future;
import java.util.concurrent.ScheduledExecutorService;
import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit;
import java.util.function.Supplier;
import org.slf4j.Logger;
import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;

public class RemoteTokenThread {
  private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(RemoteTokenThread.class);
  
  private static final long CHECK_INTERVAL = 2000L;
  
  private static final long STOP_TIMEOUT = 3000L;
  
  private final ScheduledExecutorService executor;
  
  private final RemoteClientDartPlugin remote;
  
  private final RightsManager rightsManager;
  
  private final Supplier<TokenPluginProxy> tokenPluginProxySupplier;
  
  private Future future;
  
  private CountDownLatch cancelLatch;
  
  private boolean oldValue;
  
  public RemoteTokenThread(RightsManager rightsManager, ScheduledExecutorService executor, RemoteClientDartPlugin remote, Supplier<TokenPluginProxy> tokenPluginProxySupplier) {
    this.rightsManager = rightsManager;
    this.executor = executor;
    this.remote = remote;
    this.tokenPluginProxySupplier = tokenPluginProxySupplier;
  }
  
  public void start() {
    scheduleTask();
  }
  
  public void stop() {
    CountDownLatch latch = cancelTask();
    if (latch == null)
      return; 
    try {
      boolean cancelled = latch.await(3000L, TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS);
      LOGGER.trace("Stop RemoteTokenThread, task cancelled = {}", Boolean.valueOf(cancelled));
    } catch (InterruptedException ex) {
      Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
      LOGGER.error("Thread interrupted on stopping remote token thread", (Throwable)ex);
      Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
    } 
  }
  
  private void refreshValue() {
    boolean cancel = isCancelling();
    LOGGER.debug("Checking if remote dongle used...");
    try {
      boolean currentValue = Boolean.parseBoolean(this.remote.getProperties().getProperty("USE_REMOTE_DONGLE"));
      if (currentValue != this.oldValue) {
        LOGGER.debug("remote-dongle-used state changed to {}", Boolean.valueOf(currentValue));
        this.oldValue = currentValue;
        String userLevel = (String)this.tokenPluginProxySupplier.get().getTokenProperties().get("User level");
        LOGGER.debug("Token Plugin Proxy returned user level '{}'", userLevel);
        this.rightsManager.setRawUserLevel(userLevel);
      } 
    } catch (Exception e) {
      LOGGER.error("Error running remote token thread", (Throwable)e);
    } 
    if (cancel)
      doCancelIfStopped(); 
  }
  
  private synchronized boolean isRunning() {
    return (this.future != null && !this.future.isDone());
  }
  
  private synchronized void scheduleTask() {
    if (!isRunning()) {
      LOGGER.info("Start RemoteTokenThread");
      this.future = this.executor.scheduleAtFixedRate(this::refreshValue, 0L, 2000L, TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS);
    } 
  }
  
  private synchronized CountDownLatch cancelTask() {
    if (isRunning() && this.cancelLatch == null) {
      LOGGER.info("Stop RemoteTokenThread");
      this.cancelLatch = new CountDownLatch(1);
    } 
    return this.cancelLatch;
  }
  
  private synchronized boolean isCancelling() {
    return (this.cancelLatch != null);
  }
  
  private synchronized void doCancelIfStopped() {
    if (this.cancelLatch != null) {
      this.future.cancel(false);
      this.cancelLatch.countDown();
      this.cancelLatch = null;
    } 
  }
}

package com.gigatronik.ebike.utils;

import javax.swing.JComponent;
import javax.swing.JScrollBar;
import javax.swing.JScrollPane;
import javax.swing.JSpinner;
import javax.swing.JViewport;

public final class ComponentNamingHelper {
  private static final String SCROLL_BAR_H_SUFFIX = "InnerHBar";
  
  private static final String SCROLL_BAR_V_SUFFIX = "InnerVBar";
  
  private static final String VIEW_PORT_SUFFIX = "InnerViewPort";
  
  private static final String EDITOR_SUFFIX = "InnerEditor";
  
  public static void addNamesForInnerScrollBarsAndViewPort(JScrollPane scrollPane, String componentPrefix, String scrollPaneName) {
    String prefixAndSpecifier = componentPrefix + componentPrefix;
    JScrollBar innerHorizontalScrollBar = scrollPane.getHorizontalScrollBar();
    innerHorizontalScrollBar.setName(prefixAndSpecifier + "InnerHBar");
    JScrollBar innerVerticalScrollBar = scrollPane.getVerticalScrollBar();
    innerVerticalScrollBar.setName(prefixAndSpecifier + "InnerVBar");
    JViewport innerViewport = scrollPane.getViewport();
    innerViewport.setName(prefixAndSpecifier + "InnerViewPort");
  }
  
  public static void addNameForInnerEditor(JSpinner spinner, String componentPrefix, String spinnerName) {
    JComponent spnEditor = spinner.getEditor();
    spnEditor.setName(componentPrefix + componentPrefix + "InnerEditor");
  }
}

package com.gigatronik.ebike.utils;

import com.gigatronik.beds.settings.SettingsProxy;
import com.gigatronik.beds.settings.global.GlobalSettingsProxy;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.bosch.updateserver.UPDATE_SERVER_URL;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.framework.plugins.exceptions.ConfigurationNotFoundException;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.framework.util.Version;
import java.io.File;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.InputStream;
import java.util.Enumeration;
import java.util.Properties;
import javax.swing.filechooser.FileSystemView;
import org.apache.commons.lang3.StringUtils;
import org.slf4j.Logger;
import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;

public class ConfigUtil {
  private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(ConfigUtil.class);
  
  private static final String FALSE = "false";
  
  private static final int MIN_VERSION_ELEMENTS = 4;
  
  private static String templateFileName = "EBike.cfg.template";
  
  public static boolean configFileValidation() throws ConfigurationNotFoundException {
    LOGGER.info("configFileValidation(): Validating logger file");
    Properties templateProperties = loadConfigTemplateFile();
    Enumeration<?> templatePropertyNames = templateProperties.propertyNames();
    while (templatePropertyNames.hasMoreElements()) {
      Object element = templatePropertyNames.nextElement();
      if (SettingsProxy.getInstance().getGlobalSettings().getProperty(element.toString()) == null)
        SettingsProxy.getInstance().getGlobalSettings().setProperty(element.toString(), ""); 
    } 
    boolean unitializedValueFound = initIfNotAvailable(SettingsProxy.getInstance().getGlobalSettings(), "proxy", "0");
    unitializedValueFound |= initIfNotAvailable(SettingsProxy.getInstance().getGlobalSettings(), "eslos_url", UPDATE_SERVER_URL.getDefaultBaseUrl().toString());
    unitializedValueFound |= initIfNotAvailable(SettingsProxy.getInstance().getGlobalSettings(), "unit_distance", "0");
    unitializedValueFound |= initIfNotAvailable(SettingsProxy.getInstance().getGlobalSettings(), "unit_height", "0");
    unitializedValueFound |= initIfNotAvailable(SettingsProxy.getInstance().getGlobalSettings(), "unit_temperature", "0");
    unitializedValueFound |= initIfNotAvailable(SettingsProxy.getInstance().getGlobalSettings(), "unit_circumference", "0");
    unitializedValueFound |= initIfNotAvailable(SettingsProxy.getInstance().getGlobalSettings(), "unit_speed", "0");
    unitializedValueFound |= initIfNotAvailable(SettingsProxy.getInstance().getGlobalSettings(), "flashassistant_button_enabled", "false");
    unitializedValueFound |= initIfNotAvailable(SettingsProxy.getInstance().getGlobalSettings(), "flashassistant_battery_key_visible", "true");
    unitializedValueFound |= initIfNotAvailable(SettingsProxy.getInstance().getGlobalSettings(), "flashassistant_flash_automatically_activated", "false");
    unitializedValueFound |= initIfNotAvailable(SettingsProxy.getInstance().getGlobalSettings(), "configurationtab_configuration_comment_visible", "false");
    unitializedValueFound |= initIfNotAvailable(SettingsProxy.getInstance().getGlobalSettings(), "crm_country", "");
    unitializedValueFound |= initIfNotAvailable(SettingsProxy.getInstance().getGlobalSettings(), "crm_customer_name", "");
    unitializedValueFound |= initIfNotAvailable(SettingsProxy.getInstance().getGlobalSettings(), "settings_userdata_companyName", "");
    unitializedValueFound |= initIfNotAvailable(SettingsProxy.getInstance().getGlobalSettings(), "settings_userdata_customerNumber", "");
    unitializedValueFound |= initIfNotAvailable(SettingsProxy.getInstance().getGlobalSettings(), "settings_userdata_customerAddress", "");
    unitializedValueFound |= initIfNotAvailable(SettingsProxy.getInstance().getGlobalSettings(), "settings_userdata_customerPhoneNumber", "");
    unitializedValueFound |= initIfNotAvailable(SettingsProxy.getInstance().getGlobalSettings(), "settings_userdata_customerEMail", "");
    unitializedValueFound |= initIfNotAvailable(SettingsProxy.getInstance().getGlobalSettings(), "settings_userdata_customerWebsite", "");
    String manufactureLogDir = SettingsProxy.getInstance().getGlobalSettings().getProperty("manufacture_log_directory");
    if (StringUtils.isBlank(manufactureLogDir) || !new File(manufactureLogDir).exists())
      SettingsProxy.getInstance().getGlobalSettings().setProperty("manufacture_log_directory", SettingsProxy.getInstance().getDataPath()); 
    String bctDir = SettingsProxy.getInstance().getGlobalSettings().getProperty("last_opened_folder");
    if (StringUtils.isBlank(bctDir) || !new File(bctDir).isDirectory())
      SettingsProxy.getInstance().getGlobalSettings().setProperty("last_opened_folder", FileSystemView.getFileSystemView().getDefaultDirectory().getPath()); 
    String remoteLogDir = SettingsProxy.getInstance().getGlobalSettings().getProperty("remote_log_directory");
    if (StringUtils.isBlank(remoteLogDir) || !new File(remoteLogDir).isDirectory())
      SettingsProxy.getInstance().getGlobalSettings().setProperty("remote_log_directory", FileSystemView.getFileSystemView().getDefaultDirectory().getPath()); 
    return !unitializedValueFound;
  }
  
  private static boolean initIfNotAvailable(GlobalSettingsProxy settings, String property, String initialValue) {
    if (StringUtils.isBlank(settings.getProperty(property))) {
      LOGGER.warn("No value for key '{}', setting to default '{}'.", property, initialValue);
      settings.setProperty(property, initialValue);
      return StringUtils.isNotBlank(initialValue);
    } 
    return false;
  }
  
  private static Properties loadConfigTemplateFile() {
    LOGGER.info("loadConfigTemplateFile(): Reading config template file");
    Properties p = new Properties();
    InputStream in = ClassLoader.getSystemResourceAsStream(templateFileName);
    try {
      p.load(in);
      in.close();
    } catch (IOException ioexception) {
      LOGGER.error("loadConfigTemplateFile(): Error reading config template file", (Throwable)ioexception);
    } 
    return p;
  }
  
  public static String getDisplayVersion() {
    Version fullVersion = getFullVersion();
    if (fullVersion.getElementCount() < 4) {
      LOGGER.error("getDisplayVersion(): Application version string is not valid (to short)");
      return getFullVersion().toString();
    } 
    Version displayVersion = new Version(new Integer[] { fullVersion.getMAJOR(), fullVersion.getMINOR(), fullVersion.getBUILD(), fullVersion.getINTERNAL() });
    return displayVersion.toString();
  }
  
  public static Version getFullVersion() {
    Version result = new Version(new Integer[] { 0, 0, 0, 0, 0 });
    try {
      String appVersion = SettingsProxy.getInstance().getInternalSettings().getProperty("application.version");
      if (appVersion != null) {
        appVersion = appVersion.split("-")[0];
        return Version.parse(appVersion);
      } 
    } catch (ConfigurationNotFoundException|IOException|NumberFormatException ex) {
      LOGGER.error("getImplementationVersion(): error retrieving implementation version", (Throwable)ex);
    } 
    return result;
  }
}

ITEM 338: com/gigatronik/ebike/utils/FileUtil.java

package com.gigatronik.ebike.utils;

import java.io.BufferedInputStream;
import java.io.BufferedOutputStream;
import java.io.File;
import java.io.FileOutputStream;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.util.Enumeration;
import java.util.zip.ZipEntry;
import java.util.zip.ZipFile;

public class FileUtil {
  private static final int MAX_BUFFER = 4096;
  
  public static String unzip(File fSourceZip) throws IOException {
    byte[] buffer = new byte[4096];
    String zipPath = fSourceZip.getCanonicalPath().replaceFirst("[.][^.]+$", "") + "Unzipped";
    File tempDir = new File(zipPath);
    tempDir.mkdir();
    try (ZipFile zipFile = new ZipFile(fSourceZip)) {
      Enumeration<?> e = zipFile.entries();
      while (e.hasMoreElements()) {
        ZipEntry entry = (ZipEntry)e.nextElement();
        File destinationFilePath = new File(zipPath, entry.getName());
        destinationFilePath.getParentFile().mkdirs();
        if (!entry.isDirectory())
          try(BufferedInputStream bis = new BufferedInputStream(zipFile.getInputStream(entry)); BufferedOutputStream bos = new BufferedOutputStream(new FileOutputStream(destinationFilePath), 4096)) {
            int b;
            while ((b = bis.read(buffer, 0, 4096)) != -1)
              bos.write(buffer, 0, b); 
            bos.flush();
          }  
      } 
    } 
    return zipPath;
  }
}

package com.gigatronik.ebike.utils;

import com.gigatronik.beds.common.order.OrderableListener;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.configuration.ConfigurationManager;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.configuration.api.HardwareConnectionChangesListener;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.configuration.event.HardwareConnectionChangedEvent;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.flashcontainer.download.PreliminaryContainerDownloader;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.flashcontainer.download.PreliminaryContainerDownloaderFactory;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.flashcontainer.download.PreliminaryContainerDownloaderListener;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.flashcontainer.download.PreliminaryContainerEvent;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.rightsmanager.api.RightsManager;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.rightsmanager.api.UserLevel;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.bosch.applicationprocess.ApplicationProcessManager;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.common.configuration.Constants;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.utils.updater.FirmwareUpdate;
import java.awt.EventQueue;
import javax.swing.SwingUtilities;
import org.slf4j.Logger;
import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;

public class FirmwareUpdatesManager implements PreliminaryContainerDownloaderListener, HardwareConnectionChangesListener {
  private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(FirmwareUpdatesManager.class);
  
  private final RightsManager rightsManager;
  
  private final FirmwareUpdate fwUpdate;
  
  private final PreliminaryContainerDownloader containerDownloader;
  
  public FirmwareUpdatesManager(RightsManager rightsManager, FirmwareUpdate updater, ConfigurationManager configurationManager) {
    this.rightsManager = rightsManager;
    this.fwUpdate = updater;
    this.containerDownloader = PreliminaryContainerDownloaderFactory.getPreliminaryContainerDownloader();
    listenPreliminaryContainerDownloader(this.containerDownloader);
    configurationManager.addListener((OrderableListener)this);
  }
  
  private void downloadPreliminaryContainer() {
    shutdownCheckupdateThread();
    this.containerDownloader.downloadPreliminaryContainer();
  }
  
  private void shutdownCheckupdateThread() {
    if (SwingUtilities.isEventDispatchThread()) {
      closeDialogs();
    } else {
      EventQueue.invokeLater(() -> 
          closeDialogs());
    } 
    this.containerDownloader.shutdownDownloaderThread();
  }
  
  private void closeDialogs() {
    LOGGER.trace("Close dialogs ...");
    this.fwUpdate.closeFwUpdateDialog();
    this.fwUpdate.closeAdditionalFwUpdateDialog();
    LOGGER.trace("... closed dialogs");
  }
  
  public PreliminaryContainerDownloader getContainerDownloader() {
    return this.containerDownloader;
  }
  
  private synchronized void onBikeConnect() {
    if (this.rightsManager.isUserInLevel(UserLevel.IBD))
      downloadPreliminaryContainer(); 
  }
  
  private synchronized void onAdditionalEcuConnect() {
    if (this.fwUpdate.wasInitialFwUpdateDialogShown().get()) {
      shutdownCheckupdateThread();
      Integer selectedValue = this.fwUpdate.showAdditionalFwUpdateDialog();
      if (selectedValue == null || selectedValue == 1) {
        this.fwUpdate.setAdditionalFirmwareCheckEnabled(false);
      } else if (selectedValue == 0) {
        downloadPreliminaryContainer();
      } 
    } else {
      downloadPreliminaryContainer();
    } 
  }
  
  private synchronized void onStandardEcuConnect() {
    this.fwUpdate.setAdditionalFirmwareCheckEnabled(false);
    this.fwUpdate.setInitialFwUpdateDialogShown(false);
    shutdownCheckupdateThread();
  }
  
  private synchronized void onEcuConnect(Constants.EcuType ecuType) {
    if (this.rightsManager.isUserInLevel(UserLevel.IBD) && this.fwUpdate.isAdditionalFirmwareCheckEnabled())
      switch (ecuType) {
        case BCS250:
        case BAS100:
        case VICTOR_PP2:
          onAdditionalEcuConnect();
          break;
        case CLASSIC_DU:
        case CLASSIC_PP:
        case VICTOR_DU:
        case VICTOR_PP1:
          onStandardEcuConnect();
          break;
      }  
  }
  
  public void onHardwareConnectionChanged(HardwareConnectionChangedEvent event) {
    LOGGER.debug("HardwareConnectionChangedEvent received: '{}'", event);
    switch (event.getAction()) {
      case SYSTEM_CONNECTED:
      case SYSTEM_RECONNECTED:
        this.fwUpdate.setAdditionalFirmwareCheckEnabled(true);
        onBikeConnect();
        break;
      case ECU_CONNECTED:
        EventQueue.invokeLater(() -> onEcuConnect(event.getComponent()));
        break;
      case SYSTEM_DISCONNECTED:
        this.fwUpdate.setAdditionalFirmwareCheckEnabled(false);
        this.fwUpdate.setInitialFwUpdateDialogShown(false);
        break;
      case ECU_DISCONNECTED:
        shutdownCheckupdateThread();
        break;
    } 
  }
  
  private boolean isGuiUpdateAllowed() {
    return !ApplicationProcessManager.getInstance().isFlashingActive();
  }
  
  public void onPreliminaryContainerDownloaded(PreliminaryContainerEvent event) {
    LOGGER.info("Preliminary response obtained.");
    if (isGuiUpdateAllowed()) {
      ApplicationProcessManager.getInstance().waitForApplicationProcessFinishedWithTimeout(ApplicationProcessManager.ApplicationProcess.READ_SERVICE_PARAMS);
      this.fwUpdate.checkForFirmwareUpdate(this.containerDownloader.getLastDownloadedContainer());
    } else {
      LOGGER.debug("GUI update is suppressed.");
    } 
  }
  
  public String getOrderingName() {
    return "PreliminaryContainerDownloader";
  }
}

package com.gigatronik.ebike.utils.functional.worker;

import javax.swing.SwingWorker;

public class FunctionalSwingWorker {
  private DoInBackground dib;
  
  private DoOnDone dod;
  
  public static FunctionalSwingWorker doInBackground(DoInBackground dib) {
    FunctionalSwingWorker functionalSwingWorker = new FunctionalSwingWorker();
    functionalSwingWorker.setBackgroundTask(dib);
    return functionalSwingWorker;
  }
  
  public void run() {
    buildSwingWorker().run();
  }
  
  public void execute() {
    buildSwingWorker().execute();
  }
  
  private SwingWorker buildSwingWorker() {
    return new SwingWorker() {
        protected Object doInBackground() throws Exception {
          return FunctionalSwingWorker.this.dib.doInBackground();
        }
        
        protected void done() {
          FunctionalSwingWorker.this.dod.onDone();
          super.done();
        }
      };
  }
  
  public FunctionalSwingWorker onDone(DoOnDone dod) {
    this.dod = dod;
    return this;
  }
  
  private void setBackgroundTask(DoInBackground dib) {
    this.dib = dib;
  }
}
