public class KeyBindingUtilImpl implements KeyBindingUtil {
  private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(KeyBindingUtilImpl.class);
  
  private static final Utf8ResourceBundleFormatted BUNDLE = ResourceBundleFactory.newDefaultResourceBundle();
  
  private static final int HOTKEY_LOCK_RELEASE_TIME = 500;
  
  private final Executor keyEventExecutor = Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor(new BasicThreadFactory.Builder().namingPattern("RightsChangedEventPublisher-%d").build());
  
  private final RightsManager rightsManager;
  
  private final GuiManager guiManager;
  
  private final ConfigurationManager configurationManager;
  
  private final EBikeApplication eBikeApplication;
  
  private final AtomicBoolean hotkeysLocked = new AtomicBoolean(false);
  
  protected Timer hotkeysLockTimer;
  
  private final BikeConfigurationPanelController bikeConfigPanelController;
  
  private final List<KeyEventListener> listeners = new ArrayList<>();
  
  public KeyBindingUtilImpl(BikeConfigurationPanelController bikeConfigPnlController, EBikeApplication ebikeApp, ConfigurationManager configManager, RightsManager rightsMan) {
    this.bikeConfigPanelController = bikeConfigPnlController;
    this.eBikeApplication = ebikeApp;
    this.configurationManager = configManager;
    this.rightsManager = rightsMan;
    this.guiManager = GuiManagerImpl.getInstance();
    this.hotkeysLockTimer = new Timer();
  }
  
  private class HotkeyLockRemover extends TimerTask {
    private final AtomicBoolean hotKeysLocked;
    
    public HotkeyLockRemover(AtomicBoolean hotKeysLocked) {
      this.hotKeysLocked = hotKeysLocked;
    }
    
    public void run() {
      KeyBindingUtilImpl.LOGGER.debug("Enable distribution of hotkey events again ...");
      this.hotKeysLocked.set(false);
    }
  }
  
  public void bindConfigKeyStrokesTo(JComponent component) {
    bindKeyManufactureDataOem(component);
    bindKeyDownload(component);
    bindKeyReadConfig(component);
    bindKeyConfigFlash(component);
    bindKeyToggleFlashAssistant(component);
  }
  
  private void bindKeyManufactureDataOem(JComponent component) {
    KeyEventBinder.bindComponent(component)
      .toStroke(MANUFACTURE_DATA_KEY_STROKE)
      .withName("oemManufactureDataEnable")
      .onStrokeExecute(this::manufactureDataOemAction)
      .onlyExecuteOnCondition(this.rightsManager.isUserInLevel(UserLevel.OEM))
      .bind();
  }
  
  private void manufactureDataOemAction(ActionEvent e) {
    LOGGER.info("Key combo for enabling manufacture data button pressed.");
    publishEvent(new EbikeKeyEvent(EbikeKeyEvent.KeyEventType.ACTIVATE_SAVE_MANUFACTURE_LOG));
  }
  
  public void bindKeySubModeOemTo(JComponent component) {
    KeyEventBinder.bindComponent(component)
      .toStroke(OEM_SUB_MODE_KEY_STROKE)
      .withName("oemSwitchSubMode")
      .onStrokeExecute(this::subModeOemAction)
      .onlyExecuteOnCondition(this.rightsManager.isUserInLevel(UserLevel.OEM))
      .bind();
  }
  
  private void subModeOemAction(ActionEvent e) {
    LOGGER.info("Key combo for switching the OEM submode pressed.");
    if (!this.configurationManager.getBikeIdentification().isBctConnected() && this.guiManager.isGuiInMode(GuiManager.GuiMode.EBIKE)) {
      RightsManager manager = this.rightsManager;
      if (manager.getMode().equals(Mode.OEM_WORKER)) {
        manager.setMode(Mode.OEM_ADMIN);
      } else if (manager.getMode().equals(Mode.OEM_ADMIN)) {
        manager.setMode(Mode.OEM_WORKER);
      } 
    } 
  }
  
  private void bindKeyConfigFlash(JComponent component) {
    KeyEventBinder.bindComponent(component)
      .toStroke(CONFIG_FLASH_KEY_STROKE)
      .withName("oemConfigFlashEnable")
      .onStrokeExecute(this::configFlashAction)
      .onlyExecuteOnCondition(this.rightsManager.isUserInLevel(UserLevel.OEM))
      .bind();
  }
  
  private void configFlashAction(ActionEvent e) {
    if (this.eBikeApplication.getApplicationPanel().getMainTabbedController().getEBikeMainTabbed().getTabbedPane().getSelectedIndex() == 0 && this.rightsManager.getMode().equals(Mode.OEM_ADMIN)) {
      LOGGER.info("Key combo for enabling configuration flashing without a container in OEM mode pressed.");
      if (this.configurationManager.isContainerLoaded()) {
        TestableJOptionPane.showMessageDialog(BUNDLE.getString("EBikeConfigurationTab.writeBikeConfigurationData.error.containerSelected.message"), BUNDLE.getString("EBikeConfigurationTab.writeBikeConfigurationData.error.containerSelected.title"), 2);
      } else {
        TestableJOptionPane.showMessageDialog(BUNDLE.getString("OemKeyBindingUtil.configFlashWithoutCff.optionPane.message"), BUNDLE.getString("OemKeyBindingUtil.configFlashWithoutCff.optionPane.title"), 1);
        publishEvent(new EbikeKeyEvent(EbikeKeyEvent.KeyEventType.ACTIVATE_FLASH_WITHOUT_CFF));
      } 
    } 
  }
  
  private void bindKeyDownload(JComponent component) {
    KeyEventBinder.bindComponent(component)
      .toStroke(DOWNLOAD_KEY_STROKE)
      .withName("oemDownload")
      .onStrokeExecute(this::downloadOemAction)
      .onlyExecuteOnCondition(this.rightsManager.isUserInLevel(UserLevel.OEM))
      .bind();
  }
  
  private void downloadOemAction(ActionEvent e) {
    if (this.rightsManager.isUserInLevel(UserLevel.OEM) && this.guiManager.isGuiInMode(GuiManager.GuiMode.EBIKE) && this.hotkeysLocked.compareAndSet(false, true)) {
      this.hotkeysLockTimer.schedule(new HotkeyLockRemover(this.hotkeysLocked), 500L);
      LOGGER.info("Key combo for download to bike accepted.");
      publishEvent(new EbikeKeyEvent(EbikeKeyEvent.KeyEventType.WRITE_CONFIG_TO_BIKE));
    } else {
      LOGGER.info("Key combo for download to bike rejected.");
    } 
  }
  
  private void bindKeyToggleFlashAssistant(JComponent component) {
    KeyEventBinder.bindComponent(component)
      .toStroke(TOGGLE_FLASH_ASSISTANT_KEY_STROKE)
      .withName("oemToggleFlashAssistant")
      .onStrokeExecute(this::toggleFlashAssistantAction)
      .onlyExecuteOnCondition(this.rightsManager.isUserInLevel(UserLevel.OEM))
      .bind();
  }
  
  private void toggleFlashAssistantAction(ActionEvent e) {
    if (this.rightsManager.isModeActive(Mode.OEM_WORKER) && this.guiManager.isGuiInMode(GuiManager.GuiMode.EBIKE) && this.hotkeysLocked.compareAndSet(false, true)) {
      this.hotkeysLockTimer.schedule(new HotkeyLockRemover(this.hotkeysLocked), 500L);
      LOGGER.info("Key for toggle the flash assistant accepted.");
      publishEvent(new EbikeKeyEvent(EbikeKeyEvent.KeyEventType.TOGGLE_FLASH_ASSISTANT));
    } else {
      LOGGER.info("Key for toggle the flash assistant rejected.");
    } 
  }
  
  private void bindKeyReadConfig(JComponent component) {
    KeyEventBinder.bindComponent(component)
      .toStroke(READ_CONFIG_KEY_STROKE)
      .withName("oemReadConfig")
      .onStrokeExecute(this::readConfigOemAction)
      .onlyExecuteOnCondition(this.rightsManager.isUserInLevel(UserLevel.OEM))
      .bind();
  }
  
  private void readConfigOemAction(ActionEvent e) {
    if (this.rightsManager.isUserInLevel(UserLevel.OEM) && this.guiManager.isGuiInMode(GuiManager.GuiMode.EBIKE) && this.hotkeysLocked.compareAndSet(false, true)) {
      this.hotkeysLockTimer.schedule(new HotkeyLockRemover(this.hotkeysLocked), 500L);
      LOGGER.info("Key combo for reading bike configuration from file accepted");
      publishEvent(new EbikeKeyEvent(EbikeKeyEvent.KeyEventType.READ_CONFIG_FROM_FILE));
    } else {
      LOGGER.info("Key combo for reading bike configuration from file rejected.");
    } 
  }
  
  public void bindKeysForForceFlashingTo(JComponent component) {
    KeyEventBinder.bindComponent(component)
      .toStroke(KEY_STROKE_COMBO)
      .withName("nonSimulatedFlashing")
      .onStrokeExecute(this::forceFlashing)
      .bind();
  }
  
  private void forceFlashing(ActionEvent e) {
    if (this.eBikeApplication.getApplicationPanel().getMainTabbedController().isBikeConfigurationTabActive()) {
      LOGGER.info("Secret non-simulated flashing key combo pressed: eBike will be flashed instead of simulating.");
      int option = TestableJOptionPane.showConfirmDialog(BUNDLE.getString("NonSimulatedFlashingUtil.overwriteFlash.optionPane.message"), 
          BUNDLE.getString("NonSimulatedFlashingUtil.overwriteFlash.optionPane.title"), 2, 2);
      if (option == 0)
        this.bikeConfigPanelController.forceFlashing(); 
    } 
  }
  
  public synchronized void addKeyEventListener(KeyEventListener listener) {
    if (!this.listeners.contains(listener))
      this.listeners.add(listener); 
  }
  
  public synchronized void removeKeyEventListener(KeyEventListener listener) {
    this.listeners.remove(listener);
  }
  
  private synchronized void publishEvent(EbikeKeyEvent event) {
    this.listeners.forEach(listener -> this.keyEventExecutor.execute(() -> listener.onKeyEvent(event)));
  }
}

ITEM 348: com/gigatronik/ebike/utils/keybinding/KeyEventBinder.java

package com.gigatronik.ebike.utils.keybinding;

import com.gigatronik.ebike.utils.functional.action.ActionFunction;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.utils.functional.action.FunctionalAbstractAction;
import javax.swing.JComponent;
import javax.swing.KeyStroke;
import org.slf4j.Logger;
import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;

public class KeyEventBinder {
  private static Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(KeyEventBinder.class);
  
  private final JComponent component;
  
  private KeyStroke stroke;
  
  private String strokeName;
  
  private ActionFunction action;
  
  private boolean condition;
  
  private KeyEventBinder(JComponent component) {
    this.condition = true;
    this.component = component;
  }
  
  static KeyEventBinder bindComponent(JComponent component) {
    return new KeyEventBinder(component);
  }
  
  KeyEventBinder toStroke(KeyStroke stroke) {
    this.stroke = stroke;
    return this;
  }
  
  KeyEventBinder withName(String name) {
    this.strokeName = name;
    return this;
  }
  
  KeyEventBinder onStrokeExecute(ActionFunction action) {
    this.action = action;
    return this;
  }
  
  KeyEventBinder onlyExecuteOnCondition(boolean condition) {
    this.condition = condition;
    return this;
  }
  
  void bind() {
    if (!this.condition) {
      LOGGER.warn("Condition to bind stroke: {} to  component:{} not met", this.stroke, this.component);
    } else if (this.component != null && this.stroke != null && this.action != null) {
      this.component.getInputMap(2).put(this.stroke, this.strokeName);
      this.component.getActionMap().put(this.strokeName, FunctionalAbstractAction.perform(this.action));
      LOGGER.debug("Bound stroke{} to component{}", this.stroke, this.component.getName());
    } else {
      LOGGER.error("Could not bind action to component{} for stroke {}", this.component, this.stroke);
    } 
  }
}

ITEM 350: com/gigatronik/ebike/utils/NyonFlashValidationUtil.java

package com.gigatronik.ebike.utils;

import com.gigatronik.beds.gui.panels.mapstab.parser.MapData;
import com.gigatronik.beds.gui.panels.mapstab.parser.MapXmlFileParser;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.communication.api.CommunicationManager;
import com.gigatronik.beds.service.configuration.ConfigurationManager;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.framework.plugins.exceptions.ConfigurationNotFoundException;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.framework.util.Version;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.common.configuration.BikeIdentification;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.common.configuration.ComplexResponse;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.common.configuration.ComponentType;
import java.util.List;
import org.apache.commons.lang3.StringUtils;
import org.slf4j.Logger;
import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;

public class NyonFlashValidationUtil {
  private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(NyonFlashValidationUtil.class);
  
  public static final int BUI270_FLASH_CHARGE_LEVEL = 85;
  
  public static final int BUI350_FLASH_CHARGE_LEVEL = 50;
  
  private final BikeIdentification bikeIdentification;
  
  private final CommunicationManager communicationManager;
  
  private final MapXmlFileParser mapXmlFileParser;
  
  public enum MapVersionCompare {
    EQUAL, NYON_MAPS_OUTDATED, LOCAL_MAPS_OUTDATED, FAILED;
  }
  
  public NyonFlashValidationUtil(ConfigurationManager confManger, CommunicationManager commManager) {
    this.bikeIdentification = confManger.getBikeIdentification();
    this.communicationManager = commManager;
    this.mapXmlFileParser = new MapXmlFileParser();
  }
  
  public boolean checkNyonChargeLevel() {
    boolean levelAboveMin;
    if (this.bikeIdentification.getHmiIdentification().isApplication() && this.bikeIdentification.getHmiIdentification().getComponentType().isNyon()) {
      try {
        levelAboveMin = checkNyonChargeLevelTry();
      } catch (ComplexResponse.DataAccessException|NumberFormatException e) {
        LOGGER.error("Parsing nyon battery charge value failed.", (Throwable)e);
        levelAboveMin = false;
      } 
    } else {
      levelAboveMin = true;
    } 
    return levelAboveMin;
  }
  
  private boolean checkNyonChargeLevelTry() throws ComplexResponse.DataAccessException {
    ComplexResponse batteryChargeValHmi = readBatteryChargeValue();
    int nyonChargeValue = Integer.parseInt(batteryChargeValHmi.getString());
    int minChargeValue = this.bikeIdentification.getHmiIdentification().getComponentType().isBUI27x() ? 85 : 50;
    LOGGER.debug("Nyon charge value is '{}', should be at least '{}'", Integer.valueOf(nyonChargeValue), Integer.valueOf(minChargeValue));
    return (nyonChargeValue >= minChargeValue);
  }
  
  private ComplexResponse readBatteryChargeValue() {
    ComplexResponse response = this.communicationManager.getHmiCom().readBatteryChargeValue();
    if (!response.isPositive()) {
      this.communicationManager.getHmiCom().startExtendedSession();
      response = this.communicationManager.getHmiCom().readBatteryChargeValue();
    } 
    return response;
  }
  
  public MapVersionCompare checkNyonMapVersionToLocal() {
    ComplexResponse nyonMapVersion = customizedMapVersion(this.bikeIdentification.getHmiIdentification().getMapVersionRequiredResponse());
    String localMapVersion = getLocalMapsVersion();
    if (nyonMapVersion.isPositive() && StringUtils.isNotBlank(localMapVersion))
      return determineMapVersionCompareResult(nyonMapVersion.toString(), localMapVersion); 
    LOGGER.warn("mapVersionNyon was null can't compare map versions");
    return MapVersionCompare.FAILED;
  }
  
  private MapVersionCompare determineMapVersionCompareResult(String nyonMapVersion, String localMapVersion) {
    int result = nyonMapVersion.compareTo(localMapVersion);
    if (result >= 1)
      return MapVersionCompare.LOCAL_MAPS_OUTDATED; 
    if (result <= -1)
      return MapVersionCompare.NYON_MAPS_OUTDATED; 
    return MapVersionCompare.EQUAL;
  }
  
  private String getLocalMapsVersion() {
    String localMapsVersion = null;
    try {
      List<MapData> list = (this.bikeIdentification.getHmiIdentification().getComponentType() == ComponentType.COMP_BUI350) ? this.mapXmlFileParser.parseBUI350MapSelectionXmlFromRepository() : this.mapXmlFileParser.parseBUI27xMapSelectionXmlFromRepository();
      if (list.size() > 0)
        localMapsVersion = list.get(0).getMapVersion(); 
    } catch (ConfigurationNotFoundException|com.gigatronik.beds.gui.panels.mapstab.exception.XmlFileParsingException ex) {
      LOGGER.warn("Local maps version could not be obtained", (Throwable)ex);
    } 
    return localMapsVersion;
  }
  
  public static ComplexResponse customizedMapVersion(ComplexResponse value) {
    try {
      if (value.isPositive() && value.getVersion().getElementCount() == 4) {
        Version version = value.getVersion();
        if (version.getElementCount() == 4) {
          StringBuilder customMapVersion = new StringBuilder();
          int major = version.getMAJOR();
          int minor = version.getMINOR();
          int bugfix = version.getBUILD();
          int internal = version.getINTERNAL();
          customMapVersion.append(major * 256 + minor);
          int length = String.valueOf(bugfix).length();
          if (length == 1)
            customMapVersion.append("0"); 
          customMapVersion.append(bugfix);
          length = String.valueOf(internal).length();
          if (length == 1)
            customMapVersion.append("0"); 
          customMapVersion.append(internal);
          return new ComplexResponse(customMapVersion.toString());
        } 
      } 
    } catch (ComplexResponse.DataAccessException ex) {
      LOGGER.error("Error reading and parsing map version", (Throwable)ex);
    } 
    return value;
  }
}

package com.gigatronik.ebike.utils;

import java.util.ArrayList;

public class ServiceHistoryData {
  private ArrayList<ServiceHistoryEntry> serviceHistoryEntries;
  
  private int index;
  
  public class ServiceHistoryEntry {
    private String date;
    
    private int odometer;
    
    protected ServiceHistoryEntry(String serviceDate, int serviceOdometer) {
      this.date = serviceDate;
      this.odometer = serviceOdometer;
    }
    
    public String getDate() {
      return this.date;
    }
    
    protected void setDate(String value) {
      this.date = value;
    }
    
    public int getOdometer() {
      return this.odometer;
    }
    
    protected void setOdometer(int value) {
      this.odometer = value;
    }
  }
  
  public ServiceHistoryData() {
    this.serviceHistoryEntries = new ArrayList<>();
    this.index = 0;
  }
  
  public void clear() {
    this.serviceHistoryEntries.clear();
  }
  
  public void add(String serviceDate, int serviceOdometer) {
    this.index = 0;
    this.serviceHistoryEntries.add(new ServiceHistoryEntry(serviceDate, serviceOdometer));
  }
  
  public ServiceHistoryEntry first() {
    this.index = 0;
    if (this.serviceHistoryEntries.size() > this.index)
      return this.serviceHistoryEntries.get(this.index++); 
    return null;
  }
  
  public ServiceHistoryEntry next() {
    if (this.serviceHistoryEntries.size() > this.index)
      return this.serviceHistoryEntries.get(this.index++); 
    return null;
  }
}

  private boolean isBctMeasurementInProgress(int initNumberOfCalls) {
    boolean progressStatus = false;
    if (this.bctMeasuringState.get()) {
      LOGGER.info("BCT Measuring is running.");
      progressStatus = true;
    } 
    if (2 > initNumberOfCalls) {
      boolean temp = progressStatus;
      initNumberOfCalls++;
      if (!temp)
        try {
          Thread.sleep(1500L);
          temp = isBctMeasurementInProgress(initNumberOfCalls);
        } catch (InterruptedException ex) {
          LOGGER.error("Thread.sleep: ", (Throwable)ex);
          Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
        }  
      if (!progressStatus)
        progressStatus = temp; 
    } 
    return progressStatus;
  }
  
  public void onBctOperationStateChanged(BctOperationStateChangeEvent event) {
    LOGGER.debug("Received BctOperationStateChangeEvent: '{}'", event);
    BctState state = event.getOperatingState();
    switch (state) {
      case NOT_CONNECTED:
      case CONNECTED_FBL:
      case IDLE:
      case IDLE_BATTERY_SET:
        this.bctMeasuringState.set(false);
        break;
      case TEST_RUNNING:
      case TEST_FINISHED:
      case TEST_ERROR:
      case DISCHARGE_RUNNING:
      case DISCHARGE_FINISHED:
      case DISCHARGE_ERROR:
        this.bctMeasuringState.set(true);
        break;
      default:
        this.bctMeasuringState.set(false);
        break;
    } 
  }
  
  private boolean isUpdateCheckAllowed(boolean isBctConnected) {
    if (isBctConnected && isBctMeasurementInProgress(0))
      return false; 
    return (!ApplicationProcessManager.getInstance().isFlashingActive() && 
      !ApplicationProcessManager.getInstance().isDownloadActive() && 
      !this.ebikeApplication.isRemoteSessionActive() && 
      !this.sampleValidator.isAnySampleHwConnected(this.bikeIdentification));
  }
  
  private void createNewFwUpdateDialog() {

  }
  
  public void checkForFirmwareUpdate(BoschContainerGen2 cff2) {
    extractPreliminaryContainerContent(cff2);
    SwingUtilities.invokeLater(() -> {
          LOGGER.info("Check for firmware update");
          boolean bctConnected = this.bikeIdentification.isBctConnected();
          if (!isCheckForAutoFirmwareUpdateDeactivated() && isUpdateCheckAllowed(bctConnected)) {
            createNewFwUpdateDialog();
            if (this.fwUpdateDialog.isNewDataAvailable()) {
              showFwUpdateDialog();
            } else {
              LOGGER.info("No new firmware available");
            } 
          } 
        });
  }
  
  private void showFwUpdateDialog() {

    setInitialFwUpdateDialogShown(true);
    if (this.fwUpdateDialog.showDialog() == 0) {
      LOGGER.info("Update confirmed by user --> Download flash container");
      if (this.bikeIdentification.isBctConnected()) {
        this.ebikeApplication.getApplicationPanel().getMainTabbedController().getBctConfigTab().getFlashButton().doClick();
      } else if (this.bikeIdentification.isBcsConnected()) {
        this.ebikeApplication.getApplicationPanel().getMainTabbedController().getBcsConfigTab().getFlashButton().doClick();
      } else {
        this.ebikeApplication.getApplicationPanel().getMainTabbedController().getBikeConfigTabController().downloadNewFlashware();
      } 
    } else {
      LOGGER.info("Update cancelled by user");
    } 
  }
  
  private void extractPreliminaryContainerContent(BoschContainerGen2 cff2) {

      LOGGER.trace("Content of preliminary container: {}", logString);
    } 
  }
  
  private boolean isCheckForAutoFirmwareUpdateDeactivated() {

  }
  
  private void populateVersionInfo(BoschContainerGen2 cff2) throws ConfigurationNotFoundException {
    if (this.bikeIdentification.getBcsIdentification().isConnected()) {
      try {
        Version swVersion = Version.parse(this.bikeIdentification.getBcsIdentification().getSwVersion());
        ComponentType bcsCompType = this.bikeIdentification.getBcsIdentification().getComponentType();
        if (bcsCompType == ComponentType.NONE || bcsCompType == ComponentType.COMP_UNSPECIFIED)
          bcsCompType = ComponentType.COMP_BCS250; 
        Version cff2SwVersion = Version.parse(cff2.getSwVersionCff2(bcsCompType));
        if (checkSwVersion(swVersion, cff2SwVersion))
          this.firmwareInfo.put("Bcs_Sw_Version", cff2SwVersion.toString()); 
      } catch (IOException|NumberFormatException e) {
        LOGGER.error("Could not parse and compare BCS sw versions", (Throwable)e);
      } 
      return;
    } 
    switch (this.bikeIdentification.getHmiIdentification().getComponentType()) {
      case COMP_BUI210:
      case COMP_BUI215:
      case COMP_BUI250:
      case COMP_BUI251:
      case COMP_BUI255:
      case COMP_BUI330:
      case COMP_BUI350:
      case COMP_CUI100:
        try {
          Version swVersion = Version.parse(this.bikeIdentification.getHmiIdentification().getSwVersion());
          Version cff2SwVersion = Version.parse(cff2.getSwVersionCff2(this.bikeIdentification.getHmiIdentification().getComponentType()));
          if (checkSwVersion(swVersion, cff2SwVersion))
            this.firmwareInfo.put("Hmi_Sw_Version", cff2SwVersion.toString()); 
        } catch (IOException|NumberFormatException e) {
          LOGGER.error("Could not parse and compare HMI sw versions", (Throwable)e);
        } 
        break;
      case COMP_BUI270:
        populateVersionInfoForBui270(cff2, BoschConstants.SwType.SW_TYPE_CFF2_APP_BACKEND, this.bikeIdentification.getHmiIdentification().getSwVersion(), this.firmwareInfo);
        populateVersionInfoForBui270(cff2, BoschConstants.SwType.SW_TYPE_CFF2_APP_FRONTEND, this.bikeIdentification.getHmiIdentification().getFrontendSwVersion(), this.firmwareInfo);
        break;
      case COMP_BUI275:
        populateVersionInfoForBui275(cff2, BoschConstants.SwType.SW_TYPE_CFF2_APP_BACKEND, this.bikeIdentification.getHmiIdentification().getSwVersion(), this.firmwareInfo);
        populateVersionInfoForBui275(cff2, BoschConstants.SwType.SW_TYPE_CFF2_APP_FRONTEND, this.bikeIdentification.getHmiIdentification().getFrontendSwVersion(), this.firmwareInfo);
        break;
    } 
    if (this.bikeIdentification.getDuIdentification().getComponentType().isBDU1xx()) {
      try {
        Version swVersion = Version.parse(this.bikeIdentification.getBms1Identification().getSwVersion());
        Version cff2SwVersion = Version.parse(cff2.getSwVersionCff2(this.bikeIdentification.getBms1Identification().getComponentType()));
        if (checkSwVersion(swVersion, cff2SwVersion))
          this.firmwareInfo.put("Bms_Sw_Version", cff2SwVersion.toString()); 
      } catch (IOException|NumberFormatException e) {
        LOGGER.error("Could not parse and compare BMS sw versions", (Throwable)e);
      } 
      try {
        Version swVersion = Version.parse(this.bikeIdentification.getDuIdentification().getSwVersion());
        Version cff2SwVersion = Version.parse(cff2.getSwVersionCff2(this.bikeIdentification.getDuIdentification().getComponentType()));
        if (checkSwVersion(swVersion, cff2SwVersion))
          this.firmwareInfo.put("Du_Sw_Version", cff2SwVersion.toString()); 
      } catch (IOException|NumberFormatException e) {
        LOGGER.error("Could not parse and compare DU sw versions", (Throwable)e);
      } 
    } else if (this.bikeIdentification.getDuIdentification().getComponentType().isBDUVictor()) {
      try {
        Version swVersion = Version.parse(this.bikeIdentification.getBms1Identification().getSwVersion());
        Version cff2SwVersion = Version.parse(cff2.getSwVersionCff2(this.bikeIdentification.getBms1Identification().getComponentType()));
        if (checkSwVersion(swVersion, cff2SwVersion))
          this.firmwareInfo.put("Bbp1_Sw_Version", cff2SwVersion.toString()); 
      } catch (IOException|NumberFormatException e) {
        LOGGER.error("Could not parse and compare BBP1 sw versions", (Throwable)e);
      } 
      try {
        Version swVersion = Version.parse(this.bikeIdentification.getBms2Identification().getSwVersion());
        Version cff2SwVersion = Version.parse(cff2.getSwVersionCff2(this.bikeIdentification.getBms2Identification().getComponentType()));
        if (checkSwVersion(swVersion, cff2SwVersion))
          this.firmwareInfo.put("Bbp2_Sw_Version", cff2SwVersion.toString()); 
      } catch (IOException|NumberFormatException e) {
        LOGGER.error("Could not parse and compare BBP2 sw versions", (Throwable)e);
      } 
      try {
        Version swVersion = Version.parse(this.bikeIdentification.getDuIdentification().getSwVersion());
        Version cff2SwVersion = Version.parse(cff2.getSwVersionCff2(this.bikeIdentification.getDuIdentification().getComponentType()));
        if (checkSwVersion(swVersion, cff2SwVersion))
          this.firmwareInfo.put("Bdu_Sw_Version", cff2SwVersion.toString()); 
      } catch (IOException|NumberFormatException e) {
        LOGGER.error("Could not parse and compare BDU sw versions", (Throwable)e);
      } 
      try {
        Version swVersion = Version.parse(this.bikeIdentification.getAbsIdentification().getSwVersion());
        Version cff2SwVersion = Version.parse(cff2.getSwVersionCff2(this.bikeIdentification.getAbsIdentification().getComponentType()));
        if (checkSwVersion(swVersion, cff2SwVersion))
          this.firmwareInfo.put("Abs_Sw_Version", cff2SwVersion.toString()); 
      } catch (IOException|NumberFormatException e) {
        LOGGER.error("Could not parse and compare ABS sw versions", (Throwable)e);
      } 
    } 
    if (this.bikeIdentification.getBctIdentification().getComponentType() == ComponentType.COMP_BCT100)
      try {
        Version swVersion = Version.parse(this.bikeIdentification.getBctIdentification().getSwVersion());
        Version cff2SwVersion = Version.parse(cff2.getSwVersionCff2(this.bikeIdentification.getBctIdentification().getComponentType()));
        if (checkSwVersion(swVersion, cff2SwVersion))
          this.firmwareInfo.put("Bct_Sw_Version", cff2SwVersion.toString()); 
      } catch (IOException|NumberFormatException e) {
        LOGGER.error("Could not parse and compare BCT sw versions", (Throwable)e);
      }  
  }
  
  private void populateVersionInfoForBui270(BoschContainerGen2 cff2, BoschConstants.SwType swType, String softwareVersion, Map<String, String> data) throws ConfigurationNotFoundException {
    try {
      Version swVersion = Version.parse(softwareVersion);
      Version cff2SwVersion = Version.parse(cff2.getSwVersionCff2(swType, this.bikeIdentification.getHmiIdentification().getComponentType()));
      if (checkSwVersion(swVersion, cff2SwVersion))
        data.put(swType.getContainerSymbol(), cff2SwVersion.toString()); 
    } catch (IOException|NumberFormatException e) {
      LOGGER.error("Could not parse and compare BUI270 sw versions", (Throwable)e);
    } 
  }
  
  private void populateVersionInfoForBui275(BoschContainerGen2 cff2, BoschConstants.SwType swType, String softwareVersion, Map<String, String> data) throws ConfigurationNotFoundException {
    try {
      Version swVersion = Version.parse(softwareVersion);
      Version cff2SwVersion = Version.parse(cff2.getSwVersionCff2(swType, this.bikeIdentification.getHmiIdentification().getComponentType()));
      if (checkSwVersion(swVersion, cff2SwVersion))
        data.put(swType.getContainerSymbol(), cff2SwVersion.toString()); 
    } catch (IOException|NumberFormatException e) {
      LOGGER.error("Could not parse and compare BUI275 sw versions", (Throwable)e);
    } 
  }
  
  private void populateReleaseNotes(BoschContainerGen2 cff2) {
    if (this.bikeIdentification.getBcsIdentification().isConnected()) {
      String str1;
      ComponentType bcsCompType = this.bikeIdentification.getBcsIdentification().getComponentType();
      if (bcsCompType == ComponentType.NONE || bcsCompType == ComponentType.COMP_UNSPECIFIED) {
        str1 = ComponentType.COMP_BCS250.toString();
      } else {
        str1 = this.bikeIdentification.getBcsIdentification().getComponentType().toString();
      } 
      String swVersion = this.bikeIdentification.getBcsIdentification().getSwVersion();
      String swVariant = this.bikeIdentification.getBcsIdentification().getSwVariant();
      List<String> cff2ReleaseNotes = cff2.getReleaseNotesCff2(str1, BoschConstants.SwType.SW_TYPE_CFF2_APP, swVersion, swVariant);
      getReleaseNoteContent("Bcs_Sw_RelNotes", cff2ReleaseNotes, this.firmwareInfo);
      return;
    } 
    ComponentType hmi = this.bikeIdentification.getHmiIdentification().getComponentType();
    String compType = hmi.toString();
    if (hmi.isBUI27x()) {
      String swVersion = this.bikeIdentification.getHmiIdentification().getSwVersion();
      List<String> cff2ReleaseNotes = cff2.getReleaseNotesCff2(compType, BoschConstants.SwType.SW_TYPE_CFF2_APP_BACKEND, swVersion, "STANDARD");
      getReleaseNoteContent("backend-RelNotes", cff2ReleaseNotes, this.firmwareInfo);
      swVersion = this.bikeIdentification.getHmiIdentification().getFrontendSwVersion();
      cff2ReleaseNotes = cff2.getReleaseNotesCff2(compType, BoschConstants.SwType.SW_TYPE_CFF2_APP_FRONTEND, swVersion, "STANDARD");
      getReleaseNoteContent("frontend-RelNotes", cff2ReleaseNotes, this.firmwareInfo);
    } else if (hmi.isCUI1xx() || hmi.isBUI21x() || hmi.isBUI25x() || hmi.isBUI33x() || hmi.isBUI35x()) {
      String swVersion = this.bikeIdentification.getHmiIdentification().getSwVersion();
      String swVariant = this.bikeIdentification.getHmiIdentification().getSwVariant();
      List<String> cff2ReleaseNotes = cff2.getReleaseNotesCff2(compType, BoschConstants.SwType.SW_TYPE_CFF2_APP, swVersion, swVariant);
      getReleaseNoteContent("Hmi_Sw-RelNotes", cff2ReleaseNotes, this.firmwareInfo);
    } else if (this.bikeIdentification.getBctIdentification().getComponentType() == ComponentType.COMP_BCT100) {
      compType = this.bikeIdentification.getBctIdentification().getComponentType().toString();
      String swVersion = this.bikeIdentification.getBctIdentification().getSwVersion();
      String swVariant = "BCT_SW_VARIANT_STANDARD";
      List<String> cff2ReleaseNotes = cff2.getReleaseNotesCff2(compType, BoschConstants.SwType.SW_TYPE_CFF2_APP, swVersion, swVariant);
      getReleaseNoteContent("Hmi_Sw-RelNotes", cff2ReleaseNotes, this.firmwareInfo);
    } 
    if (StringUtils.isNotBlank(this.bikeIdentification.getBikeType()) && this.bikeIdentification.getBikeType().contains("CLASSIC")) {
      compType = this.bikeIdentification.getDuIdentification().getComponentType().toString();
      String swVersion = this.bikeIdentification.getDuIdentification().getSwVersion();
      String swVariant = this.bikeIdentification.getDuIdentification().getSwVariant();
      List<String> cff2ReleaseNotes = cff2.getReleaseNotesCff2(compType, BoschConstants.SwType.SW_TYPE_CFF2_APP, swVersion, swVariant);
      getReleaseNoteContent("Du_Sw-RelNotes", cff2ReleaseNotes, this.firmwareInfo);
      compType = this.bikeIdentification.getBms1Identification().getComponentType().toString();
      swVersion = this.bikeIdentification.getBms1Identification().getSwVersion();
      swVariant = this.bikeIdentification.getBms1Identification().getSwVariant();
      cff2ReleaseNotes = cff2.getReleaseNotesCff2(compType, BoschConstants.SwType.SW_TYPE_CFF2_APP, swVersion, swVariant);
      getReleaseNoteContent("Bms_Sw-RelNotes", cff2ReleaseNotes, this.firmwareInfo);
    } else {
      compType = this.bikeIdentification.getDuIdentification().getComponentType().toString();
      String swVersion = this.bikeIdentification.getDuIdentification().getSwVersion();
      String swVariant = this.bikeIdentification.getDuIdentification().getSwVariant();
      List<String> cff2ReleaseNotes = cff2.getReleaseNotesCff2(compType, BoschConstants.SwType.SW_TYPE_CFF2_APP, swVersion, swVariant);
      getReleaseNoteContent("Bdu_Sw-RelNotes", cff2ReleaseNotes, this.firmwareInfo);
      compType = this.bikeIdentification.getBms1Identification().getComponentType().toString();
      swVersion = this.bikeIdentification.getBms1Identification().getSwVersion();
      swVariant = this.bikeIdentification.getBms1Identification().getSwVariant();
      cff2ReleaseNotes = cff2.getReleaseNotesCff2(compType, BoschConstants.SwType.SW_TYPE_CFF2_APP, swVersion, swVariant);
      getReleaseNoteContent("Bbp1_Sw-RelNotes", cff2ReleaseNotes, this.firmwareInfo);
      compType = this.bikeIdentification.getBms2Identification().getComponentType().toString();
      swVersion = this.bikeIdentification.getBms2Identification().getSwVersion();
      swVariant = this.bikeIdentification.getBms2Identification().getSwVariant();
      cff2ReleaseNotes = cff2.getReleaseNotesCff2(compType, BoschConstants.SwType.SW_TYPE_CFF2_APP, swVersion, swVariant);
      getReleaseNoteContent("Bbp2_Sw-RelNotes", cff2ReleaseNotes, this.firmwareInfo);
      compType = this.bikeIdentification.getAbsIdentification().getComponentType().toString();
      swVersion = this.bikeIdentification.getAbsIdentification().getSwVersion();
      cff2ReleaseNotes = cff2.getReleaseNotesCff2(compType, BoschConstants.SwType.SW_TYPE_CFF2_APP, swVersion, "BAS_SW_VARIANT_STANDARD");
      getReleaseNoteContent("Abs_Sw_RelNotes", cff2ReleaseNotes, this.firmwareInfo);
    } 
  }
  
  private boolean checkSwVersion(Version swVersionDevice, Version cff2SwVersion) {
    return (swVersionDevice != null && cff2SwVersion != null && swVersionDevice.compareTo(cff2SwVersion) < 0);
  }
  
  private void getReleaseNoteContent(String type, List<String> notes, Map<String, String> data) {
    if (notes != null) {
      StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
      Objects.requireNonNull(sb);
      notes.forEach(sb::append);
      String content = sb.toString();
      if (StringUtils.isNotBlank(content))
        data.put(type, content); 
    } 
  }
}

package com.gigatronik.ebike.utils.updater;

import com.gigatronik.dart2.bosch.service.internationalization.ResourceBundleFactory;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.bosch.service.internationalization.Utf8ResourceBundleFormatted;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.bosch.updateserver.UPDATE_SERVER_URL;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.bosch.updateserver.UpdateServerConnection;
import com.gigatronik.dart2.framework.util.Version;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.gui.EBikeApplication;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.gui.EBikeSoftwareUpdateProgressDialog;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.gui.testinterface.TestableJOptionPane;
import com.gigatronik.ebike.utils.window.uac.Elevator;
import java.io.File;
import java.io.FileInputStream;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.nio.MappedByteBuffer;
import java.nio.channels.FileChannel;
import java.nio.charset.Charset;
import org.slf4j.Logger;
import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;

public class SoftwareUpdate {
  private static final Utf8ResourceBundleFormatted BUNDLE = ResourceBundleFactory.newDefaultResourceBundle();
  
  private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(SoftwareUpdate.class);
  
  private static final String VERSION_FILE_NAME = "version.txt";
  
  private static final String EXE_FILE_NAME = "Setup.exe";
  
  private final EBikeApplication ebikeApplication;
  
  private final UpdateServerConnection updateServerConnection;
  
  private Version availableVersionOnServer;
  
  public SoftwareUpdate(EBikeApplication eBikeApp, UpdateServerConnection connection) {
    this.ebikeApplication = eBikeApp;
    this.updateServerConnection = connection;
  }
  
  public void checkForSoftwareUpdate(String appVersion) {
    LOGGER.info("Checking for app software update for version: {}", appVersion);
    boolean available = !this.updateServerConnection.isServerAvailable() ? false : isSoftwareUpdateAvailable(appVersion);
    if (available) {
      LOGGER.debug("Show software update confirmation dialog");
      String message = BUNDLE.getString("EBikeApplication.updateCheck.optionPane.message").replace("[0]", this.availableVersionOnServer.toString());
      int answer = TestableJOptionPane.showConfirmDialog(message, BUNDLE.getString("EBikeApplication.updateCheck.optionPane.title"), 0, 3);
      if (answer == 0) {
        LOGGER.info("User chose updating software...");
        if (downloadAndRunUpdateSetup() == -2)
          TestableJOptionPane.showMessageDialog(BUNDLE.getString("EBikeApplication.setupRunError.optionPane.message"), BUNDLE.getString("EBikeApplication.setupRunError.optionPane.title"), 0); 
      } else {
        LOGGER.info("User canceled software update");
      } 
    } 
  }
  
  private int downloadAndRunUpdateSetup() {
    LOGGER.info("Downloading setup");
    EBikeSoftwareUpdateProgressDialog progressDialog = new EBikeSoftwareUpdateProgressDialog(TestableJOptionPane.getDefaultParentFrame(), "EBikeSoftwareUpdateProgressBar.title", "EBikeSoftwareUpdateProgressBar.DOWNLOADING");
    try {
      String url = UPDATE_SERVER_URL.get(UPDATE_SERVER_URL.PC_TOOL_UPDATE).toString() + "Setup.exe";
      LOGGER.info("Using software URL: {}", url);
      if (!this.updateServerConnection.isServerAvailable()) {
        progressDialog.setErrorState();
        LOGGER.info("No internet available");
        return -1;
      } 
      progressDialog.showDialog();
      String setupPath = this.updateServerConnection.downloadFileSync(url, progressDialog);
      if (setupPath.isEmpty()) {
        progressDialog.setErrorState();
        LOGGER.error("Error during download. No file downloaded.");
        return -1;
      } 
      progressDialog.setSuccessState("EBikeSoftwareUpdateProgressBar.DONE");
      Thread.sleep(1000L);
      return install(setupPath, progressDialog);
    } catch (InterruptedException e) {
      LOGGER.error("Interrupted exception!!!", (Throwable)e);
      progressDialog.setErrorState();
      Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
      return -1;
    } 
  }
  
  private void runSetup(String setupPath) throws IOException {
    File file = new File(setupPath);
    if (file.exists() && file.isFile()) {
      LOGGER.info("Execute setup " + file.getAbsolutePath() + " using elevated rights");
      Elevator.executeAsAdministrator(file.getAbsolutePath(), "");
      this.ebikeApplication.quit(2, false);
    } else {
      throw new IOException("File cannot be opened or executed: " + setupPath);
    } 
  }
  
  public boolean isSoftwareUpdateAvailable(String appVersion) {
    String appVersionFile;
    String path = this.updateServerConnection.downloadFileSync(UPDATE_SERVER_URL.get(UPDATE_SERVER_URL.PC_TOOL_UPDATE).toString() + "version.txt");
    try {
      appVersionFile = readFile(path);
    } catch (IOException e) {
      LOGGER.error("Failed to read version in {}", "version.txt", e);
      return false;
    } 
    if (appVersionFile.isEmpty()) {
      LOGGER.error("Version could not be read. Most probably download failed.");
      return false;
    } 
    try {
      Version applicationVersion = Version.parse(appVersion);
      this.availableVersionOnServer = Version.parse(appVersionFile);
      if (applicationVersion != null && applicationVersion.compareTo(this.availableVersionOnServer) >= 0) {
        LOGGER.info("No software update available.");
        return false;
      } 
    } catch (IOException|NumberFormatException e) {
      LOGGER.error("Could not parse and compare application and server versions.", (Throwable)e);
      return false;
    } 
    LOGGER.info("Software update {} available", appVersionFile);
    return true;
  }
  
  private String readFile(String filePath) throws IOException {
    FileInputStream stream = new FileInputStream(new File(filePath));
    try {
      FileChannel fc = stream.getChannel();
      MappedByteBuffer bb = fc.map(FileChannel.MapMode.READ_ONLY, 0L, fc.size());
      return Charset.defaultCharset().decode(bb).toString();
    } finally {
      stream.close();
    } 
  }
  
  private int install(String setupPath, EBikeSoftwareUpdateProgressDialog progressDialog) {
    try {
      runSetup(setupPath);
    } catch (IOException e) {
      LOGGER.error("Error trying to execute setup", (Throwable)e);
      progressDialog.disposeDialog();
      return -2;
    } 
    return 0;
  }
}

ITEM 354: com/gigatronik/ebike/utils/window/uac/Elevator.java

package com.gigatronik.ebike.utils.window.uac;

import com.sun.jna.WString;
import com.sun.jna.platform.win32.Kernel32;
import com.sun.jna.platform.win32.Kernel32Util;
import java.io.IOException;

public class Elevator {
  public static void main(String... args) throws IOException {
    executeAsAdministrator("c:\\windows\\system32\\cmd.exe", "");
  }
  
  public static void executeAsAdministrator(String command, String args) throws IOException {
    Shell32X.ShellExecuteInfo execInfo = new Shell32X.ShellExecuteInfo();
    execInfo.lpFile = new WString(command);
    if (args != null)
      execInfo.lpParameters = new WString(args); 
    execInfo.nShow = 10;
    execInfo.fMask = 64;
    execInfo.lpVerb = new WString("runas");
    boolean result = Shell32X.INSTANCE.ShellExecuteEx(execInfo);
    if (!result) {
      int lastError = Kernel32.INSTANCE.GetLastError();
      String errorMessage = Kernel32Util.formatMessageFromLastErrorCode(lastError);
      throw new IOException("Error performing elevation: " + lastError + ": " + errorMessage + " (apperror=" + execInfo.hInstApp + ")");
    } 
  }
}

package com.gigatronik.ebike.utils.window.uac;

import com.sun.jna.Native;
import com.sun.jna.Pointer;
import com.sun.jna.Structure;
import com.sun.jna.WString;
import com.sun.jna.platform.win32.Shell32;
import com.sun.jna.platform.win32.WinDef;
import com.sun.jna.platform.win32.WinNT;
import com.sun.jna.platform.win32.WinReg;
import com.sun.jna.win32.W32APIOptions;
import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.List;

public interface Shell32X extends Shell32 {
  public static final Shell32X INSTANCE = (Shell32X)Native.loadLibrary("shell32", Shell32X.class, W32APIOptions.UNICODE_OPTIONS);
  
  public static final int SW_HIDE = 0;
  
  public static final int SW_MAXIMIZE = 3;
  
  public static final int SW_MINIMIZE = 6;
  
  public static final int SW_RESTORE = 9;
  
  public static final int SW_SHOW = 5;
  
  public static final int SW_SHOWDEFAULT = 10;
  
  public static final int SW_SHOWMAXIMIZED = 3;
  
  public static final int SW_SHOWMINIMIZED = 2;
  
  public static final int SW_SHOWMINNOACTIVE = 7;
  
  public static final int SW_SHOWNA = 8;
  
  public static final int SW_SHOWNOACTIVATE = 4;
  
  public static final int SW_SHOWNORMAL = 1;
  
  public static final int SE_ERR_FNF = 2;
  
  public static final int SE_ERR_PNF = 3;
  
  public static final int SE_ERR_ACCESSDENIED = 5;
  
  public static final int SE_ERR_OOM = 8;
  
  public static final int SE_ERR_DLLNOTFOUND = 32;
  
  public static final int SE_ERR_SHARE = 26;
  
  public static final int SEE_MASK_NOCLOSEPROCESS = 64;
  
  int ShellExecute(int paramInt1, String paramString1, String paramString2, String paramString3, String paramString4, int paramInt2);
  
  boolean ShellExecuteEx(ShellExecuteInfo paramShellExecuteInfo);
  
  WinNT.HRESULT SetCurrentProcessExplicitAppUserModelID(WString paramWString);
  
  public static class ShellExecuteInfo extends Structure {
    public int cbSize = size();
    
    public int fMask;
    
    public WinDef.HWND hwnd;
    
    public WString lpVerb;
    
    public WString lpFile;
    
    public WString lpParameters;
    
    public WString lpDirectory;
    
    public int nShow;
    
    public WinDef.HINSTANCE hInstApp;
    
    public Pointer lpIDList;
    
    public WString lpClass;
    
    public WinReg.HKEY hKeyClass;
    
    public int dwHotKey;
    
    public WinNT.HANDLE hMonitor;
    
    public WinNT.HANDLE hProcess;
    
    protected List<String> getFieldOrder() {
      return Arrays.asList("cbSize", "fMask", "hwnd", "lpVerb", "lpFile", "lpParameters", "lpDirectory", "nShow", "hInstApp", "lpIDList", "lpClass", "hKeyClass", "dwHotKey", "hMonitor", "hProcess");
    }
  }
}

package com.gigatronik.ebike.utils.window.uac;

import com.sun.jna.WString;

public class WindowsNativeUtil {
  public static void setCurrentProcessExplicitAppUserModelID(String appID) throws Exception {
    if (0L != Shell32X.INSTANCE.SetCurrentProcessExplicitAppUserModelID(new WString(appID)).longValue())
      throw new Exception("Unable to set current process explicit AppUserModelID to: " + appID); 
  }
}
